package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet;

/**
 * Registry for background conversions: enqueue, cancel, observe, and recover.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Invariants the rest of the app relies on:
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;Raw files under conversion are &lt;b&gt;never written to&lt;/b&gt; — only read.
 *       Punch-in edits copy bytes out, so an edit can never invalidate an
 *       in-flight conversion. The only invalidations are delete and
 *       replace, which cancel the job first.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;One active job per raw file. Enqueueing for the same raw returns the
 *       existing job instead of doubling the work.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;Every state change is persisted to the job sidecar &lt;em&gt;and&lt;/em&gt;
 *       fanned out to {@link Listener}s, so the library, notifications and
 *       share warnings stay in sync whether the app is open or not.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 */
public final class ConversionJobs {

    public interface Listener {
        void onJobsChanged();
    }

    public static final class SaveResult {
        /** True when the file is ready now (incremental output adopted). */
        public final boolean adopted;
        public final File file;
        public final String label;
        public final long durationMs;
        public final String title;
        /** Non-null when the save went to the background worker. */
        public final ConversionJob job;

        private SaveResult(boolean adopted, File file, String label,
                           long durationMs, String title, ConversionJob job) {
            this.adopted = adopted;
            this.file = file;
            this.label = label;
            this.durationMs = durationMs;
            this.title = title;
            this.job = job;
        }

        static SaveResult adopted(File file, String label, long durationMs,
                                  String title) {
            return new SaveResult(true, file, label, durationMs, title, null);
        }

        static SaveResult background(ConversionJob job) {
            return new SaveResult(false, null, null, job.durationMs,
                    job.title, job);
        }
    }

    private ConversionJobs() {}

    /**
     * How long a save may spend finishing the incremental encoder inline
     * before giving up and converting in the background. Kept small on
     * purpose: a budget overrun is paid as visible latency on the UI thread,
     * and a backlog that cannot drain inside it is handed to the worker
     * anyway.
     */
    private static final long ADOPT_DRAIN_BUDGET_MS = 350L;

    /**
     * Largest unencoded backlog still worth draining inline (~1.5s of audio),
     * which encodes in well under the budget above.
     */
    private static final long MAX_INLINE_TAIL_FRAMES =
            RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE * 3L / 2L;

    private static final Map<String, ConversionJob> ACTIVE = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Set<Listener> LISTENERS = new CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
    /** rawPath -> finished library take id, for replace-after-completion. */
    private static final Map<String, Long> COMPLETED = new HashMap<>();
    /**
     * raws with an in-flight reader. The worker defers its raw.delete() while
     * one is open, so an Edit on a converting card cannot have the file
     * pulled out from under AudioImporter mid-decode.
     */
    private static final Map<String, Integer> RAW_READERS =
            new HashMap<>();
    /** Synthetic (negative) take id -> raw path, for edit-replace lookup. */
    private static final Map<Long, String> NEG_TO_RAW = new HashMap<>();
    /**
     * rawPath -> latest user-chosen title from a rename requested while its
     * take was converting. Kept separately from {@link ConversionJob#title}
     * so a rename that arrives after the worker read the title but before the
     * finished take is visible can still be applied exactly once.
     */
    private static final Map<String, String> RENAMED_TITLES = new HashMap<>();

    public static synchronized void addListener(Listener l) {
        if (l != null) LISTENERS.add(l);
    }

    public static synchronized void removeListener(Listener l) {
        LISTENERS.remove(l);
    }

    private static void fireChanged() {
        for (Listener l : LISTENERS) {
            try {
                l.onJobsChanged();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static synchronized List<ConversionJob> active() {
        return new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE.values());
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob get(String jobId) {
        return ACTIVE.get(jobId);
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob forRaw(String rawPath) {
        for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
            if (j.rawPath.equals(rawPath)) return j;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob forTakeId(long takeId) {
        for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
            if (j.takeId() == takeId) return j;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static synchronized void noteCompletion(String rawPath, long takeId) {
        COMPLETED.put(rawPath, takeId);
    }

    public static synchronized Long completedTakeIdForRaw(String rawPath) {
        return COMPLETED.get(rawPath);
    }

    /**
     * Atomically records a rename for a take that was (or still is)
     * converting. Updates the active job and sidecar when the job is still in
     * flight, remembers the override by raw path so the worker handoff cannot
     * miss it, and renames the finished take when the job already completed
     * while the rename dialog was open.
     *
     * <p>The repository rename happens after this class's lock is released:
     * the worker can hold the repository lock while calling back into this
     * registry, so nesting those two locks in the other order could deadlock.
     */
    public static String renameConvertingOrCompleted(String jobId,
                                                     long syntheticTakeId,
                                                     String rawPath,
                                                     String newTitle) {
        String clean = newTitle != null ? newTitle.trim() : "";
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        final String effectiveRaw;
        final Long doneId;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            ConversionJob job = null;
            if (jobId != null && !jobId.isEmpty()) {
                job = ACTIVE.get(jobId);
            }
            if (job == null && syntheticTakeId < 0) {
                for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
                    if (j.takeId() == syntheticTakeId) {
                        job = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (job == null && rawPath != null && !rawPath.isEmpty()) {
                for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
                    if (rawPath.equals(j.rawPath)) {
                        job = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            String eff = rawPath;
            if ((eff == null || eff.isEmpty()) && job != null) {
                eff = job.rawPath;
            }
            if ((eff == null || eff.isEmpty()) && syntheticTakeId < 0) {
                eff = NEG_TO_RAW.get(syntheticTakeId);
            }
            if (eff != null && !eff.isEmpty()) {
                RENAMED_TITLES.put(eff, clean);
            }
            if (job != null) {
                job.title = clean;
                if (job.replaceTitle != null) {
                    job.replaceTitle = clean;
                }
                job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
                job.write();
            }
            effectiveRaw = eff;
            doneId = (eff != null && !eff.isEmpty())
                    ? COMPLETED.get(eff) : null;
        }
        if (doneId != null) {
            TakesRepository.rename(doneId, clean);
        }
        fireChanged();
        return clean;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the most up-to-date title for {@code job}, honouring any rename
     * that arrived while the job was queued or running.
     */
    public static synchronized String latestTitle(ConversionJob job,
                                                  String fallback) {
        String cleanFallback = fallback != null ? fallback : "";
        if (job == null) return cleanFallback;
        String byRaw = RENAMED_TITLES.get(job.rawPath);
        if (byRaw != null && !byRaw.trim().isEmpty()) {
            job.title = byRaw.trim();
            return job.title;
        }
        if (job.title != null && !job.title.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return job.title.trim();
        }
        return cleanFallback;
    }

    /**
     * Takes and clears a pending rename override recorded by
     * {@link #renameConvertingOrCompleted}. The worker calls this after the
     * finished take is visible, then applies the result without holding this
     * class's lock.
     */
    public static synchronized String consumeRenamedTitle(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
        String renamed = RENAMED_TITLES.remove(rawPath);
        if (renamed == null || renamed.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        return renamed.trim();
    }

    /**
     * Reads a pending rename override without clearing it, so the worker can
     * decide which title a completion should carry while still honouring the
     * initial edit-replace title when no rename arrived.
     */
    public static synchronized String peekRenamedTitle(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
        String renamed = RENAMED_TITLES.get(rawPath);
        if (renamed == null || renamed.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        return renamed.trim();
    }

    public static synchronized void noteTakeRaw(long takeId, String rawPath) {
        NEG_TO_RAW.put(takeId, rawPath);
    }

    public static synchronized String rawForTakeId(long takeId) {
        return NEG_TO_RAW.get(takeId);
    }

    public static synchronized void forgetCompletion(String rawPath) {
        COMPLETED.remove(rawPath);
        RENAMED_TITLES.remove(rawPath);
    }

    /** Marks {@code rawPath} as being read. Pair every call with {@link #endRawRead}. */
    public static void beginRawRead(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            Integer n = RAW_READERS.get(rawPath);
            RAW_READERS.put(rawPath, n == null ? 1 : n + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void endRawRead(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        boolean lastReader;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            Integer n = RAW_READERS.get(rawPath);
            if (n == null) return;
            if (n <= 1) {
                RAW_READERS.remove(rawPath);
                lastReader = true;
            } else {
                RAW_READERS.put(rawPath, n - 1);
                lastReader = false;
            }
            if (lastReader && DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.remove(rawPath)
                    && forRaw(rawPath) == null) {
                // The worker finished while this reader held the file and
                // deferred its deletion: no job owns the raw anymore, so
                // remove it now instead of leaking it into reconcile().
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(rawPath).delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    /** Raws whose deletion was deferred until their last reader finishes. */
    private static final java.util.Set<String> DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES =
            new java.util.HashSet<>();

    /** True while some thread is decoding this raw. */
    public static synchronized boolean rawIsBeingRead(String rawPath) {
        return RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath);
    }

    /**
     * Deletes a finished conversion's raw immediately, unless a reader
     * (preview playback or edit import) still holds it open — then the
     * deletion is deferred to {@link #endRawRead} so the file can neither be
     * pulled out from under the reader nor leaked into reconcile().
     */
    public static void deleteOrDeferRaw(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            if (RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath)) {
                DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.add(rawPath);
                return;
            }
        }
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(rawPath).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Enqueues a background conversion for a finalized raw take. Returns the
     * existing job when one is already active for the same raw.
     */
    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs) {
        return enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, durationMs, -1, null);
    }

    /**
     * Same, carrying edit-replace lineage: when the job completes, the take
     * with {@code replaceTakeId} is replaced (under {@code replaceTitle})
     * instead of adding a duplicate.
     */
    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs,
                                                     long replaceTakeId,
                                                     String replaceTitle) {
        ConversionJob existing = forRaw(raw.getAbsolutePath());
        if (existing != null) return existing;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        // AUDIT-3-02 fix: read the geometry from the `raw` file itself.
        // The engine may be idle/cleared (dataBytes 0, channels back to its
        // 2 default) at enqueue time, which recorded framesTotal = 1 and the
        // wrong channel count for a mono take.
        int ch = Math.max(1, e.channels);
        long bytes = e.dataBytes;
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
            ch = Math.max(1, info.channels);
            bytes = info.dataBytes;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        long framesTotal = Math.max(1, bytes / 4 / ch);
        String jobTitle = (replaceTitle != null && !replaceTitle.trim().isEmpty())
                ? replaceTitle.trim()
                : (title != null ? title : "");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                jobTitle,
                raw.getAbsolutePath(),
                ConversionJob.partFor(raw).getAbsolutePath(),
                preset != null ? preset.id : RecordPreset.MEMO.id,
                format != null ? format.id : SaveFormat.AUTO.id,
                ch,
                preset != null ? preset.aacBitrate : 128000,
                Math.max(durationMs, 1000),
                framesTotal);
        job.replaceTakeId = replaceTakeId;
        job.replaceTitle = replaceTitle;
        NEG_TO_RAW.put(job.takeId(), raw.getAbsolutePath());
        ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
        job.write();
        fireChanged();
        return job;
    }

    /**
     * Cancels a job: stops the worker, deletes partial output and — when
     * {@code deleteRaw} — the raw take itself. The sidecar always goes.
     * When the raw is kept it gets its pending marker back, so the next
     * launch offers the usual continue/discard recovery instead of leaking
     * an invisible file.
     */
    public static synchronized boolean cancel(String jobId, boolean deleteRaw) {
        ConversionJob job = ACTIVE.get(jobId);
        if (job == null) return false;
        job.cancelled = true;
        job.state = ConversionJob.CANCELLED;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        job.write();
        ACTIVE.remove(jobId);
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(job.partPath).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        job.deleteSidecar();
        if (deleteRaw) {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(job.rawPath).delete();
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(job.rawPath + ".pending").delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            forgetCompletion(job.rawPath);
        } else {
            try {
                File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
                if (raw.exists()) {
                    RecordingEngine.writePendingMarker(raw, job.title,
                            job.channels);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        fireChanged();
        return true;
    }

    /** Cancels by library card id (negative synthetic ids map to jobs). */
    public static synchronized boolean cancelByTakeId(long takeId,
                                                      boolean deleteRaw) {
        ConversionJob job = forTakeId(takeId);
        return job != null && cancel(job.jobId, deleteRaw);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves or cancels the source of an Edit -> Replace save BEFORE the
     * edited take is converted or adopted.
     *
     * <ul>
     *   <li>If {@code replaceTakeId < 0} and the original conversion job is
     *       still queued or running, cancels it immediately (marking it
     *       {@code superseded} and deleting its raw + part + sidecar) so the
     *       worker never wastes time finishing the obsolete original file,
     *       and returns {@code -1} because no finished library row exists to
     *       replace.</li>
     *   <li>If {@code replaceTakeId < 0} and the original conversion job
     *       already finished while the user was editing, returns the positive
     *       {@code Take.id} of that finished take so the replacement deletes
     *       it.</li>
     * </ul>
     */
    public static long cancelForReplace(Context ctx, long replaceTakeId) {
        if (replaceTakeId >= 0) return replaceTakeId;
        String jobIdToCancel = null;
        Long finishedId;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            ConversionJob srcJob = forTakeId(replaceTakeId);
            String srcRaw = srcJob != null ? srcJob.rawPath
                    : NEG_TO_RAW.get(replaceTakeId);
            if (srcJob != null) {
                srcJob.superseded = true;
                srcJob.cancelled = true;
                jobIdToCancel = srcJob.jobId;
                cancel(srcJob.jobId, true);
            }
            finishedId = (srcRaw != null) ? COMPLETED.get(srcRaw) : null;
        }
        if (jobIdToCancel != null && ctx != null) {
            ConversionService.cancelJob(ctx, jobIdToCancel);
            ConversionService.onRecordingStateChanged();
        }
        return finishedId != null ? finishedId : -1L;
    }

    /**
     * Cancels any active background conversion job that was scheduled to
     * replace {@code deletedTakeId}. Prevents a replacement conversion from
     * resurrecting a take that the user deleted while the conversion was
     * still in flight.
     */
    public static void cancelForDeletedTargetTake(Context ctx, long deletedTakeId) {
        if (deletedTakeId < 0) return;
        List<String> jobsToCancel = new ArrayList<>();
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            for (ConversionJob j : new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE.values())) {
                if (j.replaceTakeId == deletedTakeId) {
                    j.superseded = true;
                    j.cancelled = true;
                    jobsToCancel.add(j.jobId);
                    cancel(j.jobId, true);
                }
            }
        }
        if (ctx != null) {
            for (String jid : jobsToCancel) {
                ConversionService.cancelJob(ctx, jid);
            }
            if (!jobsToCancel.isEmpty()) {
                ConversionService.onRecordingStateChanged();
            }
        }
    }

    static synchronized void updateProgress(ConversionJob job, int pct,
                                            long framesDone) {
        job.progress = pct;
        job.framesDone = framesDone;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if ((pct % 5) == 0 || pct >= 100) job.write();
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markRunning(ConversionJob job) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        job.write();
        if (!ACTIVE.containsKey(job.jobId)) ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markDone(ConversionJob job) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.DONE;
        job.progress = 100;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ACTIVE.remove(job.jobId);
        job.deleteSidecar();
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markFailed(ConversionJob job, String error) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.FAILED;
        job.error = error;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ACTIVE.remove(job.jobId);
        job.deleteSidecar();
        fireChanged();
    }

    /**
     * Startup sweep: resurrect interrupted jobs, drop garbage. Returns the
     * jobs the worker should run. Stale sidecars (orphaned > 7 days) and
     * partial outputs without a sidecar are deleted.
     */
    public static synchronized List<ConversionJob> sweep(Context ctx) {
        List<ConversionJob> resume = new ArrayList<>();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File[] files;
        try {
            files = dir.listFiles();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            files = null;
        }
        if (files == null) return resume;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Set<String> liveParts = new HashSet<>();
        // A live capture owns a .part with no sidecar yet. Sweep used to
        // assume it only ran at cold start, but the service sweeps on every
        // start command, so this file was deleted out from under the running
        // StreamingEncoder mid-recording.
        File activeRaw = RecordingEngine.get().rawFile;
        if (activeRaw != null) {
            liveParts.add(ConversionJob.partFor(activeRaw).getAbsolutePath());
        }
        // Same protection for a session that is being written but not yet
        // finalized (a .pending marker sits beside it).
        for (File f : files) {
            if (f.isFile() && f.getName().endsWith(".pending")) {
                String rawName = f.getName().substring(0,
                        f.getName().length() - ".pending".length());
                liveParts.add(new File(dir, rawName + ".part")
                        .getAbsolutePath());
            }
        }
        for (File f : files) {
            if (f.isFile() && f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json.tmp")) {
                String mainName = f.getName().substring(
                        0, f.getName().length() - ".tmp".length());
                File mainSidecar = new File(dir, mainName);
                if (!mainSidecar.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    f.renameTo(mainSidecar);
                } else {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    f.delete();
                }
            }
        }
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json")) continue;
            ConversionJob job = ConversionJob.read(f);
            if (job == null) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            liveParts.add(job.partPath);
            // Already tracked in memory (RUNNING or QUEUED): keep the live
            // instance. Replacing it reset progress to 0 and let the queue run
            // the same jobId twice, the second run reporting a false failure
            // because the raw was already gone.
            ConversionJob inMem = ACTIVE.get(job.jobId);
            if (inMem != null) {
                resume.add(inMem);
                continue;
            }
            boolean stale = now - job.updatedAt > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L;
            File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
            if (stale || !raw.exists()
                    || ConversionJob.DONE.equals(job.state)
                    || ConversionJob.FAILED.equals(job.state)
                    || ConversionJob.CANCELLED.equals(job.state)) {
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(job.partPath).delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            job.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
            job.cancelled = false;
            job.write();
            NEG_TO_RAW.put(job.takeId(), job.rawPath);
            ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
            resume.add(job);
        }
        // Partial outputs with no sidecar are crash garbage — except the one
        // a live capture may be writing right now (protected above).
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !f.getName().endsWith(".part")) continue;
            if (!liveParts.contains(f.getAbsolutePath())) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
            }
        }
        if (!resume.isEmpty()) fireChanged();
        return resume;
    }

    /**
     * The unified save dispatch: finalize the raw, then either adopt the
     * incremental output (fast path) or enqueue a background job. Never
     * blocks on conversion work beyond draining the incremental tail.
     */
    public static SaveResult dispatchSave(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                          SaveFormat format,
                                          StreamingEncoder.Progress cb) {
        return dispatchSave(ctx, preset, format, cb, -1, null);
    }

    /**
     * Same, carrying edit-replace lineage into the background job when the
     * fast path misses.
     */
    public static SaveResult dispatchSave(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                          SaveFormat format,
                                          StreamingEncoder.Progress cb,
                                          long replaceTakeId,
                                          String replaceTitle) {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        File raw = e.finalizeRawForSave();
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        }
        // If replacing a take that is still converting (replaceTakeId < 0),
        // cancel the original conversion job immediately so we never convert
        // the original file first and then convert the edited file second.
        if (replaceTakeId < 0) {
            replaceTakeId = cancelForReplace(ctx, replaceTakeId);
        }
        // If the original take already exists in the library (either because
        // the user edited a finished take, or because the converting take
        // finished while the user was editing in Studio), delete the previous
        // take and its file immediately before starting the new conversion!
        if (replaceTakeId > 0) {
            TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replaceTakeId);
            replaceTakeId = -1L;
        }
        String title = (replaceTitle != null && !replaceTitle.trim().isEmpty())
                ? replaceTitle.trim()
                : (e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "");
        long dur = Math.max(e.durationMs(), 1000);
        StreamingEncoder sess = e.endStreamingDetach();
        SaveFormat eff = format.effective(preset);
        if (eff == SaveFormat.AUTO) eff = SaveFormat.M4A;
        // An enabled-but-unbaked FX chain invalidates the incremental output:
        // the pump encoded raw microphone frames, so its .part would ship
        // without a single effect. Drop it and let the worker convert the
        // FX-baked raw instead of silently losing the whole chain.
        if (e.isFxBakeRequired()) {
            if (sess != null) {
                try {
                    sess.abort();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                sess = null;
            }
            // Bake the active FX chain into `raw` here so saves triggered from
            // the notification shade (RecordingService calls dispatchSave
            // directly) or any other path that skipped StudioFragment's
            // doSaveSequence() bake still include the user's unbaked chain
            // instead of converting dry audio.
            try {
                if (ctx != null) {
                    DspChain.Config cfg = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
                    if (cfg != null && cfg.isActive()) {
                        FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4
                                / Math.max(1, info.channels);
                        if (totalFrames > 0) {
                            DspChain chain = new DspChain(info.channels, cfg);
                            EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, 0, totalFrames,
                                     chain, null);
                            e.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "dispatchSave fx bake failed: " + ex);
            }
            e.setFxBakeRequired(false);
        }
        // framesEncoded() > 0 is NOT evidence that the pump kept up: a
        // format switch restarts the encoder from the top of the raw file, so
        // it reports progress after its first chunk while nearly the whole
        // take is still unencoded. Only drain inline when the real backlog is
        // tiny; otherwise skip straight to the worker with no stall at all.
        boolean canAdoptInline = sess != null && sess.healthy()
                && sess.matches(preset, format)
                && sess.framesEncoded() > 0
                && sess.unencodedFrames() <= MAX_INLINE_TAIL_FRAMES;
        if (canAdoptInline) {
            try {
                if (!sess.finish(ADOPT_DRAIN_BUDGET_MS)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("drain budget exceeded");
                }
                if (sess.finishedOk()) {
                    File part = sess.partFile();
                    // Same guard as the background path: a pass-through FLAC
                    // encoder hands back a near-full-size file under a
                    // lossless label. Fall through to the worker, which
                    // re-encodes as WAV24.
                    if (eff == SaveFormat.FLAC
                            && TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(part.length(),
                            raw.length())) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "flac ineffective; fallback to worker");
                    }
                    FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
                    File fin = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw,
                            eff.extension());
                    if (!part.renameTo(fin)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("adopt failed");
                    }
                    if (!fin.equals(raw)) {
                        // Keep the scratch only when it is the result.
                        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                        raw.delete();
                    }
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
                    return SaveResult.adopted(fin,
                            TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, format), dur, title);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "stream adopt failed: " + ex);
            }
            // abort(), never a bare unlink: a timed-out finish() leaves the
            // pump running, and only abort() stops it. Enqueuing a job onto
            // the same part path while that thread still writes it corrupts
            // the container.
            sess.abort();
        } else if (sess != null) {
            sess.abort();
        }
        ConversionJob job = enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, dur,
                replaceTakeId, replaceTitle);
        // The sidecar now exists, so recovery no longer needs the pending
        // marker. Keep it until this instant to close the finalize/enqueue
        // crash window.
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(0);
        return SaveResult.background(job);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

/**
 * Library store. The in-memory list stays the synchronous UI model, but
 * every row is mirrored into Room, so the library (titles, favorites,
 * positions, lineage) survives process death. All database work runs on a
 * single background thread, in order, so callers never block and writes
 * can never overtake the initial load.
 */
public final class TakesRepository {

    /** Removed takes + their positions, so a delete can be undone. */
    public static final class RestoreOp {
        public final List&lt;Take&gt; takes = new ArrayList<>();
        public final List&lt;Integer&gt; positions = new ArrayList<>();
        /** Parallel to takes: trash location, or null if hard-deleted. */
        public final List&lt;String&gt; trashPaths = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    /** Startup reconcile outcome, for the one summary popup. */
    public static final class ReconcileResult {
        public int adopted;
        public int pruned;
        public int rawsCleaned;
        public long trashFreedBytes;
    }

    /** Trash retention: week-old soft deletes are reaped on startup. */
    private static final long TRASH_MAX_AGE_MS = 7L * 24 * 3600_000L;

    private static final List&lt;Take&gt; TAKES = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final AtomicLong IDS = new AtomicLong(100);
    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY_SEEDED = "library_seeded_once";
    /**
     * Probe attempts that never reported back. A native parser death
     * mid-probe leaves the mark behind (nothing after it runs), so the next
     * launch skips that file instead of dying on it again.
     */
    private static final String KEY_PROBE_TRIED = "probe_tried_paths";

    private static volatile boolean ready;
    private static final List&lt;Runnable&gt; READY_QUEUE = new ArrayList<>();
    private static TakeDatabase db;
    private static Context app;
    private static final ExecutorService IO = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private static volatile ReconcileResult lastReconcile;

    private TakesRepository() {}

    // ---- lifecycle ----

    /** Idempotent. Loads rows, seeds once, reconciles disk, then fires ready. */
    public static synchronized void init(Context ctx) {
        if (app != null) return;
        app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        db = TakeDatabase.get(app);
        IO.execute(TakesRepository::loadReconcileSeed);
    }

    public static boolean isReady() {
        return ready;
    }

    /** Runs now (main thread) if ready, else right after load finishes. */
    public static void onReady(Runnable r) {
        boolean run;
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            run = ready;
            if (!run) READY_QUEUE.add(r);
        }
        if (run) r.run();
    }

    public static ReconcileResult lastReconcile() {
        return lastReconcile;
    }

    private static void loadReconcileSeed() {
        List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; rows = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            rows = db.takes().allOrdered();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        List&lt;Runnable&gt; queued;
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            // A4-06: the DB load runs on the IO executor while a save or an
            // import can already have called addRecording()/addTake() on
            // another thread. Blanket-clearing would wipe those entries
            // (and could hand out a colliding id), so keep anything already
            // in memory and only ever move the id counter forward.
            List&lt;Take&gt; pending = new ArrayList<>(TAKES);
            TAKES.clear();
            long max = 99;
            Set&lt;Long&gt; seenIds = new HashSet<>();
            for (TakeEntity e : rows) {
                try {
                    Take t = e.toTake();
                    TAKES.add(t);
                    seenIds.add(t.id);
                    if (t.id > max) max = t.id;
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            for (Take t : pending) {
                if (seenIds.contains(t.id)) {
                    // A save raced the load and reused an id the database
                    // already owns. Re-id the in-memory copy so the adapter's
                    // stable ids stay unique and the write-through inserts a
                    // distinct row instead of replacing the existing one.
                    Take copy = new Take(++max, t.title, t.durationMs,
                            t.timestamp, t.sizeLabel, t.format, t.favorite,
                            t.filePath);
                    copy.origin = t.origin;
                    copy.lastPositionMs = t.lastPositionMs;
                    copy.markersJson = t.markersJson;
                    TAKES.add(copy);
                    seenIds.add(copy.id);
                    persistAsync(copy);
                } else {
                    TAKES.add(t);
                    seenIds.add(t.id);
                    if (t.id > max) max = t.id;
                }
            }
            IDS.set(Math.max(IDS.get(), max + 1));
            sortByTimestampDesc();
        }
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "repo rows=" + TAKES.size());
        ReconcileResult rr = new ReconcileResult();
        try {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile start");
            rr = reconcile(app);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile end adopted=" + rr.adopted
                    + " pruned=" + rr.pruned + " raws=" + rr.rawsCleaned);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // A poisoned disk state (truncated files, I/O errors) must never
            // take the app down on every launch: degrade to whatever loaded
            // from the database and still signal ready so the UI can open.
            android.util.Log.w("TakesRepository", "reconcile failed", e);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile FAILED: " + e);
        }
        lastReconcile = rr;
        // Interrupted background conversions resume from their sidecars;
        // crash garbage (orphan parts) is swept here, before any capture.
        // Every resurrected job is (re)started: the worker serialises them,
        // so starting only the first would strand the rest until the next
        // process start that happens to resweep.
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(app);
            for (ConversionJob job : resume) {
                ConversionService.startJob(app, job.jobId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "conversion sweep FAILED: " + e);
        }
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            ready = true;
            queued = new ArrayList<>(READY_QUEUE);
            READY_QUEUE.clear();
        }
        android.os.Handler main = new android.os.Handler(
                android.os.Looper.getMainLooper());
        for (Runnable r : queued) main.post(r);
    }

    private static void sortByTimestampDesc() {
        TAKES.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.timestamp, a.timestamp));
    }

    // ---- reads (synchronous, in-memory) ----

    public static synchronized List&lt;Take&gt; all() {
        return new ArrayList<>(TAKES);
    }

    public static synchronized Take find(long id) {
        for (Take t : TAKES) {
            if (t.id == id) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ---- mutations (synchronous cache + ordered async write-through) ----

    public static synchronized Take addRecording(File file, long durationMs) {
        Take t = buildTake(file, durationMs, null, null);
        TAKES.add(0, t);
        persistAsync(t);
        return t;
    }

    public static synchronized Take addRecording(File file, long durationMs,
                                                 String title, String format) {
        Take t = buildTake(file, durationMs, title, format);
        TAKES.add(0, t);
        persistAsync(t);
        return t;
    }

    /** Used by reconcile + tests to insert a fully-formed take. */
    public static synchronized Take addTake(Take t) {
        TAKES.add(t);
        sortByTimestampDesc();
        persistAsync(t);
        return t;
    }

    /**
     * Edit-replace mutation shared by the studio fast path and the
     * background worker (BUG-02): deletes the original take and inserts the
     * re-saved file under the original title. A negative
     * {@code originalId} means the source was still converting when the edit
     * began — its job is cancelled and a take that finished mid-edit is
     * resolved the same way the studio dialog does.
     */
    /**
     * Immediately deletes a take (and its backing file) when the user chooses
     * Replace in the editor, so the obsolete file is removed right away before
     * the new conversion starts.
     */
    public static synchronized boolean deleteImmediateForReplace(long targetId) {
        if (targetId < 0) {
            targetId = ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(app, targetId);
        }
        if (targetId <= 0) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < TAKES.size(); i++) {
            if (TAKES.get(i).id == targetId) {
                Take t = TAKES.remove(i);
                deleteBackingFile(t);
                deleteAsync(targetId);
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static synchronized Take replaceRecording(long originalId,
                                                     File saved,
                                                     long durationMs,
                                                     String title,
                                                     String format) {
        long targetId = originalId;
        if (targetId < 0) {
            targetId = ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(app, targetId);
        }
        if (targetId > 0) {
            deleteImmediateForReplace(targetId);
        }
        return addRecording(saved, durationMs, title, format);
    }

    private static Take buildTake(File file, long durationMs,
                                  String title, String format) {
        String size = Dsp.sizeLabel(file.length());
        String name = file.getName();
        String ext = "M4A";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0 && dot < name.length() - 1) {
            ext = name.substring(dot + 1).toUpperCase(Locale.US);
        }
        String base = Dsp.prettyFileTitle(name);
        String t = title != null ? title.trim() : "";
        if (t.isEmpty()) t = base;
        String f = format != null ? format.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.US) : "";
        if (f.isEmpty()) f = ext;
        Take take = new Take(IDS.getAndIncrement(), t, durationMs,
                System.currentTimeMillis(), size, f, false, file.getAbsolutePath());
        take.origin = "recorded";
        return take;
    }

    public static synchronized void toggleFavorite(long id) {
        Take t = find(id);
        if (t != null) {
            t.favorite = !t.favorite;
            persistAsync(t);
        }
    }

    public static synchronized void rename(long id, String newTitle) {
        Take t = find(id);
        if (t != null && newTitle != null && !newTitle.trim().isEmpty()) {
            t.title = newTitle.trim();
            persistAsync(t);
        }
    }

    public static synchronized void updatePosition(long id, long posMs) {
        Take t = find(id);
        if (t == null) return;
        t.lastPositionMs = Math.max(0, posMs);
        final long pid = id;
        final long ppos = t.lastPositionMs;
        IO.execute(() -> {
            try {
                if (db != null) db.takes().updatePosition(pid, ppos);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    public static synchronized void delete(long id) {
        ConversionJobs.cancelForDeletedTargetTake(app, id);
        for (int i = 0; i < TAKES.size(); i++) {
            if (TAKES.get(i).id == id) {
                Take t = TAKES.remove(i);
                trashBackingFile(t);
                deleteAsync(id);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    public static synchronized RestoreOp deleteMany(Set&lt;Long&gt; ids) {
        return deleteManyInternal(ids, true);
    }

    private static synchronized RestoreOp deleteManyInternal(
            Set&lt;Long&gt; ids, boolean cancelReplacingJobs) {
        RestoreOp op = new RestoreOp();
        if (ids == null || ids.isEmpty()) return op;
        if (cancelReplacingJobs) {
            for (Long id : ids) {
                if (id != null && id > 0) {
                    ConversionJobs.cancelForDeletedTargetTake(app, id);
                }
            }
        }
        List&lt;Long&gt; gone = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = TAKES.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (ids.contains(TAKES.get(i).id)) {
                op.takes.add(0, TAKES.get(i));
                op.positions.add(0, i);
                op.trashPaths.add(0, trashBackingFile(TAKES.get(i)));
                gone.add(TAKES.get(i).id);
                TAKES.remove(i);
            }
        }
        if (!gone.isEmpty()) {
            final List&lt;Long&gt; idsCopy = new ArrayList<>(gone);
            IO.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    if (db != null) db.takes().deleteByIds(idsCopy);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            });
        }
        return op;
    }

    public static synchronized void restore(RestoreOp op) {
        if (op == null) return;
        List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; rows = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < op.takes.size(); i++) {
            int pos = Math.min(op.positions.get(i), TAKES.size());
            Take t = op.takes.get(i);
            // Bring the audio back too when it went through the trash.
            if (i < op.trashPaths.size() && op.trashPaths.get(i) != null
                    && t.filePath != null) {
                // A4-09: the restored file may land on a uniquified name, so
                // follow it and persist the real path, otherwise the row
                // points at a file that is not there.
                File back = Dsp.restoreFromTrash(
                        new File(op.trashPaths.get(i)), new File(t.filePath));
                if (back != null) t.filePath = back.getAbsolutePath();
            }
            TAKES.add(pos, t);
            rows.add(TakeEntity.fromTake(t));
        }
        if (!rows.isEmpty()) {
            final List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; copy = new ArrayList<>(rows);
            IO.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    if (db != null) db.takes().upsertAll(copy);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            });
        }
    }

    private static void persistAsync(Take t) {
        final TakeEntity e = TakeEntity.fromTake(t);
        IO.execute(() -> {
            try {
                if (db != null) db.takes().upsert(e);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    private static void deleteAsync(long id) {
        IO.execute(() -> {
            try {
                if (db != null) db.takes().deleteById(id);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /**
     * Soft-delete: the file moves to .trash so undo restores audio, not
     * just the entry. Falls back to a straight delete when the move fails.
     *
     * @return trash location, or null when hard-deleted / no file.
     */
    private static String trashBackingFile(Take t) {
        if (t.filePath == null) return null;
        File src = new File(t.filePath);
        if (!src.exists()) return null;
        try {
            File takesDir = app != null
                    ? RecordingEngine.takesDir(app) : src.getParentFile();
            File trashed = Dsp.moveToTrash(takesDir, src);
            if (trashed != null) return trashed.getAbsolutePath();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        deleteBackingFile(t);
        return null;
    }

    private static void deleteBackingFile(Take t) {
        if (t.filePath != null) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(t.filePath).delete();
        }
    }

    // ---- first-run demo seeding (once ever) ----

    private static boolean seededOnce(Context ctx) {
        try {
            SharedPreferences p = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            return p.getBoolean(KEY_SEEDED, false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return true; // fail closed: never reseed blindly
        }
    }

    private static void markSeeded(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putBoolean(KEY_SEEDED, true).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void seedDemos(Context ctx) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long h = 3600_000L;
        long d = 24 * h;
        List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; rows = new ArrayList<>();
        Take[] demos = {
                demo(1, "Midnight Vocals — Take 7", 252000, now - 2 * h, "4.1 MB", "WAV", true),
                demo(2, "Quick Humming Idea", 44000, now - 40 * 60_000L, "0.8 MB", "M4A", false),
                demo(3, "Podcast Intro Draft", 107000, now - 20 * h, "1.8 MB", "M4A", false),
                demo(4, "Guitar Riff Idea", 38000, now - 3 * d, "0.7 MB", "WAV", true),
                demo(5, "Voice Memo — Meeting", 725000, now - 9 * d, "11.9 MB", "M4A", false),
                demo(6, "Drum Loop Test", 56000, now - 15 * d, "1.0 MB", "WAV", false),
        };
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            for (Take t : demos) {
                TAKES.add(t);
                rows.add(TakeEntity.fromTake(t));
            }
            IDS.set(100);
            sortByTimestampDesc();
        }
        try {
            db.takes().upsertAll(rows);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        markSeeded(ctx);
    }

    private static Take demo(long id, String title, long dur, long ts,
                             String size, String fmt, boolean fav) {
        Take t = new Take(id, title, dur, ts, size, fmt, fav, null);
        t.origin = "demo";
        return t;
    }

    // ---- startup reconcile ----

    private static final String[] AUDIO_EXTS = {
            "wav", "m4a", "3gp", "3ga", "flac", "opus", "webm", "mp3", "ogg",
            "aac",
    };

    private static boolean isAudioFile(String name) {
        String lower = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (lower.endsWith(".pending")) return false;
        int dot = lower.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot < 0) return false;
        String ext = lower.substring(dot + 1);
        for (String a : AUDIO_EXTS) {
            if (a.equals(ext)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String stemOf(String name) {
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        String stem = dot > 0 ? name.substring(0, dot) : name;
        // Scratch raws are "&lt;base&gt;.raw.wav"; strip that marker so a finished
        // conversion groups with its leftover raw instead of orphaning it.
        stem = stem.replaceFirst("\\.raw$", "");
        // Old WAV saves landed as "&lt;base&gt; (2).wav" because the raw
        // "&lt;base&gt;.wav" still existed when uniqueFinal() ran. Strip the
        // uniquifier too so legacy leftovers still group.
        return stem.replaceFirst("\\s*\\(\\d+\\)$", "");
    }

    /**
     * Makes disk and database agree: seeds demos once on a truly fresh
     * install, drops rows whose files vanished, deletes finalized raw
     * leftovers shadowed by a finished conversion, and adopts orphaned
     * recordings back into the library. Files with a .pending marker are
     * left alone — the unfinished-take flow owns them.
     */
    static ReconcileResult reconcile(Context ctx) {
        ReconcileResult rr = new ReconcileResult();
        File dir;
        try {
            dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return rr;
        }
        File[] files = dir.listFiles();
        if (files == null) files = new File[0];

        // Week-old soft deletes are reaped so the trash can't grow forever.
        // Runs before adoption so a resurrected file is never swept same-boot.
        try {
            rr.trashFreedBytes = Dsp.pruneTrash(Dsp.trashDir(dir), TRASH_MAX_AGE_MS);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        Map<String, File> byPath = new HashMap<>();
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            for (Take t : TAKES) {
                if (t.filePath != null) byPath.put(t.filePath, new File(t.filePath));
            }
        }

        Set&lt;String&gt; pendingStems = new HashSet<>();
        for (File f : files) {
            // NEW-03 fix: a stem with an interrupted conversion sidecar must
            // be left alone (sweep resumes it); otherwise the raw leftover
            // cleaner or the orphan adopter races the worker.
            if (f.getName().endsWith(".pending")
                    || f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json")) {
                String n = f.getName()
                        .replaceFirst("\\.pending$", "")
                        .replaceFirst("\\.conv\\.json$", "");
                pendingStems.add(stemOf(n));
            }
        }

        // 1) Prune rows whose backing files are gone.
        List&lt;Long&gt; prune = new ArrayList<>();
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            for (Take t : TAKES) {
                if (t.filePath != null && !(new File(t.filePath).exists())) {
                    prune.add(t.id);
                }
            }
            for (long id : prune) {
                for (int i = TAKES.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if (TAKES.get(i).id == id) TAKES.remove(i);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!prune.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                db.takes().deleteByIds(prune);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            rr.pruned = prune.size();
        }

        // Refresh the referenced set after pruning.
        Set&lt;String&gt; referenced = new HashSet<>();
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            for (Take t : TAKES) {
                if (t.filePath != null) referenced.add(t.filePath);
            }
        }

        // 2) Finalized raw leftovers: a float32 .wav sharing a stem with a
        // finished conversion (and no .pending / .conv.json) is a
        // crashed-save remnant.
        Map<String, List&lt;File&gt;> byStem = new HashMap<>();
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !isAudioFile(f.getName())) continue;
            String stem = stemOf(f.getName());
            List&lt;File&gt; g = byStem.get(stem);
            if (g == null) {
                g = new ArrayList<>();
                byStem.put(stem, g);
            }
            g.add(f);
        }
        for (Map.Entry<String, List&lt;File&gt;> e : byStem.entrySet()) {
            List&lt;File&gt; g = e.getValue();
            if (g.size() < 2 || pendingStems.contains(e.getKey())) continue;
            boolean hasFinal = false;
            File floatWav = null;
            for (File f : g) {
                String n = f.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.US);
                if (n.endsWith(".wav") && isFloat32Wav(f)) {
                    floatWav = f;
                } else {
                    hasFinal = true;
                }
            }
            if (hasFinal && floatWav != null && !referenced.contains(
                    floatWav.getAbsolutePath())) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                if (floatWav.delete()) rr.rawsCleaned++;
            }
        }

        // 3) Adopt orphans back into the library.
        List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; adopted = new ArrayList<>();
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !isAudioFile(f.getName())) continue;
            if (f.getName().contains("_subrep_")) {
                // A crashed Select & Replace snippet is never a standalone
                // take; the parent raw remains the only source of truth.
                RecordingEngine.deletePendingMarker(f);
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            String abs = f.getAbsolutePath();
            if (referenced.contains(abs)) continue;
            if (pendingStems.contains(stemOf(f.getName()))) continue;
            if (!f.exists()) continue;
            Take t = adoptFile(ctx, f);
            if (t == null) continue;
            synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
                TAKES.add(t);
                referenced.add(abs);
            }
            adopted.add(TakeEntity.fromTake(t));
            rr.adopted++;
        }
        if (!adopted.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                db.takes().upsertAll(adopted);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
                sortByTimestampDesc();
            }
        }

        // 4) New installs start with an empty library: no synthetic demos.
        markSeeded(ctx);
        return rr;
    }

    private static boolean hasAnyAudio(File[] files) {
        for (File f : files) {
            if (f.isFile() && isAudioFile(f.getName())) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** NEW-07 fix: use {@link Dsp#parseWavHeader(java.io.RandomAccessFile)}. */
    private static boolean isFloat32Wav(File f) {
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            return h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Distinguish integer 24-bit WAV from the standard 16/float badge. */
    private static String wavBadge(File f) {
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r =
                     new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 24) return "WAV24";
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return "WAV";
    }

    /** True when an ASCII/byte token occurs anywhere in the file. */
    private static boolean containsToken(File f, byte[] token) {
        if (f == null || token == null || token.length == 0) return false;
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r =
                     new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int carry = 0;
            long left = r.length();
            r.seek(0);
            while (left > 0) {
                int n = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                r.readFully(buf, 0, n);
                left -= n;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (buf[i] == token[carry]) {
                        if (++carry == token.length) return true;
                    } else {
                        carry = buf[i] == token[0] ? 1 : 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    private static Take adoptFile(Context ctx, File f) {
        try {
            String ext = "";
            String n = f.getName();
            int dot = n.lastIndexOf('.');
            if (dot > 0) ext = n.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            long dur = Dsp.wavDurationMs(f);
            if (dur < 0) {
                // Truncated conversion remnants (< 2 KB) are adopted with a
                // fallback duration instead of being fed to the platform
                // parser: never let a half-written file near stagefright.
                // Files whose probe never reported back (native death
                // mid-probe) are skipped the same way, once and for all.
                String abs = f.getAbsolutePath();
                if (f.length() < 2048 || probeTried(ctx, abs)) dur = 1000;
                else dur = probeDuration(ctx, f);
            }
            if (dur < 0) dur = 1000;
            String badge;
            switch (ext) {
                case "wav":
                    badge = wavBadge(f);
                    break;
                case "m4a":
                    badge = "M4A";
                    break;
                case "3gp":
                case "3ga":
                    badge = containsToken(f, new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'})
                            ? "AMR-WB" : "AMR";
                    break;
                case "flac":
                    badge = "FLAC";
                    break;
                case "opus":
                case "webm":
                    badge = "OPUS";
                    break;
                case "mp3":
                    badge = "MP3";
                    break;
                default:
                    badge = ext.toUpperCase(Locale.US);
                    break;
            }
            Take t;
            synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
                t = new Take(IDS.getAndIncrement(), Dsp.prettyFileTitle(n), dur,
                        Math.max(1, f.lastModified()), Dsp.sizeLabel(f.length()),
                        badge, false, f.getAbsolutePath());
                t.origin = "recovered";
            }
            return t;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static long probeDuration(Context ctx, File f) {
        String abs = f.getAbsolutePath();
        // Marked BEFORE the probe with a synchronous write: if the parser
        // dies natively, nothing after this runs and the mark survives.
        markProbeTried(ctx, abs, true);
        MediaMetadataRetriever r = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
        try {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "probe " + abs);
            r.setDataSource(abs);
            String d = r.extractMetadata(
                    MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
            long ms = (long) Math.max(0, Double.parseDouble(d));
            markProbeTried(ctx, abs, false);
            return ms;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Catchable failure (unsupported file, no metadata): allow a
            // retry next launch, it throws the same way every time.
            markProbeTried(ctx, abs, false);
            return -1;
        } finally {
            try {
                r.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private static boolean probeTried(Context ctx, String abs) {
        try {
            Set&lt;String&gt; s = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getStringSet(KEY_PROBE_TRIED, null);
            return s != null && s.contains(abs);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static void markProbeTried(Context ctx, String abs, boolean tried) {
        try {
            SharedPreferences p =
                    ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            Set&lt;String&gt; cur = p.getStringSet(KEY_PROBE_TRIED, null);
            Set&lt;String&gt; next = cur != null
                    ? new HashSet<>(cur) : new HashSet&lt;String&gt;();
            if (tried) next.add(abs);
            else next.remove(abs);
            SharedPreferences.Editor ed = p.edit();
            ed.putStringSet(KEY_PROBE_TRIED, next);
            // Synchronous: the mark must be on disk before the probe runs.
            // noinspection ApplySharedPref
            ed.commit();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}
