package com.example.hello;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.app.Dialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable;
import android.text.InputType;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.Window;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Three-way value control: minus, value, plus.
 *
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tap&lt;/b&gt; minus/plus to step the value.&lt;/li&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Double-tap the value&lt;/b&gt; to type an exact number.&lt;/li&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tap and scroll left/right&lt;/b&gt; anywhere on the control to scrub the
 *       value continuously, without lifting off.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 *
 * A single tap deliberately does nothing: no popup list and no keyboard.
 * Used for teleprompter text size / speed / words-per-line, the FX rack and
 * waveform zoom, so the same muscle memory applies everywhere.
 */
public class TeleValue extends LinearLayout {

    public interface OnValueChanged {
        void onValueChanged(int value);
    }

    /**
     * Continuous scrub notifications. Unlike {@link OnValueChanged}, these fire
     * while the finger is still down; the final committed value is reported
     * through {@link #onScrubFinished(int)} rather than the discrete listener.
     */
    public interface OnScrubListener {
        void onScrubValueChanged(int value);
        void onScrubFinished(int value);
    }

    private static final int DOUBLE_TAP_MS = 280;

    private int min;
    private int max = 100;
    private int step = 1;
    private int value;
    private String unit = "";

    public interface StepRule {
        int stepFor(int currentValue, int direction);
    }

    /**
     * Optional presentation override so a consumer can render dB, Hz or ratio
     * labels without subclassing. When unset, the numeric value is joined
     * with the configured unit.
     */
    public interface ValueFormatter {
        String formatValueText(int value);
    }

    private int valueScale = 1;
    private StepRule stepRule;
    private ValueFormatter valueFormatter;
    private Runnable paywallInterceptor;

    public void setValueFormatter(ValueFormatter formatter) {
        this.valueFormatter = formatter;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    /**
     * When non-null, marks this control as locked by the paywall on subsequent
     * recordings: visually dimmed ({@code alpha = 0.35f}) while keeping its
     * minus, plus, and value buttons clickable so any tap or scrub opens the
     * paywall immediately.
     */
    public void setPaywallInterceptor(Runnable interceptor) {
        this.paywallInterceptor = interceptor;
        setAlpha(interceptor != null ? 0.35f : 1f);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    /**
     * Fixed-point divisor for high-resolution controls (e.g. 100 for basis
     * points where 10000 = 100% and 92 = 0.92%). Default is 1 (integer).
     */
    public void setValueScale(int scale) {
        this.valueScale = Math.max(1, scale);
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    public int getValueScale() {
        return valueScale;
    }

    public void setStepRule(StepRule rule) {
        this.stepRule = rule;
    }

    private int effectiveStep(int fromValue, int dir) {
        if (stepRule != null) {
            return Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(fromValue, dir));
        }
        return Math.max(1, step);
    }

    private String formatNumberPart(int v) {
        if (valueScale <= 1) {
            return String.valueOf(v);
        }
        if (v % valueScale == 0) {
            return String.valueOf(v / valueScale);
        }
        double d = v / (double) valueScale;
        if (Math.abs((long) v) >= 10L * valueScale) {
            String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", d);
            if (s.endsWith(".0")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 2);
            return s;
        }
        String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", d);
        while (s.contains(".") && (s.endsWith("0") || s.endsWith("."))) {
            if (s.endsWith(".")) {
                s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
                break;
            }
            s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        }
        return s;
    }

    private String formatValueText(int v) {
        if (valueFormatter != null) {
            return valueFormatter.formatValueText(v);
        }
        String num = formatNumberPart(v);
        return unit.isEmpty() ? num : num + unit;
    }

    private OnValueChanged listener;
    private OnScrubListener scrubListener;

    private TextView caption;
    private LinearLayout controlRow;
    private boolean stacked;
    private TextView minus;
    private TextView plus;
    private TextView label;

    private float downX;
    private boolean scrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubEnabled;
    private float downY;
    private int activePointerId = -1;
    private boolean movedBeyondSlop;
    private int dragStartValue;
    private float dragStartPos;
    private long lastTapAt = -DOUBLE_TAP_MS - 1;
    private boolean compact;
    private Dialog keyboardDialog;

    public TeleValue(Context context) {
        this(context, null);
    }

    /** Required for XML inflation; without it the studio screen crashes. */
    public TeleValue(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        build(context);
    }

    private void build(Context ctx) {
        setOrientation(VERTICAL);
        setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);

        caption = new TextView(ctx);
        caption.setTextSize(8.5f);
        caption.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        caption.setTextColor(0xFF8A93A0);
        caption.setSingleLine(true);
        caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        addView(caption, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        row.setOrientation(HORIZONTAL);
        row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
        row.setPadding(dp(ctx, 2), 0, dp(ctx, 2), 0);
        controlRow = row;

        minus = button(ctx, "−");
        plus = button(ctx, "+");

        label = new TextView(ctx);
        label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        label.setTextSize(12);
        label.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        label.setSingleLine(true);
        label.setMaxLines(1);
        label.setContentDescription("value");
        // The system long-press listener is intentionally not used: Android
        // would schedule the keyboard as soon as the finger rests, even if the
        // user then begins a scrub. A value hold is detected below instead.
        label.setLongClickable(false);

        row.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                        LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
        row.addView(label, lp);
        row.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));

        addView(row, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dp(ctx, 26)));

        minus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, -1);
            int next = value - s;
            // If stepping down lands within one step of min, snap to min.
            if (value > min && next < min) next = min;
            setValue(next, true);
        });
        plus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, 1);
            setValue(value + s, true);
        });

        // A single tap is intentionally inert when unlocked. Only a double-tap
        // opens the exact-value keyboard; when paywall-locked, any tap opens
        // the paywall.
        label.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (scrubbing || movedBeyondSlop) return;
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
            if (now - lastTapAt < DOUBLE_TAP_MS) {
                lastTapAt = 0;
                showKeyboardInput();
            } else {
                lastTapAt = now;
            }
        });
    }

    private void updateStepperButtons() {
        if (minus == null || plus == null) return;
        if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
            minus.setEnabled(true);
            minus.setClickable(true);
            minus.setAlpha(1f);
            plus.setEnabled(true);
            plus.setClickable(true);
            plus.setAlpha(1f);
            return;
        }
        boolean canDec = value > min;
        boolean canInc = value < max;
        minus.setEnabled(canDec);
        minus.setClickable(canDec);
        minus.setAlpha(canDec ? 1f : 0.35f);
        plus.setEnabled(canInc);
        plus.setClickable(canInc);
        plus.setAlpha(canInc ? 1f : 0.35f);
    }

    private void clearChildPress() {
        if (minus != null) {
            minus.cancelLongPress();
            minus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (plus != null) {
            plus.cancelLongPress();
            plus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.cancelLongPress();
            label.setPressed(false);
        }
    }

    private TextView button(Context ctx, String glyph) {
        TextView t = new TextView(ctx);
        t.setText(glyph);
        t.setTextSize(15);
        t.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        t.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        t.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_round_btn);
        t.setContentDescription(glyph.equals("+") ? "increase" : "decrease");
        return t;
    }

    public boolean isStacked() {
        return stacked;
    }

    /** Small name shown above the stepper, so controls need no external label. */
    public void setCaption(String s) {
        if (caption == null) return;
        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) {
            caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        } else {
            caption.setText(s);
            caption.setVisibility(VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Stacks minus/value/plus vertically for a narrow rail, such as waveform
     * zoom. Gesture handling is unchanged: a horizontal scrub still adjusts
     * the value, while taps retain their four behaviours.
     */
    public void setStacked(boolean stacked) {
        if (controlRow == null || minus == null || label == null || plus == null) {
            return;
        }
        this.stacked = stacked;
        int button = dp(getContext(), 26);
        int height = dp(getContext(), 24);
        controlRow.setOrientation(stacked ? VERTICAL : HORIZONTAL);
        controlRow.setGravity(stacked ? Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
                : Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        controlRow.removeAllViews();
        if (stacked) {
            // The row must wrap its content: it was built for a single 24dp
            // horizontal strip, which would crush a vertical stack to 2px.
            // High-resolution labels ("0.92%") also need a slightly more
            // compact text size to fit cleanly inside the 40dp rail.
            // Plus sits on top, minus at the bottom, matching the drag
            // direction (up increases, down decreases).
            label.setTextSize(10.5f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(getContext(), 20)));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        } else {
            label.setTextSize(12f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, height));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(0,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    /**
     * Compacts the control for dense FX cards: smaller caption, label and
     * stepper buttons without changing its gestures. Ignored in stacked mode
     * because that rail already has its own sizing.
     */
    public void setCompact(boolean compact) {
        this.compact = compact;
        Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (caption != null) {
            caption.setTextSize(compact ? 8f : 8.5f);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.setTextSize(compact ? 11f : 12f);
        }
        if (!stacked && controlRow != null
                && minus != null && plus != null) {
            int size = dp(ctx, compact ? 22 : 26);
            minus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            plus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            if (controlRow.getLayoutParams() instanceof LayoutParams) {
                LayoutParams rp = (LayoutParams)
                        controlRow.getLayoutParams();
                rp.height = size;
                controlRow.setLayoutParams(rp);
            }
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean isCompact() {
        return compact;
    }

    /** Values the wheel may show when {@code step > 1}, padded to range. */
    private int[] steppedValues() {
        java.util.ArrayList&lt;Integer&gt; out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (stepRule != null) {
            int cur = min;
            out.add(cur);
            while (cur < max) {
                int s = Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(cur, 1));
                int next = (cur == min && s > 1)
                        ? ((cur / s) + 1) * s
                        : cur + s;
                if (next <= cur) next = cur + 1;
                if (next >= max) {
                    out.add(max);
                    break;
                }
                out.add(next);
                cur = next;
            }
        } else {
            int rem = ((min % step) + step) % step;
            int first = (rem == 0) ? min : Math.min(max, min + (step - rem));
            if (first > min && (valueScale > 1 || min < 0)) {
                out.add(min);
            }
            for (int v = first; v <= max; v += step) {
                out.add(v);
            }
            if (!out.isEmpty() && out.get(out.size() - 1) < max) {
                out.add(max);
            }
            if (out.isEmpty()) {
                for (int v = min; v <= max; v++) out.add(v);
            }
        }
        int[] arr = new int[out.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) arr[i] = out.get(i);
        return arr;
    }

    private String[] steppedLabels() {
        int[] vals = steppedValues();
        String[] out = new String[vals.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
            out[i] = formatValueText(vals[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Test hook: the wheel labels for the configured step. */
    String[] steppedLabelsForTest() {
        return steppedLabels();
    }

    public void configure(int min, int max, int step, int value, String unit) {
        this.min = min;
        this.max = max;
        this.step = Math.max(1, step);
        this.unit = unit == null ? "" : unit;
        setValue(value, false);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    public void setOnValueChanged(OnValueChanged l) {
        listener = l;
    }

    public void setOnScrubListener(OnScrubListener l) {
        scrubListener = l;
    }

    /**
     * Allows vertical drags to scrub the value (drag up increases), reported
     * through the same {@link OnScrubListener} as horizontal scrubs. Off by
     * default so a vertical pass over an unrelated control stays inert.
     */
    public void setVerticalScrub(boolean enabled) {
        verticalScrubEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public int getValue() {
        return value;
    }

    public int getMin() {
        return min;
    }

    private int clamp(int v) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
    }

    public void setValue(int v, boolean notify) {
        int nv = clamp(v);
        String formatted = formatValueText(nv);
        if (nv == value && label != null
                && formatted.contentEquals(label.getText())) {
            updateStepperButtons();
            return;
        }
        value = nv;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatted);
        }
        updateStepperButtons();
        if (notify && listener != null) listener.onValueChanged(value);
    }

    // ---- keyboard ----

    private String captionTitle() {
        CharSequence cap = caption != null ? caption.getText() : null;
        if (cap != null && cap.length() > 0) {
            return cap.toString();
        }
        return getContext().getString(R.string.tele_value_picker);
    }

    private static void styleModalWindow(Dialog dialog) {
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(dialog);
    }

    /** Overridable presentation hook so gesture routing is unit-testable. */
    protected void showKeyboardInput() {
        final Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (keyboardDialog != null && keyboardDialog.isShowing()) return;
        try {
            final Dialog d = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
            keyboardDialog = d;
            d.setOnDismissListener(dd -> {
                if (keyboardDialog == d) keyboardDialog = null;
            });
            d.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

            int pad = dp(ctx, 20);
            LinearLayout box = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            box.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            box.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 21) {
                box.setElevation(dp(ctx, 16));
            }
            box.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

            TextView title = new TextView(ctx);
            title.setText(captionTitle());
            title.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            title.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            title.setTextSize(18);
            title.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            box.addView(title, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

            TextView sub = new TextView(ctx);
            sub.setText(formatValueText(min) + " – " + formatValueText(max));
            sub.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            sub.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            sub.setTextSize(12);
            LayoutParams subLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            subLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
            box.addView(sub, subLp);

            LinearLayout inputBox = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            inputBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            inputBox.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
            inputBox.setPadding(dp(ctx, 14), dp(ctx, 2),
                    dp(ctx, 14), dp(ctx, 2));
            LayoutParams ibLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            ibLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 16);

            final EditText input = new EditText(ctx);
            input.setBackground(null);
            input.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            input.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            input.setHintTextColor(0xFF5D6672);
            input.setTextSize(16);
            input.setSingleLine(true);
            input.setMaxLines(1);
            // Signed keyboards appear only for ranges that can go negative
            // (e.g. a -24..+24 dB trim), so every existing positive-only
            // control keeps its familiar keypad.
            int inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER;
            if (min < 0) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_SIGNED;
            }
            if (valueScale > 1) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_DECIMAL;
            }
            input.setInputType(inputType);
            input.setText(formatNumberPart(value));
            input.setSelectAllOnFocus(true);
            inputBox.addView(input, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(ctx, 50)));
            box.addView(inputBox, ibLp);

            LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            LayoutParams rowLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rowLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 14);

            TextView cancelBtn = new TextView(ctx);
            cancelBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
            cancelBtn.setTextSize(14);
            cancelBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            cancelBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cancelBtn.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            cancelBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);

            TextView okBtn = new TextView(ctx);
            okBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.settings_done));
            okBtn.setTextSize(14);
            okBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            okBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            okBtn.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
            okBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);

            LayoutParams half = new LayoutParams(0, dp(ctx, 48), 1f);
            half.rightMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            LayoutParams half2 = new LayoutParams(0, dp(ctx, 48), 1f);
            half2.leftMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            row.addView(cancelBtn, half);
            row.addView(okBtn, half2);
            box.addView(row, rowLp);
            PressAnim.apply(cancelBtn);
            PressAnim.apply(okBtn);

            d.setContentView(box);
            input.setImeOptions(android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                    .IME_ACTION_DONE);
            input.setOnEditorActionListener((v2, actionId, ev) -> {
                if (actionId == android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                        .IME_ACTION_DONE) {
                    commitTyped(input);
                    d.dismiss();
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            });
            cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> d.dismiss());
            okBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                commitTyped(input);
                d.dismiss();
            });
            styleModalWindow(d);
            Window w = d.getWindow();
            if (w != null) {
                w.setSoftInputMode(WindowManager.LayoutParams
                        .SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                        | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
            }
            d.setOnShowListener(dd -> input.requestFocus());
            d.show();
            input.post(() -> {
                android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager imm =
                        (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager) ctx
                                .getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
                if (imm != null) {
                    imm.showSoftInput(input,
                            android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager
                                    .SHOW_IMPLICIT);
                }
            });
            // Back / outside-tap dismisses WITHOUT committing: cancelling
            // must never mutate the value.
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            keyboardDialog = null;
        }
    }

    /** Parses and commits the typed value exactly once. */
    private void commitTyped(EditText input) {
        try {
            String raw = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (raw.isEmpty()) return;
            int v = valueScale > 1
                    ? (int) Math.round(Double.parseDouble(raw) * valueScale)
                    : Integer.parseInt(raw);
            setValue(v, true);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    /**
     * Horizontal scrubs are intercepted here rather than in an
     * {@code OnTouchListener}: the minus, value and plus children are all
     * clickable, so they consume ACTION_DOWN and the parent would never see
     * the gesture at all.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Only a clean tap reaches the children. Motion beyond touch slop is
     * consumed here, so a scrolling finger can never turn into a value change
     * or a stray double-tap.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                downX = ev.getX();
                downY = ev.getY();
                activePointerId = eventPointerId(ev, 0);
                movedBeyondSlop = false;
                scrubbing = false;
                verticalScrubbing = false;
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN:
                // A second finger invalidates tap and double-tap semantics.
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                clearChildPress();
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                int pointerIndex = ev.findPointerIndex(activePointerId);
                if (pointerIndex < 0) return true;
                float x = ev.getX(pointerIndex);
                float y = ev.getY(pointerIndex);
                float dx = x - downX;
                float dy = y - downY;
                float slop = ViewConfiguration.get(getContext())
                        .getScaledTouchSlop();
                if (!movedBeyondSlop
                        && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > slop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = true;
                    clearChildPress();
                }
                if (!scrubbing && !verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Claim the gesture once its direction is clear. A
                    // vertical move is consumed so it cannot become a tap
                    // when the finger lifts — unless vertical scrubbing is
                    // enabled, in which case it drives the value.
                    if (!movedBeyondSlop) {
                        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
                    }
                    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
                        scrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        dragStartPos = x;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else if (verticalScrubEnabled) {
                        verticalScrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        // Anchor at the current position like horizontal
                        // scrub does: anchoring at the touch-down point
                        // makes the value jump by the slop distance.
                        dragStartPos = y;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                    return true;
                }
                if (verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Drag upward increases the value, drag downward decreases it,
                    // matching the direction the finger moves away from the
                    // starting point.
                    int delta = (int) Math.round((dragStartPos - y)
                            / dp(getContext(), 7));
                    int s = effectiveStep(dragStartValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
                    setLiveValue(dragStartValue + delta * s);
                    return true;
                }
                int delta = (int) Math.round((x - dragStartPos)
                        / dp(getContext(), 7));
                scrubTo(dragStartValue, delta);
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP: {
                int lifted = eventPointerId(ev, ev.getActionIndex());
                if (lifted == activePointerId) {
                    return finishInterruptedGesture();
                }
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
                    scrubbing = false;
                    verticalScrubbing = false;
                    if (getParent() != null) {
                        getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
                    }
                    if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                        paywallInterceptor.run();
                        return true;
                    }
                    // A scrub reports through the scrub listener only. The
                    // discrete listener remains reserved for +/- and keyboard
                    // commits.
                    if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
                    performClick();
                    return true;
                }
                if (movedBeyondSlop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = false;
                    return true;
                }
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            default:
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
        }
    }

    private boolean finishInterruptedGesture() {
        activePointerId = -1;
        if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
            scrubbing = false;
            verticalScrubbing = false;
            if (getParent() != null) {
                getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
            }
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
            performClick();
        }
        movedBeyondSlop = true;
        return true;
    }

    private static int eventPointerId(MotionEvent ev, int pointerIndex) {
        try {
            return ev.getPointerId(pointerIndex);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    private void setLiveValue(int v) {
        int before = value;
        setValue(v, false);
        if (value != before && scrubListener != null) {
            scrubListener.onScrubValueChanged(value);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies a scrub delta measured in 7dp ticks. Without a step rule this
     * is one fixed step per tick; with a piecewise rule (e.g. zoom) each
     * tick steps from the running value so bracket boundaries are honored
     * instead of extrapolating a single step across the whole drag.
     */
    private void scrubTo(int startValue, int delta) {
        if (delta == 0) {
            setLiveValue(startValue);
            return;
        }
        if (stepRule == null) {
            int s = effectiveStep(startValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
            setLiveValue(startValue + delta * s);
            return;
        }
        int dir = delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
        int v = startValue;
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.abs(delta); i++) {
            v += effectiveStep(v, dir);
        }
        setLiveValue(v);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        scrubbing = false;
        verticalScrubbing = false;
        movedBeyondSlop = false;
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    private static int dp(Context c, int v) {
        return Math.round(v * c.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}


--- FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/PressAnim.java ---
package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.PathInterpolator;

/**
 * Restrained press feedback for every tappable view.
 *
 * The effect is deliberately shallow — a small scale dip plus a barely-there
 * alpha change — and every transition runs on a falloff curve so the motion
 * decays quickly instead of flashing. Nothing here changes layout, so it can
 * safely coexist with the selection scale driven by the adapter.
 */
public final class PressAnim {

    /** Fast lift-off, long settle: the "falloff" easing used on release. */
    private static final PathInterpolator FALLOFF =
            new PathInterpolator(0.2f, 0f, 0f, 1f);
    /** Opposite curve for pressing in: moves a little, then eases. */
    private static final PathInterpolator SETTLE_IN =
            new PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0f, 0.6f, 1f);

    private PressAnim() {}

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void apply(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    // A disabled or non-clickable chip must not give press
                    // feedback: that is what made disabled actions look tappable.
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(0.97f).scaleY(0.97f)
                            .alpha(0.9f)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .alpha(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false; // let click listeners still fire
        });
    }

    public static void applyAll(View... views) {
        if (views == null) return;
        for (View v : views) apply(v);
    }

    /**
     * Gentler variant for elements that already have their own emphasis
     * (icons, chips): scales a touch and never dips alpha, so there is no
     * visible flash — just a soft give.
     */
    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void applySoft(View v, final float pressedScale) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(pressedScale).scaleY(pressedScale)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Small confirmation pop for icons — a light nudge on the same falloff
     * curve. Used instead of a hard overshoot so nothing flashes.
     */
    public static void nudge(View v, float peak) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate().scaleX(peak).scaleY(peak)
                .setDuration(90).setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate()
                        .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(260).setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN).start())
                .start();
    }

    /** One-shot entrance pop used for dialog icons. */
    public static void pop(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setScaleX(0.6f);
        v.setScaleY(0.6f);
        v.setAlpha(0f);
        v.animate()
                .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(280)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }
}

--- FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/AudioImporter.java ---
package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.MediaCodec;
import android.media.MediaExtractor;
import android.media.MediaFormat;
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Decodes a library take (float/16-bit WAV, M4A/AAC, …) into a fresh 32-bit
 * float WAV session file so the studio can punch in from its end. The
 * original file is never touched.
 */
public final class AudioImporter {

    public interface Progress {
        void onProgress(int percent);
    }

    /** Metadata and stored file returned by {@link #importOriginal}. */
    public static final class ImportedAudio {
        public final File file;
        public final long durationMs;
        public final String title;
        public final String badge;

        public ImportedAudio(File file, long durationMs, String title,
                             String badge) {
            this.file = file;
            this.durationMs = durationMs;
            this.title = title;
            this.badge = badge;
        }
    }

    /** Bound on draining a decoder that never signals end of stream. */
    private static final long DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000L;

    private AudioImporter() {}

    /**
     * True when {@code src} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit IEEE float mono/stereo
     * WAV, so preparing an edit session is a straight byte copy rather than a
     * format conversion.
     */
    public static boolean isNativeFloatWav(File src) {
        if (src == null || !src.exists()) return false;
        try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            return h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32
                    && h.sampleRate == RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE
                    && (h.channels == 1 || h.channels == 2)
                    && h.dataStart == 44L
                    && Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart) > 0;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copies a user-selected SAF document directly into the takes directory
     * in its original container/format without converting it to 32-bit float.
     * Its 32-bit float master is created lazily the first time the user
     * presses Edit on the imported take.
     */
    public static ImportedAudio importOriginal(Context ctx,
                                               android.net.Uri uri,
                                               File targetDir) throws Exception {
        if (ctx == null || uri == null || targetDir == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing import source");
        }
        String display = queryDisplayName(ctx, uri);
        String ext = extensionOf(display);
        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
            ext = extensionFromMime(ctx, uri);
        }
        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
            ext = "m4a";
        }
        String rawTitle = stripExtension(display != null ? display
                : "Imported_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
        String cleanBase = rawTitle.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
        if (cleanBase.isEmpty()) cleanBase = "Imported";
        String prettyTitle = Dsp.prettyFileTitle(cleanBase + "." + ext);
        if (prettyTitle.isEmpty()) prettyTitle = cleanBase;

        File dst = uniqueImportedFile(targetDir, cleanBase, ext);
        try {
            try (java.io.InputStream in =
                         ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                 java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                         new java.io.FileOutputStream(dst)) {
                if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("cannot open uri");
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
                out.getFD().sync();
            }
            if (!dst.exists() || dst.length() <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("empty import");
            }
            long durMs;
            String badge;
            if ("wav".equals(ext)) {
                try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "r")) {
                    Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
                    if (h.channels < 1 || h.channels > 2 || h.sampleRate <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav");
                    }
                    long onDisk = Math.max(0L, r.length() - h.dataStart);
                    if (onDisk <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("empty wav");
                    }
                }
                durMs = Math.max(1000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst));
                badge = TakesRepository.wavBadge(dst);
            } else {
                durMs = probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(dst);
                badge = badgeForExtension(dst, ext);
            }
            return new ImportedAudio(dst, durMs, prettyTitle, badge);
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
    }

    private static File uniqueImportedFile(File dir, String base, String ext) {
        String stamp = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",
                Locale.US).format(new java.util.Date());
        File c = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + "." + ext);
        if (!c.exists()) return c;
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            File n = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + " (" + i + ")." + ext);
            if (!n.exists()) return n;
            i++;
        }
    }

    private static String extensionFromMime(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri) {
        try {
            String mime = ctx.getContentResolver().getType(uri);
            if (mime == null) return "";
            String lower = mime.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            if (lower.contains("wav")) return "wav";
            if (lower.contains("flac")) return "flac";
            if (lower.contains("opus")) return "opus";
            if (lower.contains("ogg")) return "ogg";
            if (lower.contains("mpeg") || lower.contains("mp3")) return "mp3";
            if (lower.contains("3gpp") || lower.contains("amr")) return "3gp";
            if (lower.contains("aac")) return "aac";
            if (lower.contains("mp4") || lower.contains("m4a")) return "m4a";
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return "";
    }

    private static String badgeForExtension(File f, String ext) {
        switch (ext.toLowerCase(Locale.US)) {
            case "wav":
                return TakesRepository.wavBadge(f);
            case "m4a":
            case "aac":
                return "M4A";
            case "flac":
                return "FLAC";
            case "opus":
            case "webm":
            case "ogg":
                return "OPUS";
            case "3gp":
            case "3ga":
                return TakesRepository.containsToken(
                        f, new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'}) ? "AMR-WB" : "AMR";
            case "mp3":
                return "MP3";
            default:
                return ext.toUpperCase(Locale.US);
        }
    }

    private static long probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(File src)
            throws Exception {
        long durationMs = -1L;
        boolean hasAudio = false;
        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
        try {
            ex.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
            for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
                MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
                String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
                if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
                    hasAudio = true;
                    try {
                        if (f.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)) {
                            durationMs = f.getLong(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)
                                    / 1000L;
                        }
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    break;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            try {
                ex.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (!hasAudio || durationMs <= 0) {
            MediaMetadataRetriever mmr = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
            try {
                mmr.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
                String has = mmr.extractMetadata(
                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_HAS_AUDIO);
                String dur = mmr.extractMetadata(
                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
                if (has != null && !has.isEmpty()) {
                    hasAudio = true;
                }
                if (dur != null) {
                    long parsed = (long) Double.parseDouble(dur);
                    if (parsed > 0) {
                        hasAudio = true;
                        durationMs = parsed;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                try {
                    mmr.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (!hasAudio) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track");
        }
        return Math.max(1000L, durationMs);
    }

    /**
     * Imports a user-selected SAF document into the takes directory as a
     * 32-bit float WAV edit master. Supports WAV PCM/float and any container
     * the platform decoder can turn into PCM (M4A/AAC, MP3, OGG/Opus, FLAC,
     * AMR, …). Throws when no decodable audio is present.
     */
    public static File importToFloatWav(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri,
                                        File targetDir) throws Exception {
        if (ctx == null || uri == null || targetDir == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing import source");
        }
        String display = queryDisplayName(ctx, uri);
        String ext = extensionOf(display);
        File temp = File.createTempFile("takeone_import_",
                ext.isEmpty() ? ".audio" : "." + ext, ctx.getCacheDir());
        try {
            try (java.io.InputStream in =
                         ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                 java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                         new java.io.FileOutputStream(temp)) {
                if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("cannot open uri");
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
            }
            String base = stripExtension(display != null ? display
                    : "Imported_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
            base = base.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
            if (base.isEmpty()) base = "Imported";
            return takeToFloatWav(temp, targetDir, base, null);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            temp.delete();
        }
    }

    private static String queryDisplayName(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri) {
        try (android.database.Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(uri,
                new String[]{android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME},
                null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                int idx = c.getColumnIndex(
                        android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                if (idx >= 0) return c.getString(idx);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    private static String extensionOf(String name) {
        if (name == null) return "";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot < 0 || dot == name.length() - 1) return "";
        return name.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
    }

    private static String stripExtension(String name) {
        if (name == null) return "Imported";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        return dot > 0 ? name.substring(0, dot) : name;
    }

    /**
     * @param dstParent   directory for the new session file (takes dir).
     * @param baseName    sanitized take title used for the session file name.
     * @return the new float WAV session file (without a pending marker —
     * callers attach it via the engine, which writes the marker).
     */
    public static File takeToFloatWav(File src, File dstParent, String baseName,
                                      Progress cb) throws Exception {
        String lower = src.getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        File dst = uniqueSession(dstParent, baseName);
        try {
            if (lower.endsWith(".wav")) {
                wavToFloatWav(src, dst, cb);
            } else {
                compressedToFloatWav(src, dst, cb);
            }
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            // A4-05: the session file lives in takes/ and starts with a
            // header. If decoding throws, a truncated float WAV would be
            // sitting there with no .pending marker, and the next launch
            // would adopt it into the library as a take full of noise.
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        // FMT-02d: validation lives inside the try so a malformed import
        // deletes its output too; otherwise the orphan is adopted on the
        // next launch by reconcile().
        try {
            // Importer output preserves the source geometry (mono stays
            // mono); callers attach the session with these exact channels.
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(dst);
            if (info.channels < 1 || info.channels > 2
                    || info.sampleRate != RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("bad import channels/rate");
            }
            if (info.dataBytes <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("empty import");
            }
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
        return dst;
    }

    private static File uniqueSession(File dir, String base) {
        String stamp = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",
                java.util.Locale.US).format(new java.util.Date());
        File c = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + ".raw.wav");
        if (!c.exists()) return c;
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            File n = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + " (" + i
                    + ").raw.wav");
            if (!n.exists()) return n;
            i++;
        }
    }

    // ---- WAV sources ----

    private static void wavToFloatWav(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        try {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            int ch = h.channels;
            int sr = h.sampleRate;
            if (ch < 1 || ch > 2) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav (need mono/stereo)");
            }
            int bytesPerSample;
            if (h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32) bytesPerSample = 4;
            else if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 16) bytesPerSample = 2;
            else if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 24) bytesPerSample = 3;
            else throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav encoding");
            long onDisk = Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart);
            long dataBytes = h.dataBytes;
            if (dataBytes <= 0 || dataBytes > onDisk) dataBytes = onDisk;
            long totalSrcFrames = dataBytes / bytesPerSample / ch;
            if (totalSrcFrames <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("empty wav");
            // Fast path: source is already 48 kHz 32-bit IEEE float WAV.
            // Copy raw payload bytes directly without unpacking floats or
            // running Dsp.Resampler.
            if (h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32
                    && sr == RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) {
                long payloadBytes = totalSrcFrames * ch * 4L;
                try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw")) {
                    w.setLength(0);
                    w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, payloadBytes));
                    r.seek(h.dataStart);
                    byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                    long left = payloadBytes;
                    while (left > 0) {
                        int n = r.read(buf, 0,
                                (int) Math.min(buf.length, left));
                        if (n <= 0) break;
                        w.write(buf, 0, n);
                        left -= n;
                    }
                    long actual = Math.max(0L, w.length() - 44L);
                    if (actual != payloadBytes) {
                        w.seek(0);
                        w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, actual));
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
            // Mono stays mono; foreign rates are resampled to the session
            // rate instead of being stamped with a lying header.
            Dsp.Resampler resampler =
                    new Dsp.Resampler(sr, RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE, ch);
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, 0));
                // Seek explicitly to the parsed data chunk start (NEW-01).
                r.seek(h.dataStart);
                byte[] in = new byte[32768 * 2 * 4];
                ByteBuffer ib = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                float[] fbuf = new float[32768 * 2];
                long done = 0;
                long payloadBytes = 0;
                int lastPct = -1;
                while (done < totalSrcFrames) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(32768, totalSrcFrames - done);
                    // NEW-01 fix: `want` is in frames, so read `want * ch`
                    // samples (`samplesToRead * bytesPerSample` bytes).
                    int samplesToRead = want * ch;
                    float[] samples;
                    if (h.audioFormat == 3) {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 4);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 4);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            fbuf[i] = ib.getFloat();
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    } else if (h.bits == 24) {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 3);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 3);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            int v = (ib.get() & 0xFF)
                                    | ((ib.get() & 0xFF) << 8)
                                    | (ib.get() << 16);
                            if ((v & 0x800000) != 0) v |= 0xFF000000;
                            fbuf[i] = v / 8388608f;
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    } else {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 2);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 2);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            fbuf[i] = ib.getShort() / 32768f;
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    }
                    int outFrames = samples.length / ch;
                    if (outFrames > 0) {
                        Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, samples, 0, samples.length);
                        payloadBytes += (long) outFrames * ch * 4;
                    }
                    done += want;
                    if (cb != null) {
                        int pct = (int) (done * 100
                                / Math.max(1, totalSrcFrames));
                        if (pct != lastPct) {
                            lastPct = pct;
                            cb.onProgress(pct);
                        }
                    }
                }
                float[] tail = resampler.flush();
                if (tail.length > 0) {
                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, tail, 0, tail.length);
                    payloadBytes += tail.length * 4L;
                }
                w.seek(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, payloadBytes));
            } finally {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }


    private static int pcmBytesPerSample(int encoding) {
        switch (encoding) {
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_8BIT:
                return 1;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED:
                return 3;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_32BIT:
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT:
                return 4;
            default:
                return 2;
        }
    }

    private static float readPcmSample(ByteBuffer b, int encoding) {
        switch (encoding) {
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_8BIT:
                return ((b.get() & 0xff) - 128) / 128f;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED: {
                int b0 = b.get() & 0xff;
                int b1 = b.get() & 0xff;
                int b2 = b.get();
                int v = (b2 << 16) | (b1 << 8) | b0;
                return v / 8388608f;
            }
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_32BIT:
                return b.getInt() / 2147483648f;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT:
                return b.getFloat();
            default:
                return b.getShort() / 32768f;
        }
    }

    // ---- compressed sources (M4A/AAC/MP3/…) via platform decoder ----

    private static void compressedToFloatWav(File src, File dst, Progress cb)
            throws Exception {
        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
        try {
            ex.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
            int track = -1;
            MediaFormat trackFmt = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
                MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
                String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
                if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
                    track = i;
                    trackFmt = f;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (track < 0 || trackFmt == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track");
            }
            int srcCh = 2;
            try {
                srcCh = trackFmt.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            int srcRate = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
            try {
                srcRate = trackFmt.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (srcRate <= 0) srcRate = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
            long durationUs = 0;
            try {
                durationUs = trackFmt.getLong(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            String mime = trackFmt.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
            ex.selectTrack(track);

            // Mono stays mono (downmix only beyond stereo); the rate is
            // resampled to the session rate instead of being stamped with a
            // lying 48 kHz header.
            int outCh = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, srcCh));
            Dsp.Resampler resampler =
                    new Dsp.Resampler(srcRate, RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE,
                            outCh);

            MediaCodec dec = MediaCodec.createDecoderByType(mime);
            // A4-05/FMT-02a: pin the decoder output to 16-bit PCM. Set it on
            // the track format directly: MediaFormat's copy constructor only
            // exists from API 29, so `new MediaFormat(trackFmt)` threw
            // NoSuchMethodError (an Error, not caught below) on API 24-28.
            try {
                trackFmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_PCM_ENCODING,
                        android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            dec.configure(trackFmt, null, null, 0);
            dec.start();
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            boolean muxed = false;
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(outCh, 0));
                float[] fbuf = new float[16384 * 2];
                MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
                boolean inEos = false;
                boolean outEos = false;
                long payloadBytes = 0;
                int lastPct = -1;
                // FMT-02c: bound the post-EOS drain. An OEM decoder that
                // never emits END_OF_STREAM otherwise hangs the import
                // dialog forever.
                int pcmEncoding = android.media.AudioFormat
                        .ENCODING_PCM_16BIT;
                long drainDeadline = 0;
                while (!outEos) {
                    if (!inEos) {
                        int idx = dec.dequeueInputBuffer(5000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            ByteBuffer ib = dec.getInputBuffer(idx);
                            int n = ex.readSampleData(ib, 0);
                            if (n < 0) {
                                dec.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                        MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                inEos = true;
                                drainDeadline = android.os.SystemClock
                                        .elapsedRealtime() + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                            } else {
                                dec.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, n,
                                        ex.getSampleTime(), 0);
                                ex.advance();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    int oidx = dec.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 5000);
                    if (oidx >= 0) {
                        if (bi.size > 0) {
                            ByteBuffer ob = dec.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                            // NEW-02 fix: MediaCodec output ByteBuffers
                            // default to BIG_ENDIAN; set LITTLE_ENDIAN so
                            // getShort() does not byte-swap PCM samples.
                            ob.order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                            ob.position(bi.offset);
                            ob.limit(bi.offset + bi.size);
                            // Decoder PCM is 16-bit: convert to float, then
                            // resample onto the session grid.
                            // FMT-02b: KEY_PCM_ENCODING is only a hint. If
                            // the decoder still reports float output, read
                            // 4-byte samples; reading them as shorts byte-swaps
                            // and doubles the apparent duration.
                            final int pcmEnc = pcmEncoding;
                            final int bytesPerSample = pcmBytesPerSample(pcmEnc);
                            int samples = bi.size / bytesPerSample;
                            int frames = samples / Math.max(1, srcCh);
                            int fpos = 0;
                            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                                float s0 = readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc);
                                float s1 = srcCh > 1
                                        ? readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc) : s0;
                                // Skip any extra channels beyond stereo.
                                for (int c = 2; c < srcCh; c++) {
                                    readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc);
                                }
                                if (outCh == 1) {
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = srcCh > 1
                                            ? (s0 + s1) * 0.5f : s0;
                                } else {
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = s0;
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = s1;
                                }
                                if (fpos + 2 > fbuf.length) {
                                    float[] conv = resampler.push(fbuf,
                                            fpos / outCh);
                                    if (conv.length > 0) {
                                        Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, conv, 0,
                                                conv.length);
                                        payloadBytes += conv.length * 4L;
                                    }
                                    fpos = 0;
                                }
                            }
                            if (fpos > 0) {
                                float[] conv = resampler.push(fbuf,
                                        fpos / outCh);
                                if (conv.length > 0) {
                                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, conv, 0, conv.length);
                                    payloadBytes += conv.length * 4L;
                                }
                            }
                            if (cb != null && durationUs > 0) {
                                int pct = (int) (bi.presentationTimeUs * 100
                                        / Math.max(1, durationUs));
                                pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(99, pct));
                                if (pct != lastPct) {
                                    lastPct = pct;
                                    cb.onProgress(pct);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        dec.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                            outEos = true;
                        }
                    } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                        if (inEos && android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                > drainDeadline) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "decoder never finished");
                        }
                    } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                        try {
                            MediaFormat of = dec.getOutputFormat();
                            try {
                                pcmEncoding = of.getInteger(
                                        MediaFormat.KEY_PCM_ENCODING);
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            int newCh = of.getInteger(
                                    MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT);
                            int newRate = srcRate;
                            try {
                                newRate = of.getInteger(
                                        MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE);
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            if (newCh >= 1 && newCh <= 8
                                    && newRate > 0) {
                                if (payloadBytes > 0
                                        && (newCh != srcCh
                                        || newRate != srcRate)) {
                                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                                            "decoder geometry changed mid-stream");
                                }
                                srcCh = newCh;
                                srcRate = newRate;
                                outCh = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, srcCh));
                                resampler = new Dsp.Resampler(srcRate,
                                        RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE, outCh);
                            }
                        } catch (IllegalStateException ise) {
                            throw ise;
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                    muxed = true;
                }
                float[] tail = resampler.flush();
                if (tail.length > 0) {
                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, tail, 0, tail.length);
                    payloadBytes += tail.length * 4L;
                }
                if (!muxed || payloadBytes <= 0) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("decode produced no audio");
                }
                w.seek(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(outCh, payloadBytes));
            } finally {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                // Stop/release the decoder HERE, not after this block: any
                // throw inside the loop above must not skip them and leak
                // the native MediaCodec instance.
                try {
                    dec.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    dec.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                ex.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }
}

public class LibraryFragment extends Fragment implements TakesAdapter.Listener {

    /** A4-12: focus holder for library playback; released in stopPlayback(). */
    private android.media.AudioManager playAudioManager;
    private android.media.AudioFocusRequest playFocusRequest;
    private android.media.AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener
            playFocusListener;

    /**
     * Lazily created (so its body can post to {@code handler}, which is
     * declared later in this class) listener that pauses library playback
     * when a call or another app takes audio focus.
     */
    private android.media.AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener
            playFocusListener() {
        if (playFocusListener == null) {
            playFocusListener = focus -> {
                if (focus == android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS
                        || focus == android.media.AudioManager
                                .AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT
                        || focus == android.media.AudioManager
                                .AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK) {
                    handler.post(this::pausePlayback);
                }
            };
        }
        return playFocusListener;
    }

    private static final int PLAY_FOCUS =
            android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK;

    /**
     * A4-12: library playback never asked for focus, so it could duck or
     * bleed into a live microphone take. Request transient-may-duck focus and
     * refuse while the studio is actually capturing.
     *
     * @return false when playback should not start.
     */
    private boolean acquirePlaybackFocus() {
        try {
            if (RecordingEngine.get().state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                // Playing back through the speaker straight into an open mic.
                return false;
            }
            if (playAudioManager == null) {
                playAudioManager = (android.media.AudioManager)
                        requireContext().getApplicationContext()
                                .getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            }
            if (playAudioManager == null) return true;
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                playFocusRequest = new android.media.AudioFocusRequest.Builder(
                        PLAY_FOCUS)
                        .setAudioAttributes(new android.media.AudioAttributes
                                .Builder()
                                .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes
                                        .USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes
                                        .CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(playFocusListener(),
                                handler)
                        .build();
                return playAudioManager.requestAudioFocus(playFocusRequest)
                        == android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
            }
            //noinspection deprecation
            return playAudioManager.requestAudioFocus(playFocusListener(),
                    android.media.AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC,
                    PLAY_FOCUS)
                    == android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    private void releasePlaybackFocus() {
        try {
            if (playAudioManager == null) return;
            if (playFocusRequest != null) {
                if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                    playAudioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(
                            playFocusRequest);
                }
                playFocusRequest = null;
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                playAudioManager.abandonAudioFocus(playFocusListener());
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container,
                             @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        return inflater.inflate(R.layout.fragment_library, container, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View v, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        sort = loadSort();

        subtitle = v.findViewById(R.id.librarySubtitle);
        list = v.findViewById(R.id.takesList);
        emptyState = v.findViewById(R.id.emptyState);
        emptyTitle = v.findViewById(R.id.emptyTitle);
        emptySub = v.findViewById(R.id.emptySub);
        searchBar = v.findViewById(R.id.searchBar);
        searchInput = v.findViewById(R.id.searchInput);
        searchClear = v.findViewById(R.id.searchClear);
        normalHeader = v.findViewById(R.id.normalHeader);
        selectionBar = v.findViewById(R.id.selectionBar);
        selCount = v.findViewById(R.id.selCount);
        selAll = v.findViewById(R.id.selAll);
        selExport = v.findViewById(R.id.selExport);
        selDelete = v.findViewById(R.id.selDelete);

        chips = new TextView[]{
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipAll), v.findViewById(R.id.chipFav),
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipDay), v.findViewById(R.id.chipWeek),
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipShort), v.findViewById(R.id.chipWav),
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipFlac), v.findViewById(R.id.chipOpus),
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipAmr), v.findViewById(R.id.chipM4a)};
        chipFilters = new Filter[]{Filter.ALL, Filter.FAV, Filter.DAY, Filter.WEEK,
                Filter.SHORT, Filter.WAV, Filter.FLAC, Filter.OPUS, Filter.AMR,
                Filter.M4A};
        for (int i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
            final Filter f = chipFilters[i];
            chips[i].setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (filter == f) return;
                filter = f;
                paintChipsAnimated();
                view.animate().cancel();
                view.setScaleX(0.9f);
                view.setScaleY(0.9f);
                view.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(180).start();
                refresh();
            });
        }

        adapter = new TakesAdapter(this);
        list.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(requireContext()));
        // No item animations at all. The animator cannot survive a stable-id
        // sign flip (converting card -> finished take): it keeps animating a
        // holder that is never rebound, and change animations on top of
        // notifyDataSetChanged() also flickered cards on ordinary updates.
        list.setItemAnimator(null);
        list.setAdapter(adapter);

        v.findViewById(R.id.searchToggle).setOnClickListener(view -> toggleSearch());
