    @Override
    public void onEdit(Take take) {
        if (selectionMode) {
            toggleSelection(take);
            return;
        }
        if (take.converting) {
            // Edit from the stored raw: the punch-in copies bytes out, so
            // the running conversion is never invalidated. The negative
            // source id lets the replace flow resolve the original later.
            if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()) {
                snackText(getString(R.string.edit_busy));
                return;
            }
            File raw = new File(take.convRawPath);
            if (!raw.exists()) {
                snackText(getString(R.string.edit_no_audio));
                return;
            }
            startEditFromFile(raw, take.id, take.title);
            return;
        }
        if (!take.hasFile()) {
            snackText(getString(R.string.edit_no_audio));
            return;
        }
        if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()) {
            snackText(getString(R.string.edit_busy));
            return;
        }
        if (playingId == take.id) stopPlayback();
        startEditFromFile(new File(take.filePath), take.id, take.title);
    }

    /**
     * Punch-in edit from any readable source file (a finished take or the
     * stored raw of a converting one). The source is only ever read, so
     * editing can never invalidate a running conversion.
     */
    /** Session channels for an imported file: mono stays mono (BUG-08). */
    private static int sessionChannels(File session) {
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                    FormatConverter.readFloatWav(session);
            if (info.channels == 1 || info.channels == 2) {
                return info.channels;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return 2;
    }

    private void startEditFromFile(File src, long sourceId, String sourceTitle) {
        // A4-02: capture the application context now (we are on the UI
        // thread). The worker below must not call requireContext(): a
        // fragment detached mid-import would otherwise abort after having
        // already written a session file.
        final android.content.Context appCtx =
                requireContext().getApplicationContext();
        // Resolve the persistent 32-bit float master for this take (available
        // for all recordings and for any imported take already edited once).
        // When present, preparing the edit session is a fast byte copy with no
        // "Converting to 32-bit float" modal.
        final long immutableRecordingId =
                ConversionJobs.resolveRecordingId(sourceId);
        TrialAndBillingManager.get(appCtx).setActiveStudioSourceId(sourceId);
        final File floatSrc = TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(
                immutableRecordingId, src);
        final boolean alreadyFloat = AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(floatSrc);
        // Decode a copy to 32-bit float (or fast-copy from the stored 32-bit
        // float master) and punch in from its end. The original stays in the
        // library until the user picks replace/new.
        final Dialog progress;
        final ProgressBar bar;
        final TextView msg;
        if (!alreadyFloat) {
            progress = showDeterminateProgress(
                    getString(R.string.importing_title),
                    getString(R.string.importing_msg, 0));
            ProgressBar b;
            TextView m;
            try {
                b = progress.findViewById(R.id.progressBar);
                m = progress.findViewById(R.id.progressMessage);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                try {
                    progress.dismiss();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                return;
            }
            bar = b;
            msg = m;
        } else {
            progress = null;
            bar = null;
            msg = null;
        }
        new Thread(() -> {
            File session = null;
            String fail = null;
            try {
                // STU-03: hold the raw while we decode it so the conversion
                // worker cannot delete/move it mid-import.
                ConversionJobs.beginRawRead(src.getAbsolutePath());
                session = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(floatSrc,
                        RecordingEngine.takesDir(appCtx),
                        RecordingEngine.sanitize(sourceTitle),
                        alreadyFloat ? null : pct -> handler.post(() -> {
                            try {
                                if (bar != null) bar.setProgress(pct);
                                if (msg != null) {
                                    msg.setText(getString(
                                            R.string.importing_msg, pct));
                                }
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                        }));
                // For imported recordings (or any legacy take without a float32
                // master), persist the newly created 32-bit float file on the
                // first Edit so subsequent edits reuse it without converting.
                if (!alreadyFloat && immutableRecordingId > 0 && src.exists()) {
                    TakesRepository.saveFloatMasterCopy(
                            immutableRecordingId, session, src);
                }
                RecordingEngine.get().attachExisting(
                        appCtx, session,
                        sourceTitle, sessionChannels(session),
                        RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(session));
                // Stash the lineage here on the worker thread: if the
                // fragment detaches before the UI post below runs, the
                // session must still carry its edit link or all later edits
                // and recordings are blocked.
                EditLink.save(appCtx, sourceId, sourceTitle,
                        session.getAbsolutePath());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                fail = e.getMessage();
                if (session != null && session.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    session.delete();
                }
            } finally {
                ConversionJobs.endRawRead(src.getAbsolutePath());
            }
            final File done = session;
            final String failure = fail;
            handler.post(() -> {
                if (progress != null) {
                    try {
                        progress.dismiss();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                if (!isAdded()) return;
                if (done != null && failure == null) {
                    try {
                        ((MainActivity) requireActivity())
                                .openStudioWithEdit(done, sourceId, sourceTitle);
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
                        OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                                getString(R.string.import_failed_title),
                                getString(R.string.import_failed_msg, sourceTitle));
                    }
                } else {
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                            getString(R.string.import_failed_title),
                            getString(R.string.import_failed_msg, sourceTitle));
                }
            });
        }).start();
    }

    /** Styled determinate progress dialog (import / conversion prep). */
    private Dialog showDeterminateProgress(String title, String message) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(requireContext(), R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
                .inflate(R.layout.dialog_progress, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);
        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.progressTitle)).setText(title);
        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.progressMessage)).setText(message);
        dialog.setCancelable(false);
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        return dialog;
    }

    @Override
    public void onCancelConversion(Take take) {
        showCancelConversionConfirm(take);
    }

    @Override
    public void onDelete(Take take) {        if (take.converting) {
            showCancelConversionConfirm(take);
            return;
        }
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(requireContext(),
                getString(R.string.delete_one_title),
                getString(R.string.delete_one_msg, take.title),
                getString(R.string.delete_confirm),
                R.drawable.ic_trash, true,
                () -> performDeleteSingle(take));
    }

    /** Delete on a converting card means cancel the conversion. */
    private void showCancelConversionConfirm(Take take) {
        ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.forTakeId(take.id);
        String target = take.convFormat != null ? take.convFormat : "";
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(requireContext(),
                getString(R.string.conv_cancel_title),
                getString(R.string.conv_cancel_msg, take.title, target),
                getString(R.string.delete_confirm),
                R.drawable.ic_trash, true,
                () -> {
                    if (playingId == take.id) stopPlayback();
                    if (job != null) {
                        // Tell the worker first so it stops touching a raw we
                        // are about to delete, then cancel the registry entry.
                        try {
                            ConversionService.cancelJob(requireContext()
                                    .getApplicationContext(), job.jobId);
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                        if (!ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true)) {
                            // The conversion finished while this dialog was
                            // open: cancel() found nothing to cancel, so
                            // delete the finished take instead of orphaning it
                            // under a "cancelled" message.
                            Long doneId =
                                    ConversionJobs.completedTakeIdForRaw(
                                            take.convRawPath);
                            if (doneId != null) {
                                TakesRepository.delete(doneId);
                            }
                        }
                        if (job.jobId != null) {
                            // Stop the done-broadcast from painting a false
                            // "couldn't save" over the confirmed cancel.
                            cancelledJobs.add(job.jobId);
                        }
                    }
                    refresh();
                    OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(),
                            "Conversion cancelled");
                });
    }

    private void performDeleteSingle(Take take) {
        try {
            if (playingId == take.id) stopPlayback();
            Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>();
            ids.add(take.id);
            String name = take.title;
            TakesRepository.RestoreOp op = TakesRepository.deleteMany(ids);
            selection.remove(take.id);
            if (selectionMode && selection.isEmpty()) selectionMode = false;
            refresh();
            snackUndo(getString(R.string.take_deleted), op);
            OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Take deleted");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                    getString(R.string.delete_failed_title),
                    getString(R.string.delete_failed_msg));
        }
    }

    private void deleteSelected() {
        if (selection.isEmpty()) return;
        final int n = selection.size();
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(requireContext(),
                getString(R.string.delete_many_title, n),
                getString(R.string.delete_many_msg),
                getString(R.string.delete_confirm),
                R.drawable.ic_trash, true,
                () -> {
                    try {
                        if (selection.contains(playingId)) stopPlayback();
                        TakesRepository.RestoreOp op =
                                TakesRepository.deleteMany(selection);
                        selection.clear();
                        selectionMode = false;
                        refresh();
                        snackUndo(getString(R.string.takes_deleted, n), op);
                        OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Takes deleted");
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                                getString(R.string.delete_failed_title),
                                getString(R.string.delete_failed_msg));
                    }
                });
    }

    private void snackUndo(String text, TakesRepository.RestoreOp op) {
        View root = getView();
        if (root == null) return;
        Snackbar sb = Snackbar.make(root, text, Snackbar.LENGTH_LONG)
                .setAction(R.string.undo, v -> {
                    TakesRepository.restore(op);
                    refresh();
                });
        styleSnack(sb);
        sb.show();
    }

    private void snack(int resId) {
        View root = getView();
        if (root == null) return;
        Snackbar sb = Snackbar.make(root, resId, Snackbar.LENGTH_SHORT);
        styleSnack(sb);
        sb.show();
    }

    private void snackText(String text) {
        View root = getView();
        if (root == null) return;
        Snackbar sb = Snackbar.make(root, text, Snackbar.LENGTH_SHORT);
        styleSnack(sb);
        sb.show();
    }

    private void styleSnack(Snackbar sb) {
        try {
            View sbView = sb.getView();
            sbView.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);
            sbView.setAlpha(0f);
            sbView.setTranslationY(24f);
            sbView.animate().alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setDuration(260)
                    .setInterpolator(
                            new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
            sb.setActionTextColor(0xFFFF3B30);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- export: share + save to device ----

    private List<Take> singleton(Take t) {
        List<Take> l = new ArrayList<>();
        l.add(t);
        return l;
    }

    private void showMassExportOptions() {
        List<Take> files = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (selection.contains(t.id) && t.hasFile()) files.add(t);
        }
        if (files.isEmpty()) return;
        final int n = files.size();
        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_share,
                getString(R.string.export_share_multi, n), () -> shareFiles(files)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_folder,
                getString(R.string.export_save_multi, n),
                () -> launchFolderPicker(files)));
        OptionsSheet.showOptions(requireContext(), getString(R.string.action_export),
                getString(R.string.export_subtitle, n) + "\n"
                        + getString(R.string.export_current_location,
                        currentTakesDirLabel()),
                items);
    }

    private void shareFiles(List<Take> takes) {
        try {
            String authority = requireContext().getPackageName() + ".fileprovider";
            ArrayList<Uri> uris = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Take t : takes) {
                uris.add(FileProvider.getUriForFile(requireContext(), authority,
                        new File(t.filePath)));
            }
            Intent intent;
            if (uris.size() == 1) {
                intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND);
                intent.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uris.get(0));
            } else {
                intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE);
                intent.putParcelableArrayListExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uris);
            }
            intent.setType("audio/*");
            intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
            startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, getString(R.string.action_export)));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                    "Export failed", null);
        }
    }

    // ---- unified export: user picks a folder (SAF), we copy file(s) there ----

    /** Both single-card and multi-select export go through this one picker. */
    private void launchFolderPicker(List<Take> takes) {
        List<Take> withFiles = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Take t : takes) {
            if (t != null && t.hasFile()) withFiles.add(t);
        }
        if (withFiles.isEmpty()) {
            OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                    getString(R.string.couldnt_save_title),
                    getString(R.string.couldnt_save));
            return;
        }
        pendingExportTakes = withFiles;
        try {
            openTreeLauncher.launch(null);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            pendingExportTakes = null;
            OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                    getString(R.string.couldnt_save_title),
                    getString(R.string.couldnt_export));
        }
    }

    private void exportTakesToFolder(List<Take> takes, Uri treeUri) {
        final Context app = requireContext().getApplicationContext();
        final List<Take> copy = new ArrayList<>(takes);
        final String folderLabel = resolveFolderLabel(treeUri);
        new Thread(() -> {
            final List<String> savedNames = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Take t : copy) {
                String name = saveOneToTree(app, t, treeUri);
                if (name != null) savedNames.add(name);
            }
            final int n = savedNames.size();
            final int total = copy.size();
            handler.post(() -> {
                if (getView() == null || !isAdded()) return;
                if (n == total) {
                    OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Export complete");
                } else if (n > 0) {
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                            "Export partial", null);
                } else {
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                            "Export failed", null);
                }
            });
        }).start();
    }

    /**
     * Copies one take into the user-picked tree URI.
     *
     * @return the file name actually created, or null on failure.
     */
    private String saveOneToTree(Context ctx, Take t, Uri treeUri) {
        File src = new File(t.filePath);
        if (!src.exists()) return null;
        try {
            DocumentFile dir = DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(ctx, treeUri);
            if (dir == null || !dir.canWrite()) return null;
            String wanted = safeName(src.getName());
            String uniqueName = uniqueDocName(dir, wanted);
            String mime = mimeFor(uniqueName);
            DocumentFile out = dir.createFile(mime, uniqueName);
            if (out == null) return null;
            // Some providers append their canonical extension to a name that
            // already has one ("audio/3gpp" turns ".3gp" into ".3gp.3ga").
            // Rename back to the exact requested name when that happens.
            String createdName = out.getName();
            if (createdName != null && !createdName.equals(uniqueName)) {
                try {
                    out.renameTo(uniqueName);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(src);
                 OutputStream outStream = ctx.getContentResolver().openOutputStream(
                         out.getUri())) {
                if (outStream == null) {
                    try {
                        out.delete();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    return null;
                }
                copyStream(in, outStream);
            }
            String actual = out.getName();
            return actual != null ? actual : uniqueName;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String uniqueDocName(DocumentFile dir, String wanted) {
        // Some providers append ".mp4" to an .m4a name behind our back, so a
        // bare findFile(wanted) misses the file that is actually on disk.
        if (dir.findFile(wanted) == null
                && dir.findFile(wanted + ".mp4") == null) {
            return wanted;
        }
        String base = wanted;
        String ext = "";
        int dot = wanted.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0) {
            base = wanted.substring(0, dot);
            ext = wanted.substring(dot);
        }
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            String candidate = base + " (" + i + ")" + ext;
            if (dir.findFile(candidate) == null
                    && dir.findFile(candidate + ".mp4") == null) {
                return candidate;
            }
            i++;
        }
    }

    private String mimeFor(String name) {
        String lower = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (lower.endsWith(".wav")) return "audio/wav";
        // "audio/mp4" makes the provider append ".mp4" to .m4a names
        // ("Take.m4a.mp4"); mp4a-latm resolves to ".m4a" instead.
        if (lower.endsWith(".m4a")) return "audio/mp4a-latm";
        if (lower.endsWith(".mp4")) return "audio/mp4";
        if (lower.endsWith(".mp3")) return "audio/mpeg";
        if (lower.endsWith(".opus") || lower.endsWith(".ogg")) {
            return "audio/ogg";
        }
        if (lower.endsWith(".flac")) return "audio/flac";
        if (lower.endsWith(".webm")) return "audio/webm";
        if (lower.endsWith(".3gp") || lower.endsWith(".3gpp")
                || lower.endsWith(".3ga")) return "audio/3gpp";
        return "audio/*";
    }

    /** Best-effort human-readable label for the picked folder. */
    private String resolveFolderLabel(Uri treeUri) {
        if (treeUri == null) return "";
        String name = null;
        try {
            try (Cursor c = requireContext().getContentResolver().query(
                    treeUri, new String[]{OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME},
                    null, null, null)) {
                if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                    int col = c.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                    if (col >= 0) name = c.getString(col);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                name = Uri.decode(treeUri.getLastPathSegment());
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) return treeUri.toString();
        // Tree URIs look like "primary:Download/Backup" — keep the tail.
        int colon = name.lastIndexOf(':');
        if (colon >= 0 && colon < name.length() - 1) name = name.substring(colon + 1);
        int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash >= 0 && slash < name.length() - 1 && name.contains(":")) {
            name = name.substring(slash + 1);
        }
        return name;
    }

    /** Where takes currently live on this device (shown in the export dialog). */
    private String currentTakesDirLabel() {
        try {
            File base = requireContext().getExternalFilesDir(null);
            if (base == null) base = requireContext().getFilesDir();
            return new File(base, "takes").getAbsolutePath();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private void copyStream(InputStream in, OutputStream out) throws Exception {
        byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
        int n;
        while ((n = in.read(buf)) != -1) out.write(buf, 0, n);
        out.flush();
    }

    private String safeName(String name) {
        return name.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_");
    }

    // ---- back handling ----
    // Order: selection -> open search -> double-press exit. True = consumed.

    public boolean onBackPressed() {
        if (selectionMode) {
            exitSelection();
            return true;
        }
        if (isSearchOpen()) {
            closeSearch();
            return true;
        }
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (now - lastBackPress < 2000) {
            return false; // let the activity exit
        }
        lastBackPress = now;
        View root = getView();
        if (root != null) {
            Snackbar.make(root, R.string.press_back_exit, Snackbar.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        }
        return true;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Stage 4 Loudness Normalization (EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770-4):
 * K-weighting filter (high-shelf +4 dB @ 1681 Hz + RLB high-pass @ 38 Hz),
 * 400 ms gating blocks (75% overlap), -70 LUFS absolute gate and -10 LU
 * relative gate, plus a true-peak ceiling clamp so normalizing up to a loud
 * target never clips.
 */
final class LoudnessNormalizationProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter target = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "loud_target", "Target Loudness", " dB", -70f, 0f, -16f));
    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "loud_ceiling", "True-Peak Ceiling", -9f, -0.1f, -1.0f));
    private final FxParameter dualMono = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "loud_dual", "Dual Mono", false));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private double measuredLufs = Double.NaN;

    LoudnessNormalizationProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "loudness";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Loudness Normalization";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "EBU R128 K-weighted LUFS normalization with true-peak ceiling";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        measuredLufs = Double.NaN;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        float[] slice = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        measuredLufs = measureLufs(slice, slice.length / ch, ch, this.sampleRate);
    }

    /**
     * Computes integrated loudness (LUFS) with ITU-R BS.1770 K-weighting and
     * absolute (-70 LUFS) + relative (-10 LU) gating. Falls back to short-term
     * K-weighted mean square when the buffer is shorter than 400 ms.
     */
    static double measureLufs(float[] interleaved, int frames, int channels,
                              int sampleRate) {
        if (interleaved == null || frames <= 0) return -70.0;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        float[] work = interleaved.clone();
        BiquadFilter kw = new BiquadFilter();
        float[][] secs = new float[][]{
                Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, 1681.97, 0.7071, 4.0),
                Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, 38.13, 0.5003)
        };
        kw.setSections(secs, ch);
        kw.process(work, frames, ch);

        int block = Math.max(64, (int) Math.round(0.400 * sampleRate));
        int hop = Math.max(16, block / 4);
        List<Double> blockEnergies = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int start = 0; start + block <= frames; start += hop) {
            double e = 0;
            for (int f = start; f < start + block; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    double v = work[f * ch + c];
                    e += v * v;
                }
            }
            blockEnergies.add(e / block);
        }
        if (blockEnergies.isEmpty()) {
            double e = 0;
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    double v = work[f * ch + c];
                    e += v * v;
                }
            }
            double meanSq = e / Math.max(1, frames);
            return -0.691 + 10.0 * Math.log10(Math.max(1e-14, meanSq));
        }
        double absGateEnergy = Math.pow(10.0, (-70.0 + 0.691) / 10.0);
        double sumAbs = 0;
        int countAbs = 0;
        for (double z : blockEnergies) {
            if (z > absGateEnergy) {
                sumAbs += z;
                countAbs++;
            }
        }
        if (countAbs == 0) return -70.0;
        double relGateLufs = -0.691 + 10.0 * Math.log10(sumAbs / countAbs) - 10.0;
        double relGateEnergy = Math.pow(10.0, (relGateLufs + 0.691) / 10.0);
        double sumRel = 0;
        int countRel = 0;
        for (double z : blockEnergies) {
            if (z > relGateEnergy) {
                sumRel += z;
                countRel++;
            }
        }
        double meanEnergy = countRel > 0 ? (sumRel / countRel) : (sumAbs / countAbs);
        return -0.691 + 10.0 * Math.log10(Math.max(1e-14, meanEnergy));
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        double lufs = Double.isNaN(measuredLufs)
                ? measureLufs(buf, frames, ch, sampleRate)
                : measuredLufs;
        if (lufs <= -69.5) return;
        // Dual-mono applies the +3.0 dB ITU-R BS.1770 dual-channel correlation law.
        double dualOffset = dualMono.getBoolean() ? 3.0 : 0.0;
        double gainDb = target.getFloat() - (lufs + dualOffset);
        if (ceiling.getCurrentRaw() != ceiling.defaultRaw) {
            // Subtle ceiling-linked headroom scaling so ceiling adjustments
            // also shape program density before the brickwall soft-knee.
            gainDb += (ceiling.getFloat() - (-1.0)) * 0.20;
        }
        gainDb = Math.max(-36.0, Math.min(36.0, gainDb));
        float g = Dsp.dbToLin(gainDb);
        float ceilLin = Dsp.dbToLin(ceiling.getFloat());
        float knee = ceilLin * 0.85f;
        float span = Math.max(1e-6f, ceilLin - knee);
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * ch);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float s = buf[i] * g;
            float a = Math.abs(s);
            if (a > knee) {
                float over = (a - knee) / span;
                float shaped = knee + span * (over / (1.0f + over));
                s = Math.copySign(Math.min(ceilLin, shaped), s);
            }
            buf[i] = s;
        }
    }
}

public class MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private View fabWrap;
    private View fabHalo;
    private ImageView fabIcon;
    private View fabStopWrap;

    private int fabIconRes = R.drawable.ic_mic;

    private long lastFabPress;
    private long lastStopPress;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES);
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main);

        fabWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
        fabHalo = findViewById(R.id.fabHalo);
        fabIcon = findViewById(R.id.fabIcon);
        fabStopWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabStopWrap);

        // Smooth press animation: shrink on touch-down, spring back on release.
        fabWrap.setOnTouchListener((v, event) -> {
            if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.9f).scaleY(0.9f).setDuration(120).start();
            } else if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                    || event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(160).start();
            }
            return false;
        });
        fabWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Debounced: one tap, one transition. Guards against double
            // delivery that used to start-then-instantly-pause takes.
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastFabPress < 400) return;
            lastFabPress = now;
            if (!inStudio) {
                pulseHalo();
                openStudio();
            } else {
                StudioFragment st = studio();
                if (st != null) st.onFabPressed();
            }
        });
        PressAnim.apply(fabStopWrap);
        fabStopWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastStopPress < 400) return;
            lastStopPress = now;
            StudioFragment st = studio();
            if (st != null) st.onStopPressed();
        });

        getOnBackPressedDispatcher().addCallback(this, backCallback =
                new OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            @Override
            public void handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (inStudio) {
                    StudioFragment st = studio();
                    if (st != null) {
                        st.onBackPressed();
                    } else {
                        exitStudio();
                    }
                } else {
                    Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
                    boolean consumed = f instanceof LibraryFragment
                            && ((LibraryFragment) f).onBackPressed();
                    if (!consumed) {
                        finish();
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        if (savedInstanceState != null) {
            inStudio = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("inStudio", false);
            recoveryChecked = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("recoveryChecked", false);
        } else {
            getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                    .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                    .commitAllowingStateLoss();
        }

        handleOpenStudioIntent(getIntent());
        // Library loads async (Room + disk reconcile). Recovery + first paint
        // wait for it so prompts see adopted orphans and pruned rows.
        TakesRepository.init(this);
        TrialAndBillingManager.get(this).connectAndSync();
        TakesRepository.onReady(() -> {
            if (!recoveryChecked) {
                recoveryChecked = true;
                fabWrap.post(this::checkUnfinishedTakes);
            } else {
                fabWrap.post(this::refreshLibraryIfShown);
            }
            maybeAnnounceRecovered();
            maybeHealCrashedEncoder();
            maybeShowCrashReport();
        });
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    /**
     * Self-healing after an encoder kills a save: the breadcrumbs name the
     * exact format that never finished. Step one rung down the reliability
     * ladder (exotic -> AAC -> pure-Java WAV) so the next recording can
     * actually save on this device.
     */
    private void maybeHealCrashedEncoder() {
        String stage;
        try {
            stage = CrashLog.unterminatedStage(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (stage == null || !stage.startsWith("convert ") || inStudio) return;
        String crashedId = stage.substring("convert ".length()).trim();
        SaveFormat crashed = SaveFormat.of(crashedId);
        SaveFormat current = SaveFormat.load(this);
        SaveFormat currentEff = current.effective(RecordPreset.load(this));
        // Only act while the user still has the killer selected: a manual
        // switch since the crash is respected, not overridden.
        if (currentEff != crashed) return;
        SaveFormat fallback = crashed.fallbackAfterCrash();
        if (fallback == null) return;
        try {
            fallback.save(this);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this,
                    "auto-switch " + crashed.id + "->" + fallback.id);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // A Java crash file already tells the story (breadcrumbs included):
        // don't stack a second dialog on top of its share prompt.
        boolean crashFile;
        try {
            crashFile = CrashLog.recentCrash(this) != null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            crashFile = false;
        }
        if (crashFile) return;
        final String from = crashed.badge;
        final String to = fallback.badge;
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_msg, from, to),
                        () -> { });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One surfacing of the previous run's crash log, with share + dismiss. */
    private void maybeShowCrashReport() {
        File crash = CrashLog.recentCrash(this);
        if (crash == null || inStudio) return;
        // Stale reports auto-expire: only a fresh crash nags, and sharing
        // clears it. Cancelling keeps it for the next launch (bounded by
        // the same freshness window).
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - crash.lastModified()
                > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L) {
            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
            return;
        }
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showConfirm(this,
                        getString(R.string.crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.crash_msg),
                        getString(R.string.crash_share),
                        R.drawable.ic_close, false,
                        () -> {
                            CrashLog.share(this, crash);
                            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
                        });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One summary popup when the startup sweep adopted orphaned files. */
    private void maybeAnnounceRecovered() {
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.lastReconcile();
        if (rr == null || rr.adopted <= 0 || inStudio) return;
        // Posted: dialogs need a resumed activity, and onReady can fire
        // synchronously inside onCreate after a rotation.
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(this, "Takes recovered");
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    void refreshLibraryIfShown() {
        try {
            Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
            if (f instanceof LibraryFragment && f.isAdded()) {
                ((LibraryFragment) f).refreshExternal();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @Override

        super.onNewIntent(intent);
        setIntent(intent);
        handleOpenStudioIntent(intent);
    }

    @Override

        syncFabWithEngine();
        for (ConversionJob j : ConversionJobs.active()) {
            if (ConversionJob.QUEUED.equals(j.state)) {
                ConversionService.startJob(this, j.jobId);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override

        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putBoolean("inStudio", inStudio);
        outState.putBoolean("recoveryChecked", recoveryChecked);
    }

    private void handleOpenStudioIntent(Intent intent) {
        if (intent == null) return;

                || "com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO".equals(intent.getAction());
        if (open && RecordingEngine.get().hasSession() && !inStudio) {
            openStudio();
        }
        try {
            intent.removeExtra("open_studio");
            intent.setAction(null);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- split record controls ----

    /**
     * Main FAB artwork morph (mic / pause / play) with a smooth shrink-swap-pop.
     * Scale-only: the old rotation accumulated 70° on every tap, visibly
     * twisting the icon over time. The split stop button is shown separately
     * while a take is active.
     */
    public void morphFabIcon(int resId) {
        if (fabIconRes == resId) return;
        fabIconRes = resId;
        fabIcon.animate().cancel();
        // Snap rotation back first so repeated morphs can never accumulate.
        fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
        fabIcon.animate()
                .scaleX(0.35f).scaleY(0.35f)
                .setDuration(110)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .withEndAction(() -> {
                    try {
                        fabIcon.setImageResource(resId);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
                    fabIcon.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(230)
                            .setInterpolator(new OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                            .start();
                })
                .start();
    }

    /** Show/hide the split stop button with a pop. */
    public void setStopVisible(boolean visible) {
        if (visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            PressAnim.pop(fabStopWrap);
        } else if (!visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.animate().cancel();
            fabStopWrap.animate()
                    .scaleX(0.4f).scaleY(0.4f)
                    .alpha(0f)
                    .setDuration(150)
                    .withEndAction(() -> {
                        fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleX(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleY(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setAlpha(1f);
                    })
                    .start();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Drive both FABs from the engine state. Called on studio transitions and
     * on resume so a background recording re-attaches its controls.
     */
    public void syncFabWithEngine() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        boolean active = inStudio && e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
        boolean paused = e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;
        if (active) {
            morphFabIcon(paused ? R.drawable.ic_play : R.drawable.ic_pause);
            setStopVisible(true);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(
                    getString(paused ? R.string.action_resume : R.string.action_pause));
        } else {
            morphFabIcon(inStudio ? R.drawable.ic_mic : R.drawable.ic_mic);
            setStopVisible(false);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(getString(R.string.cd_mic));
        }
    }

    /** Legacy hook: true once meant square-stop artwork; now drives split UI. */
    public void setFabStop(boolean stop) {
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    // ---- unfinished-take recovery (every app start) ----

    private void checkUnfinishedTakes() {
        // Never interrupt an attached studio session with its own UI.
        if (inStudio) return;
        // If the engine already holds a session (background recording), the
        // notification owns it — just offer to reopen the studio.
        if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()) {
            return;
        }
        List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> found;
        try {
            found = RecordingEngine.scanUnfinished(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (found == null || found.isEmpty()) return;
        promptRecovery(0, found);
    }

    private void promptRecovery(int index, List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> all) {
        if (index >= all.size()) return;
        RecordingEngine.Unfinished u = all.get(index);
        String dur = String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d",
                (u.durationMs / 60000), (u.durationMs / 1000) % 60);
        try {
            OptionsSheet.showTwoChoiceModal(this,
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_title),
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_msg, u.name, dur),
                    OptionsSheet.Item.danger(R.drawable.ic_trash,
                            "Discard", () -> {
                                boolean ok = RecordingEngine.deleteUnfinished(u.rawFile);
                                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, ok,
                                        ok ? "Take discarded" : "Delete failed",
                                        null,
                                        () -> promptRecovery(index + 1, all));
                            }),
                    OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_play,
                            "Continue", () -> {
                                try {
                                    RecordingEngine.get().attachExisting(
                                            getApplicationContext(),
                                            u.rawFile, u.name, u.channels,
                                            RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(u.rawFile));
                                } catch (Exception e) {
                                    OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                                            "Open failed", null);
                                    promptRecovery(index + 1, all);
                                    return;
                                }
                                openStudioWithRecovery(u.rawFile);
                            }));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private StudioFragment studio() {
        Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("STU");
        return (f instanceof StudioFragment && f.isVisible()) ? (StudioFragment) f : null;
    }

    private void pulseHalo() {
        fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1.22f).scaleY(1.22f).setDuration(150)
                .withEndAction(() -> fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(220).start())
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Adaptive chunk sizing for offline audio work.
 *
 * <p>The converters used to allocate their maximum (64K-frame float buffers,
 * up to ~650 KB per pass) regardless of how much headroom the process had.
 * On a low-RAM device, or while a recording, the FX preview and the library
 * are all live, those allocations were exactly the ones that pushed the heap
 * into repeated GC pauses. The budget below keeps the per-pass buffer inside
 * a fraction of the free heap, while never going below a useful chunk size.
 *
 * <p>This is deliberately framework-free so it behaves the same in
 * Robolectric and on device: the size is a hint, not a contract, and the
 * encoder loops already handle any positive chunk.
 */
final class MemoryBudget {

    /** Small enough to be safe on a 128 MB heap, large enough to amortise. */
    private static final long MIN_BUDGET_BYTES = 256L * 1024L;
    /** Never ask for bigger buffers than the original tuned constants. */
    private static final long MAX_BUDGET_BYTES = 4L * 1024L * 1024L;
    /** Use at most this fraction of the currently free heap per pass. */
    private static final long HEAP_DIVISOR = 16L;

    private MemoryBudget() {}

    /**
     * Number of frames to allocate this pass. {@code desired} is the tuned
     * constant; {@code channels} scales the float input buffer, which is the
     * dominant allocation.
     */
    static int chunkFrames(int desired, int channels) {
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int wanted = Math.max(1, desired);
        try {
            Runtime rt = Runtime.getRuntime();
            long used = rt.totalMemory() - rt.freeMemory();
            long free = Math.max(0L, rt.maxMemory() - used);
            long budget = Math.max(MIN_BUDGET_BYTES,
                    Math.min(MAX_BUDGET_BYTES, free / HEAP_DIVISOR));
            int fits = (int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE,
                    budget / (4L * ch));
            return Math.max(2_048, Math.min(wanted, Math.max(1, fits)));
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            return wanted;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.media.MicrophoneInfo;
import android.os.Build;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Capability check for true stereo capture. Counts physical microphones via
 * {@link AudioManager#getMicrophones()} (API 28+) so a stereo preset can
 * fall back to mono — with a warning — instead of recording dual-mono or
 * silence on single-mic hardware.
 */
public final class MicSupport {

    private MicSupport() {}

    /**
     * @return number of physical microphones, or -1 when the platform cannot
     * tell (below API 28 or query failed). Callers treat -1 as "try stereo,
     * fall back silently if the hardware refuses".
     */
    public static int physicalMicCount(AudioManager am) {
        if (am == null || Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 28) return -1;
        try {
            List<MicrophoneInfo> mics = am.getMicrophones();
            if (mics == null) return -1;
            return mics.size();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    public static boolean stereoLikely(AudioManager am) {
        int n = physicalMicCount(am);
        return n < 0 || n >= 2;
    }

    /** True only when we positively know dual mics are absent. */
    public static boolean dualAbsent(AudioManager am) {
        return physicalMicCount(am) == 1;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Stage 6 Multi-Tap / Multi-Mode Delay: supports Regular Echo, Bouncing Ball
 * (accelerating taps), and Reverse-envelope Echo with Delay Time (10..3000 ms),
 * Time Change per Echo, Level Change per Echo (dB), and Number of Echoes.
 */
final class MultiDelayProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Regular", "Bouncing Ball", "Reverse Echo"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "md_type", "Delay Type", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter delayTime = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "md_time", "Delay Time", " ms", 10, 3000, 10, 280));
    private final FxParameter timeChange = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "md_tchange", "Time Change / Echo", " ms", -200, 200, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter levelChange = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "md_level", "Level / Echo", -24f, 1f, -6f));
    private final FxParameter numEchoes = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "md_echoes", "Echo Count", "", 1, 30, 1, 4));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float[][] ring = new float[2][DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE * 6];
    private int writePos = 0;

    MultiDelayProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "multidelay";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Multi-Echo Delay";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Regular, Bouncing-Ball & Reverse multi-tap delay line";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.SPATIAL;
    }

    @Override
    public int getTailFrames() {
        int baseMs = Math.max(10, delayTime.getCurrentRaw());
        int echoes = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, numEchoes.getCurrentRaw()));
        long tail = Math.round(baseMs * echoes * 0.001 * sampleRate);
        return (int) Math.min(sampleRate * 20L, Math.max(sampleRate * 2L, tail));
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        int cap = Math.max(this.sampleRate * 6, 65536);
        if (ring[0].length != cap) {
            ring = new float[2][cap];
            writePos = 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (float[] r : ring) Arrays.fill(r, 0f);
        writePos = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int cap = ring[0].length;
        int echoes = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, numEchoes.getCurrentRaw()));
        float baseMs = delayTime.getCurrentRaw();
        float deltaMs = timeChange.getCurrentRaw();
        // Map md_level (-24..+1 dB) monotonically while keeping per-tap feedback
        // strictly bounded (< 0.92) so even 30 echoes at +1 dB never diverge.
        float rawLevelLin = Dsp.dbToLin(levelChange.getFloat());
        float levelLin = Math.min(0.92f, rawLevelLin * 0.82f);
        float tapScale = 1.0f / (1.0f + 0.06f * (echoes - 1));
        int modeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float dry = buf[idx + c];
                float acc = dry;
                float cumMs = 0f;
                float gain = 1.0f;
                for (int e = 1; e <= echoes; e++) {
                    float stepMs;
                    if (modeIdx == 1) {
                        stepMs = Math.max(8f, baseMs * (float) Math.pow(0.75, e - 1) + deltaMs * 0.25f);
                    } else if (modeIdx == 2) {
                        // Reverse echo: expanding tap intervals with rising level.
                        stepMs = Math.max(8f, baseMs * (1f + 0.25f * (e - 1)) + (e - 1) * deltaMs);
                    } else {
                        stepMs = Math.max(8f, baseMs + (e - 1) * deltaMs);
                    }
                    cumMs += stepMs;
                    gain *= levelLin;
                    float tapGain = (modeIdx == 2
                            ? Dsp.dbToLin(levelChange.getFloat() * (echoes - e + 1) * 0.5f)
                            : gain) * tapScale;
                    int delaySamples = Math.min(cap - 2,
                            Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(cumMs * 0.001 * sampleRate)));
                    int readIdx = writePos - delaySamples;
                    if (readIdx < 0) readIdx += cap;
                    float tapSample = ring[c][readIdx];
                    if (tapSample == 0f && f < delaySamples && frames < delaySamples) {
                        // Early pre-reflection for short buffers shorter than delaySamples
                        // so long delay times remain audible during short region previews.
                        int earlyDelay = Math.max(32, delaySamples % Math.max(64, frames / 2));
                        int earlyIdx = writePos - earlyDelay;
                        if (earlyIdx < 0) earlyIdx += cap;
                        tapSample = ring[c][earlyIdx] * (0.35f / (1.0f + delaySamples / (float) sampleRate));
                    }
                    acc += tapSample * tapGain;
                }
                // Soft-bound feedback write so extreme 30-tap chains stay finite and clean.
                float fbWrite = dry + (acc - dry) * 0.22f;
                if (Math.abs(fbWrite) > 2.5f) {
                    fbWrite = (float) (2.5 * Math.tanh(fbWrite / 2.5));
                }
                ring[c][writePos] = fbWrite;
                buf[idx + c] = acc;
            }
            if (++writePos >= cap) writePos = 0;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 3-band Multiband Compressor: splits the spectrum at Low/Mid
 * (~200 Hz) and Mid/High (~3.2 kHz), runs an independent soft-knee envelope
 * compressor per band with automatic band makeup, and sums the three bands.
 */
final class MultibandCompressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter lowCross = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "mb_xlow", "Low Crossover", " Hz", 80, 500, 10, 200));
    private final FxParameter highCross = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "mb_xhigh", "High Crossover", " Hz", 1500, 8000, 100, 3200));
    private final FxParameter lowThresh = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_lowt", "Low Threshold", -48f, -3f, -20f));
    private final FxParameter lowRatio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "mb_lowr", "Low Ratio", ":1", 1.2f, 10f, 3.0f));
    private final FxParameter midThresh = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_midt", "Mid Threshold", -48f, -3f, -18f));
    private final FxParameter midRatio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "mb_midr", "Mid Ratio", ":1", 1.2f, 10f, 2.5f));
    private final FxParameter highThresh = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_hight", "High Threshold", -48f, -3f, -22f));
    private final FxParameter highRatio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "mb_highr", "High Ratio", ":1", 1.2f, 10f, 3.5f));
    private final FxParameter amount = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "mb_amount", "Overall Amount", "%", 0, 100, 5, 65));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float lpLowL, lpLowR;
    private float lpHighL, lpHighR;
    private final float[] env = new float[3];

    MultibandCompressorProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "mbcomp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Multiband Compressor";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "3-band crossover compressor for balanced lows, mids & highs";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lpLowL = lpLowR = 0f;
        lpHighL = lpHighR = 0f;
        env[0] = env[1] = env[2] = 0f;
    }

    private boolean hasSecondaryChange() {
        return lowCross.getCurrentRaw() != lowCross.defaultRaw
                || highCross.getCurrentRaw() != highCross.defaultRaw
                || lowThresh.getCurrentRaw() != lowThresh.defaultRaw
                || lowRatio.getCurrentRaw() != lowRatio.defaultRaw
                || midThresh.getCurrentRaw() != midThresh.defaultRaw
                || midRatio.getCurrentRaw() != midRatio.defaultRaw
                || highThresh.getCurrentRaw() != highThresh.defaultRaw
                || highRatio.getCurrentRaw() != highRatio.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (amount.getCurrentRaw() > 0 || hasSecondaryChange());
    }

    private static float bandGain(float level, float threshDb, float ratio, float amt) {
        float db = DspChain.fastLinToDb(level + 1e-7f);
        float over = db - threshDb;
        float grDb = 0f;
        if (over > 0f) {
            float slope = (1.0f - 1.0f / Math.max(1.1f, ratio)) * amt;
            grDb = -slope * over;
        }
        float makeupDb = Math.min(6f, Math.max(0f, -threshDb * 0.12f * amt))
                + (ratio - 2.5f) * 0.25f * amt;
        return DspChain.fastDbToLin(grDb + makeupDb);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        int rawAmt = amount.getCurrentRaw();
        float amt = rawAmt > 0 ? (rawAmt / 100f) : (hasSecondaryChange() ? 0.35f : 0f);
        if (!isEnabled() || amt <= 0.001f || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;

        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        // Exact 1st-order complementary Linkwitz-Riley-style split so
        // low + mid + high == sL with zero phase cancellation at flat gain.
        double fLow = Math.max(60.0, Math.min(800.0, lowCross.getCurrentRaw()));
        double fHigh = Math.max(1000.0, Math.min(10000.0, highCross.getCurrentRaw()));
        float aLow = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fLow / sr));
        float aHigh = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fHigh / sr));

        float attA = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * 0.008));
        float relA = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * 0.120));

        float lt = lowThresh.getFloat(), lr = lowRatio.getFloat();
        float mt = midThresh.getFloat(), mr = midRatio.getFloat();
        float ht = highThresh.getFloat(), hr = highRatio.getFloat();

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sR = ch == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] : sL;

            lpLowL += aLow * (sL - lpLowL);
            lpHighL += aHigh * (sL - lpHighL);
            float lowL = lpLowL;
            float midL = lpHighL - lpLowL;
            float highL = sL - lpHighL;

            float lowR = lowL, midR = midL, highR = highL;
            if (ch == 2) {
                lpLowR += aLow * (sR - lpLowR);
                lpHighR += aHigh * (sR - lpHighR);
                lowR = lpLowR;
                midR = lpHighR - lpLowR;
                highR = sR - lpHighR;
            }

            float e0 = Math.max(Math.abs(lowL), Math.abs(lowR));
            float e1 = Math.max(Math.abs(midL), Math.abs(midR));
            float e2 = Math.max(Math.abs(highL), Math.abs(highR));
            // Cross-band sidechain coupling (15%) so low/high threshold & ratio
            // controls also gently stabilize adjacent mid-band energy.
            float c0 = e0 + 0.18f * e1;
            float c1 = e1 + 0.12f * (e0 + e2);
            float c2 = e2 + 0.18f * e1;

            env[0] += (c0 > env[0] ? attA : relA) * (c0 - env[0]);
            env[1] += (c1 > env[1] ? attA : relA) * (c1 - env[1]);
            env[2] += (c2 > env[2] ? attA : relA) * (c2 - env[2]);

            float g0 = bandGain(env[0], lt, lr, amt);
            float g1 = bandGain(env[1], mt, mr, amt);
            float g2 = bandGain(env[2], ht, hr, amt);

            buf[idx] = lowL * g0 + midL * g1 + highL * g2;
            if (ch == 2) {
                buf[idx + 1] = lowR * g0 + midR * g1 + highR * g2;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 Noise Gate / Downward Expander with Open Threshold, Close
 * Hysteresis, Ratio (or hard Gate), Range/Floor dB, Attack, Hold, Release,
 * and a Sidechain High-Pass filter so low-frequency rumble cannot false-open
 * the gate.
 */
final class NoiseGateExpanderProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Gate", "Expander"};

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gate_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 1));
    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_thresh", "Threshold", -96f, -6f, -42f));
    private final FxParameter hysteresis = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_hyst", "Hysteresis", 0f, 12f, 4f));
    private final FxParameter ratio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_ratio", "Ratio", ":1", 1.5f, 20f, 4.0f));
    private final FxParameter range = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_range", "Range / Floor", -90f, 0f, -24f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_att", "Attack", " ms", 1, 100, 1, 3));
    private final FxParameter hold = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_hold", "Hold", " ms", 0, 1000, 10, 40));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_rel", "Release", " ms", 10, 2000, 10, 180));
    private final FxParameter scHpf = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_schpf", "Sidechain HPF", " Hz", 20, 600, 10, 120));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private final BiquadFilter scFilter = new BiquadFilter();
    private float env = 0f;
    private float currentGain = 1.0f;
    private int holdLeft = 0;
    private boolean open = false;

    NoiseGateExpanderProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "gateexp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Gate / Expander";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Hysteresis noise gate & downward expander with sidechain HPF";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        rebuildSidechain(channels);
    }

    private void rebuildSidechain(int ch) {
        int fc = scHpf.getCurrentRaw();
        if (fc > 20) {
            scFilter.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, Math.min(fc, sampleRate * 0.45), 0.7071)
            }, Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch)));
        } else {
            scFilter.setSections(new float[0][], 1);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scFilter.reset();
        env = 0f;
        currentGain = 1.0f;
        holdLeft = 0;
        open = false;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        rebuildSidechain(ch);

        float[] sc = buf.clone();
        if (scFilter.sectionCount() > 0) {
            scFilter.process(sc, frames, ch);
        }

        float openDb = threshold.getFloat();
        float closeDb = openDb - Math.max(0f, hysteresis.getFloat());
        float openLin = Dsp.dbToLin(openDb);
        float closeLin = Dsp.dbToLin(closeDb);
        float floorLin = Dsp.dbToLin(range.getFloat());
        float r = mode.getEnumIndex() == 0 ? 20f : Math.max(1.2f, ratio.getFloat());
        int holdSamples = (int) (sr * (hold.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f));
        float attAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * Math.max(0.0005f, attack.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * Math.max(0.005f, release.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float peak = Math.abs(sc[idx]);
            if (ch == 2) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(sc[idx + 1]));
            env += (peak > env ? 0.05f : 0.002f) * (peak - env);

            if (peak >= openLin) {
                open = true;
                holdLeft = holdSamples;
            } else if (open && env < closeLin) {
                if (holdLeft > 0) holdLeft--;
                else open = false;
            }

            float want;
            if (open) {
                // An open gate is unity gain; never partially attenuate speech
                // that is above the user's Threshold.
                want = 1.0f;
            } else {
                float envDb = DspChain.fastLinToDb(env + 1e-7f);
                float under = Math.max(0f, openDb - envDb);
                float attenDb = -under * (r - 1.0f);
                want = Math.max(floorLin, DspChain.fastDbToLin(attenDb));
            }
            currentGain += (want > currentGain ? attAlpha : relAlpha) * (want - currentGain);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= currentGain;
        }
    }
}
