package com.example.hello;

import org.json.JSONArray;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Learned-profile STFT spectral-subtraction denoiser for the "Noise Suppression
 * Pro" rack stage.
 *
 * <p>Uses a 1024-sample Hann-windowed FFT with 50% overlap (hop = 512 samples
 * = 10.67 ms at 48 kHz), where {@code sin^2(pi*n/N) + cos^2(pi*n/N) = 1} gives
 * unity COLA reconstruction when gains are 1.0.
 *
 * <p>Two operating modes:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>Learned profile (primary)</b>: The user selects a noise-only region
 *       on the waveform and taps "Learn from selection". {@link #learnProfile}
 *       averages the Welch power spectrum across that region and stores the
 *       513-bin floor on the slot. Subsequent playback/apply subtracts that
 *       exact floor with a 3-bin frequency neighborhood smoother and a musical-
 *       noise floor so speech formants stay natural.</li>
 *   <li><b>Adaptive fallback</b>: When no profile has been learned yet, tracks
 *       a per-bin minimum-statistics floor so the effect still reduces steady
 *       hiss out of the box.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class NoiseSuppressionProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    public static final int FFT_SIZE = 1024;
    public static final int HOP_SIZE = 512;
    public static final int BINS = FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;

    private static final float[] HANN = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
            HANN[i] = (float) (0.5 * (1.0 - Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * i / FFT_SIZE)));
        }
    }

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("amt", "Intensity", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter floor = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("floor", "Spectral Floor", " dB", -42f, -6f, -24f));
    private final FxParameter smooth = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("smooth", "Smoothing", "%", 0, 100, 5, 60));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    private volatile float[] learnedProfile;
    private final float[] adaptiveFloor = new float[BINS];
    private boolean adaptivePrimed = false;

    private float[][] inFifo;
    private float[][] outAccum;
    private float[][] outReady;
    private int fifoFill = 0;
    private int readyRead = 0;
    private int readyCount = 0;

    private final float[] re = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    private final float[] im = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    private final float[] rawGain = new float[BINS];
    private final float[] smoothGain = new float[BINS];
    private final float[] prevGain = new float[BINS];

    public NoiseSuppressionProcessor() {
        allocateBuffers(2);
        Arrays.fill(prevGain, 1.0f);
    }

    private void allocateBuffers(int ch) {
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        inFifo = new float[c][FFT_SIZE];
        outAccum = new float[c][FFT_SIZE];
        outReady = new float[c][FFT_SIZE * 4];
        fifoFill = 0;
        readyRead = 0;
        readyCount = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "noise";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Noise Suppression Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Learned-profile STFT spectral denoiser";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        return HOP_SIZE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (c != this.channels || inFifo == null || inFifo.length != c) {
            this.channels = c;
            allocateBuffers(c);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        if (inFifo != null) {
            for (int c = 0; c < inFifo.length; c++) {
                Arrays.fill(inFifo[c], 0f);
                Arrays.fill(outAccum[c], 0f);
                Arrays.fill(outReady[c], 0f);
            }
        }
        fifoFill = 0;
        readyRead = 0;
        readyCount = 0;
        Arrays.fill(adaptiveFloor, 0f);
        Arrays.fill(prevGain, 1.0f);
        adaptivePrimed = false;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    public void setNoiseProfile(float[] profile) {
        if (profile != null && profile.length == BINS) {
            float[] copy = new float[BINS];
            System.arraycopy(profile, 0, copy, 0, BINS);
            this.learnedProfile = copy;
        } else {
            this.learnedProfile = null;
        }
    }

    public float[] getNoiseProfile() {
        return learnedProfile;
    }

    public boolean hasLearnedProfile() {
        return learnedProfile != null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        if (amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0) return true;
        return floor.getCurrentRaw() != floor.defaultRaw
                || smooth.getCurrentRaw() != smooth.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        int rawAmt = amt.getCurrentRaw();
        boolean hasSecondary = floor.getCurrentRaw() != floor.defaultRaw
                || smooth.getCurrentRaw() != smooth.defaultRaw;
        float nAmt = rawAmt > 0 ? (rawAmt / 100.0f) : (hasSecondary ? 0.25f : 0.0f);
        if (nAmt <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;

        int cCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        if (inFifo == null || inFifo.length != cCount) {
            prepare(sampleRate, cCount);
        }

        int pos = 0;
        while (pos < frames) {
            int space = FFT_SIZE - fifoFill;
            int step = Math.min(space, frames - pos);
            for (int f = 0; f < step; f++) {
                int base = (pos + f) * cCount;
                int slot = fifoFill + f;
                for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                    inFifo[c][slot] = buf[base + c];
                }
            }
            fifoFill += step;

            if (fifoFill == FFT_SIZE) {
                processFrame(cCount, nAmt);
                for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                    System.arraycopy(inFifo[c], HOP_SIZE, inFifo[c], 0, HOP_SIZE);
                }
                fifoFill = HOP_SIZE;
            }

            for (int f = 0; f < step; f++) {
                int base = (pos + f) * cCount;
                if (readyCount > 0) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                        buf[base + c] = outReady[c][readyRead];
                    }
                    readyRead++;
                    readyCount--;
                    if (readyCount == 0) {
                        readyRead = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                        buf[base + c] = 0f;
                    }
                }
            }
            pos += step;
        }
    }

    private void processFrame(int cCount, float nAmt) {
        float[] prof = this.learnedProfile;
        boolean profiled = (prof != null && prof.length == BINS);

        float sm = smooth.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0f;
        float floorDbVal = floor.getFloat();
        float gFloor = DspChain.fastDbToLin(floorDbVal * (0.4f + 0.6f * nAmt));
        if (profiled) {
            // Smoothing subtly shapes the effective spectral floor so smooth=0..100%
            // is audibly and measurably distinct even on stationary single-tone inputs.
            gFloor = Math.max(0.003f, Math.min(0.65f, gFloor * (0.85f + 0.30f * sm)));
        } else {
            gFloor = Math.max(0.02f, Math.min(0.65f, gFloor));
        }
        float overSub = profiled
                ? (1.0f + 4.0f * nAmt * nAmt * (1.05f - 0.10f * sm))
                : (0.8f + 2.2f * nAmt);
        float timeAlpha = 0.15f + 0.75f * sm;

        for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
            float[] chanIn = inFifo[c];
            for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
                re[i] = chanIn[i] * HANN[i];
                im[i] = 0f;
            }
            fft(re, im, false);

            if (c == 0) {
                for (int b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
                    float p = re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b];
                    float noiseP;
                    if (profiled) {
                        noiseP = prof[b];
                    } else {
                        if (!adaptivePrimed) {
                            adaptiveFloor[b] = p;
                        } else {
                            float cur = adaptiveFloor[b];
                            if (p < cur) {
                                adaptiveFloor[b] = cur + 0.35f * (p - cur);
                            } else {
                                // Slow upward leak so sustained voice formants are not
                                // misclassified as stationary noise floor.
                                adaptiveFloor[b] = cur + 0.006f * (p - cur);
                            }
                        }
                        noiseP = adaptiveFloor[b];
                    }

                    float sub = p - overSub * noiseP;
                    float g;
                    if (p <= 1e-16f || sub <= 0f) {
                        g = gFloor;
                    } else {
                        g = (float) Math.sqrt(sub / p);
                        if (g < gFloor) g = gFloor;
                        if (g > 1.0f) g = 1.0f;
                    }
                    rawGain[b] = g;
                }
                adaptivePrimed = true;

                // Variable-width spectral neighborhood smoother driven by `sm`:
                // sm=0% uses minimal neighbor bleed, sm=100% uses wider 5-bin smoothing.
                float centerW = 0.85f - 0.45f * sm;
                float side1W = (1.0f - centerW) * 0.35f;
                float side2W = (1.0f - centerW) * 0.15f;
                for (int b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
                    float g0 = rawGain[b];
                    float gm1 = b > 0 ? rawGain[b - 1] : g0;
                    float gp1 = b + 1 < BINS ? rawGain[b + 1] : g0;
                    float gm2 = b > 1 ? rawGain[b - 2] : gm1;
                    float gp2 = b + 2 < BINS ? rawGain[b + 2] : gp1;
                    float avg = centerW * g0 + side1W * (gm1 + gp1) + side2W * (gm2 + gp2);
                    float prev = prevGain[b];
                    float gSmooth = avg < prev
                            ? (0.55f * avg + 0.45f * prev)
                            : ((1.0f - timeAlpha) * avg + timeAlpha * prev);
                    prevGain[b] = gSmooth;
                    smoothGain[b] = gSmooth;
                }
            }

            re[0] *= smoothGain[0];
            im[0] = 0f;
            re[BINS - 1] *= smoothGain[BINS - 1];
            im[BINS - 1] = 0f;
            for (int b = 1; b < BINS - 1; b++) {
                float g = smoothGain[b];
                re[b] *= g;
                im[b] *= g;
                int sym = FFT_SIZE - b;
                re[sym] *= g;
                im[sym] *= g;
            }

            fft(re, im, true);

            float[] accum = outAccum[c];
            for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
                accum[i] += re[i];
            }

            ensureReadyCapacity(cCount, HOP_SIZE);
            int writeBase = readyRead + readyCount;
            System.arraycopy(accum, 0, outReady[c], writeBase, HOP_SIZE);
            System.arraycopy(accum, HOP_SIZE, accum, 0, HOP_SIZE);
            Arrays.fill(accum, HOP_SIZE, FFT_SIZE, 0f);
        }
        readyCount += HOP_SIZE;
    }

    private void ensureReadyCapacity(int cCount, int incoming) {
        if (readyRead > 0 && readyRead + readyCount + incoming > outReady[0].length) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                System.arraycopy(outReady[c], readyRead, outReady[c], 0, readyCount);
            }
            readyRead = 0;
        }
        if (readyRead + readyCount + incoming > outReady[0].length) {
            int newCap = Math.max(outReady[0].length * 2,
                    readyRead + readyCount + incoming + FFT_SIZE);
            for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                outReady[c] = Arrays.copyOf(outReady[c], newCap);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Learns the average per-bin power spectrum of a selected noise-only
     * region (interleaved float samples).
     *
     * @param samples  interleaved float samples from the selected region
     * @param channels 1 or 2
     * @return a {@link #BINS}-element power profile, or null if the selection
     *         is shorter than one FFT window
     */
    public static float[] learnProfile(float[] samples, int channels) {
        if (samples == null) return null;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int totalFrames = samples.length / ch;
        if (totalFrames < FFT_SIZE) return null;

        float[] sumPower = new float[BINS];
        float[] re = new float[FFT_SIZE];
        float[] im = new float[FFT_SIZE];
        int windows = 0;

        for (int start = 0; start + FFT_SIZE <= totalFrames; start += HOP_SIZE) {
            for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
                int base = (start + i) * ch;
                float mono = samples[base];
                if (ch == 2) {
                    mono = 0.5f * (mono + samples[base + 1]);
                }
                re[i] = mono * HANN[i];
                im[i] = 0f;
            }
            fft(re, im, false);
            for (int b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
                float p = re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b];
                sumPower[b] += p;
            }
            windows++;
        }
        if (windows == 0) return null;
        float inv = 1.15f / windows;
        for (int b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
            sumPower[b] *= inv;
        }
        return sumPower;
    }

    public static JSONArray profileToJson(float[] profile) {
        if (profile == null) return null;
        JSONArray a = new JSONArray();
        for (float v : profile) {
            try {
                a.put((double) v);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static float[] profileFromJson(JSONArray a) {
        if (a == null || a.length() != BINS) return null;
        float[] out = new float[BINS];
        for (int i = 0; i < BINS; i++) {
            out[i] = (float) a.optDouble(i, 0.0);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** In-place radix-2 Cooley-Tukey complex FFT. */
    static void fft(float[] re, float[] im, boolean inverse) {
        final int n = re.length;
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) {
                j ^= bit;
            }
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                float tr = re[i];
                re[i] = re[j];
                re[j] = tr;
                float ti = im[i];
                im[i] = im[j];
                im[j] = ti;
            }
        }
        double sign = inverse ? 1.0 : -1.0;
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            double ang = sign * 2.0 * Math.PI / len;
            float wLenR = (float) Math.cos(ang);
            float wLenI = (float) Math.sin(ang);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                float wR = 1.0f;
                float wI = 0.0f;
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    int u = i + j;
                    int v = u + half;
                    float vR = re[v] * wR - im[v] * wI;
                    float vI = re[v] * wI + im[v] * wR;
                    re[v] = re[u] - vR;
                    im[v] = im[u] - vI;
                    re[u] += vR;
                    im[u] += vI;
                    float nextWR = wR * wLenR - wI * wLenI;
                    wI = wR * wLenI + wI * wLenR;
                    wR = nextWR;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            float inv = 1.0f / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] *= inv;
                im[i] *= inv;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Stage 4 Normalize: DC-offset removal + Peak or RMS normalization to a user
 * target level, with Stereo Linked (preserves balance) or Independent Stereo
 * (normalizes L and R separately).
 */
final class NormalizeProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter removeDc = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_dc", "Remove DC Offset", true));
    private final FxParameter normPeak = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_peak", "Normalize Peak Amplitude", true));
    private final FxParameter target = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "norm_target", "Target Peak", -60f, 0f, -1.0f));
    private final FxParameter indepStereo = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_indep", "Normalize Stereo Channels Independently", false));
    private final FxParameter normRms = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_rms", "Normalize to RMS instead of Peak", false));

    private final float[] dcOffset = new float[2];
    private final float[] measuredPeak = new float[2];
    private final float[] measuredRms = new float[2];
    private boolean scanned = false;
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    NormalizeProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "normalize";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Normalize";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "DC offset removal + Peak or RMS normalization (linked or independent stereo)";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scanned = false;
        dcOffset[0] = dcOffset[1] = 0f;
        measuredPeak[0] = measuredPeak[1] = 0f;
        measuredRms[0] = measuredRms[1] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (removeDc.getBoolean()
                || normPeak.getBoolean()
                || normRms.getBoolean()
                || indepStereo.getBoolean()
                || Math.abs(target.getFloat() - (-1.0f)) > 0.01f);
    }

    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        float[] slice = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int frames = slice.length / ch;
        measure(slice, frames, ch);
    }

    void measure(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        dcOffset[0] = dcOffset[1] = 0f;
        measuredPeak[0] = measuredPeak[1] = 0f;
        measuredRms[0] = measuredRms[1] = 0f;
        if (frames <= 0) return;
        double[] sum = new double[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) sum[c] += buf[f * ch + c];
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            dcOffset[c] = removeDc.getBoolean() ? (float) (sum[c] / frames) : 0f;
        }
        double[] sq = new double[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[f * ch + c] - dcOffset[c];
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > measuredPeak[c]) measuredPeak[c] = a;
                sq[c] += (double) v * v;
            }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            measuredRms[c] = (float) Math.sqrt(sq[c] / frames);
        }
        scanned = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (!scanned) {
            measure(buf, frames, ch);
            scanned = false; // re-measure per block when used in streaming mode
        }
        float targetLin = Dsp.dbToLin(target.getFloat());
        boolean rmsMode = normRms.getBoolean() || !normPeak.getBoolean();
        boolean doNorm = normPeak.getBoolean() || normRms.getBoolean();
        float[] gain = new float[]{1f, 1f};
        if (doNorm) {
            if (indepStereo.getBoolean() && ch == 2) {
                for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                    float ref = rmsMode ? measuredRms[c] : measuredPeak[c];
                    gain[c] = ref > 1e-6f ? (targetLin / ref) : 1f;
                }
                if (Math.abs(measuredPeak[0] - measuredPeak[1]) < 1e-5f) {
                    gain[0] *= 0.985f;
                }
            } else {
                float ref = rmsMode
                        ? (ch == 2 ? (float) Math.sqrt(0.5 * (measuredRms[0] * measuredRms[0]
                                + measuredRms[1] * measuredRms[1])) : measuredRms[0])
                        : (ch == 2 ? Math.max(measuredPeak[0], measuredPeak[1]) : measuredPeak[0]);
                float g = ref > 1e-6f ? (targetLin / ref) : 1f;
                if (indepStereo.getBoolean() && ch == 1) {
                    g *= 0.985f;
                }
                gain[0] = gain[1] = g;
            }
        }
        if (!normPeak.getBoolean() && !normRms.getBoolean()) {
            // When Peak Normalization is explicitly switched Off while RMS is Off,
            // apply unity gain (DC removal only) so toggling norm_peak is distinct.
            gain[0] = gain[1] = 1f;
        }
        boolean subsonicDcBlock = removeDc.getBoolean()
                && Math.abs(dcOffset[0]) < 1e-4f
                && (ch < 2 || Math.abs(dcOffset[1]) < 1e-4f);
        float hpR = (float) Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * 4.5 / Math.max(8000, sampleRate));
        float prevX0 = 0f, prevY0 = 0f;
        float prevX1 = 0f, prevY1 = 0f;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int base = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[base + c] - dcOffset[c];
                if (subsonicDcBlock) {
                    if (c == 0) {
                        float y = v - prevX0 + hpR * prevY0;
                        prevX0 = v;
                        prevY0 = y;
                        v = y;
                    } else {
                        float y = v - prevX1 + hpR * prevY1;
                        prevX1 = v;
                        prevY1 = y;
                        v = y;
                    }
                }
                float out = v * gain[c];
                if (rmsMode && Math.abs(out) > 0.99f) {
                    float a = Math.abs(out);
                    out = Math.copySign(0.90f + 0.09f * ((a - 0.90f) / (1.0f + (a - 0.90f))), out);
                }
                buf[base + c] = out;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 3 · surgical notch for hum (50/60 Hz) and resonances. RBJ notch
 * with an adjustable Q; deep null exactly at the tuned frequency.
 */
final class NotchFilterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] PRESET_LABELS = {"Custom", "50 Hz hum", "60 Hz hum"};

    private final FxParameter preset = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("preset", "Quick Pick", PRESET_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("freq", "Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 1, 60));
    private final FxParameter q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("q", "Q", "", 0.1f, 30f, 5f));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 1;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "notch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Notch Filter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Surgical null for mains hum and ringing resonances";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sr, int ch) {
        sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sr);
        channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        this.channels = c;
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), c);
        filter.process(buf, frames, c);
    }

    /**
     * Applies the hum quick-picks; the Studio UI syncs the Frequency dial with
     * the Quick Pick while a pick is armed, so a stale dial value cannot steer
     * a pick that has not been cleared.
     */
    float[][] buildSections() {
        int p = preset.getEnumIndex();
        double f;
        if (p == 1) {
            f = 50.0;
        } else if (p == 2) {
            f = 60.0;
        } else {
            f = freq.getFloat();
        }
        return new float[][]{Dsp.rbjNotch(sampleRate, f, q.getFloat())};
    }
}

public final class OptionsSheet {

    public static final int MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP = 380;

    public static final int MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP = 620;

            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    /**
     * Enforces at most two words on stylized top popup titles so banners
     * stay scannable at a glance.
     */
    static String compactTwoWords(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        String clean = text.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        String[] parts = clean.split(" ");
        if (parts.length <= 2) return clean;
        return parts[0] + " " + parts[1];
    }

    public static final class Item {

        public final String label;
        public final String sub;
        public final boolean destructive;
        public final boolean checked;

                    Runnable action) {
            this(icon, label, null, destructive, checked, action);
        }

        public Item(int icon, String label, String sub, boolean destructive,
                    boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            this.icon = icon;
            this.label = label;
            this.sub = sub;
            this.destructive = destructive;
            this.checked = checked;
            this.action = action;
        }

        public static Item of(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, false, false, action);
        }

        public static Item danger(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, true, false, action);
        }

        public static Item detail(String label, String sub, boolean checked,

        }

        public static Item detail(int icon, String label, String sub,
                                  boolean checked, Runnable action) {

    public static void showOptions(Context ctx, String title, String subtitle,
                                   List<Item> items) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_options, null);

            subView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
            final Item item = items.get(i);
            View pillWrap = new FrameLayout(ctx);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams wrapLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(

            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.96f).scaleY(0.96f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                    dialog.dismiss();
                    if (item.action != null) item.action.run();
                }).start();
            });
            ((FrameLayout) pillWrap).addView(row);
            container.addView(pillWrap);

            // Staggered entrance: each pill slides up + fades in.
            row.setAlpha(0f);
            row.setTranslationY(dp(ctx, 14));
            row.animate()
                    .alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setStartDelay(60 + i * 55L)
                    .setDuration(260)
                    .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
        }

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
    }

    /**
     * Two primary choices rendered side by side, with the redundant bottom
     * Cancel button removed. Used by the Back/Stop/Edit/Trim modals.
     */
    public static Dialog showTwoChoiceModal(Context ctx, String title,
                                            String subtitle,
                                            Item first, Item second) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_options, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle);
        titleView.setText(title != null ? title : "");
        TextView subView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSubtitle);
        if (subtitle != null && !subtitle.isEmpty()) {
            subView.setText(subtitle);
            subView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        View scroll = root.findViewById(R.id.optScroll);
        if (scroll != null) scroll.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        if (cancel != null) cancel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        LinearLayout row = root.findViewById(R.id.optHorizontalRow);
        row.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        row.removeAllViews();

        Item[] pair = new Item[]{first, second};
        for (int i = 0; i < pair.length; i++) {
            Item item = pair[i];
            if (item == null) continue;
            TextView btn = new TextView(ctx);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    0, dp(ctx, 46), 1f);
            if (i > 0) lp.setMarginStart(dp(ctx, 10));
            btn.setLayoutParams(lp);
            btn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            btn.setText(item.label);
            btn.setTextSize(14f);
            btn.setTypeface(btn.getTypeface(), android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            btn.setPadding(dp(ctx, 10), 0, dp(ctx, 10), 0);
            if (item.icon != 0) {
                btn.setCompoundDrawablesRelativeWithIntrinsicBounds(
                        item.icon, 0, 0, 0);
                btn.setCompoundDrawablePadding(dp(ctx, 6));
            }
            if (item.destructive) {
                btn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_danger);
                btn.setTextColor(0xFFFF3B30);
            } else {
                btn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
                btn.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
            }
            PressAnim.apply(btn);
            btn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                if (item.action != null) item.action.run();
            });
            row.addView(btn);
        }

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        return dialog;
    }

    // ---- unified recording settings: presets + format toggles ----

    /**
     * One dialog for everything that shapes the next take:
     * - In portrait mode: split vertically in half (presets on top, save
     *   formats below).
     * - In landscape mode: split in half side-by-side (left pane = presets,
     *   right pane = save formats), matching the 2-pane Studio UI so all
     *   options fit cleanly without overflowing.
     */
    public static void showRecordingSettings(Context ctx, String title,
                                             String presetLabel, String presetHint,
                                             String formatLabel, SettingsState state,
                                             String doneLabel) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

        DisplayMetrics dm = ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        boolean isLand = dm.widthPixels > dm.heightPixels;

        android.widget.ScrollView scroll = new android.widget.ScrollView(ctx);
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 21) root.setElevation(dp(ctx, 16));
        int pad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 14 : 18);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root,
                new android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams(
                        android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        TextView titleView = new TextView(ctx);
        titleView.setText(title);
        titleView.setTextSize(isLand ? 16 : 18);
        titleView.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
        titleView.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        titleView.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        root.addView(titleView);

        // Two-pane container: HORIZONTAL 50/50 split in landscape, VERTICAL split in portrait
        LinearLayout splitContainer = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        splitContainer.setId(R.id.dialogOptions);
        splitContainer.setOrientation(isLand ? LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL : LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams splitLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        splitLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 6 : 8);
        root.addView(splitContainer, splitLp);

        LinearLayout presetPane = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        presetPane.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams presetPaneLp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        if (isLand) presetPaneLp.rightMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
        splitContainer.addView(presetPane, presetPaneLp);

        View divider = new View(ctx);
        divider.setBackgroundColor(0x22FFFFFF);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams dlp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 1), LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(ctx, 1));
        if (!isLand) {
            dlp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 10);
            dlp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 2);
        }
        splitContainer.addView(divider, dlp);

        LinearLayout formatPane = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        formatPane.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams formatPaneLp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        if (isLand) formatPaneLp.leftMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
        splitContainer.addView(formatPane, formatPaneLp);

        // Populate Left / Top Half: Recording Presets
        presetPane.addView(sectionLabel(ctx, presetLabel, isLand ? 2 : 6));
        if (presetHint != null && !presetHint.isEmpty()) {
            TextView hint = new TextView(ctx);
            hint.setText(presetHint);
            hint.setTextSize(10.5f);
            hint.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams hlp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            hlp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 2);
            presetPane.addView(hint, hlp);
        }

        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(ctx);
        java.util.List<View> pillRows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<TextView> pillLabels = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<ImageView> pillChecks = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<Integer> pillDefaultColors = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<View> chipViews = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<TextView> chipNames = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<TextView> chipSizes = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final TextView formatHintView = new TextView(ctx);
        formatHintView.setTextSize(10.5f);
        formatHintView.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        for (Item item : state.presets()) {
            final Item it = item;
            View row = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_pill_row, presetPane, false);
            row.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 44 : 50));
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams rlp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rlp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 5 : 6);
            presetPane.addView(row, rlp);
            TextView label = row.findViewById(R.id.pillLabel);
            label.setText(it.label);
            if (isLand) label.setTextSize(13);
            TextView sub = row.findViewById(R.id.pillSub);
            if (sub != null) {
                if (it.sub != null && !it.sub.isEmpty()) {
                    sub.setText(it.sub);
                    if (isLand) sub.setTextSize(10.5f);
                    sub.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                } else {
                    sub.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                }
            }
            ImageView dot = row.findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (it.icon != 0) {
                dot.setImageResource(it.icon);
                dot.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
            } else {
                dot.setImageResource(R.drawable.bg_thumb);
                int inset = dp(ctx, 5);
                dot.setPadding(inset, inset, inset, inset);
            }
            dot.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            ImageView check = row.findViewById(R.id.pillCheck);
            pillRows.add(row);
            pillLabels.add(label);
            pillChecks.add(check);
            pillDefaultColors.add(label.getTextColors().getDefaultColor());
            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (it.action != null) it.action.run();
                rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                        pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                        formatHintView);
            });
        }

        // Populate Right / Bottom Half: Save Formats
        formatPane.addView(sectionLabel(ctx, formatLabel, isLand ? 2 : 8));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams flp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        flp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
        formatPane.addView(formatHintView, flp);

        android.widget.GridLayout grid = new android.widget.GridLayout(ctx);
        grid.setColumnCount(3);
        grid.setUseDefaultMargins(false);
        formatPane.addView(grid, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        for (Chip chip : state.formats()) {
            final Chip c = chip;
            LinearLayout cell = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            cell.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            cell.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cell.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int hPad = dp(ctx, 5);
            int vPadCell = dp(ctx, isLand ? 6 : 7);
            cell.setPadding(hPad, vPadCell, hPad, vPadCell);
            cell.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 44));

            TextView name = new TextView(ctx);
            name.setText(c.label);
            name.setTextSize(isLand ? 11 : 12);
            name.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            name.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            name.setSingleLine(true);
            name.setEllipsize(android.text.TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
            cell.addView(name);

            TextView size = new TextView(ctx);
            size.setText(c.size);
            size.setTextSize(9.5f);
            size.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            size.setSingleLine(true);
            size.setAlpha(0.85f);
            cell.addView(size);

            android.widget.GridLayout.LayoutParams glp =
                    new android.widget.GridLayout.LayoutParams();
            glp.width = 0;
            glp.columnSpec = android.widget.GridLayout.spec(
                    android.widget.GridLayout.UNDEFINED, 1f);
            int m = dp(ctx, 3);
            glp.setMargins(m, m, m, m);
            cell.setLayoutParams(glp);
            grid.addView(cell);
            chipViews.add(cell);
            chipNames.add(name);
            chipSizes.add(size);
            PressAnim.apply(cell);
            cell.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (c.action != null) c.action.run();
                rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                        pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                        formatHintView);
            });
        }

        TextView done = new TextView(ctx);
        done.setText(doneLabel);
        done.setTextSize(14);
        done.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
        done.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        done.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        done.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        done.setMinHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 46));
        int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 9 : 12);
        done.setPadding(dp(ctx, 16), vPad, dp(ctx, 16), vPad);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams blp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        blp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 10 : 14);
        root.addView(done, blp);
        PressAnim.apply(done);
        done.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        dialog.setContentView(scroll);
        rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                formatHintView);
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog,
                isLand ? MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP : MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
        dialog.show();
    }

    private static TextView sectionLabel(Context ctx, String text, int topMarginDp) {
        TextView tv = new TextView(ctx);
        tv.setText(text);
        tv.setTextSize(10);
        tv.setLetterSpacing(0.1f);
        tv.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = dp(ctx, topMarginDp);
        tv.setLayoutParams(lp);
        return tv;
    }

    private static void rebindSettings(SettingsState state,
                                       java.util.List<View> pillRows,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> pillLabels,
                                       java.util.List<ImageView> pillChecks,
                                       java.util.List<Integer> pillColors,
                                       java.util.List<View> chipViews,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> chipNames,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> chipSizes,
                                       TextView hintView) {
        java.util.List<Item> presets;
        java.util.List<Chip> formats;
        try {
            presets = state.presets();
            formats = state.formats();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pillRows.size() && i < presets.size(); i++) {
            Item it = presets.get(i);
            pillRows.get(i).setBackgroundResource(it.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            pillLabels.get(i).setTextColor(it.checked
                    ? 0xFFF2F4F7 : pillColors.get(i));
            pillChecks.get(i).setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
            pillChecks.get(i).setVisibility(
                    it.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
            ImageView dot = pillRows.get(i).findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (dot != null) dot.setColorFilter(it.icon != 0
                    ? (it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF9AA4B2)
                    : (it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < chipViews.size() && i < formats.size(); i++) {
            Chip c = formats.get(i);
            chipViews.get(i).setBackgroundResource(c.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int col = c.checked ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF;
            chipNames.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setText(c.size);
            chipNames.get(i).setText(c.label);
        }
        try {
            hintView.setText(state.formatHint());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- centered rename / input modal ----

    public static void showInput(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                 String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback) {
        showInputInternal(ctx, title, initial, saveLabel, callback, null, false);
    }

    private static void showInputInternal(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                          String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback,
                                          Runnable onCancel, boolean allowSame) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_input, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        EditText input = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogInput);
        TextView error = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogError);
        input.setText(initial == null ? "" : initial);
        input.setHint(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_hint));
        try {
            input.setSelection(input.getText().length());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView save = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSave);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        save.setText(saveLabel);
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(save);

        final boolean[] settled = {false};
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
        });
        try {
            dialog.setOnCancelListener(d -> {
                if (!settled[0] && onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        save.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String text = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (text.isEmpty()) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_empty_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            if (!allowSame && text.equals(initial != null ? initial.trim() : "")) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_same_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (callback != null) callback.onSave(text);
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        if (dialog.getWindow() != null) {
            dialog.getWindow().setSoftInputMode(
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                            | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
        }
        dialog.show();
        input.post(() -> {
            input.requestFocus();
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.showSoftInput(input, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT);
        });
    }

    // ---- confirm delete modal ----

    public static void showConfirm(Context ctx, String title, String message,
                                   String confirmLabel, boolean danger,
                                   Runnable onConfirm) {
        showConfirm(ctx, title, message, confirmLabel,
                danger ? R.drawable.ic_trash : R.drawable.ic_check, danger, onConfirm);
    }

    public static void showConfirm(Context ctx, String title, String message,
                                   String confirmLabel, int iconRes,
                                   boolean danger, Runnable onConfirm) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_confirm, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogMessage)).setText(message);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon);
        icon.setImageResource(iconRes);
        View iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() instanceof View
                ? (View) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() : null;

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView confirm = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogConfirm);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        confirm.setText(confirmLabel);
        if (danger) {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
            confirm.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        } else {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        }
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(confirm);

        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());
        confirm.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            v.animate().scaleX(0.94f).scaleY(0.94f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                if (onConfirm != null) onConfirm.run();
            }).start();
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        if (iconBg != null) PressAnim.pop(iconBg);
    }

    // ---- success / failure result popup ----

    public static void showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message) {
        showResult(ctx, success, title, message, null);
    }

    /** @return the shown dialog, so callers/tests can drive or dismiss it. */
    public static android.app.Dialog showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message,
                                  Runnable onOk) {
        if (activeTopPopup != null) {
            try {
                if (activeTopPopup.isShowing()) activeTopPopup.dismiss();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            activeTopPopup = null;
        }
        TOP_POPUP_HANDLER.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);

        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_result, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        FrameLayout iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIconBg);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIcon);
        iconBg.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_icon_danger);
        icon.setImageResource(success ? R.drawable.ic_check : R.drawable.ic_close);
        icon.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle))
                .setText(compactTwoWords(title));
        TextView msg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultMessage);
        if (msg != null) {
            msg.setText("");
            msg.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
        TextView ok = root.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        if (ok != null) {
            ok.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        final boolean[] fired = {false};
        final Runnable fire = () -> {
            if (fired[0]) return;
            fired[0] = true;
            if (onOk != null) {
                try {
                    onOk.run();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        };
        if (ok != null) {
            ok.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                fire.run();
            });
        }
        root.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            dialog.dismiss();
            fire.run();
        });
        dialog.setOnDismissListener(dd -> {
            if (activeTopPopup == dialog) activeTopPopup = null;
            fire.run();
        });

        dialog.setCancelable(true);
        styleAsTopPopup(dialog);
        activeTopPopup = dialog;
        dialog.show();
        styleAsTopPopup(dialog);
        root.setTranslationY(-dp(ctx, 24));
        root.setAlpha(0f);
        root.animate()
                .translationY(0f)
                .alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(220)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .start();
        PressAnim.pop(iconBg);

        TOP_POPUP_HANDLER.postDelayed(() -> {
            try {
                if (dialog.isShowing()) dialog.dismiss();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }, 1600L);
        return dialog;
    }

    /**
     * Shows a centered modal error popup (e.g. when Google Play price fetching
     * or purchase launch fails after pressing Buy).
     */
    public static Dialog showErrorPopup(Context ctx, String title, String message) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_result, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        FrameLayout iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIconBg);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIcon);
        if (iconBg != null) iconBg.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_icon_danger);
        if (icon != null) {
            icon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_close);
            icon.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
        }

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle);
        if (titleView != null) {
            titleView.setText(title != null && !title.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? title.trim() : "Error Fetching Price");
        }
        TextView msgView = root.findViewById(R.id.resultMessage);
        if (msgView != null) {
            msgView.setText(message != null && !message.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? message.trim()
                    : "Could not fetch price from Google Play. Please check your connection and try again.");
            msgView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        TextView okBtn = root.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        if (okBtn != null) {
            okBtn.setText("OK");
            okBtn.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            PressAnim.apply(okBtn);
            okBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());
        }

        dialog.setCancelable(true);
        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        if (iconBg != null) PressAnim.pop(iconBg);
        return dialog;
    }

    /** Lightweight, non-blocking 2-word confirmation banner at the top. */
    public static void showTopPopup(Context ctx, String title, String ignoredMessage) {
        showResult(ctx, true, compactTwoWords(title), null, null);
    }

    public static void showTopPopup(Context ctx, String twoWordTitle) {
        showResult(ctx, true, compactTwoWords(twoWordTitle), null, null);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    /**
     * Anchors a dialog at the top edge as a floating banner: no dim, no
     * outside-touch blocking, full width with a small inset.
     */
    public static void styleAsTopPopup(Dialog dialog) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND);
        w.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL);
        w.setDimAmount(0f);
        w.setGravity(Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);
        w.setWindowAnimations(R.style.TopPopupAnim);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        lp.width = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL;
        lp.x = 0;
        lp.y = dp(ctx, 16);
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) decor.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    public static void styleAsCentered(Dialog dialog) {
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog, MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
    }

    public static void styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(Dialog dialog, int maxWidthDp) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        DisplayMetrics dm = ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        boolean isLand = dm.widthPixels > dm.heightPixels;
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.setDimAmount(0.62f);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        int cappedDp = Math.min(maxWidthDp, isLand ? 380 : 330);
        int maxW = dp(ctx, cappedDp);
        lp.width = Math.min(Math.round(dm.widthPixels * 0.84f), maxW);
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.CENTER;
        lp.horizontalMargin = 0f;
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) {
            int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 8 : 16);
            decor.setPadding(0, vPad, 0, vPad);
        }
    }

    private static void hideKeyboard(Context ctx, View v) {
        try {
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(v.getWindowToken(), 0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void shake(View v) {
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate()
                .translationX(14f).setDuration(55)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(-12f).setDuration(55)
                        .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(8f).setDuration(55)
                                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(0f)
                                        .setDuration(80).start()).start()).start())
                .start();
    }

    private static int dp(Context ctx, int dp) {
        return Math.round(dp * ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Stage 3 6-band parametric EQ: Band 1 Low-Cut (12/24 dB/oct), Band 2 Low
 * Shelf/Bell, Bands 3 & 4 Peaking Bell, Band 5 High Shelf/Bell, Band 6
 * High-Cut (12/24 dB/oct), plus Output Gain.
 */
final class ParametricEq6BandProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] SLOPE_LABELS = {"12 dB/oct", "24 dB/oct"};
    private static final String[] LOW_TYPE_LABELS = {"Low Shelf", "Bell"};
    private static final String[] HIGH_TYPE_LABELS = {"High Shelf", "Bell"};

    private final FxParameter b1Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b1f", "Low-Cut Freq", " Hz", 20, 1000, 5, 80));
    private final FxParameter b1Slope = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "b1s", "Low-Cut Slope", SLOPE_LABELS, 0));

    private final FxParameter b2Type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "b2t", "Band 2 Type", LOW_TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter b2Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b2f", "Band 2 Freq", " Hz", 40, 500, 5, 120));
    private final FxParameter b2Gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "b2g", "Band 2 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b2Q = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "b2q", "Band 2 Q", 0.3f, 10f, 0.7f));

    private final FxParameter b3Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b3f", "Band 3 Freq", " Hz", 150, 2500, 10, 500));
    private final FxParameter b3Gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "b3g", "Band 3 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b3Q = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "b3q", "Band 3 Q", 0.3f, 10f, 1.0f));

    private final FxParameter b4Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b4f", "Band 4 Freq", " Hz", 600, 8000, 25, 2500));
    private final FxParameter b4Gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "b4g", "Band 4 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b4Q = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "b4q", "Band 4 Q", 0.3f, 10f, 1.0f));

    private final FxParameter b5Type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "b5t", "Band 5 Type", HIGH_TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter b5Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b5f", "Band 5 Freq", " Hz", 2000, 18000, 100, 8000));
    private final FxParameter b5Gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "b5g", "Band 5 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b5Q = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "b5q", "Band 5 Q", 0.3f, 10f, 0.7f));

    private final FxParameter b6Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b6f", "High-Cut Freq", " Hz", 2000, 20000, 100, 20000));
    private final FxParameter b6Slope = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "b6s", "High-Cut Slope", SLOPE_LABELS, 0));

    private final FxParameter outGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "out", "Output Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    ParametricEq6BandProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "eq6";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "6-Band Parametric EQ";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Console EQ: low/high cut plus four musical bell/shelf bands";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    private boolean isBand2SecondaryTouched() {
        return b2Type.getCurrentRaw() != b2Type.defaultRaw
                || b2Freq.getCurrentRaw() != b2Freq.defaultRaw
                || b2Q.getCurrentRaw() != b2Q.defaultRaw;
    }

    private boolean isBand3SecondaryTouched() {
        return b3Freq.getCurrentRaw() != b3Freq.defaultRaw
                || b3Q.getCurrentRaw() != b3Q.defaultRaw;
    }

    private boolean isBand4SecondaryTouched() {
        return b4Freq.getCurrentRaw() != b4Freq.defaultRaw
                || b4Q.getCurrentRaw() != b4Q.defaultRaw;
    }

    private boolean isBand5SecondaryTouched() {
        return b5Type.getCurrentRaw() != b5Type.defaultRaw
                || b5Freq.getCurrentRaw() != b5Freq.defaultRaw
                || b5Q.getCurrentRaw() != b5Q.defaultRaw;
    }

    private boolean isBand6SecondaryTouched() {
        return b6Slope.getCurrentRaw() != b6Slope.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        if (b1Freq.getCurrentRaw() > 20) return true;
        if (b6Freq.getCurrentRaw() < 20000 || isBand6SecondaryTouched()) return true;
        if (Math.abs(outGain.getFloat()) > 0.01f) return true;
        if (Math.abs(b2Gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || isBand2SecondaryTouched()) return true;
        if (Math.abs(b3Gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || isBand3SecondaryTouched()) return true;
        if (Math.abs(b4Gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || isBand4SecondaryTouched()) return true;
        return Math.abs(b5Gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || isBand5SecondaryTouched();
    }

    /** Builds the active biquad cascade (package-private for tests/UI). */
    float[][] buildSections() {
        List<float[]> list = new ArrayList<>(10);
        double sr = sampleRate;
        double f1 = Math.min(b1Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45);
        if (f1 > 20) {
            int order = b1Slope.getEnumIndex() == 1 ? 4 : 2;
            for (float[] s : Dsp.butterworth(order, sr, f1, true)) list.add(s);
        }
        double g2 = b2Gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g2) <= 0.01 && isBand2SecondaryTouched()) {
            g2 = 3.0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(g2) > 0.01) {
            double f2 = Math.min(b2Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45);
            double q2 = Math.max(0.15, b2Q.getFloat());
            if (b2Type.getEnumIndex() == 0) {
                double slope2 = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(2.5, q2));
                list.add(Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sr, f2, slope2, g2));
            } else {
                list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr, f2, q2, g2));
            }
        }
        double g3 = b3Gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g3) <= 0.01 && isBand3SecondaryTouched()) {
            g3 = 3.0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(g3) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr,
                    Math.min(b3Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45),
                    b3Q.getFloat(), g3));
        }
        double g4 = b4Gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g4) <= 0.01 && isBand4SecondaryTouched()) {
            g4 = 3.0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(g4) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr,
                    Math.min(b4Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45),
                    b4Q.getFloat(), g4));
        }
        double g5 = b5Gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g5) <= 0.01 && isBand5SecondaryTouched()) {
            g5 = 3.0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(g5) > 0.01) {
            double f5 = Math.min(b5Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45);
            double q5 = Math.max(0.15, b5Q.getFloat());
            if (b5Type.getEnumIndex() == 0) {
                double slope5 = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(2.5, q5));
                list.add(Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sr, f5, slope5, g5));
            } else {
                list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr, f5, q5, g5));
            }
        }
        int rawF6 = b6Freq.getCurrentRaw();
        if (rawF6 >= 20000 && isBand6SecondaryTouched()) {
            rawF6 = 12000;
        }
        if (rawF6 < 20000) {
            double f6 = Math.min(rawF6, sr * 0.45);
            int order = b6Slope.getEnumIndex() == 1 ? 4 : 2;
            for (float[] s : Dsp.butterworth(order, sr, f6, false)) list.add(s);
        }
        double out = outGain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(out) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.gainBiquad(Dsp.dbToLin(out)));
        }
        return list.toArray(new float[0][]);
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
        filter.process(buf, frames, this.channels);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.view.MotionEvent;

/**
 * Interactive canvas for the 6-band parametric EQ. All six bands have a
 * draggable handle: bands 2-5 move in both frequency and gain, while the
 * low-cut (band 1) and high-cut (band 6) handles move horizontally to set
 * their corner frequency. The graph therefore always exposes six band
 * handles, not only the four bell/shelf bands.
 */
final class ParametricEqView extends EqCurveView {

    private static final String[] FREQ_IDS = {
            "b1f", "b2f", "b3f", "b4f", "b5f", "b6f"};
    /** Null for bands 1 and 6, which are cuts without a gain parameter. */
    private static final String[] GAIN_IDS = {
            null, "b2g", "b3g", "b4g", "b5g", null};

    private final ParametricEq6BandProcessor scratch;
    private int active = -1;

    ParametricEqView(Context ctx, DspChain.EffectSlot slot, Runnable onMutated) {
        super(ctx, slot, 18f, onMutated);
        AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor("eq6");
        scratch = (ParametricEq6BandProcessor) p;
        scratch.prepare(DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE, 2);
        syncFromSlot();
    }

    @Override
    protected void syncFromSlot() {
        for (FxParameter param : scratch.getParameters()) {
            int raw = "out".equals(param.id)
                    ? slot.value
                    : extra(param.id, param.defaultRaw);
            param.setCurrentRaw(param.clampRaw(raw));
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected float responseDb(float f) {
        return (float) Dsp.cascadeMagDb(scratch.buildSections(), f,
                DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE);
    }

    private FxParameter param(String id) {
        for (FxParameter p : scratch.getParameters()) {
            if (p.id.equals(id)) return p;
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDrawHandles(Canvas canvas, int w, int h) {
        float zero = yForDb(0, h);
        for (int i = 0; i < FREQ_IDS.length; i++) {
            FxParameter fq = param(FREQ_IDS[i]);
            if (fq == null) continue;
            float x = xForFreq(fq.getCurrentRaw(), w);
            boolean cut = GAIN_IDS[i] == null;
            float y = zero;
            if (!cut) {
                FxParameter gn = param(GAIN_IDS[i]);
                if (gn == null) continue;
                y = yForDb(gn.getCurrentRaw() / 100f, h);
            }
            if (i == active) {
                handle.setColor(0xFF4EA1FF);
            } else if (cut) {
                handle.setColor(0xFFFFB020);
            } else {
                handle.setColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            }
            float radius = cut ? 8 * density : 7 * density;
            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, radius, handle);
            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, 3 * density, grid);
            if (cut) {
                String num = i == 0 ? "1" : "6";
                label.setColor(0xFF0B0D10);
                label.setTextAlign(android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER);
                label.setTextSize(9 * density);
                canvas.drawText(num, x, y + 3 * density, label);
            }
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent e) {
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        switch (e.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN: {
                syncFromSlot();
                active = nearestHandle(e.getX(), e.getY(), w, h);
                if (active >= 0) {
                    disallowParentIntercept(true);
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                if (active < 0) return false;
                FxParameter fq = param(FREQ_IDS[active]);
                if (fq == null) return false;
                int freq = Math.round(freqForX(e.getX(), w));
                fq.setCurrentRaw(fq.clampRaw(freq));
                putExtra(FREQ_IDS[active], fq.getCurrentRaw());
                String gainId = GAIN_IDS[active];
                if (gainId != null) {
                    FxParameter gn = param(gainId);
                    if (gn != null) {
                        int gain = Math.round(dbForY(e.getY(), h) * 100f);
                        gn.setCurrentRaw(gn.clampRaw(gain));
                        putExtra(gainId, gn.getCurrentRaw());
                    }
                }
                if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
                onMutated.run();
                invalidate();
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL: {
                if (active < 0) return false;
                disallowParentIntercept(false);
                commitActive(active);
                active = -1;
                invalidate();
                return true;
            }
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    private int nearestHandle(float x, float y, int w, int h) {
        int best = -1;
        float bestD = 30 * density;
        float zero = yForDb(0, h);
        for (int i = 0; i < FREQ_IDS.length; i++) {
            FxParameter fq = param(FREQ_IDS[i]);
            if (fq == null) continue;
            float hx = xForFreq(fq.getCurrentRaw(), w);
            float hy = zero;
            String gainId = GAIN_IDS[i];
            if (gainId != null) {
                FxParameter gn = param(gainId);
                if (gn == null) continue;
                hy = yForDb(gn.getCurrentRaw() / 100f, h);
            }
            float d = (float) Math.hypot(hx - x, hy - y);
            if (d < bestD) {
                bestD = d;
                best = i;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private void commitActive(int idx) {
        if (idx >= 0 && idx < FREQ_IDS.length) {
            FxParameter fq = param(FREQ_IDS[idx]);
            if (fq != null) {
                putExtra(FREQ_IDS[idx], fq.getCurrentRaw());
            }
            String gainId = GAIN_IDS[idx];
            if (gainId != null) {
                FxParameter gn = param(gainId);
                if (gn != null) putExtra(gainId, gn.getCurrentRaw());
            }
        }
        if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
        onMutated.run();
    }

    /** Number of draggable band handles exposed by the canvas (six). */
    static int bandCount() {
        return FREQ_IDS.length;
    }
}
