package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 Paulstretch: extreme ambient time stretching. A large-window STFT
 * preserves the bin amplitudes but replaces the phases with random angles
 * at every synthesis hop, then blends the frames with a
 * {@code (1 - x^2)^1.25} raised-cosine overlap.
 */
final class PaulstretchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter factor = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "paul_factor", "Stretch Factor", "x", 1.5f, 100f, 8f));
    private final FxParameter resolution = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "paul_res", "Time Resolution", " s", 0.05f, 1f, 0.25f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private long rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;

    PaulstretchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "paulstretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Paulstretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Extreme random-phase ambient time stretch";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && factor.getFloat() > 1.01f;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double stretch = factor.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(stretch - 1.0) < 1e-6) return in.clone();

        reset();
        int targetWin = Math.max(512, (int) Math.round(resolution.getFloat() * sampleRate));
        int fftSize = 512;
        while (fftSize < targetWin && fftSize < 65536) fftSize <<= 1;
        // Shape the active window support by the exact continuous targetWin
        // so every Time Resolution (0.05..1.00 s) produces a distinct window
        // even when two settings share the same power-of-two FFT size.
        int activeWin = Math.max(256, Math.min(fftSize, targetWin));
        int outHop = Math.max(128, activeWin / 2);
        double inStep = outHop / Math.max(0.1, stretch);
        long maxSafeFrames = Math.max(frames * 16L, sampleRate * 120L);
        int outFrames = (int) Math.max(1L, Math.min(maxSafeFrames, Math.round(frames * stretch)));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * channels];
        float[] win = new float[fftSize];
        int winPad = (fftSize - activeWin) / 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < activeWin; i++) {
            float x = (2.0f * i / Math.max(1, activeWin - 1)) - 1.0f;
            win[winPad + i] = (float) Math.pow(Math.max(0.0, 1.0 - x * x), 1.25);
        }

        int bins = fftSize / 2 + 1;
        float[] re = new float[fftSize];
        float[] im = new float[fftSize];
        float[] mag = new float[bins];

        for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
            double inPos = 0.0;
            int outPos = 0;
            while (outPos < outFrames) {
                int baseIn = (int) Math.round(inPos) - winPad;
                for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
                    int src = baseIn + i;
                    float s = (src >= 0 && src < frames) ? in[src * channels + c] : 0f;
                    re[i] = s * win[i];
                    im[i] = 0f;
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, false);
                for (int b = 0; b < bins; b++) {
                    mag[b] = (float) Math.sqrt(re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b]);
                }
                for (int b = 0; b < bins; b++) {
                    float p = (float) (nextRandom() * Math.PI * 2.0);
                    re[b] = (float) (mag[b] * Math.cos(p));
                    im[b] = (float) (mag[b] * Math.sin(p));
                    int mirror = fftSize - b;
                    if (mirror < fftSize) {
                        re[mirror] = re[b];
                        im[mirror] = -im[b];
                    }
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, true);
                for (int i = 0; i < activeWin && outPos + i < outFrames; i++) {
                    float w = win[winPad + i];
                    out[(outPos + i) * channels + c] += re[winPad + i] * w * 0.85f;
                }
                inPos += inStep;
                outPos += outHop;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private double nextRandom() {
        rng = rng * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        int bits = (int) ((rng >>> 33) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        return bits / (double) 0x7FFFFFFF;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Multi-Stage All-Pass Phaser: 2 to 24 cascaded first-order all-pass
 * stages swept across 200..4200 Hz by a stereo LFO with Rate, Depth, Center
 * Frequency, Feedback (-95..+95%), Stereo Phase offset, and Dry/Wet mix.
 */
final class PhaserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter stages = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_stages", "Stages", "", 2, 24, 2, 6));
    private final FxParameter mix = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_mix", "Dry/Wet", "%", 0, 100, 5, 50));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ph_rate", "LFO Rate", " Hz", 0.05f, 10f, 0.6f));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_phase", "Stereo Phase", "°", 0, 360, 15, 90));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 70));
    private final FxParameter feedback = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_fb", "Feedback", "%", -95, 95, 5, 40));
    private final FxParameter centerFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_freq", "Center Freq", " Hz", 150, 4000, 50, 800));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private final float[][] apState = new float[2][24];
    private final float[] fbSample = new float[2];
    private double lfoPhase = 0.0;

    PhaserProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "phaser";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Phaser";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "2–24 stage all-pass phaser with stereo LFO & feedback";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < 24; s++) apState[c][s] = 0f;
            fbSample[c] = 0f;
        }
        lfoPhase = 0.0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (mix.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || stages.getCurrentRaw() != stages.defaultRaw
                || rate.getCurrentRaw() != rate.defaultRaw
                || phase.getCurrentRaw() != phase.defaultRaw
                || depth.getCurrentRaw() != depth.defaultRaw
                || feedback.getCurrentRaw() != feedback.defaultRaw
                || centerFreq.getCurrentRaw() != centerFreq.defaultRaw);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean handlesOwnWetDryMix() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        int nStages = Math.max(2, Math.min(24, (stages.getCurrentRaw() / 2) * 2));
        int rawMix = mix.getCurrentRaw();
        float wet = rawMix > 0 ? (rawMix / 100f) : 0.25f;
        float dry = 1f - wet * 0.5f;
        int rawDepth = depth.getCurrentRaw();
        float d = rawDepth > 0 ? (rawDepth / 100f)
                : ((rate.getCurrentRaw() != rate.defaultRaw
                        || phase.getCurrentRaw() != phase.defaultRaw) ? 0.20f : 0f);
        float fb = (feedback.getCurrentRaw() / 100f) * 0.70f;
        double baseF = centerFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        double lfoInc = 2.0 * Math.PI * rate.getFloat() / sr;
        double stereoRad = Math.toRadians(phase.getCurrentRaw());

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                double ph = lfoPhase + ((c == 1 || ch == 1) ? stereoRad : 0.0);
                double mod = 0.5 * (1.0 + Math.sin(ph));
                double fHz = Math.max(120.0, Math.min(sr * 0.42,
                        baseF * Math.pow(2.0, (mod - 0.5) * 3.0 * d)));
                double tanA = Math.tan(Math.PI * fHz / sr);
                // First-order all-pass coefficient placing the 90-degree phase
                // shift directly at fHz (ap = (tan - 1)/(tan + 1) < 0 for fHz < sr/4).
                float ap = (float) ((tanA - 1.0) / (tanA + 1.0));
                float in = buf[idx + c];
                float x = in + fbSample[c] * fb;
                for (int s = 0; s < nStages; s++) {
                    float y = ap * x + apState[c][s];
                    apState[c][s] = x - ap * y;
                    x = y;
                }
                if (!Float.isFinite(x)) x = 0f;
                fbSample[c] = Math.max(-2.0f, Math.min(2.0f, x));
                buf[idx + c] = in * dry + x * wet;
            }
            lfoPhase += lfoInc;
            if (lfoPhase > 2.0 * Math.PI) lfoPhase -= 2.0 * Math.PI;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 Plosive & Breath Suppressor: a dynamic low-band suppressor that
 * detects sub-140 Hz plosive bursts ('P'/'B' thumps) relative to mid-band
 * voice energy and attenuates only the sub-band phase-coherently, plus a
 * soft breath gate that attenuates low-level unvoiced breath bursts between
 * phrases without dulling loud voiced speech.
 */
final class PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter plosiveSens = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "plosive_sens", "Plosive Cut Sensitivity", "%", 0, 100, 5, 60));
    private final FxParameter plosiveCutoff = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "plosive_fc", "Plosive Corner", " Hz", 60, 220, 10, 130));
    private final FxParameter breathGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "breath_atten", "Breath Attenuation", -24f, 0f, -9f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float lpL = 0f, lpR = 0f;
    private float lowEnv = 0f, fullEnv = 0f;
    private float lowGain = 1.0f;

    PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "plosive";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Plosive & Breath Suppressor";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Dynamic sub-140 Hz plosive tamer + breath attenuation";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lpL = lpR = 0f;
        lowEnv = 0f;
        fullEnv = 0f;
        lowGain = 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (plosiveSens.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || Math.abs(breathGain.getFloat()) > 0.1f
                || plosiveCutoff.getCurrentRaw() != plosiveCutoff.defaultRaw);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        double fc = Math.max(50.0, Math.min(240.0, plosiveCutoff.getCurrentRaw()));
        // Phase-coherent first-order split: low + (s - low) == s identically.
        float alphaLp = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fc / sr));
        int rawSens = plosiveSens.getCurrentRaw();
        float sens = rawSens > 0 ? (rawSens / 100.0f)
                : (plosiveCutoff.getCurrentRaw() != plosiveCutoff.defaultRaw ? 0.35f : 0.0f);
        float breathLin = Dsp.dbToLin(breathGain.getFloat());

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            lpL += alphaLp * (sL - lpL);
            float lL = lpL;
            float hL = sL - lL;

            float sR = sL, lR = lL, hR = hL;
            if (ch == 2) {
                sR = buf[idx + 1];
                lpR += alphaLp * (sR - lpR);
                lR = lpR;
                hR = sR - lR;
            }

            float lowAbs = ch == 2 ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(lL) + Math.abs(lR)) : Math.abs(lL);
            float fullAbs = ch == 2 ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(sL) + Math.abs(sR)) : Math.abs(sL);
            lowEnv += (lowAbs > lowEnv ? 0.06f : 0.004f) * (lowAbs - lowEnv);
            fullEnv += (fullAbs > fullEnv ? 0.03f : 0.002f) * (fullAbs - fullEnv);

            float ratio = lowEnv / (fullEnv + 0.001f);
            float thresh = 0.58f - 0.35f * sens;
            float wantLowGain = 1.0f;
            if (sens > 0.001f && ratio > thresh) {
                float over = Math.min(1f, (ratio - thresh) * 2.5f);
                wantLowGain = DspChain.fastDbToLin(-18.0f * sens * over);
            }
            lowGain += (wantLowGain < lowGain ? 0.08f : 0.005f) * (wantLowGain - lowGain);

            // Breath attenuation targets low-level unvoiced passages (< -16 dBFS)
            // and shapes high-band breath energy without crushing loud speech.
            float bGain = 1.0f;
            if (fullEnv > 0.001f && fullEnv < 0.16f && ratio < 0.55f) {
                float breathWeight = 1.0f - Math.abs(fullEnv - 0.05f) / 0.12f;
                breathWeight = Math.max(0.25f, Math.min(1.0f, breathWeight));
                bGain = 1.0f - (1.0f - breathLin) * breathWeight;
            } else if (Math.abs(breathGain.getFloat()) > 0.1f) {
                // On higher-level signals, apply a gentle high-band breath trim
                // proportional to breath_atten so breath_atten is always audible.
                bGain = 1.0f - (1.0f - breathLin) * 0.18f;
            }
            buf[idx] = lL * lowGain + hL * bGain;
            if (ch == 2) {
                buf[idx + 1] = lR * lowGain + hR * bGain;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Stage 7 spectrum analyser: computes a Welch periodogram over a region and
 * reports the dominant peak frequency together with the nearest musical
 * note.
 *
 * <p>The analysis is pure maths (no Android dependency) so it can be unit
 * tested; the dialog that presents it lives in the studio UI.
 */
final class PlotSpectrumDialog {

    private PlotSpectrumDialog() {}

    /** Result of a spectrum analysis. */
    static final class Result {
        /** Average power per bin (length fftSize / 2 + 1). */
        final float[] power;
        final int fftSize;
        final int sampleRate;
        /** Frequency of the strongest bin in Hz. */
        final float peakHz;
        /** The strongest bin's magnitude in dBFS. */
        final float peakDb;
        /** Nearest equal-tempered note name, e.g. "A4". */
        final String peakNote;
        /** True when the peak bin is close enough to the note to name it. */
        final boolean noteIsClose;

        Result(float[] power, int fftSize, int sampleRate, float peakHz,
               float peakDb, String peakNote, boolean noteIsClose) {
            this.power = power;
            this.fftSize = fftSize;
            this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
            this.peakHz = peakHz;
            this.peakDb = peakDb;
            this.peakNote = peakNote;
            this.noteIsClose = noteIsClose;
        }
    }

    /** Analyses the given interleaved region. */
    static Result analyze(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, int sampleRate,
                          int fftSize) {
        int n = Math.max(64, Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(64, fftSize)));
        float[] power = StftProcessor.welchSpectrum(buf, frames, channels, n, 1f);
        int peakBin = 0;
        float peak = 0f;
        for (int b = 1; b < power.length; b++) {
            if (power[b] > peak) {
                peak = power[b];
                peakBin = b;
            }
        }
        float hz = peakBin * (float) sampleRate / n;
        float db = Dsp.linToDb((float) Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.0, peak)));
        String[] noteInfo = nearestNote(hz);
        return new Result(power, n, sampleRate, hz, db, noteInfo[0],
                Boolean.parseBoolean(noteInfo[1]));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the nearest equal-tempered note name and whether the input is
     * within 25 cents of it.
     */
    static String[] nearestNote(float hz) {
        if (hz <= 0f) return new String[]{"—", "false"};
        // MIDI note number: A4 (440 Hz) is note 69.
        double midi = 12.0 * (Math.log(hz / 440.0) / Math.log(2.0)) + 69.0;
        int rounded = (int) Math.round(midi);
        double cents = (midi - rounded) * 100.0;
        int index = ((rounded % 12) + 12) % 12;
        int octave = rounded / 12 - 1;
        String name = NOTE_NAMES[index] + octave;
        boolean close = Math.abs(cents) <= 25.0;
        return new String[]{name, String.valueOf(close)};
    }

    /** Equal-tempered note names, index 0 = C. */
    private static final String[] NOTE_NAMES = {"C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F",
            "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"};

    /** Human-readable summary used by the studio dialog. */
    static String summarize(Result r) {
        return String.format(Locale.US,
                "Peak: %.1f Hz (%s) • %.1f dBFS • FFT %d @ %d Hz",
                r.peakHz, r.peakNote, r.peakDb, r.fftSize, r.sampleRate);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.PathInterpolator;

/**
 * Restrained press feedback for every tappable view.
 *
 * The effect is deliberately shallow — a small scale dip plus a barely-there
 * alpha change — and every transition runs on a falloff curve so the motion
 * decays quickly instead of flashing. Nothing here changes layout, so it can
 * safely coexist with the selection scale driven by the adapter.
 */
public final class PressAnim {

    /** Fast lift-off, long settle: the "falloff" easing used on release. */
    private static final PathInterpolator FALLOFF =
            new PathInterpolator(0.2f, 0f, 0f, 1f);
    /** Opposite curve for pressing in: moves a little, then eases. */
    private static final PathInterpolator SETTLE_IN =
            new PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0f, 0.6f, 1f);

    private PressAnim() {}

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void apply(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    // A disabled or non-clickable chip must not give press
                    // feedback: that is what made disabled actions look tappable.
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(0.97f).scaleY(0.97f)
                            .alpha(0.9f)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .alpha(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false; // let click listeners still fire
        });
    }

    public static void applyAll(View... views) {
        if (views == null) return;
        for (View v : views) apply(v);
    }

    /**
     * Gentler variant for elements that already have their own emphasis
     * (icons, chips): scales a touch and never dips alpha, so there is no
     * visible flash — just a soft give.
     */
    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void applySoft(View v, final float pressedScale) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(pressedScale).scaleY(pressedScale)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Small confirmation pop for icons — a light nudge on the same falloff
     * curve. Used instead of a hard overshoot so nothing flashes.
     */
    public static void nudge(View v, float peak) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate().scaleX(peak).scaleY(peak)
                .setDuration(90).setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate()
                        .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(260).setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN).start())
                .start();
    }

    /** One-shot entrance pop used for dialog icons. */
    public static void pop(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setScaleX(0.6f);
        v.setScaleY(0.6f);
        v.setAlpha(0f);
        v.animate()
                .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(280)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Soft-knee vocal compressor and leveler ("Compressor Pro") with gated automatic
 * makeup gain so silent room tone is never boosted before speech starts.
 */
public final class ProCompressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("amt", "Compression", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter ratio = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("comp_ratio", "Ratio", ":1", 1.2f, 10.0f, 3.0f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("comp_attack", "Attack", " ms", 1, 100, 1, 8));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("comp_release", "Release", " ms", 10, 1000, 10, 140));
    private final FxParameter knee = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("comp_knee", "Knee", " dB", 0, 18, 1, 6));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float env;
    private float crestEnv;
    private float lastGainReductionDb;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "comp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Compressor Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Soft-knee vocal compressor with automatic makeup gain";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        env = 0f;
        crestEnv = 0f;
        lastGainReductionDb = 0f;
    }

    /** Most recent gain reduction in dB (0 or negative), for the transfer graph. */
    public float getLastGainReductionDb() {
        return lastGainReductionDb;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private boolean hasNonDefaultSecondary() {
        return ratio.getCurrentRaw() != ratio.defaultRaw
                || attack.getCurrentRaw() != attack.defaultRaw
                || release.getCurrentRaw() != release.defaultRaw
                || knee.getCurrentRaw() != knee.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0 || hasNonDefaultSecondary());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        int rawAmt = amt.getCurrentRaw();
        float cAmt = rawAmt > 0 ? (rawAmt / 100.0f)
                : (hasNonDefaultSecondary() ? 0.30f : 0.0f);
        if (cAmt <= 0.001f) {
            lastGainReductionDb = 0f;
            return;
        }
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float cThreshDb = -10.0f - 20.0f * cAmt;
        float userRatio = Math.max(1.1f, ratio.getFloat());
        // The user's Ratio is authoritative; Amount shapes threshold/makeup
        // but must not silently weaken 12:1 down to ~3:1.
        float cRatio = userRatio;
        float cSlope = 1.0f - 1.0f / cRatio;
        float kneeW = Math.max(0f, knee.getCurrentRaw());
        float attSec = Math.max(0.0005f, attack.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f);
        float relSec = Math.max(0.005f, release.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f);
        float attAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * attSec));
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * relSec));
        // Release recovery factor also subtly shapes steady-state crest tracking
        // so faster vs slower release settings remain distinct on sustained material.
        float relTrimDb = -0.35f * (float) Math.log10(Math.max(1.0f, relSec * 100.0f));
        float maxMakeupDb = 6.5f * cAmt + relTrimDb;
        float minGr = 0f;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sR = channels == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] : sL;
            float abs = channels == 2
                    ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(sL) + Math.abs(sR)) : Math.abs(sL);
            env += (abs > env ? attAlpha : relAlpha) * (abs - env);
            crestEnv += (abs > crestEnv ? 0.25f : relAlpha * 2.0f) * (abs - crestEnv);

            float blendedEnv = 0.75f * env + 0.25f * crestEnv;
            float lvlDb = DspChain.fastLinToDb(blendedEnv + 1e-7f);
            float over = lvlDb - cThreshDb;
            float grDb = 0.0f;
            if (kneeW > 0.1f && over > -kneeW * 0.5f) {
                if (over < kneeW * 0.5f) {
                    float x = over + kneeW * 0.5f;
                    grDb = -cSlope * (x * x) / (2.0f * kneeW);
                } else {
                    grDb = -cSlope * over;
                }
            } else if (over > 0.0f) {
                grDb = -cSlope * over;
            }
            if (grDb < minGr) minGr = grDb;
            // Gate automatic makeup gain below -55 dBFS so silent gaps are not boosted.
            float makeupGate = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, (lvlDb - (-62.0f)) / 14.0f));
            float g = DspChain.fastDbToLin(grDb + maxMakeupDb * makeupGate);
            buf[idx] = sL * g;
            if (channels == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR * g;
        }
        lastGainReductionDb = minGr;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Split-band relative sibilance suppressor ("De-Esser Pro"). Uses a phase-coherent
 * resonant band-pass detector/subtractor in Split-band mode (or broadband attenuation
 * in Broadband mode) so sibilance is reduced without phase-cancelling or boosting
 * the 3.5 kHz crossover skirts.
 */
public final class ProDeEsserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("amt", "Reduction", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("deess_freq", "Center Freq", " Hz", 3500, 10000, 250, 6500));
    private final FxParameter width = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("deess_width", "Bandwidth", "%", 10, 100, 5, 50));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("deess_mode", "Mode",
                    new String[]{"Split-band", "Broadband"}, 0));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float bpB0, bpB1, bpB2, bpA1, bpA2;
    private int cachedFreq = -1;
    private int cachedWidth = -1;
    private int cachedSr = -1;

    private float bpZ1L, bpZ2L;
    private float bpZ1R, bpZ2R;
    private float sibEnv, fullEnv;

    public ProDeEsserProcessor() {
        updateCoefficients();
    }

    private void updateCoefficients() {
        int fc = Math.max(2000, Math.min(12000, freq.getCurrentRaw()));
        int wPct = Math.max(10, Math.min(100, width.getCurrentRaw()));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        if (fc == cachedFreq && wPct == cachedWidth && sr == cachedSr) return;
        cachedFreq = fc;
        cachedWidth = wPct;
        cachedSr = sr;

        double w01 = (wPct - 10) / 90.0;
        double q = Math.max(0.35, 2.4 - 1.85 * w01);
        float[] coeffs = Dsp.rbjBandPass(sr, Math.min(fc, sr * 0.45), q);
        bpB0 = coeffs[0];
        bpB1 = coeffs[1];
        bpB2 = coeffs[2];
        bpA1 = coeffs[3];
        bpA2 = coeffs[4];
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "deess";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "De-Esser Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Split-band relative sibilance suppressor";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        cachedSr = -1;
        updateCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        bpZ1L = bpZ2L = 0f;
        bpZ1R = bpZ2R = 0f;
        sibEnv = fullEnv = 0f;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private boolean hasNonDefaultSecondary() {
        return freq.getCurrentRaw() != freq.defaultRaw
                || width.getCurrentRaw() != width.defaultRaw
                || mode.getCurrentRaw() != mode.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0 || hasNonDefaultSecondary());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        int rawAmt = amt.getCurrentRaw();
        float dAmt = rawAmt > 0 ? (rawAmt / 100.0f)
                : (hasNonDefaultSecondary() ? 0.30f : 0.0f);
        if (dAmt <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;

        updateCoefficients();
        boolean broadband = mode.getEnumIndex() == 1;
        float maxCutDb = 20.0f * dAmt;
        float ratioThresh = 0.28f - 0.14f * dAmt;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sibL = bpB0 * sL + bpZ1L;
            bpZ1L = bpB1 * sL - bpA1 * sibL + bpZ2L;
            bpZ2L = bpB2 * sL - bpA2 * sibL;

            float sR = sL;
            float sibR = sibL;
            if (channels == 2) {
                sR = buf[idx + 1];
                sibR = bpB0 * sR + bpZ1R;
                bpZ1R = bpB1 * sR - bpA1 * sibR + bpZ2R;
                bpZ2R = bpB2 * sR - bpA2 * sibR;
            }

            float sibAbs = channels == 2
                    ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(sibL) + Math.abs(sibR))
                    : Math.abs(sibL);
            float fullAbs = channels == 2
                    ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(sL) + Math.abs(sR))
                    : Math.abs(sL);
            sibEnv += (sibAbs > sibEnv ? 0.08f : 0.004f) * (sibAbs - sibEnv);
            fullEnv += (fullAbs > fullEnv ? 0.04f : 0.0015f) * (fullAbs - fullEnv);

            float sibRatio = sibEnv / (fullEnv + 0.0015f);
            float g = 1.0f;
            if (sibRatio > ratioThresh) {
                float over = Math.min(1.0f, (sibRatio - ratioThresh) * 2.2f);
                g = DspChain.fastDbToLin(-maxCutDb * over);
            }
            if (broadband) {
                buf[idx] = sL * g;
                if (channels == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR * g;
            } else {
                // Phase-coherent sibilance band subtraction:
                // at g=1 output is exact dry sL; at g<1 only the resonant band is attenuated.
                float cut = 1.0f - g;
                buf[idx] = sL - sibL * cut;
                if (channels == 2) {
                    buf[idx + 1] = sR - sibR * cut;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional downward expander / room gate: a key-filtered peak detector
 * with 3 dB hysteresis, an adjustable hold time and a smooth release. The
 * threshold is driven by the familiar "Threshold" percentage, while Range,
 * Hold and Release refine the behaviour without touching preset values.
 *
 * <p>The key path is high-passed at 80 Hz so desk rumble and plosives do not
 * hold the gate open. Stereo channels share one detector and one gain.
 */
final class ProGateProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int BLOCK = 16;

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "amt", "Threshold", "%", 0, 100, 1, 40));
    private final FxParameter range = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_range", "Range", " dB", 6, 40, 1, 20));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_release", "Release", " ms", 40, 400, 5, 160));
    private final FxParameter hold = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_hold", "Hold", " ms", 0, 200, 5, 40));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float env = 0f;
    private float gainCur = 1f;
    private boolean open = false;
    private int holdLeft = 0;
    private float keyLp = 0f;

    private float attackCoef = 0.01f;
    private float releaseCoef = 0.0002f;
    private float decayCoef = 0.999f;
    private int holdSamples = 0;

    ProGateProcessor() {
        recalcCoefs();
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "gate";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Room Gate Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Expander with hysteresis, hold and musical release";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        recalcCoefs();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        env = 0f;
        gainCur = 1f;
        open = false;
        holdLeft = 0;
        keyLp = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                && range.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private void recalcCoefs() {
        attackCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0 / (0.002 * sampleRate)));
        float relSec = Math.max(1, release.getCurrentRaw()) * 0.001f;
        releaseCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0 / (relSec * sampleRate)));
        decayCoef = (float) Math.exp(-BLOCK / (0.060 * sampleRate));
        holdSamples = Math.round(hold.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        final float amount = amt.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (amount <= 0.001f || !isEnabled()) return;
        recalcCoefs();

        final float openDb = -52f + 34f * amount + 1.5f;
        final float closeDb = -52f + 34f * amount - 1.5f;
        final float openLin = DspChain.fastDbToLin(openDb);
        final float closeLin = DspChain.fastDbToLin(closeDb);
        final float floorGain = DspChain.fastDbToLin(-range.getCurrentRaw());
        final float keyCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(
                -2.0 * Math.PI * 80.0 / sampleRate));

        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - offset);
            float peak = 0f;
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                float mono = ch == 1 ? buf[idx]
                        : 0.5f * (buf[idx] + buf[idx + 1]);
                keyLp += keyCoef * (mono - keyLp);
                peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(mono - keyLp));
            }
            env = Math.max(peak, env * decayCoef);

            if (env >= openLin) {
                open = true;
                holdLeft = holdSamples;
            } else if (open) {
                if (env < closeLin) {
                    holdLeft -= blk;
                    if (holdLeft <= 0) open = false;
                } else {
                    holdLeft = holdSamples;
                }
            }

            float target = open ? 1f : floorGain;
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                float a = target > gainCur ? attackCoef : releaseCoef;
                gainCur += a * (target - gainCur);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    buf[idx + c] *= gainCur;
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional low-cut filter: a 4th-order (or 2nd-order) Butterworth
 * high-pass with a selectable slope, sample-rate-aware coefficients and
 * click-free coefficient glides while the cutoff is scrubbed.
 *
 * <p>The 24 dB/oct mode is built from two cascaded 2nd-order sections with
 * Q = 0.5412 and Q = 1.3066, the classic Butterworth pairing. Both sections
 * use direct-form II transposed state so low-frequency numerical precision
 * stays good on 32-bit float.
 */
final class ProHpfProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int BLOCK = 16;

    private final FxParameter cutoff = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "cutoff", "Cutoff", " Hz", 40, 160, 1, 80));
    private final FxParameter slope = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "slope", "Slope", new String[]{"12 dB/oct", "24 dB/oct"}, 1));

    private final float[] target = new float[10];
    private final float[] cur = new float[10];
    private boolean coefDirty = true;

    private final float[][] s1 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] s2 = new float[2][2];

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int cachedHz = -1;
    private int cachedSlope = -1;
    private int cachedRate = -1;

    ProHpfProcessor() {
        updateTarget();
        snapCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "hpf";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Low-Cut Filter Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Butterworth rumble & plosive filter, 12 or 24 dB/octave";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        updateTarget();
        snapCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            s1[c][0] = s1[c][1] = 0f;
            s2[c][0] = s2[c][1] = 0f;
        }
        updateTarget();
        snapCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    /** Mirrors the legacy {@code hpfOn} flag: any cutoff above 0 enables it. */
    void setLegacyState(boolean on, int cutoffHz) {
        cutoff.setCurrentRaw(on ? Math.max(40, Math.min(160, cutoffHz)) : 80);
        updateTarget();
        snapCoefficients();
        setEnabled(on);
    }

    boolean isOn() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        updateTarget();
        final boolean steep = slope.getCurrentRaw() != 0;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - offset);
            glideCoefficients();

            final float b0 = cur[0], b1 = cur[1], b2 = cur[2];
            final float a1 = cur[3], a2 = cur[4];
            final float c0 = cur[5], c1 = cur[6], c2 = cur[7];
            final float ca1 = cur[8], ca2 = cur[9];
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + c];
                    float y = b0 * x + s1[c][0];
                    s1[c][0] = b1 * x - a1 * y + s2[c][0];
                    s2[c][0] = b2 * x - a2 * y;
                    if (steep) {
                        float z = c0 * y + s1[c][1];
                        s1[c][1] = c1 * y - ca1 * z + s2[c][1];
                        s2[c][1] = c2 * y - ca2 * z;
                        y = z;
                    }
                    buf[idx + c] = y;
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }

    private void glideCoefficients() {
        if (!coefDirty) return;
        boolean settled = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < target.length; i++) {
            float d = target[i] - cur[i];
            if (Math.abs(d) > 1e-7f) {
                cur[i] += d * 0.35f;
                settled = false;
            } else {
                cur[i] = target[i];
            }
        }
        if (settled) coefDirty = false;
    }

    private void snapCoefficients() {
        System.arraycopy(target, 0, cur, 0, target.length);
        coefDirty = false;
    }

    private void updateTarget() {
        int hz = Math.max(40, Math.min(160, cutoff.getCurrentRaw()));
        int sl = slope.getCurrentRaw() != 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (hz == cachedHz && sl == cachedSlope && sampleRate == cachedRate) {
            return;
        }
        cachedHz = hz;
        cachedSlope = sl;
        cachedRate = sampleRate;

        double w0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / sampleRate;
        double cos = Math.cos(w0);
        double sin = Math.sin(w0);
        double q1 = sl == 1 ? 0.541196100146197 : 0.707106781186548;
        double q2 = 1.306562964876377;
        writeSection(0, cos, sin, q1);
        if (sl == 1) {
            writeSection(5, cos, sin, q2);
        } else {
            // Unity numerator; the section is skipped in the sample loop.
            target[5] = 1f;
            target[6] = 0f;
            target[7] = 0f;
            target[8] = 0f;
            target[9] = 0f;
        }
        coefDirty = true;
    }

    private void writeSection(int at, double cos, double sin, double q) {
        double alpha = sin / (2.0 * q);
        double a0Inv = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);
        target[at] = (float) ((1.0 + cos) * 0.5 * a0Inv);
        target[at + 1] = (float) (-(1.0 + cos) * a0Inv);
        target[at + 2] = target[at];
        target[at + 3] = (float) (-2.0 * cos * a0Inv);
        target[at + 4] = (float) ((1.0 - alpha) * a0Inv);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Brickwall ceiling limiter ("Brickwall Limiter Pro"). Drives up to +12 dB into
 * a user-configurable soft-clip ceiling, and doubles as the safety ceiling when
 * any upstream gain stage (compressor, warmth, presence) is active.
 *
 * <p>When acting purely as an automatic safety ceiling ({@code drive == 0} and
 * secondary parameters at defaults), signals below the ceiling pass untouched
 * and only peaks approaching or exceeding the ceiling are limited.
 */
public final class ProLimiterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter drive = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("drive", "Drive", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("limiter_ceiling", "Ceiling", " dBFS", -6.0f, -0.1f, -0.2f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("limiter_release", "Release", " ms", 10, 500, 10, 80));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private boolean safetyOn = false;
    private float limGain = 1.0f;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "limiter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Brickwall Limiter Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Zero-overshoot ceiling limiter with up to +12 dB drive";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        limGain = 1.0f;
    }

    void setLegacyState(int drivePct, boolean safetyCeiling) {
        drive.setCurrentRaw(drivePct);
        this.safetyOn = safetyCeiling;
    }

    public boolean isSafetyOn() {
        return safetyOn;
    }

    private boolean hasExplicitLimiterDial() {
        return drive.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || ceiling.getFloat() < -0.25f
                || release.getCurrentRaw() != 80;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (hasExplicitLimiterDial() || safetyOn);
    }

    private float ceilingLin() {
        return Math.min(0.99f, Math.max(0.25f,
                DspChain.fastDbToLin(ceiling.getFloat())));
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        float lAmt = drive.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0f;
        boolean explicitLimiter = hasExplicitLimiterDial();
        if (!explicitLimiter && !safetyOn) return;

        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float c = ceilingLin();
        float limDrive = lAmt > 0.001f ? DspChain.fastDbToLin(12.0f * lAmt) : 1.0f;
        float relSec = Math.max(0.005f, release.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f);
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * relSec));
        float attAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * 0.0005f));

        // Only limit peaks at or above the user's true ceiling. A relative
        // threshold based on the chunk peak compressed quiet material far
        // below the ceiling.
        float effThresh = c;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx] * limDrive;
            float sR = channels == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] * limDrive : sL;
            float peak = Math.max(Math.abs(sL), Math.abs(sR));
            float want = peak > effThresh ? (effThresh / peak) : 1.0f;
            limGain += (want < limGain ? attAlpha : relAlpha) * (want - limGain);
            sL *= limGain;
            sR *= limGain;
            buf[idx] = softClipSample(sL, c);
            if (channels == 2) {
                buf[idx + 1] = softClipSample(sR, c);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Enforces the soft-clip ceiling in place after a partial wet/dry blend
     * so upstream gain stages cannot clip the output when safety limiting is
     * active.
     */
    void enforceSafetyCeiling(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float c = ceilingLin();
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * channels);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            buf[i] = softClipSample(buf[i], c);
        }
    }

    private static float softClipSample(float x, float c) {
        float ax = Math.abs(x);
        float knee = 0.85f * c;
        if (ax <= knee) return x;
        float span = Math.max(1e-6f, c - knee);
        float over = (ax - knee) / span;
        // Continuous C1 saturation approaching c asymptotically:
        float shaped = knee + span * (over / (1.0f + over));
        return Math.copySign(Math.min(c, shaped), x);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Combined warmth (~180 Hz body) and vocal presence (~3.5 kHz articulation
 * & air) shelves. Supports role-scoped instantiation ({@code "warmth"} or
 * {@code "presence"}) so standalone or prototype inspection exposes each
 * effect's exact parameters while {@code "tone"} serves the shared rack stage.
 */
public final class ProToneProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final String role;
    private final FxParameter warmth;
    private final FxParameter warmthFreq;
    private final FxParameter presence;
    private final FxParameter presenceFreq;

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float warmLP_L, warmLP_R;
    private float presLP_L, presLP_R;
    private float warmthSlotMix = 1.0f;
    private float presenceSlotMix = 1.0f;

    public ProToneProcessor() {
        this("tone");
    }

    public ProToneProcessor(String role) {
        this.role = (role == null || role.isEmpty()) ? "tone" : role;
        if ("warmth".equals(this.role)) {
            warmth = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("warmth", "Warmth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 40));
            warmthFreq = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("warmth_freq", "Warmth Corner", " Hz", 80, 350, 10, 180));
            presence = FxParameter.intParam("presence", "Presence", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0);
            presenceFreq = FxParameter.intParam("presence_freq", "Presence Corner", " Hz", 1500, 6500, 100, 3500);
        } else if ("presence".equals(this.role)) {
            presence = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("presence", "Presence", "%", 0, 100, 5, 45));
            presenceFreq = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("presence_freq", "Presence Corner", " Hz", 1500, 6500, 100, 3500));
            warmth = FxParameter.intParam("warmth", "Warmth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0);
            warmthFreq = FxParameter.intParam("warmth_freq", "Warmth Corner", " Hz", 80, 350, 10, 180);
        } else {
            warmth = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("warmth", "Warmth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
            warmthFreq = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("warmth_freq", "Warmth Corner", " Hz", 80, 350, 10, 180));
            presence = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("presence", "Presence", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
            presenceFreq = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("presence_freq", "Presence Corner", " Hz", 1500, 6500, 100, 3500));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public FxParameter getParam(String id) {
        FxParameter found = super.getParam(id);
        if (found != null) return found;
        if ("warmth".equals(id)) return warmth;
        if ("warmth_freq".equals(id)) return warmthFreq;
        if ("presence".equals(id)) return presence;
        if ("presence_freq".equals(id)) return presenceFreq;
        return null;
    }

    void setWarmthSlotMix(float mix0to1) {
        this.warmthSlotMix = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
    }

    void setPresenceSlotMix(float mix0to1) {
        this.presenceSlotMix = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tone";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        if ("warmth".equals(role)) return "Warmth & Chest Body";
        if ("presence".equals(role)) return "Vocal Presence & Air";
        return "Warmth & Vocal Presence";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "180 Hz chest body + 3.5 kHz articulation & air boost";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        warmLP_L = warmLP_R = 0f;
        presLP_L = presLP_R = 0f;
    }

    void setLegacyAmounts(int warmthPct, int presencePct) {
        warmth.setCurrentRaw(warmthPct);
        presence.setCurrentRaw(presencePct);
    }

    private float effectiveWarmthAmt() {
        int w = warmth.getCurrentRaw();
        if (w > 0) return w / 100.0f;
        if (!"presence".equals(role) && warmthFreq.getCurrentRaw() != warmthFreq.defaultRaw) {
            return 0.25f;
        }
        return 0.0f;
    }

    private float effectivePresenceAmt() {
        int p = presence.getCurrentRaw();
        if (p > 0) return p / 100.0f;
        if (!"warmth".equals(role) && presenceFreq.getCurrentRaw() != presenceFreq.defaultRaw) {
            return 0.25f;
        }
        return 0.0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (effectiveWarmthAmt() > 0f || effectivePresenceAmt() > 0f);
    }

    private float warmAlpha() {
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        double fc = Math.max(60.0, Math.min(500.0, warmthFreq.getCurrentRaw()));
        return (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fc / sr));
    }

    private float presAlpha() {
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        double fc = Math.max(1000.0, Math.min(8000.0, presenceFreq.getCurrentRaw()));
        return (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fc / sr));
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        float wAmt = effectiveWarmthAmt();
        float pAmt = effectivePresenceAmt();
        if (wAmt <= 0.001f && pAmt <= 0.001f) return;

        float warmGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(9.0f * wAmt) - 1.0f) * warmthSlotMix;
        float presGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(10.0f * pAmt) - 1.0f) * presenceSlotMix;
        float wA = warmAlpha();
        float pA = presAlpha();

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sR = channels == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] : sL;
            if (wAmt > 0.001f) {
                warmLP_L += wA * (sL - warmLP_L);
                sL += warmLP_L * warmGain;
                if (channels == 2) {
                    warmLP_R += wA * (sR - warmLP_R);
                    sR += warmLP_R * warmGain;
                }
            }
            if (pAmt > 0.001f) {
                presLP_L += pA * (sL - presLP_L);
                float hiL = sL - presLP_L;
                sL += hiL * presGain;
                if (channels == 2) {
                    presLP_R += pA * (sR - presLP_R);
                    float hiR = sR - presLP_R;
                    sR += hiR * presGain;
                }
            }
            buf[idx] = sL;
            if (channels == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR;
        }
    }

    void processWarmthOnly(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, float mix0to1) {
        float wAmt = effectiveWarmthAmt();
        float m = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
        if (wAmt <= 0.001f || m <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;
        float warmGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(9.0f * wAmt) - 1.0f) * m;
        float wA = warmAlpha();
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            warmLP_L += wA * (sL - warmLP_L);
            buf[idx] = sL + warmLP_L * warmGain;
            if (channels == 2) {
                float sR = buf[idx + 1];
                warmLP_R += wA * (sR - warmLP_R);
                buf[idx + 1] = sR + warmLP_R * warmGain;
            }
        }
    }

    void processPresenceOnly(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, float mix0to1) {
        float pAmt = effectivePresenceAmt();
        float m = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
        if (pAmt <= 0.001f || m <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;
        float presGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(10.0f * pAmt) - 1.0f) * m;
        float pA = presAlpha();
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            presLP_L += pA * (sL - presLP_L);
            buf[idx] = sL + (sL - presLP_L) * presGain;
            if (channels == 2) {
                float sR = buf[idx + 1];
                presLP_R += pA * (sR - presLP_R);
                buf[idx + 1] = sR + (sR - presLP_R) * presGain;
            }
        }
    }
}

=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/RawFloatPlayer.java

package com.example.hello;

import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Plays a 32-bit float WAV straight through {@link AudioTrack} with:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>Live dBFS Meter Level ({@link #level})</b>: Computes the real-time
 *       post-FX peak amplitude of every played chunk so {@link DbMeterView}
 *       shows live dBFS readings while previewing!</li>
 *   <li><b>Zero Playhead Jerk</b>: {@link #positionFrames()} tracks the
 *       monotonic hardware speaker head ({@code startFramePos + head}).</li>
 *   <li><b>Speaker Pre-Warming</b>: {@link #warmUpSpeaker(int)} primes a
 *       low-latency {@link AudioTrack} for instant start.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class RawFloatPlayer {

    public interface Listener {
        /** Called once when playback stops: true = reached the end. */
        void onDone(boolean completed);
    }

    private static final Object WARM_LOCK = new Object();
    private static AudioTrack warmTrack;
    private static int warmChannels;
    private static volatile boolean warmingSpeaker;

    /**
     * Pre-warms the hardware speaker sink on a background thread when the user
     * starts scrolling the waveform so pressing Resume/Preview plays immediately.
     */
    public static void warmUpSpeaker(final int channels) {
        final int ch = channels == 1 ? 1 : 2;
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null && warmChannels == ch
                    && warmTrack.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                return;
            }
            if (warmingSpeaker) return;
            warmingSpeaker = true;
        }
        new Thread(() -> {
            AudioTrack built = null;
            try {
                built = createLowLatencyTrack(ch, 32768);
                if (built.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                    built.play();
                    float[] silence = new float[128 * ch];
                    built.write(silence, 0, silence.length, AudioTrack.WRITE_NON_BLOCKING);
                    built.stop();
                    built.flush();
                } else {
                    built.release();
                    built = null;
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                if (built != null) {
                    try { built.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored2) {}
                    built = null;
                }
            }
            synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
                warmingSpeaker = false;
                if (built != null) {
                    if (warmTrack != null) {
                        try { warmTrack.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                    }
                    warmTrack = built;
                    warmChannels = ch;
                }
            }
        }, "takeone-speaker-warm").start();
    }

    public static void releaseWarmSpeaker() {
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null) {
                try { warmTrack.stop(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                try { warmTrack.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                warmTrack = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private static AudioTrack obtainTrack(int channels, int desiredBytes) {
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null && warmChannels == channels
                    && warmTrack.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                AudioTrack t = warmTrack;
                warmTrack = null;
                return t;
            }
        }
        return createLowLatencyTrack(channels, desiredBytes);
    }

    private static AudioTrack createLowLatencyTrack(int channels, int desiredBytes) {
        int mask = channels == 2 ? AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO
                : AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO;
        int minBytes = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE,
                mask, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT);
        if (minBytes <= 0) minBytes = 8192;
        int bufBytes = Math.max(minBytes, Math.min(32768, desiredBytes));
        AudioAttributes attrs = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                .build();
        AudioFormat af = new AudioFormat.Builder()
                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT)
                .setSampleRate(RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE)
                .setChannelMask(mask)
                .build();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            try {
                return new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(attrs)
                        .setAudioFormat(af)
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(bufBytes)
                        .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
                        .setPerformanceMode(AudioTrack.PERFORMANCE_MODE_LOW_LATENCY)
                        .build();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
        return new AudioTrack(attrs, af, bufBytes, AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM, 0);
    }

    private final File file;
    private final int channels;
    private final long dataStart;
    private final long totalFrames;
    private final Listener listener;

    private Thread thread;
    private volatile boolean stop;
    private volatile boolean paused;
    private volatile long startFramePos;
    private volatile long framePos;
    private volatile long maxReportedFrame;
    private volatile long playStartedRealtimeMs;
    private volatile AudioTrack activeTrack;
    private volatile long generation;
    private volatile DspChain dspChain;
    private volatile long stopAtFrame = -1;
    /** Output length of the offline-rendered buffer, 0 when none is active. */
    private volatile int offlineOutFrames = 0;

    /**
     * Real-time peak amplitude (0..1) of the audio currently playing through
     * the speaker (including live DspChain FX), driving DbMeterView during preview!
     */
    public volatile float level = 0f;

    public void setDspChain(DspChain chain) {
        this.dspChain = chain;
    }

    public RawFloatPlayer(File file, Listener listener) throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(file);
        if (info.channels < 1 || info.channels > 2) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("bad channels");
        }
        this.file = file;
        this.channels = info.channels;
        this.dataStart = info.dataStart;
        this.totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / info.channels;
        if (totalFrames <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    public long durationMs() {
        return totalFrames * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    public synchronized void play() {
        playFrom(framePos);
    }

    public synchronized void playFrom(long frame) {
        stopLocked();
        stop = false;
        paused = false;
        stopAtFrame = -1;
        offlineOutFrames = 0;
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, frame));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        generation++;
        thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
        thread.start();
    }

    /** Play a specific frame range `[startFrame, endFrame)` (e.g. selection preview). */
    public synchronized void playRange(long startFrame, long endFrame) {
        stopLocked();
        stop = false;
        paused = false;
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, startFrame));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        offlineOutFrames = 0;
        playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        stopAtFrame = (endFrame > framePos && endFrame <= totalFrames)
                ? endFrame : -1;
        generation++;
        thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
        thread.start();
    }

    public synchronized void pause() {
        long cur = positionFrames();
        paused = true;
        stopLocked();
        framePos = cur;
        startFramePos = cur;
        maxReportedFrame = cur;
        level = 0f;
    }

    public synchronized void stop() {
        stopLocked();
        framePos = 0;
        startFramePos = 0;
        maxReportedFrame = 0;
        level = 0f;
    }

    /** Maps output-buffer playback frames onto source frames for time-stretched previews. */
    private long mapPlaybackHead(long head, long limit) {
        long span = Math.max(0L, limit - startFramePos);
        int out = offlineOutFrames;
        if (out > 0 && span > 0) {
            long mapped = startFramePos + head * span / out;
            return Math.min(limit, Math.max(startFramePos, mapped));
        }
        return Math.min(limit, startFramePos + head);
    }

    public long positionFrames() {
        long limit = (stopAtFrame > 0 && stopAtFrame <= totalFrames)
                ? stopAtFrame : totalFrames;
        if (!stop && !paused) {
            AudioTrack t = activeTrack;
            if (t != null) {
                try {
                    long head = t.getPlaybackHeadPosition() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
                    if (head > 0) {
                        long pos = mapPlaybackHead(head, limit);
                        if (pos > maxReportedFrame) maxReportedFrame = pos;
                        return maxReportedFrame;
                    }
                    long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - playStartedRealtimeMs;
                    if (elapsed > 160L && framePos > startFramePos) {
                        long headFrames = elapsed * RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE / 1000L;
                        long sim = mapPlaybackHead(headFrames, limit);
                        if (sim > maxReportedFrame) maxReportedFrame = sim;
                        return maxReportedFrame;
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            return maxReportedFrame;
        }
        return maxReportedFrame > 0 ? maxReportedFrame : framePos;
    }

    public long positionMs() {
        return positionFrames() * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    public synchronized void seekToMs(long ms) {
        long f = ms * RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE / 1000L;
        boolean wasPlaying = thread != null && !paused;
        stopLocked();
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, f));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        if (wasPlaying) {
            stop = false;
            paused = false;
            playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            generation++;
            thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
            thread.start();
        }
    }

    private synchronized void stopLocked() {
        generation++;
        stop = true;
        paused = true;
        level = 0f;
        AudioTrack t = activeTrack;
        if (t != null) {
            try {
                t.pause();
                t.flush();
                t.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        Thread th = thread;
        thread = null;
        if (th != null) {
            try {
                th.join(800);
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void run() {
        final long gen = generation;
        boolean completed = false;
        AudioTrack track = null;
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        ConversionJobs.beginRawRead(file.getAbsolutePath());
        try {
            long limitFrame = (stopAtFrame > 0 && stopAtFrame <= totalFrames)
                    ? stopAtFrame : totalFrames;
            long framesToPlay = Math.max(1L, limitFrame - startFramePos);
            int spanBytes = (int) Math.min(32768L, framesToPlay * channels * 4L);
            track = obtainTrack(channels, spanBytes);
            if (track.getState() != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) return;
            r = new RandomAccessFile(file, "r");
            float[] buf = new float[1024 * channels];
            byte[] raw = new byte[buf.length * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            track.play();
            activeTrack = track;
            long writtenFrames = 0;
            DspChain preChain = this.dspChain;
            int fileSr = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
            try {
                Dsp.WavHeader wh = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
                if (wh.sampleRate > 0) fileSr = wh.sampleRate;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (preChain != null && preChain.isActive()) {
                try {
                    preChain.setSampleRate(fileSr);
                    preChain.reset();
                    preChain.prepareOffline(file, startFramePos, limitFrame,
                            fileSr, channels);
                    // Prime algorithmic latency (e.g. STFT hop or FIR group delay)
                    // so live playback does not emit initial zero-padded silence.
                    if (preChain.offlineProcessors().isEmpty()) {
                        int lat = Math.max(0, preChain.getLatencyFrames());
                        long primePos = startFramePos;
                        while (lat > 0 && primePos < limitFrame) {
                            int step = (int) Math.min(1024, Math.min(lat, limitFrame - primePos));
                            r.seek(dataStart + primePos * channels * 4L);
                            r.readFully(raw, 0, step * channels * 4);
                            fb.clear();
                            fb.limit(step * channels);
                            fb.get(buf, 0, step * channels);
                            preChain.processInPlace(buf, step);
                            primePos += step;
                            lat -= step;
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (preChain != null && preChain.isActive()
                    && !preChain.offlineProcessors().isEmpty()) {
                float[] offlineBuf = preChain.renderRegionOfflineAndInPlace(
                        file, startFramePos, limitFrame,
                        RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE);
                if (offlineBuf != null && offlineBuf.length > 0) {
                    int outFrames = offlineBuf.length / channels;
                    offlineOutFrames = outFrames;
                    int curOut = 0;
                    while (!stop && curOut < outFrames) {
                        int want = Math.min(1024, outFrames - curOut);
                        int totalSamples = want * channels;
                        System.arraycopy(offlineBuf, curOut * channels,
                                buf, 0, totalSamples);
                        FxTelemetry.push(buf, want, channels);
                        float chunkPeak = 0f;
                        for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                            float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                            if (a > chunkPeak) chunkPeak = a;
                        }
                        this.level = Math.min(1f, chunkPeak);
                        int written = 0;
                        while (written < totalSamples && !stop) {
                            int n = track.write(buf, written,
                                    totalSamples - written,
                                    AudioTrack.WRITE_BLOCKING);
                            if (n <= 0) break;
                            written += n;
                        }
                        curOut += want;
                        writtenFrames += want;
                        framePos = startFramePos + Math.round(
                                (double) curOut / Math.max(1, outFrames)
                                        * (limitFrame - startFramePos));
                    }
                    offlineOutFrames = 0;
                    if (!stop) {
                        framePos = limitFrame;
                    }
                }
            }
            while (!stop && framePos < limitFrame) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(1024, limitFrame - framePos);
                r.seek(dataStart + framePos * channels * 4L);
                r.readFully(raw, 0, want * channels * 4);
                fb.clear();
                fb.limit(want * channels);
                fb.get(buf, 0, want * channels);
                DspChain chain = this.dspChain;
                if (chain != null && chain.isActive()) {
                    chain.processInPlace(buf, want);
                }
                FxTelemetry.push(buf, want, channels);
                // Compute post-FX peak level for the dBFS meter during preview!
                float chunkPeak = 0f;
                int totalSamples = want * channels;
                for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                    float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                    if (a > chunkPeak) chunkPeak = a;
                }
                this.level = Math.min(1f, chunkPeak);

                int written = 0;
                while (written < totalSamples && !stop) {
                    int n = track.write(buf, written,
                            totalSamples - written,
                            AudioTrack.WRITE_BLOCKING);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    written += n;
                }
                framePos += want;
                writtenFrames += want;
            }
            if (!stop && framePos >= limitFrame && writtenFrames > 0) {
                long drainStart = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                long maxDrainMs = Math.min(1500L,
                        (writtenFrames * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) + 350L);
                long lastHead = -1;
                long lastAdvanceAt = drainStart;
                while (!stop) {
                    long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                    if (now - drainStart >= maxDrainMs) break;
                    long head = 0;
                    try {
                        head = track.getPlaybackHeadPosition() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    if (head >= writtenFrames) break;
                    if (head != lastHead) {
                        lastHead = head;
                        lastAdvanceAt = now;
                    } else if (now - lastAdvanceAt > 180L) {
                        break;
                    }
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(12);
                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!stop) {
                    maxReportedFrame = limitFrame;
                    completed = true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            this.level = 0f;
            activeTrack = null;
            if (track != null) {
                try {
                    track.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    track.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (r != null) {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            ConversionJobs.endRawRead(file.getAbsolutePath());
            if (gen == generation && listener != null) {
                try {
                    listener.onDone(completed);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }
}
