package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Foreground host for an ongoing take: keeps capture alive when the app is
 * backgrounded, owns audio-focus interruption handling (pause, never
 * auto-resume) and exposes one clean persistent notification — name, preset,
 * live timer plus pause/resume, Save and Cancel actions that work without
 * opening the app.
 */
public class RecordingService extends Service {

    public static final String ACTION_START =
            "com.example.hello.REC_START";
    public static final String ACTION_TOGGLE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_TOGGLE";
    public static final String ACTION_SAVE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_SAVE";
    public static final String ACTION_CANCEL =
            "com.example.hello.REC_CANCEL";
    public static final String ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF =
            "com.example.hello.action.RESTORE_NOTIF";

    public static final String EXTRA_FORMAT = "format";

    /** Broadcast when a background save/cancel finishes. */
    public static final String BROADCAST_DONE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_DONE";
    public static final String EXTRA_OK = "ok";
    public static final String EXTRA_MESSAGE = "message";
    public static final String EXTRA_TITLE = "title";
    public static final String EXTRA_KIND = "kind"; // "save" or "cancel"

    private static final String CHANNEL = "takeone_recording";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 41;
    /** Focus losses inside this window after a (re)start are spurious. */
    private static final long FOCUS_GRACE_MS = 1200;

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private boolean ticking;
    private boolean busy; // a save/cancel is running
    private int convertingPct = -1;
    private long lastToggleAt;
    private long lastPctPush;
    private long captureStartedAt;

    private static volatile RecordingService activeInstance;

    private PendingIntent cachedContentIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedToggleIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedSaveIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedCancelIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedRestoreIntent;

    private String lastNotifTitle = "";
    private String lastNotifText = "";
    private Boolean lastNotifPaused = null;
    private int lastNotifPct = -2;
    private long lastChronoBaseMs = 0L;

    private AudioManager audioManager;
    private AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener focusListener;

    public static void start(Context ctx, String presetId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_START);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT, presetId);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            } else {
                ctx.startService(i);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                ctx.startService(i);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static void stopService(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.stopService(new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Called by RecordingEngine whenever capture starts, pauses, resumes,
     * finalizes, clears, aborts, or renames, so the notification updates
     * immediately without waiting for the next tick.
     */
    public static void onRecordingStateChanged() {
        RecordingService s = activeInstance;
        if (s != null) {
            s.handler.post(() -> s.refreshNotif(true));
        }
    }

    public static boolean isRunning(Context ctx) {
        // Best-effort: true while the engine holds an active capture session.
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        return e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        super.onCreate();
        activeInstance = this;
        ensureChannel();
        audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        initPendingIntents();
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent == null) {
            // System-restarted. START_NOT_STICKY means this should not happen,
            // but never re-enter startForeground() from here: a restart
            // racing the save could hit the Android 14+ rule that a
            // microphone FGS may not start from the background, and a
            // startForegroundService() that never promotes itself is fatal
            // to the process.
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        String a = intent.getAction();
        if (ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF.equals(a)) {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (e.hasSession() && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                    || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED)) {
                startFg();
                refreshNotif(true);
            } else {
                stopSelf();
            }
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        if (ACTION_START.equals(a)) {
            String preset = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT);
            if (preset != null) RecordPreset.of(preset).save(this);
            captureStartedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            registerFocus();
            startFg();
            startTick();
        } else if (ACTION_TOGGLE.equals(a)) {
            doToggle();
        } else if (ACTION_SAVE.equals(a)) {
            doSave();
        } else if (ACTION_CANCEL.equals(a)) {
            doCancel();
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (activeInstance == this) activeInstance = null;
        stopTick();
        abandonFocus();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ---- audio focus: interruptions pause, never auto-resume ----

    private android.media.AudioFocusRequest focusReq26;

    /**
     * True when a cellular or VoIP call (ringing, dialing, or in-call) is active.
     * Prevents resuming AudioRecord while Android's telephony policy mutes the mic.
     */
    public static boolean isCallActive(Context ctx) {
        if (ctx == null) return false;
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am != null) {
                int mode = am.getMode();
                if (mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_CALL
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_RINGTONE) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            android.telephony.TelephonyManager tm =
                    (android.telephony.TelephonyManager) ctx.getSystemService(
                            Context.TELEPHONY_SERVICE);
            if (tm != null) {
                int callState = tm.getCallState();
                if (callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_RINGING
                        || callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Requests audio focus and returns true only if granted.
     * If a call or exclusive speaker session rejects focus, returns false.
     */
    private boolean registerFocus() {
        try {
            if (isCallActive(this)) return false;
            if (audioManager == null) {
                audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            }
            if (audioManager == null) return true;
            if (focusListener == null) {
                focusListener = focus -> {
                    if (focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK) {
                        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - captureStartedAt
                                < FOCUS_GRACE_MS) {
                            return;
                        }
                        handler.post(() -> {
                            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
                            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                                e.pauseCapture();
                                abandonFocus();
                                boolean call = isCallActive(RecordingService.this);
                                toast(getString(call
                                        ? R.string.msg_paused_call
                                        : R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                                refreshNotif(true);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                };
            }
            int res;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                focusReq26 = new android.media.AudioFocusRequest.Builder(
                        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
                        .setAudioAttributes(new android.media.AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(focusListener, handler)
                        .build();
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusReq26);
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusListener,
                        AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN);
            }
            return res == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    private void abandonFocus() {
        try {
            if (audioManager != null) {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && focusReq26 != null) {
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(focusReq26);
                    focusReq26 = null;
                } else if (focusListener != null) {
                    //noinspection deprecation
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocus(focusListener);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        focusListener = null;
    }

    // ---- actions (debounced: one tap, one transition) ----

    private void doToggle() {
        if (busy) return;
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (now - lastToggleAt < 400) return;
        lastToggleAt = now;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        try {
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                e.pauseCapture();
                abandonFocus();
            } else if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED) {
                if (isCallActive(this)) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_call_active));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                captureStartedAt = now;
                if (!registerFocus()) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                e.resumeCapture(getApplicationContext(),
                        RecordPreset.load(this).audioSource);
            } else {
                return;
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            toast(getString(R.string.msg_need_mic));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            toast(getString(R.string.couldnt_save));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        }
        refreshNotif(true);
    }

    private void doSave() {
        if (busy) return;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        if (!e.hasSession()) {
            stopSelf();
            return;
        }
        if (e.isSaving()) return;
        e.setSaving(true);
        busy = true;
        RecordPreset curPreset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        SaveFormat curSave = SaveFormat.load(this);
        boolean immediateWav32 = curSave.effective(curPreset) == SaveFormat.WAV32
                && !e.isFxBakeRequired();
        convertingPct = immediateWav32 ? -1 : 0;
        lastPctPush = 0;
        refreshNotif();
        new Thread(() -> {
            boolean ok;
            String msg;
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            try {
                Context appCtx = getApplicationContext();
                if (e.isInSubSession()) {
                    // The notification saved while a Select & Replace
                    // sub-session was open: splice first, then save the parent
                    // instead of exporting only the temporary snippet.
                    boolean commitSub = e.rawFile != null
                            && RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(e.rawFile) > 0;
                    e.exitSelectAndReplaceSubSession(commitSub, null);
                }
                RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
                SaveFormat save = SaveFormat.load(this);
                // NEW-06 fix: honour and clear stashed EditLink when saving
                // an edited take from the notification action.
                String rawPath = e.rawFile != null
                        ? e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() : null;
                long replaceId = -1;
                String replaceTitle = null;
                if (EditLink.matches(appCtx, rawPath)) {
                    replaceId = EditLink.id(appCtx);
                    replaceTitle = EditLink.title(appCtx);
                }
                ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                        appCtx, preset, save, this::setPct,
                        replaceId, replaceTitle);
                EditLink.clear(appCtx);
                if (r.adopted) {
                    if (replaceId > 0) {
                        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replaceId);
                    }
                    String rt = replaceTitle != null
                            && !replaceTitle.isEmpty()
                            ? replaceTitle : r.title;
                    TakesRepository.addRecordingWithId(
                            r.recordingId, r.file, r.durationMs,
                            rt, r.label);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.convert_done_msg, r.title,
                            r.label);
                } else {
                    // Handed to the conversion service; this service is done.
                    ConversionService.startJob(appCtx, r.job.jobId);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.conv_bg_toast);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                ok = false;
                msg = getString(R.string.convert_failed_msg, title);
            }
            final boolean done = ok;
            final String text = msg;
            final String t = title;
            handler.post(() -> {
                e.setSaving(false);
                try {
                    convertingPct = -1;
                    refreshNotif();
                    Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, done);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "save");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, t);
                try {
                    // Explicit package: stays inside the app, satisfies
                    // UnsafeImplicitIntentLaunch, same delivery as before.
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                convertingPct = -1;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    CrashLog.breadcrumb(getApplicationContext(),
                            "service completion FAILED: " + ex);
                    try {
                        stopSelf();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            });
        }).start();
    }

    private void doCancel() {
        if (busy) return;
        if (RecordingEngine.get().isSaving()) return;
        busy = true;
        new Thread(() -> {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            boolean ok = e.abortAndDelete();
            EditLink.clear(getApplicationContext());
            final String text = ok
                    ? getString(R.string.delete_success_one, title)
                    : getString(R.string.delete_failed_msg);
            handler.post(() -> {
                toast(text);
                Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, ok);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "cancel");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, title);
                try {
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
            });
        }).start();
    }

    // ---- notification: one clean standard layout ----

    private void ensureChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;
        try {
            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(
                    CHANNEL, getString(R.string.notif_channel),
                    NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ch.setDescription(getString(R.string.notif_channel_desc));
            nm.createNotificationChannel(ch);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void startFg() {
        lastNotifTitle = "";
        lastNotifText = "";
        lastNotifPaused = null;
        lastNotifPct = -2;
        Notification n = buildNotif();
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n,
                        ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
            }
            return;
        } catch (Exception typed) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "typed startForeground failed: " + typed);
        }
        // Untyped retry: a service launched with startForegroundService()
        // must reach the foreground within ~5s or the system kills the app,
        // so it is always worth attempting the permissive call.
        try {
            startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "startForeground failed: " + e);
            try {
                stopSelf();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void refreshNotif() {
        refreshNotif(false);
    }

    private void refreshNotif(boolean force) {
        try {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (!e.hasSession() && !busy) return;
            String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
            boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
            RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
            String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
            long durMs = e.durationMs();
            String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

            String title;
            String text;
            if (convertingPct >= 0) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
                text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
            } else if (paused) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
                // Chronometer is hidden when paused, so show frozen MM:SS here.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                        + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
            } else {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
                // Native Chronometer in header is the single live timer;
                // do not duplicate a second text timer in contentText.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
            }

            long expectedBase = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            boolean baseDrifted = !paused && convertingPct < 0
                    && Math.abs(expectedBase - lastChronoBaseMs) > 250L;

            if (!force && !baseDrifted
                    && title.equals(lastNotifTitle)
                    && text.equals(lastNotifText)
                    && lastNotifPaused != null && lastNotifPaused == paused
                    && lastNotifPct == convertingPct) {
                return;
            }
            lastNotifTitle = title;
            lastNotifText = text;
            lastNotifPaused = paused;
            lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
            if (!paused && convertingPct < 0) {
                lastChronoBaseMs = expectedBase;
            }

            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm != null) {
                nm.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * A single standard notification: small mic icon, "Recording — name"
     * title, "preset • live timer" text and exactly three actions. Built
     * with NotificationCompat so it renders identically (and lint-clean)
     * from API 24 up, with no custom RemoteViews for the system to duplicate.
     */
    private Notification buildNotif() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
        boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
        long durMs = e.durationMs();
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

        String title;
        String text;
        if (convertingPct >= 0) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
            text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
        } else if (paused) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                    + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
        } else {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
        }
        lastNotifTitle = title;
        lastNotifText = text;
        lastNotifPaused = paused;
        lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
        return buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs);
    }

    private Notification buildNotifWith(String title, String text,
                                        boolean paused, long durMs) {
        if (cachedContentIntent == null && cachedToggleIntent == null) {
            initPendingIntents();
        }
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));
        androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL);
        b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_mic);
        // Match TakeOne brand colors: record red (#FF3B30) when active,
        // amber (#FF9F0A) when paused.
        // Tint only the icon badge and action buttons (never flood-fill the
        // card background with setColorized(true)).
        b.setColor(paused ? 0xFFFF9F0A : 0xFFFF3B30);
        b.setColorized(false);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setCategory(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_SERVICE);
        b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setOngoing(true);
        b.setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        b.setSilent(true);
        if (cachedRestoreIntent != null) {
            b.setDeleteIntent(cachedRestoreIntent);
        }
        // Native SystemUI Chronometer ticks in real time on the system UI
        // thread without requiring sub-second Binder IPC updates.
        if (convertingPct < 0 && !paused) {
            long base = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            lastChronoBaseMs = base;
            b.setWhen(base);
            b.setShowWhen(true);
            b.setUsesChronometer(true);
        } else {
            b.setShowWhen(false);
            b.setUsesChronometer(false);
        }
        if (cachedContentIntent != null) {
            b.setContentIntent(cachedContentIntent);
        }
        if (convertingPct < 0) {
            b.addAction(0,
                    paused ? getString(R.string.notif_resume)
                            : getString(R.string.notif_pause),
                    cachedToggleIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_save),
                    cachedSaveIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_cancel),
                    cachedCancelIntent);
        } else {
            b.setProgress(100, Math.max(0, Math.min(100, convertingPct)), false);
        }
        try {
            Notification n = b.build();
            n.flags |= Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT
                    | Notification.FLAG_NO_CLEAR
                    | Notification.FLAG_FOREGROUND_SERVICE;
            return n;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return new Notification();
        }
    }

    private void initPendingIntents() {
        Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
        open.putExtra("open_studio", true);
        open.setAction("com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO");
        try {
            cachedContentIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 10, open,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            cachedContentIntent = null;
        }
        cachedToggleIntent = action(ACTION_TOGGLE, 21);
        cachedSaveIntent = action(ACTION_SAVE, 22);
        cachedCancelIntent = action(ACTION_CANCEL, 23);
        cachedRestoreIntent = action(ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF, 24);
    }

    private PendingIntent action(String what, int code) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(what);
        try {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
        }
    }

    private void startTick() {
        if (ticking) return;
        ticking = true;
        handler.post(tick);
    }

    private void stopTick() {
        ticking = false;
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
    }

    private final Runnable tick = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            if (!ticking) return;
            refreshNotif(false);
            // Align to the next whole-second boundary while recording so the
            // MM:SS readout steps in sync with the audio duration and never
            // exceeds 1 update/sec.
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            long delay = 1000L;
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                long rem = 1000L - (e.durationMs() % 1000L);
                delay = Math.max(200L, Math.min(1000L, rem));
            }
            handler.postDelayed(this, delay);
        }
    };

    private void setPct(int pct) {
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (pct == convertingPct) return;
        if (pct < 100 && now - lastPctPush < 500) {
            convertingPct = pct;
            return;
        }
        convertingPct = pct;
        lastPctPush = now;
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    private void toast(String text) {
        try {
            Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), text, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 Repair (LPC Short-Glitch & Dropout Interpolator): detects the worst
 * glitch or dropout span inside the region and reconstructs it by running
 * Burg/Levinson-Durbin linear predictive coding (LPC) forward from the left
 * context and backward from the right context, cross-fading the two
 * predictions with a raised-cosine window across the full repair length.
 */
final class RepairProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter lpcOrder = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "repair_order", "Prediction Order", "", 8, 32, 2, 16));
    private final FxParameter repairLen = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "repair_len", "Max Repair Length", " ms", 0.5f, 50f, 3.0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    RepairProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "repair";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Repair";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Bidirectional LPC autoregressive interpolation for glitches & dropouts";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames < 128) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int order = Math.max(4, Math.min(32, lpcOrder.getCurrentRaw()));
        int maxSamples = Math.max(8, Math.min(frames / 3,
                (int) Math.round(repairLen.getFloat() * 0.001 * sampleRate)));
        int ctxLen = Math.max(order * 4, 128);
        if (frames < ctxLen * 2 + maxSamples) return;

        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            float[] x = new float[frames];
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) x[f] = buf[f * ch + c];

            // Locate a sudden dropout to silence surrounded by active audio.
            int dropoutStart = -1;
            int dropoutEnd = -1;
            for (int f = ctxLen; f < frames - ctxLen; f++) {
                if (dropoutStart < 0 && Math.abs(x[f]) < 1e-4f
                        && Math.abs(x[f - 1]) > 0.01f) {
                    int e = f;
                    while (e < frames - ctxLen && Math.abs(x[e]) < 1e-4f) e++;
                    if (e - f >= 4) {
                        dropoutStart = f;
                        dropoutEnd = e;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Only repair actual dropouts. Never overwrite a clean window
            // around the largest natural curvature peak: that corrupted up to
            // 58% of every dropout-free chunk with synthetic LPC audio.
            if (dropoutStart < ctxLen || dropoutEnd <= dropoutStart) continue;
            int start = dropoutStart;
            int end = Math.min(dropoutEnd, dropoutStart + maxSamples);
            repairSpan(x, start, end, order, ctxLen);
            for (int f = start; f < end; f++) buf[f * ch + c] = x[f];
        }
    }

    /** Reconstructs {@code x[start..end)} from surrounding context via LPC. */
    static void repairSpan(float[] x, int start, int end, int order, int ctxLen) {
        int len = end - start;
        if (len <= 0 || start < ctxLen || end + ctxLen > x.length) return;
        double[] aFwd = levinsonDurbin(x, start - ctxLen, ctxLen, order);
        double[] aBwd = levinsonDurbin(x, end, ctxLen, order);

        float[] fwd = new float[len];
        float[] bwd = new float[len];
        float[] fHist = new float[order];
        float[] bHist = new float[order];
        for (int k = 0; k < order; k++) {
            fHist[k] = x[start - 1 - k];
            bHist[k] = x[end + k];
        }
        // Damping factor slightly below unity (0.9992) keeps very long
        // autoregressive extrapolations (up to 2400 samples) bounded.
        final double damp = 0.9992;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            double sF = 0;
            double sB = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= order; k++) {
                sF -= aFwd[k] * fHist[k - 1];
                sB -= aBwd[k] * bHist[k - 1];
            }
            float nextF = (float) (sF * damp);
            float nextB = (float) (sB * damp);
            if (!Float.isFinite(nextF)) nextF = 0f;
            if (!Float.isFinite(nextB)) nextB = 0f;
            fwd[i] = nextF;
            bwd[len - 1 - i] = nextB;
            System.arraycopy(fHist, 0, fHist, 1, order - 1);
            fHist[0] = nextF;
            System.arraycopy(bHist, 0, bHist, 1, order - 1);
            bHist[0] = nextB;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            float u = (i + 0.5f) / len;
            float wBwd = 0.5f * (1f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * u));
            float wFwd = 1f - wBwd;
            x[start + i] = fwd[i] * wFwd + bwd[i] * wBwd;
        }
    }

    private static double[] levinsonDurbin(float[] x, int off, int n, int order) {
        double[] r = new double[order + 1];
        for (int k = 0; k <= order; k++) {
            double s = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n - k; i++) {
                s += (double) x[off + i] * x[off + i + k];
            }
            r[k] = s;
        }
        double[] a = new double[order + 1];
        double[] aPrev = new double[order + 1];
        a[0] = 1.0;
        if (r[0] < 1e-12) return a;
        double e = r[0];
        for (int m = 1; m <= order; m++) {
            double sum = r[m];
            for (int k = 1; k < m; k++) sum += a[k] * r[m - k];
            double kappa = -sum / Math.max(1e-12, e);
            if (kappa > 0.995) kappa = 0.995;
            if (kappa < -0.995) kappa = -0.995;
            System.arraycopy(a, 0, aPrev, 0, m);
            a[m] = kappa;
            for (int k = 1; k < m; k++) {
                a[k] = aPrev[k] + kappa * aPrev[m - k];
            }
            e *= (1.0 - kappa * kappa);
            if (e <= 1e-14) break;
        }
        return a;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.MediaCodecInfo;
import android.media.MediaCodecList;
import android.media.MediaFormat;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Container/codec the user wants the finished take written in.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Audio is always captured to a crash-safe 32-bit float WAV on disk first;
 * this choice only governs the final conversion step after the user stops.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;WAV16/WAV24/WAV32 are written by our own pure-Java writer (always available);
 * M4A uses the baseline AAC encoder mandated by the Android CDD. The other
 * formats (FLAC, Opus, AMR-NB, AMR-WB) are gated by a one-shot
 * {@link MediaCodecList} probe so the picker never offers an encoder the
 * device does not actually have.
 */
public enum SaveFormat {
    AUTO("auto", R.string.save_auto, R.string.save_auto_sub, "AUTO"),
    M4A("m4a", R.string.save_m4a, R.string.save_m4a_sub, "M4A"),
    WAV16("wav16", R.string.save_wav16, R.string.save_wav16_sub, "WAV"),
    WAV24("wav24", R.string.save_wav24, R.string.save_wav24_sub, "WAV24"),
    WAV32("wav32", R.string.save_wav32, R.string.save_wav32_sub, "WAV32"),
    FLAC("flac", R.string.save_flac, R.string.save_flac_sub, "FLAC"),
    OPUS("opus", R.string.save_opus, R.string.save_opus_sub, "OPUS"),
    AMR_NB("amr_nb", R.string.save_amr_nb, R.string.save_amr_nb_sub, "AMR"),
    AMR_WB("amr_wb", R.string.save_amr_wb, R.string.save_amr_wb_sub, "AMR-WB");

    public final String id;
    public final int titleRes;
    public final int subRes;
    /** Short badge stored on the library card ("M4A", "WAV", "FLAC", …). */
    public final String badge;

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY = "save_format";
    private static volatile SaveFormat cached;
    private static final Map<SaveFormat, Boolean> AVAIL = new HashMap<>();

    SaveFormat(String id, int titleRes, int subRes, String badge) {
        this.id = id;
        this.titleRes = titleRes;
        this.subRes = subRes;
        this.badge = badge;
    }

    public static SaveFormat of(String id) {
        if (id != null) {
            for (SaveFormat f : values()) {
                if (f.id.equalsIgnoreCase(id)) return f;
            }
        }
        return AUTO;
    }

    public static SaveFormat load(Context ctx) {
        SaveFormat c = cached;
        if (c != null) return c;
        try {
            String raw = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getString(KEY, AUTO.id);
            c = of(raw);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            c = AUTO;
        }
        cached = c;
        return c;
    }

    public void save(Context ctx) {
        cached = this;
        try {
            ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putString(KEY, id).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** True if this device can actually encode this format right now. */
    public synchronized boolean available(Context ctx) {
        switch (this) {
            case AUTO:
            case M4A:
            case WAV16:
            case WAV24:
            case WAV32:
                return true;
            case OPUS:
                // MediaMuxer only gained OGG/WEBM Opus support across the
                // board on API 29; older builds have the codec but no muxer.
                if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 26) return false;
                break;
            case FLAC:
            case AMR_NB:
            case AMR_WB:
                break;
        }
        Boolean hit = AVAIL.get(this);
        if (hit != null) return hit;
        boolean ok = hasEncoder(encoderMime());
        AVAIL.put(this, ok);
        return ok;
    }

    /**
     * Proves the device can actually instantiate and configure the encoder
     * at our recording geometry — not merely that it lists the MIME in
     * {@link MediaCodecList}. Some builds advertise a codec that then throws
     * on {@code configure()} for 48 kHz stereo.
     */
    private boolean hasEncoder(String mime) {
        if (mime == null) return true;
        try {
            MediaCodecList list = new MediaCodecList(MediaCodecList.ALL_CODECS);
            boolean listed = false;
            for (MediaCodecInfo info : list.getCodecInfos()) {
                if (!info.isEncoder()) continue;
                for (String t : info.getSupportedTypes()) {
                    if (mime.equalsIgnoreCase(t)) {
                        listed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (listed) break;
            }
            if (!listed) return false;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public String encoderMime() {
        switch (this) {
            case M4A: return MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC;
            case FLAC: return "audio/flac";
            case OPUS: return "audio/opus";
            case AMR_NB: return "audio/3gpp";
            case AMR_WB: return "audio/amr-wb";
            default: return null;
        }
    }

    /** File extension (without dot) for a resolved format. */
    public String extension() {
        switch (this) {
            case WAV16:
            case WAV24:
            case WAV32: return "wav";
            case AMR_NB:
            case AMR_WB: return "3gp";
            case FLAC: return "flac";
            case OPUS:
                return android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29 ? "opus" : "webm";
            case M4A:
            case AUTO:
            default: return "m4a";
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resolves {@link #AUTO} against the active preset:
     * &lt;ul&gt;
     *   &lt;li&gt;Voice Memo / Podcast — speech, where AAC is transparent at a
     *       tenth of the size, so Auto picks {@link #M4A}.</li>
     *   &lt;li&gt;Music — unprocessed stereo master where any lossy pass
     *       discards real detail, so Auto saves lossless 32-bit float WAV
     *       ({@link #WAV32}).</li>
     * &lt;/ul&gt;
     * Any explicit choice is returned unchanged.
     */
    public SaveFormat effective(RecordPreset preset) {
        if (this != AUTO) return this;
        if (preset != null && preset.autoSavesLossless) {
            return WAV32;
        }
        return M4A;
    }

    /**
     * Next format to switch to when an encoder for {@code this} crashes the
     * process mid-save. Walks down to a simpler encoder and finally to
     * {@link #WAV16}, which is our own pure-Java writer (no MediaCodec) and
     * cannot die natively. Null when already at the bottom. FLAC falls back
     * to WAV24, never to lossy AAC: a lossless save must not silently
     * degrade when pure-Java WAV24 is available.
     */
    public SaveFormat fallbackAfterCrash() {
        switch (this) {
            case OPUS:
            case AMR_NB:
            case AMR_WB:
                return M4A;
            case FLAC:
                return WAV24;
            case M4A:
            case AUTO:
                return WAV16;
            case WAV16:
            case WAV24:
            case WAV32:
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Approximate bytes written per minute of audio when saved in this
     * format under the given preset. Constant-rate estimates are exact;
     * FLAC is a content-dependent guess (see {@link #FLAC_RATIO}).
     */
    public long bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset preset) {
        SaveFormat eff = effective(preset);
        int ch = preset != null ? Math.max(1, preset.channels) : 2;
        int br = preset != null ? preset.aacBitrate : 128000;
        long sr = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
        switch (eff) {
            case WAV16:
                return sr * ch * 2 * 60;
            case WAV24:
                return sr * ch * 3 * 60;
            case WAV32:
                return sr * ch * 4 * 60;
            case AMR_NB:
                // 12.2 kbps mono regardless of preset.
                return 12200L * 60 / 8;
            case AMR_WB:
                // 23.85 kbps mono regardless of preset.
                return 23850L * 60 / 8;
            case OPUS: {
                // FormatConverter clamps Opus to [32k, 256k].
                long clamped = Math.max(32000, Math.min(256000,
                        br <= 0 ? 128000 : br));
                return clamped * 60 / 8;
            }
            case FLAC:
                // Android's FLAC encoder takes 16-bit PCM input; typical
                // music compresses to ~55% of that.
                return (long) (sr * ch * 2 * 60 * FLAC_RATIO);
            case M4A:
            case AUTO:
            default: {
                long clamped = Math.max(64000, Math.min(320000, br));
                return clamped * 60 / 8;
            }
        }
    }

    /** Lossless-compression ratio used for the FLAC estimate. */
    private static final double FLAC_RATIO = 0.55d;

    /** True when the size estimate is content-dependent rather than fixed-rate. */
    public boolean sizeIsApproximate() {
        return this == FLAC || this == AUTO;
    }

    /**
     * Short human label for the format picker ("~1.9 MB/min", "17 MB/min").
     * Prefixed with {@code ~} when the rate is content-dependent so variable
     * formats never look like a promise.
     */
    public String sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset preset) {
        long bpm = bytesPerMinute(preset);
        double mb = bpm / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
        String prefix = sizeIsApproximate() ? "~" : "";
        if (mb >= 9.95) {
            return String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%s%.0f MB/min",
                    prefix, mb);
        }
        return String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%s%.1f MB/min",
                prefix, mb);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.util.Log;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream;

/**
 * Reads a script into plain text from a .txt or .docx picked by the user.
 *
 * <p>A .docx is a ZIP whose {@code word/document.xml} holds the text. We pull
 * {@code <w:t>} runs and treat {@code </w:p>} as a paragraph break, which
 * preserves the line structure a teleprompter needs. Anything we cannot parse
 * degrades to a readable dump rather than failing the import.
 */
public final class ScriptImporter {

    private static final String TAG = "ScriptImport";
    private static final String DOCX_ENTRY = "word/document.xml";
    private static final int MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

    private ScriptImporter() {}

    /** Result of an import, including why it failed when it did. */
    public static final class Result {
        public final String text;
        public final boolean docx;
        public final String error;

        Result(String text, boolean docx, String error) {
            this.text = text;
            this.docx = docx;
            this.error = error;
        }

        public boolean ok() {
            return text != null && !text.trim().isEmpty();
        }
    }

    public static Result read(Context ctx, Uri uri) {
        try {
            String name = queryName(ctx, uri);
            InputStream in = ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
            if (in == null) return new Result(null, false, "could not open file");
            try {
                if (name != null && name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US)
                        .endsWith(".docx")) {
                    return readDocx(in);
                }
                // Unknown extension: sniff the ZIP magic so a renamed .docx
                // still works.
                byte[] head = new byte[4];
                int n = in.read(head, 0, 4);
                boolean zip = n == 4 && head[0] == 'P' && head[1] == 'K'
                        && head[2] == 3 && head[3] == 4;
                if (zip) {
                    return readDocx(new FileInputStreamWrapper(in, head));
                }
                // Plain text: replay the sniffed header bytes, otherwise
                // every import silently loses its first four characters.
                if (n <= 0) return new Result("", false, null);
                return new Result(readPlain(new FileInputStreamWrapper(in,
                        java.util.Arrays.copyOf(head, n))), false, null);
            } finally {
                try {
                    in.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (SecurityException e) {
            return new Result(null, false, "no permission to read that file");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "import failed", e);
            return new Result(null, false, "could not read that file");
        }
    }

    private static String readPlain(InputStream in) throws Exception {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(in, "UTF-8"), 8192);
        char[] buf = new char[4096];
        int n;
        while ((n = r.read(buf)) > 0) {
            sb.append(buf, 0, n);
            if (sb.length() > MAX_BYTES) break;
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static Result readDocx(InputStream in) {
        // ZipInputStream cannot rewind, so buffer the entry we need to a file.
        File tmp = null;
        try (ZipInputStream zip = new ZipInputStream(in)) {
            ZipEntry entry;
            byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
            while ((entry = zip.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                if (!DOCX_ENTRY.equals(entry.getName())) continue;
                tmp = File.createTempFile("script", ".docx");
                OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(tmp);
                try {
                    int n;
                    int total = 0;
                    while ((n = zip.read(buf)) > 0) {
                        out.write(buf, 0, n);
                        total += n;
                        if (total > MAX_BYTES) break;
                    }
                } finally {
                    try {
                        out.close();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                break;
            }
            if (tmp == null || tmp.length() == 0) {
                return new Result(null, true, "not a Word document");
            }
            String text = parseDocumentXml(tmp);
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            tmp.delete();
            return new Result(text, true, null);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "docx parse failed", e);
            return new Result(null, true, "could not read that Word file");
        } finally {
            if (tmp != null) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tmp.delete();
            }
        }
    }

    /** Walks document.xml, emitting paragraph breaks and text runs. */
    private static String parseDocumentXml(File docx) throws Exception {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        XmlPullParser p = android.util.Xml.newPullParser();
        // A4-13: the stream was never closed, leaking a descriptor on every
        // .docx import.
        try (java.io.InputStream fis = new FileInputStream(docx)) {
            p.setInput(fis, "UTF-8");
            return parseWith(p);
        }
    }

    private static String parseWith(XmlPullParser p) throws Exception {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        boolean firstPara = true;
        int event;
        try {
        while ((event = p.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT) {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.START_TAG) {
                String tag = p.getName();
                if (tag != null) {
                    int colon = tag.indexOf(':');
                    if (colon >= 0) tag = tag.substring(colon + 1);
                }
                if ("p".equals(tag)) {
                    // Every paragraph after the first starts a new line,
                    // unconditionally: empty paragraphs (<w:p/>) then
                    // survive as blank lines instead of collapsing.
                    if (!firstPara) {
                        out.append('\n');
                    }
                    firstPara = false;
                } else if ("t".equals(tag)) {
                    // Text run begins; content arrives as TEXT events.
                    if (p.next() == XmlPullParser.TEXT) {
                        String t = p.getText();
                        if (t != null) out.append(t);
                    }
                } else if ("tab".equals(tag)) {
                    out.append('\t');
                } else if ("br".equals(tag)) {
                    out.append('\n');
                }
            }
        }
        } catch (org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException e) {
            // A capped read of word/document.xml can end mid-tag; keep the
            // text decoded so far instead of failing the whole import.
            if (out.length() == 0) throw e;
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static String queryName(Context ctx, Uri uri) {
        try {
            if ("content".equals(uri.getScheme())) {
                android.database.Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(
                        uri, new String[]{android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME},
                        null, null, null);
                if (c != null) {
                    try {
                        if (c.moveToFirst()) return c.getString(0);
                    } finally {
                        c.close();
                    }
                }
            }
            return uri.getLastPathSegment();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return uri.getLastPathSegment();
        }
    }

    /** Test hook for the sniffed-header replay stream. */
    static java.io.InputStream wrapForTest(java.io.InputStream src,
                                            byte[] head) {
        return new FileInputStreamWrapper(src, head);
    }

    /** Re-injects the magic bytes already consumed while sniffing. */
    private static final class FileInputStreamWrapper extends InputStream {
        private final InputStream src;
        private final byte[] head;
        private int pos;

        FileInputStreamWrapper(InputStream src, byte[] head) {
            this.src = src;
            this.head = head;
        }

        // A4-13: the buffered head is served purely by `pos < head.length`.
        // A one-shot `headDone` flag was set on the very first read() and
        // dropped every remaining sniffed byte when the caller did not
        // consume the whole header in one call.

        @Override
        public int read() throws java.io.IOException {
            if (pos < head.length) return head[pos++] & 0xFF;
            return src.read();
        }

        @Override
        public int read(byte[] b, int off, int len) throws java.io.IOException {
            if (len == 0) return 0;
            if (pos < head.length) {
                int n = Math.min(len, head.length - pos);
                System.arraycopy(head, pos, b, off, n);
                pos += n;
                if (n == len) return n;
                int r = src.read(b, off + n, len - n);
                return r < 0 ? n : n + r;
            }
            return src.read(b, off, len);
        }

        @Override
        public int available() throws java.io.IOException {
            return head.length - pos + src.available();
        }

        @Override
        public void close() throws java.io.IOException {
            src.close();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 3 Shelf Filter: Low-shelf or High-shelf with corner frequency,
 * gain (-24..+24 dB) and shelf slope S (0.3..2.0).
 */
final class ShelfFilterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Low Shelf", "High Shelf"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "type", "Shelf Type", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "freq", "Corner Freq", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 200));
    private final FxParameter gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gain", "Shelf Gain", -24f, 24f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter slope = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "slope", "Slope S", 0.3f, 2.0f, 0.7f));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    ShelfFilterProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "shelf";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Shelf Filter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Broad high or low tonal shelf with adjustable slope";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    private boolean hasSecondaryChange() {
        return type.getCurrentRaw() != type.defaultRaw
                || freq.getCurrentRaw() != freq.defaultRaw
                || slope.getCurrentRaw() != slope.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || hasSecondaryChange());
    }

    float[][] buildSections() {
        double g = gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g) < 0.01) {
            if (!hasSecondaryChange()) return new float[0][];
            g = 3.0;
        }
        double f0 = Math.max(20.0, Math.min(sampleRate * 0.45, freq.getCurrentRaw()));
        double s = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(2.0, slope.getFloat()));
        float[] sec = type.getEnumIndex() == 1
                ? Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, f0, s, g)
                : Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sampleRate, f0, s, g);
        return new float[][]{sec};
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
        filter.process(buf, frames, this.channels);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 sliding stretch: a time-varying WSOLA whose stretch ratio and
 * pitch factor ramp linearly from the initial to the final value across the
 * processed region, with raised-cosine crossfades across segment boundaries
 * so transitions are click-free.
 */
final class SlidingStretchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter initialTempo = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_init", "Initial Tempo Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter finalTempo = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_final", "Final Tempo Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter initialPitch = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_pitchinit", "Initial Pitch Shift", " st", -24f, 24f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter finalPitch = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_pitchfinal", "Final Pitch Shift", " st", -24f, 24f, 0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    SlidingStretchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "slidestretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Sliding Stretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Continuous tempo and pitch ramp across the region";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (initialTempo.getFloat() != 0f
                || finalTempo.getFloat() != 0f
                || initialPitch.getFloat() != 0f
                || finalPitch.getFloat() != 0f);
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double r0 = 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + initialTempo.getFloat() / 100.0);
        double r1 = 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + finalTempo.getFloat() / 100.0);
        double p0 = initialPitch.getFloat();
        double p1 = finalPitch.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(r0 - 1.0) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(r1 - 1.0) < 1e-6
                && Math.abs(p0) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(p1) < 1e-6) {
            return in.clone();
        }
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        final int segments = 8;
        final int overlapIn = Math.min(120, Math.max(0, frames / (segments * 4)));
        float[][] segBuffers = new float[segments][];
        int[] coreFrames = new int[segments];
        int totalOutFrames = 0;
        int inPos = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < segments; s++) {
            double u = (s + 0.5) / segments;
            double ratio = Math.max(0.2, r0 + (r1 - r0) * u);
            double pitch = p0 + (p1 - p0) * u;
            int segIn = (s == segments - 1) ? frames - inPos
                    : Math.max(1, frames / segments);
            if (segIn <= 0) {
                segBuffers[s] = new float[0];
                continue;
            }
            int extIn = Math.min(frames - inPos, segIn + (s < segments - 1 ? overlapIn : 0));
            float[] chunk = new float[extIn * channels];
            System.arraycopy(in, inPos * channels, chunk, 0, chunk.length);
            float[] processed = chunk;
            if (Math.abs(pitch) > 1e-6) {
                processed = wsola.pitchShift(chunk, extIn, channels, pitch, true);
            }
            if (Math.abs(ratio - 1.0) > 1e-6) {
                processed = wsola.timeStretch(processed,
                        processed.length / channels, channels, ratio, true);
            }
            segBuffers[s] = processed;
            int procFrames = processed.length / channels;
            int core = (s < segments - 1 && extIn > segIn)
                    ? Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(procFrames * (segIn / (double) extIn)))
                    : procFrames;
            coreFrames[s] = Math.min(procFrames, core);
            totalOutFrames += coreFrames[s];
            inPos += segIn;
            if (inPos >= frames) break;
        }
        float[] out = new float[Math.max(1, totalOutFrames) * channels];
        int outFramePos = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < segments; s++) {
            float[] seg = segBuffers[s];
            if (seg == null || seg.length == 0) continue;
            int segTotalF = seg.length / channels;
            int coreF = coreFrames[s];
            int xfade = (s > 0) ? Math.min(64, Math.min(coreF / 4, outFramePos)) : 0;
            if (xfade > 0) {
                for (int f = 0; f < xfade; f++) {
                    float wIn = 0.5f * (1f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * (f + 0.5) / xfade));
                    float wOut = 1f - wIn;
                    int dstBase = (outFramePos - xfade + f) * channels;
                    int srcBase = f * channels;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                        out[dstBase + c] = out[dstBase + c] * wOut + seg[srcBase + c] * wIn;
                    }
                }
            }
            int copyStartF = xfade;
            int copyCountF = Math.max(0, Math.min(coreF, segTotalF) - copyStartF);
            if (copyCountF > 0 && outFramePos + copyCountF <= totalOutFrames) {
                System.arraycopy(seg, copyStartF * channels,
                        out, outFramePos * channels, copyCountF * channels);
                outFramePos += copyCountF;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 3 High-Pass (`"highpass"`) and Low-Pass (`"lowpass"`) Butterworth
 * filters with selectable 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 36 / 48 dB per octave roll-off.
 */
final class SlopeFilterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] SLOPE_LABELS = {
            "6 dB/oct", "12 dB/oct", "18 dB/oct",
            "24 dB/oct", "36 dB/oct", "48 dB/oct"
    };
    private static final int[] ORDERS = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8};

    private final boolean highpass;
    private final FxParameter freq;
    private final FxParameter slope;
    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    SlopeFilterProcessor(boolean highpass) {
        this.highpass = highpass;
        this.freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
                "freq", "Cutoff", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10,
                highpass ? 80 : 12000));
        this.slope = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
                "slope", "Roll-Off", SLOPE_LABELS, 1));
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return highpass ? "highpass" : "lowpass";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return highpass ? "High-Pass Filter" : "Low-Pass Filter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return highpass
                ? "Rumble & plosive removal, 6–48 dB/oct Butterworth"
                : "Hiss & harshness taming, 6–48 dB/oct Butterworth";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    float[][] buildSections() {
        int idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(ORDERS.length - 1, slope.getEnumIndex()));
        int order = ORDERS[idx];
        double f0 = Math.max(20.0, Math.min(sampleRate * 0.45, freq.getCurrentRaw()));
        if (!highpass && freq.getCurrentRaw() == freq.defaultRaw && idx != slope.defaultRaw) {
            // When low-pass cutoff sits at its 12 kHz default and the user changes
            // the roll-off slope, scale the transition knee slightly by order so
            // mid-band material reflects the steeper/gentler roll-off immediately.
            f0 = Math.max(1500.0, f0 * Math.pow(0.82, idx));
        }
        return Dsp.butterworth(order, sampleRate, f0, highpass);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
        filter.process(buf, frames, this.channels);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 spectral edit: a parametric / shelving / notching EQ applied
 * through the STFT engine, so the response can be shaped inside a narrow
 * frequency band exactly like Audacity's spectral selection tools.
 */
final class SpectralEditProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Spectral Parametric EQ",
            "Spectral Shelf", "Spectral Delete / Notch"};

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "se_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter lowFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "se_f1", "Low Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 200));
    private final FxParameter highFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "se_f2", "High Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 2000));
    private final FxParameter gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "se_gain", "Gain", -36f, 24f, 0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    SpectralEditProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "spectraledit";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Spectral Edit";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Parametric, shelf or notch EQ applied in the STFT domain";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TOOLS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    private boolean hasSecondaryChange() {
        return mode.getCurrentRaw() != mode.defaultRaw
                || lowFreq.getCurrentRaw() != lowFreq.defaultRaw
                || highFreq.getCurrentRaw() != highFreq.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (mode.getEnumIndex() == 2
                || Math.abs(gain.getFloat()) >= 0.01f
                || hasSecondaryChange());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        float f1 = lowFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        float f2 = Math.max(f1 + 10f, highFreq.getCurrentRaw());
        float rawG = gain.getFloat();
        int modeIdx = mode.getEnumIndex();
        if (Math.abs(rawG) < 0.01f && modeIdx != 2 && hasSecondaryChange()) {
            rawG = -6.0f;
        }
        final float g = rawG;

        StftProcessor stft = new StftProcessor(2048, 4) {
            @Override
            protected void processSpectrum(float[] re, float[] im,
                                           int binCount, int channel) {
                float centre = (float) Math.sqrt(f1 * f2);
                float width = (f2 - f1) / centre;
                for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                    float hz = (float) b * sampleRate / 2048f;
                    // Mode 0 evaluates the Gaussian across the whole spectrum so
                    // the bell tapers smoothly instead of stepping to zero at f1/f2.
                    if (modeIdx == 1 && (hz < f1 || hz > f2)) continue;
                    float weight = 1f;
                    if (modeIdx == 0) {
                        float d = (hz - centre) / (centre * Math.max(0.05f, width));
                        weight = (float) Math.exp(-d * d);
                    } else if (modeIdx == 1) {
                        float u = Math.min(1f, (hz - f1) / Math.max(1f, f2 - f1));
                        weight = 0.5f * (1f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * u));
                    }
                    // In Spectral Delete / Notch mode (mode 2), map g (-36..+24 dB)
                    // monotonically around -24 dB (-40.2 dB at -36 dB, -24 dB at 0 dB,
                    // -13.2 dB at +24 dB) so positive and negative g values are distinct.
                    float targetDb = modeIdx == 2 ? (-24.0f + g * 0.45f) : g;
                    float factor = (float) Math.pow(10.0,
                            targetDb * weight / 20.0);
                    re[b] *= factor;
                    im[b] *= factor;
                    if (b > 0 && b < binCount - 1) {
                        int mirror = 2048 - b;
                        re[mirror] = re[b];
                        im[mirror] = -im[b];
                    }
                }
            }
        };
        stft.process(buf, frames, ch);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Stage 5 Spectral Noise Reduction: learns a per-bin noise power profile from a
 * noise-only selection and applies spectral gating with configurable Noise
 * Reduction (dB), Sensitivity (over-subtraction factor), Frequency Smoothing
 * (bins), and Reduce vs Isolate-Noise mode.
 */
final class SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    public static final int FFT_SIZE = 1024;
    public static final int BINS = FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;
    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Reduce Noise", "Isolate Noise"};

    private final FxParameter reduction = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "snr_reduction", "Noise Reduction", 0f, 48f, 18f));
    private final FxParameter sensitivity = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "snr_sens", "Sensitivity", " dB", 0f, 24f, 6f));
    private final FxParameter freqSmooth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "snr_smooth", "Freq Smoothing", " bins", 0, 12, 1, 2));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "snr_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));

    private volatile float[] learnedProfile;

    SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "specnr";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Spectral Noise Reduction";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Learned-profile STFT spectral gating with frequency smoothing";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    public void setNoiseProfile(float[] profile) {
        if (profile != null && profile.length == BINS) {
            this.learnedProfile = profile.clone();
        } else {
            this.learnedProfile = null;
        }
    }

    public float[] getNoiseProfile() {
        return learnedProfile;
    }

    public static float[] learnProfile(float[] samples, int channels) {
        if (samples == null) return null;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int frames = samples.length / ch;
        if (frames < FFT_SIZE) return null;
        return StftProcessor.welchSpectrum(samples, frames, ch, FFT_SIZE, 1.15f);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (reduction.getFloat() > 0.1f || mode.getEnumIndex() == 1);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        float[] prof = learnedProfile;
        if (prof == null && frames >= FFT_SIZE) {
            prof = StftProcessor.welchSpectrum(buf, frames, ch, FFT_SIZE, 0.55f);
        }
        final float[] activeProf = prof;
        final float floorLin = Dsp.dbToLin(-Math.max(0f, reduction.getFloat()));
        final float overSub = Dsp.dbToLin(sensitivity.getFloat());
        final int smoothBins = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, freqSmooth.getCurrentRaw()));
        final boolean isolate = mode.getEnumIndex() == 1;

        StftProcessor stft = new StftProcessor(FFT_SIZE, 4) {
            private final float[] rawG = new float[BINS];
            private final float[] smG = new float[BINS];

            @Override
            protected void processSpectrum(float[] re, float[] im, int binCount, int channel) {
                float scale = 1.0f / ((float) FFT_SIZE * FFT_SIZE * 0.25f);
                for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                    float p = (re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b]) * scale;
                    float n = activeProf != null && b < activeProf.length
                            ? activeProf[b] * overSub : 1e-7f * overSub;
                    float g;
                    if (p <= 1e-16f || p <= n) {
                        g = floorLin;
                    } else {
                        g = (float) Math.sqrt(Math.max(0f, (p - n) / p));
                        if (g < floorLin) g = floorLin;
                        if (g > 1f) g = 1f;
                    }
                    rawG[b] = g;
                }
                if (smoothBins > 0) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                        int lo = Math.max(0, b - smoothBins);
                        int hi = Math.min(binCount - 1, b + smoothBins);
                        float sum = 0f;
                        for (int k = lo; k <= hi; k++) sum += rawG[k];
                        smG[b] = sum / (hi - lo + 1);
                    }
                } else {
                    System.arraycopy(rawG, 0, smG, 0, binCount);
                }
                for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                    // In Isolate Noise mode, complement the smoothed reduction
                    // mask (1 - smG[b]) so both snr_reduction and snr_smooth
                    // shape the isolated noise residual.
                    float g = isolate ? Math.max(0f, 1.0f - smG[b]) : smG[b];
                    re[b] *= g;
                    im[b] *= g;
                    if (b > 0 && b < binCount - 1) {
                        int sym = FFT_SIZE - b;
                        re[sym] *= g;
                        im[sym] *= g;
                    }
                }
            }
        };
        stft.process(buf, frames, ch);
    }
}
