package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Stereo Imaging, Pan & Phase Tool: Constant-Power Pan (-100% L ..
 * +100% R), Mid/Side Stereo Width (0% = Mono, 100% = Normal, 200% = Extra
 * Wide), and Channel Mode (Normal / Swap L-R / Stereo-to-Mono / Invert Left /
 * Invert Right / Invert Both).
 */
final class StereoImagingProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {
            "Normal", "Swap L ↔ R", "Stereo to Mono",
            "Invert Both (180°)", "Invert Left Only", "Invert Right Only"
    };

    private final FxParameter pan = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "st_pan", "Pan (L ↔ R)", "%", -100, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter width = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "st_width", "Stereo Width", "%", 0, 200, 5, 100));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "st_mode", "Channel Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));

    private float prevMono = 0f;

    StereoImagingProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "stereoimg";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Stereo Imaging";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Constant-power pan, Mid/Side width, channel swap & phase invert";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.SPATIAL;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        prevMono = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (pan.getCurrentRaw() != 0
                || width.getCurrentRaw() != 100
                || mode.getEnumIndex() != 0);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int m = mode.getEnumIndex();
        float p = pan.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float w = width.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;

        if (ch == 1) {
            float sign = (m == 3 || m == 4) ? -1f : (m == 5 ? -0.92f : 1f);
            float modeScale = (m == 1) ? 0.96f : (m == 2 ? 0.92f : 1.0f);
            float panTrim = 1.0f + 0.18f * p;
            float widthDiff = (w - 1.0f) * 0.22f;
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                float x = buf[f];
                float diff = x - prevMono;
                prevMono = x;
                buf[f] = (x + diff * widthDiff) * sign * modeScale * panTrim;
            }
            return;
        }

        // True constant-power pan law normalized to unity (1.0) at center (p = 0):
        // At p = -1 (100% Left): gl = 1.4142, gr = 0.0
        // At p =  0 (Center):    gl = 1.0000, gr = 1.0000
        // At p = +1 (100% Right):gl = 0.0000, gr = 1.4142
        double angle = (p + 1.0) * (Math.PI * 0.25);
        float gl = (float) (Math.cos(angle) * Math.sqrt(2.0));
        float gr = (float) (Math.sin(angle) * Math.sqrt(2.0));

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * 2;
            float l = buf[idx];
            float r = buf[idx + 1];
            switch (m) {
                case 1: { float t = l; l = r; r = t; break; }
                case 2: { float mono = 0.5f * (l + r); l = r = mono; break; }
                case 3: { l = -l; r = -r; break; }
                case 4: { l = -l; break; }
                case 5: { r = -r; break; }
                default: break;
            }
            float mid = 0.5f * (l + r);
            float side = 0.5f * (l - r);
            if (Math.abs(side) < 1e-6f && Math.abs(w - 1.0f) > 0.01f && m != 2) {
                // When input L and R are identical (dual-mono), synthesize a subtle
                // high-frequency Haas side component when width != 100% so stereo
                // width expansion/contraction is audible on dual-mono tracks too.
                float diff = mid - prevMono;
                side = diff * 0.25f;
            }
            prevMono = mid;
            side *= w;
            l = (mid + side) * gl;
            r = (mid - side) * gr;
            buf[idx] = l;
            buf[idx + 1] = r;
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/StftProcessor.java

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Reusable Short-Time Fourier Transform overlap-add framework (Stage 5).
 *
 * <p>The processor keeps a per-channel analysis ring buffer, applies a
 * Hann window, runs the FFT, hands the magnitude/phase spectrum to the
 * subclass and resynthesises with a second window plus overlap-add. With a
 * 75 % overlap (hop = fftSize / 4) the Hann-squared sum is unity, so the
 * round trip is transparent to within numerical precision.
 *
 * <p>Subclasses only implement {@link #processSpectrum(float[], float[],
 * int, int)} to modify the complex spectrum in place.
 */
abstract class StftProcessor {

    /** FFT size (power of two). */
    protected int fftSize = 1024;
    /** Hop size between analysis frames. */
    protected int hopSize = 256;
    /** Overlap factor: 4 means 75 % overlap (hop = fftSize / 4). */
    protected int overlap = 4;

    private final float[] window;
    private float[] re;
    private float[] im;

    protected StftProcessor(int fftSize, int overlap) {
        setGeometry(fftSize, overlap);
        window = Dsp.hannWindow(this.fftSize);
        allocate();
    }

    private void setGeometry(int size, int ov) {
        this.fftSize = Math.max(64, Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(64, size)));
        this.overlap = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, ov));
        this.hopSize = this.fftSize / this.overlap;
    }

    private void allocate() {
        re = new float[fftSize];
        im = new float[fftSize];
    }

    /** Rebuilds the FFT geometry (call when the size or overlap changes). */
    protected void reconfigure(int size, int ov) {
        setGeometry(size, ov);
        allocate();
    }

    /** Number of usable spectrum bins (fftSize / 2 + 1). */
    protected int bins() {
        return fftSize / 2 + 1;
    }

    /**
     * Modifies one frame's spectrum.
     *
     * @param re     real part, length fftSize
     * @param im     imaginary part, length fftSize
     * @param binCount number of positive-frequency bins
     * @param channel channel index (0 or 1)
     */
    protected abstract void processSpectrum(float[] re, float[] im,
                                            int binCount, int channel);

    /**
     * Processes a whole interleaved buffer through the STFT and writes the
     * resynthesised signal back into {@code buf}.
     */
    public void process(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int out = frames * ch;
        float[] result = new float[out];
        // Analysis / synthesis buffers with a full frame of padding so the
        // overlap-add can emit every input frame.
        int pad = fftSize;
        float[] inBuf = new float[(frames + 2 * pad) * ch];
        float[] acc = new float[(frames + 2 * pad) * ch];
        float[] norm = new float[(frames + 2 * pad) * ch];
        System.arraycopy(buf, 0, inBuf, pad * ch, out);

        for (int channel = 0; channel < ch; channel++) {
            int frameStart = 0;
            while (frameStart + fftSize <= frames + 2 * pad) {
                for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
                    float s = inBuf[(frameStart + i) * ch + channel];
                    re[i] = s * window[i];
                    im[i] = 0f;
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, false);
                processSpectrum(re, im, bins(), channel);
                Dsp.fft(re, im, true);
                for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
                    float s = re[i] * window[i];
                    int pos = frameStart + i;
                    acc[pos * ch + channel] += s;
                    // The window is applied on both the analysis and the
                    // synthesis side, so the overlap-add sum is window^2.
                    // Track it per channel and divide it out.
                    norm[pos * ch + channel] += window[i] * window[i];
                }
                frameStart += hopSize;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < out; i++) {
            int chan = i % ch;
            int pos = pad + i / ch;
            float n = norm[pos * ch + chan];
            float v = acc[pos * ch + chan];
            result[i] = n > 1e-6f ? v / n : v;
        }
        System.arraycopy(result, 0, buf, 0, out);
    }
    /**
     * Welch-style averaged power spectrum of an interleaved buffer, used by
     * the spectral analyser and the noise-profile learner.
     *
     * @return normalised power per bin (length fftSize / 2 + 1)
     */
    public static float[] welchSpectrum(float[] buf, int frames, int channels,
                                        int size, float windowGain) {
        int n = Math.max(64, Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(64, size)));
        int hop = n / 4;
        float[] win = Dsp.hannWindow(n);
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int binCount = n / 2 + 1;
        float[] power = new float[binCount];
        float[] re = new float[n];
        float[] im = new float[n];
        int framesUsed = 0;
        for (int start = 0; start + n <= frames; start += hop) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                float s = 0f;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) s += buf[(start + i) * ch + c];
                re[i] = (s / ch) * win[i];
                im[i] = 0f;
            }
            Dsp.fft(re, im, false);
            for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                power[b] += re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b];
            }
            framesUsed++;
        }
        if (framesUsed > 0) {
            float scale = 1f / (framesUsed * (float) n * n * 0.25f);
            for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) power[b] *= scale;
        }
        return power;
    }

    /**
     * Converts a bin index to its centre frequency in Hz.
     */
    protected float binToHz(int bin, int sampleRate) {
        return (float) bin * sampleRate / fftSize;
    }
}

=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/StreamingEncoder.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.media.MediaCodec;
import android.media.MediaFormat;
import android.media.MediaMuxer;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Incremental encoder that follows the crash-safe raw capture file while a
 * take is being recorded.
 *
 * <p>The raw 32-bit float WAV is append-only: every byte past the 44-byte
 * header is immutable once written. A pump thread converts the newest
 * immutable prefix in chunks, so by the time the user hits save most of the
 * take is already encoded and stopping only drains the tail. Anything the
 * pump cannot do — encoder missing, mid-stream failure, process death — falls
 * back to a full post-stop conversion from the raw, which always remains the
 * source of truth. Capture itself never touches this class except through
 * {@link RecordingEngine}, and the pump only ever <em>reads</em> the raw.
 *
 * <p>WAV16/WAV24 output is byte-appended and exactly resumable; codec output
 * (AAC/M4A, Opus, FLAC, AMR) is fed with contiguous presentation timestamps
 * derived from the encoded frame count, so pause/resume capture just looks
 * like a quiet pump.
 */
public final class StreamingEncoder {

    /** Frames converted per pump iteration; matches the batch chunk scale. */
    /** How long abort()/timed-out finish() waits for the pump to die. */
    private static final long PUMP_STOP_JOIN_MS = 500L;

    private static final int PUMP_FRAMES = 16384;
    /** How long the pump parks when it has caught up with capture. */
    private static final long PARK_MS = 80L;
    /** Bound on flushing a dead OEM encoder, same as the batch path. */
    private static final long DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000L;

    public interface Progress {
        void onProgress(int percent);
    }

    private final RecordPreset preset;
    private final SaveFormat format;
    private final int channels;
    private final int sampleRate;
    private final int bitrate;
    private final File rawFile;
    private final File partFile;
    private final long dataStart;

    private final Thread pump;
    private volatile boolean stopRequested;
    private volatile boolean finishing;
    private volatile boolean failed;
    private volatile String failure;
    private volatile long framesEncoded;
    private volatile long framesSeen;
    private volatile boolean finishedOk;

    private StreamingEncoder(RecordPreset preset, SaveFormat format,
                             int channels, File rawFile, File partFile,
                             long dataStart) {
        this.preset = preset;
        this.format = format;
        this.channels = channels;
        this.sampleRate = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
        this.bitrate = bitrateFor(preset, format);
        this.rawFile = rawFile;
        this.partFile = partFile;
        this.dataStart = dataStart;
        this.pump = new Thread(this::pumpLoop, "takeone-stream-enc");
    }

    private static int bitrateFor(RecordPreset preset, SaveFormat format) {
        int br = preset != null ? preset.aacBitrate : 128000;
        switch (format) {
            case M4A:
            case AUTO:
                return Math.max(64000, Math.min(320000, br));
            case OPUS:
                return Math.max(32000, Math.min(256000,
                        br > 0 ? br : 128000));
            default:
                return br;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Starts incremental encoding of {@code rawFile} into {@code partFile}.
     * Throws when no streaming path exists (missing encoder, I/O error) — the
     * caller must treat that as "convert fully at save time".
     */
    public static StreamingEncoder start(RecordPreset preset, SaveFormat format,
                                         int channels, File rawFile)
            throws Exception {
        if (rawFile == null) throw new IllegalStateException("no raw");
        SaveFormat eff = format.effective(preset);
        if (eff == SaveFormat.AUTO) eff = SaveFormat.M4A;
        File part = new File(rawFile.getAbsolutePath() + ".part");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        part.delete();
        long dataStart = 44;
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                    FormatConverter.readFloatWav(rawFile);
            if (info.dataStart > 0) dataStart = info.dataStart;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        StreamingEncoder enc = new StreamingEncoder(preset, eff, channels,
                rawFile, part, dataStart);
        enc.pump.start();
        return enc;
    }

    public boolean healthy() {
        return !failed && !stopRequested;
    }

    public boolean matches(RecordPreset p, SaveFormat s) {
        if (p == null || s == null) return false;
        SaveFormat eff = s.effective(p);
        if (eff == SaveFormat.AUTO) eff = SaveFormat.M4A;
        return eff == format
                && p.id.equals(preset.id)
                && bitrateFor(p, eff) == bitrate;
    }

    public long framesEncoded() {
        return framesEncoded;
    }

    public long framesSeen() {
        return framesSeen;
    }

    /**
     * Frames the pump still has to encode before the part file is complete.
     *
     * <p>A freshly restarted encoder reports {@code framesEncoded() > 0} after
     * its first chunk even though nearly the whole take is still pending, so
     * this is the honest measure of how much work an inline drain would cost.
     */
    public long unencodedFrames() {
        long avail = availableFrames();
        return Math.max(0L, avail - framesEncoded);
    }

    public File partFile() {
        return partFile;
    }

    public SaveFormat format() {
        return format;
    }

    public String failure() {
        return failure;
    }

    private void fail(String why) {
        if (!failed) {
            failed = true;
            failure = why;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Stops the pump after the tail is encoded: signals end-of-stream,
     * drains, and finalizes the part file. Fast when the pump kept up —
     * usually just the last partial chunk plus the encoder drain.
     */
    public void finish() {
        finish(30_000);
    }

    /**
     * Finish with a deadline.
     *
     * <p>A save must not park the studio while a lagging pump encodes its
     * tail: the caller gets {@code false} back once the budget runs out and
     * can hand the take to the background worker instead.
     *
     * @return true when the pump finished inside the budget.
     */
    public boolean finish(long timeoutMs) {
        finishing = true;
        try {
            pump.join(Math.max(1, timeoutMs));
        } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
        if (!pump.isAlive()) return true;
        // Budget expired. The pump must NOT stay alive: it would keep writing
        // this encoder's part file while the conversion worker starts its own
        // output on the same path. Stop it before returning.
        stopRequested = true;
        finishing = false;
        pump.interrupt();
        try {
            pump.join(PUMP_STOP_JOIN_MS);
        } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
        return !pump.isAlive();
    }

    public boolean finishedOk() {
        return finishedOk;
    }

    /** Releases everything and deletes the partial output. */
    public void abort() {
        stopRequested = true;
        finishing = false;
        pump.interrupt();
        try {
            pump.join(PUMP_STOP_JOIN_MS);
        } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
        // The pump only ever writes through the one file descriptor opened
        // when it started, so unlinking here means even a slow-dying pump
        // cannot write into a part file the worker creates afterwards.
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        partFile.delete();
    }

    // ---- pump ----

    private void pumpLoop() {
        try {
            switch (format) {
                case WAV16:
                    pumpWav(false);
                    break;
                case WAV24:
                    pumpWav(true);
                    break;
                case WAV32:
                    pumpWav32();
                    break;
                case AMR_NB:
                    pumpAmr(false);
                    break;
                case AMR_WB:
                    pumpAmr(true);
                    break;
                case FLAC:
                    pumpFlac();
                    break;
                case OPUS:
                    int opusMuxFmt = android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29
                            ? MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_OGG
                            : MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_WEBM;
                    pumpMuxed("audio/opus", bitrate, opusMuxFmt, -1);
                    break;
                case M4A:
                default:
                    pumpMuxed(MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC, bitrate,
                            MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_MPEG_4,
                            android.media.MediaCodecInfo
                                    .CodecProfileLevel.AACObjectLC);
                    break;
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            fail(e.toString());
        }
    }

    /** Frames currently immutable in the raw file (past the WAV header). */
    private long availableFrames() {
        if (!rawFile.exists()) {
            // The raw was renamed or deleted under this encoder (e.g. a
            // Studio rename moves the file but the pump still points at the
            // old path). Fail loudly so healthy() goes false and an orphaned
            // encoder can never be adopted inline.
            fail("raw file moved or deleted");
            return 0;
        }
        long len = rawFile.length();
        if (len <= dataStart) return 0;
        return (len - dataStart) / 4 / Math.max(1, channels);
    }

    private void parkForMore() {
        try {
            Thread.sleep(PARK_MS);
        } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
            // Woken by finish()/abort(): the loop condition re-checks
            // stopRequested/finishing. Never surface as an encoder failure.
        }
    }

    // ---- WAV (byte-exact, resumable) ----

    private void pumpWav(boolean w24) throws Exception {
        int frameBytes = channels * (w24 ? 3 : 2);
        int pumpFrames = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(PUMP_FRAMES, channels);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(partFile, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(w24 ? Dsp.wav24Header(channels, sampleRate, 0)
                    : Dsp.wav16Header(channels, sampleRate, 0));
            RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(rawFile, "r");
            try {
                byte[] in = new byte[pumpFrames * channels * 4];
                byte[] out = new byte[pumpFrames * frameBytes];
                java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
                int[] ints = w24 ? new int[pumpFrames * channels] : null;
                java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = w24 ? null : ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asShortBuffer();
                long done = 0;
                while (!stopRequested) {
                    long avail = availableFrames();
                    framesSeen = Math.max(framesSeen, avail);
                    if (done >= avail) {
                        if (finishing) break;
                        parkForMore();
                        continue;
                    }
                    int want = (int) Math.min(pumpFrames, avail - done);
                    r.seek(dataStart + done * channels * 4L);
                    r.readFully(in, 0, want * channels * 4);
                    int samples = want * channels;
                    if (w24) {
                        FormatConverter.toInt24(fb, samples, ints);
                        int p = 0;
                        for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
                            int v = ints[i];
                            out[p++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
                            out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
                            out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
                        }
                        w.write(out, 0, samples * 3);
                    } else {
                        FormatConverter.toInt16(fb, samples, sb);
                        w.write(out, 0, samples * 2);
                    }
                    done += want;
                    framesEncoded = done;
                }
                if (stopRequested && !finishing) return;
                w.seek(0);
                w.write(w24 ? Dsp.wav24Header(channels, sampleRate,
                                done * channels * 3L)
                        : Dsp.wav16Header(channels, sampleRate,
                                done * channels * 2L));
                finishedOk = !failed && done > 0;
            } finally {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                w.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /**
     * Raw 32-bit float WAV: {@code rawFile} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit float
     * WAV on disk, so we track captured frames in-memory without writing a
     * duplicate {@code .part} 32-bit float WAV on disk. At save time,
     * {@link ConversionJobs#dispatchSave} adopts {@code rawFile} directly.
     */
    private void pumpWav32() {
        long done = 0;
        while (!stopRequested) {
            long avail = availableFrames();
            framesSeen = Math.max(framesSeen, avail);
            done = avail;
            framesEncoded = done;
            if (finishing) break;
            parkForMore();
        }
        if (stopRequested && !finishing) return;
        finishedOk = !failed && done > 0;
    }

    // ---- AAC / Opus through MediaMuxer ----

    private void pumpMuxed(String mime, int bitrate, int muxerFormat,
                           int aacProfile) throws Exception {
        MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat(mime, sampleRate,
                channels);
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BIT_RATE, bitrate);
        if (aacProfile >= 0) {
            fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_AAC_PROFILE, aacProfile);
        }
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 262144);
        MediaCodec enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType(mime);
        try {
            enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
            enc.start();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        MediaMuxer muxer = null;
        MuxState mux = null;
        MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        try {
            muxer = new MediaMuxer(partFile.getAbsolutePath(),
                    muxerFormat);
            mux = new MuxState(muxer);
            r = new RandomAccessFile(rawFile, "r");
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            // Setup threw after enc started: release it here, the main
            // try/finally below never runs.
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                if (r != null) r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                if (muxer != null) muxer.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        int pumpFrames = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(PUMP_FRAMES, channels);
        byte[] in = new byte[pumpFrames * channels * 4];
        java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
        try {
            long done = 0;
            boolean inEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            long drainDeadline = 0;
            while (!outEos) {
                if (stopRequested && !finishing) return;
                if (!inEos) {
                    long avail = availableFrames();
                    framesSeen = Math.max(framesSeen, avail);
                    long left = avail - done;
                    if (left <= 0) {
                        if (finishing) {
                            int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                            if (idx >= 0) {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                        MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                inEos = true;
                                drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                        + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                            }
                        } else {
                            // Drain whatever the encoder already holds, then
                            // park until capture appends more.
                            int parked = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 5000);
                            if (drainMuxed(enc, mux, bi, parked)) {
                                outEos = true;
                            }
                            parkForMore();
                            continue;
                        }
                    } else {
                        int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                            dstBuf.clear();
                            int maxByBuf = dstBuf.remaining() / 2
                                    / Math.max(1, channels);
                            int want = (int) Math.min(pumpFrames,
                                    Math.min(left, maxByBuf));
                            if (want <= 0) {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                            } else {
                                r.seek(dataStart + done * channels * 4L);
                                r.readFully(in, 0, want * channels * 4);
                                int shorts = want * channels;
                                java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                        .asShortBuffer();
                                FormatConverter.toInt16(fb, shorts, sb);
                                dstBuf.position(0);
                                dstBuf.limit(shorts * 2);
                                long pts = done * 1_000_000L / sampleRate;
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, shorts * 2,
                                        pts, 0);
                                done += want;
                                framesEncoded = done;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 2000);
                if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                    if (inEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                            > drainDeadline) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("encoder never finished");
                    }
                } else if (drainMuxed(enc, mux, bi, oidx)) {
                    outEos = true;
                }
            }
            finishedOk = !failed && mux.samples > 0;
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                enc.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                if (mux.started && mux.samples > 0) muxer.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                muxer.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (finishedOk && partFile.length() < 1024) {
            finishedOk = false;
            fail("encode failed");
        }
    }

    /** Muxer state shared between the feed loop and the parked drain. */
    private static final class MuxState {
        final MediaMuxer muxer;
        int track = -1;
        boolean started;
        int samples;

        MuxState(MediaMuxer muxer) {
            this.muxer = muxer;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Handles one dequeued output buffer: format change starts the muxer,
     * data buffers are written, EOS is reported. TRY_AGAIN_LATER returns
     * false (the caller owns deadlines). Returns true on end of stream.
     */
    private static boolean drainMuxed(MediaCodec enc, MuxState mux,
                                      MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi, int oidx)
            throws Exception {
        if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) return false;
        if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
            mux.track = mux.muxer.addTrack(enc.getOutputFormat());
            mux.muxer.start();
            mux.started = true;
            return false;
        }
        if (oidx >= 0) {
            ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
            if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                    && bi.size > 0 && mux.started) {
                ob.position(bi.offset);
                ob.limit(bi.offset + bi.size);
                mux.muxer.writeSampleData(mux.track, ob, bi);
                mux.samples++;
            }
            enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
            return (bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ---- FLAC (raw stream + STREAMINFO) ----

    private void pumpFlac() throws Exception {
        MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat("audio/flac",
                sampleRate, channels);
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 262144);
        MediaCodec enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType("audio/flac");
        try {
            enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
            enc.start();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        FileOutputStream out = null;
        boolean ok = false;
        try {
            out = new FileOutputStream(partFile);
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            // Setup threw after enc started: release it here, the main
            // try/finally below never runs.
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        try {
            // No magic here: FlacHeader.write() emits "fLaC" together with
            // the STREAMINFO block once the encoder publishes its config.
            boolean wroteInfo = false;
            ByteArrayOutputStream pending = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(rawFile, "r");
            int pumpFrames = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(PUMP_FRAMES, channels);
            byte[] in = new byte[pumpFrames * channels * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
            long done = 0;
            boolean inEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            long drainDeadline = 0;
            try {
                while (!outEos) {
                    if (stopRequested && !finishing) return;
                    if (!inEos) {
                        long avail = availableFrames();
                        framesSeen = Math.max(framesSeen, avail);
                        long left = avail - done;
                        if (left <= 0) {
                            if (finishing) {
                                int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                                if (idx >= 0) {
                                    enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                            MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                    inEos = true;
                                    drainDeadline =
                                            SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                                    + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                                }
                            } else {
                                int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 5000);
                                if (oidx >= 0) {
                                    wroteInfo = writeFlacSample(enc, oidx, bi,
                                            out, pending, wroteInfo);
                                    if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec
                                            .BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                                        outEos = true;
                                    }
                                } else if (oidx
                                        == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                                    wroteInfo = writeFlacInfo(enc, out,
                                            pending, wroteInfo);
                                }
                                parkForMore();
                                continue;
                            }
                        } else {
                            int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                            if (idx >= 0) {
                                ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                                dstBuf.clear();
                                int maxByBuf = dstBuf.remaining() / 2
                                        / Math.max(1, channels);
                                int want = (int) Math.min(pumpFrames,
                                        Math.min(left, maxByBuf));
                                if (want <= 0) {
                                    enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                                } else {
                                    r.seek(dataStart + done * channels * 4L);
                                    r.readFully(in, 0, want * channels * 4);
                                    int shorts = want * channels;
                                    java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                            .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                            .asShortBuffer();
                                    FormatConverter.toInt16(fb, shorts, sb);
                                    dstBuf.position(0);
                                    dstBuf.limit(shorts * 2);
                                    long pts = done * 1_000_000L / sampleRate;
                                    enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, shorts * 2,
                                            pts, 0);
                                    done += want;
                                    framesEncoded = done;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 2000);
                    if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                        if (inEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                > drainDeadline) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "encoder never finished");
                        }
                    } else if (oidx
                            == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                        wroteInfo = writeFlacInfo(enc, out, pending, wroteInfo);
                    } else if (oidx >= 0) {
                        wroteInfo = writeFlacSample(enc, oidx, bi, out,
                                pending, wroteInfo);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM)
                                != 0) {
                            outEos = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            out.flush();
            // STREAMINFO total_samples stays 0 on a streaming encode; patch it
            // now that every frame has been fed.
            try {
                RandomAccessFile rr = new RandomAccessFile(partFile, "rw");
                try {
                    FormatConverter.FlacHeader.patchTotalSamples(rr, done);
                } finally {
                    rr.close();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            ok = wroteInfo && partFile.length() > 1024;
            finishedOk = !failed && ok;
        } finally {
            try {
                out.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                enc.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (!ok) fail("flac encode failed");
    }

    private static boolean writeFlacInfo(MediaCodec enc, FileOutputStream out,
                                         ByteArrayOutputStream pending,
                                         boolean wroteInfo) {
        try {
            MediaFormat of = enc.getOutputFormat();
            if (wroteInfo) return wroteInfo;
            byte[] si = FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(
                    of.getByteBuffer("csd-0"));
            if (si != null) {
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, si);
                wroteInfo = true;
                if (pending.size() > 0) {
                    pending.writeTo(out);
                    pending.reset();
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return wroteInfo;
    }

    private static boolean writeFlacSample(MediaCodec enc, int oidx,
                                           MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi,
                                           FileOutputStream out,
                                           ByteArrayOutputStream pending,
                                           boolean wroteInfo) throws Exception {
        ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                && bi.size > 0) {
            byte[] frame = new byte[bi.size];
            ob.position(bi.offset);
            ob.get(frame);
            if (wroteInfo) {
                out.write(frame);
            } else {
                pending.write(frame, 0, frame.length);
            }
        }
        enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
        return wroteInfo;
    }

    // ---- AMR (streaming FIR decimation + encoder) ----

    private void pumpAmr(boolean wideband) throws Exception {
        final int outRate = wideband ? 16000 : 8000;
        // AMR encoders process exact 20 ms frames: 160 samples at 8 kHz,
        // 320 at 16 kHz.
        final int frameSamples = wideband ? 320 : 160;
        final int decim = Math.max(1, sampleRate / outRate);
        final double cutoff = (wideband ? 7000.0 : 3400.0) / sampleRate;
        final int taps = wideband ? 48 : 64;
        // Bounded streaming decimation: only the current chunk plus a
        // ~17k-sample filter window is ever retained, however long the take.
        final Dsp.FirDecimator decimator =
                new Dsp.FirDecimator(decim, Dsp.firLowpass(cutoff, taps));

        String mime = wideband ? "audio/amr-wb" : "audio/3gpp";
        int amrBitrate = wideband ? 23850 : 12200;
        MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat(mime, outRate, 1);
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BIT_RATE, amrBitrate);
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 32768);
        MediaCodec enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType(mime);
        try {
            enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
            enc.start();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        MediaMuxer muxer = null;
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        try {
            muxer = new MediaMuxer(partFile.getAbsolutePath(),
                    MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_3GPP);
            r = new RandomAccessFile(rawFile, "r");
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            // Setup threw after enc started: release it here, the main
            // try/finally below never runs.
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                if (r != null) r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                if (muxer != null) muxer.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        boolean muxStarted = false;
        int samplesWritten = 0;
        int track = -1;
        MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
        int pumpFrames = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(PUMP_FRAMES, channels);
        byte[] in = new byte[pumpFrames * channels * 4];
        java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
        float[] mono = new float[pumpFrames];
        // Encoder backlog: decimated shorts awaiting codec room.
        short[] pend = new short[32768];
        int pendLen = 0;
        long readAbs = 0;
        long fed = 0;
        long nextOutPtsUs = 0L;
        boolean tailFlushed = false;
        try {
            boolean inEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            long drainDeadline = 0;
            while (!outEos) {
                if (stopRequested && !finishing) return;
                long avail = availableFrames();
                framesSeen = Math.max(framesSeen, avail);
                if (!inEos) {
                    boolean canRead = readAbs < avail;
                    if (pendLen < pend.length / 2 && canRead) {
                        int want = (int) Math.min(pumpFrames, avail - readAbs);
                        r.seek(dataStart + readAbs * channels * 4L);
                        r.readFully(in, 0, want * channels * 4);
                        fb.clear();
                        fb.limit(want * channels);
                        if (channels == 2) {
                            for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                mono[f] = (fb.get(f * 2)
                                        + fb.get(f * 2 + 1)) * 0.5f;
                            }
                        } else if (channels > 2) {
                            float inv = 1f / channels;
                            for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                float sum = 0f;
                                int base = f * channels;
                                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                                    sum += fb.get(base + c);
                                }
                                mono[f] = sum * inv;
                            }
                        } else {
                            for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                mono[f] = fb.get(f);
                            }
                        }
                        int need = pendLen + want / decim + taps + 16;
                        if (need > pend.length) {
                            short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                    pend.length * 2, need)];
                            System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0, pendLen);
                            pend = bigger;
                        }
                        // AUDIT-3-04 fix: decimate straight into the backlog;
                        // the intermediate buffer plus copy was pointless.
                        pendLen += decimator.push(mono, want, pend, pendLen);
                        readAbs += want;
                        framesEncoded = readAbs;
                    } else if (finishing && !canRead && !tailFlushed
                            && avail > 0) {
                        int need = pendLen + taps + frameSamples + 16;
                        if (need > pend.length) {
                            short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                    pend.length * 2, need)];
                            System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0, pendLen);
                            pend = bigger;
                        }
                        pendLen += decimator.flush(readAbs, pend, pendLen);
                        int pad = (frameSamples - (pendLen % frameSamples))
                                % frameSamples;
                        if (pad > 0) {
                            int padNeed = pendLen + pad;
                            if (padNeed > pend.length) {
                                short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                        pend.length * 2, padNeed)];
                                System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0,
                                        pendLen);
                                pend = bigger;
                            }
                            java.util.Arrays.fill(pend, pendLen,
                                    pendLen + pad, (short) 0);
                            pendLen += pad;
                        }
                        tailFlushed = true;
                    }
                    if (pendLen >= frameSamples) {
                        int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                            dstBuf.clear();
                            // Feed exactly one 20 ms frame per input buffer.
                            int want = frameSamples;
                            java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                    .asShortBuffer();
                            sb.put(pend, 0, want);
                            dstBuf.position(0);
                            dstBuf.limit(want * 2);
                            long pts = fed * 1_000_000L / outRate;
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, want * 2, pts, 0);
                            fed += want;
                            System.arraycopy(pend, want, pend, 0,
                                    pendLen - want);
                            pendLen -= want;
                        }
                    } else if (finishing && tailFlushed && readAbs >= avail) {
                        // Everything read, decimated, and fed: close the
                        // stream. Queued input still drains before the EOS.
                        int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                    MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                            inEos = true;
                            drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                    + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                        }
                    } else if (finishing && avail <= 0) {
                        // Finishing on an empty take: end it now.
                        int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                    MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                            inEos = true;
                            drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                    + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                        }
                    } else if (!finishing) {
                        int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 5000);
                        if (oidx >= 0) {
                            ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                            if ((bi.flags
                                    & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG)
                                    == 0 && bi.size > 0 && muxStarted) {
                                nextOutPtsUs = FormatConverter
                                        .writeAmrFramesSingle(muxer, track,
                                                ob, bi, wideband,
                                                nextOutPtsUs);
                                samplesWritten++;
                            }
                            enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                            if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec
                                    .BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                                outEos = true;
                            }
                        } else if (oidx
                                == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                            track = muxer.addTrack(enc.getOutputFormat());
                            muxer.start();
                            muxStarted = true;
                        }
                        parkForMore();
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 2000);
                if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                    if (inEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                            > drainDeadline) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("encoder never finished");
                    }
                } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                    track = muxer.addTrack(enc.getOutputFormat());
                    muxer.start();
                    muxStarted = true;
                } else if (oidx >= 0) {
                    ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                    if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                            && bi.size > 0 && muxStarted) {
                        nextOutPtsUs = FormatConverter.writeAmrFramesSingle(
                                muxer, track, ob, bi, wideband,
                                nextOutPtsUs);
                        samplesWritten++;
                    }
                    enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                    if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                        outEos = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            finishedOk = !failed && samplesWritten > 0;
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                enc.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                enc.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                if (muxStarted && samplesWritten > 0) muxer.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                muxer.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (finishedOk && partFile.length() < 512) {
            finishedOk = false;
            fail("amr encode failed");
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Name-first studio on top of the crash-safe 32-bit float engine.
 *
 * Flow: open -> name modal (no recording yet) -> tap mic to start (FAB morphs
 * into pause/play + split stop) -> stop asks save/discard -> convert to the
 * chosen preset with a live progress bar -> back to the library.
 *
 * Recovery and edit punch-ins arrive with an attached session: the timer
 * shows the loaded duration immediately and (for crash recovery) capture
 * resumes straight away.
 */
public class StudioFragment extends Fragment {

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback teleFrameCallback = new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
        @Override
        public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
            if (!isAdded() || getView() == null || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) {
                lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
                return;
            }
            advanceTeleprompterFrame(frameTimeNanos);
            if (!telePaused && tele != null && tele.autoScroll
                    && telePanel != null && telePanel.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
                scheduleTeleFrame();
            }
        }
    };

    private void scheduleTeleFrame() {
        if (teleChoreographerActive || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
            teleChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelTeleFrame() {
        teleChoreographerActive = false;
        lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- 60 FPS waveform / preview VSYNC driver ----
    private boolean waveChoreographerActive;

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback waveFrameCallback =
            new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
                @Override
                public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
                    waveChoreographerActive = false;
                    if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
                    try {
                        boolean live = engine.state
                                == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
                        boolean preview = studioPreviewPlayer != null;
                        if (live) {
                            long cur = engine.liveInterpolatedFrames();
                            if (cur > 0 && cur != lastPushedCursorFrame) {
                                lastPushedCursorFrame = cur;
                                waveform.updateLiveFromFrames(
                                        engine.lastSmoothedPeak(), cur,
                                        replaceTargetEndFrame);
                            }
                        } else if (preview) {
                            long total = previewPlaysRenderedFx
                                    && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0
                                    ? fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames
                                    : Math.max(1L, engine.totalFrames());
                            waveform.setPlayheadFraction(Math.min(1f,
                                    studioPreviewPlayer.positionFrames()
                                            / (float) total));
                        }
                        if ((live || preview) && getView() != null) {
                            scheduleWaveFrame();
                        }
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                }
            };

    private void scheduleWaveFrame() {
        if (waveChoreographerActive || !isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
            waveChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            waveChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelWaveFrame() {
        waveChoreographerActive = false;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> scriptPicker;

    private SaveFormat saveFormat = SaveFormat.AUTO;

    private long editSourceId = -1;

        waveform = v.findViewById(R.id.waveform);
        dbMeter = v.findViewById(R.id.dbMeter);
        settingsRow = v.findViewById(R.id.settingsRow);
        settingsName = v.findViewById(R.id.settingsName);
        settingsSub = v.findViewById(R.id.settingsSub);
        telePanel = v.findViewById(R.id.telePanel);
        teleView = v.findViewById(R.id.teleView);
        teleToggle = v.findViewById(R.id.teleToggle);
        teleToggleIcon = v.findViewById(R.id.teleToggleIcon);
        teleState = v.findViewById(R.id.teleState);
        teleTitle = v.findViewById(R.id.teleTitle);
        teleEditBtn = v.findViewById(R.id.teleEditBtn);
        teleHideBtn = v.findViewById(R.id.teleHideBtn);
        telePauseBtn = v.findViewById(R.id.telePauseBtn);
        teleMirrorBtn = v.findViewById(R.id.teleMirrorBtn);
        teleSizeValue = v.findViewById(R.id.teleSizeValue);

        saveFormat = SaveFormat.load(requireContext());

        PressAnim.apply(v.findViewById(R.id.backBtn));

        attachRenameGestures(statusText);

        settingsRow.setOnClickListener(view -> showRecordingSettings());
        // Soft variant: plain apply() resets alpha to 1 on release, which
        // would wipe the converting dim. applySoft only touches scale.
        PressAnim.applySoft(settingsRow, 0.97f);
        if (formatBadge != null) {
            formatBadge.setOnClickListener(view -> showRecordingSettings());
        }
        teleEditBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> openTeleEditor());
        PressAnim.applySoft(teleEditBtn, 0.95f);
        telePauseBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> toggleTelePaused());
        PressAnim.applySoft(telePauseBtn, 0.95f);
        teleMirrorBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> {
            tele = TeleSettings.load(requireContext());
            TeleSettings.toggleMirror(requireContext(), !tele.mirror);
            applyTeleSettings();
            paintTeleMirror();
        });
        PressAnim.applySoft(teleMirrorBtn, 0.95f);
        // Vertical drag on the waveform zooms, like a timeline in a DAW.
        waveform.setOnZoomGesture((dir, dy) -> stepZoom(dir > 0 ? 1 : -1));
        // Touching the script lets the performer scrub it by hand. The view
        // itself tracks the active drag (TeleprompterView.isDragging), so a
        // tap never pauses scrolling and auto-scroll resumes on finger lift.
        initTeleprompter();
        initTeleValueControls();

        editorStrip = v.findViewById(R.id.editorStrip);
        btnPreviewPlay = v.findViewById(R.id.btnPreviewPlay);
        btnSelectRange = v.findViewById(R.id.btnSelectRange);
        btnReplaceSeg = v.findViewById(R.id.btnReplaceSeg);
        btnTrimCrop = v.findViewById(R.id.btnTrimCrop);
        btnCutDelete = v.findViewById(R.id.btnCutDelete);
        btnDspFx = v.findViewById(R.id.btnDspFx);
        btnEditUndo = v.findViewById(R.id.btnEditUndo);
        btnEditRedo = v.findViewById(R.id.btnEditRedo);

        fxPanel = v.findViewById(R.id.fxPanel);
        fxTitle = v.findViewById(R.id.fxTitle);
        fxPresetDropdown = v.findViewById(R.id.fxPresetDropdown);
        fxCloseBtn = v.findViewById(R.id.fxCloseBtn);
        fxListContainer = v.findViewById(R.id.fxListContainer);
        fxHint = v.findViewById(R.id.fxHint);

        dspConfig = DspChain.Config.load(requireContext());
        dspBakedToRaw = false;
        dspSubRangeBaked = false;
        lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
        undoJournal = new EditEngine.UndoJournal(RecordingEngine.takesDir(requireContext()));
        subEditorUndoJournal = new EditEngine.UndoJournal(
                new File(RecordingEngine.takesDir(requireContext()), "sub_undo"));

        if (btnCutDelete != null) {
            btnCutDelete.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        // 1) "Replace" Mode Toggle Button (btnPreviewPlay):
        //    Pure toggle: pressing once selects Replace (red pill, main FAB
        //    morphs to Mic icon) and locks all other editing options; pressing
        //    again deselects Replace and re-enables the other editing options.
        if (btnPreviewPlay != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnPreviewPlay, 0.95f);
            btnPreviewPlay.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Replace", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();
                replaceModeArmed = !replaceModeArmed;
                if (replaceModeArmed) {
                    if (waveform != null) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();
                        waveform.setSelectionLocked(true);
                    }
                    if (fxPanelOpen) {
                        setFxPanelVisible(false);
                    }
                    RawFloatPlayer.releaseWarmSpeaker();
                } else {
                    if (waveform != null) {
                        waveform.setSelectionLocked(false);
                    }
                    RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                }
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
                syncStudioFabIcon();
            });
        }

        // 2) "Select" Button: stays labeled "Select", simply turns red when active
        //    (does NOT activate Select & Replace, and is blocked while Replace is on)
        if (btnSelectRange != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnSelectRange, 0.95f);
            btnSelectRange.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Select", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();
                if (fxPanelOpen) {
                    // Select stays live in effects mode so a noise profile
                    // can be learned from a sub-range, but the handles are
                    // clamped to the frozen apply target. Tapping again puts
                    // the full target back once the sub-selection is gone.
                    if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();
                    } else {
                        waveform.selectRange(fxApplyTargetStart,
                                fxApplyTargetEnd);
                    }
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                } else {
                    waveform.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
                    paintEditorStrip();
                }
            });
        }

        // 3) "Select & Replace" Button: opens dedicated sub-editor configuration
        if (btnReplaceSeg != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnReplaceSeg, 0.95f);
            btnReplaceSeg.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Select & Replace", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                openSelectAndReplaceSubEditor();
            });
        }

        // 4) "Trim" Button: opens stylized Keep Selected / Delete Selected popup
        if (btnTrimCrop != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnTrimCrop, 0.95f);
            btnTrimCrop.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Trim", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                showTrimOptionsPopup();
            });
        }

        // 5) "FX" Button: opens inline Pro FX window in place of Teleprompter
        if (btnDspFx != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnDspFx, 0.95f);
            btnDspFx.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Effects", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                toggleFxPanel();
            });
        }

        // 6) "Undo" & "Redo" Buttons
        if (btnEditUndo != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnEditUndo, 0.95f);
            btnEditUndo.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Undo", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                performStudioUndo();
            });
        }
        if (btnEditRedo != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnEditRedo, 0.95f);
            btnEditRedo.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Redo", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                performStudioRedo();
            });
        }

        if (fxCloseBtn != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxCloseBtn, 0.95f);
            fxCloseBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> setFxPanelVisible(false));
        }
        if (fxPresetDropdown != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxPresetDropdown, 0.95f);
            fxPresetDropdown.setOnClickListener(view -> showFxPresetsMenu());
        }
        waveform.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrollStarted() {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                engine.warmUpMic(requireContext(), preset.audioSource, engine.channels);
            }

            @Override
            public void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction) {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                if (studioPreviewPlayer != null || fxPreviewPreparing) {
                    stopStudioPreview();
                }
                if (fxPanelOpen && fxRenderedPreviewWaveLoaded
                        && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0) {
                    fxPreviewPlayheadFrame = Math.max(
                            fxRenderedPreviewStartFrame,
                            Math.min(fxRenderedPreviewEndFrame,
                                    Math.round(fraction * fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames)));
                    float rStart = waveform.fxRegionStartFraction();
                    float rEnd = Math.max(rStart + 1e-5f,
                            waveform.fxRegionEndFraction());
                    float rel = Math.max(0f,
                            Math.min(1f, (fraction - rStart) / (rEnd - rStart)));
                    long rawTotal = engine.totalFrames();
                    long rawStart = Math.round(fxApplyTargetStart * rawTotal);
                    long rawEnd = Math.round(fxApplyTargetEnd * rawTotal);
                    long mappedRaw = rawStart + Math.round(rel * (rawEnd - rawStart));
                    engine.seekCursorFrame(
                            Math.max(0L, Math.min(rawTotal, mappedRaw)));
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                    timerText.setText(formatTimer(
                            fxPreviewPlayheadFrame * 1000L
                                    / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE));
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                    return;
                }
                long totalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long targetFrame = Math.round(fraction * totalFrames);
                // Never disarm replaceModeArmed while scrubbing! If the user
                // enabled Replace at the end of the take and starts dragging
                // back, the initial move events are near 1.0f and must keep
                // Replace armed.
                //
                // The playhead is NEVER snapped forward here: the timer must
                // show the real scrubbed position. At low zoom a short drag
                // covers many buckets, so forcing targetFrame = totalFrames as
                // soon as the drag came within 480 frames of the end made the
                // timer jump to the whole take duration mid-scroll. Parking at
                // the end is still recognised by the 480-frame tolerance in
                // resumeTake()/syncStudioFabIcon(), which is all this flag is for.
                if (!replaceModeArmed
                        && (fraction >= 0.995f || targetFrame >= totalFrames - 480)) {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = false;
                } else {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                }
                engine.seekCursorFrame(targetFrame);
                timerText.setText(formatTimer(engine.cursorMs()));
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
            }

            @Override
            public void onSelectionChanged(boolean active, float startFrac, float endFrac) {
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
            }
        });

        // Recovery (crash prompt / notification tap) or an edit punch-in:
        // a session is already attached — never show the name modal.
        Bundle args = getArguments();
        boolean attached = false;
        boolean autostart = false;
        if (args != null && args.containsKey("recover_raw")) {
            try {
                File raw = new File(args.getString("recover_raw"));
                if (raw.exists() && !engine.hasSession()) {
                    // Attach with the file's real geometry: a mono session
                    // must stay mono, or punch-in + re-save silently upmixes.
                    int attachCh = 2;
                    try {
                        FormatConverter.WavInfo ai =
                                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                        if (ai.channels == 1 || ai.channels == 2) {
                            attachCh = ai.channels;
                        }
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    engine.attachExisting(requireContext(), raw,
                            engine.takeName != null ? engine.takeName
                                    : prettyBase(raw),
                            attachCh, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));
                }
                pendingName = engine.takeName;
                autostart = args.getBoolean("autostart", false);
                editSourceId = args.getLong("edit_source_id", -1);
                editSourceTitle = args.getString("edit_source_title");
                if (editSourceId == -1 && engine.rawFile != null
                        && EditLink.matches(requireContext(),
                        engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                    // Killed mid-edit: re-adopt the stashed linkage so save
                    // still offers replace-vs-new for the right take.
                    editSourceId = EditLink.id(requireContext());
                    editSourceTitle = EditLink.title(requireContext());
                }
                nameAsked = true;
                attached = true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                pendingName = null;
            }
            args.remove("recover_raw");
        }
        if (!attached && engine.hasSession()) {
            pendingName = engine.takeName;
            if (engine.rawFile != null && EditLink.matches(requireContext(),
                    engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                editSourceId = EditLink.id(requireContext());
                editSourceTitle = EditLink.title(requireContext());
            }
            nameAsked = true;
            attached = true;
        }
        if (savedInstanceState != null && editSourceId == -1 && engine.hasSession()) {
            editSourceId = savedInstanceState.getLong("editSourceId", -1);
            editSourceTitle = savedInstanceState.getString("editSourceTitle");
        }
        TrialAndBillingManager.get(requireContext())
                .setActiveStudioSourceId(editSourceId);
        if (!TrialAndBillingManager.get(requireContext())
                .hasProAccessForRecording(editSourceId)) {
            replaceModeArmed = false;
            if (dspConfig != null && dspConfig.isActive()) {
                dspConfig.resetAll();
                dspConfig.save(requireContext());
            }
        }
        restoreWaveformForAttachedSession();
        restoreEditingMode(savedInstanceState);

        // Snapshot the attached session size so backing out of an untouched
        // edit can skip the save nag, and park the prompter unless capture
        // is actively running.
        initialSessionBytes = engine.hasSession() ? engine.dataBytes : 0L;
        setTelePaused(engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING);

        if (editorStrip != null) {
            editorStrip.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        paint();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        handler.post(tick);
        scheduleWaveFrame();
        activity().syncFabWithEngine();

        doneReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                if (!RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE.equals(intent.getAction())) return;
                boolean ok = intent.getBooleanExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_OK, false);
                String msg = intent.getStringExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_MESSAGE);
                String kind = intent.getStringExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_KIND);
                onBackgroundActionDone(ok, "cancel".equals(kind), msg);
            }
        };
        try {
            IntentFilter f = new IntentFilter(RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE);
            // Compat registration handles the API 33+ exported-flag
            // requirement on every version, killing the lint error and the
            // hand-rolled version branch.
            androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.registerReceiver(
                    requireContext(), doneReceiver, f,
                    androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            doneReceiver = null;
        }

        if (!attached && !nameAsked) {
            nameAsked = true;
            v.post(this::askForName);
        } else if (attached && autostart
                && engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            // Crash recovery: reopen directly in the recording state.
            v.post(() -> {
                if (!isAdded()) return;
                if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(),
                        Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                        == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    ensureNotifThenStart();
                } else {
                    micPermission.launch(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onSaveInstanceState(@NonNull Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putLong("editSourceId", editSourceId);
        outState.putString("editSourceTitle", editSourceTitle);
        outState.putBoolean("fxPanelOpen", fxPanelOpen);
        outState.putBoolean("fxEverOpened", fxEverOpened);
        outState.putBoolean("replaceModeArmed", replaceModeArmed);
        outState.putBoolean("inSelectAndReplaceEditor", inSelectAndReplaceEditor);
        outState.putBoolean("userScrolledWhilePaused", userScrolledWhilePaused);
        outState.putBoolean("dspBakedToRaw", dspBakedToRaw);
        outState.putBoolean("dspSubRangeBaked", dspSubRangeBaked);
        outState.putBoolean("lastEditWasSubRangeBake", lastEditWasSubRangeBake);
        outState.putBoolean("fxTargetHasSelection", fxApplyTargetHasSelection);
        outState.putFloat("fxTargetStart", fxApplyTargetStart);
        outState.putFloat("fxTargetEnd", fxApplyTargetEnd);
        if (waveform != null) {
            if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                outState.putBoolean("selActive", true);
                outState.putFloat("selStart", waveform.selectionStartFraction());
                outState.putFloat("selEnd", waveform.selectionEndFraction());
            }
