package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.junit.Assert.fail;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * FLAC stream-header correctness (FMT-01) and container validation (FMT-03).
 *
 * <p>The old writer emitted 0x90 (metadata block type 16, reserved) and
 * copied STREAMINFO from offset 0 of csd-0 even though Android's encoder
 * prefixes it with "fLaC" + a block header. The result was a file every
 * Android extractor rejected.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FlacHeaderTest {

    /** 34-byte STREAMINFO describing 48 kHz / 2ch / 32-bit. */
    private static byte[] streamInfo(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        byte[] si = new byte[34];
        ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(si).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
        b.putShort((short) 4096);    // min block size
        b.putShort((short) 4096);    // max block size
        si[10] = (byte) ((sampleRate >>> 12) & 0xFF);
        si[11] = (byte) ((sampleRate >>> 4) & 0xFF);
        si[12] = (byte) (((sampleRate & 0x0F) << 4)
                | (((channels - 1) & 0x07) << 1));
        si[13] = (byte) (((channels - 1) & 0x01) << 7); // bps=0
        return si;
    }

    @Test
    public void writesStreamInfoHeaderNotReservedType() throws Exception {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, si);
        byte[] f = out.toByteArray();

        assertEquals(42, f.length);
        assertEquals('f', f[0]);
        assertEquals('L', f[1]);
        assertEquals('a', f[2]);
        assertEquals('C', f[3]);
        // 0x80 = last-metadata-block set + type 0 (STREAMINFO). Never 0x90.
        assertEquals("metadata block header must be 0x80",
                (byte) 0x80, f[4]);
        assertEquals(0, f[5]);
        assertEquals(0, f[6]);
        assertEquals(34, f[7]);
        // The payload must not repeat the magic.
        assertFalse(f[8] == 'f' && f[9] == 'L' && f[10] == 'a'
                && f[11] == 'C');
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(
                java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(f, 8, 42)));
        assertTrue(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(f));
    }

    @Test
    public void extractsStreamInfoFromAllCsdShapes() {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        // Shape 1: bare STREAMINFO.
        ByteBuffer bare = ByteBuffer.allocate(34).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
        bare.put(si).flip();
        assertNotNull(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(bare));
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(bare)));

        // Shape 2: block header + STREAMINFO (38 bytes).
        ByteBuffer hdr = ByteBuffer.allocate(38);
        hdr.put(new byte[]{(byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34}).put(si).flip();
        byte[] got2 = FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(hdr);
        assertNotNull(got2);
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(got2));

        // Shape 3: "fLaC" + block header + STREAMINFO (42 bytes) — the
        // shape Android's C2 FLAC encoder actually emits.
        ByteBuffer full = ByteBuffer.allocate(42);
        full.put(new byte[]{'f', 'L', 'a', 'C', (byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34})
                .put(si).flip();
        byte[] got3 = FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(full);
        assertNotNull("42-byte csd-0 was not understood", got3);
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(got3));
        // Crucially the sample rate must not be 0 (a 'fLaC'-prefixed buffer
        // read from offset 0 would decode garbage here).
        assertEquals(0, got3.length == 0 ? -1 : 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void csdPositionIsNotConsumed() {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        ByteBuffer full = ByteBuffer.allocate(42);
        full.put(new byte[]{'f', 'L', 'a', 'C', (byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34})
                .put(si).flip();
        int before = full.position();
        FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(full);
        assertEquals("csd-0 position must be restored", before,
                full.position());
    }

    @Test
    public void totalSamplesIsPatchedIntoStreamInfo() throws Exception {
        File f = File.createTempFile("flac", ".flac");
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, streamInfo(48000, 2));
            try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
                w.write(out.toByteArray());
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.patchTotalSamples(w, 96000L);
            }
            try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
                byte[] h = new byte[42];
                r.readFully(h);
                // 36-bit field: low nibble of file byte 21, then 22..25.
                long total = ((h[21] & 0x0FL) << 32)
                        | ((h[22] & 0xFFL) << 24)
                        | ((h[23] & 0xFFL) << 16)
                        | ((h[24] & 0xFFL) << 8)
                        | (h[25] & 0xFFL);
                assertEquals(96000L, total);
                // The rate must survive the patch.
                assertEquals(48000, ((h[18] & 0xFF) << 12)
                        | ((h[19] & 0xFF) << 4) | ((h[20] & 0xF0) >>> 4));
            }
        } finally {
            //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validHeadRejectsReservedTypeAndZeroRate() {
        byte[] good;
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, streamInfo(48000, 2));
            good = out.toByteArray();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            fail(e.toString());
            return;
        }
        assertTrue(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(good));

        byte[] reserved = good.clone();
        reserved[4] = (byte) 0x90;
        assertFalse("0x90 must be rejected",
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(reserved));

        byte[] zeroRate = good.clone();
        zeroRate[18] = 0;
        zeroRate[19] = 0;
        zeroRate[20] &= (byte) 0x0F;
        assertFalse("0 Hz sample rate must be rejected",
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(zeroRate));

        byte[] shortLen = good.clone();
        shortLen[7] = 33;
        assertFalse(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(shortLen));

        assertFalse(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(new byte[10]));
        assertNull(null);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Cross-stage catalogue contract: every effect in the "+ Add Effect" list
 * must have a registered processor, a primary parameter that matches the
 * slot's dial range, a category, and must survive a JSON round-trip.
 */
public class FxCatalogTest {

    @Test
    public void everyEffectTypeHasARegisteredProcessor() {
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(t.id);
            assertNotNull("No processor registered for " + t.id + " ("
                    + t.title + ")", p);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void everyNonLegacyEffectHasAPrimaryParameterInRange() {
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            if (t.isLegacyStage()) continue;
            String primary = DspChain.primaryParamId(t);
            assertNotNull("No primary param for " + t.id, primary);
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(t.id);
            FxParameter fp = p.getParam(primary);
            assertNotNull("Primary param " + primary + " missing on " + t.id,
                    fp);
            assertEquals("Dial range mismatch for " + t.id,
                    fp.minRaw, t.minVal);
            assertEquals("Dial range mismatch for " + t.id,
                    fp.maxRaw, t.maxVal);
            assertEquals("Default mismatch for " + t.id,
                    fp.defaultRaw, t.defaultVal);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void everyEffectBelongsToACategory() {
        Set<FxCategory> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            FxCategory c = DspChain.categoryOf(t);
            assertNotNull("No category for " + t.id, c);
            seen.add(c);
        }
        // The whole catalog must cover the eight families.
        assertEquals("Not every category is represented", 8, seen.size());
    }

    @Test
    public void onlyNoiseToolsRequireALearnedProfile() {
        Set<DspChain.EffectType> expected = new HashSet<>();
        expected.add(DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION);
        expected.add(DspChain.EffectType.SPECTRAL_NOISE_REDUCTION);
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            assertEquals("Learn flag mismatch for " + t.id,
                    expected.contains(t), t.requiresLearnedProfile());
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void effectIdsAreUnique() {
        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            assertTrue("Duplicate effect id " + t.id, ids.add(t.id));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void newEffectsJoinTheRack() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR, true, -1800, true));
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB, true, 55, true));
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_TEMPO, true, 5000, true));

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        // The rack always carries the seven legacy stages plus one
        // processor per non-legacy slot.
        assertEquals("Wrong rack size", 7 + 3, chain.getRack().size());
        assertTrue("Compressor missing from the rack",
                chain.getRack().indexOf("dyncomp") >= 0);
        assertTrue("Reverb missing from the rack",
                chain.getRack().indexOf("reverb") >= 0);
        assertTrue("Tempo processor missing from the rack",
                chain.getRack().indexOf("tempo") >= 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void neutralEffectsDoNotCountAsAnActiveRack() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        // Amplify at 0 dB does nothing.
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.AMPLIFY, true, 0, false));
        assertFalse("A neutral effect must not arm the rack", cfg.isActive());

        // The same effect at +6 dB does.
        cfg.slots.get(0).value = 600;
        assertTrue("An engaged effect must arm the rack", cfg.isActive());
    }

    @Test
    public void offlineEffectsAreSeparatedFromTheRealtimeChain() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_TEMPO, true, 5000, false));
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        assertEquals("Offline processors not detected",
                1, chain.offlineProcessors().size());
        assertFalse("Offline-only chain must not report in-place processors",
                chain.hasInPlaceProcessors());
        chain.clearOfflineProcessors();
        assertEquals("Offline processors not cleared",
                0, chain.offlineProcessors().size());
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Stage 1 FX-commit audit fixes: the seam crossfades must use GLOBAL frame
 * offsets so a multi-chunk range neither repeats the head fade on every 4096-
 * frame chunk nor drops a tail fade that straddles a chunk boundary, and they
 * must be skipped entirely at the file edges (a whole-take bake has nothing to
 * crossfade toward). Also covers dispatchSave() baking an unbaked chain when
 * the save arrives from the notification path.
 *
 * <p>The brickwall limiter at drive 100 is a deterministic per-sample gain
 * (fastDbToLin(10.5) ≈ 3.35x) with no clamping below the 0.82 ceiling, so the
 * tests can assert exact dry/wet blends instead of heuristics.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxCommitAndCrossfadeTest {

    /** Session rate the engine writes WAV headers at (48 kHz). */
    private static final int SR = 48000;

    /** Full drive maps to 6.5 dB and the soft knee settles at 0.9362. */
    private static final float LIMITER_GAIN =
            DspChain.fastDbToLin(6.5f) * 0.9362f;

    private static File writeSineWav(File dir, String name, int frames,
                                     int channels, float amp) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        long dataBytes = (long) frames * channels * 4L;
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(channels, SR, dataBytes));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * channels];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                float s = (float) (amp
                        * Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 440.0 * i / SR));
                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                    buf[i * channels + c] = s;
                }
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, buf, 0, buf.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static float[] readAllSamples(File wav, int frames, int channels)
            throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        byte[] raw = new byte[frames * channels * 4];
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "r")) {
            raf.seek(info.dataStart);
            raf.readFully(raw);
        }
        float[] out = new float[frames * channels];
        ByteBuffer.wrap(raw).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                .asFloatBuffer().get(out);
        return out;
    }

    /** Limiter-only chain: a pure per-sample gain, no filter or AGC state. */
    private static DspChain limiterChain() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, true, 100, false));
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        return new DspChain(1, cfg);
    }

    @Test
    public void durationPreviewRendersOnlyTheCopy() throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        int frames = 4800;
        File raw = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_preview_raw.wav", frames, 1, 0.25f);
        File copy = new File(dir, "fx_preview_copy.wav");
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_TEMPO, true, 5000, false));
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        EditEngine.copyFile(raw, copy);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        long regionEnd = frames;
        long newTotal = frames;
        for (AudioProcessor proc : chain.offlineProcessors()) {
            long next = EditEngine.applyLengthChangingEffectToRange(
                    copy, 0, regionEnd, proc, null);
            assertTrue("preview render failed", next > 0);
            regionEnd = next - (newTotal - regionEnd);
            newTotal = next;
        }
        assertNotEquals("duration preview did not change length",
                frames, newTotal);
        assertEquals("source raw was mutated",
                frames, FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw).dataBytes / 4);
        assertEquals("copy duration mismatch", newTotal,
                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(copy).dataBytes / 4);
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        copy.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void fullRangeApplyProcessesEntireFileWithoutBoundaryFadeArtifacts()
            throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        int totalFrames = 2400;
        File wav = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_full.wav", totalFrames, 1, 0.25f);
        float[] before = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);

        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, 0, totalFrames, chain, null);
        float[] after = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        double diffEnergy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalFrames; i++) {
            double d = after[i] - before[i];
            diffEnergy += d * d;
        }
        assertTrue("Full-take FX bake should modify audio samples",
                diffEnergy > 1e-3);
    }

    @Test
    public void subRangeApplyCrossfadesCleanlyAtBothBoundaries() throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        int totalFrames = 4000;
        File wav = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_sub.wav", totalFrames, 1, 0.20f);
        float[] before = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        DspChain chain = limiterChain();

        int start = 1000;
        int end = 3000;
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, start, end, chain, null);
        float[] after = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < start; i++) {
            assertEquals("Pre-selection sample mutated at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
        for (int i = end; i < totalFrames; i++) {
            assertEquals("Post-selection sample mutated at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
        // The first/last frames of an interior range sit at the dry end of
        // their raised-cosine fades (u=0 and u=1), so they must be untouched.
        assertEquals("Start seam frame must start at dry level",
                before[start], after[start], 1e-5f);
        assertEquals("End seam frame must land at dry level",
                before[end - 1], after[end - 1], 1e-5f);

        float stepStart = Math.abs(after[start] - after[start - 1]);
        float stepEnd = Math.abs(after[end] - after[end - 1]);
        assertTrue("Start boundary step too large: " + stepStart,
                stepStart < 0.05f);
        assertTrue("End boundary step too large: " + stepEnd,
                stepEnd < 0.05f);
    }

    @Test
    public void multiChunkSelectionDoesNotRepeatHeadFadeOrDropStraddledTailFade()
            throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        // Selection length 8292 = 4096 * 2 + 100: spans three chunks, and the
        // final chunk holds only 100 frames so the 240-frame tail fade
        // straddles chunk 1 (140 frames) and chunk 2 (100 frames).
        int totalFrames = 12000;
        int start = 1000;
        int end = start + 8292;
        File wav = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_multichunk.wav", totalFrames, 1, 0.20f);
        float[] before = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, start, end, limiterChain(), null);
        float[] after = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        // 1. Chunk 1's head must be pure wet. The old local-index loop re-ran
        //    the head fade on every chunk, stamping origHead[0] (= before[start])
        //    over chunk 1's first 240 frames; the fixed global-offset code
        //    touches only [start, start + 240).
        int chunk1Start = start + 4096;
        assertEquals("Chunk 1 head must be pure wet (no repeated head fade)",
                LIMITER_GAIN * before[chunk1Start], after[chunk1Start], 2e-3f);
        assertTrue("Head fade must not stamp the original head onto chunk 1",
                Math.abs(after[chunk1Start] - before[start]) > 0.2f);

        // 2. The straddled tail fade must keep blending on the final chunk
        //    instead of being dropped: frame end-120 sits at u = 120/239 of the
        //    fade, so it must be an exact dry/wet blend, not pure wet.
        int fMid = 120;
        float uMid = fMid / 239f;
        float gDryMid = 0.5f * (1f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * uMid));
        float expectedMid = before[end - 240 + fMid] * gDryMid
                + LIMITER_GAIN * before[end - 240 + fMid] * (1f - gDryMid);
        assertEquals("Straddled tail fade must blend mid-window, not drop",
                expectedMid, after[end - 240 + fMid], 2e-3f);

        // 3. The very last frame of the range lands at the dry end of the fade.
        assertEquals("Straddled tail seam must land at dry level at end - 1",
                before[end - 1], after[end - 1], 1e-5f);
        float stepEnd = Math.abs(after[end] - after[end - 1]);
        assertTrue("End boundary step across straddled tail fade too large: "
                + stepEnd, stepEnd < 0.05f);

        // 4. Everything outside the selection is bit-identical.
        for (int i = 0; i < start; i++) {
            assertEquals("Pre-selection sample mutated at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
        for (int i = end; i < totalFrames; i++) {
            assertEquals("Post-selection sample mutated at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void veryShortSelectionShrinksFadesAndKeepsGeometry() throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        int totalFrames = 6000;
        File wav = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_short.wav", totalFrames, 1, 0.20f);
        float[] before = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        // 100 frames is below one crossfade window: the fades must shrink to
        // half the range instead of reading past it or writing outside it.
        int start = 2000;
        int end = 2100;
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, start, end, limiterChain(), null);
        float[] after = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        assertEquals("Geometry must be untouched",
                (long) totalFrames * 4L, info.dataBytes);
        assertEquals("Audio before a short range must not move",
                before[start - 1], after[start - 1], 1e-6f);
        assertEquals("Audio after a short range must not move",
                before[end], after[end], 1e-6f);
        // A 50-frame fade still lands dry at the range edges.
        assertEquals("Short-range head edge stays dry",
                before[start], after[start], 1e-5f);
        assertEquals("Short-range tail edge stays dry",
                before[end - 1], after[end - 1], 1e-5f);
    }

    @Test
    public void fxBakeRequiredFlagInvalidatesStreamingAdoptionAndBakesRawOnSave()
            throws Exception {
        android.content.Context ctx = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();

        // Persist an active chain exactly as the studio would, so
        // dispatchSave()'s notification-path bake sees it via Config.load().
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, true, 100, false));
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        cfg.save(ctx);

        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "FxBakeTest", 1);
        assertFalse("fresh session has no pending FX bake",
                engine.isFxBakeRequired());

        int frames = 2400;
        float[] rawSamples = new float[frames];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            rawSamples[i] = (float) (0.15
                    * Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 440.0 * i / SR));
        }
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(engine.rawFile, "rw")) {
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, SR, (long) frames * 4L));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, rawSamples, 0, rawSamples.length);
        }
        engine.dataBytes = (long) frames * 4L;
        float[] before = readAllSamples(engine.rawFile, frames, 1);

        engine.setFxBakeRequired(true);
        assertTrue(engine.isFxBakeRequired());

        ConversionJobs.SaveResult res = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV24, null);
        assertFalse("Unbaked FX must not adopt a dry streaming .part",
                res.adopted);
        assertFalse("dispatchSave must clear fxBakeRequired after baking raw",
                engine.isFxBakeRequired());

        float[] after = readAllSamples(engine.rawFile, frames, 1);
        double diffEnergy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            double d = after[i] - before[i];
            diffEnergy += d * d;
        }
        assertTrue("dispatchSave must bake the active chain into raw when "
                + "fxBakeRequired (notification-save path)", diffEnergy > 1e-2);

        if (res.job != null) {
            ConversionJobs.cancel(res.job.jobId, true);
        }
        engine.abortAndDelete();
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/FxDivergenceGuardTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

/**
 * Guards the three processors that diverged at settings inside their own ranges,
 * as found by the parameter matrix: a chorus feedback loop that compounded past
 * unity, a multi-tap delay whose feedback sum exceeded unity, and an upward
 * compressor whose gain sign boosted quiet material by the full ratio.
 *
 * <p>Each case renders to the end of the buffer and asserts the render stays
 * finite and bounded, so a regression shows up here instead of in a 5.8e11 peak.
 */
public class FxDivergenceGuardTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] tone(int frames, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            out[f] = (float) (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static float[] impulses(int frames) {
        float[] out = new float[frames];
        for (int at = 2400; at < frames; at += 24000) {
            out[at] = 0.8f;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static void assertFiniteAndBounded(String label, float[] buf,
                                               float bound) {
        float peak = 0f;
        int bad = 0;
        for (float v : buf) {
            if (!Float.isFinite(v)) {
                bad++;
                continue;
            }
            peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v));
        }
        assertEquals(label + " produced non-finite samples", 0, bad);
        assertTrue(label + " peak " + peak + " exceeded " + bound,
                peak <= bound);
    }

    @Test
    public void chorusFeedbackStaysStableAtBothExtremes() {
        for (int fbRaw : new int[]{90, -90}) {
            ChorusFlangerProcessor chorus = new ChorusFlangerProcessor();
            chorus.getParam("ch_fb").setCurrentRaw(fbRaw);
            chorus.getParam("ch_mix").setCurrentRaw(100);
            chorus.getParam("ch_depth").setCurrentRaw(100);
            float[] buf = tone(SR, 220.0, 0.4f);
            chorus.prepare(SR, 1);
            chorus.processInPlace(buf, SR, 1);
            assertFiniteAndBounded("chorus fb=" + fbRaw, buf, 10f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void multiDelayFeedbackSumCannotExceedUnity() {
        for (int type : new int[]{0, 1, 2}) {
            MultiDelayProcessor delay = new MultiDelayProcessor();
            delay.getParam("md_type").setEnumIndex(type);
            delay.getParam("md_level").setFloat(1f);      // the +1 dB maximum
            delay.getParam("md_echoes").setCurrentRaw(30);
            delay.getParam("md_time").setCurrentRaw(10);
            float[] buf = impulses(SR * 2);
            delay.prepare(SR, 1);
            delay.processInPlace(buf, SR * 2, 1);
            assertFiniteAndBounded("multidelay type=" + type, buf, 200f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void upwardCompressionAttenuatesInsteadOfBoosting() {
        CompressorProcessor comp = new CompressorProcessor();
        comp.getParam("dyncomp_upward").setBoolean(true);
        comp.getParam("dyncomp_thresh").setFloat(-6f);
        comp.getParam("dyncomp_ratio").setFloat(20f);
        comp.getParam("dyncomp_makeup").setBoolean(false);
        float[] quiet = tone(SR, 300.0, 0.01f);
        float[] before = quiet.clone();
        comp.prepare(SR, 1);
        comp.processInPlace(quiet, SR, 1);
        assertFiniteAndBounded("dyncomp upward", quiet, 1f);

        double inRms = rms(before);
        double outRms = rms(quiet);
        assertTrue("upward expansion must widen the range downward, not boost "
                        + "quiet material (in=" + inRms + ", out=" + outRms + ")",
                outRms < inRms);
    }

    private static double rms(float[] v) {
        double sum = 0;
        for (float s : v) sum += (double) s * s;
        return Math.sqrt(sum / Math.max(1, v.length));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Effects mode: the FX rack drives the transport.
 *
 * <p>With the rack open, Play auditions the effect-applied audio, Stop
 * commits the rack to the region that was selected before the rack opened,
 * and the FX chip is only highlighted while the panel is actually open.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxEffectsModeTest {

    private Context ctx;
    private RecordingEngine engine;

    @Before
    public void setUp() {
        ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
    }

    @After
    public void tearDown() {
        engine.abortAndDelete();
    }

    private File createFloatWav(String name, int frames, int ch) throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), "fxmode");
        dir.mkdirs();
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, 48000, (long) frames * ch * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                float s = (float) (Math.sin(i * 2 * Math.PI * 440 / 48000) * 0.2);
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[i * ch + c] = s;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static float[] readSamples(File wav, int frames, int ch)
            throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        byte[] raw = new byte[frames * ch * 4];
        try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "r")) {
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            r.readFully(raw);
        }
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        ByteBuffer.wrap(raw).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer().get(out);
        return out;
    }

    @Test
    public void theFxChipIsOnlyHighlightedWhileTheRackIsOpen() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File raw = createFloatWav("chip_highlight.wav", frames, 1);
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        // A rack with an effect in it, but the panel is closed.
        DspChain.EffectSlot slot =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB);
        slot.value = 80;
        cfg.save(ctx);

        engine.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "Chip Take", 1,
                RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));
        MainActivity act = Robolectric.buildActivity(MainActivity.class)
                .create().start().resume().visible().get();
        act.openStudioWithEdit(raw, 301L, "Chip Take");
        Robolectric.flushForegroundThreadScheduler();

        StudioFragment frag = (StudioFragment) act.getSupportFragmentManager()
                .findFragmentByTag("STU");
        assertNotNull(frag);
        View root = frag.getView();
        assertNotNull(root);

        TextView btnDspFx = root.findViewById(R.id.btnDspFx);
        assertFalse("The rack must start closed", frag.isFxPanelOpen());
        // The studio paints the selected chip white and the idle one grey,
        // so the text colour is the chip's own selected/idle signal.
        int idleColour = btnDspFx.getCurrentTextColor();
        assertNotEquals("A pending rack must not highlight the FX chip",
                SELECTED_CHIP_TEXT, idleColour);

        // Effects mode needs a region before it can open.
        ((WaveformView) root.findViewById(R.id.waveform))
                .selectRange(0.25f, 0.75f);

        // Open the rack: now the chip is highlighted.
        btnDspFx.performClick();
        assertTrue("The rack must be open", frag.isFxPanelOpen());
        assertEquals("An open rack must highlight the FX chip",
                SELECTED_CHIP_TEXT, btnDspFx.getCurrentTextColor());
    }

    @Test
    public void defaultPresetIsEnabledOnFirstOpeningFxPanel() {
        ctx.getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().clear().commit();
        DspChain.Config cfg = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH.id, cfg.activePresetId);
        assertTrue("Default FX preset must be active on first open", cfg.isActive());
        assertEquals(4, cfg.enabledSlotCount());
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot slot : cfg.slots) {
            assertTrue("Default slot " + slot.type.id + " must be enabled", slot.enabled);
        }
    }

    /** Text colour the studio uses for a selected (highlighted) chip. */
    private static final int SELECTED_CHIP_TEXT = 0xFFFFFFFF;

    /** The attached take loads its bars on a worker; wait for that handoff. */
    private static void awaitHistory(WaveformView wf) throws Exception {
        long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 5000L;
        while (wf.historyCount() <= 1
                && System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
            Robolectric.flushForegroundThreadScheduler();
            Thread.sleep(10L);
        }
        Robolectric.flushForegroundThreadScheduler();
    }

    @Test
    public void theRackCommitsToTheRegionSelectedBeforeItOpened()
            throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File raw = createFloatWav("frozen_target.wav", frames, 1);
        float[] before = readSamples(raw, frames, 1);

        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot shelf =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.SHELF_FILTER);
        shelf.value = 600;
        shelf.extraParams.put("freq", 20000);
        cfg.save(ctx);

        engine.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "Frozen Take", 1,
                RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));
        MainActivity act = Robolectric.buildActivity(MainActivity.class)
                .create().start().resume().visible().get();
        act.openStudioWithEdit(raw, 302L, "Frozen Take");
        Robolectric.flushForegroundThreadScheduler();

        StudioFragment frag = (StudioFragment) act.getSupportFragmentManager()
                .findFragmentByTag("STU");
        assertNotNull(frag);
        View root = frag.getView();
        assertNotNull(root);

        WaveformView wf = root.findViewById(R.id.waveform);
        TextView btnDspFx = root.findViewById(R.id.btnDspFx);

        // Select the second half BEFORE opening the rack.
        wf.selectRange(0.5f, 1f);
        btnDspFx.performClick();
        assertTrue("The rack must be open", frag.isFxPanelOpen());

        // Stop commits the rack to that region.
        frag.applyEffectsToSelection();

        float[] after = readSamples(raw, frames, 1);
        float peakFirstHalf = 0f;
        float peakSecondHalf = 0f;
        for (int i = 100; i < 2000; i++) {
            peakFirstHalf = Math.max(peakFirstHalf, Math.abs(after[i]));
        }
        for (int i = 2600; i < 4600; i++) {
            peakSecondHalf = Math.max(peakSecondHalf, Math.abs(after[i]));
        }
        assertEquals("The first half must stay dry",
                0.20f, peakFirstHalf, 0.03f);
        assertEquals("The selected half must carry the effect",
                0.40f, peakSecondHalf, 0.06f);
        // The untouched half must be bit-identical.
        for (int i = 100; i < 2000; i++) {
            assertEquals("The dry region must be untouched at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void anEmptyRackDoesNotArmTheChain() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        assertFalse("An empty rack must stay inactive", cfg.isActive());
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        assertFalse("An empty rack must not process audio", chain.isActive());
    }

    @Test
    public void openingEffectsModeWithoutASelectionAsksForOne()
            throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File raw = createFloatWav("needs_selection.wav", frames, 1);

    @Test
    public void effectsModeKeepsThePlayheadInsideItsTarget() {
        WaveformView wf = new WaveformView(ctx);
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) wf.push(0.5f);
        wf.setFxRegionBounds(0.25f, 0.75f);

        wf.setPlayheadFraction(0.1f);
        assertEquals("Playhead must clamp up to the target start",
                0.25f, wf.playheadFraction(), 0.01f);

        wf.setPlayheadFraction(0.9f);
        assertEquals("Playhead must clamp down to the target end",
                0.75f, wf.playheadFraction(), 0.01f);

        wf.setPlayheadFraction(0.5f);
        assertEquals("A playhead inside the target is untouched",
                0.5f, wf.playheadFraction(), 0.01f);

        wf.clearFxRegion();
        wf.setPlayheadFraction(0.9f);
        assertEquals("Leaving effects mode releases the clamp",
                0.9f, wf.playheadFraction(), 0.01f);
    }

    @Test
    public void durationChangingEffectsUpdateTimelineInRealTimeAndPreserveFxScrollBounds()
            throws Exception {
        int frames = 48000; // 1.0 s take -> 20 buckets at 20 Hz
        File raw = createFloatWav("realtime_stretch.wav", frames, 1);

        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        // 0.5x speed doubles the selected region's duration!
        DspChain.EffectSlot speed =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_SPEED_AND_PITCH);
        speed.value = 50; // 0.50x speed
        cfg.save(ctx);

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        File previewWav = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), "live_preview_stretch.wav");
        FxPreviewPeaks.LiveRegionResult res = FxPreviewPeaks.renderRegionLive(
                raw, chain, 20, 48000, 0.25f, 0.75f, previewWav);
        assertNotNull("Live region result must not be null", res);
        assertTrue("Change Speed must report lengthChanged", res.lengthChanged);
        // Original take: 48,000 frames; selected [0.25, 0.75) = 24,000 frames
        // At 0.5x speed, selected region becomes 48,000 frames -> total 72,000 frames (30 buckets)!
        assertEquals(72000L, res.newTotalFrames);
        assertEquals(20, res.peaks.length);

        WaveformView wf = new WaveformView(ctx);
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) wf.push(0.4f);
        wf.setLive(false);
        wf.setFxRegionBounds(0.25f, 0.75f);
        wf.setFxRegionStretchedPeaks(res.peaks, 0.25f, 0.75f, res.newTotalFrames);

        // Total bars updated in real time from 20 -> 30 (5 prefix + 20 stretched + 5 suffix)
        assertEquals(30, wf.getHistoryCount());
        assertEquals(20, wf.getBaseHistoryCount());
        assertTrue("FX region must remain active after stretch", wf.hasFxRegion());
        assertEquals(5f / 30f, wf.fxRegionStartFraction(), 0.02f);
        assertEquals(25f / 30f, wf.fxRegionEndFraction(), 0.02f);

        // Scrolling/clamping in FX mode must stay bounded to the stretched FX region!
        wf.setPlayheadFraction(0.01f);
        assertEquals("Playhead must clamp to stretched FX region start",
                5f / 30f, wf.playheadFraction(), 0.02f);
        wf.setPlayheadFraction(0.99f);
        assertEquals("Playhead must clamp to stretched FX region end",
                25f / 30f, wf.playheadFraction(), 0.02f);

        // Closing FX mode restores the original 20 dry bars and [0.25, 0.75] bounds
        wf.clearFxRegion();
        assertEquals(20, wf.getHistoryCount());
        assertFalse(wf.hasFxRegion());
        previewWav.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void audioGeneratorDurationTimerResizesRegionAtAllValuesIncludingDefault() {
        AudioGeneratorTool gen = new AudioGeneratorTool();
        gen.prepare(48000, 1);
        // Even at default 5.0 s (500 raw) or custom 2.0 s (200 raw), outFrames follows gen_dur:
        float[] in = new float[24000]; // 0.5 s selection
        float[] outDefault5s = gen.processOfflineRegion(in, 24000, 1);
        assertEquals(48000 * 5, outDefault5s.length);

        gen.getParam("gen_dur").setFloat(2.0f);
        float[] out2s = gen.processOfflineRegion(in, 24000, 1);
        assertEquals(48000 * 2, out2s.length);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotSame;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Effects mode renders only the target region and learns noise profiles from
 * the audio as it enters the profiler, i.e. after every effect above it.
 */
public class FxLivePreviewTest {

    private static File writeSine(File dir, String name, int frames, int ch,
                                  float amp) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, 48000,
                    (long) frames * ch * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                float s = (float) (Math.sin(
                        i * 2 * Math.PI * 440 / 48000) * amp);
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[i * ch + c] = s;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static DspChain.Config shelfRack() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot shelf =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.SHELF_FILTER);
        shelf.value = 600;
        shelf.extraParams.put("freq", 20000);
        return cfg;
    }

    @Test
    public void prefixContainsOnlyTheEnabledEffectsAboveTheTarget() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot eq =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.SHELF_FILTER);
        eq.value = 300;
        eq.wetDry = 0.5f;
        eq.extraParams.put("freq", 8000);
        DspChain.EffectSlot comp =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        comp.enabled = false;
        DspChain.EffectSlot target =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION);

        DspChain.Config prefix =
                StudioFragment.prefixConfigFor(cfg, target);

        assertEquals("Only the enabled effect above the target belongs "
                + "in the learning prefix", 1, prefix.slots.size());
        DspChain.EffectSlot copy = prefix.slots.get(0);
        assertEquals(DspChain.EffectType.SHELF_FILTER, copy.type);
        assertEquals(300, copy.value);
        assertEquals(0.5f, copy.wetDry, 1e-6f);
        assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(8000),
                copy.extraParams.get("freq"));
        assertNotSame("The prefix must be a snapshot, not the live slot",
                eq, copy);
    }

    @Test
    public void theLearningPrefixProcessesTheAudioLikeTheRack()
            throws Exception {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot amp =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.AMPLIFY);
        amp.value = 600;
        DspChain.EffectSlot target =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION);

        DspChain prefix = new DspChain(1,
                StudioFragment.prefixConfigFor(cfg, target));
        assertTrue("The prefix must run the earlier effect", prefix.isActive());
        float[] buf = new float[4800];
        java.util.Arrays.fill(buf, 0.2f);
        prefix.prepareOffline(null, 0, buf.length, 48000, 1);
        prefix.reset();
        prefix.processInPlace(buf, buf.length);
        assertEquals("The profiler must see +6 dB from the effect above it",
                0.4f, buf[buf.length - 1], 0.02f);
    }

    @Test
    public void regionRenderFillsOnlyTheTargetBuckets() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"),
                "takeone-fx-live-tests");
        dir.mkdirs();
        File raw = writeSine(dir, "region_render.wav", frames, 1, 0.2f);

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, shelfRack());
        float[] peaks = FxPreviewPeaks.renderRegion(raw, chain, 100,
                48000, 0.5f, 1f);
        assertTrue("The region render must produce buckets", peaks != null);
        assertEquals(100, peaks.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
            assertEquals("Bucket " + i + " is outside the target",
                    0f, peaks[i], 1e-6f);
        }
        float wetPeak = 0f;
        for (int i = 50; i < 100; i++) {
            wetPeak = Math.max(wetPeak, peaks[i]);
        }
        assertEquals("The target region must carry the +6 dB effect",
                0.4f, wetPeak, 0.05f);
    }

    @Test
    public void auditionStartsAtThePlayheadWhenItIsInsideTheRange() {
        assertEquals(3000L,
                StudioFragment.auditionStartFrame(1000L, 5000L, 3000L));
        assertEquals("Playhead on the start keeps the range start",
                1000L, StudioFragment.auditionStartFrame(
                        1000L, 5000L, 1000L));
        assertEquals("Playhead on the end restarts the range",
                1000L, StudioFragment.auditionStartFrame(
                        1000L, 5000L, 5000L));
        assertEquals("Playhead before the range starts at its beginning",
                1000L, StudioFragment.auditionStartFrame(
                        1000L, 5000L, 200L));
        assertEquals("Playhead after the range starts at its beginning",
                1000L, StudioFragment.auditionStartFrame(
                        1000L, 5000L, 9000L));
    }

    @Test
    public void regionRenderRejectsAnEmptyRange() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"),
                "takeone-fx-live-tests");
        dir.mkdirs();
        File raw = writeSine(dir, "empty_range.wav", 4800, 1, 0.2f);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, shelfRack());
        assertNull(FxPreviewPeaks.renderRegion(raw, chain, 100,
                48000, 0.5f, 0.5f));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.junit.Assert.fail;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Tier 0 of the FX verification harness: the runtime parameter inventory.
 *
 * <p>Walks the effect catalog exactly as the "+ Add Effect" dialog does and
 * records every parameter each processor actually exposes, so the test matrix
 * is derived from the code instead of a hand-maintained list. The workflow
 * compares this output against its own matrix and fails on drift.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxParamInventoryTest {

    @Test
    public void everyEffectExposesItsParameters() throws Exception {
        File out = FxVerifySupport.outRoot("params");
        JSONArray effects = new JSONArray();
        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();
        StringBuilder idList = new StringBuilder();

        for (DspChain.EffectType type : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            AudioProcessor proto = FxRackChain.createProcessor(type.id);
            assertNotNull("No processor registered for " + type.id, proto);
            assertTrue("Duplicate effect id " + type.id, ids.add(type.id));

            String primary = FxVerifySupport.primaryParamId(type);
            JSONArray params = new JSONArray();
            boolean sawPrimary = primary == null;
            for (FxParameter p : proto.getParameters()) {
                JSONObject o = p.toJson();
                o.put("primary", p.id.equals(primary));
                p.resetToDefault();
                o.put("display", p.formatDisplay());
                params.put(o);
                if (p.id.equals(primary)) sawPrimary = true;
            }
            if (!sawPrimary) {
                fail("Effect " + type.id + " has no primary parameter '"
                        + primary + "' in its own parameter list");
            }
            assertTrue("Effect " + type.id + " exposes no parameters",
                    params.length() > 0);

            JSONObject e = new JSONObject();
            e.put("id", type.id);
            e.put("title", type.title);
            e.put("description", type.description);
            e.put("paramLabel", type.paramLabel);
            e.put("dialMin", type.minVal);
            e.put("dialMax", type.maxVal);
            e.put("dialStep", type.stepVal);
            e.put("dialDefault", type.defaultVal);
            FxCategory cat = DspChain.categoryOf(type);
            e.put("category", cat == null ? "" : cat.name());
            e.put("offlineOnly", proto.isOfflineOnly());
            e.put("handlesOwnWetDryMix", proto.handlesOwnWetDryMix());
            e.put("requiresLearnedProfile", type.requiresLearnedProfile());
            e.put("primaryParam", primary == null ? "" : primary);
            e.put("paramCount", params.length());
            e.put("params", params);
            effects.put(e);

            idList.append(type.id).append('\n');
        }

        JSONObject root = new JSONObject();
        root.put("effectCount", effects.length());
        root.put("effects", effects);

        write(new File(out, "params.json"), root.toString(2));
        write(new File(out, "effect_ids.txt"), idList.toString());
        System.out.println("FX inventory: " + effects.length() + " effects, "
                + countParams(effects) + " parameters");
    }

    private static int countParams(JSONArray effects) throws Exception {
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < effects.length(); i++) {
            n += effects.getJSONObject(i).getInt("paramCount");
        }
        return n;
    }

    private static void write(File f, String text) throws Exception {
        File parent = f.getParentFile();
        if (parent != null) parent.mkdirs();
        try (Writer w = new OutputStreamWriter(new FileOutputStream(f),
                StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            w.write(text);
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/FxParamMatrixDumpTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Tier 1 of the FX verification harness: the exhaustive parameter matrix.
 *
 * <p>Runs one effect (selected by {@code FX_EFFECT}) through every parameter it
 * exposes, at the parameter's minimum, default and maximum (or every enum
 * label / both boolean states), with all other parameters left at their
 * defaults. Each case is rendered against the probes that can actually show
 * the parameter's effect, and every render is written out as a 32-bit float
 * WAV next to a JSON manifest, so the analysis side never has to guess what a
 * file contains.
 *
 * <p>The DSP layer is pure Java, so this runs on a plain JVM shard - no
 * emulator, no MediaCodec - which is what makes an exhaustive sweep cheap.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxParamMatrixDumpTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;
    private static final int FULL_FRAMES = 30 * SR;

    /** Probes that can show a given effect's behaviour. */
    private static final Map<String, String[]> EFFECT_PROBES = new HashMap<>();
    /** Per-parameter overrides, keyed {@code effect.param}. */
    private static final Map<String, String[]> PARAM_PROBES = new HashMap<>();
    private static final String[] DEFAULT_PROBES = {"clip", "tone"};

    static {
        EFFECT_PROBES.put("noise", new String[]{"noise"});
        EFFECT_PROBES.put("specnr", new String[]{"noise"});
        EFFECT_PROBES.put("deess", new String[]{"sibilant"});
        EFFECT_PROBES.put("deesssplit", new String[]{"sibilant"});
        EFFECT_PROBES.put("hpf", new String[]{"sweep", "tone"});
        EFFECT_PROBES.put("highpass", new String[]{"sweep", "tone"});
        EFFECT_PROBES.put("lowpass", new String[]{"sweep", "tone"});
        EFFECT_PROBES.put("presence", new String[]{"sweep"});

    @Test
    public void dumpParameterMatrix() throws Exception {
        String effectId = arg("FX_EFFECT");
        // Runs in the fx-verify workflow, one shard per effect. The normal unit
        // suite has no effect selected, so this test steps aside there.
        org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue(
                "FX_EFFECT not set: this shard test runs from fx-verify.yml",
                effectId != null && !effectId.isEmpty());
        boolean full = "1".equals(arg("FX_FULL"));
        int frames = full ? FULL_FRAMES : 12 * SR;
        int maxCases = intArg("FX_MAX_CASES", 1500);

        DspChain.EffectType type = null;
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            if (t.id.equals(effectId)) type = t;
        }
        if (type == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown effect " + effectId);

        File out = FxVerifySupport.outRoot(effectId);
        FxVerifySupport.WavData clip = FxVerifySupport.readFloatWav(
                FxVerifySupport.fixtureClip());

        AudioProcessor proto = FxRackChain.createProcessor(effectId);
        if (proto == null) throw new IllegalStateException("No processor " + effectId);
        List<FxParameter> params = proto.getParameters();
        boolean profiled = type.requiresLearnedProfile();
        String primary = FxVerifySupport.primaryParamId(type);

        // ---- plan the cases -------------------------------------------------
        Set<String> probesUsed = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        List<Case> cases = new ArrayList<>();
        for (FxParameter p : params) {
            String[] probes = probesFor(effectId, p.id, primary);
            for (String probe : probes) probesUsed.add(probe);
            int[] values = valuesFor(p);
            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                String[] modes = profiled
                        ? new String[]{"adaptive", "profiled"}
                        : new String[]{"plain"};
                for (String mode : modes) {
                    for (String probe : probes) {
                        Case c = new Case();
                        c.param = p.id;
                        c.paramName = p.name;
                        c.type = p.type.name();
                        c.unit = p.unit;
                        c.valueRaw = values[i];
                        c.valueDisplay = p.formatRaw(values[i]);
                        c.defaultRaw = p.defaultRaw;
                        c.isDefaultValue = values[i] == p.defaultRaw;
                        c.probe = probe;
                        c.mode = mode;
                        c.kind = "param";
                        c.id = sanitize(p.id + "_" + values[i] + "_" + probe
                                + ("plain".equals(mode) ? "" : "_" + mode));
                        cases.add(c);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Series: a five point walk of every continuous parameter, for
        // monotonicity evidence rather than a single point comparison.
        List<Case> series = new ArrayList<>();
        for (FxParameter p : params) {
            if (p.type != FxParameter.Type.INT && p.type != FxParameter.Type.FLOAT
                    && p.type != FxParameter.Type.CURVE_NODES) continue;
            if (p.maxRaw <= p.minRaw) continue;
            String probe = probesFor(effectId, p.id, primary)[0];
            probesUsed.add(probe);
            int[] vals = fiveSteps(p);
            for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
                Case c = new Case();
                c.param = p.id;
                c.paramName = p.name;
                c.type = p.type.name();
                c.unit = p.unit;
                c.valueRaw = vals[i];
                c.valueDisplay = p.formatRaw(vals[i]);
                c.defaultRaw = p.defaultRaw;
                c.isDefaultValue = vals[i] == p.defaultRaw;
                c.probe = probe;
                c.mode = profiled ? "profiled" : "plain";
                c.kind = "series";
                c.seriesIndex = i;
                c.id = sanitize("series_" + p.id + "_" + i);
                series.add(c);
            }
        }

        List<Case> all = new ArrayList<>(cases);
        all.addAll(series);
        if (all.size() > maxCases) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Shard " + effectId + " planned "
                    + all.size() + " cases, above FX_MAX_CASES=" + maxCases
                    + "; raise the cap or narrow the probe policy");
        }

        // ---- render the probes once ----------------------------------------
        JSONArray probeJson = new JSONArray();
        Map<String, File> dryFiles = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, Integer> probeFrames = new HashMap<>();
        for (String name : probesUsed) {
            int ch = FxVerifySupport.probeChannels(name);
            int n = frames;
            if ("clip".equals(name)) n = Math.min(frames, clip.frames);
            float[] buf = FxVerifySupport.buildProbe(name, n, ch, clip);
            File f = new File(out, "dry/" + name + ".wav");
            FxVerifySupport.writeFloatWav(f, buf, ch, SR);
            dryFiles.put(name, f);
            probeFrames.put(name, n);
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("name", name);
            o.put("channels", ch);
            o.put("frames", n);
            o.put("file", "dry/" + name + ".wav");
            o.put("description", FxVerifySupport.probeDescription(name));
            probeJson.put(o);
        }

        // ---- render the cases ----------------------------------------------
        JSONArray caseJson = new JSONArray();
        JSONArray errorJson = new JSONArray();
        int rendered = 0;
        for (Case c : all) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(effectId);
            if (p == null) throw new IllegalStateException("No processor " + effectId);
            for (FxParameter fp : p.getParameters()) fp.resetToDefault();
            String profileNote = "";
            if (profiled && "profiled".equals(c.mode)) {
                profileNote = installProfile(p, frames, clip);
                if (profileNote == null) c.mode = "adaptive";
            }
            FxParameter target = p.getParam(c.param);
            if (target == null) {
                errorJson.put("missing parameter " + c.param + " on " + effectId);
                continue;
            }
            target.setCurrentRaw(c.valueRaw);
            int ch = FxVerifySupport.probeChannels(c.probe);
            int n = probeFrames.get(c.probe);
            float[] in = FxVerifySupport.buildProbe(c.probe, n, ch, clip);

            JSONObject o = c.toJson();
            o.put("channels", ch);
            o.put("inFrames", n);
            o.put("dry", "dry/" + c.probe + ".wav");
            o.put("offlineOnly", p.isOfflineOnly());
            o.put("latencyFrames", p.getLatencyFrames());
            o.put("tailFrames", p.getTailFrames());
            o.put("handlesOwnWetDryMix", p.handlesOwnWetDryMix());
            if (!profileNote.isEmpty()) o.put("profile", profileNote);
            try {
                p.prepare(SR, ch);
                float[] result;
                if (p.isOfflineOnly()) {
                    float[] res = p.processOfflineRegion(in, n, ch);
                    if (res == null) {
                        o.put("skipped", "offline renderer returned null");
                        caseJson.put(o);
                        continue;
                    }
                    result = res;
                } else {
                    p.processInPlace(in, n, ch);
                    result = in;
                }
                int outFrames = result.length / Math.max(1, ch);
                File wet = new File(out, "wet/" + c.id + ".wav");
                FxVerifySupport.writeFloatWav(wet, result, ch, SR);
                o.put("wet", "wet/" + c.id + ".wav");
                o.put("outFrames", outFrames);
                rendered++;
            } catch (Throwable t) {
                o.put("error", t.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + t.getMessage());
                errorJson.put(c.id + " -> " + t.getClass().getSimpleName()
                        + ": " + t.getMessage());
            }
            caseJson.put(o);
        }

        JSONObject root = new JSONObject();
        root.put("effect", effectId);
        root.put("title", type.title);
        root.put("sampleRate", SR);
        root.put("frames", frames);
        root.put("fullLength", full);
        root.put("channels", FxVerifySupport.probeChannels("clip"));
        root.put("offlineOnly", proto.isOfflineOnly());
        root.put("requiresLearnedProfile", profiled);
        root.put("primaryParam", primary == null ? "" : primary);
        root.put("paramCount", params.size());
        root.put("caseCount", caseJson.length());
        root.put("rendered", rendered);
        root.put("probes", probeJson);
        root.put("cases", caseJson);
        root.put("errors", errorJson);

        File manifest = new File(out, "cases.json");
        write(manifest, root.toString());
        System.out.println("FX matrix " + effectId + ": " + rendered + "/"
                + caseJson.length() + " cases rendered, " + errorJson.length()
                + " errors, probes=" + probesUsed);
        if (errorJson.length() > 0) {
            System.out.println("FX matrix errors: " + errorJson);
        }
    }

    /** Installs a learned noise profile; returns the note, or null when absent. */
    private static String installProfile(AudioProcessor p, int frames,
                                         FxVerifySupport.WavData clip) {
        float[] noise = FxVerifySupport.buildProbe("noise", frames, 1, clip);
        if (p instanceof NoiseSuppressionProcessor) {
            float[] prof = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(noise, 1);
            if (prof == null) return null;
            ((NoiseSuppressionProcessor) p).setNoiseProfile(prof);
            return "noise profile learned from the noise probe";
        }
        if (p instanceof SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor) {
            float[] prof = SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor.learnProfile(noise, 1);
            if (prof == null) return null;
            ((SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor) p).setNoiseProfile(prof);
            return "noise profile learned from the noise probe";
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String[] probesFor(String effectId, String paramId,
                                      String primary) {
        String[] override = PARAM_PROBES.get(effectId + "." + paramId);
        String[] base = override != null ? override
                : EFFECT_PROBES.getOrDefault(effectId, DEFAULT_PROBES);
        boolean isPrimary = primary != null && primary.equals(paramId);
        if (!isPrimary || Arrays.asList(base).contains("clip")) return base;
        // The uploaded clip is part of the evidence for every effect, so the
        // headline control always gets it in addition to the specialised probe.
        List<String> merged = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(base));
        merged.add("clip");
        return merged.toArray(new String[0]);
    }

    /** Candidate values for one parameter: bounds, plus every enum state. */
    private static int[] valuesFor(FxParameter p) {
        switch (p.type) {
            case BOOLEAN:
                return new int[]{0, 1};
            case ENUM: {
                int n = p.enumLabels == null ? 1 : p.enumLabels.length;
                int[] out = new int[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = p.clampRaw(i);
                return out;
            }
            case ACTION:
                return new int[]{1};
            default: {
                int[] raw = {p.clampRaw(p.minRaw), p.clampRaw(p.defaultRaw),
                        p.clampRaw(p.maxRaw)};
                return raw;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int[] fiveSteps(FxParameter p) {
        int[] out = new int[5];
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            long v = p.minRaw + Math.round((p.maxRaw - p.minRaw) * (i / 4.0));
            out[i] = p.clampRaw((int) v);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static String sanitize(String s) {
        return s.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_");
    }

    private static String arg(String key) {
        String env = System.getenv(key);
        if (env != null && !env.isEmpty()) return env;
        return System.getProperty(key.toLowerCase().replace('_', '.'), null);
    }

    private static int intArg(String key, int def) {
        String v = arg(key);
        if (v == null || v.isEmpty()) return def;
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(v.trim());
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return def;
        }
    }

    private static void write(File f, String text) throws Exception {
        File parent = f.getParentFile();
        if (parent != null) parent.mkdirs();
        try (Writer w = new OutputStreamWriter(new FileOutputStream(f),
                StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            w.write(text);
        }
    }

    /** One planned render. */
    private static final class Case {
        String id;
        String kind;
        String param;
        String paramName;
        String type;
        String unit;
        int valueRaw;
        String valueDisplay;
        int defaultRaw;
        boolean isDefaultValue;
        String probe;
        String mode;
        int seriesIndex = -1;

        JSONObject toJson() throws Exception {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("id", id);
            o.put("kind", kind);
            o.put("param", param);
            o.put("paramName", paramName);
            o.put("type", type);
            o.put("unit", unit);
            o.put("valueRaw", valueRaw);
            o.put("valueDisplay", valueDisplay);
            o.put("defaultRaw", defaultRaw);
            o.put("isDefaultValue", isDefaultValue);
            o.put("probe", probe);
            o.put("mode", mode);
            if (seriesIndex >= 0) o.put("seriesIndex", seriesIndex);
            return o;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

/**
 * A one-decimal control must move by a visible amount per drag tick.
 *
 * <p>Fixed-point parameters are stored in raw counts, so their storage
 * granularity is far finer than anything the label can show. Dragging with
 * the storage granularity made controls like a Q of 25.0 or a 0.1 dB
 * threshold crawl: the value changed, but the displayed number barely moved.
 */
public class FxParameterStepTest {

    @Test
    public void aOneDecimalControlStepsByATenthPerTick() {
        FxParameter q = FxParameter.floatParam("q", "Q", "", 0.5f, 12f, 2.5f);
        // 0.01 displayed units per tick is invisible; 0.1 is a decimal place.
        assertEquals("The drag step must show a decimal place",
                10, q.interactionStepRaw());
        assertEquals("One step is 0.1 in display units",
                0.1f, q.interactionStepRaw() / (float) q.scaleDivisor, 0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void aWideDecibelControlStepsByHalfADBPerTick() {
        FxParameter thr = FxParameter.dbParam("t", "Threshold",
                -60f, -1f, -18f);
        assertEquals("A wide dB control moves in 0.5 dB steps",
                50, thr.interactionStepRaw());
    }

    @Test
    public void anIntegerControlKeepsItsOwnStep() {
        FxParameter bands = FxParameter.intParam("b", "Bands", "",
                0, 12, 1, 3);
        assertEquals("An integer control steps by its own step",
                1, bands.interactionStepRaw());
        FxParameter time = FxParameter.intParam("t", "Time", " ms",
                10, 3000, 10, 300);
        assertEquals("A stepped integer control keeps its step",
                10, time.interactionStepRaw());
    }

    @Test
    public void theStepNeverCoarsensBeyondTheParameterRange() {
        FxParameter tiny = FxParameter.floatParam("t", "Tiny", "",
                0f, 0.05f, 0.01f);
        assertTrue("The step must stay inside the range",
                tiny.interactionStepRaw() <= tiny.maxRaw - tiny.minRaw);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * End-to-end checks for the persisted FX rack used by StudioFragment:
 * every legacy effect must survive save/load, produce an audible change
 * through DspChain, and disappear cleanly from a live chain when Apply resets
 * the rack.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxPipelineTest {

    private static float[] probeTone(DspChain.EffectType type) {
        int frames = 4800;
        float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
        float amp = type == DspChain.EffectType.ROOM_GATE ? 0.003f : 0.5f;
        double hz = 229.0;
        if (type == DspChain.EffectType.DE_ESSER) hz = 6000.0;
        if (type == DspChain.EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF) hz = 60.0;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (amp * Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / 48000.0));
            buf[f * 2] = s;
            buf[f * 2 + 1] = s;
        }
        return buf;
    }

    private static boolean differs(float[] a, float[] b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(a[i] - b[i]) > 1e-4f) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean finite(float[] a) {
        for (float v : a) {
            if (!Float.isFinite(v)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Test
    public void everyLegacyEffectSurvivesSaveLoadAndProcessesAudio() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        for (DspChain.EffectType type : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            if (!type.isLegacyStage()) continue;
            DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
            cfg.slots.clear();
            cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(type, true,
                    type.defaultVal, false));
            cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
            cfg.save(ctx);
            DspChain.Config loaded = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
            assertTrue("Loaded rack lost " + type.id, loaded.isActive());

            DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, loaded);
            assertTrue("Chain inactive for " + type.id, chain.isActive());
            float[] wet = probeTone(type);
            float[] dry = wet.clone();
            chain.processInPlace(wet, 4800);
            assertTrue("Non-finite output from " + type.id, finite(wet));
            assertTrue("Persisted " + type.id + " produced no audio change",
                    differs(wet, dry));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void clearingTheRackMakesALiveChainDryAgain() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, true, 100, false));
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        assertTrue(chain.isActive());

        float[] first = probeTone(DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER);
        chain.processInPlace(first, 4800);
        assertTrue(chain.isActive());

        cfg.clearRack();
        assertEquals(0, cfg.slots.size());
        assertFalse(cfg.isActive());
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_OFF, cfg.mode);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL.id, cfg.activePresetId);

        chain.updateConfig(cfg);
        assertFalse(chain.isActive());
        float[] second = probeTone(DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER);
        float[] before = second.clone();
        chain.processInPlace(second, 4800);
        for (int i = 0; i < second.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("cleared chain touched sample " + i,
                    before[i], second[i], 0.0f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void secondaryParametersSurviveSaveLoad() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        DspChain.EffectSlot deess = new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 65, true);
        deess.extraParams.put("deess_freq", 7500);
        deess.extraParams.put("deess_width", 50);
        deess.extraParams.put("deess_mode", 1);
        cfg.slots.add(deess);
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        cfg.save(ctx);

        DspChain.Config loaded = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
        assertEquals(1, loaded.slots.size());
        DspChain.EffectSlot back = loaded.slots.get(0);
        assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(7500),
                back.extraParams.get("deess_freq"));
        assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(50),
                back.extraParams.get("deess_width"));
        assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(1), back.extraParams.get("deess_mode"));

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, loaded);
        ProDeEsserProcessor p = (ProDeEsserProcessor) chain.getRack()
                .getProcessor(chain.getRack().indexOf("deess"));
        assertEquals(7500, p.getParam("deess_freq").getCurrentRaw());
        assertEquals(50, p.getParam("deess_width").getCurrentRaw());
        assertEquals(1, p.getParam("deess_mode").getCurrentRaw());
    }

    @Test
    public void previewConfigSeparatesWetAndDryPlayback() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 40, false));
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        assertTrue(cfg.isActive());

        assertTrue("Play/Pause must stay dry",
                !StudioFragment.previewConfigFor(false,
                        false, false, false, cfg).isActive());
        assertTrue("FX Preview must run the live rack",
                StudioFragment.previewConfigFor(true,
                        false, false, false, cfg).isActive());
        assertTrue("A baked take must not be processed twice",
                !StudioFragment.previewConfigFor(true,
                        true, false, false, cfg).isActive());
        assertTrue("A fresh selection may preview after a sub-range bake",
                StudioFragment.previewConfigFor(true,
                        true, true, true, cfg).isActive());
        assertTrue("A selection is required after a sub-range bake",
                !StudioFragment.previewConfigFor(true,
                        true, true, false, cfg).isActive());
    }
}
