package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.json.JSONObject;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Modular-rack contract: ordering, bypass, wet/dry blending, safety limiting
 * and JSON/SharedPreferences persistence must behave as documented.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxRackChainTest {

    private static float[] tone(int frames, int ch, float amp, float step) {
        float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) Math.sin(f * step) * amp;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return buf;
    }

    private static float[] sineAt(int frames, float amp, double hz) {
        return tone(frames, 1, amp, (float) (2 * Math.PI * hz / 48000.0));
    }

    private static double rmsTail(float[] buf) {
        int from = buf.length / 2;
        double sum = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < buf.length; i++) sum += buf[i] * buf[i];
        return Math.sqrt(sum / Math.max(1, buf.length - from));
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------- rack mechanics

    @Test
    public void inactiveLegacyConfigLeavesBufferUntouched() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        FxRackChain rack = chain.getRack();
        assertNotNull(rack);
        assertFalse(rack.isActive());
        float[] buf = tone(777, 2, 0.9f, 0.05f);
        float[] before = buf.clone();
        rack.processInPlace(buf, 777);
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            assertEquals(before[i], buf[i], 0.0f);
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------- rack mechanics

    @Test
    public void moveProcessorReordersRackAndGuardsBounds() {
        FxRackChain rack = new FxRackChain(2);
        rack.addProcessor(new ProHpfProcessor());
        rack.addProcessor(new NoiseSuppressionProcessor());
        rack.addProcessor(new ProGateProcessor());
        assertEquals("hpf", rack.getProcessor(0).getId());
        assertEquals("noise", rack.getProcessor(1).getId());
        assertEquals("gate", rack.getProcessor(2).getId());

        assertTrue(rack.moveProcessor(0, 2));
        assertEquals("noise", rack.getProcessor(0).getId());
        assertEquals("gate", rack.getProcessor(1).getId());
        assertEquals("hpf", rack.getProcessor(2).getId());
        assertEquals(0, rack.indexOf("noise"));
        assertEquals(2, rack.indexOf("hpf"));

        assertFalse(rack.moveProcessor(0, 0));
        assertFalse(rack.moveProcessor(-1, 0));
        assertFalse(rack.moveProcessor(0, 99));
        assertFalse(rack.moveProcessor(2, 99));
        assertEquals(3, rack.size());

        assertEquals("hpf", rack.removeProcessor(2).getId());
        assertEquals(2, rack.size());
        assertNull(rack.removeProcessor(5));
    }

    @Test
    public void bypassedProcessorLeavesSignalBitIdentical() {
        final int frames = 512;
        float[] input = tone(frames, 2, 0.8f, 0.04f);

        NoiseSuppressionProcessor noise = new NoiseSuppressionProcessor();
        noise.setLegacyAmount(80);
        assertTrue(noise.isAudible());

        FxRackChain rack = new FxRackChain(2);
        rack.addProcessor(noise);
        assertTrue(rack.isActive());

        float[] wet = input.clone();
        rack.processInPlace(wet, frames);
        boolean changed = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < wet.length; i++) {
            if (Float.compare(wet[i], input[i]) != 0) {
                changed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("enabled noise stage did nothing", changed);

        noise.setEnabled(false);
        assertFalse(noise.isAudible());
        assertFalse(rack.isActive());
        float[] dry = input.clone();
        rack.processInPlace(dry, frames);
        for (int i = 0; i < dry.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("bypassed stage touched @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(input[i]),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(dry[i]));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void wetDryMixBlendsExactlyHalfAndHalf() {
        final int frames = 256;
        float[] input = tone(frames, 2, 0.9f, 0.037f);

        ProToneProcessor wetProc = new ProToneProcessor();
        wetProc.setLegacyAmounts(70, 60);
        FxRackChain wetRack = new FxRackChain(2);
        wetRack.addProcessor(wetProc);
        float[] wet = input.clone();
        wetRack.processInPlace(wet, frames);

        ProToneProcessor halfProc = new ProToneProcessor();
        halfProc.setLegacyAmounts(70, 60);
        halfProc.setWetDryMix(0.5f);
        FxRackChain halfRack = new FxRackChain(2);
        halfRack.addProcessor(halfProc);
        float[] half = input.clone();
        halfRack.processInPlace(half, frames);

        for (int i = 0; i < half.length; i++) {
            float expected = input[i] * 0.5f + wet[i] * 0.5f;
            assertEquals("blend mismatch @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(expected),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(half[i]));
        }

        // A zero mix is a pure dry pass.
        ProToneProcessor offProc = new ProToneProcessor();
        offProc.setLegacyAmounts(70, 60);
        offProc.setWetDryMix(0f);
        FxRackChain offRack = new FxRackChain(2);
        offRack.addProcessor(offProc);
        float[] off = input.clone();
        offRack.processInPlace(off, frames);
        for (int i = 0; i < off.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("zero mix touched @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(input[i]),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(off[i]));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- serialization

    @Test
    public void jsonRoundTripPreservesOrderEnableMixAndParams() throws Exception {
        FxRackChain rack = FxRackChain.fromLegacyConfig(2,
                DspChain.Config.voicePolish());
        AudioProcessor hpf = rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("hpf"));
        AudioProcessor noise = rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("noise"));
        assertNotNull(hpf);
        assertNotNull(noise);
        hpf.setWetDryMix(0.25f);
        noise.setEnabled(false);
        noise.getParam("amt").setCurrentRaw(75);
        rack.addProcessor(FxRackChain.createProcessor("limiter"));

        JSONObject json = rack.toJson();
        FxRackChain back = FxRackChain.fromJson(2, json);

        assertEquals(rack.size(), back.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < rack.size(); i++) {
            AudioProcessor a = rack.getProcessor(i);
            AudioProcessor b = back.getProcessor(i);
            assertNotNull("missing " + a.getId(), b);
            assertEquals(a.getId(), b.getId());
            assertEquals("enabled " + a.getId(),
                    a.isEnabled(), b.isEnabled());
            assertEquals("mix " + a.getId(),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(a.getWetDryMix()),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(b.getWetDryMix()));
            for (FxParameter pa : a.getParameters()) {
                FxParameter pb = b.getParam(pa.id);
                assertNotNull("missing param " + pa.id, pb);
                assertEquals("raw " + pa.id,
                        pa.getCurrentRaw(), pb.getCurrentRaw());
            }
        }
        assertEquals(0.25f,
                back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("hpf")).getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);
        assertFalse(back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("noise")).isEnabled());
        assertEquals(75, back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("noise"))
                .getParam("amt").getCurrentRaw());
    }

    }

    @Test
    public void slotWetDryAndExtraParamsPersist() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);

            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION) loaded = s;

    @Test
    public void slotWetDryDrivesProcessorMixThroughUpdateConfig() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION) {
                s.wetDry = 0.25f;
            }
        }
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        AudioProcessor noise =
                chain.getRack().getProcessor(chain.getRack().indexOf("noise"));
        assertEquals(0.25f, noise.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);

        // Live edit path: the FX inspector mutates the slot and calls
        // updateConfig, which must re-push the mix.
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION) {
                s.wetDry = 0.75f;
            }
        }
        chain.updateConfig(cfg);
        assertEquals(0.75f, noise.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void warmthAndPresenceShareOneToneProcessorWithoutSlotMix() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.WARM_VOCAL);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        FxRackChain rack = chain.getRack();

        // Both slots map to the single combined tone stage, which stays fully
        // wet regardless of slot mixes.
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            s.wetDry = 0.1f;

        chain.updateConfig(cfg);

        assertEquals(1.0f, toneProc.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);

    }

    @Test
    public void limiterActsAsSafetyCeilingForGainStagesAlone() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        FxRackChain rack = chain.getRack();
        AudioProcessor limiter =
                rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("limiter"));
        assertNotNull(limiter);
        // Compressor alone must arm the safety limiter even at drive 0.
        assertTrue(limiter.isEnabled());
        assertTrue(limiter.isAudible());

        // A loud tone is soft-clipped by the 0.82 ceiling after makeup gain.
        float[] buf = new float[960];
        for (int f = 0; f < buf.length; f++) {
            buf[f] = 0.95f * (float) Math.sin(f * 0.11);
        }
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 960);
        for (float v : buf) {
            assertTrue(Float.isFinite(v));
            assertTrue("unbounded " + v, Math.abs(v) < 1.02f);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ live state

    @Test
    public void liveConfigUpdatePreservesFilterState() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        float[] warm = tone(2048, 1, 0.8f, 0.043f);
        chain.processInPlace(warm, 2048);

        // Change the HPF cutoff live: coefficients update, but the biquad's
        // z-history must survive (the original engine never reset state).
        DspChain.Config next = new DspChain.Config();
        next.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        next.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF);
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : next.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF) s.value = 150;
        }
        chain.updateConfig(next);

        float[] hot = tone(256, 1, 0.8f, 0.043f);
        float[] carried = hot.clone();
        chain.processInPlace(carried, 256);

        DspChain fresh = new DspChain(1, next);
        float[] cold = hot.clone();
        fresh.processInPlace(cold, 256);

        // Fresh chain starts from zero z-state, so a live update that kept
        // state MUST differ (unless the signal is silent, which it is not).
        boolean anyDiff = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < carried.length; i++) {
            if (Float.compare(carried[i], cold[i]) != 0) {
                anyDiff = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("live update reset the filter state", anyDiff);
        for (float v : carried) assertTrue(Float.isFinite(v));
    }


    // ----------------------------------------- Stage 2 audit regression tests

    @Test
    public void slotReorderingChangesRackExecutionOrderAndAudioOutput() {
        // BUG-01 regression: reordering cfg.slots must reorder rack processors
        // and produce distinct audio when nonlinear stages change order.
        DspChain.Config cfgA = new DspChain.Config();
        cfgA.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        cfgA.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        cfgA.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfgA.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY) s.value = 85;
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR) s.value = 85;
        }
        DspChain chainA = new DspChain(1, cfgA);
        assertTrue(chainA.getRack().indexOf("tone")
                < chainA.getRack().indexOf("comp"));

        // Swap slot order in-place (Compressor BEFORE Warmth) and call updateConfig
        DspChain.Config cfgB = new DspChain.Config();
        cfgB.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        cfgB.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        cfgB.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfgB.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY) s.value = 85;
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR) s.value = 85;
        }
        DspChain chainB = new DspChain(1, cfgB);
        assertTrue(chainB.getRack().indexOf("comp")
                < chainB.getRack().indexOf("tone"));

        float[] sigA = tone(1024, 1, 0.6f, 0.05f);
        float[] sigB = sigA.clone();
        chainA.processInPlace(sigA, 1024);
        chainB.processInPlace(sigB, 1024);

        boolean diff = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < sigA.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(sigA[i] - sigB[i]) > 1e-4f) {
                diff = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("Reordering compressor before tone had no effect on audio", diff);
    }

    @Test
    public void primarySlotParamCannotBeOverwrittenByStaleExtraParams() {
        // BUG-02 regression: the limiter's primary "drive" param
        // must be driven by slot.value and never clobbered by slot.extraParams.
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);

                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER);

    }

    @Test
    public void safetyLimiterCeilingHoldsEvenWhenLimiterSlotMixIsZeroOrUnchecked() {
        // BUG-03 regression: upstream gain stages (Warmth + Presence + Comp)
        // must never clip past the brickwall safety ceiling even if a
        // BRICKWALL_LIMITER slot has wetDry < 1.0f or is unchecked.
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot w = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        DspChain.EffectSlot p = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE);
        DspChain.EffectSlot c = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain.EffectSlot l = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER);
        w.value = 100;
        p.value = 100;
        c.value = 100;
        l.value = 50;
        l.wetDry = 0.0f; // 0% drive mix on limiter slot

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        float[] hot = tone(1024, 1, 0.95f, 0.09f);
        chain.processInPlace(hot, 1024);
        for (int i = 0; i < hot.length; i++) {
            assertTrue("Sample clipped past safety ceiling @" + i + ": " + hot[i],
                    Math.abs(hot[i]) <= 0.99f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void removingSlotResetsProcessorWetDryMixToDefault() {
        // BUG-04 regression: removing a slot with wetDry = 0.2f must reset the
        // backing processor's wetDryMix back to 1.0f on updateConfig.
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        DspChain.EffectSlot noiseSlot = null;
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION) noiseSlot = s;
        }
        assertNotNull(noiseSlot);
        noiseSlot.wetDry = 0.2f;

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        AudioProcessor noiseProc = chain.getRack().getProcessor(
                chain.getRack().indexOf("noise"));
        assertEquals(0.2f, noiseProc.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);

        cfg.removeSlot(noiseSlot);
        chain.updateConfig(cfg);
        assertEquals(1.0f, noiseProc.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);
    }

    @Test

        cfg.noisePct = 65;

        assertEquals(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR, cfg.slots.get(0).type);
        assertEquals(0.4f, cfg.slots.get(0).wetDry, 0.0f);

                cfg.slots.get(0).extraParams.get("custom_knob"));
    }

    @Test
    public void setSampleRateUpdatesBiquadFilterResponse() {
        // Sample-rate changes must retune the biquad stages.
        // recompute coefficients when FxRackChain.setSampleRate is called.
        FxRackChain rack48 = new FxRackChain(1);
        ProHpfProcessor hpf48 = new ProHpfProcessor();
        hpf48.setLegacyState(true, 150);
        rack48.addProcessor(hpf48);
        rack48.setSampleRate(48000);

        FxRackChain rack96 = new FxRackChain(1);
        ProHpfProcessor hpf96 = new ProHpfProcessor();
        hpf96.setLegacyState(true, 150);

        rack96.processInPlace(b, 256);

            if (Math.abs(a[i] - b[i]) > 1e-4f) {
                diff = true;
                break;

    @Test

    @Test
    public void separatingWarmthAndPresenceAroundCompressorChangesAudioOutput() {
        // Order 1: [WARMTH, PRESENCE, COMPRESSOR] (both before Compressor)
        DspChain.Config cfg1 = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg1.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot w1 = cfg1.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        DspChain.EffectSlot p1 = cfg1.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE);
        DspChain.EffectSlot c1 = cfg1.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        w1.value = 85;
        p1.value = 85;
        c1.value = 85;
        cfg1.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();

        // Order 2: [WARMTH, COMPRESSOR, PRESENCE] (Presence moved after Compressor)
        DspChain.Config cfg2 = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg2.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot w2 = cfg2.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        DspChain.EffectSlot c2 = cfg2.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain.EffectSlot p2 = cfg2.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE);
        w2.value = 85;
        p2.value = 85;
        c2.value = 85;
        cfg2.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();

        float[] sig1 = tone(1024, 1, 0.55f, 0.06f);
        for (int i = 0; i < sig1.length; i += 5) {
            sig1[i] += 0.35f * (float) Math.sin(i * 0.65);
        }
        float[] sig2 = sig1.clone();

        new DspChain(1, cfg1).processInPlace(sig1, 1024);
        new DspChain(1, cfg2).processInPlace(sig2, 1024);

        boolean diff = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < sig1.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(sig1[i] - sig2[i]) > 1e-4f) {
                diff = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("Moving Presence after Compressor had no effect on audio", diff);
    }

    @Test
    public void disabledToneSlotDoesNotTrapEnabledSiblingPosition() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot w = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        DspChain.EffectSlot c = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain.EffectSlot p = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE);
        w.enabled = false;
        c.enabled = true;
        p.enabled = true;
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        assertTrue("Disabled Warmth at slot 0 must not trap enabled Presence before Compressor",
                chain.getRack().indexOf("comp") < chain.getRack().indexOf("tone"));
    }

    @Test
    public void syncSlotsFromLegacyFieldsPreservesDisabledSlotsAndTheirSettings() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.PODCAST_BROADCAST);
        DspChain.EffectSlot gateSlot = null;
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.ROOM_GATE) gateSlot = s;
        }
        assertNotNull(gateSlot);
        gateSlot.enabled = false;
        gateSlot.value = 65;
        gateSlot.wetDry = 0.4f;
        gateSlot.extraParams.put("hold_ms", 120);
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();

        cfg.noisePct = 70;
        cfg.onManualAdjustment();

        DspChain.EffectSlot preserved = null;
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.ROOM_GATE) preserved = s;
        }
        assertNotNull("Disabled ROOM_GATE slot was dropped by syncSlotsFromLegacyFields",
                preserved);
        assertFalse(preserved.enabled);
        assertEquals(65, preserved.value);
        assertEquals(0.4f, preserved.wetDry, 0.0f);
        assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(120), preserved.extraParams.get("hold_ms"));
    }

    @Test
    public void setSampleRateRetunesToneStage() {
        FxRackChain tone48 = new FxRackChain(1);
        ProToneProcessor tp48 = new ProToneProcessor();

        tone48.addProcessor(tp48);

        ProToneProcessor tp96 = new ProToneProcessor();

        tone96.addProcessor(tp96);
        tone96.setSampleRate(96000);

        float[] tA = tone(256, 1, 0.6f, 0.04f);
        float[] tB = tA.clone();
        tone48.processInPlace(tA, 256);
        tone96.processInPlace(tB, 256);
        boolean toneDiff = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < tA.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(tA[i] - tB[i]) > 1e-4f) {
                toneDiff = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("ProToneProcessor ignored sample rate change", toneDiff);

    }

    @Test

    @Test

        db.setCurrentRaw(-350);

        db.setCurrentRaw(-5);

    @Test
    public void toneTargetsFollowLegacyAmountsChangedAfterPrepare() {
        ProToneProcessor tone = new ProToneProcessor();
        tone.prepare(48000, 1);
        tone.setLegacyAmounts(0, 90);

        float[] high = sineAt(4096, 0.2f, 5000.0);
        double before = rmsTail(high);
        tone.processInPlace(high, 4096, 1);
        double after = rmsTail(high);
        assertTrue("post-prepare presence change was ignored: "
                        + before + " -> " + after,
                after > before * 1.8);
    }

    @Test
    public void splitPresenceStillRunsWhenMiddleEqIsInaudible() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY).value = 40;
        DspChain.EffectSlot eq =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.PARAMETRIC_EQ6);
        eq.value = 0;
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE).value = 90;
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        assertEquals("eq6", chain.getSplitToneAfterId());
        ParametricEq6BandProcessor eqProc =
                (ParametricEq6BandProcessor) chain.getRack().getProcessor(
                        chain.getRack().indexOf("eq6"));
        assertNotNull(eqProc);
        eqProc.getParam("b1f").setCurrentRaw(20);
        assertFalse("test must exercise the inaudible anchor path",
                eqProc.isAudible());

        float[] high = sineAt(2048, 0.2f, 5000.0);
        double before = rmsTail(high);
        chain.getRack().processInPlace(high, 2048);
        double after = rmsTail(high);
        assertTrue("second tone stage skipped across an inaudible eq6: "
                        + before + " -> " + after,
                after > before * 1.15);
    }

    @Test
    public void splitPresenceAfterLimiterStillHonoursSafetyCeiling() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY).value = 100;
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER).value = 50;
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.PARAMETRIC_EQ6).value = 0;
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE).value = 100;
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        assertEquals("eq6", chain.getSplitToneAfterId());
        ParametricEq6BandProcessor eqProc =
                (ParametricEq6BandProcessor) chain.getRack().getProcessor(
                        chain.getRack().indexOf("eq6"));
        assertNotNull(eqProc);
        eqProc.getParam("b1f").setCurrentRaw(20);
        assertFalse(eqProc.isAudible());

        float[] hot = sineAt(2048, 0.95f, 5000.0);
        chain.getRack().processInPlace(hot, 2048);
        for (int i = 0; i < hot.length; i++) {
            assertTrue("split second stage bypassed safety ceiling at "
                            + i + ": " + hot[i],
                    Math.abs(hot[i]) < 0.99f);
        }
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * A rack with two copies of the same effect must survive a save and load
 * with both entries intact, their identities distinct and their parameters
 * unmixed.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxRackDuplicatesPersistenceTest {

    @Test
    public void duplicateCopiesSurviveASaveAndLoadRoundTrip() throws Exception {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot first =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB);
        DspChain.EffectSlot second =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB);
        first.value = 30;
        second.value = 80;
        first.extraParams.put("rv_decay", 20);
        second.extraParams.put("rv_decay", 90);

        // Round-trip through the persisted JSON form.
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("id", s.type.id);
            o.put("iid", s.instanceId);
            o.put("en", s.enabled);
            o.put("val", s.value);
            o.put("mix", (double) s.wetDry);
            JSONObject p = new JSONObject();
            for (java.util.Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : s.extraParams.entrySet()) {
                p.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
            }
            o.put("params", p);
            arr.put(o);
        }

        DspChain.Config loaded = new DspChain.Config();
        loaded.slots.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject o = arr.getJSONObject(i);
            DspChain.EffectType t = DspChain.EffectType.byId(
                    o.optString("id", "noise"));
            DspChain.EffectSlot s = new DspChain.EffectSlot(t,
                    o.optBoolean("en", true), o.optInt("val", t.defaultVal),
                    false, o.optLong("iid", 0L));
            JSONObject p = o.optJSONObject("params");
            if (p != null) {
                java.util.Iterator<String> keys = p.keys();
                while (keys.hasNext()) {
                    String k = keys.next();
                    s.extraParams.put(k, p.optInt(k));
                }
            }
            loaded.slots.add(s);
        }
        assertEquals("Both copies survive the round trip", 2, loaded.slots.size());
        assertNotEquals("Identities stay distinct",
                loaded.slots.get(0).instanceId, loaded.slots.get(1).instanceId);
        assertEquals(30, loaded.slots.get(0).value);
        assertEquals(80, loaded.slots.get(1).value);
        assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(20),
                loaded.slots.get(0).extraParams.get("rv_decay"));
        assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(90),
                loaded.slots.get(1).extraParams.get("rv_decay"));
    }

    @Test
    public void aRestoredRackRebuildsOneProcessorPerCopy() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot first =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB);
        first.value = 30;

        // A restored rack is rebuilt from the persisted JSON, so the copy
        // identities have to survive for the processors to stay separate.
        DspChain.Config restored = new DspChain.Config();
        restored.slots.clear();
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            restored.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(s.type, s.enabled,
                    s.value, s.expanded, s.instanceId));
        }
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, restored);
        int reverbs = 0;
        for (AudioProcessor p : chain.getRack().processors()) {
            if ("reverb".equals(p.getId())) reverbs++;
        }
        assertEquals("Each copy gets its own processor", 2, reverbs);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * The FX rack must let the same effect be inserted twice, with each copy
 * keeping its own parameters, and the catalog must stay navigable.
 */
public class FxRackDuplicatesTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Test
    public void theSameEffectCanBeAddedTwice() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot first =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain.EffectSlot second =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR);
        assertNotNull(first);
        assertNotNull(second);
        assertNotEquals("A second copy must be a new rack entry",
                first, second);
        assertNotEquals("Each copy needs its own identity",
                first.instanceId, second.instanceId);
        assertEquals("Both copies live in the rack", 2, cfg.slots.size());
    }

    @Test
    public void duplicateCopiesKeepIndependentParameters() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot first =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain.EffectSlot second =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR);
        first.value = -600;
        second.value = -3000;

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        int comps = 0;
        for (AudioProcessor p : chain.getRack().processors()) {
            if (!"dyncomp".equals(p.getId())) continue;
            comps++;
            FxParameter thr = p.getParam("dyncomp_thresh");
            assertNotNull("The compressor must expose its threshold", thr);
        }
        assertEquals("Both copies need their own processor", 2, comps);

        // Changing one copy must not touch the other.
        cfg.slots.get(0).value = -1200;
        chain.updateConfig(cfg);
        int[] seen = new int[2];
        int i = 0;
        for (AudioProcessor p : chain.getRack().processors()) {
            if (!"dyncomp".equals(p.getId())) continue;
            if (i < 2) seen[i++] = p.getParam("dyncomp_thresh").getCurrentRaw();
        }
        assertEquals("The first copy keeps its own value", -1200, seen[0]);
        assertEquals("The second copy keeps its own value", -3000, seen[1]);
    }

    @Test
    public void legacyStagesCanAlsoBeStackedMultipleTimes() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot first =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain.EffectSlot second =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        assertNotEquals("Legacy stages can be stacked multiple times", first, second);
        assertEquals("Both copies live in the rack", 2, cfg.slots.size());
        first.value = 35;
        second.value = 75;
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        int comps = 0;
        for (AudioProcessor p : chain.getRack().processors()) {
            if ("comp".equals(p.getId()) && p.isEnabled()) comps++;
        }
        assertEquals("Both stacked legacy copies have active processors", 2, comps);
    }

    @Test
    public void removingOneCopyLeavesTheOtherInPlace() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot first =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB);
        assertEquals(2, cfg.slots.size());

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        int before = 0;
        for (AudioProcessor p : chain.getRack().processors()) {
            if ("reverb".equals(p.getId())) before++;
        }
        assertEquals("Two processors for two copies", 2, before);

        cfg.removeSlot(first);
        chain.updateConfig(cfg);
        int after = 0;
        for (AudioProcessor p : chain.getRack().processors()) {
            if ("reverb".equals(p.getId())) after++;
        }
        assertEquals("The removed copy drops its processor", 1, after);
    }

    @Test
    public void theCatalogIsOrderedAlphabetically() {
        // The Add Effect menu lists the catalog by title, so the list is
        // sorted the same way the dialog sorts it.
        DspChain.EffectType[] all = DspChain.EffectType.values();
        java.util.List<DspChain.EffectType> sorted =
                new java.util.ArrayList<>(java.util.Arrays.asList(all));
        java.util.Collections.sort(sorted,
                new java.util.Comparator<DspChain.EffectType>() {
                    @Override
                    public int compare(DspChain.EffectType a,
                                       DspChain.EffectType b) {
                        return a.title.compareToIgnoreCase(b.title);
                    }
                });
        for (int i = 1; i < sorted.size(); i++) {
            assertTrue("Titles must sort ascending: "
                            + sorted.get(i - 1).title + " then "
                            + sorted.get(i).title,
                    sorted.get(i - 1).title.compareToIgnoreCase(
                            sorted.get(i).title) <= 0);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Shared plumbing for the FX verification harness: where artifacts go, how the
 * deterministic probes are synthesised, and 32-bit float WAV I/O that matches
 * the app's own working format.
 */
public final class FxVerifySupport {

    private FxVerifySupport() {}

    /** Every probe the matrix can render through an effect. */
    public static final String[] PROBES = {
            "clip", "tone", "sweep", "noise", "impulse", "clicks",
            "hum", "clipped", "gaps", "plosive", "stereo", "silence",
            "sibilant"};

    public static int probeChannels(String name) {
        return "stereo".equals(name) ? 2 : 1;
    }

    /** Repo root, found by walking up from the test working directory. */
    public static File repoRoot() {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("user.dir", ".")).getAbsoluteFile();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6 && dir != null; i++) {
            if (new File(dir, "settings.gradle").isFile()) return dir;
            dir = dir.getParentFile();
        }
        return new File(System.getProperty("user.dir", ".")).getAbsoluteFile();
    }

    /** Artifact directory: {@code $FX_OUT} when set, else app/build/fxverify. */
    public static File outRoot(String sub) {
        String env = System.getenv("FX_OUT");
        File base = (env != null && !env.isEmpty())
                ? new File(env)
                : new File(repoRoot(), "app/build/fxverify");
        File dir = (sub == null || sub.isEmpty()) ? base : new File(base, sub);
        dir.mkdirs();
        return dir;
    }

    /** The uploaded verification clip, committed as a harness fixture. */
    public static File fixtureClip() {
        File f = new File(repoRoot(), "tools/fxverify/fixtures/take2_48k_f32.wav");
        if (!f.isFile()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Fixture clip missing: " + f);
        }
        return f;
    }

    /** The dial the FX card drives for an effect (null when it has none). */
    public static String primaryParamId(DspChain.EffectType type) {
        try {
            Method m = DspChain.class.getDeclaredMethod("primaryParamId",
                    DspChain.EffectType.class);
            m.setAccessible(true);
            Object v = m.invoke(null, type);
            return v == null ? null : (String) v;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- WAV I/O

    public static final class WavData {
        public final float[] samples;
        public final int channels;
        public final int sampleRate;
        public final int frames;

        WavData(float[] samples, int channels, int sampleRate) {
            this.samples = samples;
            this.channels = channels;
            this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
            this.frames = channels == 0 ? 0 : samples.length / channels;
        }
    }

    /** Writes interleaved floats as the app's 32-bit float WAV. */
    public static void writeFloatWav(File f, float[] samples, int channels,
                                     int sampleRate) throws Exception {
        File parent = f.getParentFile();
        if (parent != null) parent.mkdirs();
        try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(channels, sampleRate,
                    (long) samples.length * 4));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, samples, 0, samples.length);
        }
    }

    /** Reads any 32-bit float WAV, tolerating extra RIFF chunks. */
    public static WavData readFloatWav(File f) throws Exception {
        try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
            byte[] head = new byte[12];
            r.readFully(head);
            int channels = 1;
            int sampleRate = 48000;
            int bits = 0;
            int format = 0;
            long dataStart = -1;
            long dataBytes = 0;
            long pos = 12;
            long len = r.length();
            while (pos + 8 <= len) {
                r.seek(pos);
                byte[] id = new byte[4];
                r.readFully(id);
                byte[] sz = new byte[4];
                r.readFully(sz);
                long size = Integer.toUnsignedLong(
                        ByteBuffer.wrap(sz).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getInt());
                String tag = new String(id, "US-ASCII");
                if ("fmt ".equals(tag)) {
                    byte[] fmt = new byte[(int) Math.min(size, 40)];
                    r.readFully(fmt);
                    ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(fmt).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                    // Absolute offsets: the buffer position walks as fields are
                    // read, and bitsPerSample lives at 14 behind byteRate and
                    // blockAlign.
                    format = b.getShort(0) & 0xFFFF;
                    channels = b.getShort(2) & 0xFFFF;
                    sampleRate = b.getInt(4);
                    bits = b.getShort(14) & 0xFFFF;
                } else if ("data".equals(tag)) {
                    dataStart = pos + 8;
                    dataBytes = Math.min(size, len - dataStart);
                }
                pos += 8 + size + (size % 2);
            }
            if (format != 3 || bits != 32 || dataStart < 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Not a 32-bit float WAV: " + f
                        + " (format=" + format + " bits=" + bits + ")");
            }
            int count = (int) (dataBytes / 4);
            byte[] bytes = new byte[count * 4];
            r.seek(dataStart);
            r.readFully(bytes);
            float[] out = new float[count];
            ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                    .asFloatBuffer().get(out);
            return new WavData(out, channels, sampleRate);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ probe signal

    /**
     * Deterministic probe synthesis. The same recipe is used for every shard, so
     * a case rendered in one job is comparable with any other run.
     */
    public static float[] buildProbe(String name, int frames, int channels,
                                     WavData clip) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * channels];
        switch (name) {
            case "clip": {
                int ch = clip.channels;
                int n = Math.min(frames, clip.frames);
                for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                        out[f * channels + c] = clip.samples[f * ch + (c % ch)];
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "tone": {
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    float s = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1000.0 * f / 48000.0) * 0.3f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[f * channels + c] = s;
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "sweep": {
                double f0 = 20.0, f1 = 20000.0, t = frames / 48000.0;
                double k = Math.log(f1 / f0);
                for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                    double time = i / 48000.0;
                    double phase = 2 * Math.PI * f0 * t / k * (Math.exp(k * time / t) - 1);
                    float s = (float) Math.sin(phase) * 0.5f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[i * channels + c] = s;
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "sibilant": {
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    double t = f / 48000.0;
                    double s = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 7000.0 * t) * 0.5
                            + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 8400.0 * t) * 0.25
                            + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1000.0 * t) * 0.2;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                        out[f * channels + c] = (float) s;
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "noise": {
                Random rnd = new Random(42);
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    float s = (rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f) * 0.05f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[f * channels + c] = s;
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "impulse": {
                for (int hit = 0; hit < 4; hit++) {
                    int at = (int) ((0.5 + hit * 3.0) * 48000);
                    if (at >= frames) break;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[at * channels + c] = 0.9f;
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "clicks": {
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    float s = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1000.0 * f / 48000.0) * 0.2f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[f * channels + c] = s;
                }
                for (int hit = 0; hit < frames / 24000; hit++) {
                    int at = hit * 24000 + 12000;
                    if (at >= frames) break;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[at * channels + c] = 0.7f;
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "hum": {
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    double t = f / 48000.0;
                    double s = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1000.0 * t) * 0.25
                            + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 50.0 * t) * 0.25
                            + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 100.0 * t) * 0.08
                            + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 150.0 * t) * 0.05
                            + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 200.0 * t) * 0.03;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                        out[f * channels + c] = (float) s;
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "clipped": {
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    float s = (float) (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 400.0 * f / 48000.0) * 1.4);
                    s = Math.max(-0.95f, Math.min(0.95f, s));
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[f * channels + c] = s;
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "gaps": {
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    float s = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1000.0 * f / 48000.0) * 0.3f;
                    double t = f / 48000.0;
                    boolean silent = (t >= 2.0 && t < 3.0) || (t >= 6.0 && t < 7.5)
                            || (t >= 10.0 && t < 10.6);
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                        out[f * channels + c] = silent ? 0f : s;
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "plosive": {
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    float s = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1000.0 * f / 48000.0) * 0.25f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[f * channels + c] = s;
                }
                for (int hit = 0; hit < 4; hit++) {
                    int start = (int) ((1.0 + hit * 2.0) * 48000);
                    int end = Math.min(frames, start + (int) (0.3 * 48000));
                    for (int f = start; f < end; f++) {
                        float burst = (float) (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 90.0 * f / 48000.0)
                                * 0.8 * Math.exp(-(f - start) / 4000.0));
                        for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                            out[f * channels + c] += burst;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "stereo": {
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    out[f * 2] = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440.0 * f / 48000.0) * 0.4f;
                    out[f * 2 + 1] = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 660.0 * f / 48000.0) * 0.4f;
                }
                return out;
            }
            case "silence":
            default:
                return out;
        }
    }

    /** Human readable probe description for the report. */
    public static String probeDescription(String name) {
        switch (name) {
            case "clip": return "the uploaded Take 2 recording (truncated)";
            case "tone": return "1 kHz sine at -10 dBFS";
            case "sweep": return "20 Hz to 20 kHz log sweep";
            case "noise": return "white noise at -26 dBFS";
            case "impulse": return "impulses at 0.5 s, 3.5 s, 6.5 s, 9.5 s";
            case "clicks": return "1 kHz tone with periodic full-scale clicks";
            case "hum": return "1 kHz tone with 50 Hz mains hum and harmonics";
            case "clipped": return "400 Hz sine hard-clipped at 0.95";
            case "gaps": return "1 kHz tone with 1 s, 1.5 s and 0.6 s silent gaps";
            case "plosive": return "1 kHz tone with four 90 Hz plosive bursts";
            case "sibilant": return "7 kHz and 8.4 kHz sibilance over a 1 kHz body tone";
            case "stereo": return "440 Hz left, 660 Hz right";
            case "silence": return "digital silence";
            default: return name;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

/**
 * The adaptive chunk size is a hint, so the important contracts are simple:
 * it never returns zero/negative, never exceeds the tuned request, and scales
 * with channel count without arithmetic overflow.
 */
public class MemoryBudgetTest {

    @Test
    public void requestedChunkIsUsedWhenHeapHasHeadroom() {
        int frames = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(65_536, 2);
        assertTrue("must be a usable chunk", frames >= 2_048);
        assertTrue("must not exceed the tuned constant",
                frames <= 65_536);
    }

    @Test
    public void stereoNeverAllocatesMoreThanMonoForTheSameBudget() {
        int mono = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(65_536, 1);
        int stereo = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(65_536, 2);
        assertTrue("stereo chunks must not be larger than mono",
                stereo <= mono);
    }

    @Test
    public void hostileInputsStillYieldAUsableChunk() {
        assertEquals(2_048, MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(0, 0));
        assertTrue(MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(-5, -5) >= 2_048);
        assertTrue(MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 2) > 0);
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/NoiseSuppressionTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertSame;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Spectral Noise Suppression Pro: selection-learned profile analysis, profile
 * persistence, stationary-noise reduction, tonal preservation, adaptive
 * fallback, chunk invariance and rack wiring/latency.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class NoiseSuppressionTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    private static float[] whiteNoise(int frames, int ch, long seed,
                                      float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        long x = seed | 1L;
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
            x ^= x << 13;
            x ^= x >>> 7;
            x ^= x << 17;
            float v = (x >>> 40) / 8388608f - 1f;
            out[i] = v * amp;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, float hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / 48000.0) * amp;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static double rms(float[] a, int fromFrame, int toFrame, int ch) {
        double sum = 0;
        int n = 0;
        for (int f = fromFrame; f < toFrame; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                double v = a[f * ch + c];
                sum += v * v;
                n++;
            }
        }
        return n == 0 ? 0 : Math.sqrt(sum / n);
    }

    private static NoiseSuppressionProcessor processor(float[] profile,
                                                       int amt) {
        NoiseSuppressionProcessor p = new NoiseSuppressionProcessor();
        p.setNoiseProfile(profile);
        p.getParam("amt").setCurrentRaw(amt);
        p.prepare(48000, 1);
        return p;
    }

    @Test
    public void readFloatSelectionExtractsTheSelectedFrames() throws Exception {
        int frames = 5000;
        float[] samples = new float[frames];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            samples[i] = (float) (Math.sin(i * 0.01) * 0.5);
        }
        File wav = tmp.newFile("selection.wav");
        try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "rw")) {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, (long) frames * 4));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, samples, 0, frames);
        }

        float[] sel = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(wav, 1000, 3000);
        assertEquals(2000, sel.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
            assertEquals(samples[1000 + i], sel[i], 0.0f);
        }
        assertEquals(0, EditEngine.readFloatSelection(
                wav, frames + 10, frames + 90).length);
    }

    @Test
    public void learnProfileBuildsFinitePositiveBins() {
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(48000, 1, 0x1234abcdL, 0.12f);
        float[] profile = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(noise, 1);
        assertNotNull(profile);
        assertEquals(NoiseSuppressionProcessor.BINS, profile.length);
        for (float v : profile) {
            assertTrue(v > 0f && !Float.isInfinite(v) && !Float.isNaN(v));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void shortSelectionCannotProduceAProfile() {
        float[] shortNoise = whiteNoise(
                NoiseSuppressionProcessor.FFT_SIZE - 1, 1, 7L, 0.1f);
        assertNull(NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(shortNoise, 1));
        assertNull(NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(null, 1));
    }

    @Test
    public void learnedProfileSuppressesStationaryNoise() {
        int frames = 96000;
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(frames, 1, 0x51ee7L, 0.10f);
        float[] analysis = Arrays.copyOfRange(noise, 0, 24000);
        float[] profile = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(analysis, 1);
        assertNotNull(profile);

        float[] wet = noise.clone();
        processPadded(processor(profile, 100), wet, frames);

        double dry = rms(noise, 48000, frames, 1);
        double out = rms(wet, 48000, frames, 1);
        double reductionDb = 20.0 * Math.log10(dry / Math.max(1e-12, out));
        assertTrue("noise reduction only " + reductionDb + " dB",
                reductionDb > 6.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void learnedProfilePreservesLoudTone() {
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(24000, 1, 0xabcL, 0.02f);
        float[] profile = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(noise, 1);
        int frames = 48000;
        float[] tone = sine(frames, 1, 1000f, 0.5f);
        float[] wet = tone.clone();
        processPadded(processor(profile, 100), wet, frames);

        double dry = rms(tone, 4800, frames, 1);
        double out = rms(wet, 4800, frames, 1);
        double deltaDb = 20.0 * Math.log10(out / dry);
        assertTrue("tone changed by " + deltaDb + " dB",
                Math.abs(deltaDb) < 2.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void adaptiveFallbackSuppressesSteadyNoiseWithoutProfile() {
        int frames = 96000;
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(frames, 1, 0x777L, 0.08f);
        float[] wet = noise.clone();
        processPadded(processor(null, 100), wet, frames);

        double dry = rms(noise, 48000, frames, 1);
        double out = rms(wet, 48000, frames, 1);
        double reductionDb = 20.0 * Math.log10(dry / Math.max(1e-12, out));
        assertTrue("adaptive fallback reduction only " + reductionDb + " dB",
                reductionDb > 6.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void profileJsonRoundTripsWithinQuantizationStep() {
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(24000, 1, 0x9eL, 0.05f);
        float[] profile = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(noise, 1);
        JSONArray json = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.profileToJson(profile);
        float[] back = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.profileFromJson(json);
        assertNotNull(back);
        for (int i = 0; i < profile.length; i++) {
            double d = Dsp.linToDb(profile[i]) - Dsp.linToDb(back[i]);
            assertTrue("bin " + i + " drifted " + d + " dB",
                    Math.abs(d) <= 0.11);
        }
        assertNull(NoiseSuppressionProcessor.profileFromJson(new JSONArray()));
    }

    @Test
    public void spectralProfileJsonRoundTripsWithItsOwnBinCount() {
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(24000, 1, 0x4d2L, 0.02f);
        float[] profile = SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor.learnProfile(
                noise, 1);
        assertNotNull(profile);
        JSONArray json = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.profileToJson(profile);
        float[] back = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.profileFromJson(json);
        assertNotNull("Spectral profile rejected on load", back);
        assertEquals(profile.length, back.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < profile.length; i++) {
            double d = Dsp.linToDb(profile[i]) - Dsp.linToDb(back[i]);
            assertTrue("bin " + i + " drifted " + d + " dB",
                    Math.abs(d) <= 0.11);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void chunkedProcessingMatchesSingleCallAndReportsLatency() {
        int frames = 12000;
        int latency = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.FFT_SIZE;
        float[] input = whiteNoise(frames, 1, 0x42L, 0.1f);
        float[] profile = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(
                Arrays.copyOfRange(input, 0, 4096), 1);

        // One call over the zero-padded take, exactly like an offline commit:
        // the reported latency drains through the padding.
        NoiseSuppressionProcessor whole = processor(profile, 80);
        float[] padded = Arrays.copyOf(input, frames + latency);
        whole.processInPlace(padded, frames + latency, 1);
        float[] expected = Arrays.copyOf(padded, frames);

        // Streamed like EditEngine.applyDspToRange: prime with the first
        // latency frames, then each chunk reads `latency` ahead and its output
        // is written at the chunk's own offset.
        NoiseSuppressionProcessor chunked = processor(profile, 80);
        chunked.processInPlace(Arrays.copyOf(input, latency), latency, 1);
        float[] actual = new float[frames];
        int cur = 0;
        int[] steps = {1, 37, 512, 2049, 3, 700, 4096};
        int i = 0;
        while (cur < frames) {
            int want = Math.min(steps[i % steps.length], frames - cur);
            float[] chunk = new float[want];
            long inPos = (long) cur + latency;
            int avail = (int) Math.max(0L,
                    Math.min((long) want, frames - inPos));
            if (avail > 0) {
                System.arraycopy(input, (int) inPos, chunk, 0, avail);
            }
            chunked.processInPlace(chunk, want, 1);
            System.arraycopy(chunk, 0, actual, cur, want);
            cur += want;
            i++;
        }
        assertArrayEquals(expected, actual, 0.0f);
        assertEquals(latency, chunked.getLatencyFrames());
    }

    @Test
    public void rackPushesLearnedProfileAndPersistsItWithTheSlot() {
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(24000, 1, 0x31L, 0.04f);
        float[] profile = NoiseSuppressionProcessor.learnProfile(noise, 1);

        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        DspChain.EffectSlot slot = new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 70, true);
        slot.noiseProfile = profile;
        cfg.slots.add(slot);
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        assertTrue(chain.isActive());
        assertEquals(NoiseSuppressionProcessor.FFT_SIZE,
                chain.getLatencyFrames());
        AudioProcessor proc = chain.getRack().getProcessor(
                chain.getRack().indexOf("noise"));
        assertTrue(proc instanceof NoiseSuppressionProcessor);
        assertSame(profile, ((NoiseSuppressionProcessor) proc)
                .getNoiseProfile());

        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        cfg.save(ctx);
        DspChain.Config back = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
        DspChain.EffectSlot loaded = null;
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : back.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION) loaded = s;
        }
        assertNotNull(loaded);
        assertNotNull(loaded.noiseProfile);
        assertEquals(profile.length, loaded.noiseProfile.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < profile.length; i++) {
            double d = Dsp.linToDb(profile[i])
                    - Dsp.linToDb(loaded.noiseProfile[i]);
            assertTrue(Math.abs(d) <= 0.11);
        }
    }

    private static void processPadded(NoiseSuppressionProcessor p,
                                      float[] buf, int frames) {
        float[] work = Arrays.copyOf(buf,
                frames + NoiseSuppressionProcessor.FFT_SIZE);
        p.processInPlace(work, frames + NoiseSuppressionProcessor.FFT_SIZE, 1);
        System.arraycopy(work, 0, buf, 0, frames);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;
import org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowLooper;

/**
 * BUG-STU-02: dismissing a result dialog by tapping outside or pressing Back
 * must still run the callback, exactly once. The studio used this callback to
 * leave the screen, so a plain dismissal trapped the user there.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class OptionsSheetResultDismissTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    @Test
    public void outsideDismissFiresCallbackOnce() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final int[] fired = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = OptionsSheet.showResult(a, true,
                "Saved", "Msg", () -> fired[0]++);
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        // Simulate a tap outside / Back press.
        d.dismiss();
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals("dismiss must run the callback", 1, fired[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void bannerTapThenDismissFiresOnlyOnce() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final int[] fired = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = OptionsSheet.showResult(a, true,
                "Take saved", null, () -> fired[0]++);
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        android.view.View ok = d.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        assertTrue("Got it button must be hidden",
                ok == null || ok.getVisibility() == android.view.View.GONE);
        android.view.View title = d.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle);
        a.runOnUiThread(((android.view.View) title.getParent().getParent())
                ::performClick);
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        d.dismiss();
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals("callback fired more than once", 1, fired[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void callbackSurvivesRepeatedDismissals() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final int[] fired = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = OptionsSheet.showResult(a, false,
                "Failed", "Msg", () -> fired[0]++);
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        d.dismiss();
        d.dismiss();
        d.cancel();
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals(1, fired[0]);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.Dialog;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.Shadows;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;
import org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowDialog;
import org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowLooper;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Every dialog builder opens, labels its controls, fires its actions and
 * dismisses — driven through the shown dialog like a user would.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class OptionsSheetTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private static Dialog latest() {
        Dialog d = ShadowDialog.getLatestDialog();
        assertTrue("no dialog shown", d != null && d.isShowing());
        return d;
    }

    private static void idle() {
        ShadowLooper shadow = Shadows.shadowOf(Looper.getMainLooper());
        shadow.idle();
    }

    @Test
    public void confirmFiresAndDismisses() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final boolean[] fired = {false};
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(a, "Title?", "Are you sure?", "Do it",
                R.drawable.ic_check, false, () -> fired[0] = true);
        Dialog d = latest();
        assertEquals("Title?",
                ((TextView) d.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).getText()
                        .toString());
        d.findViewById(R.id.dialogConfirm).performClick();
        idle();
        assertTrue("confirm action never fired", fired[0]);
        assertTrue("dialog did not dismiss", !d.isShowing());
    }

    @Test
    public void confirmCancelDismissesWithoutFiring() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final boolean[] fired = {false};
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(a, "Title?", "Are you sure?", "Do it",
                R.drawable.ic_trash, true, () -> fired[0] = true);
        Dialog d = latest();
        d.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel).performClick();
        idle();
        assertTrue(!fired[0]);
        assertTrue(!d.isShowing());
    }

    @Test
    public void resultShowsTwoWordTitleAndHidesGotItButton() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final boolean[] ok = {false};
        OptionsSheet.showResult(a, true, "Take saved", "Ignored sub",
                () -> ok[0] = true);
        Dialog d = latest();
        assertEquals("Take saved",
                ((TextView) d.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle)).getText()
                        .toString());
        View okBtn = d.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        assertEquals(View.GONE, okBtn.getVisibility());
        d.dismiss();
        idle();
        assertTrue(ok[0]);
        assertTrue(!d.isShowing());
    }

    @Test

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;

import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Press feedback must never break taps or layouts: it only animates scale
 * (and alpha for the plain variant), always returning views home.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class PressAnimTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    @Test
    public void applyKeepsClicksWorking() {
        Activity a = activity();
        View v = new View(a);
        final boolean[] clicked = {false};
        v.setOnClickListener(view -> clicked[0] = true);
        PressAnim.apply(v);
        v.performClick();
        assertTrue("click listener lost", clicked[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void applySoftKeepsClicksWorking() {
        Activity a = activity();
        View v = new View(a);
        final boolean[] clicked = {false};
        v.setOnClickListener(view -> clicked[0] = true);
        PressAnim.applySoft(v, 0.95f);
        v.performClick();
        assertTrue("click listener lost", clicked[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void nudgeAndPopDoNotThrow() {
        Activity a = activity();
        View v = new View(a);
        a.setContentView(v);
        PressAnim.nudge(v, 1.1f);
        PressAnim.pop(v);
        assertTrue("view detached", v.getParent() != null);
    }
}
