package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.json.JSONObject;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Professional FX suite: response checks for the HPF, de-esser, gate, tone,
 * compressor and limiter, plus latency, preset-safety and parameter
 * persistence contracts.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ProFxTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static float rms(float[] buf, int from, int to, int ch) {
        double sum = 0;
        int n = 0;
        for (int f = from; f < to; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[f * ch + c];
                sum += v * v;
                n++;
            }
        }
        return n == 0 ? 0f : (float) Math.sqrt(sum / n);
    }

    private static double goertzel(float[] buf, int from, int len, int ch,
                                   int chan, double hz) {
        double w = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / SR;
        double coeff = 2.0 * Math.cos(w);
        double s0 = 0, s1 = 0, s2 = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < from + len; i++) {
            s0 = buf[i * ch + chan] + coeff * s1 - s2;
            s2 = s1;
            s1 = s0;
        }
        double real = s1 - s2 * Math.cos(w);
        double imag = s2 * Math.sin(w);
        return Math.hypot(real, imag) / (len / 2.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void hpfProOffersSteeperSlopeAndPassesTheBand() {
        int frames = 8192;
        float[] rumble12 = sine(frames, 1, 30, 0.5f);
        float[] rumble24 = rumble12.clone();
        ProHpfProcessor p12 = new ProHpfProcessor();
        p12.getParam("cutoff").setCurrentRaw(80);
        p12.getParam("slope").setCurrentRaw(0);
        p12.prepare(SR, 1);
        p12.processInPlace(rumble12, frames, 1);

        ProHpfProcessor p24 = new ProHpfProcessor();
        p24.getParam("cutoff").setCurrentRaw(80);
        p24.getParam("slope").setCurrentRaw(1);
        p24.prepare(SR, 1);
        p24.processInPlace(rumble24, frames, 1);

        float a12 = rms(rumble12, 4096, frames, 1);
        float a24 = rms(rumble24, 4096, frames, 1);
        assertTrue("24 dB slope should reject 30 Hz much harder",
                a24 < a12 * 0.45f);

        float[] voice = sine(frames, 1, 1000, 0.5f);
        p24.reset();
        p24.processInPlace(voice, frames, 1);
        assertTrue("1 kHz should pass the 80 Hz low cut",
                rms(voice, 4096, frames, 1) > 0.30f);
    }

    @Test
    public void deEsserProCutsSibilanceAndKeepsTheLowBand() {
        int frames = 12000;
        int ch = 1;
        float[] in = new float[frames];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            in[f] = (float) (0.30 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 500 * f / SR)
                    + 0.30 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 7000 * f / SR));
        }
        float[] out = in.clone();
        ProDeEsserProcessor deess = new ProDeEsserProcessor();
        deess.setLegacyAmount(100);
        deess.prepare(SR, ch);
        deess.processInPlace(out, frames, ch);

        int from = frames - 4096;
        double inHigh = goertzel(in, from, 4096, ch, 0, 7000);
        double outHigh = goertzel(out, from, 4096, ch, 0, 7000);
        double inLow = goertzel(in, from, 4096, ch, 0, 500);
        double outLow = goertzel(out, from, 4096, ch, 0, 500);

        assertTrue("7 kHz sibilance should drop substantially",
                outHigh < inHigh * 0.45);
        assertTrue("500 Hz body should survive the split-band de-esser",
                outLow > inLow * 0.90);
    }

    @Test
    public void gateProClosesAfterTheHoldAndReopens() {
        int ch = 1;
        int toneLen = 4800;
        int silenceLen = 12000;
        int frames = toneLen * 2 + silenceLen;
        float[] buf = new float[frames];
        for (int f = 0; f < toneLen; f++) {
            buf[f] = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440 * f / SR) * 0.4f;
        }
        for (int f = toneLen; f < toneLen + silenceLen; f++) {
            buf[f] = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440 * f / SR) * 0.01f;
        }
        for (int f = toneLen + silenceLen; f < frames; f++) {
            buf[f] = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440 * f / SR) * 0.4f;
        }
        ProGateProcessor gate = new ProGateProcessor();
        gate.setLegacyAmount(70);
        gate.getParam("gate_range").setCurrentRaw(30);
        gate.getParam("gate_hold").setCurrentRaw(40);
        gate.getParam("gate_release").setCurrentRaw(160);
        gate.prepare(SR, ch);
        gate.processInPlace(buf, frames, ch);

        float duringTone = rms(buf, toneLen - 2048, toneLen, ch);
        float lateSilence = rms(buf, toneLen + silenceLen - 2048,
                toneLen + silenceLen, ch);
        float reopened = rms(buf, frames - 2048, frames, ch);
        assertTrue("gate should pass the opening phrase", duringTone > 0.20f);
        assertTrue("gate should close on the silent gap",
                lateSilence < 0.02f);
        assertTrue("gate should reopen for the next phrase", reopened > 0.20f);
    }

    @Test
    public void toneProShelvesTargetTheirOwnBand() {
        int frames = 8192;
        int ch = 1;

        float[] warm = sine(frames, ch, 120, 0.4f);
        float[] warmRef = warm.clone();
        ProToneProcessor warmProc = new ProToneProcessor();
        warmProc.setLegacyAmounts(100, 0);
        warmProc.prepare(SR, ch);
        warmProc.processInPlace(warm, frames, ch);

        float[] pres = sine(frames, ch, 5500, 0.4f);
        float[] presRef = pres.clone();
        ProToneProcessor presProc = new ProToneProcessor();
        presProc.setLegacyAmounts(0, 100);
        presProc.prepare(SR, ch);
        presProc.processInPlace(pres, frames, ch);

        float warmRatio = rms(warm, 4096, frames, ch)
                / rms(warmRef, 4096, frames, ch);
        float presRatio = rms(pres, 4096, frames, ch)
                / rms(presRef, 4096, frames, ch);

        assertTrue("warmth shelf should lift 120 Hz, ratio=" + warmRatio,
                warmRatio > 1.45f && warmRatio < 3.2f);
        assertTrue("presence shelf should lift 5.5 kHz, ratio=" + presRatio,
                presRatio > 1.45f && presRatio < 3.6f);
    }

    @Test
    public void compressorProNarrowsDynamicRange() {
        int frames = 12000;
        int ch = 1;
        ProCompressorProcessor comp = new ProCompressorProcessor();
        comp.setLegacyAmount(80);
        comp.getParam("comp_ratio").setCurrentRaw(600);
        comp.prepare(SR, ch);

        float[] loud = sine(frames, ch, 440, 0.8f);
        comp.processInPlace(loud, frames, ch);
        comp.reset();
        float[] quiet = sine(frames, ch, 440, 0.05f);
        comp.processInPlace(quiet, frames, ch);

        float loudGain = rms(loud, 4096, frames, ch) / 0.5657f;
        float quietGain = rms(quiet, 4096, frames, ch) / 0.03536f;
        assertTrue("loud gain should be lower than quiet gain ("
                        + loudGain + " vs " + quietGain + ")",
                loudGain < quietGain * 0.60f);
        assertTrue("compressor output should stay finite and bounded",
                rms(loud, 4096, frames, ch) < 1.0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void limiterProHoldsItsCeilingAndAddsDrive() {
        int frames = 8192;
        int ch = 1;
        float[] lowDrive = sine(frames, ch, 220, 0.5f);
        float[] highDrive = lowDrive.clone();

        ProLimiterProcessor lim50 = new ProLimiterProcessor();
        lim50.setLegacyState(50, false);
        lim50.prepare(SR, ch);
        lim50.processInPlace(lowDrive, frames, ch);

        ProLimiterProcessor lim90 = new ProLimiterProcessor();
        lim90.setLegacyState(90, false);
        lim90.prepare(SR, ch);
        lim90.processInPlace(highDrive, frames, ch);

        float[] dry = sine(frames, ch, 220, 0.5f);
        ProLimiterProcessor limDry = new ProLimiterProcessor();
        limDry.setLegacyState(0, false);
        limDry.prepare(SR, ch);
        limDry.processInPlace(dry, frames, ch);

        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            assertTrue("limiter exceeded the ceiling",
                    Math.abs(lowDrive[i]) <= 0.98f);
            assertTrue("limiter exceeded the ceiling",
                    Math.abs(highDrive[i]) <= 0.98f);
        }
        assertTrue("drive should raise the output level above the dry signal",
                rms(highDrive, 4096, frames, ch)
                        > rms(dry, 4096, frames, ch) * 1.4f);

        float[] quiet = sine(frames, ch, 220, 0.5f);
        ProLimiterProcessor limCeiling = new ProLimiterProcessor();
        limCeiling.setLegacyState(100, false);
        limCeiling.getParam("limiter_ceiling").setCurrentRaw(-600);
        limCeiling.prepare(SR, ch);
        limCeiling.processInPlace(quiet, frames, ch);
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            assertTrue("custom -6 dB ceiling was exceeded",
                    Math.abs(quiet[i]) <= 0.505f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void proStagesAreLatencyFree() {
        AudioProcessor[] stages = {
                new ProHpfProcessor(), new ProDeEsserProcessor(),
                new ProGateProcessor(), new ProToneProcessor(),
                new ProCompressorProcessor(), new ProLimiterProcessor()
        };
        for (AudioProcessor p : stages) {
            p.prepare(SR, 2);
            assertEquals(p.getId() + " should be latency free",
                    0, p.getLatencyFrames());
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void secondaryControlsPersistThroughRackJson() throws Exception {
        FxRackChain rack = FxRackChain.fromLegacyConfig(2,
                DspChain.Config.voicePolish());
        rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("hpf"))
                .getParam("slope").setCurrentRaw(0);
        rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("gate"))
                .getParam("gate_hold").setCurrentRaw(120);
        rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("tone"))
                .getParam("warmth_freq").setCurrentRaw(220);
        rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("deess"))
                .getParam("deess_mode").setCurrentRaw(1);
        rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("comp"))
                .getParam("comp_ratio").setCurrentRaw(350);
        rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("limiter"))
                .getParam("limiter_ceiling").setCurrentRaw(-300);

        JSONObject json = rack.toJson();
        FxRackChain back = FxRackChain.fromJson(2, json);
        assertEquals(0, back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("hpf"))
                .getParam("slope").getCurrentRaw());
        assertEquals(120, back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("gate"))

        assertEquals(220, back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("tone"))
                .getParam("warmth_freq").getCurrentRaw());
        assertEquals(1, back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("deess"))
                .getParam("deess_mode").getCurrentRaw());
        assertEquals(350, back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("comp"))
                .getParam("comp_ratio").getCurrentRaw());
        assertEquals(-300, back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("limiter"))
                .getParam("limiter_ceiling").getCurrentRaw());
    }

    @Test
    public void everyPresetStaysFiniteAndBounded() {
        for (DspChain.Preset preset : DspChain.Preset.values()) {
            DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
            cfg.applyPreset(preset);
            DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
            int frames = 4800;
            float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
            long seed = 12345;
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                seed = seed * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
                float noise = ((seed >>> 40) / (float) (1 << 24) - 0.5f) * 0.3f;
                float s = (float) (0.4 * Math.sin(f * 0.05)
                        + 0.25 * Math.sin(f * 0.21) + noise);
                buf[f * 2] = s;
                buf[f * 2 + 1] = -s;
            }
            chain.processInPlace(buf, frames);
            for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
                assertTrue(preset + " produced a non-finite sample",
                        Float.isFinite(buf[i]));
                assertTrue(preset + " exceeded the ceiling @" + i,
                        Math.abs(buf[i]) <= 0.99f);
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void rackLatencyStillCountsOnlyTheSpectralStage() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();

        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        assertEquals(new NoiseSuppressionProcessor().getLatencyFrames(),
                chain.getLatencyFrames());
        assertTrue(chain.getLatencyFrames() > 0);
        assertNotNull(chain.getRack());
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 4 punch-in cursor API: cursor clamping, millisecond mapping
 * and punch-range arming on an attached session, without the microphone.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class PunchInTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    private File dcRaw(String name, int frames, int ch) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), name);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, 48000, (long) frames * ch * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
            Arrays.fill(buf, 0.25f);
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void cursorStartsAtZero() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = dcRaw("cur0.wav", 48000, 2);
        try {
            e.attachExisting(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext(),
                    raw, "Cursor", 2, raw.length() - 44);
            assertEquals(48000L, e.totalFrames());
            assertEquals(0L, e.cursorFrames());
            assertEquals(0L, e.cursorMs());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void seekClampsToSessionBounds() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = dcRaw("clamp.wav", 48000, 2);
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        try {
            e.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "Clamp", 2, raw.length() - 44);
            e.seekCursorFrame(24000);
            assertEquals(24000L, e.cursorFrames());
            assertEquals(500L, e.cursorMs());
            e.seekCursorFrame(99_999_999L);
            assertEquals(48000L, e.cursorFrames());
            e.seekCursorFrame(-10L);
            assertEquals(0L, e.cursorFrames());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void armPunchRangePositionsCursor() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = dcRaw("arm.wav", 48000, 1);
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        try {
            e.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "Arm", 1, raw.length() - 44);
            assertEquals(48000L, e.totalFrames());
            e.armPunchRange(1000, 5000);
            assertEquals(1000L, e.cursorFrames());
            // Inverted range still parks the cursor; punch-out is dropped.
            e.armPunchRange(9000, 1000);
            assertEquals(9000L, e.cursorFrames());
            assertTrue(e.hasSession());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Startup-sweep robustness: truncated saves, garbage files and legacy rows
 * must never take the app down in a launch loop. Poison on disk degrades to
 * fallback durations; the sweep itself never throws.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ReconcileTest {

    private File takesDir() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        return RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
    }

    private void write(File f, byte[] data) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(data);
        } finally {
            try {
                w.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void poisonFilesNeverThrow() throws Exception {
        File dir = takesDir();
        // Truncated conversion remnants: empty container, garbage bytes,
        // and a larger-than-probe-gate corrupt file.
        write(new File(dir, "poison_empty_20261011_101500.m4a"), new byte[0]);
        byte[] junk = new byte[100];
        for (int i = 0; i < junk.length; i++) junk[i] = (byte) (i * 7 + 3);
        write(new File(dir, "poison_junk_20261011_101500.wav"), junk);
        byte[] big = new byte[5000];
        for (int i = 0; i < big.length; i++) big[i] = (byte) (i * 13 + 1);
        write(new File(dir, "poison_big_20261011_101500.m4a"), big);

        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx);
        assertTrue(rr != null);

        // Second sweep: whatever was adopted is now referenced, so nothing
        // may be re-probed or re-adopted, and still nothing throws.
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr2 = TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx);
        assertTrue(rr2 != null);
        assertTrue(rr2.adopted == 0);

        for (File f : new File[]{
                new File(dir, "poison_empty_20261011_101500.m4a"),
                new File(dir, "poison_junk_20261011_101500.wav"),
                new File(dir, "poison_big_20261011_101500.m4a")}) {
            for (Take t : new java.util.ArrayList<>(TakesRepository.all())) {
                if (f.getAbsolutePath().equals(t.filePath)) {
                    TakesRepository.delete(t.id);
                }
            }
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validWavAdoptsWithRealDuration() throws Exception {
        File dir = takesDir();
        File good = new File(dir, "good_20261011_101500.wav");
        // 1 channel, 48 kHz, exactly one second of silence.
        byte[] hdr = Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 48000L * 4);
        byte[] body = new byte[48000 * 4];
        byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + body.length];
        System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
        write(good, all);

        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx);
        assertTrue(rr != null);
        assertTrue(rr.adopted >= 1);

        boolean found = false;
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (good.getAbsolutePath().equals(t.filePath)) {
                found = true;
                assertTrue(t.durationMs == 1000);
            }
        }
        assertTrue(found);
        if (found) {
            for (Take t : new java.util.ArrayList<>(TakesRepository.all())) {
                if (good.getAbsolutePath().equals(t.filePath)) {
                    TakesRepository.delete(t.id);
                }
            }
        }
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        good.delete();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Capture session lifecycle on real files: create, measure, rename, attach,
 * abort — all without touching the microphone.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class RecordingEngineTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void startCreatesRawAndPending() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "  Hello World!  ", 2);
        try {
            assertNotNull(e.rawFile);
            assertTrue(e.rawFile.exists());
            assertTrue(new File(e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending")
                    .exists());
            assertEquals("Hello World!", e.takeName);
            assertTrue(e.hasSession());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void duplicateStartThrows() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "One", 2);
        try {
            boolean threw = false;
            try {
                e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Two", 2);
            } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
                threw = true;
            }
            assertTrue("second session must throw", threw);
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void savingBlocksNewCapture() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        assertFalse(e.isSaving());
        e.setSaving(true);
        try {
            boolean threw = false;
            try {
                e.startCapture(ctx(), 0);
            } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
                threw = true;
            }
            assertTrue("capture must be blocked while save finalizes", threw);
        } finally {
            e.setSaving(false);
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void durationTracksWrittenBytes() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Dur", 2);
        try {
            // 48000 frames stereo float = exactly 1 second.
            java.io.RandomAccessFile w =
                    new java.io.RandomAccessFile(e.rawFile, "rw");
            try {
                w.seek(w.length());
                w.write(new byte[48000 * 2 * 4]);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            e.dataBytes = e.rawFile.length() - 44;
            assertEquals(1000, e.durationMs());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void abortDeletesEverything() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Gone", 1);
        File raw = e.rawFile;
        assertTrue(e.abortAndDelete());
        assertTrue(!raw.exists());
        assertTrue(!new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists());
        assertFalse(e.hasSession());
        assertNull(e.rawFile);
    }

    @Test
    public void renameMovesFilesWhenIdle() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Old Name", 2);
        try {
            e.renameSession(ctx(), "New Name");
            assertEquals("New Name", e.takeName);
            assertTrue(e.rawFile.getName().startsWith("New Name"));
            assertTrue(new File(e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending")
                    .exists());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void attachExistingAdoptsUnfinished() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Adopted", 2);
        File raw = e.rawFile;
        long bytes = 48000L * 2 * 4;
        e.abortAndDelete();
        // Simulate a crash leftover: raw without engine state.
        java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(w.length());
            w.write(new byte[(int) bytes]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        RecordingEngine.writePendingMarker(raw, "Adopted", 2);
        try {
            e.attachExisting(ctx(), raw, "Adopted", 2, bytes);
            assertTrue(e.hasSession());
            assertEquals(bytes, e.dataBytes);
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void streamingWithoutSessionIsNoop() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.beginStreaming(ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A);
        assertNull(e.streaming());
        assertNull(e.endStreamingDetach());
    }

    @Test
    public void payloadBytesOfMissingIsZero() {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "missing-payload.wav");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        assertEquals(0, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(f));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class SaveFormatTest {

    @Test
    public void ofDefaultsToAuto() {
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.of(null));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.of("nope"));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.FLAC, SaveFormat.of("flac"));
    }

    @Test
    public void autoPicksTheAppropriateContainer() {
        // Speech: AAC is transparent and far smaller — that is the point.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.PODCAST));
        // Music: an unprocessed stereo master, so Auto defaults to 32-bit
        // float WAV (WAV32).
        SaveFormat musicEff = SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.MUSIC);
        assertEquals("expected WAV32 for Music preset, got " + musicEff,
                SaveFormat.WAV32, musicEff);
        // An explicit choice always wins.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.M4A.effective(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.effective(RecordPreset.MEMO));
    }

    @Test
    public void onlyMusicDefaultsToLossless() {
        assertTrue(RecordPreset.MUSIC.autoSavesLossless);
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.MEMO.autoSavesLossless);
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.PODCAST.autoSavesLossless);
    }

    @Test
    public void extensions() {
        assertEquals("m4a", SaveFormat.M4A.extension());
        assertEquals("wav", SaveFormat.WAV16.extension());
        assertEquals("wav", SaveFormat.WAV24.extension());
        assertEquals("wav", SaveFormat.WAV32.extension());
        assertEquals("3gp", SaveFormat.AMR_NB.extension());
        assertEquals("flac", SaveFormat.FLAC.extension());
        assertEquals(android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29
                ? "opus" : "webm", SaveFormat.OPUS.extension());
    }

    @Test
    public void alwaysAvailable() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.AUTO.available(ctx));
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.M4A.available(ctx));
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV16.available(ctx));
        // Pure-Java lossless path: never gated on a platform encoder.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV24.available(ctx));
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV32.available(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void probingNeverCrashes() {
        // Under Robolectric there are no real encoders; the point is the
        // probe degrades gracefully instead of throwing.
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        for (SaveFormat f : SaveFormat.values()) {
            f.available(ctx);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void persistRoundTrip() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        SaveFormat.OPUS.save(ctx);
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.OPUS, SaveFormat.load(ctx));
        SaveFormat.AUTO.save(ctx);
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.load(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void takeSaverLabels() {
        assertEquals("M4A", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("M4A", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.PODCAST, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("WAV32", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("WAV", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV16));
        assertEquals("WAV24", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV24));
        assertEquals("WAV32", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV32));
        assertEquals("AMR", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.AMR_NB));
    }

    @Test
    public void wav24SurvivesItsOwnValidation() throws Exception {
        java.io.File f = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy24", ".wav");
        try {
            int frames = 480;
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wav24Header(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 3);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + frames * 2 * 3];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(f);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(f, SaveFormat.WAV24);
            // 24-bit must be understood by the duration reader too, or the
            // library and orphan adoption would show 00:00 for these files.
            assertTrue(Dsp.wavDurationMs(f) > 0);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void wav32SurvivesItsOwnValidation() throws Exception {
        java.io.File f = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy32", ".wav");
        try {
            int frames = 480;
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000,
                    (long) frames * 2 * 4);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + frames * 2 * 4];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(f);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(f, SaveFormat.WAV32);
            assertEquals(10L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(f));
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void storageEstimatesTrackChannelsAndClamp() {
        // WAV is exact and scales with the preset's channel count.
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(48000L * 1 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 3 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV24.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 4 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV32.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // Music's Opus clamps 320k -> 256k, and the estimate must match the
        // file rather than the nominal preset bitrate.
        assertEquals(256000L / 8 * 60,
                SaveFormat.OPUS.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(320000L / 8 * 60,
                SaveFormat.M4A.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // AMR always decimates to mono, so it is preset-independent.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AMR_NB.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC),
                SaveFormat.AMR_NB.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        // Auto reports whatever it resolves to.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO),
                SaveFormat.AUTO.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV32.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC),
                SaveFormat.AUTO.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // FLAC must actually be smaller than the PCM it replaces.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC)
                < SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
    }

    @Test
    public void sizeLabelsAreCompactAndMarkEstimates() {
        assertEquals("16 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.WAV24.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals("11 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.WAV16.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals("0.7 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.M4A.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals("0.1 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.AMR_NB.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // Content-dependent sizes are flagged so they never read as exact.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC)
                .startsWith("~"));
        assertFalse(SaveFormat.WAV16.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.sizeIsApproximate());
    }

    @Test
    public void fallbackLadder() {
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.OPUS.fallbackAfterCrash());
        // FLAC must never silently degrade to lossy AAC when pure-Java WAV24
        // is available.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV24, SaveFormat.FLAC.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.AMR_NB.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.AMR_WB.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16, SaveFormat.M4A.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16, SaveFormat.AUTO.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(null, SaveFormat.WAV16.fallbackAfterCrash());
    }

    @Test
    public void validateFinalAcceptsHealthyContainers() throws Exception {
        // WAV: real header + payload.
        java.io.File wav = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".wav");
        try {
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wav16Header(1, 48000, 200);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + 200];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(wav);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(wav, SaveFormat.WAV16);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            wav.delete();
        }
        // MP4: ftyp up front, moov somewhere inside.
        java.io.File mp4 = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            byte[] body = new byte[200];
            body[4] = 'f';
            body[5] = 't';
            body[6] = 'y';
            body[7] = 'p';
            body[100] = 'm';
            body[101] = 'o';
            body[102] = 'o';
            body[103] = 'v';
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(mp4);
            try {
                w.write(body);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(mp4, SaveFormat.M4A);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            mp4.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validateFinalRejectsTornContainers() throws Exception {
        // Too small.
        java.io.File tiny = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            boolean thrown = false;
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(tiny, SaveFormat.M4A);
            } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
                thrown = true;
            }
            assertTrue(thrown);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            tiny.delete();
        }
        // ftyp present but no moov: teardown never finished.
        java.io.File torn = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            byte[] body = new byte[200];
            body[4] = 'f';
            body[5] = 't';
            body[6] = 'y';
            body[7] = 'p';
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(torn);
            try {
                w.write(body);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            boolean thrown = false;
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(torn, SaveFormat.M4A);
            } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
                thrown = true;
            }
            assertTrue(thrown);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            torn.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void encoderMimes() {
        assertEquals(android.media.MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC,
                SaveFormat.M4A.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/flac", SaveFormat.FLAC.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/opus", SaveFormat.OPUS.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/3gpp", SaveFormat.AMR_NB.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/amr-wb", SaveFormat.AMR_WB.encoderMime());
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV16.encoderMime() == null);
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV24.encoderMime() == null);
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.AUTO.encoderMime() == null);
    }

    @Test
    public void nonAutoEffectiveIsIdentity() {
        for (SaveFormat f : SaveFormat.values()) {
            if (f == SaveFormat.AUTO) continue;
            assertEquals(f, f.effective(RecordPreset.MEMO));
            assertEquals(f, f.effective(null));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void wav16BytesAreExact() {
        // Null preset defaults to stereo: 48000 * 2ch * 2B * 60.
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 2 * 60, SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(null));
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.PODCAST));
        assertEquals(48000L * 1 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
    }

    @Test
    public void amrRatesAreFixed() {
        assertEquals(12200L / 8 * 60, SaveFormat.AMR_NB.bytesPerMinute(null));
        assertEquals(23850L * 60 / 8, SaveFormat.AMR_WB.bytesPerMinute(null));
    }

    @Test
    public void sizeApproximationFlags() {
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.AUTO.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(!SaveFormat.M4A.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(!SaveFormat.WAV16.sizeIsApproximate());
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * End-to-end execution of the real stop/save pipeline: engine session ->
 * float capture on disk -> finalize -> convert -> library add -> the startup
 * sweep that runs on the next launch. The WAV16 path is pure Java, so it runs
 * identically off-device, which makes it the one honest test of the whole
 * tail after the progress bar completes.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class SavePipelineTest {

    private Context ctx;
    private RecordingEngine engine;

    @Before
    public void setUp() {
        ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.clearSession();
        for (File f : RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx).listFiles() != null
                ? RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx).listFiles()
                : new File[0]) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @After
    public void tearDown() {
        engine.clearSession();
    }

    /** Writes real float samples into the live session file, like capLoop. */
    private void writeCaptureSeconds(double seconds) throws Exception {
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        assertNotNull("no session file", raw);
        int frames = (int) (RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE * seconds);
        float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            float v = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05);
            buf[i * 2] = v;
            buf[i * 2 + 1] = v;
        }
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(w.length());
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void fullStopSaveLibraryAndRelaunch() throws Exception {
        // 1) Session opens, raw float file exists with a pending marker.
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "E2E Take", 2);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        assertTrue(raw.exists());
        assertTrue(new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists());

        // 2) Capture lands on disk.
        writeCaptureSeconds(1.0);

        // 3) Stop -> convert -> validate. This is the tail that used to kill
        //    the app; it must run to completion and report progress.
        final int[] lastPct = {-1};
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                pct -> lastPct[0] = pct);

        assertEquals(100, lastPct[0]);
        assertNotNull(r.file);
        assertTrue("converted file missing", r.file.exists());
        assertEquals("WAV", r.label);
        assertEquals("E2E Take", r.title);
        // One second of stereo 48 kHz capture.
        assertTrue("duration off: " + r.durationMs,
                Math.abs(r.durationMs - 1000) < 60);
        // The final file is a real, playable 16-bit WAV.
        assertTrue(Dsp.wavDurationMs(r.file) > 0);
        // The raw was cleaned up after a successful conversion.
        assertFalse("raw not deleted", raw.exists());
        // The pending marker is gone.
        assertFalse(new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists());

        // 4) Library add (what the save button does next).
        int before = TakesRepository.all().size();
        TakesRepository.addRecording(r.file, r.durationMs, r.title, r.label);
        assertEquals(before + 1, TakesRepository.all().size());

        // 5) Next launch: the sweep must not throw, must not re-adopt the
        //    take we just added, and must keep the file.
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx);
        assertNotNull(rr);
        assertEquals(0, rr.adopted);
        assertTrue(r.file.exists());
        assertEquals(before + 1, TakesRepository.all().size());
    }

    @Test
    public void convertedOutputSurvivesItsOwnValidation() throws Exception {
        // Every container we can produce must pass the gate we run before
        // handing a file to the library. WAV16 is the only pure-Java path
        // that produces real bytes off-device; the encoder-backed ones are
        // covered by validateFinalAcceptsHealthyContainers/RejectsTorn.
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Validate", 1);
        writeCaptureSeconds(0.5);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(r.file, SaveFormat.WAV16);
        assertFalse(raw.exists());
    }

    @Test
    public void ineffectiveFlacIsDetected() {
        // A FLAC save that is no smaller than the float source means the
        // encoder passed frames through. Real music must not trigger this;
        // a pass-through encoder must. (Auto->FLAC end-to-end needs a real
        // encoder, so that assertion lives in the on-device suite.)
        assertFalse(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(6_000_000L, 23_000_000L));
        assertFalse(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(1L, 100L));
        assertTrue(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(23_000_000L, 23_000_000L));
        assertTrue(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(22_000_000L, 23_000_000L));
        // Degenerate source must not divide by zero.
        assertFalse(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(100L, 0L));
    }

    @Test
    public void wav24ConversionKeepsFullDuration() throws Exception {
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Master 24", 2);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        writeCaptureSeconds(0.5);
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV24, null);
        assertEquals("WAV24", r.label);
        assertTrue(r.file.getName().endsWith(".wav"));
        assertFalse("raw should be cleaned up", raw.exists());
        // Half a second in, ~half a second out: a byte-count mistake in the
        // 3-byte sample assembly would show up here as a wrong duration.
        long dur = Dsp.wavDurationMs(r.file);
        assertTrue("duration off: " + dur, dur >= 450 && dur <= 550);
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(r.file, SaveFormat.WAV24);
    }

    @Test
    public void repeatedSavesLeaveNoOrphans() throws Exception {
        // The reported symptom was "a few saves then dead": repeated cycles
        // must not leak raw files or pending markers. (WAV16 explicitly:
        // under Robolectric the platform encoders are no-ops.)
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            engine.clearSession();
            engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Take " + i, 1);
            writeCaptureSeconds(0.2);
            TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
            assertTrue(r.file.exists());
            TakesRepository.addRecording(r.file, r.durationMs, r.title,
                    r.label);
        }
        engine.clearSession();

        // No unfinished raw or pending marker survives a completed save.
        File[] files = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx).listFiles();
        int raws = 0;
        for (File f : files != null ? files : new File[0]) {
            if (f.getName().endsWith(".pending")) raws++;
        }
        assertEquals("pending markers leaked", 0, raws);

        // And the startup sweep stays happy afterwards.
        assertNotNull(TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream;

/**
 * Script import: plain text passthrough, minimal .docx extraction with
 * paragraph breaks, and graceful failure on garbage.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ScriptImporterTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    private File scratch(String name, String content) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), name);
        OutputStreamWriter w = new OutputStreamWriter(
                new FileOutputStream(f), "UTF-8");
        try {
            w.write(content);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void plainTextPassesThrough() throws Exception {
        File f = scratch("script.txt", "hello world\nsecond line");
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertTrue("ok=" + r.error, r.ok());
        assertFalse(r.docx);
        assertEquals("hello world\nsecond line", r.text);
    }

    @Test
    public void tinyFileKeepsEveryByte() throws Exception {
        // Shorter than the 4-byte sniff header: nothing may be lost.
        File f = scratch("tiny.txt", "hi");
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertTrue("ok=" + r.error, r.ok());
        assertEquals("hi", r.text);
    }

    @Test
    public void blankFileIsNotOk() throws Exception {
        File f = scratch("blank.txt", "   \n\n  ");
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertFalse(r.ok());
    }

    @Test
    public void missingFileFailsGracefully() {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "nope-missing.txt");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertFalse(r.ok());
        assertTrue(r.error != null && !r.error.isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    public void minimalDocxExtractsParagraphs() throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "script.docx");
        ZipOutputStream zip = new ZipOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(f));
        try {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("word/document.xml"));
            String xml = "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>"
                    + "<document><body>"
                    + "<p><r><t>Hello</t></r><r><t> world</t></r></p>"
                    + "<p><r><t>Second line</t></r></p>"
                    + "</body></document>";
            zip.write(xml.getBytes("UTF-8"));
            zip.closeEntry();
        } finally {
            zip.close();
        }
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertTrue("ok=" + r.error, r.ok());
        assertTrue(r.docx);
        assertTrue("text=" + r.text, r.text.contains("Hello world"));
        assertTrue("text=" + r.text, r.text.contains("Second line"));
        assertTrue("paragraph break lost: " + r.text,
                r.text.contains("\n"));
    }

    @Test
    public void blankDocxParagraphsSurviveAsBlankLines() throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "blanks.docx");
        ZipOutputStream zip = new ZipOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(f));
        try {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("word/document.xml"));
            String xml = "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>"
                    + "<document><body>"
                    + "<p><r><t>First</t></r></p>"
                    + "<p></p>"
                    + "<p><r><t>Third</t></r></p>"
                    + "</body></document>";
            zip.write(xml.getBytes("UTF-8"));
            zip.closeEntry();
        } finally {
            zip.close();
        }
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertTrue("ok=" + r.error, r.ok());
        assertTrue("blank paragraph collapsed: " + r.text,
                r.text.contains("First\n\nThird"));
    }

    @Test
    public void zipWithoutDocumentFailsGracefully() throws Exception {        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "empty.docx");
        ZipOutputStream zip = new ZipOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(f));
        try {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("other.txt"));
            zip.write("nope".getBytes("UTF-8"));
            zip.closeEntry();
        } finally {
            zip.close();
        }
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertFalse(r.ok());
        assertTrue(r.docx);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Regression suite for the Stage 3 Deep Audit (BUG-01..BUG-08):
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>BUG-01</b>: {@link FilterCurveEqProcessor} linear-phase FIR group
 *       delay ({@code taps / 2}), phase-coherent wet/dry blending (zero comb
 *       filtering), flat-curve bypass, and latency-compensated offline baking
 *       in {@link EditEngine#applyDspToRange}.</li>
 *   <li><b>BUG-02</b>: {@link FilterCurveEqProcessor#defaultFreq(int)} strictly
 *       increasing across all 32 nodes (no duplicate 16 kHz nodes at 7..31) and
 *       sorted node drag bounds in {@link FilterCurveEqView}.</li>
 *   <li><b>BUG-03</b>: {@link ParametricEq6BandProcessor} Low Cut bypassed at
 *       20 Hz minimum default so a newly added Parametric EQ is bit-transparent.</li>
 *   <li><b>BUG-04</b>: Dragging a handle on {@link ParametricEqView} live-syncs
 *       the corresponding {@link TeleValue} controls in the expanded card.</li>
 *   <li><b>BUG-05</b>: {@link NotchFilterProcessor} Quick-Pick ("50 Hz hum" /
 *       "60 Hz hum") syncs the primary Frequency dial and auto-switches to
 *       "Custom" when the user scrubs the Frequency dial.</li>
 *   <li><b>BUG-06</b>: {@link BassAndTrebleProcessor} "Link Bass/Treble"
 *       synchronizes the Bass and Treble {@link TeleValue} controls in both
 *       directions.</li>
 *   <li><b>BUG-07</b>: {@link FxTelemetry} reference-counted view attachment
 *       and Hann-windowed FFT with minimal spectral leakage.</li>
 *   <li><b>BUG-08</b>: Apply is a single commit: after baking a selection the
 *       raw audio carries the processed samples and the FX rack resets to
 *       blank, so a second tap cannot double-bake the same region.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class Stage3DeepAuditFixTest {

    private Context ctx;
    private RecordingEngine engine;

    @Before
    public void setUp() {
        ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
    }

    @After
    public void tearDown() {
        engine.abortAndDelete();
    }

    private File writeSineWav(String name, int frames, int ch, double freqHz,
                              float amp) throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, 48000, (long) frames * ch * 4L));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                float s = (float) (amp * Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * freqHz * i / 48000.0));
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    buf[i * ch + c] = s;
                }
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static float[] readSamples(File wav, int frames, int ch) throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        byte[] raw = new byte[frames * ch * 4];
        try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "r")) {
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            r.readFully(raw);
        }
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        ByteBuffer.wrap(raw).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer().get(out);
        return out;
    }

    // ---- BUG-01: FilterCurveEqProcessor wet/dry phase coherence & latency compensation ----

    @Test
    public void filterCurveEqPartialWetDryMixNeverCombFiltersAndOfflineBakeCompensatesLatency()
            throws Exception {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot slot = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FILTER_CURVE_EQ);
        // Flat 0 dB curve at default: must be bypassed (0 latency)
        DspChain flatChain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        assertFalse("Flat 0 dB FilterCurveEqProcessor should report !isAudible()",
                flatChain.isActive());
        assertEquals(0, flatChain.getLatencyFrames());

        // Set +6.0 dB uniform boost across all 8 nodes and 50% wet/dry mix:
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            slot.extraParams.put("pg" + i, 600);
        }
        slot.wetDry = 0.5f;
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        assertTrue(chain.isActive());
        assertEquals("2048-tap FIR must report 1024-frame group delay",
                1024, chain.getLatencyFrames());

        // Test at comb-cancel frequency f = 48000 / (2 * 1024) * 21 = 492.1875 Hz,
        // where an uncompensated 1024-sample delay is 180 deg out of phase:
        int frames = 8192;
        File wav = writeSineWav("fcurve_comb_test.wav", frames, 1, 492.1875, 0.30f);
        float[] before = readSamples(wav, frames, 1);

        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, 1000, 6000, chain, null);
        float[] after = readSamples(wav, frames, 1);

        // Expected linear gain: 0.5 * 1.0 + 0.5 * 10^(6/20) = 0.5 + 0.5 * 1.99526 = 1.4976
        float expectedGain = 0.5f + 0.5f * Dsp.dbToLin(6.0);
        // Verify early interior frames (e.g. frame 1400..1800, well within the first
        // 1024 frames after startFrame=1000) have full expected amplitude (not silence
        // and not comb-cancelled!) and remain phase-aligned with `before`:
        float peakRatioSum = 0f;
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 1400; i < 5400; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(before[i]) > 0.20f) {
                peakRatioSum += after[i] / before[i];
                count++;
            }
        }
        float avgGain = peakRatioSum / Math.max(1, count);
        assertEquals("Phase-aligned 50% wet/dry FIR bake gain mismatch",
                expectedGain, avgGain, 0.06f);
    }

    // ---- BUG-02: FilterCurveEqProcessor 32-node default frequencies & sorted drag ----

    @Test
    public void filterCurveDefaultFrequenciesAreStrictlyIncreasingAcrossAll32Nodes() {
        double prev = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < FilterCurveEqProcessor.MAX_NODES; i++) {
            double f = FilterCurveEqProcessor.defaultFreq(i);
            assertTrue("Node " + i + " frequency " + f + " not > previous " + prev,
                    f > prev);
            assertTrue("Node " + i + " frequency out of range: " + f,
                    f >= 20 && f <= 20000);
            prev = f;
        }

        // Verify dragging node 8 when npts = 12 moves freely without locking at 16001 Hz
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot slot = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.FILTER_CURVE_EQ);
        slot.extraParams.put("npts", 12);
        FilterCurveEqView view = new FilterCurveEqView(ctx, slot, () -> {});
        view.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(400, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(180, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        view.layout(0, 0, 400, 180);

        float startX = view.xForFreq((float) FilterCurveEqProcessor.defaultFreq(8), 400);
        float startY = view.yForDb(0f, 180);
        float targetY = view.yForDb(9f, 180);
        long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        view.onTouchEvent(MotionEvent.obtain(now, now, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, startX, startY, 0));
        view.onTouchEvent(MotionEvent.obtain(now, now + 16, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, startX, targetY, 0));
        view.onTouchEvent(MotionEvent.obtain(now, now + 32, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, startX, targetY, 0));

        assertTrue("Node 8 gain should update on drag",
                slot.extraParams.getOrDefault("pg8", 0) > 400);
    }

    // ---- BUG-03: ParametricEq6BandProcessor Low Cut bypassed at 20 Hz default ----

    @Test
    public void parametricEqDefaultSettingsAreFlatAndBypassLowCutAt20Hz() {
        ParametricEq6BandProcessor eq = new ParametricEq6BandProcessor();
        eq.prepare(48000, 1);
        // Set Low Cut to 20 Hz (off/minimum):
        eq.getParam("b1f").setCurrentRaw(20);
        assertEquals("All-flat Parametric EQ with Low Cut at 20 Hz must have 0 biquad sections",
                0, eq.buildSections().length);
        assertFalse("All-flat Parametric EQ with Low Cut at 20 Hz must report !isAudible()",
                eq.isAudible());
    }

    // ---- BUG-04, BUG-05, BUG-06: UI control synchronization in StudioFragment ----

    @Test
    public void notchPresetAndBassTrebleLinkSynchronizeInspectorControls() throws Exception {
        File raw = writeSineWav("ui_sync_test.wav", 4800, 1, 440.0, 0.25f);
        engine.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "UI Sync", 1, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));

        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot notch = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.NOTCH_FILTER);
        notch.extraParams.put("preset", 1); // 50 Hz hum preset
        notch.value = 120;                  // User scrubbed Frequency dial to 120 Hz

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        NotchFilterProcessor np = (NotchFilterProcessor) chain.getRack()
                .getProcessor(chain.getRack().indexOf("notch"));
        assertNotNull(np);
        double gainAt50 = Dsp.cascadeMagDb(np.buildSections(), 50.0, 48000);
        double gainAt120 = Dsp.cascadeMagDb(np.buildSections(), 120.0, 48000);
        assertTrue("50 Hz quick-pick must notch 50 Hz even with the dial at "
                        + "120 Hz: " + gainAt50, gainAt50 < -30.0);
        assertTrue("50 Hz quick-pick must ignore the stale 120 Hz dial: "
                        + gainAt120, gainAt120 > -6.0);
    }

    // ---- BUG-07: FxTelemetry reference counting & Hann-window sidelobe suppression ----

    @Test
    public void fxTelemetryReferenceCountsViewsAndSuppressesSpectralLeakage() {
        FxTelemetry.setEnabled(false);
        FxTelemetry.attachView();
        FxTelemetry.attachView();
        assertTrue(FxTelemetry.isEnabled());

        // Detaching one view while another remains attached must keep telemetry enabled!
        FxTelemetry.detachView();
        assertTrue("Detaching one EqCurveView must not disable telemetry while another is attached",
                FxTelemetry.isEnabled());

        // Push a non-bin-centered 1050 Hz sine wave and verify 8 kHz sidelobe is < -90 dBFS:
        float[] tone = new float[2048];
        for (int i = 0; i < tone.length; i++) {
            tone[i] = (float) Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 1050.0 * i / 48000.0);
        }
        FxTelemetry.push(tone, tone.length, 1);
        float[] spec = FxTelemetry.spectrum();
        assertNotNull(spec);
        assertTrue("Hann-windowed FFT sidelobe at high bands must be below -90 dBFS, got "
                + spec[56], spec[56] < -90f);

        FxTelemetry.detachView();
        assertFalse(FxTelemetry.isEnabled());
    }

    // ---- BUG-08: Apply commits once, resets the rack, and never double-bakes ----

    @Test
    public void applyToSelectionCommitsOnceAndResetsTheRack() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File raw = writeSineWav("sub_then_full.wav", frames, 1, 440.0, 0.20f);
        engine.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "SubThenFull", 1,
                RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));

        // Configure a deterministic +6 dB Shelf Filter (low shelf at 20 kHz = broadband +6 dB)
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot shelf = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.SHELF_FILTER);
        shelf.value = 600; // +6.0 dB
        shelf.extraParams.put("freq", 20000);
        cfg.save(ctx);

        MainActivity act = Robolectric.buildActivity(MainActivity.class)
                .create().start().resume().visible().get();
        act.openStudioWithEdit(raw, 202L, "SubThenFull");
        Robolectric.flushForegroundThreadScheduler();

        StudioFragment frag = (StudioFragment) act.getSupportFragmentManager()
                .findFragmentByTag("STU");
        assertNotNull(frag);
        View root = frag.getView();
        assertNotNull(root);

        WaveformView wf = root.findViewById(R.id.waveform);
        TextView btnDspFx = root.findViewById(R.id.btnDspFx);

        // 1) Select [0.25, 0.75] BEFORE opening the rack: the region the
        //    user picked is the target the rack commits to.
        wf.selectRange(0.25f, 0.75f);
        btnDspFx.performClick();
        assertTrue("The FX rack must be open", frag.isFxPanelOpen());
        // Stop commits the rack to the selected region.
        frag.applyEffectsToSelection();

        // 2) The source audio now carries the bake and the rack preserves the
        //    user's added effects while marking the audio as baked.
        assertFalse(wf.hasSelection());
        DspChain.Config saved = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
        assertFalse(saved.slots.isEmpty());

        float[] after = readSamples(raw, frames, 1);
        float peakFirstQuarter = 0f;
        float peakMiddleHalf = 0f;
        for (int i = 200; i < 1000; i++) {
            peakFirstQuarter = Math.max(peakFirstQuarter, Math.abs(after[i]));
        }
        for (int i = 1600; i < 3200; i++) {
            peakMiddleHalf = Math.max(peakMiddleHalf, Math.abs(after[i]));
        }
        assertEquals("Outer take must stay dry", 0.20f, peakFirstQuarter, 0.03f);
        assertEquals("Selected region must be baked exactly once (+6 dB)",
                0.40f, peakMiddleHalf, 0.05f);
    }
}

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
