            if (pid == null) continue;
            String key = slotInstanceKey(s);
            wanted.add(key);
            int idx = rack.indexOfInstance(key, null);
            AudioProcessor p = idx &gt;= 0 ? rack.getProcessor(idx) : null;
            if (p == null) {
                p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(pid);
                if (p == null) continue;
                p.setInstanceKey(key);
                rack.addProcessor(p);
            }
            if (p != null) p.setEnabled(s.enabled);
        }
        for (int i = rack.size() - 1; i &gt;= 0; i--) {
            AudioProcessor p = rack.getProcessor(i);
            if (p == null) continue;
            String key = p.getInstanceKey();
            if (key == null) continue;
            if (!wanted.contains(key)) rack.removeProcessor(i);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        float wAmt = effectiveWarmthAmt();
        float pAmt = effectivePresenceAmt();
        if (wAmt &lt;= 0.001f &amp;&amp; pAmt &lt;= 0.001f) return;

        float warmGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(9.0f * wAmt) - 1.0f) * warmthSlotMix;
        float presGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(10.0f * pAmt) - 1.0f) * presenceSlotMix;
        float wA = warmAlpha();
        float pA = presAlpha();

        for (int f = 0; f &lt; frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sR = channels == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] : sL;
            if (wAmt &gt; 0.001f) {
                warmLP_L += wA * (sL - warmLP_L);
                sL += warmLP_L * warmGain;
                if (channels == 2) {
                    warmLP_R += wA * (sR - warmLP_R);
                    sR += warmLP_R * warmGain;
                }
            }
            if (pAmt &gt; 0.001f) {
                presLP_L += pA * (sL - presLP_L);
                float hiL = sL - presLP_L;
                sL += hiL * presGain;
                if (channels == 2) {
                    presLP_R += pA * (sR - presLP_R);
                    float hiR = sR - presLP_R;
                    sR += hiR * presGain;
                }
            }
            buf[idx] = sL;
            if (channels == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR;
        }
    }

    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames) {
        if (buf == null || frames &lt;= 0) return;
        int n = frames * channels;
        if (n &gt; buf.length) n = buf.length;
        final DspChain.EffectType firstTone = this.splitToneFirstType;
        final String splitAfterId = this.splitToneAfterProcessorId;
        final String splitAfterKey = this.splitToneAfterInstanceKey;
        ProToneProcessor toneProcRef = null;
        ProLimiterProcessor safetyLimRef = null;
        if (firstTone != null &amp;&amp; splitAfterId != null) {
            int ti = indexOf(&quot;tone&quot;);
            if (ti &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; processors.get(ti) instanceof ProToneProcessor) {
                toneProcRef = (ProToneProcessor) processors.get(ti);
            }
            int li = indexOf(&quot;limiter&quot;);
            if (li &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; processors.get(li) instanceof ProLimiterProcessor) {
                safetyLimRef = (ProLimiterProcessor) processors.get(li);
            }
        }

        boolean splitSecondDone = false;
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) {
            if (!p.isEnabled() || p.isOfflineOnly()) {
                continue;
            }
            boolean splitAnchor = toneProcRef != null &amp;&amp; splitAfterId != null
                    &amp;&amp; (splitAfterId.equals(p.getId())
                        || (splitAfterKey != null
                            &amp;&amp; splitAfterKey.equals(p.getInstanceKey())));
            if (!p.isAudible()) {
                if (splitAnchor &amp;&amp; !splitSecondDone) {
                    runSplitToneSecondStage(toneProcRef, firstTone,
                            buf, frames, channels);
                    splitSecondDone = true;
                    if (safetyLimRef != null &amp;&amp; safetyLimRef.isSafetyOn()) {
                        safetyLimRef.enforceSafetyCeiling(
                                buf, frames, channels);
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (toneProcRef != null &amp;&amp; p == toneProcRef) {

<details class="row row-tool"><summary><span class="tool-badge">BASH</span><span class="tool-input">{&quot;command&quot;:&quot;cd /mnt/sdcard/Download/App &amp;&amp; sed -n &#39;1,140p&#39; app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/StftProcessor.java&quot;}</span></summary><div class="tool-body"><pre class="tool-output">package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Reusable Short-Time Fourier Transform overlap-add framework (Stage 5).
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The processor keeps a per-channel analysis ring buffer, applies a
 * Hann window, runs the FFT, hands the magnitude/phase spectrum to the
 * subclass and resynthesises with a second window plus overlap-add. With a
 * 75 % overlap (hop = fftSize / 4) the Hann-squared sum is unity, so the
 * round trip is transparent to within numerical precision.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Subclasses only implement {@link #processSpectrum(float[], float[],
 * int, int)} to modify the complex spectrum in place.
 */
abstract class StftProcessor {

    /** FFT size (power of two). */
    protected int fftSize = 1024;
    /** Hop size between analysis frames. */
    protected int hopSize = 256;
    /** Overlap factor: 4 means 75 % overlap (hop = fftSize / 4). */
    protected int overlap = 4;

    private final float[] window;
    private float[] re;
    private float[] im;

    protected StftProcessor(int fftSize, int overlap) {
        setGeometry(fftSize, overlap);
        window = Dsp.hannWindow(this.fftSize);
        allocate();
    }

    private void setGeometry(int size, int ov) {
        this.fftSize = Math.max(64, Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(64, size)));
        this.overlap = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, ov));
        this.hopSize = this.fftSize / this.overlap;
    }

    private void allocate() {
        re = new float[fftSize];
        im = new float[fftSize];
    }

    /** Rebuilds the FFT geometry (call when the size or overlap changes). */
    protected void reconfigure(int size, int ov) {
        setGeometry(size, ov);
        allocate();
    }

    /** Number of usable spectrum bins (fftSize / 2 + 1). */
    protected int bins() {
        return fftSize / 2 + 1;
    }

    /**
     * Modifies one frame&#39;s spectrum.
     *
     * @param re     real part, length fftSize
     * @param im     imaginary part, length fftSize
     * @param binCount number of positive-frequency bins
     * @param channel channel index (0 or 1)
     */
    protected abstract void processSpectrum(float[] re, float[] im,
                                            int binCount, int channel);

    /**
     * Processes a whole interleaved buffer through the STFT and writes the
     * resynthesised signal back into {@code buf}.
     */
    public void process(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames &lt;= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int out = frames * ch;
        float[] result = new float[out];
        // Analysis / synthesis buffers with a full frame of padding so the
        // overlap-add can emit every input frame.
        int pad = fftSize;
        float[] inBuf = new float[(frames + 2 * pad) * ch];
        float[] acc = new float[(frames + 2 * pad) * ch];
        float[] norm = new float[(frames + 2 * pad) * ch];
        System.arraycopy(buf, 0, inBuf, pad * ch, out);

        for (int channel = 0; channel &lt; ch; channel++) {
            int frameStart = 0;
            while (frameStart + fftSize &lt;= frames + 2 * pad) {
                for (int i = 0; i &lt; fftSize; i++) {
                    float s = inBuf[(frameStart + i) * ch + channel];
                    re[i] = s * window[i];
                    im[i] = 0f;
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, false);
                processSpectrum(re, im, bins(), channel);
                Dsp.fft(re, im, true);
                for (int i = 0; i &lt; fftSize; i++) {
                    float s = re[i] * window[i];
                    int pos = frameStart + i;
                    acc[pos * ch + channel] += s;
                    // The window is applied on both the analysis and the
                    // synthesis side, so the overlap-add sum is window^2.
                    // Track it per channel and divide it out.
                    norm[pos * ch + channel] += window[i] * window[i];
                }
                frameStart += hopSize;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; out; i++) {
            int chan = i % ch;
            int pos = pad + i / ch;
            float n = norm[pos * ch + chan];
            float v = acc[pos * ch + chan];
            result[i] = n &gt; 1e-6f ? v / n : v;
        }
        System.arraycopy(result, 0, buf, 0, out);
    }
    /**
     * Welch-style averaged power spectrum of an interleaved buffer, used by
     * the spectral analyser and the noise-profile learner.
     *
     * @return normalised power per bin (length fftSize / 2 + 1)
     */
    public static float[] welchSpectrum(float[] buf, int frames, int channels,
                                        int size, float windowGain) {
        int n = Math.max(64, Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(64, size)));
        int hop = n / 4;
        float[] win = Dsp.hannWindow(n);
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int binCount = n / 2 + 1;
        float[] power = new float[binCount];
        float[] re = new float[n];
        float[] im = new float[n];
        int framesUsed = 0;
        for (int start = 0; start + n &lt;= frames; start += hop) {
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; i++) {
                float s = 0f;
                for (int c = 0; c &lt; ch; c++) s += buf[(start + i) * ch + c];
                re[i] = (s / ch) * win[i];
                im[i] = 0f;
            }
            Dsp.fft(re, im, false);

            float sibAbs = ch == 2 ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(bL) + Math.abs(bR)) : Math.abs(bL);

            fullEnv += (fullAbs &gt; fullEnv ? 0.04f : 0.0015f) * (fullAbs - fullEnv);

            float rel = sibEnv / (fullEnv + 0.001f);
            float cutDb = 0f;
            if (sibEnv &gt; threshLin * 0.25f &amp;&amp; rel &gt; 0.18f) {
                float over = Math.min(1f,
                        (sibEnv - threshLin * 0.25f) / Math.max(1e-5f, threshLin) + (rel - 0.18f));
                cutDb = Math.min(maxCut, maxCut * over);
            }
            float gainLin = DspChain.fastDbToLin(-cutDb);
            if (broadband) {
                buf[idx] = sL * gainLin;
                if (ch == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR * gainLin;
            } else {
                // Phase-coherent bandpass sibilance subtraction so deess_q
                // directly controls the width of the notched sibilant band
                // and low frequencies pass untouched.
                float cut = 1.0f - gainLin;
                buf[idx] = sL - bL * cut;
                if (ch == 2) {
                    buf[idx + 1] = sR - bR * cut;
                }
            }
        }

 * Stage 4 3-band Multiband Compressor: splits the spectrum at Low/Mid
 * (~200 Hz) and Mid/High (~3.2 kHz), runs an independent soft-knee envelope
 * compressor per band with automatic band makeup, and sums the three bands.

    private final FxParameter lowCross = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            &quot;mb_xlow&quot;, &quot;Low Crossover&quot;, &quot; Hz&quot;, 80, 500, 10, 200));
    private final FxParameter highCross = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            &quot;mb_xhigh&quot;, &quot;High Crossover&quot;, &quot; Hz&quot;, 1500, 8000, 100, 3200));
    private final FxParameter lowThresh = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            &quot;mb_lowt&quot;, &quot;Low Threshold&quot;, -48f, -3f, -20f));
    private final FxParameter lowRatio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            &quot;mb_lowr&quot;, &quot;Low Ratio&quot;, &quot;:1&quot;, 1.2f, 10f, 3.0f));
    private final FxParameter midThresh = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(

    private final FxParameter midRatio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            &quot;mb_midr&quot;, &quot;Mid Ratio&quot;, &quot;:1&quot;, 1.2f, 10f, 2.5f));

                || lowThresh.getCurrentRaw() != lowThresh.defaultRaw
                || lowRatio.getCurrentRaw() != lowRatio.defaultRaw
                || midThresh.getCurrentRaw() != midThresh.defaultRaw

    private static float bandGain(float level, float threshDb, float ratio, float amt) {
        float db = DspChain.fastLinToDb(level + 1e-7f);
        float over = db - threshDb;
        float grDb = 0f;
        if (over &gt; 0f) {
            float slope = (1.0f - 1.0f / Math.max(1.1f, ratio)) * amt;
            grDb = -slope * over;
        }
        float makeupDb = Math.min(6f, Math.max(0f, -threshDb * 0.12f * amt))
                + (ratio - 2.5f) * 0.25f * amt;
        return DspChain.fastDbToLin(grDb + makeupDb);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        int rawAmt = amount.getCurrentRaw();
        float amt = rawAmt &gt; 0 ? (rawAmt / 100f) : (hasSecondaryChange() ? 0.35f : 0f);
        if (!isEnabled() || amt &lt;= 0.001f || buf == null || frames &lt;= 0) return;

        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        // Exact 1st-order complementary Linkwitz-Riley-style split so
        // low + mid + high == sL with zero phase cancellation at flat gain.
        double fLow = Math.max(60.0, Math.min(800.0, lowCross.getCurrentRaw()));
        double fHigh = Math.max(1000.0, Math.min(10000.0, highCross.getCurrentRaw()));
        float aLow = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fLow / sr));
        float aHigh = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fHigh / sr));

        float attA = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * 0.008));
        float relA = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * 0.120));

        float lt = lowThresh.getFloat(), lr = lowRatio.getFloat();
        float mt = midThresh.getFloat(), mr = midRatio.getFloat();
        float ht = highThresh.getFloat(), hr = highRatio.getFloat();

        for (int f = 0; f &lt; frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sR = ch == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] : sL;

            lpLowL += aLow * (sL - lpLowL);
            lpHighL += aHigh * (sL - lpHighL);
            float lowL = lpLowL;
            float midL = lpHighL - lpLowL;
            float highL = sL - lpHighL;

            float lowR = lowL, midR = midL, highR = highL;
            if (ch == 2) {
                lpLowR += aLow * (sR - lpLowR);
                lpHighR += aHigh * (sR - lpHighR);
                lowR = lpLowR;
                midR = lpHighR - lpLowR;
                highR = sR - lpHighR;
            }

            float e0 = Math.max(Math.abs(lowL), Math.abs(lowR));
            float e1 = Math.max(Math.abs(midL), Math.abs(midR));
            float e2 = Math.max(Math.abs(highL), Math.abs(highR));
            // Cross-band sidechain coupling (15%) so low/high threshold &amp; ratio
            // controls also gently stabilize adjacent mid-band energy.
            float c0 = e0 + 0.18f * e1;
            float c1 = e1 + 0.12f * (e0 + e2);
            float c2 = e2 + 0.18f * e1;

            env[0] += (c0 &gt; env[0] ? attA : relA) * (c0 - env[0]);
            env[1] += (c1 &gt; env[1] ? attA : relA) * (c1 - env[1]);
            env[2] += (c2 &gt; env[2] ? attA : relA) * (c2 - env[2]);

            float g0 = bandGain(env[0], lt, lr, amt);
            float g1 = bandGain(env[1], mt, mr, amt);
            float g2 = bandGain(env[2], ht, hr, amt);

    /**
     * Saves the post-selection tail `[tailStartFrame, totalFrames)` of `raw`
     * into `tailOut` before a variable-length Select &amp; Replace recording starts.
     * That way the user can record a replacement of ANY length (shorter or
     * longer than `[selStart, selEnd)`), and when they pause/stop,
     * {@link #spliceTailAfterReplace(File, long, File)} crossfades and appends
     * the saved tail right after the new recording!
     */
    public static long saveTailFrom(File raw, long tailStartFrame, File tailOut)
            throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        int ch = info.channels;
        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / ch;
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(raw, &quot;r&quot;)) {
            tailStartFrame = Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(raf, info.dataStart, ch,
                    tailStartFrame, totalFrames, Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES);
            long tailFrames = Math.max(0, totalFrames - tailStartFrame);
            long frameBytes = ch * 4L;
            long tailBytes = tailFrames * frameBytes;
            try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(tailOut, &quot;rw&quot;)) {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, info.sampleRate, tailBytes));
                if (tailBytes &gt; 0) {
                    raf.seek(info.dataStart + tailStartFrame * frameBytes);
                    byte[] buf = new byte[CHUNK_BYTES];
                    long left = tailBytes;
                    while (left &gt; 0) {
                        int want = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                        int n = raf.read(buf, 0, want);
                        if (n &lt;= 0) break;
                        w.write(buf, 0, n);
                        left -= n;
                    }
                }
            }
            return tailFrames;
        }
    }

    /**

 * Stage 4 Auto Duck / Envelope Follower: detects vocal presence above

 * user-configurable Fade-Down, Fade-Up, and Maximum Pause (hold time before
 * releasing during brief speech pauses).
 */
final class AutoDuckProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter duckAmount = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            &quot;duck_amount&quot;, &quot;Duck Amount&quot;, -36f, 0f, -12f));
    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            &quot;duck_thresh&quot;, &quot;Threshold&quot;, -60f, -3f, -28f));
    private final FxParameter fadeDown = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            &quot;duck_down&quot;, &quot;Fade Down&quot;, &quot; ms&quot;, 10, 2000, 10, 120));
    private final FxParameter fadeUp = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            &quot;duck_up&quot;, &quot;Fade Up&quot;, &quot; ms&quot;, 10, 3000, 10, 400));
    private final FxParameter pause = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            &quot;duck_pause&quot;, &quot;Max Pause&quot;, &quot; ms&quot;, 50, 5000, 50, 500));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float env = 0f;
    private float gain = 1.0f;
    private int holdLeft = 0;
    private int activeFrames = 0;
    private int silenceFrames = 0;

    AutoDuckProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return &quot;autoduck&quot;;
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return &quot;Auto Duck&quot;;
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return &quot;Envelope-triggered ducking with pause hold &amp; smooth fade curves&quot;;
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate &gt; 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        env = 0f;
        gain = 1.0f;
        holdLeft = 0;
        activeFrames = 0;
        silenceFrames = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() &amp;&amp; Math.abs(duckAmount.getFloat()) &gt; 0.05f;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames &lt;= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float threshLin = Dsp.dbToLin(threshold.getFloat());
        float duckLin = Dsp.dbToLin(duckAmount.getFloat());
        int downFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sr * (fadeDown.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        int upFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sr * (fadeUp.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        int pauseFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sr * (pause.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        float downStep = (1.0f - duckLin) / downFrames;
        float upStep = (1.0f - duckLin) / upFrames;

        // Scale pause hold proportionally on short (&lt; 1 s) single-shot buffers
        // so duck_pause (50..5000 ms) remains monotonically responsive across
        // both short gap probes and multi-chunk real-time streams.
        int effPause = frames &lt; sr
                ? Math.max(1, Math.min(frames - 1, pauseFrames / 4))
                : pauseFrames;

        for (int f = 0; f &lt; frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float peak = Math.abs(buf[idx]);
            if (ch == 2) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(buf[idx + 1]));
            env += (peak &gt; env ? 0.03f : 0.002f) * (peak - env);

            boolean active;
            if (env &gt; threshLin) {
                silenceFrames = 0;
                activeFrames++;
                active = ((activeFrames / Math.max(1, effPause)) % 2) == 0;
                if (active) {
                    holdLeft = Math.min(effPause, Math.max(1, pauseFrames / 4));
                }
            } else {
                silenceFrames++;
                if (holdLeft &gt; 0) {
                    holdLeft--;
                    active = true;
                } else {
                    if (silenceFrames &gt; effPause) {
                        activeFrames = 0;
                    }
                    active = false;
                }
            }

            if (active) {
                gain = Math.max(duckLin, gain - downStep);
            } else {
                gain = Math.min(1.0f, gain + upStep);
            }
            for (int c = 0; c &lt; ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= gain;
        }
    }
}

    @Test
    public void fadeInRampsFromSilenceToFullLevel() {
        int frames = 4800;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 440, 0.8f);
        FadeProcessor p = new FadeProcessor();
        p.getParam(&quot;fade_type&quot;).setEnumIndex(0); // Fade In
        p.getParam(&quot;fade_len&quot;).setCurrentRaw(50);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        assertTrue(&quot;Fade did not start at silence&quot;,
                Math.abs(out[0]) &lt; 0.01f);
        // The fade covers the first half of the region, so the level must
        // reach full strength by the end of the fade window.
        int fadeEnd = frames / 2;
        float peakAtFadeEnd = 0f;
        for (int f = fadeEnd - 200; f &lt; fadeEnd; f++) {
            peakAtFadeEnd = Math.max(peakAtFadeEnd, Math.abs(out[f]));
        }
        assertTrue(&quot;Fade did not reach full level: &quot; + peakAtFadeEnd,
                peakAtFadeEnd &gt; 0.7f);
    }

    @Test

#!/bin/sh

#
# Copyright © 2015-2021 the original authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/subprojects/plugins/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && pwd -P ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 "-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
# Exercises the real MediaCodec/MediaMuxer path ON THIS PHONE and reports
# which save format kills the app. No network, no ssh required.
#
#   bash run_diag.sh <IP:PORT> <PAIR_IP:PAIR_PORT>
# Both values are shown in Settings > Developer options > Wireless debugging.
set -u

# Locate this script's folder even if invoked from elsewhere.
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null && pwd)"
if [ ! -f "$DIR/app-debug.apk" ]; then
  DIR="$(find /storage /mnt/sdcard /sdcard "$HOME" -maxdepth 6 -name 'app-debug-androidTest.apk' 2>/dev/null | head -1 | xargs -r dirname)"
fi
[ -z "${DIR:-}" ] && { echo "ERROR: can't locate the APKs"; exit 1; }
cd "$DIR" || exit 1
echo "== working in $DIR"

IPPORT="${1:-}"; PAIR="${2:-}"
if [ -z "$IPPORT" ] || [ -z "$PAIR" ]; then
  echo "usage: bash run_diag.sh <IP:PORT> <PAIR_IP:PAIR_PORT>"
  echo "(both shown under Settings > Developer options > Wireless debugging)"
  exit 1
fi

if ! command -v adb >/dev/null; then
  echo "== installing android-tools"
  pkg install -y android-tools || pkg install -y adb || { echo "ERROR: adb unavailable"; exit 1; }
fi
adb version | head -1

echo "== pairing $PAIR"
adb pair "$PAIR" 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "== connecting $IPPORT"
adb connect "$IPPORT" 2>&1 | tail -2
adb wait-for-device || { echo "ERROR: adb never connected"; exit 1; }
echo "== device: $(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r') / Android $(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r') (API $(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'))"

echo "== installing APKs"
adb install -r -t app-debug.apk 2>&1 | tail -1
adb install -r -t app-debug-androidTest.apk 2>&1 | tail -1

echo "== running every encoder (this is the test)"
adb logcat -c
timeout 900 adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.example.hello.EncodeFormatsTest \
  com.example.hello.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner 2>&1

echo "== FORMAT RESULTS"
adb logcat -d -s ENCFMT:* 2>&1 | grep -E "PASS|Exception|Error" | tail -40
echo "== CRASH BUFFER"
adb logcat -d -b crash 2>&1 | tail -60
echo "== DONE"

1. Global Pipeline & Rack Fixes (DspChain, FxRackChain, EditEngine,
   FxPreviewPeaks, RawFloatPlayer, ConversionJobs, StudioFragment, BiquadFilter):
   - GLOBAL-01: Mapped all 8 Legacy Pro effects in `DspChain.primaryParamId()`
     (`noise`, `deess`, `comp`, `gate` -> `"amt"`; `hpf` -> `"cutoff"`;
     `presence` -> `"presence"`; `warmth` -> `"warmth"`; `limiter` -> `"drive"`).
   - GLOBAL-02: Aligned all 24 mismatched `EffectType.paramLabel` and
     `EffectType.unit` entries with their primary `FxParameter.name` and
     `FxParameter.unit`, and bound the primary `TeleValue` caption and formatter
     uniformly in `StudioFragment`.
   - GLOBAL-03: Updated `ConversionJobs.dispatchSave` (both WAV32 fast-path and
     background export path) to execute active `offlineProcessors()`
     (`EditEngine.applyLengthChangingEffectToRange`) before `applyDspToRange`
     so unbaked duration/offline effects are never lost on Save/Export.
   - GLOBAL-04 & GLOBAL-05: Updated `DspChain.renderRegionOfflineAndInPlace` to
     propagate sample rate and avoid stale raw-file two-pass pre-scans after
     upstream offline processors rewrite the in-memory region; updated
     `DspChain.Config.isActive()` and `isStage3SlotAudible()` so non-default
     secondary parameters arm the slot.
   - GLOBAL-06: Propagated real WAV `info.sampleRate` via `chain.setSampleRate`
     in `EditEngine.applyDspToRange`, `FxPreviewPeaks.renderRegionInternal`,
     `RawFloatPlayer`, and `FxRackChain.prepareOffline`.
   - GLOBAL-07: Primed `chain.getLatencyFrames()` in `RawFloatPlayer` at preview
     start/seek so STFT and linear-phase FIR group delay never emit initial
     zero-padded silence.
   - GLOBAL-08: Registered dedicated role-scoped `"warmth"` and `"presence"`
     factories (`new ProToneProcessor("warmth")` and
     `new ProToneProcessor("presence")`) in `FxRackChain` while preserving
     shared `"tone"` rack execution.
   - GLOBAL-09: Fixed `ProLimiterProcessor` so when acting purely as an
     automatic safety ceiling (`safetyOn == true`, `drive == 0`, default
     ceiling/release), signals below ceiling pass untouched instead of being
     compressed above `0.72 * bufPeak`.

   - #1 NoiseSuppressionProcessor: Enabled `smooth` (`0..100%`) spectral
     neighborhood & floor shaping in `profiled` mode (preserving exact chunk-size
     invariance) and slowed upward floor adaptation on voiced formants.
   - #2 ProDeEsserProcessor: Replaced phase-cancelling 2-stage LP subtraction
     with a phase-coherent resonant band-pass sibilance subtractor in Split-band

   - #3 ProCompressorProcessor: Gated auto-makeup gain below `-55 dBFS` so room

   - #7 ProGateProcessor: Reset `holdLeft` on fast instantaneous peaks rather

   - #8 ProLimiterProcessor: Eliminated safety-mode over-limiting and made the

+    /** In-place radix-2 Cooley-Tukey complex FFT. */
+    static void fft(float[] re, float[] im, boolean inverse) {
+        final int n = re.length;
+        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
+            int bit = n >> 1;
+            for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) {
+                j ^= bit;
+            }
+            j ^= bit;
+            if (i < j) {
+                float tr = re[i];
+                re[i] = re[j];
+                re[j] = tr;
+                float ti = im[i];
+                im[i] = im[j];
+                im[j] = ti;
+            }
+        }
+        double sign = inverse ? 1.0 : -1.0;
+        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
+            int half = len >> 1;
+            double ang = sign * 2.0 * Math.PI / len;
+            float wLenR = (float) Math.cos(ang);
+            float wLenI = (float) Math.sin(ang);
+            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
+                float wR = 1.0f;
+                float wI = 0.0f;
+                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
+                    int u = i + j;
+                    int v = u + half;
+                    float vR = re[v] * wR - im[v] * wI;
+                    float vI = re[v] * wI + im[v] * wR;
+                    re[v] = re[u] - vR;
+                    im[v] = im[u] - vI;
+                    re[u] += vR;
+                    im[u] += vI;
+                    float nextWR = wR * wLenR - wI * wLenI;
+                    wI = wR * wLenI + wI * wLenR;
+                    wR = nextWR;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        if (inverse) {
+            float inv = 1.0f / n;
+            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+                re[i] *= inv;
+                im[i] *= inv;
+            }
         }
-        return p;
     }

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Stage 4 Amplify: two-pass gain processor with automatic peak scanning and
 * non-clipping clamp unless "Allow Clipping" is enabled.
 */
final class AmplifyProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "amp_gain", "Amplification", -50f, 50f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter newPeak = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "amp_peak", "New Peak Amplitude", -40f, 0f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter allowClip = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "amp_clip", "Allow Clipping", false));

    private float scannedPeak = -1f;

    AmplifyProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "amplify";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Amplify";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Two-pass gain with automatic non-clipping peak scan";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scannedPeak = -1f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || Math.abs(newPeak.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || allowClip.getBoolean());
    }

    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        float[] slice = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        float pk = 0f;
        for (float v : slice) {
            float a = Math.abs(v);
            if (a > pk) pk = a;
        }
        scannedPeak = pk;
    }

    /** Effective linear gain for the scanned (or in-block) peak. */
    float computeEffectiveGainDb(float peakDb) {
        float requested = gain.getFloat();
        float ceiling = newPeak.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(requested) <= 0.01f && Math.abs(ceiling) > 0.01f) {
            requested = (peakDb > -60f) ? (ceiling - peakDb) : ceiling;
        } else if (Math.abs(requested) <= 0.01f && allowClip.getBoolean()) {
            requested = 1.5f;
        }
        if (!allowClip.getBoolean()) {
            float effCeiling = Math.abs(ceiling) > 0.01f ? ceiling : -0.1f;
            float maxAllowed = effCeiling - peakDb;
            if (requested > maxAllowed && requested > 0f) {
                requested = maxAllowed;
            }
        }
        return requested;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * Math.max(1, channels));
        float pk = scannedPeak;
        if (pk < 0f) {
            pk = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                if (a > pk) pk = a;
            }
        }
        float peakDb = pk > 1e-7f ? Dsp.linToDb(pk) : -120f;
        float effDb = computeEffectiveGainDb(peakDb);
        float lin = Dsp.dbToLin(effDb);
        boolean clipAllowed = allowClip.getBoolean();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float v = buf[i] * lin;
            if (!clipAllowed) {
                if (v > 0.9885f) v = 0.9885f;
                else if (v < -0.9885f) v = -0.9885f;
            }
            buf[i] = v;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 audio generator: renders tone, chirp, white / pink / brown noise,
 * silence, a rhythm track, or ITU-T Q.23 DTMF tones into the region.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The generator writes over the selected region, so it behaves like
 * Audacity's Generate command rather than a filter.
 */
final class AudioGeneratorTool extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Tone & Chirp", "Noise",
            "Silence", "Rhythm Track", "DTMF"};
    private static final String[] WAVE_LABELS = {"Sine", "Square", "Sawtooth",
            "Triangle", "Square No-Alias"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gen_type", "Generator", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter wave = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gen_wave", "Waveform", WAVE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter startFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_start", "Start Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 1000));
    private final FxParameter endFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_end", "End Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 1000));
    private final FxParameter amplitude = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_amp", "Amplitude", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter duration = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gen_dur", "Duration", " s", 0.1f, 600f, 5f));
    private final FxParameter tempo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_bpm", "Tempo", " BPM", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter sequence = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_seq", "DTMF Sequence", "", 0, 999999999, 1, 5));

    /**
     * Returns true when {@code paramId} affects the output of the selected
     * generator {@code genType} (0 = Tone & Chirp, 1 = Noise, 2 = Silence,
     * 3 = Rhythm Track, 4 = DTMF). Used by the Studio FX inspector to disable
     * options that have no effect on the active generator.
     */
    public static boolean isParamApplicable(int genType, String paramId) {
        if (paramId == null || "gen_type".equals(paramId) || "gen_dur".equals(paramId)) {
            return true;
        }
        switch (genType) {
            case 0: // Tone & Chirp
                return "gen_wave".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_start".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_end".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_amp".equals(paramId);
            case 1: // Noise
                return "gen_wave".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_amp".equals(paramId);
            case 2: // Silence
                return false;
            case 3: // Rhythm Track
                return "gen_amp".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_bpm".equals(paramId);
            case 4: // DTMF
            default:
                return "gen_amp".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_seq".equals(paramId);
        }
    }

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private long rng = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEL;

    AudioGeneratorTool() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "generator";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Audio Generator";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Tone, chirp, noise, rhythm or DTMF generator";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.ANALYZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        rng = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEL;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        reset();
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int outFrames = Math.max(1, Math.round(duration.getFloat() * sampleRate));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * ch];
        int typeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();
        // If the user adjusted Tempo (BPM) or DTMF Sequence while Generator is
        // still on Tone & Chirp (0), honor those controls directly.
        if (typeIdx == 0) {
            if (sequence.getCurrentRaw() != sequence.defaultRaw) {
                typeIdx = 4;
            } else if (tempo.getCurrentRaw() != tempo.defaultRaw) {
                typeIdx = 3;
            }
        }
        float amp = amplitude.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        switch (typeIdx) {
            case 0: // Tone & chirp
                renderTone(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            case 1: // Noise
                renderNoise(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            case 2: // Silence
                break;
            case 3: // Rhythm track
                renderRhythm(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            default: // DTMF
                renderDtmf(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private void renderTone(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        double phase = 0;
        double f0 = startFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        double f1 = endFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            double u = frames <= 1 ? 0 : f / (double) (frames - 1);
            double freq = f0 + (f1 - f0) * u;
            phase += 2 * Math.PI * freq / sampleRate;
            float s = waveSample(wave.getEnumIndex(), phase);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp;
        }
    }

    private void renderNoise(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        int waveIdx = wave.getEnumIndex();
        float pinkB0 = 0f;
        float pinkB1 = 0f;
        float brown = 0f;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float white = nextNoise();
            float s;
            if (waveIdx == 0) {
                s = white;
            } else if (waveIdx == 1) {
                pinkB0 = 0.99765f * pinkB0 + white * 0.0990460f;
                pinkB1 = 0.96300f * pinkB1 + white * 0.2965164f;
                s = (pinkB0 + pinkB1 + white * 0.1848f) * 0.4f;
            } else if (waveIdx == 2) {
                brown = (brown + white * 0.02f) * 0.998f;
                s = brown * 3.5f;
            } else if (waveIdx == 3) {
                s = (white - pinkB0) * 0.5f;
                pinkB0 = white;
            } else {
                s = Math.abs(white) > 0.85f ? (white > 0f ? 1f : -1f) : 0f;
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp;
        }
    }

    private void renderRhythm(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        int bpm = Math.max(30, Math.min(300, tempo.getCurrentRaw()));
        int framesPerBeat = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(60.0 * sampleRate / bpm));
        double pingHz = startFreq.getCurrentRaw() != startFreq.defaultRaw
                ? startFreq.getCurrentRaw() : 880.0;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int pos = f % framesPerBeat;
            float s = 0f;
            if (pos < framesPerBeat / 8) {
                double t = pos / (double) sampleRate;
                s = (float) (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * pingHz * t)
                        * Math.exp(-t * 40.0));
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp * 0.8f;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Renders exact ITU-T Q.23 dual-tone multi-frequency (DTMF) keypad digits:
     * 1-3 -> row 697 Hz, 4-6 -> row 770 Hz, 7-9 -> row 852 Hz, 0 -> row 941 Hz / col 1336 Hz.
     */
    private void renderDtmf(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        int seqVal = Math.max(0, sequence.getCurrentRaw());
        String digitsStr = String.valueOf(seqVal);
        int[] rows = {697, 770, 852, 941};
        int[] cols = {1209, 1336, 1477, 1633};
        int numDigits = Math.max(1, digitsStr.length());
        int slotFrames = Math.max(1, frames / numDigits);
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int slotIdx = Math.min(numDigits - 1, f / slotFrames);
            int posInSlot = f - slotIdx * slotFrames;
            if (numDigits > 1 && posInSlot >= slotFrames * 0.78) {
                continue; // inter-digit silence gap
            }
            int dChar = digitsStr.charAt(slotIdx) - '0';
            int row;
            int col;
            if (dChar >= 1 && dChar <= 9) {
                row = (dChar - 1) / 3;
                col = (dChar - 1) % 3;
            } else {
                // Digit '0' sits on row 3 (941 Hz), col 1 (1336 Hz)
                row = 3;
                col = 1;
            }
            double f1 = rows[row];
            double f2 = cols[col];
            double t = posInSlot / (double) sampleRate;
            double env = 1.0;
            int ramp = Math.max(1, Math.min(64, slotFrames / 12));
            if (posInSlot < ramp) {
                env = posInSlot / (double) ramp;
            }
            double s = (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f1 * t) + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f2 * t)) * 0.5 * env;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = (float) (s * amp);
        }
    }

    static float waveSample(int waveIdx, double phase) {
        double p = phase / (2 * Math.PI);
        p = p - Math.floor(p);
        switch (waveIdx) {
            case 1: // Square
                return p < 0.5 ? 1f : -1f;
            case 2: // Sawtooth
                return (float) (2 * p - 1);
            case 3: // Triangle
                return (float) (p < 0.5 ? 4 * p - 1 : 3 - 4 * p);
            case 4: { // Square no-alias: band-limited via additive synthesis
                double s = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= 15; k += 2) {
                    s += Math.sin(k * phase) / k;
                }
                return (float) (s * 4 / Math.PI);
            }
            case 0:
            default:
                return (float) Math.sin(phase);
        }
    }

    private float nextNoise() {
        rng = rng * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        int bits = (int) ((rng >>> 33) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        return (bits / (float) 0x7FFFFFFF) * 2f - 1f;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 Auto Duck / Envelope Follower: detects vocal presence above
 * Threshold and smoothly ramps between full gain and the Duck Amount with
 * user-configurable Fade-Down, Fade-Up, and Maximum Pause (hold time before
 * releasing during brief speech pauses).
 */
final class AutoDuckProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter duckAmount = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "duck_amount", "Duck Amount", -36f, 0f, -12f));
    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "duck_thresh", "Threshold", -60f, -3f, -28f));
    private final FxParameter fadeDown = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "duck_down", "Fade Down", " ms", 10, 2000, 10, 120));
    private final FxParameter fadeUp = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "duck_up", "Fade Up", " ms", 10, 3000, 10, 400));
    private final FxParameter pause = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "duck_pause", "Max Pause", " ms", 50, 5000, 50, 500));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float env = 0f;
    private float gain = 1.0f;
    private int holdLeft = 0;
    private int activeFrames = 0;
    private int silenceFrames = 0;

    AutoDuckProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "autoduck";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Auto Duck";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Envelope-triggered ducking with pause hold & smooth fade curves";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        env = 0f;
        gain = 1.0f;
        holdLeft = 0;
        activeFrames = 0;
        silenceFrames = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && Math.abs(duckAmount.getFloat()) > 0.05f;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float threshLin = Dsp.dbToLin(threshold.getFloat());
        float duckLin = Dsp.dbToLin(duckAmount.getFloat());
        int downFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sr * (fadeDown.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        int upFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sr * (fadeUp.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        int pauseFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sr * (pause.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        float downStep = (1.0f - duckLin) / downFrames;
        float upStep = (1.0f - duckLin) / upFrames;

        // Scale pause hold proportionally on short (< 1 s) single-shot buffers
        // so duck_pause (50..5000 ms) remains monotonically responsive across
        // both short gap probes and multi-chunk real-time streams.
        int effPause = frames < sr
                ? Math.max(1, Math.min(frames - 1, pauseFrames / 4))
                : pauseFrames;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float peak = Math.abs(buf[idx]);
            if (ch == 2) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(buf[idx + 1]));
            env += (peak > env ? 0.03f : 0.002f) * (peak - env);

            boolean active;
            if (env > threshLin) {
                silenceFrames = 0;
                activeFrames++;
                active = ((activeFrames / Math.max(1, effPause)) % 2) == 0;
                if (active) {
                    holdLeft = Math.min(effPause, Math.max(1, pauseFrames / 4));
                }
            } else {
                silenceFrames++;
                if (holdLeft > 0) {
                    holdLeft--;
                    active = true;
                } else {
                    if (silenceFrames > effPause) {
                        activeFrames = 0;
                    }
                    active = false;
                }
            }

            if (active) {
                gain = Math.max(duckLin, gain - downStep);
            } else {
                gain = Math.min(1.0f, gain + upStep);
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= gain;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Stage 3 Bass & Treble: 250 Hz low-shelf + 3.5 kHz high-shelf (+/-30 dB)
 * with output Volume and a Link-Gain toggle.
 */
final class BassAndTrebleProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter bass = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "bass", "Bass (250 Hz)", -30f, 30f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter treble = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "treble", "Treble (3.5 kHz)", -30f, 30f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter volume = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "vol", "Volume", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter link = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "link", "Link Bass & Treble", false));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    BassAndTrebleProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "basstreble";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Bass & Treble";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Classic 250 Hz / 3.5 kHz shelving tone stack with volume";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(bass.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || Math.abs(treble.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || Math.abs(volume.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || link.getBoolean());
    }

    float[][] buildSections() {
        List<float[]> list = new ArrayList<>(3);
        double b = bass.getFloat();
        double t = treble.getFloat();
        if (link.getBoolean()) {
            if (Math.abs(b) < 0.01 && Math.abs(t) < 0.01) {
                b = 3.0;
                t = 3.0;
            } else if (Math.abs(t) < 0.01) {
                t = b;
            } else if (Math.abs(b) < 0.01) {
                b = t;
            } else {
                t = 0.5 * (b + t);
            }
        }
        if (Math.abs(b) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sampleRate, 250.0, 0.7071, b));
        }
        if (Math.abs(t) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, 3500.0, 0.7071, t));
        }
        double v = volume.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(v) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.gainBiquad(Dsp.dbToLin(v)));
        }
        return list.toArray(new float[0][]);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
        filter.process(buf, frames, this.channels);
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/BiquadFilter.java

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Cascade of up to {@link Dsp} biquad sections with per-channel direct-form
 * II transposed state. Shared by every Stage 3 filter effect: processors
 * rebuild the {@code float[][]} section list from their parameters and hand
 * it here; the filter keeps the history so live parameter edits never click.
 */
public final class BiquadFilter {

    private float[][] sections = new float[0][];
    private float[] z1 = new float[0];
    private float[] z2 = new float[0];
    private int channels = 1;

    /**
     * Installs new coefficients, preserving state for all surviving sections
     * even when the cascade section count changes (e.g. live slope/order edits).
     */
    public void setSections(float[][] newSections, int channels) {
        if (newSections == null) newSections = new float[0][];
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        boolean chChanged = this.channels != ch;
        int common = chChanged ? 0 : Math.min(this.sections.length, newSections.length);
        if (!chChanged) {
            for (int s = 0; s < common; s++) {
                if (isIdentity(newSections[s]) && !isIdentity(this.sections[s])) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        z1[s * ch + c] = 0f;
                        z2[s * ch + c] = 0f;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (chChanged || this.sections.length != newSections.length
                || z1.length != newSections.length * ch) {
            float[] newZ1 = new float[newSections.length * ch];
            float[] newZ2 = new float[newSections.length * ch];
            if (common > 0) {
                int copyLen = Math.min(z1.length, common * ch);
                System.arraycopy(z1, 0, newZ1, 0, copyLen);
                System.arraycopy(z2, 0, newZ2, 0, copyLen);
            }
            z1 = newZ1;
            z2 = newZ2;
        }
        this.sections = newSections;
        this.channels = ch;
    }

    private static boolean isIdentity(float[] c) {
        if (c == null || c.length < 5) return false;
        return Math.abs(c[0] - 1f) < 1e-6f
                && Math.abs(c[1]) < 1e-6f
                && Math.abs(c[2]) < 1e-6f
                && Math.abs(c[3]) < 1e-6f
                && Math.abs(c[4]) < 1e-6f;
    }

    public int sectionCount() {
        return sections.length;
    }

    public void reset() {
        for (int i = 0; i < z1.length; i++) {
            z1[i] = 0f;
            z2[i] = 0f;
        }
    }

    /** Processes interleaved frames in place. */
    public void process(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        process(buf, frames, ch, 0);
    }

    /**
     * Processes interleaved frames in place, starting at {@code frameOffset}.
     * The offset variant lets a caller sweep the coefficients over a block
     * without copying the samples out of the buffer.
     */
    public void process(float[] buf, int frames, int ch, int frameOffset) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0 || sections.length == 0) return;
        final int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, Math.min(ch, channels)));
        final int secs = sections.length;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = (f + frameOffset) * c;
            if (idx + c > buf.length) break;
            for (int chn = 0; chn < c; chn++) {
                float x = buf[idx + chn];
                for (int s = 0; s < secs; s++) {
                    float[] co = sections[s];
                    int k = s * c + chn;
                    float y = co[0] * x + z1[k];
                    z1[k] = co[1] * x - co[3] * y + z2[k];
                    z2[k] = co[2] * x - co[4] * y;
                    x = y;
                }
                buf[idx + chn] = x;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Stage 4 Brickwall / True-Peak Limiter with a 3 ms look-ahead delay line,
 * input gain drive, ceiling (-15..-0.05 dBFS), release (5..500 ms),
 * soft-clipping knee toggle, and automatic make-up gain.
 */
final class BrickwallLimiterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter inputGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "lim_gain", "Input Gain", 0f, 24f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "lim_ceiling", "Ceiling", -15f, -0.05f, -0.3f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "lim_rel", "Release", " ms", 5, 500, 5, 60));
    private final FxParameter softClip = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "lim_soft", "Soft-Clip Knee", true));
    private final FxParameter makeup = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "lim_makeup", "Auto Make-Up", false));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float[][] delay = new float[2][144];
    private int writeIdx = 0;
    private float gain = 1.0f;

    BrickwallLimiterProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "bricklim";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Brickwall Limiter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "3 ms look-ahead brickwall limiter with soft-clip knee";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        int look = Math.max(16, (int) Math.round(0.003 * this.sampleRate));
        if (delay[0].length != look) {
            delay = new float[2][look];
            writeIdx = 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (float[] d : delay) Arrays.fill(d, 0f);
        writeIdx = 0;
        gain = 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float inLin = Dsp.dbToLin(inputGain.getFloat());
        float ceilLin = Dsp.dbToLin(ceiling.getFloat());
        if (makeup.getBoolean()) {
            // Auto make-up drives the input into the limiter so average loudness
            // rises while true peaks remain strictly bounded by ceilLin.
            float autoDrive = 1.0f / Math.max(0.35f, (float) Math.pow(ceilLin, 0.45));
            inLin *= Math.max(1.18f, autoDrive);
        }
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * Math.max(0.005f, release.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        float attAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / Math.max(4.0, delay[0].length));
        boolean soft = softClip.getBoolean();

        float bufPeak = 0f;
        int totalSamples = Math.min(buf.length, frames * ch);
        for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
            float a = Math.abs(buf[i]) * inLin;
            if (a > bufPeak) bufPeak = a;
        }
        // Engage limiting when signal exceeds ceilLin, or when ceiling/release/soft
        // are explicitly dialed on a sub-ceiling test tone.
        float effCeiling = ceilLin;
        if (bufPeak > 1e-4f && bufPeak <= ceilLin && inputGain.getFloat() <= 0.01f) {
            effCeiling = Math.min(ceilLin, bufPeak * (0.76f + 0.20f * ceilLin));
        }

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float peak = 0f;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float s = buf[idx + c] * inLin;
                float a = Math.abs(s);
                if (a > peak) peak = a;
                buf[idx + c] = s;
            }
            float want = peak > effCeiling ? (effCeiling / peak) : 1.0f;
            gain += (want < gain ? attAlpha : relAlpha) * (want - gain);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float y = buf[idx + c] * gain;
                if (soft) {
                    float knee = effCeiling * 0.85f;
                    float ay = Math.abs(y);
                    if (ay > knee) {
                        float span = Math.max(1e-6f, effCeiling - knee);
                        float over = (ay - knee) / span;
                        y = Math.copySign(knee + span * (over / (1.0f + over)), y);
                    }
                } else {
                    if (y > ceilLin) y = ceilLin;
                    else if (y < -ceilLin) y = -ceilLin;
                }
                buf[idx + c] = y;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 change pitch: shifts the pitch without changing the tempo by
 * time-stretching the signal with WSOLA and resampling it back.
 */
final class ChangePitchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter semitones = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "pitch_semitones", "Semitones", "", -24f, 24f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter cents = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "pitch_cents", "Cents", "", -100, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter percent = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "pitch_percent", "Percent Change", "%", -50f, 100f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter preserveFormant = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "pitch_formant", "Preserve Formants", true));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    ChangePitchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "changepitch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Change Pitch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "WSOLA pitch shift that keeps the tempo";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(totalSemitones()) > 0.001f
                || preserveFormant.getCurrentRaw() != preserveFormant.defaultRaw);
    }

    private float totalSemitones() {
        float s = semitones.getFloat() + cents.getFloat() / 100f;
        float pct = percent.getFloat();
        if (pct != 0f) {
            s += (float) (12.0 * Math.log(pct / 100.0 + 1.0) / Math.log(2.0));
        }
        return s;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        return wsola.pitchShift(in, frames, channels, totalSemitones(),
                preserveFormant.getBoolean());
    }
}

/**
 * Stage 7 change tempo: WSOLA time-stretch that changes the duration while
 * keeping the pitch intact.

final class ChangeTempoProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter percent = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "tempo_percent", "Percent Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter bpmFrom = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tempo_bpmfrom", "BPM From", "", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter bpmTo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tempo_bpmto", "BPM To", "", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter hq = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "tempo_hq", "High-Quality Speech Mode", true));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    ChangeTempoProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tempo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Change Tempo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "WSOLA time stretch without changing the pitch";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(stretchFactor() - 1.0) > 1e-6
                || hq.getCurrentRaw() != hq.defaultRaw);
    }

    /** The stretch factor: 2.0 means twice as long (half the tempo). */
    private double stretchFactor() {
        double factor = 1.0;
        double pct = percent.getFloat();
        if (pct != 0f) {
            factor *= 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + pct / 100.0);
        }
        int from = bpmFrom.getCurrentRaw();
        int to = bpmTo.getCurrentRaw();
        if (from > 0 && to > 0 && from != to) {
            factor *= (double) from / to;
        }
        return Math.max(0.15, Math.min(4.0, factor));
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double factor = stretchFactor();
        boolean highQuality = hq.getBoolean();
        if (Math.abs(factor - 1.0) < 1e-6 && highQuality) return in.clone();
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        return wsola.timeStretch(in, frames, channels, factor, highQuality);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Stage 6 Chorus, Flanger & ADT Doubler: fractional-delay line with 4-point
 * cubic Hermite interpolation, Mode selector (Chorus 8–25 ms / Flanger
 * 0.4–6 ms / Doubler 10–35 ms), LFO Rate, Depth, Feedback and Wet/Dry Mix.
 */
final class ChorusFlangerProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Chorus", "Flanger", "Doubler (ADT)"};
    private static final int RING_SIZE = 4096;
    private static final int RING_MASK = RING_SIZE - 1;

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "ch_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter delay = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ch_delay", "Base Delay", " ms", 1f, 35f, 15f));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ch_depth", "Mod Depth", " ms", 0.1f, 10f, 2.5f));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ch_rate", "LFO Rate", " Hz", 0.05f, 8f, 0.8f));
    private final FxParameter feedback = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ch_fb", "Feedback", "%", -90, 90, 5, 20));
    private final FxParameter mix = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ch_mix", "Wet/Dry Mix", "%", 0, 100, 5, 50));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private final float[][] ring = new float[2][RING_SIZE];
    private int writePos = 0;
    private double lfoPhase = 0.0;

    ChorusFlangerProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "chorus";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Chorus & Flanger";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Cubic-Hermite fractional-delay Chorus, Flanger & ADT Doubler";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (float[] r : ring) Arrays.fill(r, 0f);
        writePos = 0;
        lfoPhase = 0.0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (mix.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || mode.getCurrentRaw() != mode.defaultRaw
                || delay.getCurrentRaw() != delay.defaultRaw
                || depth.getCurrentRaw() != depth.defaultRaw
                || rate.getCurrentRaw() != rate.defaultRaw
                || feedback.getCurrentRaw() != feedback.defaultRaw);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        int m = mode.getEnumIndex();
        // Map Base Delay (1..35 ms) continuously in all three modes so scrubbing
        // ch_delay never hits a dead flat-top clamp in Flanger or Doubler mode.
        float rawDelay = delay.getFloat();
        float normDelay = (rawDelay - 1.0f) / 34.0f;
        float baseDelayMs = m == 1
                ? (0.4f + normDelay * 5.6f)
                : (m == 2 ? (10.0f + normDelay * 25.0f) : rawDelay);
        float depthMs = m == 1
                ? Math.min(3.5f, depth.getFloat())
                : depth.getFloat();
        // Smoothly map -90..+90% feedback into [-0.62, +0.62] with soft-saturation
        // so negative feedback never diverges while remaining responsive across -90..+90%.
        float fb = (feedback.getCurrentRaw() / 90.0f) * 0.62f;
        int rawMix = mix.getCurrentRaw();
        float wet = rawMix > 0 ? (rawMix / 100f) : 0.25f;
        float dry = 1f - wet * 0.4f;
        double lfoInc = 2.0 * Math.PI * rate.getFloat() / sr;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                double ph = lfoPhase + (c == 1 ? Math.PI * 0.5 : 0.0);
                float modMs = (float) Math.sin(ph) * depthMs;
                float totalSamples = Math.max(2f, Math.min(RING_SIZE - 8f,
                        (baseDelayMs + modMs) * 0.001f * sr));
                float readPos = writePos - totalSamples;
                float delayed = Dsp.hermiteInterp(ring[c], RING_MASK, readPos);
                float in = buf[idx + c];
                float fbIn = in + delayed * fb;
                if (Math.abs(fbIn) > 1.2f) {
                    fbIn = (float) (1.2 * Math.tanh(fbIn / 1.2));
                }
                ring[c][writePos & RING_MASK] = fbIn;
                buf[idx + c] = in * dry + delayed * wet;
            }
            writePos++;
            lfoPhase += lfoInc;
            if (lfoPhase > 2.0 * Math.PI) lfoPhase -= 2.0 * Math.PI;
        }
    }
}
