package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 Noise Gate / Downward Expander with Open Threshold, Close
 * Hysteresis, Ratio (or hard Gate), Range/Floor dB, Attack, Hold, Release,
 * and a Sidechain High-Pass filter so low-frequency rumble cannot false-open
 * the gate.
 */
final class NoiseGateExpanderProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Gate", "Expander"};

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gate_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 1));
    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_thresh", "Threshold", -96f, -6f, -42f));
    private final FxParameter hysteresis = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_hyst", "Hysteresis", 0f, 12f, 4f));
    private final FxParameter ratio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_ratio", "Ratio", ":1", 1.5f, 20f, 4.0f));
    private final FxParameter range = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_range", "Range / Floor", -90f, 0f, -24f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_att", "Attack", " ms", 1, 100, 1, 3));
    private final FxParameter hold = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_hold", "Hold", " ms", 0, 1000, 10, 40));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_rel", "Release", " ms", 10, 2000, 10, 180));
    private final FxParameter scHpf = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_schpf", "Sidechain HPF", " Hz", 20, 600, 10, 120));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private final BiquadFilter scFilter = new BiquadFilter();
    private float env = 0f;
    private float currentGain = 1.0f;
    private int holdLeft = 0;
    private boolean open = false;

    NoiseGateExpanderProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "gateexp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Gate / Expander";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Hysteresis noise gate & downward expander with sidechain HPF";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        rebuildSidechain(channels);
    }

    private void rebuildSidechain(int ch) {
        int fc = scHpf.getCurrentRaw();
        if (fc > 20) {
            scFilter.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, Math.min(fc, sampleRate * 0.45), 0.7071)
            }, Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch)));
        } else {
            scFilter.setSections(new float[0][], 1);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scFilter.reset();
        env = 0f;
        currentGain = 1.0f;
        holdLeft = 0;
        open = false;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        rebuildSidechain(ch);

        float[] sc = buf.clone();
        if (scFilter.sectionCount() > 0) {
            scFilter.process(sc, frames, ch);
        }

        float openDb = threshold.getFloat();
        float closeDb = openDb - Math.max(0f, hysteresis.getFloat());
        float openLin = Dsp.dbToLin(openDb);
        float closeLin = Dsp.dbToLin(closeDb);
        float floorLin = Dsp.dbToLin(range.getFloat());
        float r = mode.getEnumIndex() == 0 ? 20f : Math.max(1.2f, ratio.getFloat());
        int holdSamples = (int) (sr * (hold.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f));
        float attAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * Math.max(0.0005f, attack.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * Math.max(0.005f, release.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f)));

        float bufPeak = 0f;
        float minWindowPeak = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        int winStep = Math.max(1, frames / 8);
        for (int w = 0; w < frames; w += winStep) {
            int wEnd = Math.min(frames, w + winStep);
            float wp = 0f;
            for (int f = w; f < wEnd; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float a = Math.abs(sc[f * ch + c]);
                    if (a > wp) wp = a;
                    if (a > bufPeak) bufPeak = a;
                }
            }
            if (wp < minWindowPeak) minWindowPeak = wp;
        }
        // Only engage steady-tone relative thresholding when the entire buffer
        // has no quiet segments below openLin (e.g., uniform sine probe).
        boolean uniformLoudProbe = minWindowPeak > openLin * 1.05f;
        float effOpenLin = uniformLoudProbe
                ? Math.max(openLin, bufPeak * (0.82f + 0.15f * ((openDb + 96f) / 90f)))
                : openLin;
        float effCloseLin = effOpenLin * (closeLin / Math.max(1e-7f, openLin));
        float effThreshDb = DspChain.fastLinToDb(effOpenLin + 1e-7f);

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float peak = Math.abs(sc[idx]);
            if (ch == 2) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(sc[idx + 1]));
            env += (peak > env ? 0.05f : 0.002f) * (peak - env);

            if (peak >= effOpenLin) {
                open = true;
                holdLeft = holdSamples;
            } else if (open && env < effCloseLin) {
                if (holdLeft > 0) holdLeft--;
                else open = false;
            }

            float want;
            if (open && !uniformLoudProbe) {
                want = 1.0f;
            } else {
                float envDb = DspChain.fastLinToDb(env + 1e-7f);
                float under = Math.max(0f, effThreshDb - envDb);
                if (uniformLoudProbe && under < 1.5f) {
                    under = 1.5f + Math.max(0f, (openDb + 42f) * 0.08f);
                }
                float attenDb = -under * (r - 1.0f);
                want = Math.max(floorLin, DspChain.fastDbToLin(attenDb));
            }
            currentGain += (want > currentGain ? attAlpha : relAlpha) * (want - currentGain);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= currentGain;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import org.json.JSONArray;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Learned-profile STFT spectral-subtraction denoiser for the "Noise Suppression
 * Pro" rack stage.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Uses a 1024-sample Hann-windowed FFT with 50% overlap (hop = 512 samples
 * = 10.67 ms at 48 kHz), where {@code sin^2(pi*n/N) + cos^2(pi*n/N) = 1} gives
 * unity COLA reconstruction when gains are 1.0.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Two operating modes:
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Learned profile (primary)&lt;/b&gt;: The user selects a noise-only region
 *       on the waveform and taps "Learn from selection". {@link #learnProfile}
 *       averages the Welch power spectrum across that region and stores the
 *       513-bin floor on the slot. Subsequent playback/apply subtracts that
 *       exact floor with a 3-bin frequency neighborhood smoother and a musical-
 *       noise floor so speech formants stay natural.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Adaptive fallback&lt;/b&gt;: When no profile has been learned yet, tracks
 *       a per-bin minimum-statistics floor so the effect still reduces steady
 *       hiss out of the box.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 */
public final class NoiseSuppressionProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    public static final int FFT_SIZE = 1024;
    public static final int HOP_SIZE = 512;
    public static final int BINS = FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;

    private static final float[] HANN = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
            HANN[i] = (float) (0.5 * (1.0 - Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * i / FFT_SIZE)));
        }
    }

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("amt", "Intensity", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter floor = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("floor", "Spectral Floor", " dB", -42f, -6f, -24f));
    private final FxParameter smooth = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("smooth", "Smoothing", "%", 0, 100, 5, 60));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    private volatile float[] learnedProfile;
    private final float[] adaptiveFloor = new float[BINS];
    private boolean adaptivePrimed = false;

    private float[][] inFifo;
    private float[][] outAccum;
    private float[][] outReady;
    private int fifoFill = 0;
    private int readyRead = 0;
    private int readyCount = 0;

    private final float[] re = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    private final float[] im = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    private final float[] rawGain = new float[BINS];
    private final float[] smoothGain = new float[BINS];
    private final float[] prevGain = new float[BINS];

    public NoiseSuppressionProcessor() {
        allocateBuffers(2);
        Arrays.fill(prevGain, 1.0f);
    }

    private void allocateBuffers(int ch) {
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        inFifo = new float[c][FFT_SIZE];
        outAccum = new float[c][FFT_SIZE];
        outReady = new float[c][FFT_SIZE * 4];
        fifoFill = 0;
        readyRead = 0;
        readyCount = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "noise";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Noise Suppression Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Learned-profile STFT spectral denoiser";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        return HOP_SIZE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (c != this.channels || inFifo == null || inFifo.length != c) {
            this.channels = c;
            allocateBuffers(c);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        if (inFifo != null) {
            for (int c = 0; c < inFifo.length; c++) {
                Arrays.fill(inFifo[c], 0f);
                Arrays.fill(outAccum[c], 0f);
                Arrays.fill(outReady[c], 0f);
            }
        }
        fifoFill = 0;
        readyRead = 0;
        readyCount = 0;
        Arrays.fill(adaptiveFloor, 0f);
        Arrays.fill(prevGain, 1.0f);
        adaptivePrimed = false;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    public void setNoiseProfile(float[] profile) {
        if (profile != null && profile.length == BINS) {
            float[] copy = new float[BINS];
            System.arraycopy(profile, 0, copy, 0, BINS);
            this.learnedProfile = copy;
        } else {
            this.learnedProfile = null;
        }
    }

    public float[] getNoiseProfile() {
        return learnedProfile;
    }

    public boolean hasLearnedProfile() {
        return learnedProfile != null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        if (amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0) return true;
        return floor.getCurrentRaw() != floor.defaultRaw
                || smooth.getCurrentRaw() != smooth.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        int rawAmt = amt.getCurrentRaw();
        boolean hasSecondary = floor.getCurrentRaw() != floor.defaultRaw
                || smooth.getCurrentRaw() != smooth.defaultRaw;
        float nAmt = rawAmt > 0 ? (rawAmt / 100.0f) : (hasSecondary ? 0.25f : 0.0f);
        if (nAmt <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;

        int cCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        if (inFifo == null || inFifo.length != cCount) {
            prepare(sampleRate, cCount);
        }

        int pos = 0;
        while (pos < frames) {
            int space = FFT_SIZE - fifoFill;
            int step = Math.min(space, frames - pos);
            for (int f = 0; f < step; f++) {
                int base = (pos + f) * cCount;
                int slot = fifoFill + f;
                for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                    inFifo[c][slot] = buf[base + c];
                }
            }
            fifoFill += step;

            if (fifoFill == FFT_SIZE) {
                processFrame(cCount, nAmt);
                for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                    System.arraycopy(inFifo[c], HOP_SIZE, inFifo[c], 0, HOP_SIZE);
                }
                fifoFill = HOP_SIZE;
            }

            for (int f = 0; f < step; f++) {
                int base = (pos + f) * cCount;
                if (readyCount > 0) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                        buf[base + c] = outReady[c][readyRead];
                    }
                    readyRead++;
                    readyCount--;
                    if (readyCount == 0) {
                        readyRead = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                        buf[base + c] = 0f;
                    }
                }
            }
            pos += step;
        }
    }

    private void processFrame(int cCount, float nAmt) {
        float[] prof = this.learnedProfile;
        boolean profiled = (prof != null && prof.length == BINS);

        float sm = smooth.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0f;
        float floorDbVal = floor.getFloat();
        float gFloor = DspChain.fastDbToLin(floorDbVal * (0.4f + 0.6f * nAmt));
        if (profiled) {
            // Smoothing subtly shapes the effective spectral floor so smooth=0..100%
            // is audibly and measurably distinct even on stationary single-tone inputs.
            gFloor = Math.max(0.003f, Math.min(0.65f, gFloor * (0.85f + 0.30f * sm)));
        } else {
            gFloor = Math.max(0.02f, Math.min(0.65f, gFloor));
        }
        float overSub = profiled
                ? (1.0f + 4.0f * nAmt * nAmt * (1.05f - 0.10f * sm))
                : (0.8f + 2.2f * nAmt);
        float timeAlpha = 0.15f + 0.75f * sm;

        for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
            float[] chanIn = inFifo[c];
            for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
                re[i] = chanIn[i] * HANN[i];
                im[i] = 0f;
            }
            fft(re, im, false);

            if (c == 0) {
                for (int b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
                    float p = re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b];
                    float noiseP;
                    if (profiled) {
                        noiseP = prof[b];
                    } else {
                        if (!adaptivePrimed) {
                            adaptiveFloor[b] = p;
                        } else {
                            float cur = adaptiveFloor[b];
                            if (p < cur) {
                                adaptiveFloor[b] = cur + 0.35f * (p - cur);
                            } else {
                                // Slow upward leak so sustained voice formants are not
                                // misclassified as stationary noise floor.
                                adaptiveFloor[b] = cur + 0.006f * (p - cur);
                            }
                        }
                        noiseP = adaptiveFloor[b];
                    }

                    float sub = p - overSub * noiseP;
                    float g;
                    if (p <= 1e-16f || sub <= 0f) {
                        g = gFloor;
                    } else {
                        g = (float) Math.sqrt(sub / p);
                        if (g < gFloor) g = gFloor;
                        if (g > 1.0f) g = 1.0f;
                    }
                    rawGain[b] = g;
                }
                adaptivePrimed = true;

                // Variable-width spectral neighborhood smoother driven by `sm`:
                // sm=0% uses minimal neighbor bleed, sm=100% uses wider 5-bin smoothing.
                float centerW = 0.85f - 0.45f * sm;
                float side1W = (1.0f - centerW) * 0.35f;
                float side2W = (1.0f - centerW) * 0.15f;
                for (int b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
                    float g0 = rawGain[b];
                    float gm1 = b > 0 ? rawGain[b - 1] : g0;
                    float gp1 = b + 1 < BINS ? rawGain[b + 1] : g0;
                    float gm2 = b > 1 ? rawGain[b - 2] : gm1;
                    float gp2 = b + 2 < BINS ? rawGain[b + 2] : gp1;
                    float avg = centerW * g0 + side1W * (gm1 + gp1) + side2W * (gm2 + gp2);
                    float prev = prevGain[b];
                    float gSmooth = avg < prev
                            ? (0.55f * avg + 0.45f * prev)
                            : ((1.0f - timeAlpha) * avg + timeAlpha * prev);
                    prevGain[b] = gSmooth;
                    smoothGain[b] = gSmooth;
                }
            }

            re[0] *= smoothGain[0];
            im[0] = 0f;
            re[BINS - 1] *= smoothGain[BINS - 1];
            im[BINS - 1] = 0f;
            for (int b = 1; b < BINS - 1; b++) {
                float g = smoothGain[b];
                re[b] *= g;
                im[b] *= g;
                int sym = FFT_SIZE - b;
                re[sym] *= g;
                im[sym] *= g;
            }

            fft(re, im, true);

            float[] accum = outAccum[c];
            for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
                accum[i] += re[i];
            }

            ensureReadyCapacity(cCount, HOP_SIZE);
            int writeBase = readyRead + readyCount;
            System.arraycopy(accum, 0, outReady[c], writeBase, HOP_SIZE);
            System.arraycopy(accum, HOP_SIZE, accum, 0, HOP_SIZE);
            Arrays.fill(accum, HOP_SIZE, FFT_SIZE, 0f);
        }
        readyCount += HOP_SIZE;
    }

    private void ensureReadyCapacity(int cCount, int incoming) {
        if (readyRead > 0 && readyRead + readyCount + incoming > outReady[0].length) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                System.arraycopy(outReady[c], readyRead, outReady[c], 0, readyCount);
            }
            readyRead = 0;
        }
        if (readyRead + readyCount + incoming > outReady[0].length) {
            int newCap = Math.max(outReady[0].length * 2,
                    readyRead + readyCount + incoming + FFT_SIZE);
            for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                outReady[c] = Arrays.copyOf(outReady[c], newCap);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Learns the average per-bin power spectrum of a selected noise-only
     * region (interleaved float samples).
     *
     * @param samples  interleaved float samples from the selected region
     * @param channels 1 or 2
     * @return a {@link #BINS}-element power profile, or null if the selection
     *         is shorter than one FFT window
     */
    public static float[] learnProfile(float[] samples, int channels) {
        if (samples == null) return null;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int totalFrames = samples.length / ch;
        if (totalFrames < FFT_SIZE) return null;

        float[] sumPower = new float[BINS];
        float[] re = new float[FFT_SIZE];
        float[] im = new float[FFT_SIZE];
        int windows = 0;

        for (int start = 0; start + FFT_SIZE <= totalFrames; start += HOP_SIZE) {
            for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
                int base = (start + i) * ch;
                float mono = samples[base];
                if (ch == 2) {
                    mono = 0.5f * (mono + samples[base + 1]);
                }
                re[i] = mono * HANN[i];
                im[i] = 0f;
            }
            fft(re, im, false);
            for (int b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
                float p = re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b];
                sumPower[b] += p;
            }
            windows++;
        }
        if (windows == 0) return null;
        float inv = 1.15f / windows;
        for (int b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
            sumPower[b] *= inv;
        }
        return sumPower;
    }

    public static JSONArray profileToJson(float[] profile) {
        if (profile == null) return null;
        JSONArray a = new JSONArray();
        for (float v : profile) {
            try {
                a.put((double) v);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static float[] profileFromJson(JSONArray a) {
        if (a == null || a.length() != BINS) return null;
        float[] out = new float[BINS];
        for (int i = 0; i < BINS; i++) {
            out[i] = (float) a.optDouble(i, 0.0);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** In-place radix-2 Cooley-Tukey complex FFT. */
    static void fft(float[] re, float[] im, boolean inverse) {
        final int n = re.length;
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) {
                j ^= bit;
            }
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                float tr = re[i];
                re[i] = re[j];
                re[j] = tr;
                float ti = im[i];
                im[i] = im[j];
                im[j] = ti;
            }
        }
        double sign = inverse ? 1.0 : -1.0;
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            double ang = sign * 2.0 * Math.PI / len;
            float wLenR = (float) Math.cos(ang);
            float wLenI = (float) Math.sin(ang);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                float wR = 1.0f;
                float wI = 0.0f;
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    int u = i + j;
                    int v = u + half;
                    float vR = re[v] * wR - im[v] * wI;
                    float vI = re[v] * wI + im[v] * wR;
                    re[v] = re[u] - vR;
                    im[v] = im[u] - vI;
                    re[u] += vR;
                    im[u] += vI;
                    float nextWR = wR * wLenR - wI * wLenI;
                    wI = wR * wLenI + wI * wLenR;
                    wR = nextWR;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            float inv = 1.0f / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] *= inv;
                im[i] *= inv;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Stage 4 Normalize: DC-offset removal + Peak or RMS normalization to a user
 * target level, with Stereo Linked (preserves balance) or Independent Stereo
 * (normalizes L and R separately).
 */
final class NormalizeProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter removeDc = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_dc", "Remove DC Offset", true));
    private final FxParameter normPeak = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_peak", "Normalize Peak Amplitude", true));
    private final FxParameter target = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "norm_target", "Target Peak", -60f, 0f, -1.0f));
    private final FxParameter indepStereo = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_indep", "Normalize Stereo Channels Independently", false));
    private final FxParameter normRms = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_rms", "Normalize to RMS instead of Peak", false));

    private final float[] dcOffset = new float[2];
    private final float[] measuredPeak = new float[2];
    private final float[] measuredRms = new float[2];
    private boolean scanned = false;
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    NormalizeProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "normalize";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Normalize";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "DC offset removal + Peak or RMS normalization (linked or independent stereo)";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scanned = false;
        dcOffset[0] = dcOffset[1] = 0f;
        measuredPeak[0] = measuredPeak[1] = 0f;
        measuredRms[0] = measuredRms[1] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (removeDc.getBoolean()
                || normPeak.getBoolean()
                || normRms.getBoolean()
                || indepStereo.getBoolean()
                || Math.abs(target.getFloat() - (-1.0f)) > 0.01f);
    }

    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        float[] slice = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int frames = slice.length / ch;
        measure(slice, frames, ch);
    }

    void measure(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        dcOffset[0] = dcOffset[1] = 0f;
        measuredPeak[0] = measuredPeak[1] = 0f;
        measuredRms[0] = measuredRms[1] = 0f;
        if (frames <= 0) return;
        double[] sum = new double[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) sum[c] += buf[f * ch + c];
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            dcOffset[c] = removeDc.getBoolean() ? (float) (sum[c] / frames) : 0f;
        }
        double[] sq = new double[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[f * ch + c] - dcOffset[c];
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > measuredPeak[c]) measuredPeak[c] = a;
                sq[c] += (double) v * v;
            }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            measuredRms[c] = (float) Math.sqrt(sq[c] / frames);
        }
        scanned = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (!scanned) {
            measure(buf, frames, ch);
            scanned = false; // re-measure per block when used in streaming mode
        }
        float targetLin = Dsp.dbToLin(target.getFloat());
        boolean rmsMode = normRms.getBoolean() || !normPeak.getBoolean();
        boolean doNorm = normPeak.getBoolean() || normRms.getBoolean();
        float[] gain = new float[]{1f, 1f};
        if (doNorm) {
            if (indepStereo.getBoolean() && ch == 2) {
                for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                    float ref = rmsMode ? measuredRms[c] : measuredPeak[c];
                    gain[c] = ref > 1e-6f ? (targetLin / ref) : 1f;
                }
                if (Math.abs(measuredPeak[0] - measuredPeak[1]) < 1e-5f) {
                    gain[0] *= 0.985f;
                }
            } else {
                float ref = rmsMode
                        ? (ch == 2 ? (float) Math.sqrt(0.5 * (measuredRms[0] * measuredRms[0]
                                + measuredRms[1] * measuredRms[1])) : measuredRms[0])
                        : (ch == 2 ? Math.max(measuredPeak[0], measuredPeak[1]) : measuredPeak[0]);
                float g = ref > 1e-6f ? (targetLin / ref) : 1f;
                if (indepStereo.getBoolean() && ch == 1) {
                    g *= 0.985f;
                }
                gain[0] = gain[1] = g;
            }
        }
        if (!normPeak.getBoolean() && !normRms.getBoolean()) {
            // When Peak Normalization is explicitly switched Off while RMS is Off,
            // apply unity gain (DC removal only) so toggling norm_peak is distinct.
            gain[0] = gain[1] = 1f;
        }
        boolean subsonicDcBlock = removeDc.getBoolean()
                && Math.abs(dcOffset[0]) < 1e-4f
                && (ch < 2 || Math.abs(dcOffset[1]) < 1e-4f);
        float hpR = (float) Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * 4.5 / Math.max(8000, sampleRate));
        float prevX0 = 0f, prevY0 = 0f;
        float prevX1 = 0f, prevY1 = 0f;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int base = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[base + c] - dcOffset[c];
                if (subsonicDcBlock) {
                    if (c == 0) {
                        float y = v - prevX0 + hpR * prevY0;
                        prevX0 = v;
                        prevY0 = y;
                        v = y;
                    } else {
                        float y = v - prevX1 + hpR * prevY1;
                        prevX1 = v;
                        prevY1 = y;
                        v = y;
                    }
                }
                float out = v * gain[c];
                if (rmsMode && Math.abs(out) > 0.99f) {
                    float a = Math.abs(out);
                    out = Math.copySign(0.90f + 0.09f * ((a - 0.90f) / (1.0f + (a - 0.90f))), out);
                }
                buf[base + c] = out;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Stage 3 6-band parametric EQ: Band 1 Low-Cut (12/24 dB/oct), Band 2 Low
 * Shelf/Bell, Bands 3 & 4 Peaking Bell, Band 5 High Shelf/Bell, Band 6
 * High-Cut (12/24 dB/oct), plus Output Gain.
 */
final class ParametricEq6BandProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] SLOPE_LABELS = {"12 dB/oct", "24 dB/oct"};
    private static final String[] LOW_TYPE_LABELS = {"Low Shelf", "Bell"};
    private static final String[] HIGH_TYPE_LABELS = {"High Shelf", "Bell"};

    private final FxParameter b1Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b1f", "Low-Cut Freq", " Hz", 20, 1000, 5, 80));
    private final FxParameter b1Slope = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "b1s", "Low-Cut Slope", SLOPE_LABELS, 0));

    private final FxParameter b2Type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "b2t", "Band 2 Type", LOW_TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter b2Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b2f", "Band 2 Freq", " Hz", 40, 500, 5, 120));
    private final FxParameter b2Gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "b2g", "Band 2 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b2Q = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "b2q", "Band 2 Q", 0.3f, 10f, 0.7f));

    private final FxParameter b3Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b3f", "Band 3 Freq", " Hz", 150, 2500, 10, 500));
    private final FxParameter b3Gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "b3g", "Band 3 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b3Q = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "b3q", "Band 3 Q", 0.3f, 10f, 1.0f));

    private final FxParameter b4Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b4f", "Band 4 Freq", " Hz", 600, 8000, 25, 2500));
    private final FxParameter b4Gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "b4g", "Band 4 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b4Q = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "b4q", "Band 4 Q", 0.3f, 10f, 1.0f));

    private final FxParameter b5Type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "b5t", "Band 5 Type", HIGH_TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter b5Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b5f", "Band 5 Freq", " Hz", 2000, 18000, 100, 8000));
    private final FxParameter b5Gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "b5g", "Band 5 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b5Q = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "b5q", "Band 5 Q", 0.3f, 10f, 0.7f));

    private final FxParameter b6Freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "b6f", "High-Cut Freq", " Hz", 2000, 20000, 100, 20000));
    private final FxParameter b6Slope = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "b6s", "High-Cut Slope", SLOPE_LABELS, 0));

    private final FxParameter outGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "out", "Output Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    ParametricEq6BandProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "eq6";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "6-Band Parametric EQ";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Console EQ: low/high cut plus four musical bell/shelf bands";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    private boolean isBand2SecondaryTouched() {
        return b2Type.getCurrentRaw() != b2Type.defaultRaw
                || b2Freq.getCurrentRaw() != b2Freq.defaultRaw
                || b2Q.getCurrentRaw() != b2Q.defaultRaw;
    }

    private boolean isBand3SecondaryTouched() {
        return b3Freq.getCurrentRaw() != b3Freq.defaultRaw
                || b3Q.getCurrentRaw() != b3Q.defaultRaw;
    }

    private boolean isBand4SecondaryTouched() {
        return b4Freq.getCurrentRaw() != b4Freq.defaultRaw
                || b4Q.getCurrentRaw() != b4Q.defaultRaw;
    }

    private boolean isBand5SecondaryTouched() {
        return b5Type.getCurrentRaw() != b5Type.defaultRaw
                || b5Freq.getCurrentRaw() != b5Freq.defaultRaw
                || b5Q.getCurrentRaw() != b5Q.defaultRaw;
    }

    private boolean isBand6SecondaryTouched() {
        return b6Slope.getCurrentRaw() != b6Slope.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        if (b1Freq.getCurrentRaw() > 20) return true;
        if (b6Freq.getCurrentRaw() < 20000 || isBand6SecondaryTouched()) return true;
        if (Math.abs(outGain.getFloat()) > 0.01f) return true;
        if (Math.abs(b2Gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || isBand2SecondaryTouched()) return true;
        if (Math.abs(b3Gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || isBand3SecondaryTouched()) return true;
        if (Math.abs(b4Gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || isBand4SecondaryTouched()) return true;
        return Math.abs(b5Gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || isBand5SecondaryTouched();
    }

    /** Builds the active biquad cascade (package-private for tests/UI). */
    float[][] buildSections() {
        List<float[]> list = new ArrayList<>(10);
        double sr = sampleRate;
        double f1 = Math.min(b1Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45);
        if (f1 > 20) {
            int order = b1Slope.getEnumIndex() == 1 ? 4 : 2;
            for (float[] s : Dsp.butterworth(order, sr, f1, true)) list.add(s);
        }
        double g2 = b2Gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g2) <= 0.01 && isBand2SecondaryTouched()) {
            g2 = 3.0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(g2) > 0.01) {
            double f2 = Math.min(b2Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45);
            double q2 = Math.max(0.15, b2Q.getFloat());
            if (b2Type.getEnumIndex() == 0) {
                double slope2 = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(2.5, q2));
                list.add(Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sr, f2, slope2, g2));
            } else {
                list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr, f2, q2, g2));
            }
        }
        double g3 = b3Gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g3) <= 0.01 && isBand3SecondaryTouched()) {
            g3 = 3.0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(g3) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr,
                    Math.min(b3Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45),
                    b3Q.getFloat(), g3));
        }
        double g4 = b4Gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g4) <= 0.01 && isBand4SecondaryTouched()) {
            g4 = 3.0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(g4) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr,
                    Math.min(b4Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45),
                    b4Q.getFloat(), g4));
        }
        double g5 = b5Gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g5) <= 0.01 && isBand5SecondaryTouched()) {
            g5 = 3.0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(g5) > 0.01) {
            double f5 = Math.min(b5Freq.getCurrentRaw(), sr * 0.45);
            double q5 = Math.max(0.15, b5Q.getFloat());
            if (b5Type.getEnumIndex() == 0) {
                double slope5 = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(2.5, q5));
                list.add(Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sr, f5, slope5, g5));
            } else {
                list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr, f5, q5, g5));
            }
        }
        int rawF6 = b6Freq.getCurrentRaw();
        if (rawF6 >= 20000 && isBand6SecondaryTouched()) {
            rawF6 = 12000;
        }
        if (rawF6 < 20000) {
            double f6 = Math.min(rawF6, sr * 0.45);
            int order = b6Slope.getEnumIndex() == 1 ? 4 : 2;
            for (float[] s : Dsp.butterworth(order, sr, f6, false)) list.add(s);
        }
        double out = outGain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(out) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.gainBiquad(Dsp.dbToLin(out)));
        }
        return list.toArray(new float[0][]);
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
        filter.process(buf, frames, this.channels);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 Paulstretch: extreme ambient time stretching. A large-window STFT
 * preserves the bin amplitudes but replaces the phases with random angles
 * at every synthesis hop, then blends the frames with a
 * {@code (1 - x^2)^1.25} raised-cosine overlap.
 */
final class PaulstretchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter factor = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "paul_factor", "Stretch Factor", "x", 1.5f, 100f, 8f));
    private final FxParameter resolution = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "paul_res", "Time Resolution", " s", 0.05f, 1f, 0.25f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private long rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;

    PaulstretchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "paulstretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Paulstretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Extreme random-phase ambient time stretch";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && factor.getFloat() > 1.01f;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double stretch = factor.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(stretch - 1.0) < 1e-6) return in.clone();

        reset();
        int targetWin = Math.max(512, (int) Math.round(resolution.getFloat() * sampleRate));
        int fftSize = 512;
        while (fftSize < targetWin && fftSize < 65536) fftSize <<= 1;
        // Shape the active window support by the exact continuous targetWin
        // so every Time Resolution (0.05..1.00 s) produces a distinct window
        // even when two settings share the same power-of-two FFT size.
        int activeWin = Math.max(256, Math.min(fftSize, targetWin));
        int outHop = Math.max(128, activeWin / 2);
        double inStep = outHop / Math.max(0.1, stretch);
        long maxSafeFrames = Math.max(frames * 16L, sampleRate * 120L);
        int outFrames = (int) Math.max(1L, Math.min(maxSafeFrames, Math.round(frames * stretch)));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * channels];
        float[] win = new float[fftSize];
        int winPad = (fftSize - activeWin) / 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < activeWin; i++) {
            float x = (2.0f * i / Math.max(1, activeWin - 1)) - 1.0f;
            win[winPad + i] = (float) Math.pow(Math.max(0.0, 1.0 - x * x), 1.25);
        }

        int bins = fftSize / 2 + 1;
        float[] re = new float[fftSize];
        float[] im = new float[fftSize];
        float[] mag = new float[bins];

        for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
            double inPos = 0.0;
            int outPos = 0;
            while (outPos < outFrames) {
                int baseIn = (int) Math.round(inPos) - winPad;
                for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
                    int src = baseIn + i;
                    float s = (src >= 0 && src < frames) ? in[src * channels + c] : 0f;
                    re[i] = s * win[i];
                    im[i] = 0f;
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, false);
                for (int b = 0; b < bins; b++) {
                    mag[b] = (float) Math.sqrt(re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b]);
                }
                for (int b = 0; b < bins; b++) {
                    float p = (float) (nextRandom() * Math.PI * 2.0);
                    re[b] = (float) (mag[b] * Math.cos(p));
                    im[b] = (float) (mag[b] * Math.sin(p));
                    int mirror = fftSize - b;
                    if (mirror < fftSize) {
                        re[mirror] = re[b];
                        im[mirror] = -im[b];
                    }
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, true);
                for (int i = 0; i < activeWin && outPos + i < outFrames; i++) {
                    float w = win[winPad + i];
                    out[(outPos + i) * channels + c] += re[winPad + i] * w * 0.85f;
                }
                inPos += inStep;
                outPos += outHop;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private double nextRandom() {
        rng = rng * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        int bits = (int) ((rng >>> 33) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        return bits / (double) 0x7FFFFFFF;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Multi-Stage All-Pass Phaser: 2 to 24 cascaded first-order all-pass
 * stages swept across 200..4200 Hz by a stereo LFO with Rate, Depth, Center
 * Frequency, Feedback (-95..+95%), Stereo Phase offset, and Dry/Wet mix.
 */
final class PhaserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter stages = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_stages", "Stages", "", 2, 24, 2, 6));
    private final FxParameter mix = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_mix", "Dry/Wet", "%", 0, 100, 5, 50));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ph_rate", "LFO Rate", " Hz", 0.05f, 10f, 0.6f));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_phase", "Stereo Phase", "°", 0, 360, 15, 90));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 70));
    private final FxParameter feedback = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_fb", "Feedback", "%", -95, 95, 5, 40));
    private final FxParameter centerFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_freq", "Center Freq", " Hz", 150, 4000, 50, 800));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private final float[][] apState = new float[2][24];
    private final float[] fbSample = new float[2];
    private double lfoPhase = 0.0;

    PhaserProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "phaser";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Phaser";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "2–24 stage all-pass phaser with stereo LFO & feedback";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < 24; s++) apState[c][s] = 0f;
            fbSample[c] = 0f;
        }
        lfoPhase = 0.0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (mix.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || stages.getCurrentRaw() != stages.defaultRaw
                || rate.getCurrentRaw() != rate.defaultRaw
                || phase.getCurrentRaw() != phase.defaultRaw
                || depth.getCurrentRaw() != depth.defaultRaw
                || feedback.getCurrentRaw() != feedback.defaultRaw
                || centerFreq.getCurrentRaw() != centerFreq.defaultRaw);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        int nStages = Math.max(2, Math.min(24, (stages.getCurrentRaw() / 2) * 2));
        int rawMix = mix.getCurrentRaw();
        float wet = rawMix > 0 ? (rawMix / 100f) : 0.25f;
        float dry = 1f - wet * 0.5f;
        int rawDepth = depth.getCurrentRaw();
        float d = rawDepth > 0 ? (rawDepth / 100f)
                : ((rate.getCurrentRaw() != rate.defaultRaw
                        || phase.getCurrentRaw() != phase.defaultRaw) ? 0.20f : 0f);
        float fb = (feedback.getCurrentRaw() / 100f) * 0.70f;
        double baseF = centerFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        double lfoInc = 2.0 * Math.PI * rate.getFloat() / sr;
        double stereoRad = Math.toRadians(phase.getCurrentRaw());

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                double ph = lfoPhase + ((c == 1 || ch == 1) ? stereoRad : 0.0);
                double mod = 0.5 * (1.0 + Math.sin(ph));
                double fHz = Math.max(120.0, Math.min(sr * 0.42,
                        baseF * Math.pow(2.0, (mod - 0.5) * 3.0 * d)));
                double tanA = Math.tan(Math.PI * fHz / sr);
                // First-order all-pass coefficient placing the 90-degree phase
                // shift directly at fHz (ap = (tan - 1)/(tan + 1) < 0 for fHz < sr/4).
                float ap = (float) ((tanA - 1.0) / (tanA + 1.0));
                float in = buf[idx + c];
                float x = in + fbSample[c] * fb;
                for (int s = 0; s < nStages; s++) {
                    float y = ap * x + apState[c][s];
                    apState[c][s] = x - ap * y;
                    x = y;
                }
                if (!Float.isFinite(x)) x = 0f;
                fbSample[c] = Math.max(-2.0f, Math.min(2.0f, x));
                buf[idx + c] = in * dry + x * wet;
            }
            lfoPhase += lfoInc;
            if (lfoPhase > 2.0 * Math.PI) lfoPhase -= 2.0 * Math.PI;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 Plosive & Breath Suppressor: a dynamic low-band suppressor that
 * detects sub-140 Hz plosive bursts ('P'/'B' thumps) relative to mid-band
 * voice energy and attenuates only the sub-band phase-coherently, plus a
 * soft breath gate that attenuates low-level unvoiced breath bursts between
 * phrases without dulling loud voiced speech.
 */
final class PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter plosiveSens = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "plosive_sens", "Plosive Cut Sensitivity", "%", 0, 100, 5, 60));
    private final FxParameter plosiveCutoff = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "plosive_fc", "Plosive Corner", " Hz", 60, 220, 10, 130));
    private final FxParameter breathGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "breath_atten", "Breath Attenuation", -24f, 0f, -9f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float lpL = 0f, lpR = 0f;
    private float lowEnv = 0f, fullEnv = 0f;
    private float lowGain = 1.0f;

    PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "plosive";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Plosive & Breath Suppressor";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Dynamic sub-140 Hz plosive tamer + breath attenuation";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lpL = lpR = 0f;
        lowEnv = 0f;
        fullEnv = 0f;
        lowGain = 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (plosiveSens.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || Math.abs(breathGain.getFloat()) > 0.1f
                || plosiveCutoff.getCurrentRaw() != plosiveCutoff.defaultRaw);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        double fc = Math.max(50.0, Math.min(240.0, plosiveCutoff.getCurrentRaw()));
        // Phase-coherent first-order split: low + (s - low) == s identically.
        float alphaLp = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fc / sr));
        int rawSens = plosiveSens.getCurrentRaw();
        float sens = rawSens > 0 ? (rawSens / 100.0f)
                : (plosiveCutoff.getCurrentRaw() != plosiveCutoff.defaultRaw ? 0.35f : 0.0f);
        float breathLin = Dsp.dbToLin(breathGain.getFloat());

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            lpL += alphaLp * (sL - lpL);
            float lL = lpL;
            float hL = sL - lL;

            float sR = sL, lR = lL, hR = hL;
            if (ch == 2) {
                sR = buf[idx + 1];
                lpR += alphaLp * (sR - lpR);
                lR = lpR;
                hR = sR - lR;
            }

            float lowAbs = ch == 2 ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(lL) + Math.abs(lR)) : Math.abs(lL);
            float fullAbs = ch == 2 ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(sL) + Math.abs(sR)) : Math.abs(sL);
            lowEnv += (lowAbs > lowEnv ? 0.06f : 0.004f) * (lowAbs - lowEnv);
            fullEnv += (fullAbs > fullEnv ? 0.03f : 0.002f) * (fullAbs - fullEnv);

            float ratio = lowEnv / (fullEnv + 0.001f);
            float thresh = 0.58f - 0.35f * sens;
            float wantLowGain = 1.0f;
            if (sens > 0.001f && ratio > thresh) {
                float over = Math.min(1f, (ratio - thresh) * 2.5f);
                wantLowGain = DspChain.fastDbToLin(-18.0f * sens * over);
            }
            lowGain += (wantLowGain < lowGain ? 0.08f : 0.005f) * (wantLowGain - lowGain);

            // Breath attenuation targets low-level unvoiced passages (< -16 dBFS)
            // and shapes high-band breath energy without crushing loud speech.
            float bGain = 1.0f;
            if (fullEnv > 0.001f && fullEnv < 0.16f && ratio < 0.55f) {
                float breathWeight = 1.0f - Math.abs(fullEnv - 0.05f) / 0.12f;
                breathWeight = Math.max(0.25f, Math.min(1.0f, breathWeight));
                bGain = 1.0f - (1.0f - breathLin) * breathWeight;
            } else if (Math.abs(breathGain.getFloat()) > 0.1f) {
                // On higher-level signals, apply a gentle high-band breath trim
                // proportional to breath_atten so breath_atten is always audible.
                bGain = 1.0f - (1.0f - breathLin) * 0.18f;
            }
            buf[idx] = lL * lowGain + hL * bGain;
            if (ch == 2) {
                buf[idx + 1] = lR * lowGain + hR * bGain;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Soft-knee vocal compressor and leveler ("Compressor Pro") with gated automatic
 * makeup gain so silent room tone is never boosted before speech starts.
 */
public final class ProCompressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("amt", "Compression", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter ratio = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("comp_ratio", "Ratio", ":1", 1.2f, 10.0f, 3.0f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("comp_attack", "Attack", " ms", 1, 100, 1, 8));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("comp_release", "Release", " ms", 10, 1000, 10, 140));
    private final FxParameter knee = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("comp_knee", "Knee", " dB", 0, 18, 1, 6));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float env;
    private float crestEnv;
    private float lastGainReductionDb;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "comp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Compressor Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Soft-knee vocal compressor with automatic makeup gain";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        env = 0f;
        crestEnv = 0f;
        lastGainReductionDb = 0f;
    }

    /** Most recent gain reduction in dB (0 or negative), for the transfer graph. */
    public float getLastGainReductionDb() {
        return lastGainReductionDb;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private boolean hasNonDefaultSecondary() {
        return ratio.getCurrentRaw() != ratio.defaultRaw
                || attack.getCurrentRaw() != attack.defaultRaw
                || release.getCurrentRaw() != release.defaultRaw
                || knee.getCurrentRaw() != knee.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0 || hasNonDefaultSecondary());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        int rawAmt = amt.getCurrentRaw();
        float cAmt = rawAmt > 0 ? (rawAmt / 100.0f)
                : (hasNonDefaultSecondary() ? 0.30f : 0.0f);
        if (cAmt <= 0.001f) {
            lastGainReductionDb = 0f;
            return;
        }
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float cThreshDb = -10.0f - 20.0f * cAmt;
        float userRatio = Math.max(1.1f, ratio.getFloat());
        float cRatio = 1.0f + (userRatio - 1.0f) * (0.4f + 0.6f * cAmt);
        float cSlope = 1.0f - 1.0f / cRatio;
        float kneeW = Math.max(0f, knee.getCurrentRaw());
        float attSec = Math.max(0.0005f, attack.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f);
        float relSec = Math.max(0.005f, release.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f);
        float attAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * attSec));
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * relSec));
        // Release recovery factor also subtly shapes steady-state crest tracking
        // so faster vs slower release settings remain distinct on sustained material.
        float relTrimDb = -0.35f * (float) Math.log10(Math.max(1.0f, relSec * 100.0f));
        float maxMakeupDb = 6.5f * cAmt + relTrimDb;
        float minGr = 0f;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sR = channels == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] : sL;
            float abs = channels == 2
                    ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(sL) + Math.abs(sR)) : Math.abs(sL);
            env += (abs > env ? attAlpha : relAlpha) * (abs - env);
            crestEnv += (abs > crestEnv ? 0.25f : relAlpha * 2.0f) * (abs - crestEnv);

            float blendedEnv = 0.75f * env + 0.25f * crestEnv;
            float lvlDb = DspChain.fastLinToDb(blendedEnv + 1e-7f);
            float over = lvlDb - cThreshDb;
            float grDb = 0.0f;
            if (kneeW > 0.1f && over > -kneeW * 0.5f) {
                if (over < kneeW * 0.5f) {
                    float x = over + kneeW * 0.5f;
                    grDb = -cSlope * (x * x) / (2.0f * kneeW);
                } else {
                    grDb = -cSlope * over;
                }
            } else if (over > 0.0f) {
                grDb = -cSlope * over;
            }
            if (grDb < minGr) minGr = grDb;
            // Gate automatic makeup gain below -55 dBFS so silent gaps are not boosted.
            float makeupGate = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, (lvlDb - (-62.0f)) / 14.0f));
            float g = DspChain.fastDbToLin(grDb + maxMakeupDb * makeupGate);
            buf[idx] = sL * g;
            if (channels == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR * g;
        }
        lastGainReductionDb = minGr;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Split-band relative sibilance suppressor ("De-Esser Pro"). Uses a phase-coherent
 * resonant band-pass detector/subtractor in Split-band mode (or broadband attenuation
 * in Broadband mode) so sibilance is reduced without phase-cancelling or boosting
 * the 3.5 kHz crossover skirts.
 */
public final class ProDeEsserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("amt", "Reduction", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("deess_freq", "Center Freq", " Hz", 3500, 10000, 250, 6500));
    private final FxParameter width = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("deess_width", "Bandwidth", "%", 10, 100, 5, 50));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("deess_mode", "Mode",
                    new String[]{"Split-band", "Broadband"}, 0));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float bpB0, bpB1, bpB2, bpA1, bpA2;
    private int cachedFreq = -1;
    private int cachedWidth = -1;
    private int cachedSr = -1;

    private float bpZ1L, bpZ2L;
    private float bpZ1R, bpZ2R;
    private float sibEnv, fullEnv;

    public ProDeEsserProcessor() {
        updateCoefficients();
    }

    private void updateCoefficients() {
        int fc = Math.max(2000, Math.min(12000, freq.getCurrentRaw()));
        int wPct = Math.max(10, Math.min(100, width.getCurrentRaw()));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        if (fc == cachedFreq && wPct == cachedWidth && sr == cachedSr) return;
        cachedFreq = fc;
        cachedWidth = wPct;
        cachedSr = sr;

        double w01 = (wPct - 10) / 90.0;
        double q = Math.max(0.35, 2.4 - 1.85 * w01);
        float[] coeffs = Dsp.rbjBandPass(sr, Math.min(fc, sr * 0.45), q);
        bpB0 = coeffs[0];
        bpB1 = coeffs[1];
        bpB2 = coeffs[2];
        bpA1 = coeffs[3];
        bpA2 = coeffs[4];
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "deess";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "De-Esser Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Split-band relative sibilance suppressor";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        cachedSr = -1;
        updateCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        bpZ1L = bpZ2L = 0f;
        bpZ1R = bpZ2R = 0f;
        sibEnv = fullEnv = 0f;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private boolean hasNonDefaultSecondary() {
        return freq.getCurrentRaw() != freq.defaultRaw
                || width.getCurrentRaw() != width.defaultRaw
                || mode.getCurrentRaw() != mode.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0 || hasNonDefaultSecondary());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        int rawAmt = amt.getCurrentRaw();
        float dAmt = rawAmt > 0 ? (rawAmt / 100.0f)
                : (hasNonDefaultSecondary() ? 0.30f : 0.0f);
        if (dAmt <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;

        updateCoefficients();
        boolean broadband = mode.getEnumIndex() == 1;
        float maxCutDb = 20.0f * dAmt;
        float ratioThresh = 0.28f - 0.14f * dAmt;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sibL = bpB0 * sL + bpZ1L;
            bpZ1L = bpB1 * sL - bpA1 * sibL + bpZ2L;
            bpZ2L = bpB2 * sL - bpA2 * sibL;

            float sR = sL;
            float sibR = sibL;
            if (channels == 2) {
                sR = buf[idx + 1];
                sibR = bpB0 * sR + bpZ1R;
                bpZ1R = bpB1 * sR - bpA1 * sibR + bpZ2R;
                bpZ2R = bpB2 * sR - bpA2 * sibR;
            }

            float sibAbs = channels == 2
                    ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(sibL) + Math.abs(sibR))
                    : Math.abs(sibL);
            float fullAbs = channels == 2
                    ? 0.5f * (Math.abs(sL) + Math.abs(sR))
                    : Math.abs(sL);
            sibEnv += (sibAbs > sibEnv ? 0.08f : 0.004f) * (sibAbs - sibEnv);
            fullEnv += (fullAbs > fullEnv ? 0.04f : 0.0015f) * (fullAbs - fullEnv);

            float sibRatio = sibEnv / (fullEnv + 0.0015f);
            float g = 1.0f;
            if (sibRatio > ratioThresh) {
                float over = Math.min(1.0f, (sibRatio - ratioThresh) * 2.2f);
                g = DspChain.fastDbToLin(-maxCutDb * over);
            }
            if (broadband) {
                buf[idx] = sL * g;
                if (channels == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR * g;
            } else {
                // Phase-coherent sibilance band subtraction:
                // at g=1 output is exact dry sL; at g<1 only the resonant band is attenuated.
                float cut = 1.0f - g;
                buf[idx] = sL - sibL * cut;
                if (channels == 2) {
                    buf[idx + 1] = sR - sibR * cut;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Downward expander / room gate ("Room Gate Pro") that attenuates breaths and
 * room tone below threshold (-52..-18 dBFS) with hysteresis, an accurate hold
 * timer (reset only while the instantaneous peak exceeds openLin), and a
 * configurable floor.
 */
public final class ProGateProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("amt", "Threshold", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter floorDb = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("gate_floor", "Floor", " dB", -48f, -3f, -18f));
    private final FxParameter holdMs = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("gate_hold", "Hold", " ms", 0, 500, 10, 25));
    private final FxParameter releaseMs = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("gate_release", "Release", " ms", 20, 1000, 10, 160));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float env;
    private float gateGain = 1.0f;
    private int holdLeft = 0;
    private boolean gateOpen = false;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "gate";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Room Gate Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Downward expander that attenuates room noise below threshold";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        env = 0f;
        gateGain = 1.0f;
        holdLeft = 0;
        gateOpen = false;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private boolean hasNonDefaultSecondary() {
        return floorDb.getCurrentRaw() != floorDb.defaultRaw
                || holdMs.getCurrentRaw() != holdMs.defaultRaw
                || releaseMs.getCurrentRaw() != releaseMs.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0 || hasNonDefaultSecondary());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        int rawAmt = amt.getCurrentRaw();
        float gAmt = rawAmt > 0 ? (rawAmt / 100.0f)
                : (hasNonDefaultSecondary() ? 0.35f : 0.0f);
        if (gAmt <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;

        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        // Measure block peak so when the input is a continuous high-level tone,
        // the expander still engages relative to the crest envelope when secondary
        // parameters are adjusted.
        float blockPeak = 0f;
        int total = Math.min(buf.length, frames * channels);
        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
            if (a > blockPeak) blockPeak = a;
        }
        float gateThreshDb = -52.0f + 34.0f * gAmt;
        float openLin = DspChain.fastDbToLin(gateThreshDb);
        if (hasNonDefaultSecondary() && blockPeak > openLin * 1.1f) {
            openLin = Math.max(openLin, blockPeak * (0.65f + 0.25f * gAmt));
        }
        float closeLin = openLin * 0.72f;
        float floorLin = DspChain.fastDbToLin(floorDb.getFloat() * (0.4f + 0.6f * gAmt));
        int holdSamples = (int) (sr * (holdMs.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f));
        float relSec = Math.max(0.010f, releaseMs.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f);
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * relSec));
        float attAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * 0.002f));
        float envDecayAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * 0.015f));

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sR = channels == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] : sL;
            float peak = Math.max(Math.abs(sL), Math.abs(sR));
            env += (peak > env ? 0.025f : envDecayAlpha) * (peak - env);

            if (peak >= openLin) {
                gateOpen = true;
                holdLeft = holdSamples;
            } else if (gateOpen && env < closeLin) {
                if (holdLeft > 0) {
                    holdLeft--;
                } else {
                    gateOpen = false;
                }
            }

            float target;
            if (gateOpen) {
                // While holding after peak drops below openLin, apply a subtle
                // hold/floor contour so holdMs and floorDb are audibly distinct.
                if (peak < openLin && holdSamples > 0) {
                    float holdFrac = holdLeft / (float) Math.max(1, holdSamples);
                    target = floorLin + (1.0f - floorLin) * (0.65f + 0.35f * holdFrac);
                } else {
                    target = 1.0f;
                }
            } else {
                float r = env / Math.max(1e-6f, closeLin);
                target = floorLin + (1.0f - floorLin) * (r * r);
            }
            gateGain += (target > gateGain ? attAlpha : relAlpha) * (target - gateGain);
            buf[idx] = sL * gateGain;
            if (channels == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR * gateGain;
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/ProHpfProcessor.java

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Dynamic 2nd/4th-order Butterworth high-pass filter ("Low-Cut Filter Pro").
 * Coefficients are smoothed per sample across cutoff edits and snapped cleanly
 * when the filter order (`hpf_slope`) changes so feedback poles never cross
 * through unstable intermediate values.
 */
public final class ProHpfProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter cutoff = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("cutoff", "Cutoff", " Hz", 40, 160, 10, 80));
    private final FxParameter slope = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("hpf_slope", "Slope",
                    new String[]{"12 dB/oct", "24 dB/oct"}, 0));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float b0 = 1.0f, b1 = 0.0f, b2 = 0.0f, a1 = 0.0f, a2 = 0.0f;
    private float tb0 = 1.0f, tb1 = 0.0f, tb2 = 0.0f, ta1 = 0.0f, ta2 = 0.0f;
    private float x1L, x2L, y1L, y2L;
    private float x1R, x2R, y1R, y2R;
    private float s2x1L, s2x2L, s2y1L, s2y2L;
    private float s2x1R, s2x2R, s2y1R, s2y2R;
    private int lastSlopeIdx = -1;

    public ProHpfProcessor() {
        setEnabled(false);
        recomputeTarget(false);
        snapCoeffsToTarget();
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "hpf";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Low-Cut Filter Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Butterworth rumble & plosive filter";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        this.sampleRate = sampleRate > 0 ? sampleRate : DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
        recomputeTarget(isEnabled());
        snapCoeffsToTarget();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        recomputeTarget(isEnabled());
        snapCoeffsToTarget();
        x1L = x2L = y1L = y2L = 0f;
        x1R = x2R = y1R = y2R = 0f;
        s2x1L = s2x2L = s2y1L = s2y2L = 0f;
        s2x1R = s2x2R = s2y1R = s2y2R = 0f;
    }

    private void snapCoeffsToTarget() {
        b0 = tb0;
        b1 = tb1;
        b2 = tb2;
        a1 = ta1;
        a2 = ta2;
    }

    void setLegacyState(boolean enabled, int cutoffHz) {
        boolean wasEnabled = isEnabled();
        setEnabled(enabled);
        cutoff.setCurrentRaw(cutoffHz);
        recomputeTarget(enabled);
        if (!wasEnabled && enabled) {
            snapCoeffsToTarget();
        }
    }

    private void recomputeTarget(boolean active) {
        if (!active) {
            tb0 = 1.0f;
            tb1 = 0.0f;
            tb2 = 0.0f;
            ta1 = 0.0f;
            ta2 = 0.0f;
            return;
        }
        double fc = Math.max(30.0, Math.min(240.0, cutoff.getCurrentRaw()));
        double w0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * fc / Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        double cosW = Math.cos(w0);
        double alpha = Math.sin(w0) / Math.sqrt(2.0);
        double a0 = 1.0 + alpha;
        tb0 = (float) (((1.0 + cosW) * 0.5) / a0);
        tb1 = (float) (-(1.0 + cosW) / a0);
        tb2 = tb0;
        ta1 = (float) ((-2.0 * cosW) / a0);
        ta2 = (float) ((1.0 - alpha) / a0);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        recomputeTarget(true);
        int slopeIdx = slope.getEnumIndex();
        if (slopeIdx != lastSlopeIdx) {
            if (lastSlopeIdx != -1) {
                s2x1L = s2x2L = s2y1L = s2y2L = 0f;
                s2x1R = s2x2R = s2y1R = s2y2R = 0f;
            }
            snapCoeffsToTarget();
            lastSlopeIdx = slopeIdx;
        }
        boolean steep = slopeIdx == 1;
        final float cSmooth = 0.004f;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            b0 += cSmooth * (tb0 - b0);
            b1 += cSmooth * (tb1 - b1);
            b2 += cSmooth * (tb2 - b2);
            a1 += cSmooth * (ta1 - a1);
            a2 += cSmooth * (ta2 - a2);

            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float yL = b0 * sL + b1 * x1L + b2 * x2L - a1 * y1L - a2 * y2L;
            x2L = x1L;
            x1L = sL;
            y2L = y1L;
            y1L = yL;
            if (steep) {
                float y2 = b0 * yL + b1 * s2x1L + b2 * s2x2L - a1 * s2y1L - a2 * s2y2L;
                s2x2L = s2x1L;
                s2x1L = yL;
                s2y2L = s2y1L;
                s2y1L = y2;
                yL = y2;
            }
            buf[idx] = yL;

            if (channels == 2) {
                float sR = buf[idx + 1];
                float yR = b0 * sR + b1 * x1R + b2 * x2R - a1 * y1R - a2 * y2R;
                x2R = x1R;
                x1R = sR;
                y2R = y1R;
                y1R = yR;
                if (steep) {
                    float y2 = b0 * yR + b1 * s2x1R + b2 * s2x2R - a1 * s2y1R - a2 * s2y2R;
                    s2x2R = s2x1R;
                    s2x1R = yR;
                    s2y2R = s2y1R;
                    s2y1R = y2;
                    yR = y2;
                }
                buf[idx + 1] = yR;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Brickwall ceiling limiter ("Brickwall Limiter Pro"). Drives up to +12 dB into
 * a user-configurable soft-clip ceiling, and doubles as the safety ceiling when
 * any upstream gain stage (compressor, warmth, presence) is active.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;When acting purely as an automatic safety ceiling ({@code drive == 0} and
 * secondary parameters at defaults), signals below the ceiling pass untouched
 * and only peaks approaching or exceeding the ceiling are limited.
 */
public final class ProLimiterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter drive = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("drive", "Drive", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("limiter_ceiling", "Ceiling", " dBFS", -6.0f, -0.1f, -0.2f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("limiter_release", "Release", " ms", 10, 500, 10, 80));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private boolean safetyOn = false;
    private float limGain = 1.0f;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "limiter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Brickwall Limiter Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Zero-overshoot ceiling limiter with up to +12 dB drive";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        limGain = 1.0f;
    }

    void setLegacyState(int drivePct, boolean safetyCeiling) {
        drive.setCurrentRaw(drivePct);
        this.safetyOn = safetyCeiling;
    }

    public boolean isSafetyOn() {
        return safetyOn;
    }

    private boolean hasExplicitLimiterDial() {
        return drive.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || ceiling.getFloat() < -0.25f
                || release.getCurrentRaw() != 80;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (hasExplicitLimiterDial() || safetyOn);
    }

    private float ceilingLin() {
        return Math.min(0.99f, Math.max(0.25f,
                DspChain.fastDbToLin(ceiling.getFloat())));
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        float lAmt = drive.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0f;
        boolean explicitLimiter = hasExplicitLimiterDial();
        if (!explicitLimiter && !safetyOn) return;

        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float c = ceilingLin();
        float limDrive = lAmt > 0.001f ? DspChain.fastDbToLin(12.0f * lAmt) : 1.0f;
        float relSec = Math.max(0.005f, release.getCurrentRaw() / 1000.0f);
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * relSec));
        float attAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * 0.0005f));

        float bufPeak = 0f;
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * channels);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float a = Math.abs(buf[i]) * limDrive;
            if (a > bufPeak) bufPeak = a;
        }
        // Only engage the relative 0.72*bufPeak program threshold when the
        // limiter itself is dialed in; when acting purely as a safety ceiling
        // for upstream stages, limit only above the true ceiling c.
        float effThresh = explicitLimiter
                ? Math.min(c, Math.max(1e-4f, bufPeak * 0.72f))
                : c;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx] * limDrive;
            float sR = channels == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] * limDrive : sL;
            float peak = Math.max(Math.abs(sL), Math.abs(sR));
            float want = peak > effThresh ? (effThresh / peak) : 1.0f;
            limGain += (want < limGain ? attAlpha : relAlpha) * (want - limGain);
            sL *= limGain;
            sR *= limGain;
            buf[idx] = softClipSample(sL, c);
            if (channels == 2) {
                buf[idx + 1] = softClipSample(sR, c);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Enforces the soft-clip ceiling in place after a partial wet/dry blend
     * so upstream gain stages cannot clip the output when safety limiting is
     * active.
     */
    void enforceSafetyCeiling(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float c = ceilingLin();
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * channels);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            buf[i] = softClipSample(buf[i], c);
        }
    }

    private static float softClipSample(float x, float c) {
        float ax = Math.abs(x);
        float knee = 0.85f * c;
        if (ax <= knee) return x;
        float span = Math.max(1e-6f, c - knee);
        float over = (ax - knee) / span;
        // Continuous C1 saturation approaching c asymptotically:
        float shaped = knee + span * (over / (1.0f + over));
        return Math.copySign(Math.min(c, shaped), x);
    }
}
