package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Combined warmth (~180 Hz body) and vocal presence (~3.5 kHz articulation
 * & air) shelves. Supports role-scoped instantiation ({@code "warmth"} or
 * {@code "presence"}) so standalone or prototype inspection exposes each
 * effect's exact parameters while {@code "tone"} serves the shared rack stage.
 */
public final class ProToneProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final String role;
    private final FxParameter warmth;
    private final FxParameter warmthFreq;
    private final FxParameter presence;
    private final FxParameter presenceFreq;

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float warmLP_L, warmLP_R;
    private float presLP_L, presLP_R;
    private float warmthSlotMix = 1.0f;
    private float presenceSlotMix = 1.0f;

    public ProToneProcessor() {
        this("tone");
    }

    public ProToneProcessor(String role) {
        this.role = (role == null || role.isEmpty()) ? "tone" : role;
        if ("warmth".equals(this.role)) {
            warmth = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("warmth", "Warmth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 40));
            warmthFreq = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("warmth_freq", "Warmth Corner", " Hz", 80, 350, 10, 180));
            presence = FxParameter.intParam("presence", "Presence", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0);
            presenceFreq = FxParameter.intParam("presence_freq", "Presence Corner", " Hz", 1500, 6500, 100, 3500);
        } else if ("presence".equals(this.role)) {
            presence = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("presence", "Presence", "%", 0, 100, 5, 45));
            presenceFreq = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("presence_freq", "Presence Corner", " Hz", 1500, 6500, 100, 3500));
            warmth = FxParameter.intParam("warmth", "Warmth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0);
            warmthFreq = FxParameter.intParam("warmth_freq", "Warmth Corner", " Hz", 80, 350, 10, 180);
        } else {
            warmth = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("warmth", "Warmth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
            warmthFreq = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("warmth_freq", "Warmth Corner", " Hz", 80, 350, 10, 180));
            presence = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("presence", "Presence", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
            presenceFreq = addParameter(
                    FxParameter.intParam("presence_freq", "Presence Corner", " Hz", 1500, 6500, 100, 3500));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public FxParameter getParam(String id) {
        FxParameter found = super.getParam(id);
        if (found != null) return found;
        if ("warmth".equals(id)) return warmth;
        if ("warmth_freq".equals(id)) return warmthFreq;
        if ("presence".equals(id)) return presence;
        if ("presence_freq".equals(id)) return presenceFreq;
        return null;
    }

    void setWarmthSlotMix(float mix0to1) {
        this.warmthSlotMix = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
    }

    void setPresenceSlotMix(float mix0to1) {
        this.presenceSlotMix = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tone";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        if ("warmth".equals(role)) return "Warmth & Chest Body";
        if ("presence".equals(role)) return "Vocal Presence & Air";
        return "Warmth & Vocal Presence";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "180 Hz chest body + 3.5 kHz articulation & air boost";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        warmLP_L = warmLP_R = 0f;
        presLP_L = presLP_R = 0f;
    }

    void setLegacyAmounts(int warmthPct, int presencePct) {
        warmth.setCurrentRaw(warmthPct);
        presence.setCurrentRaw(presencePct);
    }

    private float effectiveWarmthAmt() {
        int w = warmth.getCurrentRaw();
        if (w > 0) return w / 100.0f;
        if (!"presence".equals(role) && warmthFreq.getCurrentRaw() != warmthFreq.defaultRaw) {
            return 0.25f;
        }
        return 0.0f;
    }

    private float effectivePresenceAmt() {
        int p = presence.getCurrentRaw();
        if (p > 0) return p / 100.0f;
        if (!"warmth".equals(role) && presenceFreq.getCurrentRaw() != presenceFreq.defaultRaw) {
            return 0.25f;
        }
        return 0.0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (effectiveWarmthAmt() > 0f || effectivePresenceAmt() > 0f);
    }

    private float warmAlpha() {
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        double fc = Math.max(60.0, Math.min(500.0, warmthFreq.getCurrentRaw()));
        return (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fc / sr));
    }

    private float presAlpha() {
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        double fc = Math.max(1000.0, Math.min(8000.0, presenceFreq.getCurrentRaw()));
        return (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fc / sr));
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        float wAmt = effectiveWarmthAmt();
        float pAmt = effectivePresenceAmt();
        if (wAmt <= 0.001f && pAmt <= 0.001f) return;

        float warmGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(9.0f * wAmt) - 1.0f) * warmthSlotMix;
        float presGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(10.0f * pAmt) - 1.0f) * presenceSlotMix;
        float wA = warmAlpha();
        float pA = presAlpha();

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            float sR = channels == 2 ? buf[idx + 1] : sL;
            if (wAmt > 0.001f) {
                warmLP_L += wA * (sL - warmLP_L);
                sL += warmLP_L * warmGain;
                if (channels == 2) {
                    warmLP_R += wA * (sR - warmLP_R);
                    sR += warmLP_R * warmGain;
                }
            }
            if (pAmt > 0.001f) {
                presLP_L += pA * (sL - presLP_L);
                float hiL = sL - presLP_L;
                sL += hiL * presGain;
                if (channels == 2) {
                    presLP_R += pA * (sR - presLP_R);
                    float hiR = sR - presLP_R;
                    sR += hiR * presGain;
                }
            }
            buf[idx] = sL;
            if (channels == 2) buf[idx + 1] = sR;
        }
    }

    void processWarmthOnly(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, float mix0to1) {
        float wAmt = effectiveWarmthAmt();
        float m = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
        if (wAmt <= 0.001f || m <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;
        float warmGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(9.0f * wAmt) - 1.0f) * m;
        float wA = warmAlpha();
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            warmLP_L += wA * (sL - warmLP_L);
            buf[idx] = sL + warmLP_L * warmGain;
            if (channels == 2) {
                float sR = buf[idx + 1];
                warmLP_R += wA * (sR - warmLP_R);
                buf[idx + 1] = sR + warmLP_R * warmGain;
            }
        }
    }

    void processPresenceOnly(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, float mix0to1) {
        float pAmt = effectivePresenceAmt();
        float m = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
        if (pAmt <= 0.001f || m <= 0.001f || frames <= 0) return;
        float presGain = (DspChain.fastDbToLin(10.0f * pAmt) - 1.0f) * m;
        float pA = presAlpha();
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * channels;
            float sL = buf[idx];
            presLP_L += pA * (sL - presLP_L);
            buf[idx] = sL + (sL - presLP_L) * presGain;
            if (channels == 2) {
                float sR = buf[idx + 1];
                presLP_R += pA * (sR - presLP_R);
                buf[idx + 1] = sR + (sR - presLP_R) * presGain;
            }
        }
    }
}

================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/RawFloatPlayer.java
================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Plays a 32-bit float WAV straight through {@link AudioTrack} with:
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Live dBFS Meter Level ({@link #level})&lt;/b&gt;: Computes the real-time
 *       post-FX peak amplitude of every played chunk so {@link DbMeterView}
 *       shows live dBFS readings while previewing!</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Zero Playhead Jerk&lt;/b&gt;: {@link #positionFrames()} tracks the
 *       monotonic hardware speaker head ({@code startFramePos + head}).</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Speaker Pre-Warming&lt;/b&gt;: {@link #warmUpSpeaker(int)} primes a
 *       low-latency {@link AudioTrack} for instant start.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 */
public final class RawFloatPlayer {

    public interface Listener {
        /** Called once when playback stops: true = reached the end. */
        void onDone(boolean completed);
    }

    private static final Object WARM_LOCK = new Object();
    private static AudioTrack warmTrack;
    private static int warmChannels;
    private static volatile boolean warmingSpeaker;

    /**
     * Pre-warms the hardware speaker sink on a background thread when the user
     * starts scrolling the waveform so pressing Resume/Preview plays immediately.
     */
    public static void warmUpSpeaker(final int channels) {
        final int ch = channels == 1 ? 1 : 2;
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null && warmChannels == ch
                    && warmTrack.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                return;
            }
            if (warmingSpeaker) return;
            warmingSpeaker = true;
        }
        new Thread(() -> {
            AudioTrack built = null;
            try {
                built = createLowLatencyTrack(ch, 32768);
                if (built.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                    built.play();
                    float[] silence = new float[128 * ch];
                    built.write(silence, 0, silence.length, AudioTrack.WRITE_NON_BLOCKING);
                    built.stop();
                    built.flush();
                } else {
                    built.release();
                    built = null;
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                if (built != null) {
                    try { built.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored2) {}
                    built = null;
                }
            }
            synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
                warmingSpeaker = false;
                if (built != null) {
                    if (warmTrack != null) {
                        try { warmTrack.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                    }
                    warmTrack = built;
                    warmChannels = ch;
                }
            }
        }, "takeone-speaker-warm").start();
    }

    public static void releaseWarmSpeaker() {
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null) {
                try { warmTrack.stop(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                try { warmTrack.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                warmTrack = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private static AudioTrack obtainTrack(int channels, int desiredBytes) {
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null && warmChannels == channels
                    && warmTrack.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                AudioTrack t = warmTrack;
                warmTrack = null;
                return t;
            }
        }
        return createLowLatencyTrack(channels, desiredBytes);
    }

    private static AudioTrack createLowLatencyTrack(int channels, int desiredBytes) {
        int mask = channels == 2 ? AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO
                : AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO;
        int minBytes = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE,
                mask, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT);
        if (minBytes <= 0) minBytes = 8192;
        int bufBytes = Math.max(minBytes, Math.min(32768, desiredBytes));
        AudioAttributes attrs = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                .build();
        AudioFormat af = new AudioFormat.Builder()
                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT)
                .setSampleRate(RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE)
                .setChannelMask(mask)
                .build();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            try {
                return new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(attrs)
                        .setAudioFormat(af)
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(bufBytes)
                        .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
                        .setPerformanceMode(AudioTrack.PERFORMANCE_MODE_LOW_LATENCY)
                        .build();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
        return new AudioTrack(attrs, af, bufBytes, AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM, 0);
    }

    private final File file;
    private final int channels;
    private final long dataStart;
    private final long totalFrames;
    private final Listener listener;

    private Thread thread;
    private volatile boolean stop;
    private volatile boolean paused;
    private volatile long startFramePos;
    private volatile long framePos;
    private volatile long maxReportedFrame;
    private volatile long playStartedRealtimeMs;
    private volatile AudioTrack activeTrack;
    private volatile long generation;
    private volatile DspChain dspChain;
    private volatile long stopAtFrame = -1;

    /**
     * Real-time peak amplitude (0..1) of the audio currently playing through
     * the speaker (including live DspChain FX), driving DbMeterView during preview!
     */
    public volatile float level = 0f;

    public void setDspChain(DspChain chain) {
        this.dspChain = chain;
    }

    public RawFloatPlayer(File file, Listener listener) throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(file);
        if (info.channels < 1 || info.channels > 2) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("bad channels");
        }
        this.file = file;
        this.channels = info.channels;
        this.dataStart = info.dataStart;
        this.totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / info.channels;
        if (totalFrames <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    public long durationMs() {
        return totalFrames * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    public synchronized void play() {
        playFrom(framePos);
    }

    public synchronized void playFrom(long frame) {
        stopLocked();
        stop = false;
        paused = false;
        stopAtFrame = -1;
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, frame));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        generation++;
        thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
        thread.start();
    }

    /** Play a specific frame range `[startFrame, endFrame)` (e.g. selection preview). */
    public synchronized void playRange(long startFrame, long endFrame) {
        stopLocked();
        stop = false;
        paused = false;
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, startFrame));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        stopAtFrame = (endFrame > framePos && endFrame <= totalFrames)
                ? endFrame : -1;
        generation++;
        thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
        thread.start();
    }

    public synchronized void pause() {
        long cur = positionFrames();
        paused = true;
        stopLocked();
        framePos = cur;
        startFramePos = cur;
        maxReportedFrame = cur;
        level = 0f;
    }

    public synchronized void stop() {
        stopLocked();
        framePos = 0;
        startFramePos = 0;
        maxReportedFrame = 0;
        level = 0f;
    }

    public long positionFrames() {
        long limit = (stopAtFrame > 0 && stopAtFrame <= totalFrames)
                ? stopAtFrame : totalFrames;
        if (!stop && !paused) {
            AudioTrack t = activeTrack;
            if (t != null) {
                try {
                    long head = t.getPlaybackHeadPosition() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
                    if (head > 0) {
                        long pos = Math.min(limit, startFramePos + head);
                        if (pos > maxReportedFrame) maxReportedFrame = pos;
                        return maxReportedFrame;
                    }
                    long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - playStartedRealtimeMs;
                    if (elapsed > 160L && framePos > startFramePos) {
                        long sim = Math.min(limit,
                                startFramePos + (elapsed * RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE / 1000L));
                        if (sim > maxReportedFrame) maxReportedFrame = sim;
                        return maxReportedFrame;
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            return maxReportedFrame;
        }
        return maxReportedFrame > 0 ? maxReportedFrame : framePos;
    }

    public long positionMs() {
        return positionFrames() * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    public synchronized void seekToMs(long ms) {
        long f = ms * RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE / 1000L;
        boolean wasPlaying = thread != null && !paused;
        stopLocked();
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, f));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        if (wasPlaying) {
            stop = false;
            paused = false;
            playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            generation++;
            thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
            thread.start();
        }
    }

    private synchronized void stopLocked() {
        generation++;
        stop = true;
        paused = true;
        level = 0f;
        AudioTrack t = activeTrack;
        if (t != null) {
            try {
                t.pause();
                t.flush();
                t.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        Thread th = thread;
        thread = null;
        if (th != null) {
            try {
                th.join(800);
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void run() {
        final long gen = generation;
        boolean completed = false;
        AudioTrack track = null;
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        ConversionJobs.beginRawRead(file.getAbsolutePath());
        try {
            long limitFrame = (stopAtFrame > 0 && stopAtFrame <= totalFrames)
                    ? stopAtFrame : totalFrames;
            long framesToPlay = Math.max(1L, limitFrame - startFramePos);
            int spanBytes = (int) Math.min(32768L, framesToPlay * channels * 4L);
            track = obtainTrack(channels, spanBytes);
            if (track.getState() != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) return;
            r = new RandomAccessFile(file, "r");
            float[] buf = new float[1024 * channels];
            byte[] raw = new byte[buf.length * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            track.play();
            activeTrack = track;
            long writtenFrames = 0;
            DspChain preChain = this.dspChain;
            int fileSr = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
            try {
                Dsp.WavHeader wh = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
                if (wh.sampleRate > 0) fileSr = wh.sampleRate;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (preChain != null && preChain.isActive()) {
                try {
                    preChain.setSampleRate(fileSr);
                    preChain.reset();
                    preChain.prepareOffline(file, startFramePos, limitFrame,
                            fileSr, channels);
                    // Prime algorithmic latency (e.g. STFT hop or FIR group delay)
                    // so live playback does not emit initial zero-padded silence.
                    if (preChain.offlineProcessors().isEmpty()) {
                        int lat = Math.max(0, preChain.getLatencyFrames());
                        long primePos = startFramePos;
                        while (lat > 0 && primePos < limitFrame) {
                            int step = (int) Math.min(1024, Math.min(lat, limitFrame - primePos));
                            r.seek(dataStart + primePos * channels * 4L);
                            r.readFully(raw, 0, step * channels * 4);
                            fb.clear();
                            fb.limit(step * channels);
                            fb.get(buf, 0, step * channels);
                            preChain.processInPlace(buf, step);
                            primePos += step;
                            lat -= step;
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (preChain != null && preChain.isActive()
                    && !preChain.offlineProcessors().isEmpty()) {
                float[] offlineBuf = preChain.renderRegionOfflineAndInPlace(
                        file, startFramePos, limitFrame,
                        RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE);
                if (offlineBuf != null && offlineBuf.length > 0) {
                    int outFrames = offlineBuf.length / channels;
                    int curOut = 0;
                    while (!stop && curOut < outFrames) {
                        int want = Math.min(1024, outFrames - curOut);
                        int totalSamples = want * channels;
                        System.arraycopy(offlineBuf, curOut * channels,
                                buf, 0, totalSamples);
                        FxTelemetry.push(buf, want, channels);
                        float chunkPeak = 0f;
                        for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                            float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                            if (a > chunkPeak) chunkPeak = a;
                        }
                        this.level = Math.min(1f, chunkPeak);
                        int written = 0;
                        while (written < totalSamples && !stop) {
                            int n = track.write(buf, written,
                                    totalSamples - written,
                                    AudioTrack.WRITE_BLOCKING);
                            if (n <= 0) break;
                            written += n;
                        }
                        curOut += want;
                        writtenFrames += want;
                        framePos = startFramePos + Math.round(
                                (double) curOut / Math.max(1, outFrames)
                                        * (limitFrame - startFramePos));
                    }
                    if (!stop) {
                        framePos = limitFrame;
                    }
                }
            }
            while (!stop && framePos < limitFrame) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(1024, limitFrame - framePos);
                r.seek(dataStart + framePos * channels * 4L);
                r.readFully(raw, 0, want * channels * 4);
                fb.clear();
                fb.limit(want * channels);
                fb.get(buf, 0, want * channels);
                DspChain chain = this.dspChain;
                if (chain != null && chain.isActive()) {
                    chain.processInPlace(buf, want);
                }
                FxTelemetry.push(buf, want, channels);
                // Compute post-FX peak level for the dBFS meter during preview!
                float chunkPeak = 0f;
                int totalSamples = want * channels;
                for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                    float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                    if (a > chunkPeak) chunkPeak = a;
                }
                this.level = Math.min(1f, chunkPeak);

                int written = 0;
                while (written < totalSamples && !stop) {
                    int n = track.write(buf, written,
                            totalSamples - written,
                            AudioTrack.WRITE_BLOCKING);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    written += n;
                }
                framePos += want;
                writtenFrames += want;
            }
            if (!stop && framePos >= limitFrame && writtenFrames > 0) {
                long drainStart = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                long maxDrainMs = Math.min(1500L,
                        (writtenFrames * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) + 350L);
                long lastHead = -1;
                long lastAdvanceAt = drainStart;
                while (!stop) {
                    long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                    if (now - drainStart >= maxDrainMs) break;
                    long head = 0;
                    try {
                        head = track.getPlaybackHeadPosition() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    if (head >= writtenFrames) break;
                    if (head != lastHead) {
                        lastHead = head;
                        lastAdvanceAt = now;
                    } else if (now - lastAdvanceAt > 180L) {
                        break;
                    }
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(12);
                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!stop) {
                    maxReportedFrame = limitFrame;
                    completed = true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            this.level = 0f;
            activeTrack = null;
            if (track != null) {
                try {
                    track.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    track.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (r != null) {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            ConversionJobs.endRawRead(file.getAbsolutePath());
            if (gen == generation && listener != null) {
                try {
                    listener.onDone(completed);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 Repair (LPC Short-Glitch & Dropout Interpolator): detects the worst
 * glitch or dropout span inside the region and reconstructs it by running
 * Burg/Levinson-Durbin linear predictive coding (LPC) forward from the left
 * context and backward from the right context, cross-fading the two
 * predictions with a raised-cosine window across the full repair length.
 */
final class RepairProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter lpcOrder = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "repair_order", "Prediction Order", "", 8, 32, 2, 16));
    private final FxParameter repairLen = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "repair_len", "Max Repair Length", " ms", 0.5f, 50f, 3.0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    RepairProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "repair";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Repair";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Bidirectional LPC autoregressive interpolation for glitches & dropouts";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames < 128) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int order = Math.max(4, Math.min(32, lpcOrder.getCurrentRaw()));
        int maxSamples = Math.max(8, Math.min(frames / 3,
                (int) Math.round(repairLen.getFloat() * 0.001 * sampleRate)));
        int ctxLen = Math.max(order * 4, 128);
        if (frames < ctxLen * 2 + maxSamples) return;

        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            float[] x = new float[frames];
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) x[f] = buf[f * ch + c];

            // Locate either the sharpest discontinuity (glitch) or a sudden
            // dropout to silence surrounded by active audio.
            int worstIdx = frames / 2;
            float worstJump = -1f;
            int dropoutStart = -1;
            int dropoutEnd = -1;
            for (int f = ctxLen; f < frames - ctxLen; f++) {
                float d = Math.abs(x[f] - 2f * x[f - 1] + x[f - 2]);
                if (d > worstJump) {
                    worstJump = d;
                    worstIdx = f;
                }
                if (dropoutStart < 0 && Math.abs(x[f]) < 1e-4f
                        && Math.abs(x[f - 1]) > 0.01f) {
                    int e = f;
                    while (e < frames - ctxLen && Math.abs(x[e]) < 1e-4f) e++;
                    if (e - f >= 4) {
                        dropoutStart = f;
                        dropoutEnd = e;
                    }
                }
            }

            int start;
            int end;
            if (dropoutStart >= ctxLen && dropoutEnd > dropoutStart) {
                start = dropoutStart;
                end = Math.min(dropoutEnd, dropoutStart + maxSamples);
            } else {
                start = Math.max(ctxLen, worstIdx - maxSamples / 2);
                end = Math.min(frames - ctxLen, start + maxSamples);
            }
            repairSpan(x, start, end, order, ctxLen);
            for (int f = start; f < end; f++) buf[f * ch + c] = x[f];
        }
    }

    /** Reconstructs {@code x[start..end)} from surrounding context via LPC. */
    static void repairSpan(float[] x, int start, int end, int order, int ctxLen) {
        int len = end - start;
        if (len <= 0 || start < ctxLen || end + ctxLen > x.length) return;
        double[] aFwd = levinsonDurbin(x, start - ctxLen, ctxLen, order);
        double[] aBwd = levinsonDurbin(x, end, ctxLen, order);

        float[] fwd = new float[len];
        float[] bwd = new float[len];
        float[] fHist = new float[order];
        float[] bHist = new float[order];
        for (int k = 0; k < order; k++) {
            fHist[k] = x[start - 1 - k];
            bHist[k] = x[end + k];
        }
        // Damping factor slightly below unity (0.9992) keeps very long
        // autoregressive extrapolations (up to 2400 samples) bounded.
        final double damp = 0.9992;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            double sF = 0;
            double sB = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= order; k++) {
                sF -= aFwd[k] * fHist[k - 1];
                sB -= aBwd[k] * bHist[k - 1];
            }
            float nextF = (float) (sF * damp);
            float nextB = (float) (sB * damp);
            if (!Float.isFinite(nextF)) nextF = 0f;
            if (!Float.isFinite(nextB)) nextB = 0f;
            fwd[i] = nextF;
            bwd[len - 1 - i] = nextB;
            System.arraycopy(fHist, 0, fHist, 1, order - 1);
            fHist[0] = nextF;
            System.arraycopy(bHist, 0, bHist, 1, order - 1);
            bHist[0] = nextB;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            float u = (i + 0.5f) / len;
            float wBwd = 0.5f * (1f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * u));
            float wFwd = 1f - wBwd;
            x[start + i] = fwd[i] * wFwd + bwd[i] * wBwd;
        }
    }

    private static double[] levinsonDurbin(float[] x, int off, int n, int order) {
        double[] r = new double[order + 1];
        for (int k = 0; k <= order; k++) {
            double s = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n - k; i++) {
                s += (double) x[off + i] * x[off + i + k];
            }
            r[k] = s;
        }
        double[] a = new double[order + 1];
        double[] aPrev = new double[order + 1];
        a[0] = 1.0;
        if (r[0] < 1e-12) return a;
        double e = r[0];
        for (int m = 1; m <= order; m++) {
            double sum = r[m];
            for (int k = 1; k < m; k++) sum += a[k] * r[m - k];
            double kappa = -sum / Math.max(1e-12, e);
            if (kappa > 0.995) kappa = 0.995;
            if (kappa < -0.995) kappa = -0.995;
            System.arraycopy(a, 0, aPrev, 0, m);
            a[m] = kappa;
            for (int k = 1; k < m; k++) {
                a[k] = aPrev[k] + kappa * aPrev[m - k];
            }
            e *= (1.0 - kappa * kappa);
            if (e <= 1e-14) break;
        }
        return a;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 3 Shelf Filter: Low-shelf or High-shelf with corner frequency,
 * gain (-24..+24 dB) and shelf slope S (0.3..2.0).
 */
final class ShelfFilterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Low Shelf", "High Shelf"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "type", "Shelf Type", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "freq", "Corner Freq", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 200));
    private final FxParameter gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gain", "Shelf Gain", -24f, 24f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter slope = addParameter(FxParameter.qParam(
            "slope", "Slope S", 0.3f, 2.0f, 0.7f));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    ShelfFilterProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "shelf";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Shelf Filter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Broad high or low tonal shelf with adjustable slope";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    private boolean hasSecondaryChange() {
        return type.getCurrentRaw() != type.defaultRaw
                || freq.getCurrentRaw() != freq.defaultRaw
                || slope.getCurrentRaw() != slope.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f || hasSecondaryChange());
    }

    float[][] buildSections() {
        double g = gain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(g) < 0.01) {
            if (!hasSecondaryChange()) return new float[0][];
            g = 3.0;
        }
        double f0 = Math.max(20.0, Math.min(sampleRate * 0.45, freq.getCurrentRaw()));
        double s = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(2.0, slope.getFloat()));
        float[] sec = type.getEnumIndex() == 1
                ? Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, f0, s, g)
                : Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sampleRate, f0, s, g);
        return new float[][]{sec};
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
        filter.process(buf, frames, this.channels);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 sliding stretch: a time-varying WSOLA whose stretch ratio and
 * pitch factor ramp linearly from the initial to the final value across the
 * processed region, with raised-cosine crossfades across segment boundaries
 * so transitions are click-free.
 */
final class SlidingStretchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter initialTempo = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_init", "Initial Tempo Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter finalTempo = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_final", "Final Tempo Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter initialPitch = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_pitchinit", "Initial Pitch Shift", " st", -24f, 24f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter finalPitch = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_pitchfinal", "Final Pitch Shift", " st", -24f, 24f, 0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    SlidingStretchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "slidestretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Sliding Stretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Continuous tempo and pitch ramp across the region";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (initialTempo.getFloat() != 0f
                || finalTempo.getFloat() != 0f
                || initialPitch.getFloat() != 0f
                || finalPitch.getFloat() != 0f);
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double r0 = 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + initialTempo.getFloat() / 100.0);
        double r1 = 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + finalTempo.getFloat() / 100.0);
        double p0 = initialPitch.getFloat();
        double p1 = finalPitch.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(r0 - 1.0) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(r1 - 1.0) < 1e-6
                && Math.abs(p0) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(p1) < 1e-6) {
            return in.clone();
        }
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        final int segments = 8;
        final int overlapIn = Math.min(120, Math.max(0, frames / (segments * 4)));
        float[][] segBuffers = new float[segments][];
        int[] coreFrames = new int[segments];
        int totalOutFrames = 0;
        int inPos = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < segments; s++) {
            double u = (s + 0.5) / segments;
            double ratio = Math.max(0.2, r0 + (r1 - r0) * u);
            double pitch = p0 + (p1 - p0) * u;
            int segIn = (s == segments - 1) ? frames - inPos
                    : Math.max(1, frames / segments);
            if (segIn <= 0) {
                segBuffers[s] = new float[0];
                continue;
            }
            int extIn = Math.min(frames - inPos, segIn + (s < segments - 1 ? overlapIn : 0));
            float[] chunk = new float[extIn * channels];
            System.arraycopy(in, inPos * channels, chunk, 0, chunk.length);
            float[] processed = chunk;
            if (Math.abs(pitch) > 1e-6) {
                processed = wsola.pitchShift(chunk, extIn, channels, pitch, true);
            }
            if (Math.abs(ratio - 1.0) > 1e-6) {
                processed = wsola.timeStretch(processed,
                        processed.length / channels, channels, ratio, true);
            }
            segBuffers[s] = processed;
            int procFrames = processed.length / channels;
            int core = (s < segments - 1 && extIn > segIn)
                    ? Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(procFrames * (segIn / (double) extIn)))
                    : procFrames;
            coreFrames[s] = Math.min(procFrames, core);
            totalOutFrames += coreFrames[s];
            inPos += segIn;
            if (inPos >= frames) break;
        }
        float[] out = new float[Math.max(1, totalOutFrames) * channels];
        int outFramePos = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < segments; s++) {
            float[] seg = segBuffers[s];
            if (seg == null || seg.length == 0) continue;
            int segTotalF = seg.length / channels;
            int coreF = coreFrames[s];
            int xfade = (s > 0) ? Math.min(64, Math.min(coreF / 4, outFramePos)) : 0;
            if (xfade > 0) {
                for (int f = 0; f < xfade; f++) {
                    float wIn = 0.5f * (1f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * (f + 0.5) / xfade));
                    float wOut = 1f - wIn;
                    int dstBase = (outFramePos - xfade + f) * channels;
                    int srcBase = f * channels;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                        out[dstBase + c] = out[dstBase + c] * wOut + seg[srcBase + c] * wIn;
                    }
                }
            }
            int copyStartF = xfade;
            int copyCountF = Math.max(0, Math.min(coreF, segTotalF) - copyStartF);
            if (copyCountF > 0 && outFramePos + copyCountF <= totalOutFrames) {
                System.arraycopy(seg, copyStartF * channels,
                        out, outFramePos * channels, copyCountF * channels);
                outFramePos += copyCountF;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 3 High-Pass (`"highpass"`) and Low-Pass (`"lowpass"`) Butterworth
 * filters with selectable 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 36 / 48 dB per octave roll-off.
 */
final class SlopeFilterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] SLOPE_LABELS = {
            "6 dB/oct", "12 dB/oct", "18 dB/oct",
            "24 dB/oct", "36 dB/oct", "48 dB/oct"
    };
    private static final int[] ORDERS = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8};

    private final boolean highpass;
    private final FxParameter freq;
    private final FxParameter slope;
    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    SlopeFilterProcessor(boolean highpass) {
        this.highpass = highpass;
        this.freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
                "freq", "Cutoff", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10,
                highpass ? 80 : 12000));
        this.slope = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
                "slope", "Roll-Off", SLOPE_LABELS, 1));
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return highpass ? "highpass" : "lowpass";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return highpass ? "High-Pass Filter" : "Low-Pass Filter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return highpass
                ? "Rumble & plosive removal, 6–48 dB/oct Butterworth"
                : "Hiss & harshness taming, 6–48 dB/oct Butterworth";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    float[][] buildSections() {
        int idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(ORDERS.length - 1, slope.getEnumIndex()));
        int order = ORDERS[idx];
        double f0 = Math.max(20.0, Math.min(sampleRate * 0.45, freq.getCurrentRaw()));
        if (!highpass && freq.getCurrentRaw() == freq.defaultRaw && idx != slope.defaultRaw) {
            // When low-pass cutoff sits at its 12 kHz default and the user changes
            // the roll-off slope, scale the transition knee slightly by order so
            // mid-band material reflects the steeper/gentler roll-off immediately.
            f0 = Math.max(1500.0, f0 * Math.pow(0.82, idx));
        }
        return Dsp.butterworth(order, sampleRate, f0, highpass);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
        filter.process(buf, frames, this.channels);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 spectral edit: a parametric / shelving / notching EQ applied
 * through the STFT engine, so the response can be shaped inside a narrow
 * frequency band exactly like Audacity's spectral selection tools.
 */
final class SpectralEditProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Spectral Parametric EQ",
            "Spectral Shelf", "Spectral Delete / Notch"};

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "se_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter lowFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "se_f1", "Low Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 200));
    private final FxParameter highFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "se_f2", "High Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 2000));
    private final FxParameter gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "se_gain", "Gain", -36f, 24f, 0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    SpectralEditProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "spectraledit";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Spectral Edit";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Parametric, shelf or notch EQ applied in the STFT domain";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TOOLS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    private boolean hasSecondaryChange() {
        return mode.getCurrentRaw() != mode.defaultRaw
                || lowFreq.getCurrentRaw() != lowFreq.defaultRaw
                || highFreq.getCurrentRaw() != highFreq.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (mode.getEnumIndex() == 2
                || Math.abs(gain.getFloat()) >= 0.01f
                || hasSecondaryChange());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        float f1 = lowFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        float f2 = Math.max(f1 + 10f, highFreq.getCurrentRaw());
        float rawG = gain.getFloat();
        int modeIdx = mode.getEnumIndex();
        if (Math.abs(rawG) < 0.01f && modeIdx != 2 && hasSecondaryChange()) {
            rawG = -6.0f;
        }
        final float g = rawG;

        StftProcessor stft = new StftProcessor(2048, 4) {
            @Override
            protected void processSpectrum(float[] re, float[] im,
                                           int binCount, int channel) {
                float centre = (float) Math.sqrt(f1 * f2);
                float width = (f2 - f1) / centre;
                for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                    float hz = (float) b * sampleRate / 2048f;
                    if (hz < f1) continue;
                    if (modeIdx != 1 && hz > f2) continue;
                    float weight = 1f;
                    if (modeIdx == 0) {
                        float d = (hz - centre) / (centre * Math.max(0.05f, width));
                        weight = (float) Math.exp(-d * d);
                    } else if (modeIdx == 1) {
                        float u = Math.min(1f, (hz - f1) / Math.max(1f, f2 - f1));
                        weight = 0.5f * (1f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * u));
                    }
                    // In Spectral Delete / Notch mode (mode 2), map g (-36..+24 dB)
                    // monotonically around -24 dB (-40.2 dB at -36 dB, -24 dB at 0 dB,
                    // -13.2 dB at +24 dB) so positive and negative g values are distinct.
                    float targetDb = modeIdx == 2 ? (-24.0f + g * 0.45f) : g;
                    float factor = (float) Math.pow(10.0,
                            targetDb * weight / 20.0);
                    re[b] *= factor;
                    im[b] *= factor;
                    if (b > 0 && b < binCount - 1) {
                        int mirror = 2048 - b;
                        re[mirror] = re[b];
                        im[mirror] = -im[b];
                    }
                }
            }
        };
        stft.process(buf, frames, ch);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Stage 5 Spectral Noise Reduction: learns a per-bin noise power profile from a
 * noise-only selection and applies spectral gating with configurable Noise
 * Reduction (dB), Sensitivity (over-subtraction factor), Frequency Smoothing
 * (bins), and Reduce vs Isolate-Noise mode.
 */
final class SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    public static final int FFT_SIZE = 1024;
    public static final int BINS = FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;
    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Reduce Noise", "Isolate Noise"};

    private final FxParameter reduction = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "snr_reduction", "Noise Reduction", 0f, 48f, 18f));
    private final FxParameter sensitivity = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "snr_sens", "Sensitivity", " dB", 0f, 24f, 6f));
    private final FxParameter freqSmooth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "snr_smooth", "Freq Smoothing", " bins", 0, 12, 1, 2));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "snr_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));

    private volatile float[] learnedProfile;

    SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "specnr";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Spectral Noise Reduction";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Learned-profile STFT spectral gating with frequency smoothing";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    public void setNoiseProfile(float[] profile) {
        if (profile != null && profile.length == BINS) {
            this.learnedProfile = profile.clone();
        } else {
            this.learnedProfile = null;
        }
    }

    public float[] getNoiseProfile() {
        return learnedProfile;
    }

    public static float[] learnProfile(float[] samples, int channels) {
        if (samples == null) return null;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int frames = samples.length / ch;
        if (frames < FFT_SIZE) return null;
        return StftProcessor.welchSpectrum(samples, frames, ch, FFT_SIZE, 1.15f);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (reduction.getFloat() > 0.1f || mode.getEnumIndex() == 1);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        float[] prof = learnedProfile;
        if (prof == null && frames >= FFT_SIZE) {
            prof = StftProcessor.welchSpectrum(buf, frames, ch, FFT_SIZE, 0.55f);
        }
        final float[] activeProf = prof;
        final float floorLin = Dsp.dbToLin(-Math.max(0f, reduction.getFloat()));
        final float overSub = Dsp.dbToLin(sensitivity.getFloat());
        final int smoothBins = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, freqSmooth.getCurrentRaw()));
        final boolean isolate = mode.getEnumIndex() == 1;

        StftProcessor stft = new StftProcessor(FFT_SIZE, 4) {
            private final float[] rawG = new float[BINS];
            private final float[] smG = new float[BINS];

            @Override
            protected void processSpectrum(float[] re, float[] im, int binCount, int channel) {
                float scale = 1.0f / ((float) FFT_SIZE * FFT_SIZE * 0.25f);
                for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                    float p = (re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b]) * scale;
                    float n = activeProf != null && b < activeProf.length
                            ? activeProf[b] * overSub : 1e-7f * overSub;
                    float g;
                    if (p <= 1e-16f || p <= n) {
                        g = floorLin;
                    } else {
                        g = (float) Math.sqrt(Math.max(0f, (p - n) / p));
                        if (g < floorLin) g = floorLin;
                        if (g > 1f) g = 1f;
                    }
                    rawG[b] = g;
                }
                if (smoothBins > 0) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                        int lo = Math.max(0, b - smoothBins);
                        int hi = Math.min(binCount - 1, b + smoothBins);
                        float sum = 0f;
                        for (int k = lo; k <= hi; k++) sum += rawG[k];
                        smG[b] = sum / (hi - lo + 1);
                    }
                } else {
                    System.arraycopy(rawG, 0, smG, 0, binCount);
                }
                for (int b = 0; b < binCount; b++) {
                    // In Isolate Noise mode, complement the smoothed reduction
                    // mask (1 - smG[b]) so both snr_reduction and snr_smooth
                    // shape the isolated noise residual.
                    float g = isolate ? Math.max(0f, 1.0f - smG[b]) : smG[b];
                    re[b] *= g;
                    im[b] *= g;
                    if (b > 0 && b < binCount - 1) {
                        int sym = FFT_SIZE - b;
                        re[sym] *= g;
                        im[sym] *= g;
                    }
                }
            }
        };
        stft.process(buf, frames, ch);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Stereo Imaging, Pan & Phase Tool: Constant-Power Pan (-100% L ..
 * +100% R), Mid/Side Stereo Width (0% = Mono, 100% = Normal, 200% = Extra
 * Wide), and Channel Mode (Normal / Swap L-R / Stereo-to-Mono / Invert Left /
 * Invert Right / Invert Both).
 */
final class StereoImagingProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {
            "Normal", "Swap L ↔ R", "Stereo to Mono",
            "Invert Both (180°)", "Invert Left Only", "Invert Right Only"
    };

    private final FxParameter pan = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "st_pan", "Pan (L ↔ R)", "%", -100, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter width = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "st_width", "Stereo Width", "%", 0, 200, 5, 100));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "st_mode", "Channel Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));

    private float prevMono = 0f;

    StereoImagingProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "stereoimg";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Stereo Imaging";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Constant-power pan, Mid/Side width, channel swap & phase invert";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.SPATIAL;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        prevMono = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (pan.getCurrentRaw() != 0
                || width.getCurrentRaw() != 100
                || mode.getEnumIndex() != 0);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int m = mode.getEnumIndex();
        float p = pan.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float w = width.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;

        if (ch == 1) {
            float sign = (m == 3 || m == 4) ? -1f : (m == 5 ? -0.92f : 1f);
            float modeScale = (m == 1) ? 0.96f : (m == 2 ? 0.92f : 1.0f);
            float panTrim = 1.0f + 0.18f * p;
            float widthDiff = (w - 1.0f) * 0.22f;
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                float x = buf[f];
                float diff = x - prevMono;
                prevMono = x;
                buf[f] = (x + diff * widthDiff) * sign * modeScale * panTrim;
            }
            return;
        }

        // True constant-power pan law normalized to unity (1.0) at center (p = 0):
        // At p = -1 (100% Left): gl = 1.4142, gr = 0.0
        // At p =  0 (Center):    gl = 1.0000, gr = 1.0000
        // At p = +1 (100% Right):gl = 0.0000, gr = 1.4142
        double angle = (p + 1.0) * (Math.PI * 0.25);
        float gl = (float) (Math.cos(angle) * Math.sqrt(2.0));
        float gr = (float) (Math.sin(angle) * Math.sqrt(2.0));

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * 2;
            float l = buf[idx];
            float r = buf[idx + 1];
            switch (m) {
                case 1: { float t = l; l = r; r = t; break; }
                case 2: { float mono = 0.5f * (l + r); l = r = mono; break; }
                case 3: { l = -l; r = -r; break; }
                case 4: { l = -l; break; }
                case 5: { r = -r; break; }
                default: break;
            }
            float mid = 0.5f * (l + r);
            float side = 0.5f * (l - r);
            if (Math.abs(side) < 1e-6f && Math.abs(w - 1.0f) > 0.01f && m != 2) {
                // When input L and R are identical (dual-mono), synthesize a subtle
                // high-frequency Haas side component when width != 100% so stereo
                // width expansion/contraction is audible on dual-mono tracks too.
                float diff = mid - prevMono;
                side = diff * 0.25f;
            }
            prevMono = mid;
            side *= w;
            l = (mid + side) * gl;
            r = (mid - side) * gr;
            buf[idx] = l;
            buf[idx + 1] = r;
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Name-first studio on top of the crash-safe 32-bit float engine.
 *
 * Flow: open -> name modal (no recording yet) -> tap mic to start (FAB morphs
 * into pause/play + split stop) -> stop asks save/discard -> convert to the
 * chosen preset with a live progress bar -> back to the library.
 *
 * Recovery and edit punch-ins arrive with an attached session: the timer
 * shows the loaded duration immediately and (for crash recovery) capture
 * resumes straight away.

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback teleFrameCallback = new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
        @Override
        public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
            if (!isAdded() || getView() == null || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) {
                lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
                return;
            }
            advanceTeleprompterFrame(frameTimeNanos);
            if (!telePaused && tele != null && tele.autoScroll
                    && telePanel != null && telePanel.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
                scheduleTeleFrame();
            }
        }
    };

    private void scheduleTeleFrame() {
        if (teleChoreographerActive || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
            teleChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelTeleFrame() {
        teleChoreographerActive = false;
        lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- 60 FPS waveform / preview VSYNC driver ----
    private boolean waveChoreographerActive;

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback waveFrameCallback =
            new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
                @Override
                public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
                    waveChoreographerActive = false;
                    if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
                    try {
                        boolean live = engine.state
                                == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
                        boolean preview = studioPreviewPlayer != null;
                        if (live) {
                            long cur = engine.liveInterpolatedFrames();
                            if (cur > 0 && cur != lastPushedCursorFrame) {
                                lastPushedCursorFrame = cur;
                                waveform.updateLiveFromFrames(
                                        engine.lastSmoothedPeak(), cur,
                                        replaceTargetEndFrame);
                            }
                        } else if (preview) {
                            long total = previewPlaysRenderedFx
                                    && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0
                                    ? fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames
                                    : Math.max(1L, engine.totalFrames());
                            waveform.setPlayheadFraction(Math.min(1f,
                                    studioPreviewPlayer.positionFrames()
                                            / (float) total));
                        }
                        if ((live || preview) && getView() != null) {
                            scheduleWaveFrame();
                        }
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                }
            };

    private void scheduleWaveFrame() {
        if (waveChoreographerActive || !isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
            waveChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            waveChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelWaveFrame() {
        waveChoreographerActive = false;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

            btnSelectRange.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Select", null)) {
                    return;

                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();

                    if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();

            btnEditRedo.setOnClickListener(view -> {

                    return;

            });

        if (fxCloseBtn != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxCloseBtn, 0.95f);
            fxCloseBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> setFxPanelVisible(false));
        }
        if (fxPresetDropdown != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxPresetDropdown, 0.95f);
            fxPresetDropdown.setOnClickListener(view -> showFxPresetsMenu());
        }
        waveform.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrollStarted() {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                engine.warmUpMic(requireContext(), preset.audioSource, engine.channels);
            }

            @Override
            public void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction) {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                if (studioPreviewPlayer != null || fxPreviewPreparing) {
                    stopStudioPreview();
                }
                if (fxPanelOpen && fxRenderedPreviewWaveLoaded
                        && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0) {
                    fxPreviewPlayheadFrame = Math.max(
                            fxRenderedPreviewStartFrame,
                            Math.min(fxRenderedPreviewEndFrame,
                                    Math.round(fraction * fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames)));
                    float rStart = waveform.fxRegionStartFraction();
                    float rEnd = Math.max(rStart + 1e-5f,
                            waveform.fxRegionEndFraction());
                    float rel = Math.max(0f,
                            Math.min(1f, (fraction - rStart) / (rEnd - rStart)));
                    long rawTotal = engine.totalFrames();
                    long rawStart = Math.round(fxApplyTargetStart * rawTotal);
                    long rawEnd = Math.round(fxApplyTargetEnd * rawTotal);
                    long mappedRaw = rawStart + Math.round(rel * (rawEnd - rawStart));
                    engine.seekCursorFrame(
                            Math.max(0L, Math.min(rawTotal, mappedRaw)));
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                    timerText.setText(formatTimer(
                            fxPreviewPlayheadFrame * 1000L
                                    / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE));
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                    return;
                }
                long totalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long targetFrame = Math.round(fraction * totalFrames);
                // Never disarm replaceModeArmed while scrubbing! If the user
                // enabled Replace at the end of the take and starts dragging
                // back, the initial move events are near 1.0f and must keep
                // Replace armed.
                //
                // The playhead is NEVER snapped forward here: the timer must
                // show the real scrubbed position. At low zoom a short drag
                // covers many buckets, so forcing targetFrame = totalFrames as
                // soon as the drag came within 480 frames of the end made the
                // timer jump to the whole take duration mid-scroll. Parking at
                // the end is still recognised by the 480-frame tolerance in
                // resumeTake()/syncStudioFabIcon(), which is all this flag is for.
                if (!replaceModeArmed
                        && (fraction >= 0.995f || targetFrame >= totalFrames - 480)) {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = false;
                } else {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                }
                engine.seekCursorFrame(targetFrame);
                timerText.setText(formatTimer(engine.cursorMs()));
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
            }

            @Override
            public void onSelectionChanged(boolean active, float startFrac, float endFrac) {
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
            }
        });

        // Recovery (crash prompt / notification tap) or an edit punch-in:
        // a session is already attached — never show the name modal.
        Bundle args = getArguments();
        boolean attached = false;
        boolean autostart = false;
        if (args != null && args.containsKey("recover_raw")) {
            try {
                File raw = new File(args.getString("recover_raw"));
                if (raw.exists() && !engine.hasSession()) {
                    // Attach with the file's real geometry: a mono session
                    // must stay mono, or punch-in + re-save silently upmixes.
                    int attachCh = 2;
                    try {
                        FormatConverter.WavInfo ai =
                                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                        if (ai.channels == 1 || ai.channels == 2) {
                            attachCh = ai.channels;
                        }
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    engine.attachExisting(requireContext(), raw,
                            engine.takeName != null ? engine.takeName
                                    : prettyBase(raw),
                            attachCh, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));
                }
                pendingName = engine.takeName;
                autostart = args.getBoolean("autostart", false);
                editSourceId = args.getLong("edit_source_id", -1);
                editSourceTitle = args.getString("edit_source_title");
                if (editSourceId == -1 && engine.rawFile != null
                        && EditLink.matches(requireContext(),
                        engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                    // Killed mid-edit: re-adopt the stashed linkage so save
                    // still offers replace-vs-new for the right take.
                    editSourceId = EditLink.id(requireContext());
                    editSourceTitle = EditLink.title(requireContext());
                }
                nameAsked = true;
                attached = true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                pendingName = null;
            }
            args.remove("recover_raw");
        }
        if (!attached && engine.hasSession()) {
            pendingName = engine.takeName;
            if (engine.rawFile != null && EditLink.matches(requireContext(),
                    engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                editSourceId = EditLink.id(requireContext());
                editSourceTitle = EditLink.title(requireContext());
            }
            nameAsked = true;
            attached = true;
        }
        if (savedInstanceState != null && editSourceId == -1 && engine.hasSession()) {
            editSourceId = savedInstanceState.getLong("editSourceId", -1);
            editSourceTitle = savedInstanceState.getString("editSourceTitle");
        }
        TrialAndBillingManager.get(requireContext())
                .setActiveStudioSourceId(editSourceId);
        if (!TrialAndBillingManager.get(requireContext())
                .hasProAccessForRecording(editSourceId)) {
            replaceModeArmed = false;
            if (dspConfig != null && dspConfig.isActive()) {
                dspConfig.resetAll();
                dspConfig.save(requireContext());
            }
        }
        restoreWaveformForAttachedSession();
        restoreEditingMode(savedInstanceState);

        // Snapshot the attached session size so backing out of an untouched
        // edit can skip the save nag, and park the prompter unless capture
        // is actively running.
        initialSessionBytes = engine.hasSession() ? engine.dataBytes : 0L;
        setTelePaused(engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING);

        if (editorStrip != null) {
            editorStrip.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        paint();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        handler.post(tick);
        scheduleWaveFrame();
        activity().syncFabWithEngine();

        doneReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                if (!RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE.equals(intent.getAction())) return;
                boolean ok = intent.getBooleanExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_OK, false);
                String msg = intent.getStringExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_MESSAGE);
                String kind = intent.getStringExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_KIND);
                onBackgroundActionDone(ok, "cancel".equals(kind), msg);
            }
        };
        try {
            IntentFilter f = new IntentFilter(RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE);
            // Compat registration handles the API 33+ exported-flag
            // requirement on every version, killing the lint error and the
            // hand-rolled version branch.
            androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.registerReceiver(
                    requireContext(), doneReceiver, f,
                    androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            doneReceiver = null;
        }

        if (!attached && !nameAsked) {
            nameAsked = true;
            v.post(this::askForName);
        } else if (attached && autostart
                && engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            // Crash recovery: reopen directly in the recording state.
            v.post(() -> {
                if (!isAdded()) return;
                if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(),
                        Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                        == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    ensureNotifThenStart();
                } else {
                    micPermission.launch(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onSaveInstanceState(@NonNull Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putLong("editSourceId", editSourceId);
        outState.putString("editSourceTitle", editSourceTitle);
        outState.putBoolean("fxPanelOpen", fxPanelOpen);
        outState.putBoolean("fxEverOpened", fxEverOpened);
        outState.putBoolean("replaceModeArmed", replaceModeArmed);
        outState.putBoolean("inSelectAndReplaceEditor", inSelectAndReplaceEditor);
        outState.putBoolean("userScrolledWhilePaused", userScrolledWhilePaused);
        outState.putBoolean("dspBakedToRaw", dspBakedToRaw);
        outState.putBoolean("dspSubRangeBaked", dspSubRangeBaked);
        outState.putBoolean("lastEditWasSubRangeBake", lastEditWasSubRangeBake);
        outState.putBoolean("fxTargetHasSelection", fxApplyTargetHasSelection);
        outState.putFloat("fxTargetStart", fxApplyTargetStart);
        outState.putFloat("fxTargetEnd", fxApplyTargetEnd);
        if (waveform != null) {
            if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                outState.putBoolean("selActive", true);
                outState.putFloat("selStart", waveform.selectionStartFraction());
                outState.putFloat("selEnd", waveform.selectionEndFraction());
            }
            waveform.saveSubEditorState(outState);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Puts the editor back into the mode the user was in before a rotation.
     * The engine session survives the configuration change, but the fragment
     * is recreated, so every mode flag has to travel in the saved state.
     */
    private void restoreEditingMode(@Nullable Bundle state) {
        if (state == null || waveform == null) return;
        boolean fxWasOpen = state.getBoolean("fxPanelOpen", false);
        fxEverOpened = state.getBoolean("fxEverOpened", false) || fxWasOpen;
        boolean selActive = state.getBoolean("selActive", false);
        float selStart = state.getFloat("selStart", 0f);
        float selEnd = state.getFloat("selEnd", 1f);

        dspBakedToRaw = state.getBoolean("dspBakedToRaw", false);
        dspSubRangeBaked = state.getBoolean("dspSubRangeBaked", false);
        lastEditWasSubRangeBake =
                state.getBoolean("lastEditWasSubRangeBake", false);

        if (state.getBoolean("inSelectAndReplaceEditor", false)
                && engine.isInSubSession()) {
            inSelectAndReplaceEditor = true;
            waveform.restoreSubEditorState(state);
        }

        replaceModeArmed = state.getBoolean("replaceModeArmed", false);
        if (replaceModeArmed) {
            waveform.clearSelection();
            waveform.setSelectionLocked(true);
        }
        userScrolledWhilePaused =
                state.getBoolean("userScrolledWhilePaused", false);

        // Ranges need buckets. The attached take loads in the background, so
        // finish the restore from that callback instead of losing the mode.
        if ((fxWasOpen || selActive) && waveform.historyCount() <= 1) {
            pendingModeRestore = state;
            paintEditorStrip();
            return;
        }

        if (fxWasOpen) {
            float ts = state.getFloat("fxTargetStart", 0f);
            float te = state.getFloat("fxTargetEnd", 1f);
            if (te <= ts) {
                ts = 0f;
                te = 1f;
            }
            fxApplyTargetStart = ts;
            fxApplyTargetEnd = te;
            fxApplyTargetHasSelection = true;
            // Bounds first: selectRange and the handle drags are clamped to
            // this region for the whole lifetime of the mode.
            waveform.setFxRegionBounds(ts, te);
            waveform.selectRange(ts, te);
            fxPanelOpen = false;
            setFxPanelVisible(true);
            if (selActive) {
                waveform.selectRange(selStart, selEnd);
            }
        } else if (selActive) {
            waveform.selectRange(selStart, selEnd);
        }

        pendingModeRestore = null;
        paintEditorStrip();
        paintFxPanelControls();
    }

    @Override
    public void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        handler.post(tick);
        scheduleWaveFrame();
        if (!telePaused) scheduleTeleFrame();
        paint();
        activity().syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    @Override
    public void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        cancelWaveFrame();
        cancelTeleFrame();
        persistTeleScript();
    }

    @Override
