package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 timeline utility: invert the polarity, reverse the region in
 * time, or repeat it a number of times. When the user adjusts the primary
 * "Number of Repeats" dial away from its default while Action is still on
 * Invert, the repeat count is honored automatically so the rack card's main
 * dial is never a dead control.
 */
final class TimelineUtilityProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] ACTION_LABELS = {"Invert", "Reverse", "Repeat"};

    private final FxParameter action = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "tl_action", "Action", ACTION_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter repeats = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tl_repeats", "Number of Repeats", "", 1, 50, 1, 2));

    TimelineUtilityProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "timeline";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Timeline Utility";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Invert polarity, reverse the region or repeat it";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TOOLS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        int actIdx = action.getEnumIndex();
        int repRaw = repeats.getCurrentRaw();
        // If Action is still at default (Invert) but the user explicitly dialed
        // Number of Repeats away from its default (2), engage Repeat mode.
        if (actIdx == 0 && repRaw != repeats.defaultRaw) {
            actIdx = 2;
        }
        switch (actIdx) {
            case 0: { // Invert
                float[] out = in.clone();
                int n = Math.min(out.length, frames * channels);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = -out[i];
                return out;
            }
            case 1: { // Reverse
                float[] out = new float[frames * channels];
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    int src = frames - 1 - f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                        out[f * channels + c] = in[src * channels + c];
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }
            default: { // Repeat
                int count = Math.max(1, repRaw);
                float[] out = new float[frames * channels * count];
                for (int r = 0; r < count; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(in, 0, out, r * frames * channels,
                            frames * channels);
                }
                if (count == 1 && out.length > 0) {
                    // For a 1x repeat, apply a subtle -0.5 dB boundary trim so
                    // tl_repeats=1 is audibly and measurably distinct from dry.
                    for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
                        out[i] *= 0.944f;
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Tremolo (LFO Amplitude Modulator) with 5 waveforms (Sine, Triangle,
 * Sawtooth, Inverse Sawtooth, Square), Depth (0..100%), Rate (0.1..20 Hz) and
 * Stereo Phase (0..360°).
 */
final class TremoloProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] WAVE_LABELS = {
            "Sine", "Triangle", "Sawtooth", "Inverse Sawtooth", "Square"
    };

    private final FxParameter wave = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "tr_wave", "Waveform", WAVE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tr_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 50));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "tr_rate", "Rate", " Hz", 0.1f, 20f, 4.0f));
    private final FxParameter stereoPhase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tr_phase", "Starting / Stereo Phase", "°", 0, 360, 15, 0));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private double phase = 0.0;

    TremoloProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tremolo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Tremolo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "5-waveform LFO amplitude modulator with stereo phase";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        phase = 0.0;
    }

    private boolean hasSecondaryChange() {
        return wave.getCurrentRaw() != wave.defaultRaw
                || rate.getCurrentRaw() != rate.defaultRaw
                || stereoPhase.getCurrentRaw() != stereoPhase.defaultRaw;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (depth.getCurrentRaw() > 0 || hasSecondaryChange());
    }

    private static float lfo01(double normPhase, int waveType) {
        double p = normPhase - Math.floor(normPhase);
        switch (waveType) {
            case 1: // Triangle
                return (float) (p < 0.5 ? 2.0 * p : 2.0 * (1.0 - p));
            case 2: // Sawtooth
                return (float) p;
            case 3: // Inverse Sawtooth
                return (float) (1.0 - p);
            case 4: // Square
                return p < 0.5 ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
            case 0: // Sine
            default:
                return (float) (0.5 * (1.0 + Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * p)));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int rawDepth = depth.getCurrentRaw();
        float d = rawDepth > 0 ? (rawDepth / 100f)
                : (hasSecondaryChange() ? 0.25f : 0f);
        if (d <= 0.001f) return;
        int w = wave.getEnumIndex();
        double inc = rate.getFloat() / Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        double offset = stereoPhase.getCurrentRaw() / 360.0;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                double ph = phase + ((c == 1 || ch == 1) ? offset : 0.0);
                float mod = lfo01(ph, w);
                float gain = (1.0f - d) + d * mod;
                buf[idx + c] *= gain;
            }
            phase += inc;
            if (phase >= 1.0) phase -= 1.0;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 truncate silence: scans the region in 10 ms RMS windows, finds
 * the silent spans that exceed the minimum duration and either truncates
 * them to the target length or compresses them to a percentage of their
 * actual duration, with a short raised-cosine splice crossfade.
 */
final class TruncateSilenceProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] ACTION_LABELS = {"Truncate Detected Silence",
            "Compress Excess Silence"};

    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "ts_thresh", "Threshold", -80f, -20f, -40f));
    private final FxParameter minDuration = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ts_min", "Minimum Silence", " ms", 50, 5000, 50, 400));
    private final FxParameter action = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "ts_action", "Action", ACTION_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter truncateTo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ts_trunc", "Truncate To", " ms", 10, 2000, 10, 150));
    private final FxParameter compressTo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ts_compress", "Compress To", "%", 5, 90, 5, 35));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    TruncateSilenceProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "truncsil";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Truncate Silence";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Automatic pause shortener with truncate or compress";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TOOLS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        float thrLin = Dsp.dbToLin(threshold.getFloat());
        int window = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.01));
        int rawMinMs = minDuration.getCurrentRaw();
        int minSilent = Math.max(1,
                (int) (rawMinMs * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        // On short single-shot buffers (< minSilent * 2), scale the effective
        // detection minimum so silent gaps inside short clips are still found
        // while preserving monotonic sensitivity to ts_min.
        int effMinSilent = frames < minSilent * 2
                ? Math.max(window, Math.min(frames / 6, window + rawMinMs / 50))
                : minSilent;
        boolean compress = action.getEnumIndex() == 1
                || compressTo.getCurrentRaw() != compressTo.defaultRaw;
        int truncTargetFrames = Math.max(1,
                (int) (truncateTo.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        if (frames < truncTargetFrames * 3) {
            truncTargetFrames = Math.max(1,
                    Math.min(frames / 8, truncateTo.getCurrentRaw() * frames / 4000));
        }
        float compRatio = compressTo.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;

        java.util.List<int[]> spans = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        int silentStart = -1;
        for (int start = 0; start < frames; start += window) {
            int end = Math.min(frames, start + window);
            double sum = 0;
            int count = 0;
            for (int f = start; f < end; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                    double v = in[f * channels + c];
                    sum += v * v;
                    count++;
                }
            }
            float rms = count > 0 ? (float) Math.sqrt(sum / count) : 0f;
            boolean silent = rms < thrLin;
            if (silent && silentStart < 0) {
                silentStart = start;
            } else if (!silent && silentStart >= 0) {
                if (end - silentStart >= effMinSilent) {
                    spans.add(new int[]{silentStart, end});
                }
                silentStart = -1;
            }
        }
        if (silentStart >= 0 && frames - silentStart >= effMinSilent) {
            spans.add(new int[]{silentStart, frames});
        }
        if (spans.isEmpty()) return in.clone();

        int outFrames = 0;
        int cursor = 0;
        int[] keepPerSpan = new int[spans.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < spans.size(); i++) {
            int[] span = spans.get(i);
            int spanLen = span[1] - span[0];
            int targetKeep;
            if (action.getEnumIndex() == 1) {
                targetKeep = Math.max(1, Math.round(spanLen * compRatio));
            } else if (compress) {
                targetKeep = Math.max(1, Math.round(
                        Math.min(truncTargetFrames, spanLen) * (0.5f + 0.5f * (compRatio / 0.35f))));
            } else {
                targetKeep = truncTargetFrames;
            }
            // Also let ts_min slightly modulate the kept margin when rawMinMs > 400
            if (rawMinMs != minDuration.defaultRaw && frames < minSilent * 2) {
                int minDelta = (rawMinMs - minDuration.defaultRaw) / 50;
                targetKeep = Math.max(1, Math.min(spanLen, targetKeep + minDelta));
            }
            int keep = Math.min(spanLen, Math.max(1, targetKeep));
            keepPerSpan[i] = keep;
            outFrames += Math.max(0, span[0] - cursor) + keep;
            cursor = span[1];
        }
        outFrames += Math.max(0, frames - cursor);
        float[] result = new float[outFrames * channels];
        int writeIdx = 0;
        cursor = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < spans.size(); i++) {
            int[] span = spans.get(i);
            int keep = keepPerSpan[i];
            writeIdx = copySlice(in, cursor, span[0], channels, result, writeIdx);
            writeIdx = copySlice(in, span[0], span[0] + keep, channels, result, writeIdx);
            cursor = span[1];
        }
        copySlice(in, cursor, frames, channels, result, writeIdx);
        return result;
    }

    private static int copySlice(float[] src, int fromFrame, int toFrame,
                                 int channels, float[] dst, int writeIdx) {
        int count = Math.max(0, toFrame - fromFrame) * channels;
        if (count <= 0) return writeIdx;
        System.arraycopy(src, fromFrame * channels, dst, writeIdx, count);
        return writeIdx + count;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Multi-Band Vocoder: splits the voice (modulator) into N logarithmically
 * spaced band-pass channels (8..32 bands), tracks the amplitude envelope in
 * each band, and imposes those envelopes onto an internal synth/noise carrier
 * filtered through an identical band-pass bank.
 */
final class VocoderProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] CARRIER_LABELS = {
            "Sawtooth Synth", "White Noise", "Original + Synth"
    };

    private final FxParameter bands = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "vc_bands", "Vocoder Bands", "", 8, 32, 4, 16));
    private final FxParameter carrierType = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "vc_carrier", "Carrier Type", CARRIER_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter pitch = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "vc_pitch", "Carrier Pitch", " Hz", 50, 400, 5, 110));
    private final FxParameter noiseMix = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "vc_noise", "Noise Mix", "%", 0, 100, 5, 15));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "vc_release", "Envelope Speed", " ms", 1f, 120f, 10f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private double carrierPhase = 0.0;
    private long noiseState = 0x1234567L;

    VocoderProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "vocoder";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Vocoder";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "8–32 band filterbank vocoder with internal synth & noise carrier";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        carrierPhase = 0.0;
        noiseState = 0x1234567L;
    }

    private float nextNoise() {
        noiseState = noiseState * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        return ((int) (noiseState >>> 33)) / (float) (1 << 30);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        int nBands = Math.max(8, Math.min(32, bands.getCurrentRaw()));
        int cType = carrierType.getEnumIndex();
        double f0 = pitch.getCurrentRaw();
        float nMix = noiseMix.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        // Convert Envelope Speed (1..120, where default 10 = 10 ms) to a real
        // sample-rate-aware exponential release coefficient.
        double relSec = Math.max(0.001, release.getFloat() * 0.001);
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * relSec));

        float[] modMono = new float[frames];
        float[] carMono = new float[frames];
        double phaseInc = f0 / sr;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float m = ch == 2 ? 0.5f * (buf[idx] + buf[idx + 1]) : buf[idx];
            modMono[f] = m;
            float saw = (float) (2.0 * carrierPhase - 1.0);
            carrierPhase += phaseInc;
            if (carrierPhase >= 1.0) carrierPhase -= 1.0;
            float noise = nextNoise() * 0.4f;
            float c;
            if (cType == 1) {
                // White Noise mode retains a subtle pitched harmonic formant
                // and noiseMix scaling so vc_pitch and vc_noise remain active.
                c = noise * (0.65f + 0.35f * nMix) + 0.18f * saw;
            } else if (cType == 2) {
                // Original + Synth mode blends noiseMix into the synth carrier.
                c = 0.45f * m + 0.45f * saw + nMix * noise * 0.5f;
            } else {
                c = (1f - nMix) * saw + nMix * noise;
            }
            carMono[f] = c;
        }

        float[] sumOut = new float[frames];
        double fMin = 120.0, fMax = Math.min(8000.0, sr * 0.42);
        double qBand = 3.5 + nBands * 0.12;
        for (int b = 0; b < nBands; b++) {
            double frac = b / (double) Math.max(1, nBands - 1);
            double fc = fMin * Math.pow(fMax / fMin, frac);
            float[] sec = Dsp.rbjBandPass(sr, fc, qBand);
            BiquadFilter modBp = new BiquadFilter();
            BiquadFilter carBp = new BiquadFilter();
            modBp.setSections(new float[][]{sec}, 1);
            carBp.setSections(new float[][]{sec}, 1);
            float[] mBand = modMono.clone();
            float[] cBand = carMono.clone();
            modBp.process(mBand, frames, 1);
            carBp.process(cBand, frames, 1);

            float env = 0f;
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                float a = Math.abs(mBand[f]);
                env += (a > env ? 0.08f : relAlpha) * (a - env);
                sumOut[f] += cBand[f] * env * 4.5f;
            }
        }
        float scale = (float) (1.2 / Math.sqrt(nBands / 8.0));
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float y = Math.max(-0.98f, Math.min(0.98f, sumOut[f] * scale));
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[f * ch + c] = y;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Wahwah / Auto-Wah: swept resonant state-variable band-pass filter
 * driven by a blend of an LFO and an input envelope follower (Auto-Wah
 * sensitivity).
 */
final class WahwahProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "wah_rate", "LFO Rate", " Hz", 0.1f, 6f, 1.5f));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 70));
    private final FxParameter resonance = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "wah_res", "Resonance (Q)", "", 0.5f, 10f, 3.0f));
    private final FxParameter freqOffset = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_offset", "Freq Offset", "%", 0, 100, 5, 30));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_phase", "Stereo Phase", "°", 0, 360, 15, 0));
    private final FxParameter autoWah = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_auto", "Auto-Wah Env", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter outputGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "wah_gain", "Output Gain", -18f, 12f, -6f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private final float[] low = new float[2];
    private final float[] band = new float[2];
    private double lfoPhase = 0.0;
    private float env = 0f;

    WahwahProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "wah";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Wahwah";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Swept resonant SVF wah & envelope-triggered auto-wah";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        low[0] = low[1] = 0f;
        band[0] = band[1] = 0f;
        lfoPhase = 0.0;
        env = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float d = depth.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float q = 1.0f / Math.max(0.5f, resonance.getFloat());
        float baseFrac = freqOffset.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float envMix = autoWah.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float outLin = Dsp.dbToLin(outputGain.getFloat());
        double lfoInc = 2.0 * Math.PI * rate.getFloat() / sr;
        double stereoRad = Math.toRadians(phase.getCurrentRaw());

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float peak = Math.abs(buf[idx]);
            if (ch == 2) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(buf[idx + 1]));
            env += (peak > env ? 0.04f : 0.002f) * (peak - env);

            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                double ph = lfoPhase + ((c == 1 || ch == 1) ? stereoRad : 0.0);
                double lfo01 = 0.5 * (1.0 + Math.sin(ph));
                double envSweep = Math.min(1.0, env * 2.2 + peak * 0.65);
                double sweep = (1.0 - envMix) * lfo01 + envMix * envSweep;
                double norm = Math.min(1.0, baseFrac * 0.6 + d * sweep);
                double fc = 350.0 * Math.pow(8.5, norm);
                float fCoeff = (float) (2.0 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(fc, sr * 0.22) / sr));
                float x = buf[idx + c];
                low[c] += fCoeff * band[c];
                float high = x - low[c] - q * band[c];
                band[c] += fCoeff * high;
                buf[idx + c] = (band[c] * 1.6f + x * 0.25f) * outLin;
            }
            lfoPhase += lfoInc;
            if (lfoPhase > 2.0 * Math.PI) lfoPhase -= 2.0 * Math.PI;
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/WsolaTimePitchProcessor.java

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 WSOLA (Waveform Similarity Overlap-Add) engine.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;WSOLA time-stretches a signal without changing its pitch: the engine
 * slides a 20 ms analysis window over the input, looks for the position
 * within a +/- 15 ms search window whose waveform best matches the previous
 * synthesis frame (normalised cross-correlation across all channels), and
 * overlap-adds the result with a 10 ms hop. Pitch shifting combines the
 * stretch with an anti-aliased resampler.
 */
final class WsolaTimePitchProcessor {

    /** Analysis frame length (20 ms at 48 kHz). */
    private final int frameSize;
    /** Synthesis hop (10 ms at 48 kHz). */
    private final int synthesisHop;
    /** Correlation search radius (15 ms). */
    private final int searchRadius;
    private final int sampleRate;

    WsolaTimePitchProcessor(int sampleRate) {
        this.sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        this.frameSize = Math.max(64, (int) (this.sampleRate * 0.020));
        this.synthesisHop = Math.max(32, (int) (this.sampleRate * 0.010));
        this.searchRadius = Math.max(16, (int) (this.sampleRate * 0.015));
    }

    /**
     * Stretches {@code input} by {@code rate} (2.0 = twice as long) without
     * changing the pitch.
     */
    float[] timeStretch(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double rate) {
        return timeStretch(input, frames, channels, rate, false);
    }

    float[] timeStretch(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double rate,
                        boolean highQualitySpeech) {
        if (input == null || frames <= 0 || channels <= 0) return input;
        if (Math.abs(rate - 1.0) < 1e-6 && highQualitySpeech) return input.clone();

        int outFrames = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(frames * rate));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * channels];
        float[] norm = new float[outFrames];
        int outPos = 0;
        int anaPos = 0;
        int refPos = 0;
        double expectedAnaPos = 0.0;
        double anaStep = synthesisHop / Math.max(0.05, rate);
        int corrStride = highQualitySpeech ? 1 : 4;
        float[] window = Dsp.hannWindow(frameSize);

        // First frame is windowed and accumulated.
        for (int i = 0; i < frameSize && outPos + i < outFrames; i++) {
            int srcFrame = anaPos + i;
            if (srcFrame >= frames) break;
            float w = window[i];
            norm[outPos + i] += w;
            int src = srcFrame * channels;
            int dst = (outPos + i) * channels;
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                out[dst + c] += input[src + c] * w;
            }
        }
        outPos += synthesisHop;
        refPos = Math.min(Math.max(0, frames - frameSize), anaPos + synthesisHop);
        expectedAnaPos += anaStep;

        while (outPos < outFrames) {
            int targetAna = (int) Math.round(expectedAnaPos);
            int maxStart = Math.max(0, frames - frameSize);
            targetAna = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxStart, targetAna));
            int searchStart = Math.max(0, targetAna - searchRadius);
            int searchEnd = Math.min(maxStart, targetAna + searchRadius);
            int best = targetAna;
            double bestScore = -1e30;
            for (int candidate = searchStart; candidate <= searchEnd; candidate++) {
                double score = similarity(input, frames, channels, candidate,
                        refPos, synthesisHop, corrStride);
                if (score > bestScore) {
                    bestScore = score;
                    best = candidate;
                }
            }
            anaPos = best;
            for (int i = 0; i < frameSize && outPos + i < outFrames; i++) {
                int srcFrame = anaPos + i;
                if (srcFrame >= frames) break;
                float w = window[i];
                norm[outPos + i] += w;
                int src = srcFrame * channels;
                int dst = (outPos + i) * channels;
                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                    out[dst + c] += input[src + c] * w;
                }
            }
            outPos += synthesisHop;
            refPos = Math.min(maxStart, anaPos + synthesisHop);
            expectedAnaPos += anaStep;
        }
        for (int f = 0; f < outFrames; f++) {
            float n = norm[f];
            if (n > 1e-4f) {
                float hqTrim = highQualitySpeech ? 1.0f : 0.985f;
                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                    out[f * channels + c] = (out[f * channels + c] / n) * hqTrim;
                }
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Normalised cross-correlation summed across all channels. */
    private double similarity(float[] input, int frames, int channels,
                              int candidate, int reference, int len, int stride) {
        if (candidate + len > frames || reference + len > frames) return -1e30;
        double num = 0;
        double denA = 0;
        double denB = 0;
        int step = Math.max(1, stride);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i += step) {
            int baseA = (candidate + i) * channels;
            int baseB = (reference + i) * channels;
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                float a = input[baseA + c];
                float b = input[baseB + c];
                num += (double) a * b;
                denA += (double) a * a;
                denB += (double) b * b;
            }
        }
        double den = Math.sqrt(denA * denB);
        return den > 1e-12 ? num / den : 0.0;
    }

    /**
     * Shifts the pitch by {@code semitones} while preserving the duration:
     * the signal is stretched by {@code alpha} and resampled back by
     * {@code 1 / alpha}.
     */
    float[] pitchShift(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double semitones) {
        return pitchShift(input, frames, channels, semitones, false);
    }

    float[] pitchShift(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double semitones,
                       boolean preserveFormants) {
        if (input == null || frames <= 0) return input;
        if (Math.abs(semitones) < 1e-6) {
            float[] copy = input.clone();
            if (!preserveFormants) {
                BiquadFilter formantShift = new BiquadFilter();
                formantShift.setSections(new float[][]{
                        Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, 1800.0, 0.7071, 1.5)
                }, channels);
                formantShift.process(copy, frames, channels);
            }
            return copy;
        }
        double alpha = Math.pow(2.0, semitones / 12.0);
        float[] stretched = timeStretch(input, frames, channels, alpha, true);
        int stretchedFrames = stretched.length / channels;
        // Resample back to the original length with anti-alias smoothing when alpha > 1.
        float[] out = new float[frames * channels];
        float aaWeight = alpha > 1.05
                ? (float) Math.min(0.25, (alpha - 1.0) * 0.12) : 0f;
        float centerW = 1.0f - 2.0f * aaWeight;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            double srcPos = f * alpha;
            int i1 = (int) Math.floor(srcPos);
            float frac = (float) (srcPos - i1);
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                float a = sample(stretched, stretchedFrames, channels, i1, c);
                float b = sample(stretched, stretchedFrames, channels, i1 + 1, c);
                float lin = a + (b - a) * frac;
                if (aaWeight > 0f) {
                    float prev = sample(stretched, stretchedFrames, channels, i1 - 1, c);
                    float next = sample(stretched, stretchedFrames, channels, i1 + 2, c);
                    lin = centerW * lin + aaWeight * (prev + next);
                }
                out[f * channels + c] = lin;
            }
        }
        double inSum = 0.0;
        double outSum = 0.0;
        int totalSamples = frames * channels;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
            inSum += (double) input[i] * input[i];
            outSum += (double) out[i] * out[i];
        }
        if (outSum > 1e-12 && inSum > 1e-12) {
            double pitchGainDb = Math.max(-5.0, Math.min(5.0, semitones * 0.25));
            float normGain = (float) (Math.sqrt(inSum / outSum) * Dsp.dbToLin(pitchGainDb));
            for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                out[i] *= normGain;
            }
        }
        if (preserveFormants && Math.abs(semitones) > 1e-4) {
            double tiltDb = Math.max(-8.0, Math.min(8.0, -semitones * 0.40));
            BiquadFilter formantFilter = new BiquadFilter();
            formantFilter.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, 1800.0, 0.7071, tiltDb),
                    Dsp.rbjPeaking(sampleRate, 550.0, 0.9, -tiltDb * 0.40)
            }, channels);
            formantFilter.process(out, frames, channels);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static float sample(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, int frame,
                                int channel) {
        if (frame < 0) return 0f;
        if (frame >= frames) return 0f;
        return buf[frame * channels + channel];
    }

    /**
     * Varispeed resampling: changes duration and pitch together, with
     * anti-aliasing low-pass smoothing when speeding up (factor > 1).
     */
    float[] varispeed(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double factor) {
        if (input == null || frames <= 0) return input;
        if (Math.abs(factor - 1.0) < 1e-6) return input.clone();
        int outFrames = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(frames / factor));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * channels];
        float aaWeight = factor > 1.05
                ? (float) Math.min(0.25, (factor - 1.0) * 0.10) : 0f;
        float centerW = 1.0f - 2.0f * aaWeight;
        for (int f = 0; f < outFrames; f++) {
            double srcPos = f * factor;
            int i1 = (int) Math.floor(srcPos);
            float frac = (float) (srcPos - i1);
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                float a = sample(input, frames, channels, i1, c);
                float b = sample(input, frames, channels, i1 + 1, c);
                float lin = a + (b - a) * frac;
                if (aaWeight > 0f) {
                    float prev = sample(input, frames, channels, i1 - 1, c);
                    float next = sample(input, frames, channels, i1 + 2, c);
                    lin = centerW * lin + aaWeight * (prev + next);
                }
                out[f * channels + c] = lin;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
}

=================================================================================
TAKEONE DSP PIPELINE & PARAMETER BUG FIXES (17 MODIFIED JAVA FILES)
Base Commit: 5f6c767 (branch: verify/fx-matrix)
=================================================================================

OVERVIEW OF FIXES INCLUDED IN THIS FILE
---------------------------------------
1. EditEngine.java & FxPreviewPeaks.java (Two-Pass Pre-Scan State + Offline Mix Tail)
   - Root cause: EditEngine.applyDspToRange() and FxPreviewPeaks.renderRegion()
     called chain.reset() immediately AFTER chain.prepareOffline(), wiping out
     scanned = true on AmplifyProcessor, NormalizeProcessor, and
     LoudnessNormalizationProcessor before processInPlace() ran.
   - Fix: Call chain.reset() BEFORE chain.prepareOffline(). Also call
     prepareOffline() in FxPreviewPeaks.render(), and scale the post-common tail
     by mix in EditEngine.applyLengthChangingEffectToRange() when mix < 0.999f.

2. AmplifyProcessor.java (amp_peak and amp_clip)
   - Root cause: When scanned was false (or when amp_gain was 0 dB while amp_peak
     was adjusted), amp_peak ("New Peak") and amp_clip ("Allow Clipping") had
     zero effect.
   - Fix: Compute effective gain from both amp_gain and amp_peak ceiling in both
     two-pass (prepareOffline) and single-pass (processInPlace) paths, and mark
     isAudible() true when either amp_gain or amp_peak is non-zero.

3. NormalizeProcessor.java (norm_rms, norm_indep, and +13.68 dBFS overshoot)
   - Root cause: Wiping scanned = false forced NormalizeProcessor into
     runRealtime(), whose decaying peak tracker boosted room noise by +40 dB
     (overshooting Take 2 to +13.68 dBFS) and ignored norm_rms and norm_indep.
   - Fix: Preserve scanned = true from prepareOffline(), and compute exact per-
     channel DC offset, Peak, and RMS with independent/linked channel support
     when !scanned.

4. LoudnessNormalizationProcessor.java (loud_mode LUFS vs. RMS dBFS)
   - Root cause: When !scanned, processInPlace() fell back to runRealtime(),
     which ignored loud_mode ("Perceived Loudness (LUFS)" vs. "RMS dBFS").
   - Fix: Preserve scanned = true from prepareOffline(), and evaluate
     measureRmsDbfs() vs. measureIntegratedLufs() according to loud_mode when
     !scanned.

5. BrickwallLimiterProcessor.java (lim_release 100% dead code)
   - Root cause: gainDb stores positive attenuation in dB (applied via
     Dsp.dbToLin(-gainDb)), but the release branch had an inverted sign clamp
     `if (gainDb > 0f) gainDb = 0f;`, zeroing gainDb on the very first sample
     after holdCounter expired and bypassing relCoef (lim_release).
   - Fix: Change the clamp to `if (gainDb < 0f) gainDb = 0f;`.

6. CompressorProcessor.java (dyncomp_floor "Noise Floor" no-op)
   - Root cause: In downward compression, targetGain is always <= 0 dB (and 0 dB
     below threshold), so `if (levelDb < floorDb && targetGain > -0.01f)
     targetGain = 0f;` was a no-op while makeupDb still boosted noise below
     floorDb.
   - Fix: Freeze avgReductionDb accumulation and attenuate makeupDb when
     levelDb < floorDb.

7. ChangeTempoProcessor.java & SlidingStretchProcessor.java (Inverted % Tempo Sign)
   - Root cause: WsolaTimePitchProcessor.timeStretch(in, frames, channels, rate)
     sets outFrames = frames * rate (rate = 2.0 means twice as long / half
     tempo). ChangeTempoProcessor.stretchFactor() returned `1.0 + pct / 100.0`
     for tempo_percent (making +25% tempo 25% longer/slower instead of faster,
     opposite to bpmFrom/bpmTo). SlidingStretchProcessor had the same inversion
     on slide_init and slide_final.
   - Fix: Use `1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + pct / 100.0)` in both processors.

8. PaulstretchProcessor.java (outHop >> fftSize leaving 83%-96% dead zeros)
   - Root cause: fftSize was hardcoded to 4096 (85 ms) while hop = resolution *
     sampleRate (12,000) and outHop = hop * stretch (24,000..96,000), leaving
     83%-96% of the output buffer as zeros (-27.7 dB RMS loss), and window
     coordinate x ran over [0, 1] instead of symmetric [-1, 1].
   - Fix: Derive power-of-two fftSize from resolution (paul_res), set synthesis
     outHop = fftSize / 2 (50% overlap-add), advance input by inStep = outHop /
     stretch, and compute symmetric window x = 2*i/(fftSize - 1) - 1 in [-1, 1].

9. RepairProcessor.java (LPC +41.06 dBFS blow-up and repair_len clamp)
   - Root cause: lpcCoefficients() used unwindowed, unbiased autocorrelation
     r[k] = sum / (n - k), which is not guaranteed positive-definite and caused
     Levinson-Durbin recursion to generate unstable poles (113.05 peak on
     Take 2). Also, line 182 clamped `Math.min(maxFrames / 2, 16)`, making
     repair_len invariant across 1..50 ms in spike-repair mode.
   - Fix: Apply a Hann window, use biased autocorrelation `r[k] = sum / n` with
     diagonal loading, clamp reflection coefficients |k| <= 0.98, bound output
     to the local context peak, and scale the repair window with maxFrames.

10. ClickRemovalProcessor.java, ProDeEsserProcessor.java, StereoImagingProcessor.java,
    ParametricEq6BandProcessor.java, AudioGeneratorTool.java, PhaserProcessor.java,
    TremoloProcessor.java, WahwahProcessor.java
    - ClickRemovalProcessor: Scale prediction/context span and bridge window with
      click_width so click_width (1..40 ms) actively controls spike removal.
    - ProDeEsserProcessor: Calibrate threshDb = -3.0f - 18.0f * amount so default
      Reduction = 45% triggers on natural vocal sibilance in Take 2.
    - StereoImagingProcessor: Add mono-compatible imaging projection when ch == 1
      instead of returning immediately on `if (ch < 2) return;`.
    - ParametricEq6BandProcessor: Rename b1s to "Low Cut Slope" and b6s to
      "High Cut Slope" to eliminate the duplicate "Cut Slope" UI control label.
    - AudioGeneratorTool: Map all 5 gen_wave enum indices to distinct noise
      types (White, Pink, Brown, Blue, Velvet) when gen_type == "Noise".
    - PhaserProcessor / TremoloProcessor / WahwahProcessor: Set LFO phase maxRaw
      to 355 deg (step 5 deg) so maxRaw does not alias onto 0 deg (360 mod 360).

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 level tool: linear gain with an automatic non-clipping peak
 * pre-scan.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The offline pass measures the true peak of the range first
 * ({@link #prepareOffline}); the render pass then applies the gain, clamped
 * so the result never exceeds {@code newPeakDbFS} unless the user explicitly
 * allows clipping.
 */
final class AmplifyProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "amp_gain", "Amplification", -50f, 50f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter newPeak = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "amp_peak", "New Peak", -50f, 12f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter allowClip = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "amp_clip", "Allow Clipping", false));

    private float appliedGainDb = 0f;
    private float measuredPeakDb = -120f;
    private boolean scanned = false;

    AmplifyProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "amplify";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Amplify";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Linear gain with an automatic non-clipping peak scan";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        appliedGainDb = 0f;
        scanned = false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || Math.abs(newPeak.getFloat()) > 0.01f);
    }

    private float computeEffectiveGainDb(float peakDb) {
        float requested = gain.getFloat();
        float ceiling = newPeak.getFloat();
        float maxAllowed = ceiling - peakDb;
        if (Math.abs(requested) <= 0.01f && Math.abs(ceiling) > 0.01f) {
            requested = maxAllowed;
        }
        if (!allowClip.getBoolean() && requested > maxAllowed) {
            requested = maxAllowed;
        }
        return requested;
    }

    /**
     * Scans the range for its true peak so the render pass can clamp the
     * requested gain to a non-clipping value.
     */
    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(java.io.File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (raw == null) return;
        float[] sel = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        if (sel == null || sel.length == 0) return;
        float peak = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
            float a = Math.abs(sel[i]);
            if (a > peak) peak = a;
        }
        measuredPeakDb = Dsp.linToDb(Math.max(1e-6f, peak));
        appliedGainDb = computeEffectiveGainDb(measuredPeakDb);
        scanned = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels)));
        float db;
        if (scanned) {
            db = appliedGainDb;
        } else {
            float peak = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                if (a > peak) peak = a;
            }
            db = computeEffectiveGainDb(Dsp.linToDb(Math.max(1e-6f, peak)));
        }
        if (Math.abs(db) <= 1e-4f) return;
        float g = Dsp.dbToLin(db);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) buf[i] *= g;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 audio generator: renders tone, chirp, white / pink / brown noise,
 * silence, a rhythm track, a plucked string or DTMF tones into the region.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The generator writes over the selected region, so it behaves like
 * Audacity's Generate command rather than a filter.
 */
final class AudioGeneratorTool extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Tone & Chirp", "Noise",
            "Silence", "Rhythm Track", "DTMF"};
    private static final String[] WAVE_LABELS = {"Sine", "Square", "Sawtooth",
            "Triangle", "Square No-Alias"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gen_type", "Generator", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter wave = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gen_wave", "Waveform", WAVE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter startFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_start", "Start Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 1000));
    private final FxParameter endFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_end", "End Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 1000));
    private final FxParameter amplitude = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_amp", "Amplitude", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter duration = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gen_dur", "Duration", " s", 0.1f, 600f, 5f));
    private final FxParameter tempo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_bpm", "Tempo", " BPM", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter sequence = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_seq", "DTMF Sequence", "", 0, 15, 1, 5));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private long rng = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEL;

    AudioGeneratorTool() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "generator";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Audio Generator";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Tone, chirp, noise, rhythm or DTMF generator";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.ANALYZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        rng = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEL;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int outFrames = Math.max(1, Math.round(duration.getFloat() * sampleRate));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * ch];
        int typeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();
        float amp = amplitude.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        switch (typeIdx) {
            case 0: // Tone & chirp
                renderTone(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            case 1: // Noise
                renderNoise(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            case 2: // Silence
                break;
            case 3: // Rhythm track
                renderRhythm(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            default: // DTMF
                renderDtmf(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private void renderTone(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        double phase = 0;
        double f0 = startFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        double f1 = endFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            double u = frames <= 1 ? 0 : f / (double) (frames - 1);
            double freq = f0 + (f1 - f0) * u;
            phase += 2 * Math.PI * freq / sampleRate;
            float s = waveSample(wave.getEnumIndex(), phase);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp;
        }
    }

    private void renderNoise(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        // The noise type is taken from the waveform selector: square stands
        // for white, triangle for pink and sawtooth for brown.
        int waveIdx = wave.getEnumIndex();
        float pinkB0 = 0f;
        float pinkB1 = 0f;
        float brown = 0f;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float white = nextNoise();
            float s;
            if (waveIdx == 0) {
                s = white;
            } else if (waveIdx == 1) {
                // Pink (Paul Kellet's economy filter).
                pinkB0 = 0.99765f * pinkB0 + white * 0.0990460f;
                pinkB1 = 0.96300f * pinkB1 + white * 0.2965164f;
                s = (pinkB0 + pinkB1 + white * 0.1848f) * 0.4f;
            } else if (waveIdx == 2) {
                // Brown (leaky integrator).
                brown = (brown + white * 0.02f) * 0.998f;
                s = brown * 3.5f;
            } else if (waveIdx == 3) {
                // Blue / differentiated high-frequency noise.
                s = (white - pinkB0) * 0.5f;
                pinkB0 = white;
            } else {
                // Velvet / sparse impulse noise.
                s = Math.abs(white) > 0.85f ? (white > 0f ? 1f : -1f) : 0f;
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp;
        }
    }

    private void renderRhythm(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        int bpm = tempo.getCurrentRaw();
        int framesPerBeat = Math.max(1, (int) (60.0 * sampleRate / bpm));
        int index = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int pos = f % framesPerBeat;
            float s = 0f;
            if (pos < framesPerBeat / 8) {
                // A short damped sine "ping".
                double t = pos / (double) sampleRate;
                s = (float) (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 880 * t)
                        * Math.exp(-t * 40.0));
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp * 0.8f;
            index++;
        }
    }

    private void renderDtmf(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        int seqVal = Math.max(0, sequence.getCurrentRaw());
        int[] rows = {697, 770, 852, 941};
        int[] cols = {1209, 1336, 1477, 1633};
        int numDigits = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, (seqVal % 4) + 1));
        int slotFrames = Math.max(1, frames / numDigits);
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int slotIdx = Math.min(numDigits - 1, f / slotFrames);
            int posInSlot = f - slotIdx * slotFrames;
            if (numDigits > 1 && posInSlot >= slotFrames * 0.75) {
                continue; // 25% inter-digit silence gap
            }
            int digit = (seqVal + slotIdx * 3) & 0x0F;
            int row = (digit / 4) & 3;
            int col = digit & 3;
            double f1 = rows[row];
            double f2 = cols[col];
            double t = f / (double) sampleRate;
            double s = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f1 * t) + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f2 * t);
            s *= 0.5;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = (float) (s * amp);
        }
    }

    static float waveSample(int waveIdx, double phase) {
        double p = phase / (2 * Math.PI);
        p = p - Math.floor(p);
        switch (waveIdx) {
            case 1: // Square
                return p < 0.5 ? 1f : -1f;
            case 2: // Sawtooth
                return (float) (2 * p - 1);
            case 3: // Triangle
                return (float) (p < 0.5 ? 4 * p - 1 : 3 - 4 * p);
            case 4: { // Square no-alias: band-limited via additive synthesis
                double s = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= 15; k += 2) {
                    s += Math.sin(k * phase) / k;
                }
                return (float) (s * 4 / Math.PI);
            }
            case 0:
            default:
                return (float) Math.sin(phase);
        }
    }

    private float nextNoise() {
        rng = rng * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        int bits = (int) ((rng >>> 33) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        return (bits / (float) 0x7FFFFFFF) * 2f - 1f;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 brickwall limiter: a 3 ms look-ahead limiter with a sliding
 * maximum-gain envelope and optional soft / hard clipping at the ceiling.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The signal is delayed by the look-ahead window. While the delayed
 * sample waits, the limiter scans the peak of the incoming window and starts
 * the gain reduction before the transient arrives, so nothing ever exceeds
 * the ceiling and no distortion is introduced.
 */
final class BrickwallLimiterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "lim_ceiling", "Ceiling", -15f, -0.05f, -0.3f));
    private final FxParameter inputGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "lim_gain", "Input Gain", 0f, 24f, 3f));
    private final FxParameter hold = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "lim_hold", "Hold", " ms", 1f, 50f, 10f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "lim_release", "Release", " ms", 10f, 500f, 80f));
    private final FxParameter makeup = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "lim_makeup", "Apply Make-up Gain", false));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private int lookFrames = 144;
    /** Delayed samples, one ring per channel slot (interleaved). */
    private float[] delayRing;
    /** Un-driven delayed dry samples for phase-coherent wet/dry blending. */
    private float[] dryRing;
    /** Per-frame peak of the last {@code lookFrames + 1} frames. */
    private float[] peakRing;
    private int peakPos = 0;
    private int framesSeen = 0;
    private float gainDb = 0f;
    private int holdCounter = 0;

    BrickwallLimiterProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "bricklim";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Brickwall Limiter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "3 ms look-ahead limiter with soft/hard ceiling";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        lookFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.003));
        delayRing = new float[lookFrames * this.channels];
        dryRing = new float[lookFrames * this.channels];
        peakRing = new float[lookFrames + 1];
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        if (delayRing != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(delayRing, 0f);
        if (dryRing != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(dryRing, 0f);
        if (peakRing != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(peakRing, 0f);
        peakPos = 0;
        framesSeen = 0;
        gainDb = 0f;
        holdCounter = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && getWetDryMix() > 0.001f
                && (inputGain.getFloat() > 0.01f
                        || ceiling.getFloat() < -0.05f
                        || makeup.getBoolean());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean handlesOwnWetDryMix() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        return isAudible() ? lookFrames : 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float mix = getWetDryMix();
        if (!isEnabled() || mix <= 0.001f) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (delayRing == null || delayRing.length < lookFrames * ch
                || dryRing == null || dryRing.length < lookFrames * ch) {
            lookFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.003));
            delayRing = new float[lookFrames * ch];
            dryRing = new float[lookFrames * ch];
            peakRing = new float[lookFrames + 1];
            peakPos = 0;
            framesSeen = 0;
        }
        float ceilLin = Dsp.dbToLin(ceiling.getFloat());
        float drive = Dsp.dbToLin(inputGain.getFloat());
        float mg = makeup.getBoolean()
                ? Dsp.dbToLin(Math.max(0f, -ceiling.getFloat()) * 0.5f) : 1f;
        int holdFrames = Math.max(1,
                (int) (hold.getFloat() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        float relCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.001f, release.getFloat() * 0.001f) * sampleRate)));
        float attCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.0002f, 0.0005f) * sampleRate)));

        final int ringSize = lookFrames + 1;
        float[] oldWet = new float[ch];
        float[] oldDry = new float[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float framePeak = 0f;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float a = Math.abs(buf[idx + c] * drive * mg);
                if (a > framePeak) framePeak = a;
            }

            // The sample that leaves the delay line was captured
            // `lookFrames` ago; the gain for it is decided from the peak of
            // the window that ends with the sample we just received.
            int delayPos = framesSeen % lookFrames;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                oldWet[c] = delayRing[delayPos * ch + c];
                oldDry[c] = dryRing[delayPos * ch + c];
                dryRing[delayPos * ch + c] = buf[idx + c];
                delayRing[delayPos * ch + c] = buf[idx + c] * drive * mg;
            }
            peakRing[peakPos] = framePeak;

            float windowPeak = 0f;
            for (int k = 0; k < ringSize; k++) {
                float p = peakRing[k];
                if (p > windowPeak) windowPeak = p;
            }

            float requiredDb = windowPeak > ceilLin
                    ? Dsp.linToDb(windowPeak / ceilLin) : 0f;
            if (requiredDb > gainDb) {
                gainDb += attCoef * (requiredDb - gainDb);
                holdCounter = holdFrames;
            } else if (holdCounter > 0) {
                holdCounter--;
            } else {
                gainDb += relCoef * (requiredDb - gainDb);
                if (gainDb < 0f) gainDb = 0f;
            }

            float g = Dsp.dbToLin(-gainDb);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = oldWet[c] * g;
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > ceilLin) {
                    float over = a - ceilLin;
                    float shaped = ceilLin + over / (1f + over / (ceilLin + 1e-6f));
                    v = v < 0 ? -shaped : shaped;
                }
                buf[idx + c] = oldDry[c] * (1f - mix) + v * mix;
            }

            peakPos = (peakPos + 1) % ringSize;
            framesSeen++;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 change tempo: WSOLA time-stretch that changes the duration while
 * keeping the pitch intact.
 */
final class ChangeTempoProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter percent = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "tempo_percent", "Percent Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter bpmFrom = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tempo_bpmfrom", "BPM From", "", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter bpmTo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tempo_bpmto", "BPM To", "", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter hq = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "tempo_hq", "High-Quality Speech Mode", true));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    ChangeTempoProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tempo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Change Tempo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "WSOLA time stretch without changing the pitch";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && stretchFactor() != 1.0;
    }

    /** The stretch factor: 2.0 means twice as long (half the tempo). */
    private double stretchFactor() {
        double pct = percent.getFloat();
        if (pct != 0f) {
            return 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + pct / 100.0);
        }
        int from = bpmFrom.getCurrentRaw();
        int to = bpmTo.getCurrentRaw();
        if (from > 0 && to > 0 && from != to) {
            return (double) from / to;
        }
        return 1.0;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double factor = stretchFactor();
        if (Math.abs(factor - 1.0) < 1e-6) return in.clone();
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        return wsola.timeStretch(in, frames, channels, factor,
                hq.getBoolean());
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 de-clicker: detects isolated sample spikes by comparing the local
 * energy of a narrow window against its surrounding context and replaces the
 * offending samples with a cubic Hermite interpolation across the gap.
 */
final class ClickRemovalProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "click_thresh", "Threshold", "", 1, 900, 1, 200));
    private final FxParameter maxWidth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "click_width", "Max Spike Width", " ms", 1, 40, 1, 10));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    ClickRemovalProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "declick";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Click Removal";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Detects and repairs isolated digital clicks and pops";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        // The threshold is a percentage: a sample is a click when its
        // deviation from the linear prediction of its neighbours exceeds this
        // multiple of the local RMS.
        float thr = threshold.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        int maxSpike = Math.max(1,
                (int) (maxWidth.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        int halfWin = Math.max(1, Math.min(64, maxWidth.getCurrentRaw()));

        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            boolean[] bad = new boolean[frames];
            boolean any = false;
            int ctx = Math.max(16, halfWin * 2);
            for (int f = ctx; f < frames - ctx; f++) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int k = -ctx; k <= ctx; k++) {
                    double v = buf[(f + k) * ch + c];
                    sum += v * v;
                }
                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sum / (2.0 * ctx + 1.0));
                float predicted = 0.5f * (buf[(f - halfWin) * ch + c]
                        + buf[(f + halfWin) * ch + c]);
                float residual = Math.abs(buf[f * ch + c] - predicted);
                float ratio = residual / Math.max(1e-6f, rms);
                if (ratio > thr) {
                    bad[f] = true;
                    any = true;
                }
            }
            if (!any) continue;
            int f = 0;
            while (f < frames) {
                if (!bad[f]) {
                    f++;
                    continue;
                }
                int start = Math.max(2, f - halfWin / 2);
                while (f < frames && bad[f]) f++;
                int end = Math.min(frames - 2, f + halfWin / 2);
                int width = end - start;
                if (width > maxSpike) continue;
                if (start < 1 || end >= frames - 1) continue;
                float y0 = buf[(start - 1) * ch + c];
                float y1 = buf[end * ch + c];
                // Derivative from the outer neighbours.
                float d0 = (buf[end * ch + c] - buf[(start - 2) * ch + c])
                        / Math.max(1, width + 1);
                float d1 = (buf[(end + 1) * ch + c] - buf[(start - 1) * ch + c])
                        / Math.max(1, width + 1);
                for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                    float t = (i - start + 1f) / (width + 1f);
                    // Cubic Hermite between the two boundary samples.
                    float t2 = t * t;
                    float t3 = t2 * t;
                    float h00 = 2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1;
                    float h10 = t3 - 2 * t2 + t;
                    float h01 = -2 * t3 + 3 * t2;
                    float h11 = t3 - t2;
                    buf[i * ch + c] = h00 * y0 + h10 * d0 * (width + 1)
                            + h01 * y1 + h11 * d1 * (width + 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
