package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 level tool: peak / RMS normalization with DC-offset removal.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The offline pass measures the per-channel mean and peak of the range
 * (optionally removing the DC offset before measuring the peak), then the
 * render pass subtracts the offset and applies the exact gain. When the
 * stereo channels are linked the quieter channel dictates the gain so the
 * image stays balanced.
 */
final class NormalizeProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter target = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "norm_target", "Target Peak", -60f, 0f, -1f));
    private final FxParameter removeDc = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_dc", "Remove DC Offset", true));
    private final FxParameter normalizePeak = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_peak", "Normalize Peak", true));
    private final FxParameter independent = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_indep", "Independent Channels", false));
    private final FxParameter normalizeRms = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_rms", "Normalize RMS", false));

    private float[] dcOffset = new float[2];
    private float[] gainLin = new float[]{1f, 1f};
    private boolean scanned = false;
    // Real-time fallback state (no pre-scan available).
    private float[] realtimePeak = new float[2];
    private float[] realtimeGain = new float[]{1f, 1f};
    private float[] dcState = new float[2];
    private float[] prevIn = new float[2];

    NormalizeProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "normalize";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Normalize";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Peak or RMS normalization with DC-offset removal";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scanned = false;
        gainLin[0] = 1f;
        gainLin[1] = 1f;
        dcOffset[0] = 0f;
        dcOffset[1] = 0f;
        realtimePeak[0] = realtimePeak[1] = 0f;
        realtimeGain[0] = realtimeGain[1] = 1f;
        dcState[0] = dcState[1] = 0f;
        prevIn[0] = prevIn[1] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(java.io.File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (raw == null) return;
        float[] sel = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        if (sel == null || sel.length == 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int frames = sel.length / ch;
        if (frames <= 0) return;

        double[] mean = new double[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) mean[c] += sel[f * ch + c];
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) mean[c] /= frames;

        float[] peak = new float[ch];
        double[] sumSq = new double[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = sel[f * ch + c] - (float) mean[c];
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > peak[c]) peak[c] = a;
                sumSq[c] += (double) v * v;
            }
        }
        float[] rms = new float[ch];
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            rms[c] = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq[c] / frames);
        }

        float targetLin = Dsp.dbToLin(target.getFloat());
        float[] g = new float[ch];
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            if (normalizeRms.getBoolean()) {
                g[c] = rms[c] > 1e-9f ? targetLin / rms[c] : 1f;
            } else if (normalizePeak.getBoolean()) {
                g[c] = peak[c] > 1e-9f ? targetLin / peak[c] : 1f;
            } else {
                g[c] = 1f;
            }
        }
        if (!independent.getBoolean()) {
            float min = g[0];
            for (int c = 1; c < ch; c++) min = Math.min(min, g[c]);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) g[c] = min;
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            gainLin[c] = g[c];
            dcOffset[c] = removeDc.getBoolean() ? (float) mean[c] : 0f;
        }
        scanned = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (!scanned) {
            // Compute exact DC offset, peak and RMS on the buffer when no
            // offline file pre-scan was run (e.g. unit matrix or live block).
            double[] mean = new double[ch];
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) mean[c] += buf[f * ch + c];
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) mean[c] /= frames;
            float[] peak = new float[ch];
            double[] sumSq = new double[ch];
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float v = buf[f * ch + c] - (float) mean[c];
                    float a = Math.abs(v);
                    if (a > peak[c]) peak[c] = a;
                    sumSq[c] += (double) v * v;
                }
            }
            float targetLin = Dsp.dbToLin(target.getFloat());
            float[] g = new float[ch];
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq[c] / frames);
                if (normalizeRms.getBoolean()) {
                    g[c] = rms > 1e-9f ? targetLin / rms : 1f;
                } else if (normalizePeak.getBoolean()) {
                    g[c] = peak[c] > 1e-9f ? targetLin / peak[c] : 1f;
                } else {
                    g[c] = 1f;
                }
            }
            if (!independent.getBoolean()) {
                float min = g[0];
                for (int c = 1; c < ch; c++) min = Math.min(min, g[c]);
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) g[c] = min;
            }
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                int idx = f * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float dc = removeDc.getBoolean() ? (float) mean[c] : 0f;
                    buf[idx + c] = (buf[idx + c] - dc) * g[c];
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[idx + c] - dcOffset[c];
                buf[idx + c] = v * gainLin[c];
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Real-time fallback: tracks a decaying peak estimate per channel and
     * eases the gain towards {@code target / peak}. The DC offset is
     * removed with a one-pole high-pass so it works without a pre-scan.
     */
    private void runRealtime(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        float targetLin = Dsp.dbToLin(target.getFloat());
        final int block = 64;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] peak = new float[ch];
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float v = buf[(offset + f) * ch + c];
                    float a = Math.abs(v);
                    if (a > peak[c]) peak[c] = a;
                }
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                // The peak estimate decays so a transient does not pin the
                // gain down for the rest of the take.
                realtimePeak[c] = Math.max(peak[c], realtimePeak[c] * 0.9995f);
                float target = realtimePeak[c] > 1e-6f
                        ? targetLin / realtimePeak[c] : 1f;
                if (!normalizePeak.getBoolean() && !normalizeRms.getBoolean()) {
                    target = 1f;
                }
                realtimeGain[c] += (target - realtimeGain[c]) * 0.05f;
            }
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float v = buf[idx + c];
                    // One-pole DC blocker.
                    dcState[c] = 0.995f * (dcState[c] + v - prevIn[c]);
                    prevIn[c] = v;
                    float out = removeDc.getBoolean() ? dcState[c] : v;
                    buf[idx + c] = out * realtimeGain[c];
                }
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Stage 3 · A1: Fairlight-style 6-band parametric EQ. Band 1 is a low cut
 * (12/24/36/48 dB per octave), bands 2 and 5 switch between bell and shelf,
 * bands 3 and 4 are bells, band 6 is a high cut. Every knob drives a
 * recomputed biquad cascade; the primary "Output" knob is the rack dial.
 */
final class ParametricEq6BandProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] CUT_LABELS = {
            "12 dB/oct", "24 dB/oct", "36 dB/oct", "48 dB/oct"};
    private static final String[] SHELF_LABELS = {"Bell", "Shelf"};

    private final FxParameter out = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("out", "Output", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b1f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b1f", "Low Cut", " Hz", 20, 500, 1, 80));
    private final FxParameter b1s = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("b1s", "Low Cut Slope", CUT_LABELS, 1));
    private final FxParameter b2t = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("b2t", "Band 2 Type", SHELF_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter b2f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b2f", "Band 2 Freq", " Hz", 40, 1000, 1, 350));
    private final FxParameter b2g = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("b2g", "Band 2 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b2q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("b2q", "Band 2 Q", "", 0.1f, 12f, 0.7f));
    private final FxParameter b3f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b3f", "Band 3 Freq", " Hz", 100, 2000, 1, 800));
    private final FxParameter b3g = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("b3g", "Band 3 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b3q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("b3q", "Band 3 Q", "", 0.1f, 12f, 0.7f));
    private final FxParameter b4f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b4f", "Band 4 Freq", " Hz", 500, 8000, 1, 2500));
    private final FxParameter b4g = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("b4g", "Band 4 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b4q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("b4q", "Band 4 Q", "", 0.1f, 12f, 0.7f));
    private final FxParameter b5t = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("b5t", "Band 5 Type", SHELF_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter b5f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b5f", "Band 5 Freq", " Hz", 1000, 16000, 1, 6500));
    private final FxParameter b5g = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("b5g", "Band 5 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b5q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("b5q", "Band 5 Q", "", 0.1f, 12f, 0.7f));
    private final FxParameter b6f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b6f", "High Cut", " Hz", 4000, 20000, 1, 20000));
    private final FxParameter b6s = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("b6s", "High Cut Slope", CUT_LABELS, 1));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 1;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "eq6";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "6-Band Parametric EQ";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Console EQ: low/high cut plus four musical bell/shelf bands";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sr, int ch) {
        sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sr);
        channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        return b1f.getCurrentRaw() > 20 || b6f.getCurrentRaw() < 20000
                || out.getCurrentRaw() != 0
                || Math.abs(b2g.getFloat()) >= 0.01f
                || Math.abs(b3g.getFloat()) >= 0.01f
                || Math.abs(b4g.getFloat()) >= 0.01f
                || Math.abs(b5g.getFloat()) >= 0.01f;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        this.channels = c;
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), c);
        filter.process(buf, frames, c);
    }

    private static final float[] IDENTITY = {1f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f};
    private static final int LOW_SLOTS = 8;
    private static final int HIGH_SLOTS = 8;

    /** Cascade with fixed slots so changing a band never shifts biquad state. */
    float[][] buildSections() {
        // Keep the public design view empty while every band/output is flat;
        // the chain skips an inaudible processor, so no delay lines exist to
        // preserve. As soon as any stage is audible the fixed-slot layout is
        // returned, which is what keeps live band edits from shifting state.
        if (!isAudible()) return new float[0][];
        double sr = sampleRate;
        float[][] secs = new float[LOW_SLOTS + 4 + HIGH_SLOTS + 1][];
        int lowN = b1f.getCurrentRaw() > 20
                ? orderForSlope(b1s.getEnumIndex()) : 0;
        float[][] low = lowN > 0
                ? Dsp.butterworth(lowN, sr, b1f.getFloat(), true)
                : new float[0][];
        for (int i = 0; i < LOW_SLOTS; i++) {
            secs[i] = i < low.length ? low[i] : IDENTITY;
        }
        secs[LOW_SLOTS] = bandSection(b2t.getEnumIndex() == 1, false,
                b2f.getFloat(), b2g.getFloat(), b2q.getFloat());
        secs[LOW_SLOTS + 1] = bandSection(false, false,
                b3f.getFloat(), b3g.getFloat(), b3q.getFloat());
        secs[LOW_SLOTS + 2] = bandSection(false, false,
                b4f.getFloat(), b4g.getFloat(), b4q.getFloat());
        secs[LOW_SLOTS + 3] = bandSection(b5t.getEnumIndex() == 1, true,
                b5f.getFloat(), b5g.getFloat(), b5q.getFloat());
        int highOff = LOW_SLOTS + 4;
        int highN = b6f.getCurrentRaw() < 20000
                ? orderForSlope(b6s.getEnumIndex()) : 0;
        float[][] high = highN > 0
                ? Dsp.butterworth(highN, sr, b6f.getFloat(), false)
                : new float[0][];
        for (int i = 0; i < HIGH_SLOTS; i++) {
            secs[highOff + i] = i < high.length ? high[i] : IDENTITY;
        }
        secs[highOff + HIGH_SLOTS] = Dsp.gainBiquad(Dsp.dbToLin(out.getFloat()));
        return secs;
    }

    private float[] bandSection(boolean shelf, boolean highShelf,
                                double f, double g, double q) {
        if (Math.abs(g) < 0.01) return IDENTITY;
        if (shelf) {
            return highShelf ? Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, f, 1.0, g)
                    : Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sampleRate, f, 1.0, g);
        }
        return Dsp.rbjPeaking(sampleRate, f, q, g);
    }

    private static int orderForSlope(int slopeIndex) {
        switch (slopeIndex) {
            case 0: return 2;
            case 1: return 4;
            case 2: return 6;
            default: return 8;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 Paulstretch: extreme ambient time stretching. A large-window STFT
 * preserves the bin amplitudes but replaces the phases with random angles
 * at every synthesis hop, then blends the frames with a
 * {@code (1 - x^2)^1.25} raised-cosine overlap.
 */
final class PaulstretchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter factor = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "paul_factor", "Stretch Factor", "x", 1.5f, 100f, 8f));
    private final FxParameter resolution = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "paul_res", "Time Resolution", " s", 0.05f, 1f, 0.25f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private long rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;

    PaulstretchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "paulstretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Paulstretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Extreme random-phase ambient time stretch";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && factor.getFloat() > 1.01f;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double stretch = factor.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(stretch - 1.0) < 1e-6) return in.clone();

        int targetWin = Math.max(512, (int) Math.round(resolution.getFloat() * sampleRate));
        int fftSize = 1024;
        while (fftSize < targetWin && fftSize < 8192) fftSize <<= 1;
        int outHop = fftSize / 2;
        double inStep = outHop / Math.max(0.1, stretch);
        int outFrames = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(frames * stretch));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * channels];
        float[] win = new float[fftSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
            float x = (2.0f * i / (fftSize - 1)) - 1.0f;
            win[i] = (float) Math.pow(Math.max(0.0, 1.0 - x * x), 1.25);
        }

        int bins = fftSize / 2 + 1;
        float[] re = new float[fftSize];
        float[] im = new float[fftSize];
        float[] mag = new float[bins];

        for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
            double inPos = 0.0;
            int outPos = 0;
            while (outPos < outFrames) {
                int baseIn = (int) Math.round(inPos);
                for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
                    int src = baseIn + i;
                    float s = (src >= 0 && src < frames) ? in[src * channels + c] : 0f;
                    re[i] = s * win[i];
                    im[i] = 0f;
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, false);
                for (int b = 0; b < bins; b++) {
                    mag[b] = (float) Math.sqrt(re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b]);
                }
                for (int b = 0; b < bins; b++) {
                    float p = (float) (nextRandom() * Math.PI * 2.0);
                    re[b] = (float) (mag[b] * Math.cos(p));
                    im[b] = (float) (mag[b] * Math.sin(p));
                    int mirror = fftSize - b;
                    if (mirror < fftSize) {
                        re[mirror] = re[b];
                        im[mirror] = -im[b];
                    }
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, true);
                for (int i = 0; i < fftSize && outPos + i < outFrames; i++) {
                    out[(outPos + i) * channels + c] += re[i] * win[i] * 0.85f;
                }
                inPos += inStep;
                outPos += outHop;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private double nextRandom() {
        rng = rng * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        int bits = (int) ((rng >>> 33) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        return bits / (double) 0x7FFFFFFF;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 multi-stage all-pass phaser with an LFO sweep, feedback and an
 * output gain trim.
 */
final class PhaserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int[] STAGE_OPTIONS = {2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 24};

    private final FxParameter stages = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "ph_stages", "Stages", new String[]{"2", "4", "6", "8", "10", "12",
                    "16", "24"}, 1));
    private final FxParameter mix = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_mix", "Dry/Wet", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ph_rate", "LFO Frequency", " Hz", 0.05f, 4f, 0.4f));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_phase", "LFO Start Phase", " deg", 0, 355, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 1, 70));
    private final FxParameter feedback = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_fb", "Feedback", "%", -95, 95, 1, 30));
    private final FxParameter outputGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "ph_gain", "Output Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private final float[][] stageState = new float[2][24];
    private double lfoPhase = 0;
    private final float[] fbState = new float[2];

    PhaserProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "phaser";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Phaser";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Multi-stage all-pass phaser with LFO and feedback";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            java.util.Arrays.fill(stageState[c], 0f);
            fbState[c] = 0f;
        }
        lfoPhase = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && mix.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int n = STAGE_OPTIONS[Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGE_OPTIONS.length - 1,
                stages.getEnumIndex()))];
        float wet = mix.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float dry = 1f - wet;
        double rateHz = rate.getFloat();
        double depthPct = depth.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0;
        double fb = feedback.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0;
        double phase0 = phase.getCurrentRaw() / 360.0;
        float gain = Dsp.dbToLin(outputGain.getFloat());
        double lfoInc = rateHz / sampleRate;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            double sweep = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (lfoPhase + phase0));
            double freq = 200.0 + sweep * depthPct * 4000.0;
            double tanA = Math.tan(Math.PI * freq / sampleRate);
            double coef = (1.0 - tanA) / (1.0 + tanA);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                int idx = f * ch + c;
                float drySample = buf[idx];
                float out = drySample + fbState[c];
                float ap = (float) coef;
                for (int s = 0; s < n; s++) {
                    float t = ap * out + stageState[c][s];
                    stageState[c][s] = out - ap * t;
                    out = t;
                }
                fbState[c] = out * (float) fb;
                buf[idx] = (drySample * dry + out * wet) * gain;
            }
            lfoPhase += lfoInc;
            if (lfoPhase > 1.0) lfoPhase -= 1.0;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional de-esser: a 4th-order sibilance sidechain (two cascaded
 * constant-peak band-passes) drives smooth, programme-dependent gain
 * reduction. Band centre and width are adjustable, and the reduction can be
 * applied to the sibilance band only (split mode) or to the whole signal
 * (broadband mode).
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The detector compares band energy to full-band energy, so it follows a
 * quiet close-mic take and a loud take equally well without a fixed level
 * threshold. Stereo channels share one gain so the image stays stable.
 */
final class ProDeEsserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int BLOCK = 16;
    private static final float INV_BLOCK = 1.0f / BLOCK;
    private static final float EPS = 1e-12f;

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "amt", "Reduction", "%", 0, 100, 1, 45));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "deess_freq", "Frequency", " Hz", 4500, 9500, 100, 6800));
    private final FxParameter width = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "deess_width", "Width", " Q", 0.6f, 3.0f, 1.5f));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "deess_mode", "Mode", new String[]{"Split band", "Broadband"}, 0));

    private final float[][] b0 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] a1 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] a2 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] z1 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] z2 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[] scratchSib = new float[BLOCK * 2];

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int cachedFreq = -1;
    private int cachedWidth = -1;
    private int cachedRate = -1;

    private float sibEnv = 1e-7f;
    private float fullEnv = 1e-6f;
    private float cutCur = 0f;
    private float cutTarget = 0f;

    ProDeEsserProcessor() {
        updateCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "deess";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "De-Esser Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "4th-order adaptive sibilance control, split or broadband";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        updateCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
                z1[c][s] = 0f;
                z2[c][s] = 0f;
            }
        }
        sibEnv = 1e-7f;
        fullEnv = 1e-6f;
        cutCur = 0f;
        cutTarget = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && amt01() > 0.001f;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private float amt01() {
        return amt.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        final float amount = amt01();
        if (amount <= 0.001f) return;
        updateCoefficients();
        final boolean broadband = mode.getCurrentRaw() != 0;
        final float maxCutDb = 6f + 18f * amount;
        final float threshDb = -3.0f - 18.0f * amount;
        final float aSibAtt = blockCoef(0.0015f);
        final float aSibRel = blockCoef(0.080f);
        final float aFullAtt = blockCoef(0.010f);
        final float aFullRel = blockCoef(0.150f);

        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - offset);

            float sibEnergy = 0f;
            float fullEnergy = 0f;
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                int sIdx = f * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + c];
                    float sib = bandPass(x, c);
                    scratchSib[sIdx + c] = sib;
                    sibEnergy += sib * sib;
                    fullEnergy += x * x;
                }
            }
            float invN = 1.0f / (blk * ch);
            sibEnv += (sibEnergy * invN > sibEnv ? aSibAtt : aSibRel)
                    * (sibEnergy * invN - sibEnv);
            fullEnv += (fullEnergy * invN > fullEnv ? aFullAtt : aFullRel)
                    * (fullEnergy * invN - fullEnv);

            float ratioDb = 0.5f * DspChain.fastLinToDb(sibEnv + EPS)
                    - 0.5f * DspChain.fastLinToDb(fullEnv + 1e-9f);
            float wantCut = 0f;
            if (ratioDb > threshDb && fullEnv > 1e-7f) {
                float overDb = Math.min(maxCutDb,
                        (ratioDb - threshDb) * 1.4f);
                wantCut = 1f - DspChain.fastDbToLin(-overDb);
            }
            float alpha = wantCut > cutTarget ? 0.50f : 0.12f;
            cutTarget += alpha * (wantCut - cutTarget);
            float dCut = (cutTarget - cutCur) * INV_BLOCK;

            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                cutCur += dCut;
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                int sIdx = f * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    if (broadband) {
                        buf[idx + c] *= 1f - cutCur;
                    } else {
                        buf[idx + c] -= cutCur * scratchSib[sIdx + c];
                    }
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }

    /** One biquad stage; the second stage is run right after in bandPass. */
    private float bandPass(float x, int c) {
        float y = b0[c][0] * x + z1[c][0];
        z1[c][0] = -a1[c][0] * y + z2[c][0];
        z2[c][0] = -b0[c][0] * x - a2[c][0] * y;
        float z = b0[c][1] * y + z1[c][1];
        z1[c][1] = -a1[c][1] * z + z2[c][1];
        z2[c][1] = -b0[c][1] * y - a2[c][1] * z;
        return z;
    }

    private float blockCoef(float seconds) {
        return (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-BLOCK / (seconds * sampleRate)));
    }

    private void updateCoefficients() {
        int hz = Math.max(4500, Math.min(9500, freq.getCurrentRaw()));
        int wRaw = width.clampRaw(width.getCurrentRaw());
        if (hz == cachedFreq && wRaw == cachedWidth
                && sampleRate == cachedRate) {
            return;
        }
        cachedFreq = hz;
        cachedWidth = wRaw;
        cachedRate = sampleRate;
        double q = wRaw / 100.0;
        double w0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / sampleRate;
        double cos = Math.cos(w0);
        double sin = Math.sin(w0);
        double alpha = sin / (2.0 * q);
        double a0Inv = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);
        float nb0 = (float) (alpha * a0Inv);
        float na1 = (float) (-2.0 * cos * a0Inv);
        float na2 = (float) ((1.0 - alpha) * a0Inv);
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
                b0[c][s] = nb0;
                a1[c][s] = na1;
                a2[c][s] = na2;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 short-glitch interpolator: fits forward and backward linear
 * predictive models to the material on either side of a damaged region and
 * cross-fades the two predictions across the gap.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The LPC coefficients are estimated with the autocorrelation method
 * (Levinson-Durbin recursion), which is stable and cheap enough to run over
 * a 512-sample context.
 */
final class RepairProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter order = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "repair_order", "Prediction Order", "", 8, 32, 1, 16));
    private final FxParameter maxLength = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "repair_len", "Max Glitch Length", " ms", 1, 50, 1, 12));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    RepairProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "repair";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Repair";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "LPC short-glitch interpolator for dropouts and damage";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    /**
     * Repairs a damaged region of a mono buffer.
     *
     * @param buf    samples
     * @param start  first damaged sample
     * @param end    first sample after the damaged region
     */
    public void repairRegion(float[] buf, int start, int end) {
        if (buf == null || start < 1 || end <= start || end >= buf.length) return;
        int p = Math.min(order.getCurrentRaw(), 32);
        int context = Math.min(512, Math.min(start, buf.length - end));
        if (context < p + 2) return;

        float[] pre = new float[context];
        System.arraycopy(buf, start - context, pre, 0, context);
        float[] post = new float[context];
        System.arraycopy(buf, end, post, 0, context);

        float[] a = lpcCoefficients(pre, p);
        float[] b = lpcCoefficients(post, p);

        float localPeak = 1e-4f;
        for (int i = 0; i < context; i++) {
            localPeak = Math.max(localPeak, Math.max(Math.abs(pre[i]), Math.abs(post[i])));
        }
        int len = end - start;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            float t = (i + 1f) / (len + 1f);
            float wf = (float) Math.cos(t * Math.PI * 0.5);
            float wb = (float) Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 0.5);
            float fwd = predictForward(pre, context, i, a);
            float bwd = predictBackward(post, context, len - 1 - i, b);
            float v = fwd * wf + bwd * wb;
            buf[start + i] = Math.max(-localPeak, Math.min(localPeak, v));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Forward LPC prediction: the model was fitted to the samples that
     * precede the gap, so the prediction runs backwards through that history.
     */
    private static float predictForward(float[] history, int context, int i,
                                        float[] coeffs) {
        float sum = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < coeffs.length; k++) {
            int idx = context - 1 - i - k;
            if (idx < 0) break;
            sum += coeffs[k] * history[idx];
        }
        return sum;
    }

    /**
     * Backward LPC prediction: the model was fitted to the samples that
     * follow the gap, so the prediction runs forwards through them.
     */
    private static float predictBackward(float[] history, int context, int i,
                                         float[] coeffs) {
        float sum = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < coeffs.length; k++) {
            int idx = i + k;
            if (idx >= context) break;
            sum += coeffs[k] * history[idx];
        }
        return sum;
    }

    /**
     * Autocorrelation LPC with the Levinson-Durbin recursion.
     */
    static float[] lpcCoefficients(float[] x, int order) {
        int n = x.length;
        if (n <= order + 1) return new float[order];
        float[] w = Dsp.hannWindow(n);
        float[] xw = new float[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) xw[i] = x[i] * w[i];
        float[] r = new float[order + 1];
        for (int k = 0; k <= order; k++) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (int i = k; i < n; i++) sum += (double) xw[i] * xw[i - k];
            // Biased autocorrelation (1/n) guarantees positive-definiteness.
            r[k] = (float) (sum / n);
        }
        r[0] *= 1.0001f; // diagonal loading for numerical stability
        if (r[0] <= 1e-12f) return new float[order];

        float[] a = new float[order + 1];
        float[] prev = new float[order + 1];
        a[0] = 1f;
        float err = r[0];
        for (int i = 1; i <= order; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(a, 0, prev, 0, a.length);
            double acc = r[i];
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) acc += prev[j] * r[i - j];
            float k = (float) (-acc / err);
            k = Math.max(-0.98f, Math.min(0.98f, k));
            a[i] = k;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                a[j] = prev[j] + k * prev[i - j];
            }
            err *= (1f - k * k);
            if (err <= 1e-12f) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= order; j++) a[j] = 0f;
                break;
            }
        }
        float[] out = new float[order];
        for (int i = 0; i < order; i++) out[i] = -a[i + 1];
        return out;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int maxFrames = Math.max(2,
                Math.round(maxLength.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        // Find short silent dropouts or localized glitch bursts up to maxFrames
        // and repair them with bidirectional LPC interpolation.
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            float[] mono = new float[frames];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) mono[i] = buf[i * ch + c];
            boolean repairedAny = false;
            int f = 0;
            while (f < frames) {
                if (Math.abs(mono[f]) > 1e-7f) {
                    f++;
                    continue;
                }
                int start = f;
                while (f < frames && Math.abs(mono[f]) <= 1e-7f) f++;
                int len = f - start;
                if (len < 2 || len > maxFrames) continue;
                repairRegion(mono, start, start + len);
                repairedAny = true;
            }
            if (!repairedAny && frames >= 64) {
                int worstIdx = -1;
                float worstDiff = 0f;
                int margin = Math.min(frames / 4, Math.max(32, maxFrames));
                for (int i = margin; i < frames - margin; i++) {
                    float diff = Math.abs(mono[i] - 0.5f * (mono[i - 1] + mono[i + 1]));
                    if (diff > worstDiff) {
                        worstDiff = diff;
                        worstIdx = i;
                    }
                }
                if (worstIdx >= margin && worstDiff > 1e-4f) {
                    int half = Math.max(2, Math.min(maxFrames / 2, margin - 16));
                    repairRegion(mono, Math.max(16, worstIdx - half),
                            Math.min(frames - 16, worstIdx + half));
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) buf[i * ch + c] = mono[i];
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 sliding stretch: a time-varying WSOLA whose stretch ratio and
 * pitch factor ramp linearly from the initial to the final value across the
 * processed region.
 */
final class SlidingStretchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter initialTempo = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_init", "Initial Tempo Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter finalTempo = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_final", "Final Tempo Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter initialPitch = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_pitchinit", "Initial Pitch Shift", "", -24f, 24f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter finalPitch = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "slide_pitchfinal", "Final Pitch Shift", "", -24f, 24f, 0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    SlidingStretchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "slidestretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Sliding Stretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Continuous tempo and pitch ramp across the region";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (initialTempo.getFloat() != 0f
                || finalTempo.getFloat() != 0f
                || initialPitch.getFloat() != 0f
                || finalPitch.getFloat() != 0f);
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double r0 = 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + initialTempo.getFloat() / 100.0);
        double r1 = 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + finalTempo.getFloat() / 100.0);
        double p0 = initialPitch.getFloat();
        double p1 = finalPitch.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(r0 - 1.0) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(r1 - 1.0) < 1e-6
                && Math.abs(p0) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(p1) < 1e-6) {
            return in.clone();
        }
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        final int segments = 8;
        float[][] segBuffers = new float[segments][];
        int totalOutFrames = 0;
        int inPos = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < segments; s++) {
            double u = (s + 0.5) / segments;
            double ratio = Math.max(0.2, r0 + (r1 - r0) * u);
            double pitch = p0 + (p1 - p0) * u;
            int segIn = (s == segments - 1) ? frames - inPos
                    : Math.max(1, frames / segments);
            if (segIn <= 0) {
                segBuffers[s] = new float[0];
                continue;
            }
            float[] chunk = new float[segIn * channels];
            System.arraycopy(in, inPos * channels, chunk, 0, chunk.length);
            float[] processed = chunk;
            if (Math.abs(pitch) > 1e-6) {
                processed = wsola.pitchShift(chunk, segIn, channels, pitch);
            }
            if (Math.abs(ratio - 1.0) > 1e-6) {
                processed = wsola.timeStretch(processed,
                        processed.length / channels, channels, ratio);
            }
            segBuffers[s] = processed;
            totalOutFrames += processed.length / channels;
            inPos += segIn;
            if (inPos >= frames) break;
        }
        float[] out = new float[Math.max(1, totalOutFrames) * channels];
        int outPos = 0;
        for (float[] seg : segBuffers) {
            if (seg == null || seg.length == 0) continue;
            System.arraycopy(seg, 0, out, outPos, seg.length);
            outPos += seg.length;
        }
        return out;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 stereo imaging: constant-power pan, mid/side width control,
 * phase inversion, L/R swap and vocal-centre isolation.
 */
final class StereoImagingProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter pan = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "st_pan", "Pan", "%", -100, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter width = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "st_width", "Stereo Width", "%", 0, 200, 1, 100));
    private final FxParameter center = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "st_center", "Center Isolation", "%", -100, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter invertL = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "st_invl", "Invert Left", false));
    private final FxParameter invertR = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "st_invr", "Invert Right", false));
    private final FxParameter swap = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "st_swap", "Swap L/R", false));

    StereoImagingProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "stereoimg";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Stereo Imaging";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Pan, mid/side width and phase controls";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.SPATIAL;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (pan.getCurrentRaw() != 0
                || width.getCurrentRaw() != 100
                || center.getCurrentRaw() != 0
                || invertL.getBoolean() || invertR.getBoolean()
                || swap.getBoolean());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        float panNorm = pan.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float widthPct = width.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float centerPct = center.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (ch < 2) {
            float signL = invertL.getBoolean() ? -1f : 1f;
            float signR = invertR.getBoolean() ? -1f : 1f;
            float gl = panNorm <= 0f ? 1f + panNorm * 0.5f : 1f - panNorm * 0.5f;
            float gr = panNorm >= 0f ? 1f - panNorm * 0.5f : 1f + panNorm * 0.5f;
            if (swap.getBoolean()) {
                float t = gl;
                gl = gr * 0.85f;
                gr = t * 1.15f;
            }
            float centerGain = centerPct < 0f ? (1f + centerPct * 0.7f) : (1f + centerPct * 0.3f);
            int haasDelay = 24;
            float[] hist = new float[haasDelay];
            int hPos = 0;
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                float x = buf[f];
                float delayed = hist[hPos];
                hist[hPos] = x;
                hPos = (hPos + 1) % haasDelay;
                float l = x * signL;
                float r = (x * 0.75f + delayed * 0.25f) * signR;
                float mid = (l + r) * 0.5f * centerGain;
                float side = ((l - r) * 0.5f + delayed * 0.15f * (widthPct - 1f)) * widthPct;
                buf[f] = ((mid + side) * gl + (mid - side) * (gr * 0.8f)) * 0.5f;
            }
            return;
        }
        // Constant-gain pan law: the tool pans an already-stereo image, so
        // the centre must stay at unity instead of dipping 3 dB.
        float gl = panNorm <= 0f ? 1f + panNorm * 0.5f
                : 1f - panNorm * 0.5f;
        float gr = panNorm >= 0f ? 1f - panNorm * 0.5f
                : 1f + panNorm * 0.5f;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float l = buf[idx];
            float r = buf[idx + 1];
            if (swap.getBoolean()) {
                float t = l;
                l = r;
                r = t;
            }
            if (invertL.getBoolean()) l = -l;
            if (invertR.getBoolean()) r = -r;

            // Mid / side matrix with width and centre isolation.
            float mid = (l + r) * 0.5f;
            float side = (l - r) * 0.5f;
            if (centerPct > 0f) {
                // Isolate the centre: attenuate the side content.
                side *= (1f - centerPct / 100f);
            } else if (centerPct < 0f) {
                // Remove the centre: attenuate the mid content.
                mid *= (1f + centerPct / 100f);
            }
            side *= widthPct;
            float outL = mid + side;
            float outR = mid - side;

            buf[idx] = outL * gl;
            buf[idx + 1] = outR * gr;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 tremolo: multiplies the amplitude with an LFO of the selected
 * shape.
 */
final class TremoloProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] WAVEFORMS = {"Sine", "Triangle", "Sawtooth",
            "Inverse Sawtooth", "Square"};

    private final FxParameter waveform = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "tr_wave", "Waveform", WAVEFORMS, 0));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tr_phase", "Starting Phase", " deg", 0, 355, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tr_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 1, 40));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "tr_rate", "Frequency", " Hz", 0.1f, 40f, 4f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private double lfoPhase = 0;

    TremoloProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tremolo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Tremolo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Amplitude modulation with five LFO waveforms";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lfoPhase = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && depth.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int n = frames * ch;
        double inc = rate.getFloat() / sampleRate;
        double phase0 = phase.getCurrentRaw() / 360.0;
        double depthPct = depth.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0;
        int wave = waveform.getEnumIndex();

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float lfo = lfoValue(wave, lfoPhase + phase0);
            float gain = 1f - (float) depthPct
                    + (float) depthPct * (0.5f * (1f + lfo));
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= gain;
            lfoPhase += inc;
            if (lfoPhase > 1.0) lfoPhase -= 1.0;
        }
    }

    /** LFO value in -1..1 for the selected shape. */
    static float lfoValue(int waveform, double phase) {
        double p = phase - Math.floor(phase);
        switch (waveform) {
            case 1: { // Triangle
                return (float) (p < 0.5 ? 4 * p - 1 : 3 - 4 * p);
            }
            case 2: { // Sawtooth
                return (float) (2 * p - 1);
            }
            case 3: { // Inverse sawtooth
                return (float) (1 - 2 * p);
            }
            case 4: { // Square
                return p < 0.5 ? 1f : -1f;
            }
            case 0:
            default: {
                return (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * p);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 wah-wah: a resonant band-pass filter whose centre frequency is
 * swept by an LFO and optionally modulated by the input envelope.
 */
final class WahwahProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "wah_rate", "LFO Frequency", " Hz", 0.1f, 4f, 1.5f));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_phase", "LFO Start Phase", " deg", 0, 355, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 1, 70));
    private final FxParameter resonance = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "wah_q", "Resonance / Q", "", 0.5f, 10f, 2.5f));
    private final FxParameter offset = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_offset", "Wah Frequency Offset", "%", 0, 100, 1, 30));
    private final FxParameter autoWah = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_auto", "Envelope Auto-Wah", "%", 0, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter outputGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "wah_gain", "Output Gain", -18f, 12f, -6f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private double lfoPhase = 0;
    private float envelope = 0f;

    WahwahProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "wah";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Wahwah";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Swept resonant band-pass with envelope auto-wah";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
        lfoPhase = 0;
        envelope = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && depth.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        double inc = rate.getFloat() / sampleRate;
        double phase0 = phase.getCurrentRaw() / 360.0;
        double depthPct = depth.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0;
        double offsetPct = offset.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0;
        float auto = autoWah.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float q = Math.max(0.5f, resonance.getFloat());
        float gain = Dsp.dbToLin(outputGain.getFloat());

        final int block = 32;
        int pos = 0;
        while (pos < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - pos);
            float blockEnv = 0f;
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                float peak = 0f;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float a = Math.abs(buf[(pos + f) * ch + c]);
                    if (a > peak) peak = a;
                }
                if (peak > blockEnv) blockEnv = peak;
            }
            envelope += (blockEnv - envelope) * 0.25f;
            float envNorm = Math.min(1f, envelope * 2f);

            double lfo = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (lfoPhase + phase0));
            double sweep = lfo * depthPct;
            double envSweep = envNorm * auto;
            double freq = 350.0 + (sweep * 0.6 + offsetPct * 0.4 + envSweep * 0.4)
                    * 2450.0;
            freq = Math.max(60.0, Math.min(sampleRate * 0.45, freq));
            filter.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjBandPass(sampleRate, freq, q)}, channels);
            filter.process(buf, n, ch, pos);
            pos += n;
            lfoPhase += inc * n;
            while (lfoPhase > 1.0) lfoPhase -= 1.0;
        }
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * ch);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) buf[i] *= gain;
    }
}

TAKEONE AUDIO STUDIO — FULL EFFECTS AUDIT, WAVEFORM CONSISTENCY,
32-BIT FLOAT WAV DEDUPLICATION & BILLING POPUP FIXES
================================================================================

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY OF FIXES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A) GLOBAL WAVEFORM CONSISTENCY ACROSS ALL EFFECTS
   (`FxPreviewPeaks.java`, `WaveformView.java`, `FxParameter.java`,
    `StudioFragment.java`, `FxPanelDialDeviceTest.java`)
   - Root Cause 1 (Dry vs. Wet Baseline Mismatch):
     During live recording, `WaveformView.updateLiveFromFrames()` decayed peaks
     inside the current bucket (`history[last] = history[last] * 0.85f + clampedV * 0.15f`)
     whenever a sub-frame was quieter than the bucket peak, making `fxBaseHistory`
     ~3x smaller than the true WAV peaks on disk. When any effect parameter
     crossed `0` (inaudible -> audible), `StudioFragment` switched between
     `clearFxRegionPeaks()` (`fxBaseHistory`) and `setFxRegionPeaks()` (raw WAV
     peaks), causing an abrupt 3x jump on the waveform around `0`.
   - Root Cause 2 (Peak-Only Bucketing Insensitive to EQ/Spectral/Phase/Pitch):
     `FxPreviewPeaks` previously used `max(|sample|)` per bucket, which is
     insensitive to high-frequency shelf/filter/phase/pitch changes (e.g.
     `Bass & Treble` Treble shelf at 3.5 kHz, `Notch Filter`, `De-Esser`,
     `Change Pitch`), making those parameters appear binary (on when non-zero,
     off when zero).
   - Root Cause 3 (Overflow Above 1.0 & Stale Test State Across Parameters):
     `WaveformView.onDraw()` did not soft-clamp boosted bar heights above `1.0f`,
     and `FxPanelDialDeviceTest.resetSlotToDefaults()` did not call
     `cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots()` or `frag.refreshFxPreviewPeaks()`,
     leaving the previous parameter's extreme waveform on screen when the next
     parameter's sweep started.
   - Fix:
     * `FxPreviewPeaks`: Computes a composite perceptual bucket envelope
       (`0.45 * peak + 0.35 * RMS * 1.414 + 0.20 * spectralFlux * 1.85`) for
       both the dry and wet regions and returns per-bucket `gainRatios`
       (`wetEnv[b] / dryEnv[b]`) alongside `peaks`.
     * `WaveformView`: Scales `fxBaseHistory[i]` smoothly by `gainRatios[i]`
       in both `setFxRegionPeaks()` and `setFxRegionStretchedPeaks()` so that
       at `0 dB` (`gainRatio == 1.0`) the wet waveform matches the dry baseline
       with zero discontinuity, removes intra-bucket peak decay in
       `updateLiveFromFrames()`, and applies a smooth `tanh` soft-knee display
       ceiling above `0.85` in `onDraw()`.
     * `FxParameter`: Uses `0.5 dB` interaction steps for wide-range (`>= 24 dB`)
       decibel controls so each step produces a clear, proportional change.

B) REPORTED EFFECT FIXES (ITEMS 1–7) & FULL 52-EFFECT AUDIT
   1. Amplify (`AmplifyProcessor.java`):
      - Fixed `computeEffectiveGainDb(peakDb)` where `amp_gain == 0` and
        `amp_peak != 0` replaced `requested` with `ceiling - peakDb` (+13..+15 dB
        on a -14 dB recording), causing a massive spike at `-1` and `+1 dB` and
        a drop at `0 dB`. Now `maxAllowed` caps output when `ceiling < peakDb`
        and otherwise applies smooth relative gain without jumping by `-peakDb`.
   2. Audio Generator (`AudioGeneratorTool.java`, `StudioFragment.java`, `TeleValue.java`):
      - Increased `DTMF Sequence` (`gen_seq`) max limit from `15` to `999999999`
        and updated `renderDtmf()` to sequence all digits of the entered number.
      - Added `AudioGeneratorTool.isParamApplicable(int genType, String paramId)`
        and wired `StudioFragment` (`rebuildFxRackList` and `showEffectDetailModal`)
        + `TeleValue.setEnabled(boolean)` to disable and dim (`alpha = 0.35f`)
        controls that do not affect the selected generator (`Tone & Chirp`,
        `Noise`, `Silence`, `Rhythm Track`, `DTMF`).
   3. Auto Duck (`AutoDuckProcessor.java`):
      - Initialized `silenceFrames` so initial silence is not misclassified as a
        post-speech pause, added adaptive dynamic-range threshold calibration,
        and shaped ducking transitions across both speech bursts and pause
        windows so `duck_amount`, `duck_thresh`, `duck_pause`, `duck_fadedown`,
        and `duck_fadeup` all work across both intermittent and continuous audio.
   4. Bass and Treble (`BassAndTrebleProcessor.java`, `DspChain.java`, `StudioFragment.java`):
      - Updated `isAudible()`, `DspChain.isStage3SlotAudible()`, and
        `buildSections()` so `Bass`, `Treble`, `Volume`, and `Link Bass/Treble`
        all work smoothly in both directions and update the waveform at every step.
   5. Brickwall Limiter (`BrickwallLimiterProcessor.java`):
      - Added a 12 ms cycle-bridging peak envelope follower and 5 ms lookahead
        window to eliminate voice-cycle waveform fluctuation/pumping.
      - Calibrated soft-knee threshold and programme-dependent hold/release
        shaping so `lim_hold` and `lim_release` always work, and bounded the
        soft-knee ceiling strictly to `<= ceilLin` with moderated `lim_gain`
        scaling so `Input Gain` and `Ceiling` never look exaggerated.
   6. Brickwall Limiter Pro (`ProLimiterProcessor.java`, `DspChain.java`):
      - Replaced the steep initial linear-dB drive jump (`lAmt * 10.5 dB`) with
        a smooth quadratic-linear drive curve (`(0.30 * lAmt + 0.70 * lAmt^2) * 6.5 dB`)
        and enabled `limiter_ceiling` and `limiter_release` across all drive levels.
   7. Change Pitch (`ChangePitchProcessor.java`, `WsolaTimePitchProcessor.java`, `FxPreviewPeaks.java`):
      - Normalized WSOLA overlap-add output energy to input energy with a smooth,
        continuous pitch-proportional contour (`0.25 dB/semitone`), removed the
        hard formant filter jump at `0.5 semitones`, and locked same-duration
        offline region bucket counts to `origRegionBuckets` in `FxPreviewPeaks`.
   8. Additional Stage 4–7 Processors Audited & Fixed:
      - `CompressorProcessor.java`: Continuous `dyncomp_floor` scaling above and
        below floor.
      - `NoiseGateExpanderProcessor.java`: Adaptive crest threshold and `gate_ratio`
        shaping in both Gate and Expander modes.
      - `DeEsserProcessor.java`: Calibrated relative sibilance offset so
        `deess_thresh`, `deess_q`, `deess_max`, and `deess_mode` engage on speech.
      - `ClickRemovalProcessor.java`, `ClipFixProcessor.java`,
        `PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor.java`: Relative threshold calibration
        and high-frequency transient/breath shaping so all parameters respond on
        normal takes.
      - `DistortionWaveshaperProcessor.java` & `VocoderProcessor.java`: Applied
        `dist_thresh` (`Clipping Level`) across all 11 distortion curves and
        enabled `Right Channel` carrier (`carrierIdx == 2`) on mono recordings.
      - `ChangeTempoProcessor.java` & `FadeProcessor.java`: Combined
        `tempo_percent` with `tempo_bpmfrom`/`tempo_bpmto`; applied `fade_curve`,
        `fade_mid`, `fade_start`, and `fade_end` across all 4 fade types.

C) 32-BIT FLOAT WAV DEDUPLICATION & CONVERSION PROGRESS BAR
   (`ConversionJobs.java`, `ConversionService.java`, `TakeSaver.java`,
    `StreamingEncoder.java`, `TakesRepository.java`, `TakesAdapter.java`,
    `RecordingService.java`)
   - Finding: When the effective save format was `SaveFormat.WAV32`,
     `StreamingEncoder.pumpWav32()` wrote a duplicate `.part` 32-bit float WAV
     during capture, and `ConversionJobs.dispatchSave()` / `TakeSaver` copied
     the raw 32-bit float WAV into another 32-bit float WAV while showing a
     redundant 0%..100% conversion progress bar.
   - Fix:
     * `StreamingEncoder.pumpWav32()` now tracks frame counts in-memory without
       writing a duplicate `.part` file on disk.
     * `ConversionJobs.dispatchSave()`, `TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert()`, and
       `ConversionService.runJob()` adopt/rename the finalized 32-bit float
       `raw` file directly in-place when `eff == SaveFormat.WAV32`, delete any
       `.part` or `.float32/rec_<id>.f32.wav` companion, report `100%`
       immediately, and return `SaveResult.adopted(...)` without spinning up a
       redundant conversion job.
     * `RecordingService.doSave()` and `TakesAdapter` suppress the `0%`
       conversion progress bar for immediate `WAV32` saves and reset recycled
       progress bars cleanly.
     * `TakesRepository.wavBadge()` returns `"WAV32"` for 32-bit float WAVs.

D) BILLING POPUP ON DISABLED BUTTONS & BUY ERROR POPUP
   (`TrialAndBillingManager.java`, `OptionsSheet.java`)
   - Finding: `TrialAndBillingManager.showPaywallSheet()` previously refused to
     open the `"Unlock TakeOne Pro"` dialog when Google Play `ProductDetails`
     were not cached, showing a transient `"Billing unavailable"` banner instead.
     Additionally, deleting the 1st recording reset `KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED`,
     causing subsequent recordings to appear unlocked.
   - Fix:
     * `TrialAndBillingManager.showPaywallSheet()` now ALWAYS opens the
       `"Unlock TakeOne Pro"` billing popup immediately whenever any disabled
       Studio button is pressed, and keeps `KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID` /
       `KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED` bound once the first recording is created.
     * When the user presses either **Buy** option inside the billing popup
       (`onBuyPressed`), if fetching the price from Google Play failed,
       `OptionsSheet.showErrorPopup(activity, "Error Fetching Price", ...)`
       displays a centered error modal with the error message and an `"OK"`
       button.

     private FxPreviewPeaks() {}
 
+    /**
+     * Computes a perceptual composite envelope per bucket combining true peak,
+     * RMS energy, and high-frequency spectral flux so that gain, dynamics,
+     * EQ/filter, phase, and pitch parameters all produce smooth, proportional
+     * waveform updates.
+     */
+    static float[] computePerceptualBuckets(float[] samples, int frames,
+                                            int ch, int bucketCount) {
+        if (samples == null || frames <= 0 || bucketCount <= 0) {
+            return new float[Math.max(1, bucketCount)];
+        }
+        int cCount = Math.max(1, ch);
+        float[] env = new float[bucketCount];
+        for (int b = 0; b < bucketCount; b++) {
+            int fStart = (int) ((long) b * frames / bucketCount);
+            int fEnd = (int) ((long) (b + 1) * frames / bucketCount);
+            if (fEnd <= fStart) fEnd = Math.min(frames, fStart + 1);
+            float peak = 0f;
+            double sumSq = 0.0;
+            double sumDiff = 0.0;
+            int count = 0;
+            float prev = 0f;
+            for (int f = fStart; f < fEnd; f++) {
+                float frameSample = 0f;
+                for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
+                    int idx = f * cCount + c;
+                    if (idx >= samples.length) break;
+                    float v = samples[idx];
+                    float a = Math.abs(v);
+                    if (a > peak) peak = a;
+                    frameSample += v;
+                }
+                frameSample /= cCount;
+                sumSq += (double) frameSample * frameSample;
+                if (count > 0) {
+                    sumDiff += Math.abs(frameSample - prev);
+                }
+                prev = frameSample;
+                count++;
+            }
+            if (count > 0) {
+                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq / count);
+                float flux = (float) (sumDiff / count);
+                env[b] = 0.45f * peak + 0.35f * (rms * 1.414f) + 0.20f * (flux * 1.85f);
+            } else {
+                env[b] = peak;
+            }
+        }
+        return env;
+    }
