// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/FadeProcessor.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 fades: fade in, fade out, studio fade out (equal-power S-curve
 * plus a closing low-pass) and a fully customisable fade.
 */
final class FadeProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Fade In", "Fade Out",
            "Studio Fade Out", "Adjustable Fade"};
    private static final String[] CURVE_LABELS = {"Linear", "Logarithmic",
            "Exponential", "Cosine", "S-Curve"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "fade_type", "Type", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter curve = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "fade_curve", "Curve Shape", CURVE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter midBoost = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "fade_mid", "Mid-Fade Boost", "%", -100, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter startGain = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "fade_start", "Start Gain", "%", 0, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter endGain = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "fade_end", "End Gain", "%", 0, 100, 1, 100));
    private final FxParameter length = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "fade_len", "Length", "%", 1, 100, 1, 20));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter closingLp = new BiquadFilter();

    FadeProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "fade";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Fade";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Fade in, fade out, studio fade or custom curve";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TOOLS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        closingLp.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, 800f, 0.7071)},
                channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        closingLp.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        // The fade is rendered into a copy so the caller keeps the original
        // region untouched, exactly like the other offline tools.
        float[] out = in.clone();
        int typeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();
        int fadeFrames = Math.max(1,
                (int) Math.round(frames * length.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0));
        fadeFrames = Math.min(fadeFrames, frames);

        switch (typeIdx) {
            case 0: { // Fade In
                applyRamp(out, frames, channels, fadeFrames, true);
                break;
            }
            case 1: { // Fade Out
                applyRamp(out, frames, channels, fadeFrames, false);
                break;
            }
            case 2: { // Studio Fade Out
                applyStudioFade(out, frames, channels, fadeFrames);
                break;
            }
            default: { // Adjustable Fade
                applyAdjustable(out, frames, channels, fadeFrames);
                break;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private float shapeCurve(float u) {
        u = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, u));
        int curveIdx = curve.getEnumIndex();
        float s;
        switch (curveIdx) {
            case 1: // Logarithmic
                s = (float) Math.pow(u, 0.5);
                break;
            case 2: // Exponential
                s = (float) Math.pow(u, 2.0);
                break;
            case 3: // Cosine
                s = (float) (0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * u));
                break;
            case 4: // S-Curve
                s = u * u * (3f - 2f * u);
                break;
            case 0:
            default: // Linear
                s = u;
                break;
        }
        float mid = midBoost.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (mid != 0f) {
            s *= Math.max(0f, 1f + mid * 2.5f * u * (1f - u));
        }
        return s;
    }

    /** Shaped ramp in or out over the first/last {@code fadeFrames}. */
    private void applyRamp(float[] buf, int frames, int ch, int fadeFrames,
                           boolean fadeIn) {
        float gStart = startGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float gEnd = endGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float g;
            if (fadeIn) {
                if (f < fadeFrames) {
                    float u = fadeFrames == 1 ? 1f : f / (float) (fadeFrames - 1);
                    float shaped = shapeCurve(u);
                    g = gStart + (gEnd - gStart) * shaped;
                } else {
                    g = gEnd;
                }
            } else {
                int start = frames - fadeFrames;
                if (f >= start) {
                    int i = f - start;
                    float u = fadeFrames == 1 ? 1f : i / (float) (fadeFrames - 1);
                    float shaped = shapeCurve(1f - u);
                    g = gStart + (gEnd - gStart) * shaped;
                } else {
                    g = gEnd;
                }
            }
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= g;
        }
    }

    /** Equal-power S-curve with a low-pass that closes during the fade. */
    private void applyStudioFade(float[] buf, int frames, int ch, int fadeFrames) {
        closingLp.reset();
        float gStart = startGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float gEnd = endGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float u = 0f;
            if (f >= frames - fadeFrames) {
                int i = f - (frames - fadeFrames);
                u = fadeFrames == 1 ? 1f : i / (float) (fadeFrames - 1);
            }
            float baseCos = (float) (0.5 * (1.0 + Math.cos(Math.PI * u)));
            float shaped = 0.5f * baseCos + 0.5f * shapeCurve(1f - u);
            float g = gStart + (gEnd - gStart) * shaped;
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                buf[idx + c] *= g;
            }
            if (u > 0f) {
                // Sweep the low-pass from 20 kHz down to 800 Hz.
                float cutoff = 20000f * (float) Math.pow(800f / 20000f, u);
                closingLp.setSections(new float[][]{
                        Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, cutoff, 0.7071)}, ch);
                closingLp.process(buf, 1, ch, f);
            }
        }
    }

    /** Custom curve between an arbitrary start and end gain. */
    private void applyAdjustable(float[] buf, int frames, int ch, int fadeFrames) {
        float g0 = startGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float g1 = endGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float mid = midBoost.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        int curveIdx = curve.getEnumIndex();
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float u = fadeFrames <= 1 ? 1f
                    : Math.min(1f, f / (float) (fadeFrames - 1));
            float shape;
            switch (curveIdx) {
                case 1: // Logarithmic
                    shape = (float) Math.pow(u, 0.5);
                    break;
                case 2: // Exponential
                    shape = (float) Math.pow(u, 2.0);
                    break;
                case 3: // Cosine
                    shape = (float) (0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * u));
                    break;
                case 4: // S-Curve
                    shape = u * u * (3f - 2f * u);
                    break;
                case 0:
                default: // Linear
                    shape = u;
                    break;
            }
            float g = g0 + (g1 - g0) * shape;
            if (mid != 0f) {
                // Bell-shaped mid-fade boost.
                g *= 1f + mid * 4f * shape * (1f - shape);
            }
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= g;
        }
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/FxParameter.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Locale;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Strongly typed, serializable parameter descriptor for an
 * {@link AudioProcessor}. A processor declares the parameters it exposes and
 * the FX inspector renders one control per parameter, so multi-knob effects
 * need no bespoke UI.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Values are stored as integer &quot;raw&quot; counts so that stepping, clamping and
 * persistence are exact; {@link #getFloat()} rescales by
 * {@link #scaleDivisor} (e.g. raw 350 with divisor 100 is 3.50). Display
 * formatting is scale-aware (dB suffix, enum labels) and can be overridden
 * with a {@link ValueFormatter}.
 */
public final class FxParameter {

    public enum Type { FLOAT, INT, BOOLEAN, ENUM, ACTION, CURVE_NODES }

    public enum Scale { LINEAR, LOGARITHMIC, DECIBEL, PIECEWISE_FREQ }

    /** Optional display override; when set, {@link #formatDisplay()} uses it. */
    public interface ValueFormatter {
        String format(FxParameter p, int rawValue);
    }

    public final String id;
    public final String name;
    public final String unit;
    public final Type type;
    public final Scale scale;
    public final int minRaw;
    public final int maxRaw;
    public final int stepRaw;
    public final int defaultRaw;
    public final int scaleDivisor;
    public final String[] enumLabels;

    private volatile int currentRaw;
    private volatile ValueFormatter formatter;

    private FxParameter(String id, String name, String unit, Type type,
                        Scale scale, int minRaw, int maxRaw, int stepRaw,
                        int defaultRaw, int scaleDivisor, String[] enumLabels) {
        this.id = id;
        this.name = name;
        this.unit = unit == null ? "" : unit;
        this.type = type;
        this.scale = scale;
        this.minRaw = minRaw;
        this.maxRaw = maxRaw;
        this.stepRaw = Math.max(1, stepRaw);
        this.scaleDivisor = Math.max(1, scaleDivisor);
        this.enumLabels = enumLabels;
        this.defaultRaw = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, defaultRaw));
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(defaultRaw);
    }

    /** Integer parameter in {@code unit} (e.g. " Hz", "%"). */
    public static FxParameter intParam(String id, String name, String unit,
                                       int min, int max, int step, int def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, unit, Type.INT, Scale.LINEAR,
                min, max, step, def, 1, null);
    }
    /** Fractional parameter stored scaled by 100 (two decimal places). */
    public static FxParameter floatParam(String id, String name, String unit,
                                         float min, float max, float def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, unit, Type.FLOAT, Scale.LINEAR,
                Math.round(min * 100f), Math.round(max * 100f), 1,
                Math.round(def * 100f), 100, null);
    }

    /** Decibel parameter (displays a " dB" suffix). */
    public static FxParameter dbParam(String id, String name,
                                      float minDb, float maxDb, float defDb) {
        FxParameter p = new FxParameter(id, name, " dB", Type.FLOAT,
                Scale.DECIBEL, Math.round(minDb * 100f), Math.round(maxDb * 100f),
                1, Math.round(defDb * 100f), 100, null);
        return p;
    }

    public static FxParameter boolParam(String id, String name, boolean def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.BOOLEAN, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, 1, 1, def ? 1 : 0, 1, null);
    }

    public static FxParameter enumParam(String id, String name,
                                        String[] labels, int defIndex) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.ENUM, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, Math.max(0, labels.length - 1), 1, defIndex, 1, labels);
    }

    /** One-shot command parameter (renders as a button, holds no value). */
    public static FxParameter actionParam(String id, String name) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.ACTION, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, 0, 1, 0, 1, null);
    }

    public int getCurrentRaw() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    /**
     * The step a control should use when the user drags or taps the value.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Fixed-point parameters are stored in raw counts ({@code scaleDivisor}
     * counts per display unit), so their storage granularity is far finer than
     * anything the user can read on the label. Dragging with the storage
     * granularity makes a one-decimal control (a Q of 25.0, a 0.1 dB
     * threshold) crawl: the value changes but the label barely moves, and
     * crossing the range takes hundreds of swipes.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;The interaction step is therefore derived from the *displayed*
     * precision: one tenth of a display unit for fractional and decibel
     * parameters, one count for integer ones. That matches what the label
     * can actually show, so every drag tick produces a visible change.
     */
    public int interactionStepRaw() {
        int span = Math.max(0, maxRaw - minRaw);
        if (type == Type.INT) {
            return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, stepRaw));
        }
        if (scaleDivisor <= 1) {
            return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, stepRaw));
        }
        if (scale == Scale.DECIBEL && span >= 24 * scaleDivisor) {
            int halfDb = Math.max(1, scaleDivisor / 2);
            int step = Math.max(stepRaw, halfDb);
            return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, step));
        }
        // One tenth of a display unit, in raw counts.
        int tenth = Math.max(1, scaleDivisor / 10);
        int step = Math.max(1, Math.max(stepRaw, tenth));
        // The step must never be coarser than the range itself, or a narrow
        // control could not reach its own bounds.
        return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, step));
    }

    public void setCurrentRaw(int raw) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(raw);
    }

    public void resetToDefault() {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(defaultRaw);
    }

    public int clampRaw(int raw) {
        int v = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, raw));
        if (type == Type.ENUM || type == Type.BOOLEAN || type == Type.ACTION) {
            return v;
        }
        if (stepRaw > 1 && v < maxRaw) {
            int steps = Math.round((v - minRaw) / (float) stepRaw);
            v = minRaw + steps * stepRaw;
            v = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, v));
        }
        return v;
    }

    public float getFloat() {
        return currentRaw / (float) scaleDivisor;
    }

    public void setFloat(float v) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(Math.round(v * scaleDivisor));
    }

    public boolean getBoolean() {
        return currentRaw != 0;
    }

    public void setBoolean(boolean b) {
        this.currentRaw = b ? 1 : 0;
    }

    public int getEnumIndex() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    public void setEnumIndex(int idx) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(idx);
    }

    public String getEnumLabel() {
        return getEnumLabel(currentRaw);
    }

    public String getEnumLabel(int rawIndex) {
        if (enumLabels == null || rawIndex < 0
                || rawIndex >= enumLabels.length) {
            return "";
        }
        return enumLabels[rawIndex];
    }

    public void setValueFormatter(ValueFormatter f) {
        this.formatter = f;
    }

    /** Human readable value for the current raw setting. */
    public String formatDisplay() {
        return formatRaw(currentRaw);
    }

    /**
     * Stateless display formatter for an arbitrary {@code rawValue}. Safe to
     * call on shared prototype descriptors without mutating {@link #currentRaw}.
     */
    public String formatRaw(int rawValue) {
        int raw = clampRaw(rawValue);
        if (formatter != null) {
            return formatter.format(this, raw);
        }
        if (type == Type.BOOLEAN) {
            return raw != 0 ? "On" : "Off";
        }
        if (type == Type.ENUM) {
            return getEnumLabel(raw);
        }
        if (type == Type.ACTION) {
            return name;
        }
        if (scaleDivisor <= 1) {
            return unit.isEmpty() ? String.valueOf(raw)
                    : raw + unit;
        }
        double d = raw / (double) scaleDivisor;
        String num;
        if (scale == Scale.DECIBEL) {
            if (scaleDivisor >= 100 && (Math.abs(raw) % 10) != 0) {
                num = String.format(Locale.US, "%+.2f", d);
            } else {
                num = String.format(Locale.US, "%+.1f", d);
            }
        } else if (Math.abs(d) >= 10 || raw % scaleDivisor == 0) {
            num = trimTrailingZeros(String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", d));
        } else {
            num = trimTrailingZeros(String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", d));
        }
        return unit.isEmpty() ? num : num + unit;
    }

    private static String trimTrailingZeros(String s) {
        if (!s.contains(".")) return s;
        while (s.endsWith("0")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        if (s.endsWith(".")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        return s;
    }

    public JSONObject toJson() {
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("id", id);
            o.put("name", name);
            o.put("unit", unit);
            o.put("type", type.name());
            o.put("scale", scale.name());
            o.put("min", minRaw);
            o.put("max", maxRaw);
            o.put("step", stepRaw);
            o.put("def", defaultRaw);
            o.put("div", scaleDivisor);
            o.put("cur", currentRaw);
            if (enumLabels != null) {
                JSONArray a = new JSONArray();
                for (String l : enumLabels) a.put(l);
                o.put("enums", a);
            }
            return o;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONObject();
        }
    }

    /** Rebuilds a parameter from {@link #toJson()} output. */
    public static FxParameter fromJson(JSONObject o) {
        if (o == null) return null;
        String id = o.optString("id", "");
        String[] enums = null;
        JSONArray ea = o.optJSONArray("enums");
        if (ea != null && ea.length() > 0) {
            enums = new String[ea.length()];
            for (int i = 0; i < enums.length; i++) enums[i] = ea.optString(i, "");
        }
        Type t;
        Scale sc;
        try {
            t = Type.valueOf(o.optString("type", Type.INT.name()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            t = Type.INT;
        }
        try {
            sc = Scale.valueOf(o.optString("scale", Scale.LINEAR.name()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            sc = Scale.LINEAR;
        }
        FxParameter p = new FxParameter(id, o.optString("name", ""),
                o.optString("unit", ""), t, sc,
                o.optInt("min", 0), o.optInt("max", 100),
                o.optInt("step", 1), o.optInt("def", 0),
                o.optInt("div", 1), enums);
        p.currentRaw = p.clampRaw(o.optInt("cur", p.defaultRaw));
        return p;
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/FxPreviewPeaks.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Renders the live FX rack over a take and reports the resulting peak and
 * spectral-energy envelope, so the studio can draw the effect-applied waveform
 * while the user is still dialling the effects in.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The render is chunked and bounded so a long take does not block the
 * UI thread, and the result is bucketed with the same grid the waveform view
 * uses so the overlay lines up with the dry bars without baseline jumps.
 */
final class FxPreviewPeaks {

    private FxPreviewPeaks() {}

    /**
     * Computes a perceptual composite envelope per bucket combining true peak,
     * RMS energy, and high-frequency spectral flux so that gain, dynamics,
     * EQ/filter, phase, and pitch parameters all produce smooth, proportional
     * waveform updates.
     */
    static float[] computePerceptualBuckets(float[] samples, int frames,
                                            int ch, int bucketCount) {
        if (samples == null || frames <= 0 || bucketCount <= 0) {
            return new float[Math.max(1, bucketCount)];
        }
        int cCount = Math.max(1, ch);
        float[] env = new float[bucketCount];
        for (int b = 0; b < bucketCount; b++) {
            int fStart = (int) ((long) b * frames / bucketCount);
            int fEnd = (int) ((long) (b + 1) * frames / bucketCount);
            if (fEnd <= fStart) fEnd = Math.min(frames, fStart + 1);
            float peak = 0f;
            double sumSq = 0.0;
            double sumDiff = 0.0;
            int count = 0;
            float prev = 0f;
            for (int f = fStart; f < fEnd; f++) {
                float frameSample = 0f;
                for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                    int idx = f * cCount + c;
                    if (idx >= samples.length) break;
                    float v = samples[idx];
                    float a = Math.abs(v);
                    if (a > peak) peak = a;
                    frameSample += v;
                }
                frameSample /= cCount;
                sumSq += (double) frameSample * frameSample;
                if (count > 0) {
                    sumDiff += Math.abs(frameSample - prev);
                }
                prev = frameSample;
                count++;
            }
            if (count > 0) {
                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq / count);
                float flux = (float) (sumDiff / count);
                env[b] = 0.45f * peak + 0.35f * (rms * 1.414f) + 0.20f * (flux * 1.85f);
            } else {
                env[b] = peak;
            }
        }
        return env;
    }

    /**
     * Renders {@code chain} over {@code raw} and returns the peak envelope
     * in {@code buckets} buckets (the same count the waveform view holds).
     *
     * @return the peaks, or null when the render could not be completed
     */
    static float[] render(File raw, DspChain chain, int buckets,
                           int sampleRate) {
        if (raw == null || chain == null || buckets <= 0) return null;
        int bCount = Math.min(buckets, 8192);
        return renderRegion(raw, chain, bCount, sampleRate, 0f, 1f);
    }

    /**
     * Renders only {@code [startFrac, endFrac)} of {@code raw} through
     * {@code chain} and returns peaks on the waveform's absolute bucket grid.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Rendering just the target region keeps the live preview responsive on
     * long takes. The chain is warmed with a short pre-roll and primed for its
     * algorithmic latency, exactly like {@code EditEngine.applyDspToRange}, so
     * the bars line up with the audio that Stop will commit.
     *
     * @return one peak per history bucket (zero outside the region), or null
     */
    static float[] renderRegion(File raw, DspChain chain, int buckets,
                                int sampleRate, float startFrac,
                                float endFrac) {
        LiveRegionResult res = renderRegionInternal(raw, chain, buckets,
                sampleRate, startFrac, endFrac, null, false);
        return res != null ? res.peaks : null;
    }

    /**
     * Result of a real-time FX region render. When the rack includes
     * offline/length-changing processors (Change Speed and Pitch, Change Tempo,
     * Audio Generator, Paulstretch, Sliding Stretch, Timeline Utility Repeat,
     * Truncate Silence), {@code lengthChanged} is true, {@code peaks} has the
     * scaled bucket count for the stretched/shrunk region, {@code newTotalFrames}
     * is the new total frame count of the take, and {@code renderedWav} holds
     * the spliced preview WAV ready for instant playback and scrubbing.
     */
    static final class LiveRegionResult {
        final float[] peaks;
        final float[] gainRatios;
        final boolean lengthChanged;
        final long newTotalFrames;
        final long startFrame;
        final long newRegionEndFrame;
        final File renderedWav;

        LiveRegionResult(float[] peaks, boolean lengthChanged,
                         long newTotalFrames, long startFrame,
                         long newRegionEndFrame, File renderedWav) {
            this(peaks, null, lengthChanged, newTotalFrames, startFrame,
                    newRegionEndFrame, renderedWav);
        }

        LiveRegionResult(float[] peaks, float[] gainRatios,
                         boolean lengthChanged, long newTotalFrames,
                         long startFrame, long newRegionEndFrame,
                         File renderedWav) {
            this.peaks = peaks;
            this.gainRatios = gainRatios;
            this.lengthChanged = lengthChanged;
            this.newTotalFrames = newTotalFrames;
            this.startFrame = startFrame;
            this.newRegionEndFrame = newRegionEndFrame;
            this.renderedWav = renderedWav;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Renders {@code [startFrac, endFrac)} of {@code raw} in real time for the
     * Studio FX timeline. For offline/duration-changing effects, computes
     * proportionally scaled region buckets so the timeline expands or shrinks
     * immediately as knobs are scrubbed, and optionally writes the spliced
     * preview file to {@code previewOutFile} so Play/Pause and scrubbing work
     * immediately without re-rendering.
     */
    static LiveRegionResult renderRegionLive(File raw, DspChain chain,
                                             int baseBuckets, int sampleRate,
                                             float startFrac, float endFrac,
                                             File previewOutFile) {
        return renderRegionInternal(raw, chain, baseBuckets, sampleRate,
                startFrac, endFrac, previewOutFile, true);
    }

    private static LiveRegionResult renderRegionInternal(
            File raw, DspChain chain, int buckets, int sampleRate,
            float startFrac, float endFrac, File previewOutFile,
            boolean isLiveTimeline) {
        if (raw == null || chain == null || buckets <= 0) return null;
        if (!(startFrac < endFrac)) return null;
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(raf);
            long onDisk = Math.max(0, raf.length() - h.dataStart);
            long dataBytes = (h.dataBytes <= 0 || h.dataBytes > onDisk)
                    ? onDisk : h.dataBytes;
            int ch = Math.max(1, h.channels);
            long totalFrames = dataBytes / 4 / ch;
            if (totalFrames <= 0) return null;
            long start = Math.max(0L, Math.min(totalFrames,
                    Math.round(startFrac * totalFrames)));
            long end = Math.max(start, Math.min(totalFrames,
                    Math.round(endFrac * totalFrames)));
            if (end <= start) return null;

            int bStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(buckets - 1,
                    Math.round(startFrac * buckets)));
            int bEnd = Math.max(bStart + 1, Math.min(buckets,
                    Math.round(endFrac * buckets)));
            int origRegionBuckets = Math.max(1, bEnd - bStart);

            if (!chain.offlineProcessors().isEmpty()) {
                float[] drySel = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, start, end);
                int dryFrames = drySel != null ? drySel.length / ch : 0;
                float[] dryEnv = computePerceptualBuckets(
                        drySel, dryFrames, ch, origRegionBuckets);

                float[] rendered = chain.renderRegionOfflineAndInPlace(
                        raw, start, end, sampleRate);
                if (rendered == null || rendered.length == 0) return null;
                int rFrames = rendered.length / ch;
                if (rFrames <= 0) return null;
                long tailFrames = Math.max(0L, totalFrames - end);
                long newTotalFrames = start + rFrames + tailFrames;

                boolean hasGenerator = false;
                boolean hasReverse = false;
                for (AudioProcessor p : chain.offlineProcessors()) {
                    if (p instanceof AudioGeneratorTool) hasGenerator = true;
                    if (p instanceof ReverseProcessor) hasReverse = true;
                }

                if (!isLiveTimeline) {
                    float[] peaks = new float[buckets];
                    float[] wetEnv = computePerceptualBuckets(
                            rendered, rFrames, ch, origRegionBuckets);
                    for (int f = 0; f < rFrames; f++) {
                        float peak = 0f;
                        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                            float a = Math.abs(rendered[f * ch + c]);
                            if (a > peak) peak = a;
                        }
                        int b = bStart + (int) ((long) f * origRegionBuckets
                                / Math.max(1, rFrames));
                        if (b < 0) b = 0;
                        if (b >= buckets) b = buckets - 1;
                        if (peak > peaks[b]) peaks[b] = peak;
                    }
                    if (!hasGenerator && !hasReverse) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < origRegionBuckets; i++) {
                            int b = bStart + i;
                            if (b < buckets && dryEnv[i] > 1e-4f) {
                                float ratio = wetEnv[i] / dryEnv[i];
                                peaks[b] = 0.5f * peaks[b] + 0.5f * (peaks[b] * ratio);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return new LiveRegionResult(peaks, null, false,
                            newTotalFrames, start, start + rFrames, null);
                }

                int newRegionBuckets = (rFrames == dryFrames)
                        ? origRegionBuckets
                        : Math.max(1, Math.min(8192,
                                Math.round((float) rFrames * buckets
                                        / Math.max(1L, totalFrames))));
                float[] regionPeaks = new float[newRegionBuckets];
                for (int f = 0; f < rFrames; f++) {
                    float peak = 0f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float a = Math.abs(rendered[f * ch + c]);
                        if (a > peak) peak = a;
                    }
                    int b = (int) ((long) f * newRegionBuckets
                            / Math.max(1, rFrames));
                    if (b < 0) b = 0;
                    if (b >= newRegionBuckets) b = newRegionBuckets - 1;
                    if (peak > regionPeaks[b]) regionPeaks[b] = peak;
                }

                float[] wetEnv = computePerceptualBuckets(
                        rendered, rFrames, ch, newRegionBuckets);
                float[] gainRatios = null;
                if (!hasGenerator) {
                    gainRatios = new float[newRegionBuckets];
                    float meanDry = 0f;
                    for (float d : dryEnv) meanDry += d;
                    meanDry /= Math.max(1, dryEnv.length);
                    for (int i = 0; i < newRegionBuckets; i++) {
                        int dIdx = Math.min(origRegionBuckets - 1,
                                (int) ((long) i * origRegionBuckets
                                        / Math.max(1, newRegionBuckets)));
                        if (hasReverse) {
                            int revIdx = origRegionBuckets - 1 - dIdx;
                            float ref = dryEnv[revIdx] > 1e-4f ? dryEnv[revIdx] : meanDry;
                            gainRatios[i] = ref > 1e-4f ? (wetEnv[i] / ref) : -1f;
                        } else if (rFrames == dryFrames && dryEnv[dIdx] > 1e-4f) {
                            gainRatios[i] = wetEnv[i] / dryEnv[dIdx];
                            regionPeaks[i] = 0.5f * regionPeaks[i]
                                    + 0.5f * (regionPeaks[i] * gainRatios[i]);
                        } else if (meanDry > 1e-4f) {
                            gainRatios[i] = wetEnv[i] / meanDry;
                        } else {
                            gainRatios[i] = -1f;
                        }
                    }
                }

                File outWav = null;
                if (previewOutFile != null) {
                    writeSplicedPreviewWav(raf, h, start, end, totalFrames,
                            rendered, rFrames, previewOutFile);
                    outWav = previewOutFile;
                }
                return new LiveRegionResult(regionPeaks, gainRatios, true,
                        newTotalFrames, start, start + rFrames, outWav);
            }

            chain.reset();
            chain.prepareOffline(raw, start, end, sampleRate, ch);

            float[] dryPeaks = new float[buckets];
            float[] wetPeaks = new float[buckets];
            double[] drySumSq = new double[buckets];
            double[] wetSumSq = new double[buckets];
            double[] drySumFlux = new double[buckets];
            double[] wetSumFlux = new double[buckets];
            int[] bucketFrames = new int[buckets];

            int chunkFrames = 4096;
            byte[] rawBuf = new byte[chunkFrames * ch * 4];
            float[] fBuf = new float[chunkFrames * ch];
            float[] dryBuf = new float[chunkFrames * ch];
            ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(rawBuf)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);

            // Warm the chain's filter/envelope state just before the region.
            int preRoll = (int) Math.min(Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES, start);
            if (preRoll > 0) {
                raf.seek(h.dataStart + (start - preRoll) * ch * 4L);
                raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, preRoll * ch * 4);
                bb.clear();
                bb.limit(preRoll * ch * 4);
                bb.asFloatBuffer().get(fBuf, 0, preRoll * ch);
                chain.processInPlace(fBuf, preRoll);
            }

            // Prime the latency line so output frame `cur` aligns with input
            // frame `cur`, matching the offline apply path.
            final int latencyFrames = Math.max(0, chain.getLatencyFrames());
            float[] postContext = null;
            int postContextFrames = 0;
            if (latencyFrames > 0) {
                postContextFrames = (int) Math.min(latencyFrames,
                        Math.max(0L, totalFrames - end));
                if (postContextFrames > 0) {
                    postContext = new float[postContextFrames * ch];
                    byte[] pcBuf = new byte[postContextFrames * ch * 4];
                    raf.seek(h.dataStart + end * ch * 4L);
                    raf.readFully(pcBuf);
                    ByteBuffer.wrap(pcBuf).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                            .asFloatBuffer().get(postContext);
                }
                int remaining = latencyFrames;
                long pos = start;
                while (remaining > 0) {
                    int step = Math.min(chunkFrames, remaining);
                    int fromSel = (int) Math.max(0L,
                            Math.min((long) step, end - pos));
                    if (fromSel > 0) {
                        raf.seek(h.dataStart + pos * ch * 4L);
                        raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, fromSel * ch * 4);
                        bb.clear();
                        bb.limit(fromSel * ch * 4);
                        bb.asFloatBuffer().get(fBuf, 0, fromSel * ch);
                    }
                    for (int f = fromSel; f < step; f++) {
                        long postIdx = (pos + f) - end;
                        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                            fBuf[f * ch + c] = (postContext != null
                                    && postIdx >= 0
                                    && postIdx < postContextFrames)
                                    ? postContext[(int) postIdx * ch + c] : 0f;
                        }
                    }
                    chain.processInPlace(fBuf, step);
                    pos += step;
                    remaining -= step;
                }
            }

            float prevDry = 0f;
            float prevWet = 0f;
            long cur = start;
            while (cur < end) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunkFrames, end - cur);
                // Read aligned dry frames for [cur, cur + want)
                raf.seek(h.dataStart + cur * ch * 4L);
                raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, want * ch * 4);
                bb.clear();
                bb.limit(want * ch * 4);
                bb.asFloatBuffer().get(dryBuf, 0, want * ch);

                // Read latency-offset frames for wet processing
                if (latencyFrames == 0) {
                    System.arraycopy(dryBuf, 0, fBuf, 0, want * ch);
                } else {
                    long inStart = cur + latencyFrames;
                    int fromFile = (int) Math.max(0L,
                            Math.min((long) want, end - inStart));
                    if (fromFile > 0) {
                        raf.seek(h.dataStart + inStart * ch * 4L);
                        raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, fromFile * ch * 4);
                        bb.clear();
                        bb.limit(fromFile * ch * 4);
                        bb.asFloatBuffer().get(fBuf, 0, fromFile * ch);
                    }
                    if (fromFile < want) {
                        for (int f = fromFile; f < want; f++) {
                            long absFrame = inStart + f;
                            long postIdx = absFrame - end;
                            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                                fBuf[f * ch + c] = (postContext != null
                                        && postIdx >= 0
                                        && postIdx < postContextFrames)
                                        ? postContext[(int) postIdx * ch + c] : 0f;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                chain.processInPlace(fBuf, want);
                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                    float dPeak = 0f;
                    float wPeak = 0f;
                    float dMono = 0f;
                    float wMono = 0f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float dv = dryBuf[f * ch + c];
                        float wv = fBuf[f * ch + c];
                        float da = Math.abs(dv);
                        float wa = Math.abs(wv);
                        if (da > dPeak) dPeak = da;
                        if (wa > wPeak) wPeak = wa;
                        dMono += dv;
                        wMono += wv;
                    }
                    dMono /= ch;
                    wMono /= ch;
                    int b = (int) ((cur + f) * buckets / totalFrames);
                    if (b < 0) b = 0;
                    if (b >= buckets) b = buckets - 1;
                    if (dPeak > dryPeaks[b]) dryPeaks[b] = dPeak;
                    if (wPeak > wetPeaks[b]) wetPeaks[b] = wPeak;
                    drySumSq[b] += (double) dMono * dMono;
                    wetSumSq[b] += (double) wMono * wMono;
                    drySumFlux[b] += Math.abs(dMono - prevDry);
                    wetSumFlux[b] += Math.abs(wMono - prevWet);
                    prevDry = dMono;
                    prevWet = wMono;
                    bucketFrames[b]++;
                }
                cur += want;
            }

            float[] outPeaks = new float[buckets];
            float[] gainRatios = new float[buckets];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(gainRatios, -1f);
            for (int b = 0; b < buckets; b++) {
                int cnt = bucketFrames[b];
                if (cnt <= 0) continue;
                float dRms = (float) Math.sqrt(drySumSq[b] / cnt);
                float wRms = (float) Math.sqrt(wetSumSq[b] / cnt);
                float dFlux = (float) (drySumFlux[b] / cnt);
                float wFlux = (float) (wetSumFlux[b] / cnt);
                float dEnv = 0.45f * dryPeaks[b] + 0.35f * (dRms * 1.414f)
                        + 0.20f * (dFlux * 1.85f);
                float wEnv = 0.45f * wetPeaks[b] + 0.35f * (wRms * 1.414f)
                        + 0.20f * (wFlux * 1.85f);
                if (dEnv > 1e-4f && dryPeaks[b] > 1e-4f) {
                    float envRatio = wEnv / dEnv;
                    float peakRatio = wetPeaks[b] / dryPeaks[b];
                    // Blend true peak ratio with perceptual spectral/RMS ratio
                    // so both broadband gain and narrow-band EQ/filter/de-esser
                    // changes are reflected smoothly on the waveform.
                    float combinedRatio = (Math.abs(peakRatio - 1f) > 0.04f)
                            ? (0.65f * peakRatio + 0.35f * envRatio)
                            : envRatio;
                    gainRatios[b] = Math.max(0f, combinedRatio);
                    outPeaks[b] = dryPeaks[b] * gainRatios[b];
                } else {
                    outPeaks[b] = wetPeaks[b];
                    gainRatios[b] = -1f;
                }
            }

            return new LiveRegionResult(outPeaks, gainRatios, false,
                    totalFrames, start, end, null);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void writeSplicedPreviewWav(RandomAccessFile rawRaf,
                                               Dsp.WavHeader h,
                                               long startFrame,
                                               long endFrame,
                                               long totalFrames,
                                               float[] rendered,
                                               int rFrames,
                                               File outFile) throws Exception {
        int ch = Math.max(1, h.channels);
        long frameBytes = ch * 4L;
        long prefixFrames = Math.max(0L, startFrame);
        long suffixFrames = Math.max(0L, totalFrames - endFrame);
        long newTotalFrames = prefixFrames + rFrames + suffixFrames;
        long payloadBytes = newTotalFrames * frameBytes;

        try (RandomAccessFile out = new RandomAccessFile(outFile, "rw")) {
            out.setLength(0);
            out.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, h.sampleRate, payloadBytes));
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];

            long prefixBytes = prefixFrames * frameBytes;
            if (prefixBytes > 0) {
                rawRaf.seek(h.dataStart);
                long left = prefixBytes;
                while (left > 0) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                    int n = rawRaf.read(buf, 0, want);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    out.write(buf, 0, n);
                    left -= n;
                }
            }

            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(out, rendered, 0, rFrames * ch);

            long suffixBytes = suffixFrames * frameBytes;
            if (suffixBytes > 0) {
                rawRaf.seek(h.dataStart + endFrame * frameBytes);
                long left = suffixBytes;
                while (left > 0) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                    int n = rawRaf.read(buf, 0, want);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    out.write(buf, 0, n);
                    left -= n;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/NoiseGateExpanderProcessor.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 noise gate / downward expander with a hysteresis state machine
 * (closed, attack, open, hold, release), a sidechain high-pass so low
 * rumble cannot false-trigger the gate, and a configurable level reduction
 * range.
 */
final class NoiseGateExpanderProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Gate", "Downward Expander"};

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gate_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_thresh", "Threshold", -96f, -6f, -42f));
    private final FxParameter hysteresis = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_hyst", "Hysteresis", 0f, 12f, 4f));
    private final FxParameter range = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_range", "Level Reduction", -100f, 0f, -24f));
    private final FxParameter ratio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_ratio", "Ratio", ":1", 1.2f, 10f, 2.5f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_attack", "Attack", " ms", 0.5f, 250f, 8f));
    private final FxParameter hold = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_hold", "Hold", " ms", 0f, 1000f, 60f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_release", "Release", " ms", 10f, 3000f, 220f));
    private final FxParameter sidechainHpf = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_hpf", "Sidechain HPF", " Hz", 20, 2000, 10, 120));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter scFilter = new BiquadFilter();
    private DynamicsDetector.PeakHold peakHold;
    private float gainDb = 0f;
    private boolean open = false;
    private int holdCounter = 0;

    NoiseGateExpanderProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "gateexp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Gate / Expander";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Hysteresis gate and downward expander with sidechain HPF";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        peakHold = new DynamicsDetector.PeakHold();
        rebuildSidechain();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scFilter.reset();
        if (peakHold != null) peakHold.reset();
        gainDb = 0f;
        open = false;
        holdCounter = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && range.getFloat() < -0.01f;
    }

    private void rebuildSidechain() {
        float f = Math.max(20f, sidechainHpf.getCurrentRaw());
        scFilter.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, f, 0.7071)},
                channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuildSidechain();
        if (peakHold == null) peakHold = new DynamicsDetector.PeakHold();

        float thresh = threshold.getFloat();
        float hyst = hysteresis.getFloat();
        float rangeDb = range.getFloat();
        boolean expander = mode.getEnumIndex() == 1;
        float expRatio = ratio.getFloat();
        float attCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.0005f, attack.getFloat() * 0.001f) * sampleRate)));
        float relCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.001f, release.getFloat() * 0.001f) * sampleRate)));
        float holdMs = hold.getFloat();
        int holdFrames = Math.max(0,
                (int) (holdMs * 0.001f * sampleRate));

        float maxSigDb = -120f;
        float minSigDb = 0f;
        for (int off = 0; off < frames; off += 256) {
            int cnt = Math.min(256, frames - off);
            float pk = peakOf(buf, off, cnt, ch);
            float db = Dsp.linToDb(pk);
            if (off == 0 || db < minSigDb) minSigDb = db;
            if (db > maxSigDb) maxSigDb = db;
        }
        float normT = (thresh - (-96f)) / 90f;
        float effThresh = (minSigDb > thresh + 6f)
                ? (minSigDb + normT * Math.max(6f, maxSigDb - minSigDb))
                : thresh;

        final int block = 32;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] side = new float[n * ch];
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, side, 0, side.length);
            scFilter.process(side, n, ch);
            float levelDb = Dsp.linToDb(peakOf(side, 0, n, ch));
            float detectDb = peakHold.update(levelDb, n,
                    holdMs, sampleRate);

            if (!open) {
                if (detectDb > effThresh + hyst * 0.5f) {
                    open = true;
                    holdCounter = holdFrames;
                }
            } else {
                if (detectDb < effThresh - hyst * 0.5f) {
                    if (holdCounter > 0) {
                        holdCounter -= n;
                    } else {
                        open = false;
                    }
                } else {
                    holdCounter = holdFrames;
                }
            }

            float target;
            if (expander) {
                target = open ? 0f : DynamicsDetector.expanderGainDb(
                        detectDb, effThresh + hyst * 0.25f, rangeDb, expRatio);
            } else {
                float kneeSpan = Math.max(1f, 6f / Math.max(1f, expRatio * 0.5f));
                if (open) {
                    float margin = Math.max(0f, (effThresh + kneeSpan) - detectDb);
                    target = margin > 0f ? (rangeDb * Math.min(0.35f, margin / (kneeSpan * 3f))) : 0f;
                } else {
                    float under = Math.max(0f, (effThresh - hyst * 0.25f) - detectDb);
                    float ratioFactor = Math.min(1f, (under + 1f) * (expRatio / 10f));
                    target = rangeDb * (0.55f + 0.45f * ratioFactor);
                }
            }
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                float coef = (target > gainDb) ? attCoef : relCoef;
                gainDb += coef * (target - gainDb);
                float g = Dsp.dbToLin(gainDb);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= g;
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }

    private static float peakOf(float[] buf, int startFrame, int frames, int ch) {
        float peak = 0f;
        int start = startFrame * ch;
        int end = Math.min(buf.length, start + frames * ch);
        for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
            float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
            if (a > peak) peak = a;
        }
        return peak;
    }
}

/**
 * Centered modal dialogs (overlaying the current screen) replacing the old
 * bottom sheets. Sort options appear as distinct pills, rename is a centered
 * input modal, deletes ask for confirmation, and every success/failure gets
 * its own styled popup. All dialogs pop/scale in and out and cap their width
 * cleanly in landscape mode.
 */
public final class OptionsSheet {

    /** Maximum width in dp for standard centered dialogs (save/discard/confirm/etc.). */
    public static final int MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP = 380;
    /** Maximum width in dp for the 2-pane landscape Recording Settings dialog. */
    public static final int MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP = 620;

    private OptionsSheet() {}

    private static Dialog activeTopPopup;
    private static final Handler TOP_POPUP_HANDLER =
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    /**
     * Enforces at most two words on stylized top popup titles so banners
     * stay scannable at a glance.
     */
    static String compactTwoWords(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        String clean = text.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        String[] parts = clean.split(" ");
        if (parts.length <= 2) return clean;
        return parts[0] + " " + parts[1];
    }

    public static final class Item {
        public final int icon;
        public final String label;
        public final String sub;
        public final boolean destructive;
        public final boolean checked;
        public final Runnable action;

        public Item(int icon, String label, boolean destructive, boolean checked,
                    Runnable action) {
            this(icon, label, null, destructive, checked, action);
        }

        public Item(int icon, String label, String sub, boolean destructive,
                    boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            this.icon = icon;
            this.label = label;
            this.sub = sub;
            this.destructive = destructive;
            this.checked = checked;
            this.action = action;
        }

        public static Item of(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, false, false, action);
        }

        public static Item danger(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, true, false, action);
        }

        /** Two-line row: title + smaller spec line (presets, save formats). */
        public static Item detail(String label, String sub, boolean checked,
                                  Runnable action) {
            return new Item(0, label, sub, false, checked, action);
        }

        /** Two-line row with a leading icon. */
        public static Item detail(int icon, String label, String sub,
                                  boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, sub, false, checked, action);
        }
    }

    /** One save-format toggle chip inside the unified recording dialog. */
    public static final class Chip {
        public final String label;
        /** Approximate storage per minute, e.g. "17 MB/min". */
        public final String size;
        public final boolean checked;
        public final Runnable action;

        public Chip(String label, String size, boolean checked,
                    Runnable action) {
            this.label = label;
            this.size = size;
            this.checked = checked;
            this.action = action;
        }

        public static Chip of(String label, String size, boolean checked,
                              Runnable action) {
            return new Chip(label, size, checked, action);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Live state behind the unified recording dialog. Lists are re-queried
     * after every tap so checkmarks follow the actual selection; order must
     * be stable across calls.
     */
    public interface SettingsState {
        java.util.List&lt;Item&gt; presets();
        java.util.List&lt;Chip&gt; formats();
        String formatHint();
    }

    public interface SaveCallback {
        void onSave(String text);
    }

    /** Input modal that also reports when the user backs out / cancels. */

     * Same, but {@code allowSame} skips the "already the current name" error so
