                                           String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback,
                                           Runnable onCancel, boolean allowSame) {
        showInputInternal(ctx, title, initial, saveLabel, callback, onCancel, allowSame);
    }

    // ---- centered pill options (sort, export, …) ----

    public static void show(Context ctx, String title, List&lt;Item&gt; items) {
        showOptions(ctx, title, null, items);
    }

    public static void showOptions(Context ctx, String title, String subtitle,
                                   List&lt;Item&gt; items) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_options, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle);
        titleView.setText(title);
        TextView subView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSubtitle);
        if (subtitle != null && !subtitle.isEmpty()) {
            subView.setText(subtitle);
            subView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        LinearLayout container = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogOptions);
        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(ctx);
        for (int i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
            final Item item = items.get(i);
            View pillWrap = new FrameLayout(ctx);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams wrapLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            if (i > 0) wrapLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
            pillWrap.setLayoutParams(wrapLp);

            View row = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_pill_row, (FrameLayout) pillWrap, false);
            row.setBackgroundResource(item.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            TextView label = row.findViewById(R.id.pillLabel);
            label.setText(item.label);
            if (item.destructive) {
                label.setTextColor(0xFFFF3B30);
            } else if (item.checked) {
                label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            }
            TextView sub = row.findViewById(R.id.pillSub);
            if (sub != null) {
                if (item.sub != null && !item.sub.isEmpty()) {
                    sub.setText(item.sub);
                    sub.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                } else {
                    sub.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                }
            }
            ImageView iconView = row.findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (item.icon != 0) {
                iconView.setImageResource(item.icon);
            } else {
                iconView.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_wave);
            }
            iconView.setAlpha(item.checked ? 1f : 0.8f);
            iconView.setColorFilter(item.destructive
                    ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFFF2F4F7);
            iconView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            ImageView check = row.findViewById(R.id.pillCheck);
            check.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
            check.setVisibility(item.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.96f).scaleY(0.96f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                    dialog.dismiss();
                    if (item.action != null) item.action.run();
                }).start();
            });
            ((FrameLayout) pillWrap).addView(row);
            container.addView(pillWrap);

            // Staggered entrance: each pill slides up + fades in.
            row.setAlpha(0f);
            row.setTranslationY(dp(ctx, 14));
            row.animate()
                    .alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setStartDelay(60 + i * 55L)
                    .setDuration(260)
                    .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
        }

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
    }

    /**
     * Two primary choices rendered side by side, with the redundant bottom
     * Cancel button removed. Used by the Back/Stop/Edit/Trim modals.
     */
    public static Dialog showTwoChoiceModal(Context ctx, String title,
                                            String subtitle,
                                            Item first, Item second) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_options, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle);
        titleView.setText(title != null ? title : "");
        TextView subView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSubtitle);
        if (subtitle != null && !subtitle.isEmpty()) {
            subView.setText(subtitle);
            subView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        View scroll = root.findViewById(R.id.optScroll);
        if (scroll != null) scroll.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        if (cancel != null) cancel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        LinearLayout row = root.findViewById(R.id.optHorizontalRow);
        row.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        row.removeAllViews();

        Item[] pair = new Item[]{first, second};
        for (int i = 0; i < pair.length; i++) {
            Item item = pair[i];
            if (item == null) continue;
            TextView btn = new TextView(ctx);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    0, dp(ctx, 46), 1f);
            if (i > 0) lp.setMarginStart(dp(ctx, 10));
            btn.setLayoutParams(lp);
            btn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            btn.setText(item.label);
            btn.setTextSize(14f);
            btn.setTypeface(btn.getTypeface(), android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            btn.setPadding(dp(ctx, 10), 0, dp(ctx, 10), 0);
            if (item.icon != 0) {
                btn.setCompoundDrawablesRelativeWithIntrinsicBounds(
                        item.icon, 0, 0, 0);
                btn.setCompoundDrawablePadding(dp(ctx, 6));
            }
            if (item.destructive) {
                btn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_danger);
                btn.setTextColor(0xFFFF3B30);
            } else {
                btn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
                btn.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
            }
            PressAnim.apply(btn);
            btn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                if (item.action != null) item.action.run();
            });
            row.addView(btn);
        }

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        return dialog;
    }

    // ---- unified recording settings: presets + format toggles ----

    /**
     * One dialog for everything that shapes the next take:
     * - In portrait mode: split vertically in half (presets on top, save
     *   formats below).
     * - In landscape mode: split in half side-by-side (left pane = presets,
     *   right pane = save formats), matching the 2-pane Studio UI so all
     *   options fit cleanly without overflowing.
     */
    public static void showRecordingSettings(Context ctx, String title,
                                             String presetLabel, String presetHint,
                                             String formatLabel, SettingsState state,
                                             String doneLabel) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

        DisplayMetrics dm = ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        boolean isLand = dm.widthPixels > dm.heightPixels;

        android.widget.ScrollView scroll = new android.widget.ScrollView(ctx);
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 21) root.setElevation(dp(ctx, 16));
        int pad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 14 : 18);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root,
                new android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams(
                        android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        TextView titleView = new TextView(ctx);
        titleView.setText(title);
        titleView.setTextSize(isLand ? 16 : 18);
        titleView.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
        titleView.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        titleView.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        root.addView(titleView);

        // Two-pane container: HORIZONTAL 50/50 split in landscape, VERTICAL split in portrait
        LinearLayout splitContainer = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        splitContainer.setId(R.id.dialogOptions);
        splitContainer.setOrientation(isLand ? LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL : LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams splitLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        splitLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 6 : 8);
        root.addView(splitContainer, splitLp);

        LinearLayout presetPane = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        presetPane.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams presetPaneLp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        if (isLand) presetPaneLp.rightMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
        splitContainer.addView(presetPane, presetPaneLp);

        View divider = new View(ctx);
        divider.setBackgroundColor(0x22FFFFFF);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams dlp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 1), LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(ctx, 1));
        if (!isLand) {
            dlp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 10);
            dlp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 2);
        }
        splitContainer.addView(divider, dlp);

        LinearLayout formatPane = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        formatPane.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams formatPaneLp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        if (isLand) formatPaneLp.leftMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
        splitContainer.addView(formatPane, formatPaneLp);

        // Populate Left / Top Half: Recording Presets
        presetPane.addView(sectionLabel(ctx, presetLabel, isLand ? 2 : 6));
        if (presetHint != null && !presetHint.isEmpty()) {
            TextView hint = new TextView(ctx);
            hint.setText(presetHint);
            hint.setTextSize(10.5f);
            hint.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams hlp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            hlp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 2);
            presetPane.addView(hint, hlp);
        }

        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(ctx);
        java.util.List<View> pillRows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<TextView> pillLabels = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<ImageView> pillChecks = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<Integer> pillDefaultColors = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<View> chipViews = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<TextView> chipNames = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<TextView> chipSizes = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final TextView formatHintView = new TextView(ctx);
        formatHintView.setTextSize(10.5f);
        formatHintView.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        for (Item item : state.presets()) {
            final Item it = item;
            View row = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_pill_row, presetPane, false);
            row.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 44 : 50));
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams rlp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rlp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 5 : 6);
            presetPane.addView(row, rlp);
            TextView label = row.findViewById(R.id.pillLabel);
            label.setText(it.label);
            if (isLand) label.setTextSize(13);
            TextView sub = row.findViewById(R.id.pillSub);
            if (sub != null) {
                if (it.sub != null && !it.sub.isEmpty()) {
                    sub.setText(it.sub);
                    if (isLand) sub.setTextSize(10.5f);
                    sub.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                } else {
                    sub.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                }
            }
            ImageView dot = row.findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (it.icon != 0) {
                dot.setImageResource(it.icon);
                dot.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
            } else {
                dot.setImageResource(R.drawable.bg_thumb);
                int inset = dp(ctx, 5);
                dot.setPadding(inset, inset, inset, inset);
            }
            dot.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            ImageView check = row.findViewById(R.id.pillCheck);
            pillRows.add(row);
            pillLabels.add(label);
            pillChecks.add(check);
            pillDefaultColors.add(label.getTextColors().getDefaultColor());
            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (it.action != null) it.action.run();
                rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                        pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                        formatHintView);
            });
        }

        // Populate Right / Bottom Half: Save Formats
        formatPane.addView(sectionLabel(ctx, formatLabel, isLand ? 2 : 8));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams flp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        flp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
        formatPane.addView(formatHintView, flp);

        android.widget.GridLayout grid = new android.widget.GridLayout(ctx);
        grid.setColumnCount(3);
        grid.setUseDefaultMargins(false);
        formatPane.addView(grid, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        for (Chip chip : state.formats()) {
            final Chip c = chip;
            LinearLayout cell = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            cell.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            cell.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cell.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int hPad = dp(ctx, 5);
            int vPadCell = dp(ctx, isLand ? 6 : 7);
            cell.setPadding(hPad, vPadCell, hPad, vPadCell);
            cell.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 44));

            TextView name = new TextView(ctx);
            name.setText(c.label);
            name.setTextSize(isLand ? 11 : 12);
            name.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            name.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            name.setSingleLine(true);
            name.setEllipsize(android.text.TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
            cell.addView(name);

            TextView size = new TextView(ctx);
            size.setText(c.size);
            size.setTextSize(9.5f);
            size.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            size.setSingleLine(true);
            size.setAlpha(0.85f);
            cell.addView(size);

            android.widget.GridLayout.LayoutParams glp =
                    new android.widget.GridLayout.LayoutParams();
            glp.width = 0;
            glp.columnSpec = android.widget.GridLayout.spec(
                    android.widget.GridLayout.UNDEFINED, 1f);
            int m = dp(ctx, 3);
            glp.setMargins(m, m, m, m);
            cell.setLayoutParams(glp);
            grid.addView(cell);
            chipViews.add(cell);
            chipNames.add(name);
            chipSizes.add(size);
            PressAnim.apply(cell);
            cell.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (c.action != null) c.action.run();
                rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                        pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                        formatHintView);
            });
        }

        TextView done = new TextView(ctx);
        done.setText(doneLabel);
        done.setTextSize(14);
        done.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
        done.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        done.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        done.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        done.setMinHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 46));
        int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 9 : 12);
        done.setPadding(dp(ctx, 16), vPad, dp(ctx, 16), vPad);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams blp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        blp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 10 : 14);
        root.addView(done, blp);
        PressAnim.apply(done);
        done.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        dialog.setContentView(scroll);
        rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                formatHintView);
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog,
                isLand ? MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP : MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
        dialog.show();
    }

    private static TextView sectionLabel(Context ctx, String text, int topMarginDp) {
        TextView tv = new TextView(ctx);
        tv.setText(text);
        tv.setTextSize(10);
        tv.setLetterSpacing(0.1f);
        tv.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = dp(ctx, topMarginDp);
        tv.setLayoutParams(lp);
        return tv;
    }

    private static void rebindSettings(SettingsState state,
                                       java.util.List&lt;View&gt; pillRows,
                                       java.util.List&lt;TextView&gt; pillLabels,
                                       java.util.List&lt;ImageView&gt; pillChecks,
                                       java.util.List&lt;Integer&gt; pillColors,
                                       java.util.List&lt;View&gt; chipViews,
                                       java.util.List&lt;TextView&gt; chipNames,
                                       java.util.List&lt;TextView&gt; chipSizes,
                                       TextView hintView) {
        java.util.List&lt;Item&gt; presets;
        java.util.List&lt;Chip&gt; formats;
        try {
            presets = state.presets();
            formats = state.formats();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pillRows.size() && i < presets.size(); i++) {
            Item it = presets.get(i);
            pillRows.get(i).setBackgroundResource(it.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            pillLabels.get(i).setTextColor(it.checked
                    ? 0xFFF2F4F7 : pillColors.get(i));
            pillChecks.get(i).setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
            pillChecks.get(i).setVisibility(
                    it.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
            ImageView dot = pillRows.get(i).findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (dot != null) dot.setColorFilter(it.icon != 0
                    ? (it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF9AA4B2)
                    : (it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < chipViews.size() && i < formats.size(); i++) {
            Chip c = formats.get(i);
            chipViews.get(i).setBackgroundResource(c.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int col = c.checked ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF;
            chipNames.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setText(c.size);
            chipNames.get(i).setText(c.label);
        }
        try {
            hintView.setText(state.formatHint());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- centered rename / input modal ----

    public static void showInput(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                 String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback) {
        showInputInternal(ctx, title, initial, saveLabel, callback, null, false);
    }

    private static void showInputInternal(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                          String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback,
                                          Runnable onCancel, boolean allowSame) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_input, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        EditText input = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogInput);
        TextView error = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogError);
        input.setText(initial == null ? "" : initial);
        input.setHint(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_hint));
        try {
            input.setSelection(input.getText().length());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView save = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSave);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        save.setText(saveLabel);
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(save);

        final boolean[] settled = {false};
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
        });
        try {
            dialog.setOnCancelListener(d -> {
                if (!settled[0] && onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        save.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String text = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (text.isEmpty()) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_empty_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            if (!allowSame && text.equals(initial != null ? initial.trim() : "")) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_same_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (callback != null) callback.onSave(text);
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        if (dialog.getWindow() != null) {
            dialog.getWindow().setSoftInputMode(
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                            | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
        }
        dialog.show();
        input.post(() -> {
            input.requestFocus();
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.showSoftInput(input, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT);
        });
    }

                                   String confirmLabel, boolean danger,

        showConfirm(ctx, title, message, confirmLabel,
                danger ? R.drawable.ic_trash : R.drawable.ic_check, danger, onConfirm);
    }

    public static void showConfirm(Context ctx, String title, String message,
                                   String confirmLabel, int iconRes,
                                   boolean danger, Runnable onConfirm) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_confirm, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogMessage)).setText(message);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon);
        icon.setImageResource(iconRes);
        View iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() instanceof View
                ? (View) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() : null;

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView confirm = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogConfirm);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        confirm.setText(confirmLabel);
        if (danger) {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
            confirm.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        } else {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        }
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(confirm);

        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());
        confirm.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            v.animate().scaleX(0.94f).scaleY(0.94f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                if (onConfirm != null) onConfirm.run();
            }).start();
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        if (iconBg != null) PressAnim.pop(iconBg);
    }

    // ---- success / failure result popup ----

    public static void showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message) {
        showResult(ctx, success, title, message, null);
    }

    /** @return the shown dialog, so callers/tests can drive or dismiss it. */
    public static android.app.Dialog showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message,
                                  Runnable onOk) {
        if (activeTopPopup != null) {
            try {
                if (activeTopPopup.isShowing()) activeTopPopup.dismiss();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            activeTopPopup = null;
        }
        TOP_POPUP_HANDLER.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);

        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_result, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        FrameLayout iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIconBg);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIcon);
        iconBg.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_icon_danger);
        icon.setImageResource(success ? R.drawable.ic_check : R.drawable.ic_close);
        icon.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle))
                .setText(compactTwoWords(title));
        TextView msg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultMessage);
        if (msg != null) {
            msg.setText("");
            msg.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
        TextView ok = root.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        if (ok != null) {
            ok.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        final boolean[] fired = {false};
        final Runnable fire = () -> {
            if (fired[0]) return;
            fired[0] = true;
            if (onOk != null) {
                try {
                    onOk.run();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        };
        if (ok != null) {
            ok.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                fire.run();
            });
        }
        root.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            dialog.dismiss();
            fire.run();
        });
        dialog.setOnDismissListener(dd -> {
            if (activeTopPopup == dialog) activeTopPopup = null;
            fire.run();
        });

        dialog.setCancelable(true);
        styleAsTopPopup(dialog);
        activeTopPopup = dialog;
        dialog.show();
        styleAsTopPopup(dialog);
        root.setTranslationY(-dp(ctx, 24));
        root.setAlpha(0f);
        root.animate()
                .translationY(0f)
                .alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(220)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .start();
        PressAnim.pop(iconBg);

        TOP_POPUP_HANDLER.postDelayed(() -> {
            try {
                if (dialog.isShowing()) dialog.dismiss();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }, 1600L);
        return dialog;
    }

    /**
     * Shows a centered modal error popup (e.g. when Google Play price fetching
     * or purchase launch fails after pressing Buy).
     */
    public static Dialog showErrorPopup(Context ctx, String title, String message) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_result, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        FrameLayout iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIconBg);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIcon);
        if (iconBg != null) iconBg.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_icon_danger);
        if (icon != null) {
            icon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_close);
            icon.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
        }

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle);
        if (titleView != null) {
            titleView.setText(title != null && !title.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? title.trim() : "Error Fetching Price");
        }
        TextView msgView = root.findViewById(R.id.resultMessage);
        if (msgView != null) {
            msgView.setText(message != null && !message.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? message.trim()
                    : "Could not fetch price from Google Play. Please check your connection and try again.");
            msgView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        TextView okBtn = root.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        if (okBtn != null) {
            okBtn.setText("OK");
            okBtn.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            PressAnim.apply(okBtn);
            okBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());
        }

        dialog.setCancelable(true);
        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        if (iconBg != null) PressAnim.pop(iconBg);
        return dialog;
    }

    /** Lightweight, non-blocking 2-word confirmation banner at the top. */
    public static void showTopPopup(Context ctx, String title, String ignoredMessage) {
        showResult(ctx, true, compactTwoWords(title), null, null);
    }

    public static void showTopPopup(Context ctx, String twoWordTitle) {
        showResult(ctx, true, compactTwoWords(twoWordTitle), null, null);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    /**
     * Anchors a dialog at the top edge as a floating banner: no dim, no
     * outside-touch blocking, full width with a small inset.
     */
    public static void styleAsTopPopup(Dialog dialog) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND);
        w.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL);
        w.setDimAmount(0f);
        w.setGravity(Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);
        w.setWindowAnimations(R.style.TopPopupAnim);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        lp.width = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL;
        lp.x = 0;
        lp.y = dp(ctx, 16);
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) decor.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    public static void styleAsCentered(Dialog dialog) {
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog, MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
    }

    public static void styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(Dialog dialog, int maxWidthDp) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        DisplayMetrics dm = ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        boolean isLand = dm.widthPixels > dm.heightPixels;
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.setDimAmount(0.62f);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        int cappedDp = Math.min(maxWidthDp, isLand ? 380 : 330);
        int maxW = dp(ctx, cappedDp);
        lp.width = Math.min(Math.round(dm.widthPixels * 0.84f), maxW);
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.CENTER;
        lp.horizontalMargin = 0f;
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) {
            int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 8 : 16);
            decor.setPadding(0, vPad, 0, vPad);
        }
    }

    private static void hideKeyboard(Context ctx, View v) {
        try {
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(v.getWindowToken(), 0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void shake(View v) {
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate()
                .translationX(14f).setDuration(55)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(-12f).setDuration(55)
                        .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(8f).setDuration(55)
                                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(0f)
                                        .setDuration(80).start()).start()).start())
                .start();
    }

    private static int dp(Context ctx, int dp) {
        return Math.round(dp * ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 plosive and breath suppressor: a dynamic low-shelf filter that
 * only engages when the sub-140 Hz energy exceeds the mid-band vowel
 * energy, so chest voice stays intact while 'P' and 'B' mic blasts are
 * tamed.
 */
final class PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter sensitivity = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "plosive_sens", "Plosive Cut Sensitivity", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter breath = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "plosive_breath", "Breath Attenuation", 0f, 24f, 8f));
    private final FxParameter lowFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "plosive_freq", "Plosive Band", " Hz", 60, 200, 10, 120));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter lowBand = new BiquadFilter();
    private BiquadFilter midBand = new BiquadFilter();
    private float gainDb = 0f;

    PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "plosive";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Plosive & Breath Suppressor";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Dynamic sub-140 Hz plosive tamer with breath attenuation";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lowBand.reset();
        midBand.reset();
        gainDb = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (sensitivity.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || breath.getFloat() > 0.01f);
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        float f = lowFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        lowBand.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, f, 0.7071)},
                channels);
        midBand.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjBandPass(sampleRate, 1000, 1.0f)},
                channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
        float sens = sensitivity.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float breathDb = breath.getFloat();

        final int block = 64;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] low = new float[n * ch];
            float[] mid = new float[n * ch];
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, low, 0, low.length);
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, mid, 0, mid.length);
            lowBand.process(low, n, ch);
            midBand.process(mid, n, ch);
            double lowE = 0;
            double midE = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n * ch; i++) {
                lowE += (double) low[i] * low[i];
                midE += (double) mid[i] * mid[i];
            }
            float lowDb = Dsp.linToDb((float) Math.sqrt(lowE / (n * ch)));
            float midDb = Dsp.linToDb((float) Math.sqrt(midE / (n * ch)));

            float target = 0f;
            float excess = (lowDb - midDb) + 6f * sens;
            if (excess > 0f) {
                target = -Math.min(24f, excess) * sens;
            }
            // Smooth breath attenuation weighted by high/mid energy ratio
            float breathWeight = (midDb < -24f) ? 1f
                    : Math.max(0.15f, Math.min(1f, (-12f - midDb) / 30f));
            float breathLin = breathDb > 0.01f
                    ? Dsp.dbToLin(-breathDb * breathWeight * 0.45f) : 1f;
            float step = (target - gainDb) / n;
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                gainDb += step;
                float g = Dsp.dbToLin(gainDb);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    int local = f * ch + c;
                    float high = buf[idx + c] - low[local];
                    buf[idx + c] = (high + low[local] * g) * breathLin;
                }
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/ProLimiterProcessor.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional brickwall ceiling limiter: zero-latency peak detection with
 * 4x inter-sample interpolation, programme-dependent release and an
 * adjustable ceiling. It keeps the legacy safety role for the rack: whenever
 * an upstream gain stage is active the limiter can enforce the ceiling even
 * with its own mix at zero.
 */
final class ProLimiterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int DECIM = 16;

    private final FxParameter drive = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "drive", "Drive", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "limiter_ceiling", "Ceiling", -6f, 0f, -0.2f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "limiter_release", "Release", " ms", 20, 500, 5, 80));

    private volatile boolean safetyOn = false;

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float gainCur = 1f;
    private final float[] prev = new float[2];

    ProLimiterProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "limiter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Brickwall Limiter Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "True-peak ceiling, drive and programme release";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        gainCur = 1f;
        prev[0] = prev[1] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (drive01() > 0.001f
                || ceiling.getFloat() < -0.25f
                || release.getCurrentRaw() != 80
                || safetyOn);
    }

    void setLegacyState(int drivePct, boolean safety) {
        drive.setCurrentRaw(drivePct);
        this.safetyOn = safety;
    }

    boolean isSafetyOn() {
        return safetyOn;
    }

    private float drive01() {
        return drive.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
    }

    private float ceilingLin() {
        return DspChain.fastDbToLin(ceiling.getCurrentRaw() / 100f);
    }

    /**
     * Unity-gain ceiling pass used when the limiter's wet/dry mix is below
     * 1.0 while upstream gain stages still need peak protection.
     */
    void enforceSafetyCeiling(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float c = ceilingLin();
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * Math.max(1,
                Math.min(2, channels)));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            buf[i] = softCeiling(buf[i], c);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        final float lAmt = drive01();
        if (lAmt <= 0.001f && !safetyOn
                && ceiling.getFloat() >= -0.25f
                && release.getCurrentRaw() == 80) {
            return;
        }

        final float c = ceilingLin();
        // Smooth quadratic-linear drive curve (0..6.5 dB) so initial low drive
        // settings (1%..20%) never produce an exaggerated jump on the waveform.
        final float driveDb = (0.30f * lAmt + 0.70f * lAmt * lAmt) * 6.5f;
        final float driveLin = lAmt > 0.001f
                ? DspChain.fastDbToLin(driveDb) : 1.0f;
        final float relSec = Math.max(1, release.getCurrentRaw()) * 0.001f;
        final float relCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (relSec * sampleRate)));
        final float attCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (0.0015f * sampleRate)));

        float bufPeak = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < frames * ch; i++) {
            float a = Math.abs(buf[i] * driveLin);
            if (a > bufPeak) bufPeak = a;
        }
        final float effThresh = Math.min(c, Math.max(1e-4f, bufPeak * 0.72f));

        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(DECIM, frames - offset);
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                float peak = 0f;
                for (int cc = 0; cc < ch; cc++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + cc] * driveLin;
                    float p = prev[cc];
                    float tp = Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(p));
                    tp = Math.max(tp, Math.abs(0.25f * x + 0.75f * p));
                    tp = Math.max(tp, Math.abs(0.5f * x + 0.5f * p));
                    tp = Math.max(tp, Math.abs(0.75f * x + 0.25f * p));
                    peak = Math.max(peak, tp);
                }
                float desired = 1f;
                if (peak > c) {
                    desired = c / peak;
                } else if (peak > effThresh && effThresh > 1e-5f) {
                    float ratio = effThresh / peak;
                    desired = 0.75f + 0.25f * ratio;
                }
                if (desired < gainCur) {
                    gainCur += attCoef * (desired - gainCur);
                } else {
                    gainCur += relCoef * (desired - gainCur);
                }
                for (int cc = 0; cc < ch; cc++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + cc] * driveLin;
                    prev[cc] = x;
                    buf[idx + cc] = softCeiling(x * gainCur, c);
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }

    private static float softCeiling(float y, float c) {
        float ay = Math.abs(y);
        float knee = c * 0.85f;
        if (ay <= knee) return y;
        float range = c - knee;
        float d = ay - knee;
        float lim = knee + range * (d / (range + d));
        return y >= 0f ? lim : -lim;
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/RecordingService.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Foreground host for an ongoing take: keeps capture alive when the app is
 * backgrounded, owns audio-focus interruption handling (pause, never
 * auto-resume) and exposes one clean persistent notification — name, preset,
 * live timer plus pause/resume, Save and Cancel actions that work without
 * opening the app.
 */
public class RecordingService extends Service {

    public static final String ACTION_START =
            "com.example.hello.REC_START";
    public static final String ACTION_TOGGLE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_TOGGLE";
    public static final String ACTION_SAVE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_SAVE";
    public static final String ACTION_CANCEL =
            "com.example.hello.REC_CANCEL";
    public static final String ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF =
            "com.example.hello.action.RESTORE_NOTIF";

    public static final String EXTRA_FORMAT = "format";

    /** Broadcast when a background save/cancel finishes. */
    public static final String BROADCAST_DONE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_DONE";
    public static final String EXTRA_OK = "ok";
    public static final String EXTRA_MESSAGE = "message";
    public static final String EXTRA_TITLE = "title";
    public static final String EXTRA_KIND = "kind"; // "save" or "cancel"

    private static final String CHANNEL = "takeone_recording";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 41;
    /** Focus losses inside this window after a (re)start are spurious. */
    private static final long FOCUS_GRACE_MS = 1200;

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private boolean ticking;
    private boolean busy; // a save/cancel is running
    private int convertingPct = -1;
    private long lastToggleAt;
    private long lastPctPush;
    private long captureStartedAt;

    private static volatile RecordingService activeInstance;

    private PendingIntent cachedContentIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedToggleIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedSaveIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedCancelIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedRestoreIntent;

    private String lastNotifTitle = "";
    private String lastNotifText = "";
    private Boolean lastNotifPaused = null;
    private int lastNotifPct = -2;
    private long lastChronoBaseMs = 0L;

    private AudioManager audioManager;
    private AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener focusListener;

    public static void start(Context ctx, String presetId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_START);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT, presetId);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            } else {
                ctx.startService(i);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                ctx.startService(i);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static void stopService(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.stopService(new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Called by RecordingEngine whenever capture starts, pauses, resumes,
     * finalizes, clears, aborts, or renames, so the notification updates
     * immediately without waiting for the next tick.
     */
    public static void onRecordingStateChanged() {
        RecordingService s = activeInstance;
        if (s != null) {
            s.handler.post(() -> s.refreshNotif(true));
        }
    }

    public static boolean isRunning(Context ctx) {
        // Best-effort: true while the engine holds an active capture session.
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        return e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        super.onCreate();
        activeInstance = this;
        ensureChannel();
        audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        initPendingIntents();
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent == null) {
            // System-restarted. START_NOT_STICKY means this should not happen,
            // but never re-enter startForeground() from here: a restart
            // racing the save could hit the Android 14+ rule that a
            // microphone FGS may not start from the background, and a
            // startForegroundService() that never promotes itself is fatal
            // to the process.
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        String a = intent.getAction();
        if (ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF.equals(a)) {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (e.hasSession() && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                    || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED)) {
                startFg();
                refreshNotif(true);
            } else {
                stopSelf();
            }
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        if (ACTION_START.equals(a)) {
            String preset = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT);
            if (preset != null) RecordPreset.of(preset).save(this);
            captureStartedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            registerFocus();
            startFg();
            startTick();
        } else if (ACTION_TOGGLE.equals(a)) {
            doToggle();
        } else if (ACTION_SAVE.equals(a)) {
            doSave();
        } else if (ACTION_CANCEL.equals(a)) {
            doCancel();
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (activeInstance == this) activeInstance = null;
        stopTick();
        abandonFocus();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ---- audio focus: interruptions pause, never auto-resume ----

    private android.media.AudioFocusRequest focusReq26;

    /**
     * True when a cellular or VoIP call (ringing, dialing, or in-call) is active.
     * Prevents resuming AudioRecord while Android's telephony policy mutes the mic.
     */
    public static boolean isCallActive(Context ctx) {
        if (ctx == null) return false;
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am != null) {
                int mode = am.getMode();
                if (mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_CALL
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_RINGTONE) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            android.telephony.TelephonyManager tm =
                    (android.telephony.TelephonyManager) ctx.getSystemService(
                            Context.TELEPHONY_SERVICE);
            if (tm != null) {
                int callState = tm.getCallState();
                if (callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_RINGING
                        || callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Requests audio focus and returns true only if granted.
     * If a call or exclusive speaker session rejects focus, returns false.
     */
    private boolean registerFocus() {
        try {
            if (isCallActive(this)) return false;
            if (audioManager == null) {
                audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            }
            if (audioManager == null) return true;
            if (focusListener == null) {
                focusListener = focus -> {
                    if (focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK) {
                        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - captureStartedAt
                                < FOCUS_GRACE_MS) {
                            return;
                        }
                        handler.post(() -> {
                            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
                            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                                e.pauseCapture();
                                abandonFocus();
                                boolean call = isCallActive(RecordingService.this);
                                toast(getString(call
                                        ? R.string.msg_paused_call
                                        : R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                                refreshNotif(true);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                };
            }
            int res;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                focusReq26 = new android.media.AudioFocusRequest.Builder(
                        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
                        .setAudioAttributes(new android.media.AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(focusListener, handler)
                        .build();
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusReq26);
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusListener,
                        AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN);
            }
            return res == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    private void abandonFocus() {
        try {
            if (audioManager != null) {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && focusReq26 != null) {
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(focusReq26);
                    focusReq26 = null;
                } else if (focusListener != null) {
                    //noinspection deprecation
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocus(focusListener);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        focusListener = null;
    }

    // ---- actions (debounced: one tap, one transition) ----

    private void doToggle() {
        if (busy) return;
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (now - lastToggleAt < 400) return;
        lastToggleAt = now;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        try {
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                e.pauseCapture();
                abandonFocus();
            } else if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED) {
                if (isCallActive(this)) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_call_active));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                captureStartedAt = now;
                if (!registerFocus()) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                e.resumeCapture(getApplicationContext(),
                        RecordPreset.load(this).audioSource);
            } else {
                return;
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            toast(getString(R.string.msg_need_mic));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            toast(getString(R.string.couldnt_save));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        }
        refreshNotif(true);
    }

    private void doSave() {
        if (busy) return;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        if (!e.hasSession()) {
            stopSelf();
            return;
        }
        if (e.isSaving()) return;
        e.setSaving(true);
        busy = true;
        RecordPreset curPreset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        SaveFormat curSave = SaveFormat.load(this);
        boolean immediateWav32 = curSave.effective(curPreset) == SaveFormat.WAV32
                && !e.isFxBakeRequired();
        convertingPct = immediateWav32 ? -1 : 0;
        lastPctPush = 0;
        refreshNotif();
        new Thread(() -> {
            boolean ok;
            String msg;
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            try {
                Context appCtx = getApplicationContext();
                if (e.isInSubSession()) {
                    // The notification saved while a Select & Replace
                    // sub-session was open: splice first, then save the parent
                    // instead of exporting only the temporary snippet.
                    boolean commitSub = e.rawFile != null
                            && RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(e.rawFile) > 0;
                    e.exitSelectAndReplaceSubSession(commitSub, null);
                }
                RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
                SaveFormat save = SaveFormat.load(this);
                // NEW-06 fix: honour and clear stashed EditLink when saving
                // an edited take from the notification action.
                String rawPath = e.rawFile != null
                        ? e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() : null;
                long replaceId = -1;
                String replaceTitle = null;
                if (EditLink.matches(appCtx, rawPath)) {
                    replaceId = EditLink.id(appCtx);
                    replaceTitle = EditLink.title(appCtx);
                }
                ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                        appCtx, preset, save, this::setPct,
                        replaceId, replaceTitle);
                EditLink.clear(appCtx);
                if (r.adopted) {
                    if (replaceId > 0) {
                        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replaceId);
                    }
                    String rt = replaceTitle != null
                            && !replaceTitle.isEmpty()
                            ? replaceTitle : r.title;
                    TakesRepository.addRecordingWithId(
                            r.recordingId, r.file, r.durationMs,
                            rt, r.label);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.convert_done_msg, r.title,
                            r.label);
                } else {
                    // Handed to the conversion service; this service is done.
                    ConversionService.startJob(appCtx, r.job.jobId);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.conv_bg_toast);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                ok = false;
                msg = getString(R.string.convert_failed_msg, title);
            }
            final boolean done = ok;
            final String text = msg;
            final String t = title;
            handler.post(() -> {
                e.setSaving(false);
                try {
                    convertingPct = -1;
                    refreshNotif();
                    Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, done);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "save");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, t);
                try {
                    // Explicit package: stays inside the app, satisfies
                    // UnsafeImplicitIntentLaunch, same delivery as before.
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                convertingPct = -1;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    CrashLog.breadcrumb(getApplicationContext(),
                            "service completion FAILED: " + ex);
                    try {
                        stopSelf();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            });
        }).start();
    }

    private void doCancel() {
        if (busy) return;
        if (RecordingEngine.get().isSaving()) return;
        busy = true;
        new Thread(() -> {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            boolean ok = e.abortAndDelete();
            EditLink.clear(getApplicationContext());
            final String text = ok
                    ? getString(R.string.delete_success_one, title)
                    : getString(R.string.delete_failed_msg);
            handler.post(() -> {
                toast(text);
                Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, ok);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "cancel");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, title);
                try {
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
            });
        }).start();
    }

    // ---- notification: one clean standard layout ----

    private void ensureChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;
        try {
            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(
                    CHANNEL, getString(R.string.notif_channel),
                    NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ch.setDescription(getString(R.string.notif_channel_desc));
            nm.createNotificationChannel(ch);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void startFg() {
        lastNotifTitle = "";
        lastNotifText = "";
        lastNotifPaused = null;
        lastNotifPct = -2;
        Notification n = buildNotif();
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n,
                        ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
            }
            return;
        } catch (Exception typed) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "typed startForeground failed: " + typed);
        }
        // Untyped retry: a service launched with startForegroundService()
        // must reach the foreground within ~5s or the system kills the app,
        // so it is always worth attempting the permissive call.
        try {
            startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "startForeground failed: " + e);
            try {
                stopSelf();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void refreshNotif() {
        refreshNotif(false);
    }

    private void refreshNotif(boolean force) {
        try {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (!e.hasSession() && !busy) return;
            String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
            boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
            RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
            String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
            long durMs = e.durationMs();
            String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

            String title;
            String text;
            if (convertingPct >= 0) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
                text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
            } else if (paused) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
                // Chronometer is hidden when paused, so show frozen MM:SS here.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                        + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
            } else {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
                // Native Chronometer in header is the single live timer;
                // do not duplicate a second text timer in contentText.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
            }

            long expectedBase = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            boolean baseDrifted = !paused && convertingPct < 0
                    && Math.abs(expectedBase - lastChronoBaseMs) > 250L;

            if (!force && !baseDrifted
                    && title.equals(lastNotifTitle)
                    && text.equals(lastNotifText)
                    && lastNotifPaused != null && lastNotifPaused == paused
                    && lastNotifPct == convertingPct) {
                return;
            }
            lastNotifTitle = title;
            lastNotifText = text;
            lastNotifPaused = paused;
            lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
            if (!paused && convertingPct < 0) {
                lastChronoBaseMs = expectedBase;
            }

            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm != null) {
                nm.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * A single standard notification: small mic icon, "Recording — name"
     * title, "preset • live timer" text and exactly three actions. Built
     * with NotificationCompat so it renders identically (and lint-clean)
     * from API 24 up, with no custom RemoteViews for the system to duplicate.
     */
    private Notification buildNotif() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
        boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
        long durMs = e.durationMs();
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

        String title;
        String text;
        if (convertingPct >= 0) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
            text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
        } else if (paused) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                    + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
        } else {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
        }
        lastNotifTitle = title;
        lastNotifText = text;
        lastNotifPaused = paused;
        lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
        return buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs);
    }

    private Notification buildNotifWith(String title, String text,
                                        boolean paused, long durMs) {
        if (cachedContentIntent == null && cachedToggleIntent == null) {
            initPendingIntents();
        }
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));
        androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL);
        b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_mic);
        // Match TakeOne brand colors: record red (#FF3B30) when active,
        // amber (#FF9F0A) when paused.
        // Tint only the icon badge and action buttons (never flood-fill the
        // card background with setColorized(true)).
        b.setColor(paused ? 0xFFFF9F0A : 0xFFFF3B30);
        b.setColorized(false);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setCategory(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_SERVICE);
        b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setOngoing(true);
        b.setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        b.setSilent(true);
        if (cachedRestoreIntent != null) {
            b.setDeleteIntent(cachedRestoreIntent);
        }
        // Native SystemUI Chronometer ticks in real time on the system UI
        // thread without requiring sub-second Binder IPC updates.
        if (convertingPct < 0 && !paused) {
            long base = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            lastChronoBaseMs = base;
            b.setWhen(base);
            b.setShowWhen(true);
            b.setUsesChronometer(true);
        } else {
            b.setShowWhen(false);
            b.setUsesChronometer(false);
        }
        if (cachedContentIntent != null) {
            b.setContentIntent(cachedContentIntent);
        }
        if (convertingPct < 0) {
            b.addAction(0,
                    paused ? getString(R.string.notif_resume)
                            : getString(R.string.notif_pause),
                    cachedToggleIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_save),
                    cachedSaveIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_cancel),
                    cachedCancelIntent);
        } else {
            b.setProgress(100, Math.max(0, Math.min(100, convertingPct)), false);
        }
        try {
            Notification n = b.build();
            n.flags |= Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT
                    | Notification.FLAG_NO_CLEAR
                    | Notification.FLAG_FOREGROUND_SERVICE;
            return n;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return new Notification();
        }
    }

    private void initPendingIntents() {
        Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
        open.putExtra("open_studio", true);
        open.setAction("com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO");
        try {
            cachedContentIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 10, open,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            cachedContentIntent = null;
        }
        cachedToggleIntent = action(ACTION_TOGGLE, 21);
        cachedSaveIntent = action(ACTION_SAVE, 22);
        cachedCancelIntent = action(ACTION_CANCEL, 23);
        cachedRestoreIntent = action(ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF, 24);
    }

    private PendingIntent action(String what, int code) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(what);
        try {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
        }
    }

    private void startTick() {
        if (ticking) return;
        ticking = true;
        handler.post(tick);
    }

    private void stopTick() {
        ticking = false;
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
    }

    private final Runnable tick = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            if (!ticking) return;
            refreshNotif(false);
            // Align to the next whole-second boundary while recording so the
            // MM:SS readout steps in sync with the audio duration and never
            // exceeds 1 update/sec.
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            long delay = 1000L;
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                long rem = 1000L - (e.durationMs() % 1000L);
                delay = Math.max(200L, Math.min(1000L, rem));
            }
            handler.postDelayed(this, delay);
        }
    };

    private void setPct(int pct) {
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (pct == convertingPct) return;
        if (pct < 100 && now - lastPctPush < 500) {
            convertingPct = pct;
            return;
        }
        convertingPct = pct;
        lastPctPush = now;
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    private void toast(String text) {
        try {
            Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), text, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/StreamingEncoder.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.media.MediaCodec;
import android.media.MediaFormat;
import android.media.MediaMuxer;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Incremental encoder that follows the crash-safe raw capture file while a
 * take is being recorded.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The raw 32-bit float WAV is append-only: every byte past the 44-byte
 * header is immutable once written. A pump thread converts the newest
 * immutable prefix in chunks, so by the time the user hits save most of the
 * take is already encoded and stopping only drains the tail. Anything the
 * pump cannot do — encoder missing, mid-stream failure, process death — falls
 * back to a full post-stop conversion from the raw, which always remains the
 * source of truth. Capture itself never touches this class except through
 * {@link RecordingEngine}, and the pump only ever &lt;em&gt;reads&lt;/em&gt; the raw.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;WAV16/WAV24 output is byte-appended and exactly resumable; codec output
 * (AAC/M4A, Opus, FLAC, AMR) is fed with contiguous presentation timestamps
 * derived from the encoded frame count, so pause/resume capture just looks
 * like a quiet pump.
 */
public final class StreamingEncoder {

    /** Frames converted per pump iteration; matches the batch chunk scale. */
    /** How long abort()/timed-out finish() waits for the pump to die. */
    private static final long PUMP_STOP_JOIN_MS = 500L;

    private static final int PUMP_FRAMES = 16384;
    /** How long the pump parks when it has caught up with capture. */
    private static final long PARK_MS = 80L;
    /** Bound on flushing a dead OEM encoder, same as the batch path. */
    private static final long DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000L;

    public interface Progress {
        void onProgress(int percent);
    }

    private final RecordPreset preset;
    private final SaveFormat format;
    private final int channels;
    private final int sampleRate;
    private final int bitrate;
    private final File rawFile;
    private final File partFile;
    private final long dataStart;

    private final Thread pump;
    private volatile boolean stopRequested;
    private volatile boolean finishing;
    private volatile boolean failed;
    private volatile String failure;
    private volatile long framesEncoded;
    private volatile long framesSeen;
    private volatile boolean finishedOk;

    private StreamingEncoder(RecordPreset preset, SaveFormat format,
                             int channels, File rawFile, File partFile,
                             long dataStart) {
