import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.SeekBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public class TakesAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<TakesAdapter.Vh> {

    public interface Listener {
        void onCardClick(Take take);
        void onCardLongPress(Take take);
        void onPlay(Take take);
        void onFavorite(Take take);
        void onRename(Take take);
        void onExport(Take take);
        void onEdit(Take take);
        void onDelete(Take take);
        void onCancelConversion(Take take);
        void onSeek(Take take, long posMs);
    }

    private final Listener listener;
    private List<Take> takes = new ArrayList<>();
    private long expandedId = -1;
    private long playingId = -1;
    private boolean paused = false;
    private boolean selectionMode = false;
    private Set<Long> selected = new HashSet<>();
    private final Map<Long, Long> progressMap = new HashMap<>();

    /** Selected cards shrink so multi-select reads at a glance. */
    private static final float SEL_SCALE = 0.92f;
    /** SeekBar resolution — high enough that progress looks continuous. */
    private static final int SCRUB_MAX = 10000;

    public TakesAdapter(Listener listener) {
        this.listener = listener;
        setHasStableIds(true);
    }

    @Override
    public long getItemId(int position) {
        // Stable ids make RecyclerView query this against its own (possibly
        // stale) position bookkeeping while a rebind is in flight. A
        // converting card that disappears on completion shortens the list, and
        // the out-of-range read used to crash the app right as the user was
        // looking at the finished take.
        if (position < 0 || position >= takes.size()) {
            return RecyclerView.NO_ID;
        }
        return takes.get(position).id;
    }

    public void setTakes(List<Take> takes) {
        setTakesAndState(takes, playingId, paused, selected, selectionMode);
    }

    /**
     * Applies list and playback/selection state in a single pass, so a refresh
     * never issues {@code notifyDataSetChanged()} followed by
     * {@code notifyItemChanged()} in the same UI turn. Under
     * {@code setHasStableIds(true)} with an id that just changed sign (a
     * converting card becoming its finished Room take) that pairing is what
     * drove RecyclerView into an inconsistent-adapter-state crash.
     */
    public void setTakesAndState(List<Take> takes, long playingId,
                                 boolean paused, Set<Long> selected,
                                 boolean selectionMode) {
        // An expanded converting card (negative id) is replaced by a real
        // take when its job finishes. Hand the open state over so the card the
        // user opened stays open instead of silently snapping shut.
        if (expandedId < 0) {
            String rawPath = ConversionJobs.rawForTakeId(expandedId);
            Long completed = rawPath != null
                    ? ConversionJobs.completedTakeIdForRaw(rawPath) : null;
            if (completed != null) expandedId = completed;
        }
        this.takes = takes;
        this.playingId = playingId;
        this.paused = paused;
        this.selected = selected;
        this.selectionMode = selectionMode;
        // Drop stale expanded refs that are no longer visible.
        boolean expAlive = false;
        for (Take t : takes) {
            if (t.id == expandedId) expAlive = true;
        }
        if (!expAlive) expandedId = -1;
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    /**
     * Keeps a recycled or failing holder from animating a view that is no
     * longer attached: a running height animator calling requestLayout() on a
     * detached holder corrupts RecyclerView's layout pass.
     */
    @Override
    public void onViewRecycled(@NonNull Vh h) {
        cancelHolderAnimations(h);
        super.onViewRecycled(h);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onFailedToRecycleView(@NonNull Vh h) {
        cancelHolderAnimations(h);
        return super.onFailedToRecycleView(h);
    }

    private void cancelHolderAnimations(Vh h) {
        if (h == null) return;
        Object pending = h.expanded.getTag();
        if (pending instanceof ValueAnimator) {
            ((ValueAnimator) pending).cancel();
        }
        h.expanded.setTag(null);
        h.expanded.getLayoutParams().height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        h.expanded.setAlpha(1f);
        h.cardRoot.animate().cancel();
        h.cardRoot.setScaleX(1f);
        h.cardRoot.setScaleY(1f);
        h.playBtn.animate().cancel();
        h.fav.animate().cancel();
        h.chevron.animate().cancel();
    }

    public void setExpandedId(long id) {
        long old = expandedId;
        expandedId = id;
        notifyForId(old);
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    public long getExpandedId() {
        return expandedId;
    }

    public void collapseAll() {
        long old = expandedId;
        expandedId = -1;
        notifyForId(old);
    }

    public void setPlayingId(long id) {
        long old = playingId;
        playingId = id;
        notifyForId(old);
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    public void setPaused(boolean p) {
        paused = p;
        notifyForId(playingId);
    }

    /** Single-notify reset of the playing state (avoids double-rebind flicker). */
    public void clearPlaying() {
        long old = playingId;
        playingId = -1;
        paused = false;
        notifyForId(old);
    }

    /**
     * Smoothly expands {@code id} (and smoothly collapses any previously
     * expanded card) using the same height/alpha transition as tapping the
     * card body, without triggering a full ViewHolder rebind.
     */
    public void expandDirectIfNeeded(RecyclerView rv, long id) {
        if (rv == null) {
            setExpandedId(id);
            return;
        }
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder curVh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (expandedId == id) {
            if (curVh instanceof Vh) {
                Vh h = (Vh) curVh;
                if (h.expanded.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) return;
                animateExpand(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            }
            return;
        }
        toggleExpandedDirect(rv, id);
    }

    /**
     * Updates the playing/paused state and repaints the play/pause button icon
     * directly on visible ViewHolder(s) without notifyItemChanged(), so an
     * in-flight smooth expand animation is never interrupted or snapped.
     */
    public void paintPlayState(RecyclerView rv, long newPlayingId,
                               boolean isPaused) {
        long oldPlayingId = this.playingId;
        this.playingId = newPlayingId;
        this.paused = isPaused;
        if (rv == null) {
            notifyForId(oldPlayingId);
            notifyForId(newPlayingId);
            return;
        }
        if (oldPlayingId != -1 && oldPlayingId != newPlayingId) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder oldVh =
                    rv.findViewHolderForItemId(oldPlayingId);
            if (oldVh instanceof Vh) {
                ((Vh) oldVh).play.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_play);
            } else {
                notifyForId(oldPlayingId);
            }
        }
        if (newPlayingId != -1) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder newVh =
                    rv.findViewHolderForItemId(newPlayingId);
            if (newVh instanceof Vh) {
                ((Vh) newVh).play.setImageResource(isPaused
                        ? R.drawable.ic_play : R.drawable.ic_pause);
            } else {
                notifyForId(newPlayingId);
            }
        }
    }

    public void refreshItem(long id) {
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    /** Update only the heart artwork, no rebind (no flicker on favorite taps). */
    public void paintFavorite(RecyclerView rv, long id, boolean fav) {
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            h.fav.setImageResource(fav ? R.drawable.ic_heart_filled : R.drawable.ic_heart);
            h.fav.setAlpha(fav ? 1f : 0.55f);
        }
    }

    /** Toggle the expanded section with a smooth height + fade animation. */
    public void toggleExpandedDirect(RecyclerView rv, long id) {
        boolean expand = expandedId != id;
        // Smoothly collapse any previously open card.
        if (expandedId != -1 && expandedId != id) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder oldVh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(expandedId);
            if (oldVh instanceof Vh) {
                Vh old = (Vh) oldVh;
                animateCollapse(old.expanded, old.chevron);
            }
        }
        expandedId = expand ? id : -1;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            // Drop any stuck pressed/focus glow on the scrubber when it (re)appears.
            h.scrubber.setPressed(false);
            h.scrubber.clearFocus();
            h.scrubber.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();
            if (expand) {
                Take t = findTake(id);
                if (t != null) {
                    h.totalTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs));
                    if (t.id != playingId) {
                        h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(0));
                        if (!h.tracking) h.scrubber.setProgress(0);
                    } else {
                        // A4-12: re-expanding the card that is playing (even
                        // paused) reset its readout to 00:00 while the audio
                        // kept its position.
                        long pos = progressMap != null && progressMap
                                .containsKey(t.id)
                                ? progressMap.get(t.id) : 0L;
                        h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(pos));
                        if (!h.tracking) {
                            h.scrubber.setProgress((int) Math.min(SCRUB_MAX,
                                    pos * SCRUB_MAX / Math.max(1L, t.durationMs)));
                        }
                    }
                    h.btnExport.setVisibility((t.hasFile() || t.converting)
                            ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                }
                animateExpand(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            } else {
                animateCollapse(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            }
        }
    }

    private void animateExpand(final View expanded, final View ignored) {
        // Cancel any in-flight height animation.
        Object tag = expanded.getTag();
        if (tag instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) tag).cancel();
        expanded.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        expanded.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(
                        ((View) expanded.getParent()).getWidth(),
                        View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED));
        final int targetH = expanded.getMeasuredHeight();
        expanded.getLayoutParams().height = 0;
        expanded.setAlpha(0f);
        expanded.requestLayout();
        ValueAnimator anim = ValueAnimator.ofInt(0, targetH);
        anim.setDuration(300);
        anim.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.3f));
        anim.addUpdateListener(a -> {
            int val = (int) a.getAnimatedValue();
            expanded.getLayoutParams().height = val;
            expanded.setAlpha(Math.min(1f, val / (float) Math.max(1, targetH)));
            expanded.requestLayout();
        });
        anim.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationEnd(android.animation.Animator animation) {
                expanded.getLayoutParams().height =
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
                expanded.setAlpha(1f);
                expanded.requestLayout();
                expanded.setTag(null);
            }
        });
        expanded.setTag(anim);
        anim.start();
    }

    private void animateCollapse(final View expanded, final View ignored) {
        if (expanded.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) return;
        Object tag = expanded.getTag();
        if (tag instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) tag).cancel();
        final int startH = expanded.getHeight() > 0
                ? expanded.getHeight() : expanded.getMeasuredHeight();
        if (startH <= 0) {
            expanded.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }
        ValueAnimator anim = ValueAnimator.ofInt(startH, 0);
        anim.setDuration(240);
        anim.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f));
        anim.addUpdateListener(a -> {
            int val = (int) a.getAnimatedValue();
            expanded.getLayoutParams().height = val;
            expanded.setAlpha(val / (float) Math.max(1, startH));
            expanded.requestLayout();
        });
        anim.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationEnd(android.animation.Animator animation) {
                expanded.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                expanded.getLayoutParams().height =
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
                expanded.setAlpha(1f);
                expanded.requestLayout();
                expanded.setTag(null);
            }
        });
        expanded.setTag(anim);
        anim.start();
    }

    /** True while the user is actively dragging this take's scrubber. */
    public boolean isTracking(long id, RecyclerView rv) {
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        return vh instanceof Vh && ((Vh) vh).tracking;
    }

    private Take findTake(long id) {
        for (Take t : takes) {
            if (t.id == id) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public void setSelection(Set<Long> selected, boolean mode) {
        Set<Long> copy = new HashSet<>(selected);
        boolean modeChanged = this.selectionMode != mode;
        boolean contentChanged = !this.selected.equals(copy);
        this.selected = copy;
        this.selectionMode = mode;
        // Any change — mode flip, single toggle, or select-all — rebinds every
        // visible row, so badges, backgrounds and the shrink always converge
        // on the tapped state in one pass. No walk-then-rebind double driver,
        // so effects can never land a tap late or on the wrong card.
        if (modeChanged || contentChanged) {
            notifyDataSetChanged();
        }
    }

    private void applySelectionScale(Vh h, boolean isSel) {
        float target = isSel ? SEL_SCALE : 1f;
        View card = h.cardRoot;
        // Stateless: always converge from the ACTUAL current scale to the
        // target. No remembered per-view state, so rapid taps, recycling and
        // mode exits can never desync — every bind ends exactly at target,
        // gliding when there is distance to cover, snapping when already home.
        card.animate().cancel();
        if (Math.abs(card.getScaleX() - target) < 0.002f
                && Math.abs(card.getScaleY() - target) < 0.002f) {
            card.setScaleX(target);
            card.setScaleY(target);
            return;
        }
        card.animate()
                .scaleX(target).scaleY(target)
                .setDuration(160)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }

    private void notifyForId(long id) {
        if (id == -1) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < takes.size(); i++) {
            if (takes.get(i).id == id) {
                notifyItemChanged(i);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private void pressBounce(View v) {
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.setScaleX(0.94f);
        v.setScaleY(0.94f);
        v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(180)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                .start();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public Vh onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
                .inflate(R.layout.item_take, parent, false);
        Vh holder = new Vh(v);
        // Press feedback on everything tappable (scrubber excluded — it drags).
        // Icons get the softer variant so they give without flashing; the card
        // uses a ripple foreground so it never fights the selection scale.
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.fav, 0.9f);
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.chevron, 0.88f);
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.playBtn, 0.92f);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnRename);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnExport);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnDelete);
        return holder;
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull Vh h, int position) {
        Take t = takes.get(position);
        boolean expanded = t.id == expandedId;
        boolean playing = t.id == playingId;
        boolean isSel = selectionMode && selected.contains(t.id);

        h.cardRoot.setBackgroundResource(isSel ? R.drawable.bg_card_selected : R.drawable.bg_card);
        h.selectBadge.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        h.selectBadge.setImageResource(isSel ? R.drawable.ic_checked : R.drawable.bg_select_ring);
        h.selectBadge.setColorFilter(isSel ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672);
        h.selectBadge.setAlpha(isSel ? 1f : 0.5f);

        // Deterministic selection shrink. Every bind converges the card to the
        // exact scale its selection state demands, so recycled holders can
        // never carry a stale size.
        applySelectionScale(h, isSel);

        h.title.setText(t.title);
        if (t.converting) {
            h.meta.setText(h.itemView.getContext().getString(
                    R.string.conv_card_status, t.convFormat, t.convProgress));
        } else {
            h.meta.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs) + "  •  " + t.dateLabel + "  •  " + t.sizeLabel);
        }
        h.formatBadge.setText(t.format);
        h.play.setImageResource((playing && !paused) ? R.drawable.ic_pause : R.drawable.ic_play);
        h.play.setContentDescription(h.itemView.getContext().getString(R.string.cd_play));

        // Professional heart: outline idle, filled red favorite, with a pop on tap.
        // Converting rows have no stored row to favorite: hide the control.
        h.fav.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
        h.fav.setImageResource(t.favorite ? R.drawable.ic_heart_filled : R.drawable.ic_heart);
        h.fav.setAlpha(t.favorite ? 1f : 0.55f);
        h.fav.setColorFilter(null);

        // Header edit shortcut (replaces the old expand chevron; tapping the
        // card itself still expands/collapses, so nothing is lost).
        h.chevron.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_pencil);
        h.chevron.setRotation(0f);
        h.chevron.setAlpha((t.hasFile() || t.converting) ? 0.85f : 0.35f);
        h.chevron.setContentDescription(
                h.itemView.getContext().getString(R.string.cd_edit));
        // Reset any mid-animation height leftovers from recycled holders.
        Object pending = h.expanded.getTag();
        if (pending instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) pending).cancel();
        h.expanded.setTag(null);
        h.expanded.getLayoutParams().height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        h.expanded.setAlpha(1f);
        h.expanded.setVisibility(expanded ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        // Detach first: setProgress() on a rebound holder fires the PREVIOUS
        // take's listener, which wrote the old take's position (and seeked it).
        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(null);
        if (expanded) {
            h.totalTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs));
            long shown = playing ? progressMap.getOrDefault(t.id, 0L) : 0L;
            if (!h.tracking) {
                h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(shown));
                h.scrubber.setProgress(t.durationMs <= 0 ? 0
                        : (int) (shown * SCRUB_MAX / t.durationMs));
            }
        }
        // Conversion chrome is bound on every pass — expanding only animates
        // visibility, it never rebinds, so expanded-only state set here
        // would otherwise show whatever a recycled holder carried. The
        // progress stays visible even collapsed so conversions read at a
        // glance; only rename is ever hidden (no stored row to rename).
        h.btnExport.setVisibility((t.hasFile() || t.converting)
                ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        // Renaming is a pure metadata change, so it is safe while the take
        // converts: the worker inserts the finished file under this title.
        h.btnRename.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        h.convStatus.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        h.convProgress.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (t.converting) {
            h.convStatus.setText(h.itemView.getContext().getString(
                    R.string.conv_card_status, t.convFormat, t.convProgress));
            h.convProgress.setProgress(t.convProgress);
        } else {
            h.convProgress.setProgress(0);
            h.convStatus.setText("");
        }

        h.cardRoot.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onCardClick(t));
        h.cardRoot.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
            listener.onCardLongPress(t);
            return true;
        });
        h.playBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            v.animate().cancel();
            v.setScaleX(0.9f);
            v.setScaleY(0.9f);
            v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(200)
                    .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                    .start();
            listener.onPlay(t);
        });
        h.fav.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Soft nudge on a falloff curve — no hard overshoot, no flash.
            PressAnim.nudge(v, 1.14f);
            listener.onFavorite(t);
        });
        h.chevron.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onEdit(t);
        });
        h.btnRename.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onRename(t);
        });
        h.btnExport.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onExport(t);
        });
        h.btnDelete.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            if (t.converting) listener.onCancelConversion(t);
            else listener.onDelete(t);
        });

        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(null);
        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener() {
            @Override
            public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar s, int progress, boolean fromUser) {
                if (fromUser && h.tracking) {
                    long pos = t.durationMs * progress / SCRUB_MAX;
                    h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(pos));
                }
            }

            @Override public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar s) {
                h.tracking = true;
            }

            @Override public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar s) {
                h.tracking = false;
                long pos = t.durationMs * s.getProgress() / SCRUB_MAX;
                listener.onSeek(t, pos);
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return takes.size();
    }

    /** Direct conversion-progress paint without rebind. */
    public void paintConvProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, int pct,
                                  String status) {
        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
        Take t = findTake(id);
        if (t == null || !t.converting) return;
        t.convProgress = clamped;
        if (status != null) t.dateLabel = status;
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            if (h.convProgress != null) {
                h.convProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                h.convProgress.setProgress(clamped);
            }
            if (status != null) {
                if (h.convStatus != null) h.convStatus.setText(status);
                if (h.meta != null) h.meta.setText(status);
            }
        } else {
            notifyForId(id);
        }
    }

    /** Direct progress paint without rebind (called ~10x/sec while playing). */
    public void paintProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, long posMs) {
        if (id != -1) progressMap.put(id, posMs);
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            ((Vh) vh).applyProgress(posMs);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Set the stored position for a take (e.g. 0 when (re)starting playback)
     * so a rebind never snaps to a stale near-end value. Also paints it live
     * when the holder is visible and the user isn't dragging.
     */
    public void setProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, long posMs) {
        progressMap.put(id, posMs);
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh && !((Vh) vh).tracking) {
            ((Vh) vh).applyProgress(posMs);
        }
    }

    public class Vh extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final View cardRoot;
        final ImageView selectBadge;
        final View playBtn;
        final ImageView play;
        final TextView title;
        final TextView meta;
        final TextView formatBadge;
        final ImageView fav;
        final ImageView chevron;
        final LinearLayout expanded;
        final TextView curTime;
        final TextView totalTime;
        final SeekBar scrubber;
        final View btnRename;
        final View btnExport;
        final View btnDelete;
        final TextView convStatus;
        final android.widget.ProgressBar convProgress;
        boolean tracking = false;

        Vh(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            cardRoot = itemView.findViewById(R.id.cardRoot);
            selectBadge = itemView.findViewById(R.id.selectBadge);
            playBtn = itemView.findViewById(R.id.playBtn);
            play = itemView.findViewById(R.id.playIcon);
            title = itemView.findViewById(R.id.takeTitle);
            meta = itemView.findViewById(R.id.takeMeta);
            formatBadge = itemView.findViewById(R.id.formatBadge);
            fav = itemView.findViewById(R.id.favIcon);
            chevron = itemView.findViewById(R.id.chevron);
            expanded = itemView.findViewById(R.id.expanded);
            curTime = itemView.findViewById(R.id.curTime);
            totalTime = itemView.findViewById(R.id.totalTime);
            scrubber = itemView.findViewById(R.id.scrubber);
            btnRename = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnRename);
            btnExport = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnExport);
            btnDelete = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnDelete);
            convStatus = itemView.findViewById(R.id.convStatus);
            convProgress = itemView.findViewById(R.id.convProgress);
        }

        void applyProgress(long posMs) {
            int pos = getBindingAdapterPosition();
            if (pos == RecyclerView.NO_POSITION || pos < 0
                    || pos >= takes.size()) {
                return;
            }
            Take t = takes.get(pos);
            progressMap.put(t.id, posMs);
            if (tracking) return;
            if (t.durationMs > 0 && scrubber != null) {
                // Clamp so completion always lands exactly on the end.
                int p = (int) (posMs * SCRUB_MAX / t.durationMs);
                scrubber.setProgress(Math.min(p, SCRUB_MAX));
            }
            if (curTime != null) curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(posMs));
        }
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/TakesRepository.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

/**
 * Library store. The in-memory list stays the synchronous UI model, but
 * every row is mirrored into Room, so the library (titles, favorites,
 * positions, lineage) survives process death. All database work runs on a
 * single background thread, in order, so callers never block and writes
 * can never overtake the initial load.
 */
public final class TakesRepository {

    /** Removed takes + their positions, so a delete can be undone. */
    public static final class RestoreOp {
        public final List&lt;Take&gt; takes = new ArrayList<>();
        public final List&lt;Integer&gt; positions = new ArrayList<>();
        /** Parallel to takes: trash location, or null if hard-deleted. */
        public final List&lt;String&gt; trashPaths = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    /** Startup reconcile outcome, for the one summary popup. */
    public static final class ReconcileResult {
        public int adopted;
        public int pruned;
        public int rawsCleaned;
        public long trashFreedBytes;
    }

    /** Trash retention: week-old soft deletes are reaped on startup. */
    private static final long TRASH_MAX_AGE_MS = 7L * 24 * 3600_000L;

    private static final List&lt;Take&gt; TAKES = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final AtomicLong IDS = new AtomicLong(100);
    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY_SEEDED = "library_seeded_once";
    private static final String KEY_NEXT_ID = "next_recording_id";
    /**
     * Probe attempts that never reported back. A native parser death
     * mid-probe leaves the mark behind (nothing after it runs), so the next
     * launch skips that file instead of dying on it again.
     */
    private static final String KEY_PROBE_TRIED = "probe_tried_paths";

    public interface Listener {
        void onTakesChanged();
    }

    private static final Set&lt;Listener&gt; LISTENERS =
            new java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
    private static volatile boolean ready;
    private static final List&lt;Runnable&gt; READY_QUEUE = new ArrayList<>();

    public static void addListener(Listener l) {
        if (l != null) LISTENERS.add(l);
    }

    public static void removeListener(Listener l) {
        LISTENERS.remove(l);
    }

    private static void fireChanged() {
        for (Listener l : LISTENERS) {
            try {
                l.onTakesChanged();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private static TakeDatabase db;
    private static Context app;
    private static final ExecutorService IO = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private static volatile ReconcileResult lastReconcile;

    private TakesRepository() {}

    /**
     * Allocates a unique, monotonically increasing positive ID for a new
     * recording. Persisted in SharedPreferences so allocations before Room
     * finishes loading can never collide with an existing database row.
     */
    public static synchronized long allocateId() {
        long next = IDS.getAndIncrement();
        if (app != null) {
            try {
                SharedPreferences p = app.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
                long stored = p.getLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, 100L);
                if (stored > next) {
                    next = stored;
                }
                for (Take t : TAKES) {
                    if (t.id >= next) {
                        next = t.id + 1;
                    }
                }
                IDS.set(next + 1);
                p.edit().putLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, next + 1).apply();
                return next;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        for (Take t : TAKES) {
            if (t.id >= next) {
                next = t.id + 1;
            }
        }
        IDS.set(next + 1);
        return next;
    }

    private static synchronized void ensureNextIdAtLeast(long minNext) {
        if (minNext > IDS.get()) {
            IDS.set(minNext);
        }
        if (app != null) {
            try {
                SharedPreferences p = app.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
                long stored = p.getLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, 100L);
                if (minNext > stored) {
                    p.edit().putLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, minNext).apply();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /**
     * Finds the immutable recording ID for a library-visible converted file on
     * disk, or {@code -1} if no in-memory {@link Take} currently owns that path.
     */
    public static synchronized long findIdByFile(File takeFile) {
        if (takeFile == null) return -1L;
        String abs = takeFile.getAbsolutePath();
        for (Take t : TAKES) {
            if (abs.equals(t.filePath)) {
                return t.id;
            }
        }
        return -1L;
    }

    // ---- persistent 32-bit float master storage (linked by immutable ID) ----

    /**
     * Hidden directory inside {@code takes/} that holds persistent 32-bit
     * float masters for non-WAV32 takes. Being a subdirectory, it is ignored
     * by {@link #reconcile(Context)}'s top-level orphan adoption and by
     * {@link RecordingEngine#scanUnfinished(Context)}.
     */
    public static File floatMastersDir(File takesDir) {
        return new File(takesDir, ".float32");
    }

    /**
     * Returns the canonical ID-linked 32-bit float master file for a recording
     * with immutable {@code recordingId}:
     * {@code takes/.float32/rec_&lt;recordingId&gt;.f32.wav}.
     */
    public static File floatMasterForId(File takesDir, long recordingId) {
        if (takesDir == null || recordingId <= 0) return null;
        return new File(floatMastersDir(takesDir),
                "rec_" + recordingId + ".f32.wav");
    }

    /**
     * Companion 32-bit float master path for {@code recordingId} and/or
     * {@code takeFile}. Prefers the immutable ID link
     * {@code takes/.float32/rec_&lt;recordingId&gt;.f32.wav} whenever {@code recordingId > 0}
     * or {@code takeFile} belongs to a known {@link Take}, falling back to
     * {@code takes/.float32/<takeFile.getName()>.f32.wav} only for unlinked
     * standalone files in unit tests.
     */
    public static File floatMasterFor(long recordingId, File takeFile) {
        if (takeFile == null) return null;
        File parent = takeFile.getParentFile();
        if (parent == null) return null;
        long effId = recordingId > 0 ? recordingId : findIdByFile(takeFile);
        if (effId > 0) {
            return floatMasterForId(parent, effId);
        }
        return new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
                takeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
    }

    /**
     * Companion 32-bit float master path for {@code takeFile}, automatically
     * resolving the owning {@link Take}'s immutable ID when registered in the
     * repository.
     */
    public static File floatMasterFor(File takeFile) {
        return floatMasterFor(-1L, takeFile);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the 32-bit float WAV file to use when opening a recording with
     * immutable {@code recordingId} and library file {@code takeFile} for
     * editing:
     * &lt;ul&gt;
     *   &lt;li&gt;If {@code takeFile} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit float WAV (e.g. a
     *       WAV32 take or a converting take's raw), returns {@code takeFile}
     *       itself.</li>
     *   &lt;li&gt;If an ID-linked 32-bit float master exists at
     *       {@code takes/.float32/rec_<recordingId>.f32.wav}, returns it.</li>
     *   &lt;li&gt;If a legacy filename-keyed master exists in {@code .float32/},
     *       migrates it to {@code rec_<recordingId>.f32.wav} and returns it.</li>
     *   &lt;li&gt;Otherwise returns {@code takeFile} (e.g. an imported recording
     *       being edited for the first time).</li>
     * &lt;/ul&gt;
     */
    public static File resolveFloatMaster(long recordingId, File takeFile) {
        if (takeFile == null || !takeFile.exists()) return takeFile;
        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(takeFile)) return takeFile;
        File parent = takeFile.getParentFile();
        long effId = recordingId > 0 ? recordingId : findIdByFile(takeFile);
        if (parent != null && effId > 0) {
            File byId = floatMasterForId(parent, effId);
            if (byId != null && byId.exists()
                    && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(byId)) {
                return byId;
            }
            File legacy = new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
                    takeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
            if (legacy.exists() && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(legacy)) {
                if (byId != null && legacy.renameTo(byId)) {
                    return byId;
                }
                return legacy;
            }
        }
        if (parent != null) {
            File legacy = new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
                    takeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
            if (legacy.exists() && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(legacy)) {
                return legacy;
            }
        }
        return takeFile;
    }

    public static File resolveFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
        return resolveFloatMaster(-1L, takeFile);
    }

    /** True when {@code takeFile} is itself float32 or has a valid float32 master. */
    public static boolean hasFloatMaster(long recordingId, File takeFile) {
        if (takeFile == null || !takeFile.exists()) return false;
        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(takeFile)) return true;
        File resolved = resolveFloatMaster(recordingId, takeFile);
        return resolved != null && !resolved.equals(takeFile)
                && resolved.exists()
                && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(resolved);
    }

    public static boolean hasFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
        return hasFloatMaster(-1L, takeFile);
    }

    /**
     * Adopts a finalized recording/edit {@code rawFloatWav} as the persistent
     * 32-bit float master linked to {@code recordingId} (and {@code finalTakeFile}).
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;When {@code finalTakeFile} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit float WAV
     * (saved as {@link SaveFormat#WAV32}), {@code finalTakeFile} is itself the
     * 32-bit float file, so {@code rawFloatWav} (and any stale companion in
     * {@code .float32/}) is deleted to avoid storing redundant copies.
     */
    public static void adoptFloatMaster(long recordingId, File rawFloatWav,
                                        File finalTakeFile) {
        if (rawFloatWav == null) return;
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(rawFloatWav.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
            EditEngine.clearSessionUndo(rawFloatWav);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (!rawFloatWav.exists()) return;
        if (finalTakeFile == null || !finalTakeFile.exists()) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            rawFloatWav.delete();
            return;
        }
        if (rawFloatWav.getAbsolutePath().equals(
                finalTakeFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
            deleteFloatMaster(recordingId, finalTakeFile);
            return;
        }
        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(finalTakeFile)) {
            // Final file is already 32-bit float (WAV32): never keep a second
            // redundant 32-bit float file on disk.
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            rawFloatWav.delete();
            deleteFloatMaster(recordingId, finalTakeFile);
            return;
        }
        File master = floatMasterFor(recordingId, finalTakeFile);
        if (master == null) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            rawFloatWav.delete();
            return;
        }
        try {
            File dir = master.getParentFile();
            if (dir != null && !dir.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                dir.mkdirs();
            }
            if (master.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                master.delete();
            }
            // Also clean up any legacy filename-based master if we are now
            // storing by immutable ID.
            File parent = finalTakeFile.getParentFile();
            if (parent != null) {
                File legacy = new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
                        finalTakeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
                if (!legacy.equals(master) && legacy.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    legacy.delete();
                }
            }
            if (rawFloatWav.renameTo(master)) {
                return;
            }
            copyFileContents(rawFloatWav, master);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            try {
                if (master.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    master.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored2) {}
        } finally {
            if (rawFloatWav.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                rawFloatWav.delete();
            }
        }
    }

    public static void adoptFloatMaster(File rawFloatWav, File finalTakeFile) {
        adoptFloatMaster(-1L, rawFloatWav, finalTakeFile);
    }

    /**
     * Persists a copy of {@code floatWavSession} as the 32-bit float master
     * linked to {@code recordingId} (and {@code finalTakeFile}). Used the first
     * time the user presses Edit on an imported take so subsequent edits reuse
     * the persisted 32-bit float file without re-converting.
     */
    public static void saveFloatMasterCopy(long recordingId,
                                           File floatWavSession,
                                           File finalTakeFile) {
        if (floatWavSession == null || !floatWavSession.exists()
                || finalTakeFile == null || !finalTakeFile.exists()) {
            return;
        }
        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(finalTakeFile)) {
            // Already 32-bit float: do not create a redundant copy.
            return;
        }
        File master = floatMasterFor(recordingId, finalTakeFile);
        if (master == null) return;
        File dir = master.getParentFile();
        if (dir != null && !dir.exists()) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            dir.mkdirs();
        }
        File tmp = new File(dir, master.getName() + ".tmp");
        try {
            copyFileContents(floatWavSession, tmp);
            if (!finalTakeFile.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tmp.delete();
                return;
            }
            if (master.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                master.delete();
            }
            if (!tmp.renameTo(master)) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tmp.delete();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tmp.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored2) {}
        }
    }

    public static void saveFloatMasterCopy(File floatWavSession,
                                           File finalTakeFile) {
        saveFloatMasterCopy(-1L, floatWavSession, finalTakeFile);
    }

    /** Deletes the companion 32-bit float master for {@code recordingId} / {@code takeFile}. */
    public static void deleteFloatMaster(long recordingId, File takeFile) {
        if (takeFile != null) {
            File parent = takeFile.getParentFile();
            long effId = recordingId > 0 ? recordingId : findIdByFile(takeFile);
            if (parent != null && effId > 0) {
                File byId = floatMasterForId(parent, effId);
                if (byId != null && byId.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    byId.delete();
                }
            }
            if (parent != null) {
                File legacy = new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
                        takeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
                if (legacy.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    legacy.delete();
                }
            }
        } else if (recordingId > 0 && app != null) {
            try {
                File takesDir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(app);
                File byId = floatMasterForId(takesDir, recordingId);
                if (byId != null && byId.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    byId.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static void deleteFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
        deleteFloatMaster(-1L, takeFile);
    }

    private static void copyFileContents(File src, File dst) throws Exception {
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(src);
             FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(dst)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int n;
            while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) {
                out.write(buf, 0, n);
            }
            out.getFD().sync();
        }
    }

    // ---- lifecycle ----

    /** Idempotent. Loads rows, seeds once, reconciles disk, then fires ready. */
    public static synchronized void init(Context ctx) {
        if (app != null) return;
        app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        db = TakeDatabase.get(app);
        try {
            SharedPreferences p = app.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            long stored = p.getLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, 100L);
            if (stored > IDS.get()) {
                IDS.set(stored);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        IO.execute(TakesRepository::loadReconcileSeed);
    }

    public static boolean isReady() {
        return ready;
    }

    /** Runs now (main thread) if ready, else right after load finishes. */
    public static void onReady(Runnable r) {
        boolean run;
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            run = ready;
            if (!run) READY_QUEUE.add(r);
        }
        if (run) r.run();
    }

    public static ReconcileResult lastReconcile() {
        return lastReconcile;
    }

    private static void loadReconcileSeed() {
        List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; rows = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            rows = db.takes().allOrdered();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        List&lt;Runnable&gt; queued;
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            // A4-06: the DB load runs on the IO executor while a save or an
            // import can already have called addRecording()/addTake() on
            // another thread. Keep anything already in memory with its
            // immutable ID intact and only ever move the ID counter forward.
            List&lt;Take&gt; pending = new ArrayList<>(TAKES);
            Map<Long, Take> pendingById = new HashMap<>();
            for (Take pt : pending) {
                pendingById.put(pt.id, pt);
            }
            TAKES.clear();
            long max = 99;
            Set&lt;Long&gt; seenIds = new HashSet<>();
            for (TakeEntity e : rows) {
                try {
                    Take t = pendingById.containsKey(e.id)
                            ? pendingById.get(e.id) : e.toTake();
                    TAKES.add(t);
                    seenIds.add(t.id);
                    if (t.id > max) max = t.id;
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            for (Take t : pending) {
                if (!seenIds.contains(t.id)) {
                    TAKES.add(t);
                    seenIds.add(t.id);
                    if (t.id > max) max = t.id;
                    persistAsync(t);
                }
            }
            ensureNextIdAtLeast(Math.max(IDS.get(), max + 1));
            sortByTimestampDesc();
        }
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "repo rows=" + TAKES.size());
        ReconcileResult rr = new ReconcileResult();
        try {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile start");
            rr = reconcile(app);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile end adopted=" + rr.adopted
                    + " pruned=" + rr.pruned + " raws=" + rr.rawsCleaned);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // A poisoned disk state (truncated files, I/O errors) must never
            // take the app down on every launch: degrade to whatever loaded
            // from the database and still signal ready so the UI can open.
            android.util.Log.w("TakesRepository", "reconcile failed", e);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile FAILED: " + e);
        }
        lastReconcile = rr;
        // Interrupted background conversions resume from their sidecars;
        // crash garbage (orphan parts) is swept here, before any capture.
        // Every resurrected job is (re)started: the worker serialises them,
        // so starting only the first would strand the rest until the next
        // process start that happens to resweep.
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(app);
            for (ConversionJob job : resume) {
                ConversionService.startJob(app, job.jobId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "conversion sweep FAILED: " + e);
        }
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            ready = true;
            queued = new ArrayList<>(READY_QUEUE);
            READY_QUEUE.clear();
        }
        android.os.Handler main = new android.os.Handler(
                android.os.Looper.getMainLooper());
        for (Runnable r : queued) main.post(r);
    }

    private static void sortByTimestampDesc() {
        TAKES.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.timestamp, a.timestamp));
    }

    // ---- reads (synchronous, in-memory) ----

    public static synchronized List&lt;Take&gt; all() {
        return new ArrayList<>(TAKES);
    }

    public static synchronized Take find(long id) {
        for (Take t : TAKES) {
            if (t.id == id) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ---- mutations (synchronous cache + ordered async write-through) ----

    public static synchronized Take addRecording(File file, long durationMs) {
        return addRecording(file, durationMs, null, null);
    }

    public static synchronized Take addRecording(File file, long durationMs,
                                                 String title, String format) {
        long existingId = findIdByFile(file);
        long id = existingId > 0 ? existingId : allocateId();
        return addRecordingWithId(id, file, durationMs, title, format);
    }

    /**
     * Inserts or updates a recording using its pre-allocated immutable
     * {@code recordingId}, ensuring both the converted library-visible file
     * and the separate 32-bit float master stay linked to the same ID across
     * Save, Rename, and Edit -> Replace.
     */
    public static synchronized Take addRecordingWithId(long recordingId,
                                                       File file,
                                                       long durationMs,
                                                       String title,
                                                       String format) {
        long effId = recordingId > 0 ? recordingId : allocateId();
        ensureNextIdAtLeast(effId + 1);
        for (int i = TAKES.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (TAKES.get(i).id == effId) {
                TAKES.remove(i);
            }
        }
        Take t = buildTakeWithId(effId, file, durationMs, title, format);
        TAKES.add(0, t);
        if (app != null) {
            try {
                TrialAndBillingManager.get(app).onRecordingSaved(t.id);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        // If a filename-based float master was created before the Take was
        // registered, migrate it to the canonical ID-based path now.
        if (file != null && file.getParentFile() != null) {
            File legacy = new File(floatMastersDir(file.getParentFile()),
                    file.getName() + ".f32.wav");
            File canonical = floatMasterForId(file.getParentFile(), t.id);
            if (legacy.exists() && canonical != null && !legacy.equals(canonical)) {
                if (canonical.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    legacy.delete();
                } else {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    legacy.renameTo(canonical);
                }
            }
        }
        persistAsync(t);
        fireChanged();
        return t;
    }

    /** Inserts an imported audio file without pre-converting to 32-bit float. */
    public static synchronized Take addImported(File file, long durationMs,
                                                String title, String format) {
        long id = allocateId();
        Take t = buildTakeWithId(id, file, durationMs, title, format);
        t.origin = "imported";
        TAKES.add(0, t);
        if (app != null) {
            try {
                TrialAndBillingManager.get(app).onRecordingSaved(t.id);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        persistAsync(t);
        fireChanged();
        return t;
    }

    /** Used by reconcile + tests to insert a fully-formed take. */
    public static synchronized Take addTake(Take t) {
        ensureNextIdAtLeast(t.id + 1);
        TAKES.add(t);
        sortByTimestampDesc();
        persistAsync(t);
        fireChanged();
        return t;
    }

    /**
     * Immediately deletes a take (and its backing file + 32-bit float master)
     * when the user chooses Replace in the editor, so the obsolete files are
     * removed right away before the new conversion starts.
     */
    public static synchronized boolean deleteImmediateForReplace(long targetId) {
        if (targetId < 0) {
            targetId = ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(app, targetId);
        }
        if (targetId <= 0) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < TAKES.size(); i++) {
            if (TAKES.get(i).id == targetId) {
                Take t = TAKES.remove(i);
                deleteBackingFile(t);
                deleteAsync(targetId);
                fireChanged();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Replaces an existing recording in-place while preserving its unique
     * immutable ID ({@code originalId}) so all ID-linked state (32-bit float
     * master, first-recording entitlement, etc.) remains unbroken.
     */
    public static synchronized Take replaceRecording(long originalId,
                                                     File saved,
                                                     long durationMs,
                                                     String title,
                                                     String format) {
        long targetId = originalId;
        if (targetId < 0) {
            targetId = ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(app, targetId);
        }
        if (targetId > 0) {
            deleteImmediateForReplace(targetId);
        }
        long finalId = targetId > 0 ? targetId : allocateId();
        return addRecordingWithId(finalId, saved, durationMs, title, format);
    }

    private static Take buildTakeWithId(long id, File file, long durationMs,
                                        String title, String format) {
        String size = Dsp.sizeLabel(file.length());
        String name = file.getName();
        String ext = "M4A";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0 && dot < name.length() - 1) {
            ext = name.substring(dot + 1).toUpperCase(Locale.US);
        }
        String base = Dsp.prettyFileTitle(name);
        String t = title != null ? title.trim() : "";
        if (t.isEmpty()) t = base;
        String f = format != null ? format.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.US) : "";
        if (f.isEmpty()) f = ext;
        Take take = new Take(id, t, durationMs,
                System.currentTimeMillis(), size, f, false, file.getAbsolutePath());
        take.origin = "recorded";
        return take;
    }

    public static synchronized void toggleFavorite(long id) {
        Take t = find(id);
        if (t != null) {
            t.favorite = !t.favorite;
            persistAsync(t);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Renames a recording in the Library: updates its display title, renames
     * the converted library-visible file on disk ({@code t.filePath}) to match
     * the new title, and persists the updated row to Room. Because the
     * recording's 32-bit float master is linked to its immutable {@code t.id}
     * ({@code takes/.float32/rec_&lt;id&gt;.f32.wav}), renaming the converted file on
     * disk never breaks the 32-bit float link.
     */
    public static synchronized void rename(long id, String newTitle) {
        Take t = find(id);
        if (t == null || newTitle == null || newTitle.trim().isEmpty()) return;
        String cleanTitle = newTitle.trim();
        t.title = cleanTitle;
        if (t.filePath != null && !t.filePath.isEmpty()) {
            File oldFile = new File(t.filePath);
            if (oldFile.exists()) {
                // Migrate any legacy filename-keyed float32 master to the
                // canonical ID-linked path before renaming oldFile on disk.
                File parent = oldFile.getParentFile();
                if (parent != null && t.id > 0) {
                    File legacyMaster = new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
                            oldFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
                    File idMaster = floatMasterForId(parent, t.id);
                    if (legacyMaster.exists() && idMaster != null
                            && !legacyMaster.equals(idMaster)) {
                        if (idMaster.exists()) {
                            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                            legacyMaster.delete();
                        } else {
                            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                            legacyMaster.renameTo(idMaster);
                        }
                    }
                }
                File renamedFile = renameConvertedFileOnDisk(
                        oldFile, cleanTitle, t.id);
                if (renamedFile != null) {
                    t.filePath = renamedFile.getAbsolutePath();
                }
            }
        }
        persistAsync(t);
        fireChanged();
    }

    private static File renameConvertedFileOnDisk(File oldFile,
                                                  String cleanTitle,
                                                  long takeId) {
        try {
            File dir = oldFile.getParentFile();
            if (dir == null) return oldFile;
            String oldName = oldFile.getName();
            String ext = "";
            int dot = oldName.lastIndexOf('.');
            if (dot > 0 && dot < oldName.length() - 1) {
                ext = oldName.substring(dot);
            }
            String cleanBase = RecordingEngine.sanitize(cleanTitle)
                    .replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_")
                    .replace(' ', '_')
                    .trim();
            if (cleanBase.isEmpty()) {
                cleanBase = "Take_" + takeId;
            }
            File target = new File(dir, cleanBase + ext);
            if (target.getAbsolutePath().equals(oldFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                return oldFile;
            }
            int suffix = 2;
            while (target.exists()
                    && !target.getAbsolutePath().equals(oldFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                target = new File(dir, cleanBase + " (" + suffix + ")" + ext);
                suffix++;
            }
            if (target.getAbsolutePath().equals(oldFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                return oldFile;
            }
            if (oldFile.renameTo(target)) {
                return target;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return oldFile;
    }

    public static synchronized void updatePosition(long id, long posMs) {
        Take t = find(id);
        if (t == null) return;
        t.lastPositionMs = Math.max(0, posMs);
        final long pid = id;
        final long ppos = t.lastPositionMs;
        IO.execute(() -> {
            try {
                if (db != null) db.takes().updatePosition(pid, ppos);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    public static synchronized void delete(long id) {
        ConversionJobs.cancelForDeletedTargetTake(app, id);
        for (int i = 0; i < TAKES.size(); i++) {
            if (TAKES.get(i).id == id) {
                Take t = TAKES.remove(i);
                trashBackingFile(t);
                deleteAsync(id);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    public static synchronized RestoreOp deleteMany(Set&lt;Long&gt; ids) {
        return deleteManyInternal(ids, true);
    }

    private static synchronized RestoreOp deleteManyInternal(
            Set&lt;Long&gt; ids, boolean cancelReplacingJobs) {
        RestoreOp op = new RestoreOp();
        if (ids == null || ids.isEmpty()) return op;
        if (cancelReplacingJobs) {
            for (Long id : ids) {
                if (id != null && id > 0) {
                    ConversionJobs.cancelForDeletedTargetTake(app, id);
                }
            }
        }
        List&lt;Long&gt; gone = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = TAKES.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (ids.contains(TAKES.get(i).id)) {
                op.takes.add(0, TAKES.get(i));
                op.positions.add(0, i);
                op.trashPaths.add(0, trashBackingFile(TAKES.get(i)));
                gone.add(TAKES.get(i).id);
                TAKES.remove(i);
            }
        }
        if (!gone.isEmpty()) {
            final List&lt;Long&gt; idsCopy = new ArrayList<>(gone);
            IO.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    if (db != null) db.takes().deleteByIds(idsCopy);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            });
        }
        return op;
    }

    public static synchronized void restore(RestoreOp op) {
        if (op == null) return;
        List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; rows = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < op.takes.size(); i++) {
            int pos = Math.min(op.positions.get(i), TAKES.size());
            Take t = op.takes.get(i);
            // Bring the audio back too when it went through the trash.
            if (i < op.trashPaths.size() && op.trashPaths.get(i) != null
                    && t.filePath != null) {
                // A4-09: the restored file may land on a uniquified name, so
                // follow it and persist the real path, otherwise the row
                // points at a file that is not there.
                File trashedFile = new File(op.trashPaths.get(i));
                File back = Dsp.restoreFromTrash(
                        trashedFile, new File(t.filePath));
                if (back != null) {
                    t.filePath = back.getAbsolutePath();
                    // Restore companion 32-bit float master linked to t.id.
                    File trashedMaster = new File(trashedFile.getParentFile(),
                            "rec_" + t.id + ".f32.wav");
                    if (!trashedMaster.exists()) {
                        trashedMaster = new File(trashedFile.getParentFile(),
                                trashedFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
                    }
                    if (trashedMaster.exists()) {
                        File restoredMaster = floatMasterFor(t.id, back);
                        if (restoredMaster != null) {
                            File mDir = restoredMaster.getParentFile();
                            if (mDir != null && !mDir.exists()) {
                                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                                mDir.mkdirs();
                            }
                            if (restoredMaster.exists()) {
                                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                                restoredMaster.delete();
                            }
                            if (!trashedMaster.renameTo(restoredMaster)) {
                                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                                trashedMaster.delete();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            ensureNextIdAtLeast(t.id + 1);
            TAKES.add(pos, t);
            rows.add(TakeEntity.fromTake(t));
        }
        if (!rows.isEmpty()) {
            final List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; copy = new ArrayList<>(rows);
            IO.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    if (db != null) db.takes().upsertAll(copy);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            });
        }
    }

    private static void persistAsync(Take t) {
        final TakeEntity e = TakeEntity.fromTake(t);
        IO.execute(() -> {
            try {
                if (db != null) db.takes().upsert(e);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    private static void deleteAsync(long id) {
        IO.execute(() -> {
            try {
                if (db != null) db.takes().deleteById(id);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /**
     * Soft-delete: the file moves to .trash so undo restores audio, not
     * just the entry. Also moves any companion 32-bit float master into
     * .trash so undo preserves instant editing and expiry reaps both.
     * Falls back to a straight delete when the move fails.
     *
     * @return trash location, or null when hard-deleted / no file.
     */
    private static String trashBackingFile(Take t) {
        if (t.filePath == null) return null;
        File src = new File(t.filePath);
        if (!src.exists()) {
            deleteFloatMaster(t.id, src);
            return null;
        }
        try {
            File takesDir = app != null
                    ? RecordingEngine.takesDir(app) : src.getParentFile();
            File master = resolveFloatMaster(t.id, src);
            boolean hasSeparateMaster = master != null
                    && !master.equals(src) && master.exists();
            File trashed = Dsp.moveToTrash(takesDir, src);
            if (trashed != null) {
                if (hasSeparateMaster) {
                    File trashedMaster = new File(trashed.getParentFile(),
                            "rec_" + t.id + ".f32.wav");
                    if (trashedMaster.exists()) {
                        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                        trashedMaster.delete();
                    }
                    if (!master.renameTo(trashedMaster)) {
                        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                        master.delete();
                    }
                }
                return trashed.getAbsolutePath();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        deleteBackingFile(t);
        return null;
    }

    private static void deleteBackingFile(Take t) {
        if (t.filePath != null) {
            File f = new File(t.filePath);
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
            deleteFloatMaster(t.id, f);
        }
    }

    // ---- first-run demo seeding (once ever) ----

    private static boolean seededOnce(Context ctx) {
        try {
            SharedPreferences p = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            return p.getBoolean(KEY_SEEDED, false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return true; // fail closed: never reseed blindly
        }
    }

    private static void markSeeded(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putBoolean(KEY_SEEDED, true).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- startup reconcile ----

    private static final String[] AUDIO_EXTS = {
            "wav", "m4a", "3gp", "3ga", "flac", "opus", "webm", "mp3", "ogg",
            "aac",
    };

    private static boolean isAudioFile(String name) {
        String lower = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (lower.endsWith(".pending")) return false;
        int dot = lower.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot < 0) return false;
        String ext = lower.substring(dot + 1);
        for (String a : AUDIO_EXTS) {
            if (a.equals(ext)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String stemOf(String name) {
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        String stem = dot > 0 ? name.substring(0, dot) : name;
        // Scratch raws are "&lt;base&gt;.raw.wav"; strip that marker so a finished
        // conversion groups with its leftover raw instead of orphaning it.
        stem = stem.replaceFirst("\\.raw$", "");
        // Old WAV saves landed as "&lt;base&gt; (2).wav" because the raw
        // "&lt;base&gt;.wav" still existed when uniqueFinal() ran. Strip the
        // uniquifier too so legacy leftovers still group.
        return stem.replaceFirst("\\s*\\(\\d+\\)$", "");
    }

    /**
     * Makes disk and database agree: seeds demos once on a truly fresh
     * install, drops rows whose files vanished, adopts or cleans finalized
     * raw leftovers shadowed by a finished conversion, adopts orphaned
     * recordings back into the library, and prunes any redundant or orphaned
     * files in {@code .float32/}. Files with a .pending marker are left
     * alone — the unfinished-take flow owns them.
     */
    static ReconcileResult reconcile(Context ctx) {
        ReconcileResult rr = new ReconcileResult();
        File dir;
        try {
            dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return rr;
        }
        File[] files = dir.listFiles();
        if (files == null) files = new File[0];

        // Week-old soft deletes are reaped so the trash can't grow forever.
        // Runs before adoption so a resurrected file is never swept same-boot.
        try {
            rr.trashFreedBytes = Dsp.pruneTrash(Dsp.trashDir(dir), TRASH_MAX_AGE_MS);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        Set&lt;String&gt; pendingStems = new HashSet<>();
        for (File f : files) {
            // NEW-03 fix: a stem with an interrupted conversion sidecar must
            // be left alone (sweep resumes it); otherwise the raw leftover
            // cleaner or the orphan adopter races the worker.
            if (f.getName().endsWith(".pending")
                    || f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json")) {
                String n = f.getName()
                        .replaceFirst("\\.pending$", "")
                        .replaceFirst("\\.conv\\.json$", "");
                pendingStems.add(stemOf(n));
            }
        }

        // 1) Prune rows whose backing files are gone.
        List&lt;Long&gt; prune = new ArrayList<>();
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            for (Take t : TAKES) {
                if (t.filePath != null && !(new File(t.filePath).exists())) {
                    prune.add(t.id);
                    deleteFloatMaster(t.id, new File(t.filePath));
                }
            }
            for (long id : prune) {
                for (int i = TAKES.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if (TAKES.get(i).id == id) TAKES.remove(i);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!prune.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                db.takes().deleteByIds(prune);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            rr.pruned = prune.size();
        }

        // Refresh the referenced set after pruning.
        Set&lt;String&gt; referenced = new HashSet<>();
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            for (Take t : TAKES) {
                if (t.filePath != null) referenced.add(t.filePath);
            }
        }

        // 2) Finalized raw leftovers: a float32 .wav sharing a stem with a
        // finished conversion (and no .pending / .conv.json) is a
        // crashed-save remnant. Adopt it into .float32/ for the finished
        // conversion if needed, or delete it if redundant.
        Map<String, List&lt;File&gt;> byStem = new HashMap<>();
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !isAudioFile(f.getName())) continue;
            String stem = stemOf(f.getName());
            List&lt;File&gt; g = byStem.get(stem);
            if (g == null) {
                g = new ArrayList<>();
                byStem.put(stem, g);
            }
            g.add(f);
        }
        for (Map.Entry<String, List&lt;File&gt;> e : byStem.entrySet()) {
            List&lt;File&gt; g = e.getValue();
            if (g.size() < 2 || pendingStems.contains(e.getKey())) continue;
            File finalFile = null;
            File floatWav = null;
            for (File f : g) {
                String n = f.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.US);
                if (n.endsWith(".wav") && isFloat32Wav(f)
                        && !referenced.contains(f.getAbsolutePath())) {
                    floatWav = f;
                } else {
                    finalFile = f;
                }
            }
            if (finalFile != null && floatWav != null && !referenced.contains(
                    floatWav.getAbsolutePath())) {
                long ownerId = findIdByFile(finalFile);
                if (!AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(finalFile)
                        && !hasFloatMaster(ownerId, finalFile)) {
                    adoptFloatMaster(ownerId, floatWav, finalFile);
                    if (!floatWav.exists()) rr.rawsCleaned++;
                } else {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    if (floatWav.delete()) rr.rawsCleaned++;
                }
            }
        }

        // 3) Adopt orphans back into the library.
        List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; adopted = new ArrayList<>();
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !isAudioFile(f.getName())) continue;
            if (f.getName().contains("_subrep_")) {
                // A crashed Select & Replace snippet is never a standalone
                // take; the parent raw remains the only source of truth.
                RecordingEngine.deletePendingMarker(f);
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            String abs = f.getAbsolutePath();
            if (referenced.contains(abs)) continue;
            if (pendingStems.contains(stemOf(f.getName()))) continue;
            if (!f.exists()) continue;
            Take t = adoptFile(ctx, f);
            if (t == null) continue;
            synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
                TAKES.add(t);
                referenced.add(abs);
            }
            adopted.add(TakeEntity.fromTake(t));
            rr.adopted++;
        }
        if (!adopted.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                db.takes().upsertAll(adopted);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
                sortByTimestampDesc();
            }
        }

        // 4) Sweep .float32/: migrate any legacy filename-keyed masters to
        // their owner's immutable ID (rec_&lt;id&gt;.f32.wav) and remove any
        // orphaned, corrupt, or redundant (WAV32) float32 files.
        try {
            File mastersDir = floatMastersDir(dir);
            File[] masterFiles = mastersDir.listFiles();
            if (masterFiles != null && masterFiles.length > 0) {
                Set&lt;String&gt; validMasterNames = new HashSet<>();
                synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
                    for (Take t : TAKES) {
                        if (t.filePath == null) continue;
                        File tf = new File(t.filePath);
                        if (tf.exists() && !AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(tf)) {
                            String canonicalName = "rec_" + t.id + ".f32.wav";
                            validMasterNames.add(canonicalName);
                            File legacy = new File(mastersDir,
                                    tf.getName() + ".f32.wav");
                            File canonical = new File(mastersDir, canonicalName);
                            if (legacy.exists() && !legacy.equals(canonical)) {
                                if (!canonical.exists()) {
                                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                                    legacy.renameTo(canonical);
                                } else {
                                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                                    legacy.delete();
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (ConversionJob j : ConversionJobs.active()) {
                    if (j.recordingId > 0) {
                        validMasterNames.add("rec_" + j.recordingId + ".f32.wav");
                    }
                }
                File[] remaining = mastersDir.listFiles();
                if (remaining != null) {
                    for (File mf : remaining) {
                        if (!mf.isFile()
                                || !validMasterNames.contains(mf.getName())
                                || !AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(mf)) {
                            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                            if (mf.delete()) rr.rawsCleaned++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        // 5) New installs start with an empty library: no synthetic demos.
        markSeeded(ctx);
        return rr;
    }
