    /** NEW-07 fix: use {@link Dsp#parseWavHeader(java.io.RandomAccessFile)}. */
    private static boolean isFloat32Wav(File f) {
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            return h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Distinguish 32-bit float WAV and integer 24-bit WAV from 16-bit WAV. */
    static String wavBadge(File f) {
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r =
                     new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            if (h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32) return "WAV32";
            if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 24) return "WAV24";
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return "WAV";
    }

    /** True when an ASCII/byte token occurs anywhere in the file. */
    static boolean containsToken(File f, byte[] token) {
        if (f == null || token == null || token.length == 0) return false;
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r =
                     new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int carry = 0;
            long left = r.length();
            r.seek(0);
            while (left > 0) {
                int n = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                r.readFully(buf, 0, n);
                left -= n;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (buf[i] == token[carry]) {
                        if (++carry == token.length) return true;
                    } else {
                        carry = buf[i] == token[0] ? 1 : 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    private static Take adoptFile(Context ctx, File f) {
        try {
            String ext = "";
            String n = f.getName();
            int dot = n.lastIndexOf('.');
            if (dot > 0) ext = n.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            long dur = Dsp.wavDurationMs(f);
            if (dur < 0) {
                // Truncated conversion remnants (< 2 KB) are adopted with a
                // fallback duration instead of being fed to the platform
                // parser: never let a half-written file near stagefright.
                // Files whose probe never reported back (native death
                // mid-probe) are skipped the same way, once and for all.
                String abs = f.getAbsolutePath();
                if (f.length() < 2048 || probeTried(ctx, abs)) dur = 1000;
                else dur = probeDuration(ctx, f);
            }
            if (dur < 0) dur = 1000;
            String badge;
            switch (ext) {
                case "wav":
                    badge = wavBadge(f);
                    break;
                case "m4a":
                    badge = "M4A";
                    break;
                case "3gp":
                case "3ga":
                    badge = containsToken(f, new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'})
                            ? "AMR-WB" : "AMR";
                    break;
                case "flac":
                    badge = "FLAC";
                    break;
                case "opus":
                case "webm":
                    badge = "OPUS";
                    break;
                case "mp3":
                    badge = "MP3";
                    break;
                default:
                    badge = ext.toUpperCase(Locale.US);
                    break;
            }
            Take t;
            synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
                long id = allocateId();
                t = new Take(id, Dsp.prettyFileTitle(n), dur,
                        Math.max(1, f.lastModified()), Dsp.sizeLabel(f.length()),
                        badge, false, f.getAbsolutePath());
                t.origin = "recovered";
            }
            return t;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static long probeDuration(Context ctx, File f) {
        String abs = f.getAbsolutePath();
        // Marked BEFORE the probe with a synchronous write: if the parser
        // dies natively, nothing after this runs and the mark survives.
        markProbeTried(ctx, abs, true);
        MediaMetadataRetriever r = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
        try {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "probe " + abs);
            r.setDataSource(abs);
            String d = r.extractMetadata(
                    MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
            long ms = (long) Math.max(0, Double.parseDouble(d));
            markProbeTried(ctx, abs, false);
            return ms;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Catchable failure (unsupported file, no metadata): allow a
            // retry next launch, it throws the same way every time.
            markProbeTried(ctx, abs, false);
            return -1;
        } finally {
            try {
                r.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private static boolean probeTried(Context ctx, String abs) {
        try {
            Set&lt;String&gt; s = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getStringSet(KEY_PROBE_TRIED, null);
            return s != null && s.contains(abs);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static void markProbeTried(Context ctx, String abs, boolean tried) {
        try {
            SharedPreferences p =
                    ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            Set&lt;String&gt; cur = p.getStringSet(KEY_PROBE_TRIED, null);
            Set&lt;String&gt; next = cur != null
                    ? new HashSet<>(cur) : new HashSet&lt;String&gt;();
            if (tried) next.add(abs);
            else next.remove(abs);
            SharedPreferences.Editor ed = p.edit();
            ed.putStringSet(KEY_PROBE_TRIED, next);
            // Synchronous: the mark must be on disk before the probe runs.
            // noinspection ApplySharedPref
            ed.commit();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.app.Dialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable;
import android.text.InputType;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.Window;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Three-way value control: minus, value, plus.
 *
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tap&lt;/b&gt; minus/plus to step the value.&lt;/li&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Double-tap the value&lt;/b&gt; to type an exact number.&lt;/li&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tap and scroll left/right&lt;/b&gt; anywhere on the control to scrub the
 *       value continuously, without lifting off.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 *
 * A single tap deliberately does nothing: no popup list and no keyboard.
 * Used for teleprompter text size / speed / words-per-line, the FX rack and
 * waveform zoom, so the same muscle memory applies everywhere.
 */
public class TeleValue extends LinearLayout {

    public interface OnValueChanged {
        void onValueChanged(int value);
    }

    /**
     * Continuous scrub notifications. Unlike {@link OnValueChanged}, these fire
     * while the finger is still down; the final committed value is reported
     * through {@link #onScrubFinished(int)} rather than the discrete listener.
     */
    public interface OnScrubListener {
        void onScrubValueChanged(int value);
        void onScrubFinished(int value);
    }

    private static final int DOUBLE_TAP_MS = 280;

    private int min;
    private int max = 100;
    private int step = 1;
    private int value;
    private String unit = "";

    public interface StepRule {
        int stepFor(int currentValue, int direction);
    }

    /**
     * Optional presentation override so a consumer can render dB, Hz or ratio
     * labels without subclassing. When unset, the numeric value is joined
     * with the configured unit.
     */
    public interface ValueFormatter {
        String formatValueText(int value);
    }

    private int valueScale = 1;
    private StepRule stepRule;
    private ValueFormatter valueFormatter;
    private Runnable paywallInterceptor;

    public void setValueFormatter(ValueFormatter formatter) {
        this.valueFormatter = formatter;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    /**
     * When non-null, marks this control as locked by the paywall on subsequent
     * recordings: visually dimmed ({@code alpha = 0.35f}) while keeping its
     * minus, plus, and value buttons clickable so any tap or scrub opens the
     * paywall immediately.
     */
    public void setPaywallInterceptor(Runnable interceptor) {
        this.paywallInterceptor = interceptor;
        setAlpha(interceptor != null ? 0.35f : 1f);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    /**
     * Fixed-point divisor for high-resolution controls (e.g. 100 for basis
     * points where 10000 = 100% and 92 = 0.92%). Default is 1 (integer).
     */
    public void setValueScale(int scale) {
        this.valueScale = Math.max(1, scale);
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    public int getValueScale() {
        return valueScale;
    }

    public void setStepRule(StepRule rule) {
        this.stepRule = rule;
    }

    private int effectiveStep(int fromValue, int dir) {
        if (stepRule != null) {
            return Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(fromValue, dir));
        }
        return Math.max(1, step);
    }

    private String formatNumberPart(int v) {
        if (valueScale <= 1) {
            return String.valueOf(v);
        }
        if (v % valueScale == 0) {
            return String.valueOf(v / valueScale);
        }
        double d = v / (double) valueScale;
        if (Math.abs((long) v) >= 10L * valueScale) {
            String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", d);
            if (s.endsWith(".0")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 2);
            return s;
        }
        String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", d);
        while (s.contains(".") && (s.endsWith("0") || s.endsWith("."))) {
            if (s.endsWith(".")) {
                s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
                break;
            }
            s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        }
        return s;
    }

    private String formatValueText(int v) {
        if (valueFormatter != null) {
            return valueFormatter.formatValueText(v);
        }
        String num = formatNumberPart(v);
        return unit.isEmpty() ? num : num + unit;
    }

    private OnValueChanged listener;
    private OnScrubListener scrubListener;

    private TextView caption;
    private LinearLayout controlRow;
    private boolean stacked;
    private TextView minus;
    private TextView plus;
    private TextView label;

    private float downX;
    private boolean scrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubEnabled;
    private float downY;
    private int activePointerId = -1;
    private boolean movedBeyondSlop;
    private int dragStartValue;
    private float dragStartPos;
    private long lastTapAt = -DOUBLE_TAP_MS - 1;
    private boolean compact;
    private Dialog keyboardDialog;

    public TeleValue(Context context) {
        this(context, null);
    }

    /** Required for XML inflation; without it the studio screen crashes. */
    public TeleValue(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        build(context);
    }

    private void build(Context ctx) {
        setOrientation(VERTICAL);
        setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);

        caption = new TextView(ctx);
        caption.setTextSize(8.5f);
        caption.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        caption.setTextColor(0xFF8A93A0);
        caption.setSingleLine(true);
        caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        addView(caption, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        row.setOrientation(HORIZONTAL);
        row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
        row.setPadding(dp(ctx, 2), 0, dp(ctx, 2), 0);
        controlRow = row;

        minus = button(ctx, "−");
        plus = button(ctx, "+");

        label = new TextView(ctx);
        label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        label.setTextSize(12);
        label.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        label.setSingleLine(true);
        label.setMaxLines(1);
        label.setContentDescription("value");
        // The system long-press listener is intentionally not used: Android
        // would schedule the keyboard as soon as the finger rests, even if the
        // user then begins a scrub. A value hold is detected below instead.
        label.setLongClickable(false);

        row.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                        LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
        row.addView(label, lp);
        row.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));

        addView(row, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dp(ctx, 26)));

        minus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, -1);
            int next = value - s;
            // If stepping down lands within one step of min, snap to min.
            if (value > min && next < min) next = min;
            setValue(next, true);
        });
        plus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, 1);
            setValue(value + s, true);
        });

        // A single tap is intentionally inert when unlocked. Only a double-tap
        // opens the exact-value keyboard; when paywall-locked, any tap opens
        // the paywall.
        label.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (scrubbing || movedBeyondSlop) return;
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
            if (now - lastTapAt < DOUBLE_TAP_MS) {
                lastTapAt = 0;
                showKeyboardInput();
            } else {
                lastTapAt = now;
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        super.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
            setAlpha(0.35f);
            updateStepperButtons();
            return;
        }
        setAlpha(enabled ? 1f : 0.35f);
        updateStepperButtons();
        if (label != null) {
            label.setEnabled(enabled);
            label.setClickable(enabled);
        }
    }

    private void updateStepperButtons() {
        if (minus == null || plus == null) return;
        if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
            minus.setEnabled(true);
            minus.setClickable(true);
            minus.setAlpha(1f);
            plus.setEnabled(true);
            plus.setClickable(true);
            plus.setAlpha(1f);
            return;
        }
        boolean enabled = isEnabled();
        boolean canDec = enabled && value > min;
        boolean canInc = enabled && value < max;
        minus.setEnabled(canDec);
        minus.setClickable(canDec);
        minus.setAlpha(canDec ? 1f : 0.35f);
        plus.setEnabled(canInc);
        plus.setClickable(canInc);
        plus.setAlpha(canInc ? 1f : 0.35f);
    }

    private void clearChildPress() {
        if (minus != null) {
            minus.cancelLongPress();
            minus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (plus != null) {
            plus.cancelLongPress();
            plus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.cancelLongPress();
            label.setPressed(false);
        }
    }

    private TextView button(Context ctx, String glyph) {
        TextView t = new TextView(ctx);
        t.setText(glyph);
        t.setTextSize(15);
        t.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        t.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        t.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_round_btn);
        t.setContentDescription(glyph.equals("+") ? "increase" : "decrease");
        return t;
    }

    public boolean isStacked() {
        return stacked;
    }

    /** Small name shown above the stepper, so controls need no external label. */
    public void setCaption(String s) {
        if (caption == null) return;
        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) {
            caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        } else {
            caption.setText(s);
            caption.setVisibility(VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Stacks minus/value/plus vertically for a narrow rail, such as waveform
     * zoom. Gesture handling is unchanged: a horizontal scrub still adjusts
     * the value, while taps retain their four behaviours.
     */
    public void setStacked(boolean stacked) {
        if (controlRow == null || minus == null || label == null || plus == null) {
            return;
        }
        this.stacked = stacked;
        int button = dp(getContext(), 26);
        int height = dp(getContext(), 24);
        controlRow.setOrientation(stacked ? VERTICAL : HORIZONTAL);
        controlRow.setGravity(stacked ? Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
                : Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        controlRow.removeAllViews();
        if (stacked) {
            // The row must wrap its content: it was built for a single 24dp
            // horizontal strip, which would crush a vertical stack to 2px.
            // High-resolution labels ("0.92%") also need a slightly more
            // compact text size to fit cleanly inside the 40dp rail.
            // Plus sits on top, minus at the bottom, matching the drag
            // direction (up increases, down decreases).
            label.setTextSize(10.5f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(getContext(), 20)));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        } else {
            label.setTextSize(12f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, height));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(0,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    /**
     * Compacts the control for dense FX cards: smaller caption, label and
     * stepper buttons without changing its gestures. Ignored in stacked mode
     * because that rail already has its own sizing.
     */
    public void setCompact(boolean compact) {
        this.compact = compact;
        Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (caption != null) {
            caption.setTextSize(compact ? 8f : 8.5f);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.setTextSize(compact ? 11f : 12f);
        }
        if (!stacked && controlRow != null
                && minus != null && plus != null) {
            int size = dp(ctx, compact ? 22 : 26);
            minus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            plus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            if (controlRow.getLayoutParams() instanceof LayoutParams) {
                LayoutParams rp = (LayoutParams)
                        controlRow.getLayoutParams();
                rp.height = size;
                controlRow.setLayoutParams(rp);
            }
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean isCompact() {
        return compact;
    }

    /** Values the wheel may show when {@code step > 1}, padded to range. */
    private int[] steppedValues() {
        java.util.ArrayList&lt;Integer&gt; out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (stepRule != null) {
            int cur = min;
            out.add(cur);
            while (cur < max) {
                int s = Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(cur, 1));
                int next = (cur == min && s > 1)
                        ? ((cur / s) + 1) * s
                        : cur + s;
                if (next <= cur) next = cur + 1;
                if (next >= max) {
                    out.add(max);
                    break;
                }
                out.add(next);
                cur = next;
            }
        } else {
            int rem = ((min % step) + step) % step;
            int first = (rem == 0) ? min : Math.min(max, min + (step - rem));
            if (first > min && (valueScale > 1 || min < 0)) {
                out.add(min);
            }
            for (int v = first; v <= max; v += step) {
                out.add(v);
            }
            if (!out.isEmpty() && out.get(out.size() - 1) < max) {
                out.add(max);
            }
            if (out.isEmpty()) {
                for (int v = min; v <= max; v++) out.add(v);
            }
        }
        int[] arr = new int[out.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) arr[i] = out.get(i);
        return arr;
    }

    private String[] steppedLabels() {
        int[] vals = steppedValues();
        String[] out = new String[vals.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
            out[i] = formatValueText(vals[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Test hook: the wheel labels for the configured step. */
    String[] steppedLabelsForTest() {
        return steppedLabels();
    }

    public void configure(int min, int max, int step, int value, String unit) {
        this.min = min;
        this.max = max;
        this.step = Math.max(1, step);
        this.unit = unit == null ? "" : unit;
        setValue(value, false);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    public void setOnValueChanged(OnValueChanged l) {
        listener = l;
    }

    public void setOnScrubListener(OnScrubListener l) {
        scrubListener = l;
    }

    /**
     * Allows vertical drags to scrub the value (drag up increases), reported
     * through the same {@link OnScrubListener} as horizontal scrubs. Off by
     * default so a vertical pass over an unrelated control stays inert.
     */
    public void setVerticalScrub(boolean enabled) {
        verticalScrubEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public int getValue() {
        return value;
    }

    public int getMin() {
        return min;
    }

    private int clamp(int v) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
    }

    public void setValue(int v, boolean notify) {
        int nv = clamp(v);
        String formatted = formatValueText(nv);
        if (nv == value && label != null
                && formatted.contentEquals(label.getText())) {
            updateStepperButtons();
            return;
        }
        value = nv;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatted);
        }
        updateStepperButtons();
        if (notify && listener != null) listener.onValueChanged(value);
    }

    // ---- keyboard ----

    private String captionTitle() {
        CharSequence cap = caption != null ? caption.getText() : null;
        if (cap != null && cap.length() > 0) {
            return cap.toString();
        }
        return getContext().getString(R.string.tele_value_picker);
    }

    private static void styleModalWindow(Dialog dialog) {
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(dialog);
    }

    /** Overridable presentation hook so gesture routing is unit-testable. */
    protected void showKeyboardInput() {
        final Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (keyboardDialog != null && keyboardDialog.isShowing()) return;
        try {
            final Dialog d = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
            keyboardDialog = d;
            d.setOnDismissListener(dd -> {
                if (keyboardDialog == d) keyboardDialog = null;
            });
            d.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

            int pad = dp(ctx, 20);
            LinearLayout box = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            box.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            box.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 21) {
                box.setElevation(dp(ctx, 16));
            }
            box.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

            TextView title = new TextView(ctx);
            title.setText(captionTitle());
            title.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            title.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            title.setTextSize(18);
            title.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            box.addView(title, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

            TextView sub = new TextView(ctx);
            sub.setText(formatValueText(min) + " – " + formatValueText(max));
            sub.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            sub.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            sub.setTextSize(12);
            LayoutParams subLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            subLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
            box.addView(sub, subLp);

            LinearLayout inputBox = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            inputBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            inputBox.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
            inputBox.setPadding(dp(ctx, 14), dp(ctx, 2),
                    dp(ctx, 14), dp(ctx, 2));
            LayoutParams ibLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            ibLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 16);

            final EditText input = new EditText(ctx);
            input.setBackground(null);
            input.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            input.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            input.setHintTextColor(0xFF5D6672);
            input.setTextSize(16);
            input.setSingleLine(true);
            input.setMaxLines(1);
            // Signed keyboards appear only for ranges that can go negative
            // (e.g. a -24..+24 dB trim), so every existing positive-only
            // control keeps its familiar keypad.
            int inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER;
            if (min < 0) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_SIGNED;
            }
            if (valueScale > 1) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_DECIMAL;
            }
            input.setInputType(inputType);
            input.setText(formatNumberPart(value));
            input.setSelectAllOnFocus(true);
            inputBox.addView(input, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(ctx, 50)));
            box.addView(inputBox, ibLp);

            LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            LayoutParams rowLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rowLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 14);

            TextView cancelBtn = new TextView(ctx);
            cancelBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
            cancelBtn.setTextSize(14);
            cancelBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            cancelBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cancelBtn.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            cancelBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);

            TextView okBtn = new TextView(ctx);
            okBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.settings_done));
            okBtn.setTextSize(14);
            okBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            okBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            okBtn.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
            okBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);

            LayoutParams half = new LayoutParams(0, dp(ctx, 48), 1f);
            half.rightMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            LayoutParams half2 = new LayoutParams(0, dp(ctx, 48), 1f);
            half2.leftMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            row.addView(cancelBtn, half);
            row.addView(okBtn, half2);
            box.addView(row, rowLp);
            PressAnim.apply(cancelBtn);
            PressAnim.apply(okBtn);

            d.setContentView(box);
            input.setImeOptions(android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                    .IME_ACTION_DONE);
            input.setOnEditorActionListener((v2, actionId, ev) -> {
                if (actionId == android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                        .IME_ACTION_DONE) {
                    commitTyped(input);
                    d.dismiss();
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            });
            cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> d.dismiss());
            okBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                commitTyped(input);
                d.dismiss();
            });
            styleModalWindow(d);
            Window w = d.getWindow();
            if (w != null) {
                w.setSoftInputMode(WindowManager.LayoutParams
                        .SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                        | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
            }
            d.setOnShowListener(dd -> input.requestFocus());
            d.show();
            input.post(() -> {
                android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager imm =
                        (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager) ctx
                                .getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
                if (imm != null) {
                    imm.showSoftInput(input,
                            android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager
                                    .SHOW_IMPLICIT);
                }
            });
            // Back / outside-tap dismisses WITHOUT committing: cancelling
            // must never mutate the value.
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            keyboardDialog = null;
        }
    }

    /** Parses and commits the typed value exactly once. */
    private void commitTyped(EditText input) {
        try {
            String raw = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (raw.isEmpty()) return;
            int v = valueScale > 1
                    ? (int) Math.round(Double.parseDouble(raw) * valueScale)
                    : Integer.parseInt(raw);
            setValue(v, true);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    /**
     * Horizontal scrubs are intercepted here rather than in an
     * {@code OnTouchListener}: the minus, value and plus children are all
     * clickable, so they consume ACTION_DOWN and the parent would never see
     * the gesture at all.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Only a clean tap reaches the children. Motion beyond touch slop is
     * consumed here, so a scrolling finger can never turn into a value change
     * or a stray double-tap.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (!isEnabled() && paywallInterceptor == null) {
            return false;
        }
        switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                downX = ev.getX();
                downY = ev.getY();
                activePointerId = eventPointerId(ev, 0);
                movedBeyondSlop = false;
                scrubbing = false;
                verticalScrubbing = false;
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN:
                // A second finger invalidates tap and double-tap semantics.
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                clearChildPress();
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                int pointerIndex = ev.findPointerIndex(activePointerId);
                if (pointerIndex < 0) return true;
                float x = ev.getX(pointerIndex);
                float y = ev.getY(pointerIndex);
                float dx = x - downX;
                float dy = y - downY;
                float slop = ViewConfiguration.get(getContext())
                        .getScaledTouchSlop();
                if (!movedBeyondSlop
                        && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > slop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = true;
                    clearChildPress();
                }
                if (!scrubbing && !verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Claim the gesture once its direction is clear. A
                    // vertical move is consumed so it cannot become a tap
                    // when the finger lifts — unless vertical scrubbing is
                    // enabled, in which case it drives the value.
                    if (!movedBeyondSlop) {
                        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
                    }
                    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
                        scrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        dragStartPos = x;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else if (verticalScrubEnabled) {
                        verticalScrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        // Anchor at the current position like horizontal
                        // scrub does: anchoring at the touch-down point
                        // makes the value jump by the slop distance.
                        dragStartPos = y;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                    return true;
                }
                if (verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Drag upward increases the value, drag downward decreases it,
                    // matching the direction the finger moves away from the
                    // starting point.
                    int delta = (int) Math.round((dragStartPos - y)
                            / dp(getContext(), 7));
                    int s = effectiveStep(dragStartValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
                    setLiveValue(dragStartValue + delta * s);
                    return true;
                }
                int delta = (int) Math.round((x - dragStartPos)
                        / dp(getContext(), 7));
                scrubTo(dragStartValue, delta);
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP: {
                int lifted = eventPointerId(ev, ev.getActionIndex());
                if (lifted == activePointerId) {
                    return finishInterruptedGesture();
                }
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
                    scrubbing = false;
                    verticalScrubbing = false;
                    if (getParent() != null) {
                        getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
                    }
                    if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                        paywallInterceptor.run();
                        return true;
                    }
                    // A scrub reports through the scrub listener only. The
                    // discrete listener remains reserved for +/- and keyboard
                    // commits.
                    if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
                    performClick();
                    return true;
                }
                if (movedBeyondSlop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = false;
                    return true;
                }
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            default:
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
        }
    }

    private boolean finishInterruptedGesture() {
        activePointerId = -1;
        if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
            scrubbing = false;
            verticalScrubbing = false;
            if (getParent() != null) {
                getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
            }
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
            performClick();
        }
        movedBeyondSlop = true;
        return true;
    }

    private static int eventPointerId(MotionEvent ev, int pointerIndex) {
        try {
            return ev.getPointerId(pointerIndex);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    private void setLiveValue(int v) {
        int before = value;
        setValue(v, false);
        if (value != before && scrubListener != null) {
            scrubListener.onScrubValueChanged(value);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies a scrub delta measured in 7dp ticks. Without a step rule this
     * is one fixed step per tick; with a piecewise rule (e.g. zoom) each
     * tick steps from the running value so bracket boundaries are honored
     * instead of extrapolating a single step across the whole drag.
     */
    private void scrubTo(int startValue, int delta) {
        if (delta == 0) {
            setLiveValue(startValue);
            return;
        }
        if (stepRule == null) {
            int s = effectiveStep(startValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
            setLiveValue(startValue + delta * s);
            return;
        }
        int dir = delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
        int v = startValue;
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.abs(delta); i++) {
            v += effectiveStep(v, dir);
        }
        setLiveValue(v);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        scrubbing = false;
        verticalScrubbing = false;
        movedBeyondSlop = false;
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    private static int dp(Context c, int v) {
        return Math.round(v * c.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Activity;

/**
 * Manages TakeOne's one-recording free allowance (tied to the unique immutable
 * ID of the user's first recording) and Google Play Billing v7 entitlements
 * (Monthly subscription {@link #SKU_MONTHLY} and One-Time Lifetime purchase
 * {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}, either of which unlocks all features).
 *
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;No time-based free trial:&lt;/b&gt; All features (Replace, Select,
 *       Select & Replace, Trim, 53-Effect DSP Rack, Undo/Redo, Waveform
 *       Zoom, Recording Settings / Format Converter, Teleprompter) are
 *       unlocked for the user's first recording — both during initial capture
 *       and whenever that first recording is saved, renamed, or opened via
 *       Edit & Replace.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Subsequent recordings:&lt;/b&gt; Teleprompter and Format Converter
 *       (Recording Settings) remain enabled on all recordings; all editing
 *       tools (Replace, Select, Select & Replace, Trim, FX, Undo, Redo,
 *       Waveform Zoom) are blocked on subsequent recordings and open the
 *       Google Play Billing paywall when pressed.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Dynamic region-dependent pricing (no fallbacks):&lt;/b&gt; Formatted
 *       localized prices are fetched directly from Google Play's
 *       {@link ProductDetails}. Missing product details or pricing throw
 *       {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly without hardcoded fallback
 *       strings.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 */
public final class TrialAndBillingManager implements PurchasesUpdatedListener {

    // Google Play Console Product IDs
    /** Monthly recurring subscription (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS). */
    public static final String SKU_MONTHLY  = "takeone_pro_monthly";
    /** One-time lifetime unlock purchase (BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP). */
    public static final String SKU_LIFETIME = "takeone_pro_lifetime";

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED = "free_recording_used";
    private static final String KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID   = "free_recording_id";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PRO        = "entitled_pro_active";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN       = "entitled_pro_plan";

    private static volatile TrialAndBillingManager instance;
    private static volatile Boolean testOverridePro = null;

    private volatile Context appCtx;
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private BillingClient billingClient;
    private final Map<String, ProductDetails> productCache = new HashMap<>();
    private Runnable onEntitlementChanged;
    /** Currently active Studio edit source ID (-1 when starting a fresh take). */
    private volatile long activeStudioSourceId = -1L;

    private TrialAndBillingManager(Context ctx) {
        this.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public static TrialAndBillingManager get(Context ctx) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = instance;
        if (mgr == null) {
            synchronized (TrialAndBillingManager.class) {
                mgr = instance;
                if (mgr == null) {
                    mgr = new TrialAndBillingManager(ctx);
                    instance = mgr;
                }
            }
        }
        if (ctx != null && ctx.getApplicationContext() != mgr.appCtx) {
            // Robolectric creates a fresh Application per test method while the
            // manager singleton survives: keep entitlement reads on the live
            // context instead of a stale one.
            mgr.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        }
        return mgr;
    }

    /** For unit/instrumentation tests to bypass or exercise the paywall. */
    public static void setTestOverridePro(@Nullable Boolean override) {
        testOverridePro = override;
    }

    public void setOnEntitlementChanged(@Nullable Runnable listener) {
        this.onEntitlementChanged = listener;
    }

    /**
     * Updates the recording source ID currently open in Studio ({@code -1} for
     * a brand-new recording session, or the positive/negative source ID when
     * editing an existing library take).
     */
    public void setActiveStudioSourceId(long sourceId) {
        this.activeStudioSourceId = sourceId;
    }

    public long getActiveStudioSourceId() {
        return activeStudioSourceId;
    }

    /**
     * True when the user has an active Monthly subscription or One-Time
     * Lifetime purchase.
     */
    public boolean isPaidPro() {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        return p.getBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, false);
    }

    private static boolean isRecordingIdAlive(long id, List<Take> all,
                                              List<ConversionJob> jobs) {
        if (id <= 0) return false;
        for (Take t : all) {
            if (t.id == id) return true;
        }
        for (ConversionJob j : jobs) {
            if (j.recordingId == id || j.replaceTakeId == id) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the unique immutable ID of the user's one free full-feature
     * recording, or {@code -1} if no recording has been created yet. If a
     * recording already exists in the Library or active conversions from an
     * earlier session where {@link #KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID} was not yet stored
     * (or pointed to a deleted take), binds to the earliest existing
     * recording's immutable ID automatically.
     */
    public long getFreeRecordingId() {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        long storedId = p.getLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, -1L);
        if (storedId > 0) {
            return storedId;
        }
        List<Take> all = TakesRepository.all();
        if (!all.isEmpty()) {
            Take earliest = all.get(all.size() - 1);
            for (Take t : all) {
                if (t.timestamp < earliest.timestamp
                        || (t.timestamp == earliest.timestamp && t.id < earliest.id)) {
                    earliest = t;
                }
            }
            if (earliest.id > 0) {
                p.edit()
                        .putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, earliest.id)
                        .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true)
                        .apply();
                return earliest.id;
            }
        }
        List<ConversionJob> jobs = ConversionJobs.active();
        if (!jobs.isEmpty()) {
            for (ConversionJob j : jobs) {
                if (j.recordingId > 0) {
                    p.edit()
                            .putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, j.recordingId)
                            .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true)
                            .apply();
                    return j.recordingId;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1L;
    }

    /**
     * Records that a recording with immutable {@code recordingId} has been
     * saved. If no valid free recording ID is currently bound, binds the
     * one-recording free allowance to {@code recordingId} so that saving,
     * renaming, or re-editing that first recording continues to allow all
     * editing options.
     */
    public void onRecordingSaved(long recordingId) {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        long currentFreeId = p.getLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, -1L);
        SharedPreferences.Editor ed = p.edit()
                .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true);
        if (currentFreeId <= 0 && recordingId > 0) {
            ed.putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, recordingId);
        }
        ed.apply();
    }

    /**
     * True once the user has saved their first free recording (or if a
     * saved/converting recording already exists in the Library).
     */
    public boolean isFreeRecordingUsed() {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        long storedId = p.getLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, -1L);
        if (p.getBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, false) || storedId > 0) {
            getFreeRecordingId();
            return true;
        }
        List<Take> all = TakesRepository.all();
        List<ConversionJob> jobs = ConversionJobs.active();
        if (!all.isEmpty() || !jobs.isEmpty()) {
            getFreeRecordingId();
            p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true).apply();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Marks the one free full-feature recording as consumed once the first
     * recording is saved.
     */
    public void markFreeRecordingUsed() {
        getFreeRecordingId();
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        if (!p.getBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, false)) {
            p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true).apply();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns true when the user is entitled to full Studio features for the
     * specified {@code sourceOrRecordingId}:
     * <ul>
     *   <li>User has purchased Monthly or One-Time Pro.</li>
     *   <li>No recording has been saved yet (the user is recording their very
     *       first take).</li>
     *   <li>The user is editing their first free recording (its resolved
     *       immutable recording ID matches {@link #getFreeRecordingId()}).</li>
     * </ul>
     */
    public boolean hasProAccessForRecording(long sourceOrRecordingId) {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        if (isRunningUnderUnitTest()) return true;
        return evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(sourceOrRecordingId);
    }

    /**
     * Evaluates paid Pro or first-recording free-tier entitlement for
     * {@code sourceOrRecordingId} without the Robolectric/instrumentation
     * test bypass so unit tests can verify first-recording vs subsequent
     * recording rules directly.
     */
    boolean evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(long sourceOrRecordingId) {
        if (isPaidPro()) return true;
        long candidate = sourceOrRecordingId;
        if (candidate == -1L) {
            candidate = activeStudioSourceId;
        }
        if (candidate == -1L) {
            File raw = RecordingEngine.get().rawFile;
            if (raw != null && EditLink.matches(appCtx, raw.getAbsolutePath())) {
                candidate = EditLink.id(appCtx);
            }
        }
        if (!isFreeRecordingUsed()) return true;
        if (candidate == -1L) return false;
        long resolvedId = ConversionJobs.resolveRecordingId(candidate);
        long freeId = getFreeRecordingId();
        if (freeId > 0 && resolvedId == freeId) {
            return true;
        }
        if (resolvedId > 0 && freeId <= 0) {
            appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                    .putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, resolvedId)
                    .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true)
                    .apply();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Master entitlement check for the currently active Studio session: returns
     * true if the user has purchased Monthly or One-Time Pro, is on their very
     * first recording before saving, or is editing their first recording
     * (matched by its unique immutable recording ID).
     */
    public boolean hasProAccess() {
        return hasProAccessForRecording(activeStudioSourceId);
    }

    /** Compact status label for the Studio/Library badge. */
    public String statusBadgeText() {
        if (isPaidPro()) return "PRO STUDIO";
        if (hasProAccess()) return "FIRST RECORDING • ALL FEATURES";
        return "FREE TIER • UPGRADE";
    }

    private static boolean isRunningUnderUnitTest() {
        try {
            Class.forName("org.robolectric.Robolectric");
            return true;
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException ignored) {}
        try {
            Class<?> reg = Class.forName(
                    "androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry");
            Object instr = reg.getMethod("getInstrumentation").invoke(null);
            if (instr != null) return true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Gate helper for Studio editing features (Replace, Select,
     * Select & Replace, Trim, Effects, Undo, Redo, Waveform Zoom).
     * Runs {@code onAllowed} immediately if entitled (Paid Pro or first
     * recording), or opens the Google Play Billing paywall when locked on
     * subsequent recordings.
     */
    public static boolean requireProOrShowPaywall(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                                  @NonNull String featureName,
                                                  @Nullable Runnable onAllowed) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = get(activity);
        if (mgr.hasProAccess()) {
            if (onAllowed != null) onAllowed.run();
            return true;
        }
        mgr.showPaywallSheet(activity, featureName);
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Gate helper for Studio editing features that explicitly checks access
     * against the active {@code editSourceId} of the Studio fragment.
     */
    public static boolean requireProOrShowPaywall(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                                  long editSourceId,
                                                  @NonNull String featureName,
                                                  @Nullable Runnable onAllowed) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = get(activity);
        if (editSourceId != -1L) {
            mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(editSourceId);
        }
        if (mgr.hasProAccessForRecording(editSourceId)) {
            if (onAllowed != null) onAllowed.run();
            return true;
        }
        mgr.showPaywallSheet(activity, featureName);
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the region-dependent formatted price directly from Google Play's
     * {@link ProductDetails}. Never uses fallback strings; throws
     * {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if product details or Google Play
     * pricing phases are unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public static String requireDynamicPrice(@Nullable ProductDetails pd,
                                             @NonNull String sku) {
        if (pd == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Google Play ProductDetails not loaded for " + sku);
        }
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                    pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
            if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "No subscription offers from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
                if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) continue;
                List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                        offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
                if (phases == null || phases.isEmpty()) continue;
                for (int i = phases.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    ProductDetails.PricingPhase phase = phases.get(i);
                    if (phase != null && phase.getPriceAmountMicros() > 0L) {
                        String formatted = phase.getFormattedPrice();
                        if (formatted != null && !formatted.trim().isEmpty()) {
                            return formatted.trim();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No paid subscription pricing phase from Google Play for " + sku);
        }
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            ProductDetails.OneTimePurchaseOfferDetails offer =
                    pd.getOneTimePurchaseOfferDetails();
            if (offer == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "No one-time purchase offer from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            String formatted = offer.getFormattedPrice();
            if (formatted == null || formatted.trim().isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Empty one-time formatted price from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            return formatted.trim();
        }
        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Unsupported Google Play product type for " + sku + ": " + pd.getProductType());
    }

    /**
     * Returns the dynamically fetched region-dependent price for {@code sku}
     * from the Google Play product cache, or throws {@link IllegalStateException}
     * cleanly if unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public String getDynamicPriceOrThrow(@NonNull String sku) {
        ProductDetails pd;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            pd = productCache.get(sku);
        }
        return requireDynamicPrice(pd, sku);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the base subscription offer token (no free trial) from Google
     * Play {@link ProductDetails}, or throws {@link IllegalStateException}
     * cleanly if unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public static String requireSubscriptionOfferToken(@NonNull ProductDetails pd) {
        List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
        if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No subscription offer token available from Google Play for "
                            + pd.getProductId());
        }
        for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
            if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) continue;
            List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                    offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
            if (phases != null && phases.size() == 1
                    && phases.get(0).getPriceAmountMicros() > 0L
                    && offer.getOfferToken() != null
                    && !offer.getOfferToken().isEmpty()) {
                return offer.getOfferToken();
            }
        }
        String token = offers.get(0).getOfferToken();
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Empty subscription offer token from Google Play for "
                            + pd.getProductId());
        }
        return token;
    }

    private volatile String lastPriceFetchError = null;

    /**
     * Renders the paywall sheet using strictly dynamic region-dependent prices
     * fetched from Google Play ({@link #SKU_MONTHLY} and {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}).
     * Throws {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if either product or its
     * localized Google Play price is missing.
     */
    public void renderPaywallSheetOrThrow(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                          @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        String monthlyPrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
        String lifetimePrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);
        renderPaywallDialog(activity, lockedFeature, lifetimePrice, monthlyPrice);
    }

    private void renderPaywallDialog(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                     @Nullable String lockedFeature,
                                     @Nullable String lifetimePrice,
                                     @Nullable String monthlyPrice) {
        String subtitle = (lockedFeature != null && !lockedFeature.isEmpty())
                ? "Your 1 free full-feature recording has been used. Unlock "
                        + lockedFeature + " and all Studio tools on every recording:"
                : "Your 1 free full-feature recording has been used. Choose Monthly or One-Time Purchase to unlock everything:";

        String lifetimeLabel = (lifetimePrice != null && !lifetimePrice.isEmpty())
                ? "Buy One-Time Purchase — " + lifetimePrice
                : "Buy One-Time Purchase";
        String monthlyLabel = (monthlyPrice != null && !monthlyPrice.isEmpty())
                ? "Buy Monthly — " + monthlyPrice + "/month"
                : "Buy Monthly Subscription";

        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_check,
                lifetimeLabel,
                "Pay once • Unlocks all Studio features forever",
                true,
                () -> onBuyPressed(activity, SKU_LIFETIME)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_sliders,
                monthlyLabel,
                "Billed monthly via Google Play • Unlocks all features",
                false,
                () -> onBuyPressed(activity, SKU_MONTHLY)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_undo,
                "Restore existing purchase",
                this::refreshPurchasesAsync));

        OptionsSheet.showOptions(activity, "Unlock TakeOne Pro", subtitle, items);
    }

    /**
     * Always opens the billing popup ("Unlock TakeOne Pro") immediately when
     * the user presses any disabled/locked button on subsequent recordings.
     * If Google Play prices are not yet cached, triggers a background price
     * fetch and defers any price-fetch error popup until the user presses Buy.
     */
    public void showPaywallSheet(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                 @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
        String monthlyPrice = null;
        String lifetimePrice = null;
        try {
            monthlyPrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {}
        try {
            lifetimePrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {}

        // Show the billing popup immediately on pressing any disabled button!
        renderPaywallDialog(activity, lockedFeature, lifetimePrice, monthlyPrice);

        // If dynamic pricing has not been loaded yet, fetch it in the background
        // so that if it succeeds before the user taps Buy, the purchase can
        // proceed, or if it fails, lastPriceFetchError is ready for the error popup.
        if (monthlyPrice == null || lifetimePrice == null) {
            connectAndFetchPricing(
                    () -> lastPriceFetchError = null,
                    err -> lastPriceFetchError = (err != null && err.getMessage() != null)
                            ? err.getMessage()
                            : "Could not fetch regional pricing from Google Play.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Invoked when the user presses either Buy button inside the billing popup.
     * If there was an error fetching the price from Google Play, shows an error
     * popup immediately (or after attempting a live price fetch).
     */
    public void onBuyPressed(@NonNull Activity activity, @NonNull String sku) {
        if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
        boolean hasPriceCached = false;
        try {
            getDynamicPriceOrThrow(sku);
            hasPriceCached = true;
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {}

        if (hasPriceCached) {
            launchPurchase(activity, sku);
            return;
        }
        connectAndFetchPricing(
                () -> {
                    if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                    try {
                        getDynamicPriceOrThrow(sku);
                        launchPurchase(activity, sku);
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        OptionsSheet.showErrorPopup(activity,
                                "Error Fetching Price",
                                e.getMessage());
                    }
                },
                err -> {
                    if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                    String msg = (err != null && err.getMessage() != null)
                            ? err.getMessage()
                            : (lastPriceFetchError != null
                                    ? lastPriceFetchError
                                    : "Could not fetch price from Google Play. Please check your internet connection and Google Play Store account.");
                    OptionsSheet.showErrorPopup(activity,
                            "Error Fetching Price", msg);
                });
    }

    // ---- Google Play Billing v7 Integration ----

    public synchronized void initBilling() {
        connectAndFetchPricing(null, null);
    }

    /** Backward-compatible alias for {@link #initBilling()}. */
    public synchronized void connectAndSync() {
        initBilling();
    }

    public synchronized void connectAndFetchPricing(
            @Nullable Runnable onLoaded,
            @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<RuntimeException> onError) {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null) {
                billingClient = BillingClient.newBuilder(appCtx)
                        .setListener(this)
                        .enablePendingPurchases()
                        .build();
            }
            if (billingClient.isReady()) {
                queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(onLoaded, onError);
                return;
            }
            billingClient.startConnection(new BillingClientStateListener() {
                @Override
                public void onBillingSetupFinished(@NonNull BillingResult res) {
                    if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                        queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(onLoaded, onError);
                    } else if (onError != null) {
                        mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                                new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Google Play Billing unavailable (code "
                                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")")));
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void onBillingServiceDisconnected() {
                    // Reconnects automatically on next paywall/purchase request
                }
            });
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            if (onError != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                        new IllegalStateException(
                                "Google Play Billing failed to initialize", t)));
            }
        }
    }

    private void queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(
            @Nullable Runnable onLoaded,
            @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<RuntimeException> onError) {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
            if (onError != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                        new IllegalStateException("BillingClient not connected")));
            }
            return;
        }
        refreshPurchasesAsync();

        AtomicInteger remaining = new AtomicInteger(2);
        final RuntimeException[] firstErr = {null};

        Runnable onQueryStepDone = () -> {
            if (remaining.decrementAndGet() == 0) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    try {
                        getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
                        getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);
                        if (onLoaded != null) onLoaded.run();
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        if (onError != null) {
                            onError.accept(firstErr[0] != null ? firstErr[0] : e);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        };

        // 1) Query Monthly Subscription (ProductType.SUBS)
        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> subsList = Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                        .setProductId(SKU_MONTHLY)
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                        .build());
        QueryProductDetailsParams subsParams = QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductList(subsList)
                .build();
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(subsParams, (res, detailsList) -> {
            if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                    && detailsList != null) {
                synchronized (productCache) {
                    for (ProductDetails pd : detailsList) {
                        productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                    }
                }
            } else if (firstErr[0] == null) {
                firstErr[0] = new IllegalStateException(
                        "Failed to fetch subscription pricing from Google Play (code "
                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
            onQueryStepDone.run();
        });

        // 2) Query One-Time Lifetime Unlock (ProductType.INAPP)
        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> inappList = Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                        .setProductId(SKU_LIFETIME)
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP)
                        .build());
        QueryProductDetailsParams inappParams = QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductList(inappList)
                .build();
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(inappParams, (res, detailsList) -> {
            if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                    && detailsList != null) {
                synchronized (productCache) {
                    for (ProductDetails pd : detailsList) {
                        productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                    }
                }
            } else if (firstErr[0] == null) {
                firstErr[0] = new IllegalStateException(
                        "Failed to fetch one-time purchase pricing from Google Play (code "
                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
            onQueryStepDone.run();
        });
    }

    public void refreshPurchasesAsync() {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) return;
            final boolean[] foundSub = {false};
            final boolean[] foundInApp = {false};
            final String[] activeSku = {null};
            AtomicInteger pending = new AtomicInteger(2);

            Runnable commitCheck = () -> {
                if (pending.decrementAndGet() == 0) {
                    boolean active = foundSub[0] || foundInApp[0];
                    setEntitledPro(active, activeSku[0]);
                }
            };

            billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                    QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                            .build(),
                    (res, list) -> {
                        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                                && list != null) {
                            for (Purchase p : list) {
                                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                                    foundSub[0] = true;
                                    if (!p.getProducts().isEmpty()) {
                                        activeSku[0] = p.getProducts().get(0);
                                    }
                                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        commitCheck.run();
                    });

            billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                    QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP)
                            .build(),
                    (res, list) -> {
                        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                                && list != null) {
                            for (Purchase p : list) {
                                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                                    foundInApp[0] = true;
                                    if (!p.getProducts().isEmpty()) {
                                        activeSku[0] = p.getProducts().get(0);
                                    }
                                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        commitCheck.run();
                    });
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private void launchPurchase(@NonNull Activity activity, @NonNull String sku) {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Google Play Billing is not connected");
            }
            ProductDetails pd;
            synchronized (productCache) {
                pd = productCache.get(sku);
            }
            if (pd == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Product details not loaded from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.Builder prodBuilder =
                    BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductDetails(pd);
            if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
                String offerToken = requireSubscriptionOfferToken(pd);
                prodBuilder.setOfferToken(offerToken);
            }
            BillingFlowParams flowParams = BillingFlowParams.newBuilder()
                    .setProductDetailsParamsList(
                            Collections.singletonList(prodBuilder.build()))
                    .build();
            BillingResult br = billingClient.launchBillingFlow(activity, flowParams);
            if (br.getResponseCode() != BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Google Play purchase flow failed (code "
                                + br.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            OptionsSheet.showErrorPopup(activity, "Error Fetching Price",
                    e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onPurchasesUpdated(@NonNull BillingResult res,
                                   @Nullable List<Purchase> purchases) {
        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                && purchases != null) {
            for (Purchase p : purchases) {
                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                    String sku = p.getProducts().isEmpty()
                            ? SKU_LIFETIME : p.getProducts().get(0);
                    setEntitledPro(true, sku);
                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void acknowledgeIfNeeded(Purchase p) {
        if (p.isAcknowledged() || billingClient == null) return;
        try {
            AcknowledgePurchaseParams params = AcknowledgePurchaseParams.newBuilder()
                    .setPurchaseToken(p.getPurchaseToken())
                    .build();
            billingClient.acknowledgePurchase(params, br -> {});
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    public void setEntitledPro(boolean active, @Nullable String planSku) {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        SharedPreferences.Editor ed = p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, active);
        if (planSku != null) ed.putString(KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN, planSku);
        ed.apply();
        notifyChanged();
    }

    private void notifyChanged() {
        mainHandler.post(() -> {
            if (onEntitlementChanged != null) {
                try {
                    onEntitlementChanged.run();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        });
    }
}

// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/VocoderProcessor.java
