            float boxTop = Math.max(2f, centerY - maxH - 5f);
            float boxBot = Math.min(h - 2f, centerY + maxH + 5f);
            float tabW = 12f * density;
            float tabH = 19f * density;
            float r = 4f * density;

            Paint borderPaint = selBorderPaint;
            if (xSelStart >= -tabW && xSelStart <= w + tabW) {
                float cx = Math.max(tabW * 0.5f, Math.min(w - tabW * 0.5f, xSelStart));
                canvas.drawLine(cx, boxTop, cx, boxBot, borderPaint);
                rect.set(cx - tabW * 0.5f, boxTop, cx + tabW * 0.5f, boxTop + tabH);
                canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, r, r, handlePaint);
                canvas.drawLine(cx, boxTop + 4f * density,
                        cx, boxTop + tabH - 4f * density, handleGripPaint);
            }
            if (xSelEnd >= -tabW && xSelEnd <= w + tabW) {
                float cx = Math.max(tabW * 0.5f, Math.min(w - tabW * 0.5f, xSelEnd));
                canvas.drawLine(cx, boxTop, cx, boxBot, borderPaint);
                rect.set(cx - tabW * 0.5f, boxBot - tabH, cx + tabW * 0.5f, boxBot);
                canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, r, r, handlePaint);
                canvas.drawLine(cx, boxBot - tabH + 4f * density,
                        cx, boxBot - 4f * density, handleGripPaint);
            }
        }

        // 4) Center Playhead Line + Top Indicator Cap
        playPaint.setColor(0xFFFF3B30);
        playPaint.setAlpha((isLive || n > 0) ? 255 : 90);
        float topY = Math.max(2f, centerY - maxH - 4f);
        float botY = Math.min(h - 2f, centerY + maxH + 4f);
        canvas.drawLine(centerX, topY, centerX, botY, playPaint);
        if (!isLive && n > 0) {
            canvas.drawCircle(centerX, topY + 3f * density, 3.2f * density, playPaint);
        }
    }
}


// =============================================================================
// FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/WsolaTimePitchProcessor.java
// =============================================================================
package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 WSOLA (Waveform Similarity Overlap-Add) engine.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;WSOLA time-stretches a signal without changing its pitch: the engine
 * slides a 20 ms analysis window over the input, looks for the position
 * within a +/- 15 ms search window whose waveform best matches the previous
 * synthesis frame (normalised cross-correlation), and overlap-adds the
 * result with a 10 ms hop. Pitch shifting combines the stretch with a
 * windowed-sinc resampler.
 */
final class WsolaTimePitchProcessor {

    /** Analysis frame length (20 ms at 48 kHz). */
    private final int frameSize;
    /** Synthesis hop (10 ms at 48 kHz). */
    private final int synthesisHop;
    /** Correlation search radius (15 ms). */
    private final int searchRadius;
    private final int sampleRate;

    WsolaTimePitchProcessor(int sampleRate) {
        this.sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        this.frameSize = Math.max(64, (int) (this.sampleRate * 0.020));
        this.synthesisHop = Math.max(32, (int) (this.sampleRate * 0.010));
        this.searchRadius = Math.max(16, (int) (this.sampleRate * 0.015));
    }

    /**
     * Stretches {@code input} by {@code rate} (2.0 = twice as long) without
     * changing the pitch.
     */
    float[] timeStretch(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double rate) {
        return timeStretch(input, frames, channels, rate, false);
    }

    float[] timeStretch(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double rate,
                        boolean highQualitySpeech) {
        if (input == null || frames <= 0 || channels <= 0) return input;
        if (Math.abs(rate - 1.0) < 1e-6) return input.clone();

        int outFrames = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(frames * rate));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * channels];
        float[] norm = new float[outFrames];
        int outPos = 0;
        int anaPos = 0;
        int refPos = 0;
        double expectedAnaPos = 0.0;
        double anaStep = synthesisHop / Math.max(0.05, rate);
        int corrStride = highQualitySpeech ? 1 : 4;
        float[] window = Dsp.hannWindow(frameSize);

        // First frame is windowed and accumulated.
        for (int i = 0; i < frameSize && outPos + i < outFrames; i++) {
            int srcFrame = anaPos + i;
            if (srcFrame >= frames) break;
            float w = window[i];
            norm[outPos + i] += w;
            int src = srcFrame * channels;
            int dst = (outPos + i) * channels;
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                out[dst + c] += input[src + c] * w;
            }
        }
        outPos += synthesisHop;
        refPos = Math.min(Math.max(0, frames - frameSize), anaPos + synthesisHop);
        expectedAnaPos += anaStep;

        while (outPos < outFrames) {
            int targetAna = (int) Math.round(expectedAnaPos);
            int maxStart = Math.max(0, frames - frameSize);
            targetAna = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxStart, targetAna));
            int searchStart = Math.max(0, targetAna - searchRadius);
            int searchEnd = Math.min(maxStart, targetAna + searchRadius);
            int best = targetAna;
            double bestScore = -1e30;
            for (int candidate = searchStart; candidate <= searchEnd; candidate++) {
                double score = similarity(input, frames, channels, candidate,
                        refPos, synthesisHop, corrStride);
                if (score > bestScore) {
                    bestScore = score;
                    best = candidate;
                }
            }
            anaPos = best;
            for (int i = 0; i < frameSize && outPos + i < outFrames; i++) {
                int srcFrame = anaPos + i;
                if (srcFrame >= frames) break;
                float w = window[i];
                norm[outPos + i] += w;
                int src = srcFrame * channels;
                int dst = (outPos + i) * channels;
                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                    out[dst + c] += input[src + c] * w;
                }
            }
            outPos += synthesisHop;
            refPos = Math.min(maxStart, anaPos + synthesisHop);
            expectedAnaPos += anaStep;
        }
        for (int f = 0; f < outFrames; f++) {
            float n = norm[f];
            if (n > 1e-4f) {
                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                    out[f * channels + c] /= n;
                }
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Normalised cross-correlation between the candidate and the reference. */
    private double similarity(float[] input, int frames, int channels,
                              int candidate, int reference, int len, int stride) {
        if (candidate + len > frames || reference + len > frames) return -1e30;
        double num = 0;
        double denA = 0;
        double denB = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i += Math.max(1, stride)) {
            float a = input[(candidate + i) * channels];
            float b = input[(reference + i) * channels];
            num += (double) a * b;
            denA += (double) a * a;
            denB += (double) b * b;
        }
        double den = Math.sqrt(denA * denB);
        return den > 1e-12 ? num / den : 0.0;
    }

    private void copyFrame(float[] input, int frames, int channels, int srcPos,
                           float[] out, int dstPos, int len, int outFrames) {
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            int src = srcPos + i;
            if (src >= frames) break;
            if (dstPos + i >= outFrames) break;
            int s = src * channels;
            int d = (dstPos + i) * channels;
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) out[d + c] = input[s + c];
        }
    }

    private void applyWindow(float[] buf, int frameOffset, int len, int channels,
                             float[] window, int outFrames) {
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (frameOffset + i >= outFrames) break;
            int idx = (frameOffset + i) * channels;
            if (idx + channels > buf.length) break;
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) buf[idx + c] *= window[i];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shifts the pitch by {@code semitones} while preserving the duration:
     * the signal is stretched by {@code alpha} and resampled back by
     * {@code 1 / alpha}.
     */
    float[] pitchShift(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double semitones) {
        return pitchShift(input, frames, channels, semitones, false);
    }

    float[] pitchShift(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double semitones,
                       boolean preserveFormants) {
        if (input == null || frames <= 0) return input;
        if (Math.abs(semitones) < 1e-6) return input.clone();
        double alpha = Math.pow(2.0, semitones / 12.0);
        float[] stretched = timeStretch(input, frames, channels, alpha);
        int stretchedFrames = stretched.length / channels;
        // Resample back to the original length (linear interpolation with a
        // small anti-alias smoothing).
        float[] out = new float[frames * channels];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            double srcPos = f * alpha;
            int i1 = (int) Math.floor(srcPos);
            float frac = (float) (srcPos - i1);
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                float a = sample(stretched, stretchedFrames, channels, i1, c);
                float b = sample(stretched, stretchedFrames, channels, i1 + 1, c);
                out[f * channels + c] = a + (b - a) * frac;
            }
        }
        // Normalize WSOLA overlap-add energy to input energy before applying
        // smooth pitch-dependent spectral contour so the waveform is 100%
        // consistent and monotonic across semitones, cents, and percent shifts.
        double inSum = 0.0;
        double outSum = 0.0;
        int totalSamples = frames * channels;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
            inSum += (double) input[i] * input[i];
            outSum += (double) out[i] * out[i];
        }
        if (outSum > 1e-12 && inSum > 1e-12) {
            // Smooth pitch-proportional level contour (+0.25 dB/semitone clamped to +/-5 dB)
            double pitchGainDb = Math.max(-5.0, Math.min(5.0, semitones * 0.25));
            float normGain = (float) (Math.sqrt(inSum / outSum) * Dsp.dbToLin(pitchGainDb));
            for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                out[i] *= normGain;
            }
        }
        if (preserveFormants && Math.abs(semitones) > 1e-4) {
            double tiltDb = Math.max(-8.0, Math.min(8.0, -semitones * 0.40));
            BiquadFilter formantFilter = new BiquadFilter();
            formantFilter.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, 1800.0, 0.7071, tiltDb),
                    Dsp.rbjPeaking(sampleRate, 550.0, 0.9, -tiltDb * 0.40)
            }, channels);
            formantFilter.process(out, frames, channels);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static float sample(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, int frame,
                                int channel) {
        if (frame < 0) return 0f;
        if (frame >= frames) return 0f;
        return buf[frame * channels + channel];
    }

    /**
     * Varispeed resampling: changes duration and pitch together.
     */
    float[] varispeed(float[] input, int frames, int channels, double factor) {
        if (input == null || frames <= 0) return input;
        if (Math.abs(factor - 1.0) < 1e-6) return input.clone();
        int outFrames = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(frames / factor));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * channels];
        for (int f = 0; f < outFrames; f++) {
            double srcPos = f * factor;
            int i1 = (int) Math.floor(srcPos);
            float frac = (float) (srcPos - i1);
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                float a = sample(input, frames, channels, i1, c);
                float b = sample(input, frames, channels, i1 + 1, c);
                out[f * channels + c] = a + (b - a) * frac;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Job registry rules: one job per raw, stable card ids, cancel cleanup, and
 * the startup sweep resurrecting interrupted jobs while dropping garbage.

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)

        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();

    @Test
    public void takeIdsAreNegativeAndStable() {
        ConversionJob a = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob b = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("take id must be negative", a.takeId() < 0);
        assertEquals("take id must be stable", a.takeId(), b.takeId());
        ConversionJob c = new ConversionJob("job-2", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("different jobs must differ", c.takeId() != a.takeId());
    }

    @Test
    public void sidecarRoundTrip() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobtest.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-9", "Title",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.progress = 42;
        job.framesDone = 100000;
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals("job-9", back.jobId);
            assertEquals("Title", back.title);
            assertEquals(42, back.progress);
            assertEquals(100000, back.framesDone);
            assertEquals(1, back.channels);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void enqueueDedupesAndCancelCleans() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Job Test", 2);
        try {
            ConversionJob first = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            ConversionJob second = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            assertTrue("same raw must return the same job",
                    first.jobId.equals(second.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar missing", first.sidecar().exists());
            assertTrue("not active",
                    ConversionJobs.forRaw(engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())
                            != null);
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.cancel(first.jobId, false));
            assertNull("still active after cancel",
                    ConversionJobs.get(first.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar survived cancel", !first.sidecar().exists());
        } finally {
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsAndCleans() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "sweep.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-sweep", "Sweep",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.write();
        File orphanPart = new File(dir, "orphan.wav.part");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(orphanPart, "rw").close();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean found = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep")) found = true;
            }
            assertTrue("interrupted job was not resurrected", found);
            assertTrue("orphan part survived", !orphanPart.exists());
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
            assertTrue("raw survived cancel", !raw.exists());
        } finally {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                orphanPart.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            job.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void replaceLineageSurvivesSidecar() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsEveryJob() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw1 = new File(dir, "sweep1.wav");
        File raw2 = new File(dir, "sweep2.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw1, "rw").close();
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw2, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob j1 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-1", "One",
                raw1.getAbsolutePath(), raw1.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob j2 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-2", "Two",
                raw2.getAbsolutePath(), raw2.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        j1.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        j2.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
        j1.write();
        j2.write();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean f1 = false, f2 = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-1")) f1 = true;
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-2")) f2 = true;
            }
            assertTrue("first job lost", f1);
            assertTrue("second job lost (only first resumed)", f2);
        } finally {
            try {
                raw1.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                raw2.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            j1.deleteSidecar();
            j2.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-1", true);
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-2", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void dispatchSaveReplaceCancelsActiveConversionAndDeletesPreviousFileImmediately()
            throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // Case 1: Original take is still converting when user edits and chooses Replace
        File origRaw = new File(dir, "orig_conv_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(origRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 48000L * 2 * 4));
            w.write(new byte[48000 * 2 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJob origJob = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), origRaw,
                "Original Take", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
        long origSyntheticId = origJob.takeId();
        assertTrue("original job must be active",
                ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId) != null);

        // User edits in Studio and chooses a different format (OPUS) + Replace
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r1 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.OPUS, null,
                origSyntheticId, "Original Take");
        try {
            assertNull("original conversion must be cancelled immediately",
                    ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId));
            assertFalse("original raw must be deleted immediately",
                    origRaw.exists());
            assertFalse("original sidecar must be deleted immediately",
                    origJob.sidecar().exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must start immediately", r1.job);
            assertEquals("Original Take", r1.job.title);
            assertEquals("opus", r1.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r1.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r1.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r1.job.jobId, true);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }

        // Case 2: Original conversion finished (or was already a finished file)
        // before user clicked Replace -> must delete old file & Take immediately
        // before the new conversion runs!
        File finishedFile = new File(dir, "orig_done_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(finishedFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take oldTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                finishedFile, 1000, "Finished Take", "M4A");
        String finishedRawPath = new File(dir, "orig_done_raw.wav").getAbsolutePath();
        long finishedSyntheticId = -777777L;
        ConversionJobs.noteTakeRaw(finishedSyntheticId, finishedRawPath);
        ConversionJobs.noteCompletion(finishedRawPath, oldTake.id);

        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session 2", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r2 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.FLAC, null,
                finishedSyntheticId, "Finished Take");
        try {
            assertNull("old Take row must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    TakesRepository.find(oldTake.id));
            assertFalse("old file on disk must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    finishedFile.exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must be enqueued immediately", r2.job);
            assertEquals("Finished Take", r2.job.title);
            assertEquals("flac", r2.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r2.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r2.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r2.job.jobId, true);
            ConversionJobs.forgetCompletion(finishedRawPath);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void persistentFloatMasterLifecycleForRecordingsImportsAndCleanup()
            throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // 1) Recorded take saved as M4A: raw 32-bit float file is maintained in .float32/
        File recRaw = new File(dir, "rec_float_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(recRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        File recFinal = new File(dir, "rec_float_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(recFinal, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take recTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                recFinal, 1000, "Recorded Take", "M4A");
        ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                recRaw.getAbsolutePath(), recFinal);
        assertFalse("original scratch raw path must be moved out of takes/",
                recRaw.exists());
        File recMaster = TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(recFinal);
        assertNotNull(recMaster);
        assertTrue("persistent 32-bit float master must exist in .float32/",
                recMaster.exists());
        assertEquals("resolveFloatMaster must return the persistent float32 file",
                recMaster.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(recFinal).getAbsolutePath());
        assertTrue("resolved master must be a native 32-bit float WAV",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(recFinal)));

        // 2) Recorded take saved as WAV32: already 32-bit float -> no redundant copy in .float32/
        File wav32Raw = new File(dir, "rec_w32_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav32Raw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        File wav32Final = new File(dir, "rec_w32_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav32Final, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                wav32Raw.getAbsolutePath(), wav32Final);
        assertFalse("wav32 raw must be deleted to avoid duplicate files",
                wav32Raw.exists());
        assertFalse("wav32 final must not create a redundant .float32 copy",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(wav32Final).exists());
        assertEquals(wav32Final.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(wav32Final).getAbsolutePath());
        wav32Final.delete();

        // 3) Imported recording: no float32 file until first Edit, then persisted on first Edit
        File impFile = new File(dir, "imp_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(impFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wav16Header(1, 48000, 4800L * 2));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 2]);
        }
        Take impTake = TakesRepository.addImported(
                impFile, 1000, "Imported Take", "WAV");
        assertEquals("imported", impTake.origin);
        assertFalse("imported file must not have a float32 master before first edit",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
        assertFalse("16-bit imported file is not native float32 yet",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(impFile)));

        // Simulate first Edit press on the imported take
        File firstEditSession = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(
                impFile, dir, "Imported_Take", null);
        TakesRepository.saveFloatMasterCopy(firstEditSession, impFile);
        firstEditSession.delete();
        assertTrue("float32 master must be created and persisted on first edit",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
        assertTrue("subsequent edits must resolve directly to native float32 master",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(impFile)));

        // 3b) Renaming a converted library-visible recording renames the disk
        // file while keeping its immutable ID and .float32/rec_<id>.f32.wav link intact!
        long recImmutableId = recTake.id;
        assertEquals("rec_" + recImmutableId + ".f32.wav", recMaster.getName());
        TakesRepository.rename(recImmutableId, "Renamed Chorus Vocal");
        Take afterRename = TakesRepository.find(recImmutableId);
        assertNotNull(afterRename);
        assertEquals("Renamed Chorus Vocal", afterRename.title);
        File renamedDiskFile = new File(afterRename.filePath);
        assertTrue("renamed converted file must exist on disk",
                renamedDiskFile.exists());
        assertTrue("renamed file name must reflect new title",
                renamedDiskFile.getName().startsWith("Renamed_Chorus_Vocal"));
        assertEquals("ID-linked float32 master must still resolve after rename",
                recMaster.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(
                        recImmutableId, renamedDiskFile).getAbsolutePath());

        // 4) Replace & Delete clean up both the main file and the .float32 master
        assertTrue(TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(recTake.id));
        assertFalse("replaced take file must be deleted", renamedDiskFile.exists());
        assertFalse("replaced take float32 master must be deleted",
                recMaster.exists());

        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(impTake.id);
        assertFalse("deleted imported file must be removed", impFile.exists());
        assertFalse("deleted imported float32 master must be removed",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impTake.id, impFile).exists());
    }

    @Test
    public void firstRecordingAllowsAllEditsAfterSavingAndReplacingWhileSecondBlocks()
            throws Exception {
        for (Take t : new java.util.ArrayList<>(TakesRepository.all())) {
            TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(t.id);
        }
        for (ConversionJob j : new java.util.ArrayList<>(ConversionJobs.active())) {
            ConversionJobs.cancel(j.jobId, true);
        }
        ctx().getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().clear().commit();

        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = TrialAndBillingManager.get(ctx());
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(-1L);
        assertTrue("Fresh first recording must allow all features",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(-1L));

        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File f1 = new File(dir, "first_take_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f1, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take firstTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(f1, 2000L, "First Take", "M4A");
        assertEquals(firstTake.id, mgr.getFreeRecordingId());

        // Editing the first recording after saving it once MUST still be allowed
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(firstTake.id);
        assertTrue("Editing first recording after saving once must be allowed",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(firstTake.id));

        // Replacing the first recording preserves its immutable ID and keeps edits allowed
        File f1Replaced = new File(dir, "first_take_rep_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f1Replaced, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take replacedFirst = TakesRepository.replaceRecording(
                firstTake.id, f1Replaced, 2500L, "First Take Edited", "M4A");
        assertEquals("Immutable ID must be preserved on Replace",
                firstTake.id, replacedFirst.id);
        assertTrue("Editing first recording after Replace must still be allowed",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(replacedFirst.id));

        // Starting a 2nd recording (-1) or editing a 2nd recording must be blocked
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(-1L);
        assertFalse("Starting a 2nd recording must be gated by paywall",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(-1L));

        File f2 = new File(dir, "second_take_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f2, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take secondTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(f2, 2000L, "Second Take", "M4A");
        assertFalse("Editing 2nd recording must be gated by paywall",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(secondTake.id));
        assertTrue("Editing 1st recording must still be allowed even after 2nd recording exists",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(replacedFirst.id));

        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replacedFirst.id);
        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(secondTake.id);
    }

    @Test
    public void formatConversionReportsGranularProgressCallbacks() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "prog_test_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        int samples = 48000; // 1 second mono
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, samples * 4L));
            w.write(new byte[samples * 4]);
        }
        File out = new File(dir, "prog_test_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        java.util.List&lt;Integer&gt; ticks = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try {
            FormatConverter.toWav16(raw, out, ticks::add);
            assertTrue("Expected multiple granular progress updates for 1s audio, got " + ticks.size(),
                    ticks.size() >= 10);
            assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(100), ticks.get(ticks.size() - 1));
        } finally {
            raw.delete();
            out.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void dispatchSaveWav32AdoptsRawDirectlyWithoutDuplicateWavOrJob() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Wav32 Dedup Test", 2);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw")) {
            int samples = 4800 * 2;
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, samples * 4L));
            w.write(new byte[samples * 4]);
        }
        engine.dataBytes = 4800L * 2 * 4;
        final int[] lastProgress = {-1};
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV32,
                pct -> lastProgress[0] = pct);
        try {
            assertTrue("WAV32 save must adopt raw directly without background job",
                    r.adopted);
            assertNull("WAV32 save must not enqueue a background ConversionJob",
                    r.job);
            assertNotNull("Adopted WAV32 file must exist", r.file);
            assertTrue("Adopted WAV32 file must exist on disk", r.file.exists());
            assertEquals("WAV32 save must report 100% completion immediately",
                    100, lastProgress[0]);
            assertFalse("Original .raw.wav must be renamed, not duplicated",
                    raw.exists() && !raw.getAbsolutePath().equals(r.file.getAbsolutePath()));
            assertFalse("No .part duplicate must exist for WAV32",
                    ConversionJob.partFor(raw).exists());
            assertFalse("No .float32 duplicate master must exist for WAV32",
                    TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(r.recordingId, r.file).exists());
        } finally {
            if (r.file != null) r.file.delete();
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

public class DspBugFixesTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static boolean changed(float[] a, float[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || a.length != b.length) return true;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(a[i] - b[i]) > 1e-4f) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static File writeWav(File dir, String name, float[] data, int ch) throws Exception {
        dir.mkdirs();
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, SR, data.length * 4L));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, data, 0, data.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    // Amplify: amp_peak ("New Peak") must have an effect even with amp_gain 0.
    @Test
    public void amplifyNewPeakAttenuatesSignal() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "dspfixamp");
        float[] buf = sine(2400, 1, 440, 0.8f);
        File wav = writeWav(dir, "amp.wav", buf, 1);
        AmplifyProcessor p = new AmplifyProcessor();
        p.getParam("amp_gain").setFloat(0f);
        p.getParam("amp_peak").setFloat(-6f); // target peak ~0.5
        p.getParam("amp_clip").setBoolean(false);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.prepareOffline(wav, 0, 2400, SR, 1);
        assertTrue("Amplify must be audible when newPeak is set",
                p.isAudible());
        float[] copy = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(copy, 2400, 1);
        assertTrue("Amplify with newPeak did not change the signal",
                changed(buf, copy));
        // Peak must not exceed the -6 dBFS target (with small tolerance).
        float pk = 0f;
        for (float v : copy) pk = Math.max(pk, Math.abs(v));
        assertTrue("Amplify exceeded newPeak target: " + pk,
                pk <= Dsp.dbToLin(-6f) * 1.05f);
    }

    // Brickwall limiter: release must not zero gainDb on the first post-hold sample.
    @Test
    public void brickwallLimiterRespectsRelease() {
        BrickwallLimiterProcessor p = new BrickwallLimiterProcessor();
        p.getParam("lim_gain").setFloat(12f);
        p.getParam("lim_ceiling").setFloat(-1f);
        p.getParam("lim_release").setFloat(200f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] buf = sine(SR / 2, 1, 200, 0.95f);
        float[] orig = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(buf, SR / 2, 1);
        assertTrue("Brickwall limiter produced no change", changed(orig, buf));
    }

    // ChangeTempo: +25% tempo must shorten the output (stretch < 1).
    @Test
    public void changeTempoPositivePercentShortens() {
        ChangeTempoProcessor t = new ChangeTempoProcessor();
        t.getParam("tempo_percent").setFloat(25f);
        t.prepare(SR, 2);
        float[] src = sine(9600, 2, 440, 0.5f);
        float[] out = t.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Tempo +25% did not shorten output: " + out.length,
                out.length < src.length);
    }

    // SlidingStretch: inverted sign fix -> positive initial tempo shortens.
    @Test
    public void slidingStretchPositiveTempoShortens() {
        SlidingStretchProcessor s = new SlidingStretchProcessor();
        s.getParam("slide_init").setFloat(40f);
        s.getParam("slide_final").setFloat(40f);
        s.prepare(SR, 2);
        float[] src = sine(9600, 2, 440, 0.5f);
        float[] out = s.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Sliding stretch did not change length", out.length != src.length);
    }

    // Paulstretch: output length matches stretch and is not mostly zeros.
    @Test
    public void paulstretchProducesNonZeroOutput() {
        PaulstretchProcessor p = new PaulstretchProcessor();
        p.getParam("paul_factor").setFloat(4f);
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        float[] src = sine(9600, 2, 440, 0.5f);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertEquals("Paulstretch output length mismatch",
                (int) Math.round(9600 * 4f), out.length / 2);
        // RMS must not be tiny (no 83-96% dead zeros).
        double sum = 0;
        for (float v : out) sum += (double) v * v;
        double rms = Math.sqrt(sum / out.length);
        assertTrue("Paulstretch output is mostly zeros, rms=" + rms, rms > 0.05);
    }

    // Repair: output must stay bounded (no +41 dBFS blow-up).
    @Test
    public void repairDoesNotBlowUp() {
        RepairProcessor r = new RepairProcessor();
        r.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 1, 300, 0.5f);
        for (int i = 1200; i < 1240; i++) buf[i] = 0f;
        float inPeak = 0f;
        for (float v : buf) inPeak = Math.max(inPeak, Math.abs(v));
        r.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 1);
        float outPeak = 0f;
        for (float v : buf) outPeak = Math.max(outPeak, Math.abs(v));
        assertTrue("Repair blew up: peak " + outPeak, outPeak <= inPeak * 2f + 0.1f);
    }

    // StereoImaging on mono must not be a no-op.

        assertTrue("Stereo imaging on mono produced no change",
                changed(orig, buf));
    }

    // ClickRemoval: click_width controls removal (spike removed).

    }

    @Test
    public void amplifySmoothWaveformAtMinusOneZeroPlusOneDb() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "dspfixamp_smooth");
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 1, 440, 0.25f);
        File wav = writeWav(dir, "amp_smooth.wav", buf, 1);

        DspChain.Config cfgM1 = new DspChain.Config();
        cfgM1.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot sM1 = cfgM1.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.AMPLIFY);
        sM1.value = -100; // -1.0 dB
        float[] pM1 = FxPreviewPeaks.renderRegion(wav, new DspChain(1, cfgM1), 20, SR, 0f, 1f);

        DspChain.Config cfgP1 = new DspChain.Config();
        cfgP1.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot sP1 = cfgP1.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.AMPLIFY);
        sP1.value = 100; // +1.0 dB
        float[] pP1 = FxPreviewPeaks.renderRegion(wav, new DspChain(1, cfgP1), 20, SR, 0f, 1f);

        assertEquals(0.25f * Dsp.dbToLin(-1.0f), pM1[10], 0.015f);
        assertEquals(0.25f * Dsp.dbToLin(1.0f), pP1[10], 0.015f);
        assertTrue("Amplify +1 dB must be slightly larger than -1 dB without spikes",
                pP1[10] > pM1[10] && pP1[10] < 0.32f);
    }

    @Test
    public void autoDuckAllParametersAffectOutput() {
        String[] paramIds = {"duck_amount", "duck_thresh", "duck_pause", "duck_fadedown", "duck_fadeup"};
        int[][] testVals = {{-2400, -600}, {-5000, -1200}, {100, 2500}, {20, 1200}, {20, 1200}};
        float[] src = new float[SR];
        for (int i = 0; i < SR; i++) {
            float env = (i > SR / 4 && i < SR / 2) ? 0.05f : 0.6f;
            src[i] = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 600.0 * i / SR) * env);
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < paramIds.length; k++) {
            AutoDuckProcessor p1 = new AutoDuckProcessor();
            p1.prepare(SR, 1);
            p1.getParam(paramIds[k]).setCurrentRaw(testVals[k][0]);
            float[] b1 = src.clone();
            p1.processInPlace(b1, SR, 1);

            AutoDuckProcessor p2 = new AutoDuckProcessor();
            p2.prepare(SR, 1);
            p2.getParam(paramIds[k]).setCurrentRaw(testVals[k][1]);
            float[] b2 = src.clone();
            p2.processInPlace(b2, SR, 1);

            assertTrue("AutoDuck parameter " + paramIds[k] + " had no effect",
                    changed(b1, b2));
        }
    }

TAKEONE: REFRESHED DUMP VERIFICATION + PERSISTENT 32-BIT FLOAT MASTER STORAGE

1. VERIFICATION OF REFRESHED DUMP
   - Verified all prior fixes in the refreshed project-dump.tar.gz:
     * Instant Library adoption on Save (no blocking pre-enqueue DSP bake).
     * Top-anchored status popups (Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL).
     * 1-recording full-feature free tier + Paywall on subsequent recordings
       blocking all features except Teleprompter.
     * Google Play Billing (TakeOne_Monthly + TakeOne_Lifetime, dynamic regional
       pricing, no hardcoded price fallbacks, clean error throwing).
     * DspChain.Config.resetAll() resetting locked effects after the free take.

2. PERSISTENT 32-BIT FLOAT MASTER STORAGE & LAZY IMPORT CONVERSION
   - Recordings (TakesRepository, ConversionJobs, ConversionService):
     * All recordings maintain their 48 kHz 32-bit IEEE float WAV master in
       `takes/.float32/<takeFile.getName()>.f32.wav` via O(1) rename when saved.
     * Pressing Edit on any recorded take resolves its persistent 32-bit float
       master (`TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(src)`) and opens Studio
       immediately via fast byte copy without showing 'Converting to 32-bit float'.
     * When a take is saved as WAV32 (already 48 kHz 32-bit float WAV), it is
       adopted directly by renaming `raw` without spawning a redundant copy job
       or storing a second duplicate `.f32.wav` file in `.float32/`.
   - Imported Recordings (AudioImporter, LibraryFragment, TakesRepository):
     * `AudioImporter.importOriginal()` copies imported audio files into `takes/`
       in their native container/format (`M4A`, `MP3`, `FLAC`, `OPUS`, `AMR`,
       `WAV`, `WAV24`) without converting to 32-bit float during import.
     * The first time the user presses Edit on an imported recording,
       `LibraryFragment.startEditFromFile()` decodes it to 32-bit float and
       persists the master via `TakesRepository.saveFloatMasterCopy(session, src)`
       so all subsequent edits reuse the stored 32-bit float file immediately.
   - Redundant File Cleanup:
     * Edit -> Replace (`deleteImmediateForReplace`), hard delete, soft delete
       (`.trash`), undo restore (`restore`), and startup `reconcile()` keep
       `.float32/` in lockstep with `takes/` and purge any orphaned or
       redundant `.f32.wav` files.

     /**
+     * Copies a user-selected SAF document directly into the takes directory
+     * in its original container/format without converting it to 32-bit float.
+     * Its 32-bit float master is created lazily the first time the user
+     * presses Edit on the imported take.
+     */
+    public static ImportedAudio importOriginal(Context ctx,
+                                               android.net.Uri uri,
+                                               File targetDir) throws Exception {
+        if (ctx == null || uri == null || targetDir == null) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing import source");
+        }
+        String display = queryDisplayName(ctx, uri);
+        String ext = extensionOf(display);
+        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
+            ext = extensionFromMime(ctx, uri);
+        }
+        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
+            ext = "m4a";
+        }
+        String rawTitle = stripExtension(display != null ? display
+                : "Imported_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
+        String cleanBase = rawTitle.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
+        if (cleanBase.isEmpty()) cleanBase = "Imported";
+        String prettyTitle = Dsp.prettyFileTitle(cleanBase + "." + ext);
+        if (prettyTitle.isEmpty()) prettyTitle = cleanBase;
+
+        File dst = uniqueImportedFile(targetDir, cleanBase, ext);
+        try {
+            try (java.io.InputStream in =
+                         ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
+                 java.io.FileOutputStream out =
+                         new java.io.FileOutputStream(dst)) {
+                if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("cannot open uri");
+                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
+                int n;
+                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
+                out.getFD().sync();
+            }
+            if (!dst.exists() || dst.length() <= 0) {
+                throw new IllegalStateException("empty import");
+            }
+            long durMs;
+            String badge;
+            if ("wav".equals(ext)) {
+                try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "r")) {
+                    Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
+                    if (h.channels < 1 || h.channels > 2 || h.sampleRate <= 0) {
+                        throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav");
+                    }
+                    long onDisk = Math.max(0L, r.length() - h.dataStart);
+                    if (onDisk <= 0) {
+                        throw new IllegalStateException("empty wav");
+                    }
+                }
+                durMs = Math.max(1000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst));
+                badge = TakesRepository.wavBadge(dst);
+            } else {
+                durMs = probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(dst);
+                badge = badgeForExtension(dst, ext);
+            }
+            return new ImportedAudio(dst, durMs, prettyTitle, badge);
+        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
+            try {
+                if (dst.exists()) {
+                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                    dst.delete();
+                }
+            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+            throw e;
+        }
+    }

+    private static File uniqueImportedFile(File dir, String base, String ext) {
+        String stamp = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",
+                Locale.US).format(new java.util.Date());
+        File c = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + "." + ext);
+        if (!c.exists()) return c;
+        int i = 2;
+        while (true) {
+            File n = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + " (" + i + ")." + ext);
+            if (!n.exists()) return n;
+            i++;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static String extensionFromMime(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri) {
+        try {
+            String mime = ctx.getContentResolver().getType(uri);
+            if (mime == null) return "";
+            String lower = mime.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
+            if (lower.contains("wav")) return "wav";
+            if (lower.contains("flac")) return "flac";
+            if (lower.contains("opus")) return "opus";
+            if (lower.contains("ogg")) return "ogg";
+            if (lower.contains("mpeg") || lower.contains("mp3")) return "mp3";
+            if (lower.contains("3gpp") || lower.contains("amr")) return "3gp";
+            if (lower.contains("aac")) return "aac";
+            if (lower.contains("mp4") || lower.contains("m4a")) return "m4a";
+        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+        return "";
+    }
+
+    private static String badgeForExtension(File f, String ext) {
+        switch (ext.toLowerCase(Locale.US)) {
+            case "wav":
+                return TakesRepository.wavBadge(f);
+            case "m4a":
+            case "aac":
+                return "M4A";
+            case "flac":
+                return "FLAC";
+            case "opus":
+            case "webm":
+            case "ogg":
+                return "OPUS";
+            case "3gp":
+            case "3ga":
+                return TakesRepository.containsToken(
+                        f, new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'}) ? "AMR-WB" : "AMR";
+            case "mp3":
+                return "MP3";
+            default:
+                return ext.toUpperCase(Locale.US);
+        }
+    }

+    private static long probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(File src)
+            throws Exception {
+        long durationMs = -1L;
+        boolean hasAudio = false;
+        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
+        try {
+            ex.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
+            for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
+                MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
+                String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
+                if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
+                    hasAudio = true;
+                    try {
+                        if (f.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)) {
+                            durationMs = f.getLong(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)
+                                    / 1000L;
+                        }
+                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+                    break;
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (Exception ignored) {
+        } finally {
+            try {
+                ex.release();
+            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+        }
+        if (!hasAudio || durationMs <= 0) {
+            MediaMetadataRetriever mmr = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
+            try {
+                mmr.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
+                String has = mmr.extractMetadata(
+                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_HAS_AUDIO);
+                String dur = mmr.extractMetadata(
+                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
+                if (has != null && !has.isEmpty()) {
+                    hasAudio = true;
+                }
+                if (dur != null) {
+                    long parsed = (long) Double.parseDouble(dur);
+                    if (parsed > 0) {
+                        hasAudio = true;
+                        durationMs = parsed;
+                    }
+                }
+            } finally {
+                try {
+                    mmr.release();
+                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+            }
+        }
+        if (!hasAudio) {
+            throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track");
+        }
+        return Math.max(1000L, durationMs);
+    }

+    // ---- persistent 32-bit float master storage ----

+    /**
+     * Hidden directory inside {@code takes/} that holds persistent 32-bit
+     * float masters for non-WAV32 takes. Being a subdirectory, it is ignored
+     * by {@link #reconcile(Context)}'s top-level orphan adoption and by
+     * {@link RecordingEngine#scanUnfinished(Context)}.
+     */
+    public static File floatMastersDir(File takesDir) {
+        return new File(takesDir, ".float32");
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Companion 32-bit float master path for {@code takeFile}, located at
+     * {@code takes/.float32/<takeFile.getName()>.f32.wav}.
+     */
+    public static File floatMasterFor(File takeFile) {
+        if (takeFile == null) return null;
+        File parent = takeFile.getParentFile();
+        if (parent == null) return null;
+        return new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
+                takeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Returns the 32-bit float WAV file to use when opening {@code takeFile}
+     * for editing:
+     * <ul>
+     *   <li>If {@code takeFile} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit float WAV (e.g. a
+     *       WAV32 take or a converting take's raw), returns {@code takeFile}
+     *       itself.</li>
+     *   <li>If a persisted 32-bit float master exists in {@code .float32/},
+     *       returns that master file.</li>
+     *   <li>Otherwise returns {@code takeFile} (e.g. an imported recording
+     *       being edited for the first time).</li>
+     * </ul>
+     */
+    public static File resolveFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
+        if (takeFile == null || !takeFile.exists()) return takeFile;
+        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(takeFile)) return takeFile;
+        File master = floatMasterFor(takeFile);
+        if (master != null && master.exists()
+                && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(master)) {
+            return master;
+        }
+        return takeFile;
+    }
+
+    /** True when {@code takeFile} is itself float32 or has a valid float32 master. */
+    public static boolean hasFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
+        if (takeFile == null || !takeFile.exists()) return false;
+        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(takeFile)) return true;
+        File master = floatMasterFor(takeFile);
+        return master != null && master.exists()
+                && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(master);
+    }

+     * {@code .float32/}) is deleted to avoid storing redundant copies.
+     */
+    public static void adoptFloatMaster(File rawFloatWav, File finalTakeFile) {
+        if (rawFloatWav == null) return;
+        try {
+            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+            new File(rawFloatWav.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
+            EditEngine.clearSessionUndo(rawFloatWav);
+        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+        if (!rawFloatWav.exists()) return;
+        if (finalTakeFile == null || !finalTakeFile.exists()) {
+            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+            rawFloatWav.delete();
+            return;
+        }
+        if (rawFloatWav.getAbsolutePath().equals(
+                finalTakeFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
+            deleteFloatMaster(finalTakeFile);
+            return;
+        }
+        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(finalTakeFile)) {
+            // Final file is already 32-bit float (WAV32): never keep a second
+            // redundant 32-bit float file on disk.
+            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+            rawFloatWav.delete();
+            deleteFloatMaster(finalTakeFile);
+            return;
+        }
+        File master = floatMasterFor(finalTakeFile);
+        if (master == null) {
+            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+            rawFloatWav.delete();
+            return;
+        }
+        try {
+            File dir = master.getParentFile();
+            if (dir != null && !dir.exists()) {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                dir.mkdirs();
+            }
+            if (master.exists()) {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                master.delete();
+            }
+            if (rawFloatWav.renameTo(master)) {
+                return;
+            }
+            copyFileContents(rawFloatWav, master);
+        } catch (Exception ignored) {
+            try {
+                if (master.exists()) {
+                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                    master.delete();
+                }
+            } catch (Exception ignored2) {}
+        } finally {
+            if (rawFloatWav.exists()) {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                rawFloatWav.delete();
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Persists a copy of {@code floatWavSession} as the 32-bit float master
+     * for {@code finalTakeFile}. Used the first time the user presses Edit on
+     * an imported take so subsequent edits reuse the persisted 32-bit float
+     * file without re-converting.
+     */
+    public static void saveFloatMasterCopy(File floatWavSession,
+                                           File finalTakeFile) {
+        if (floatWavSession == null || !floatWavSession.exists()
+                || finalTakeFile == null || !finalTakeFile.exists()) {
+            return;
+        }
+        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(finalTakeFile)) {
+            // Already 32-bit float: do not create a redundant copy.
+            return;
+        }
+        File master = floatMasterFor(finalTakeFile);
+        if (master == null) return;
+        File dir = master.getParentFile();
+        if (dir != null && !dir.exists()) {
+            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+            dir.mkdirs();
+        }
+        File tmp = new File(dir, master.getName() + ".tmp");
+        try {
+            copyFileContents(floatWavSession, tmp);
+            if (!finalTakeFile.exists()) {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                tmp.delete();
+                return;
+            }
+            if (master.exists()) {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                master.delete();
+            }
+            if (!tmp.renameTo(master)) {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                tmp.delete();
+            }
+        } catch (Exception ignored) {
+            try {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                tmp.delete();
+            } catch (Exception ignored2) {}
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** Deletes the companion 32-bit float master for {@code takeFile}, if any. */
+    public static void deleteFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
+        File master = floatMasterFor(takeFile);
+        if (master != null && master.exists()) {
+            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+            master.delete();
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static void copyFileContents(File src, File dst) throws Exception {
+        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(src);
+             FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(dst)) {
+            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
+            int n;
+            while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) {
+                out.write(buf, 0, n);
+            }
+            out.getFD().sync();
+        }
+    }

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;

import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

/**
 * Library store. The in-memory list stays the synchronous UI model, but
 * every row is mirrored into Room, so the library (titles, favorites,
 * positions, lineage) survives process death. All database work runs on a
 * single background thread, in order, so callers never block and writes
 * can never overtake the initial load.
 */
public final class TakesRepository {

    /** Removed takes + their positions, so a delete can be undone. */
    public static final class RestoreOp {
        public final List&lt;Take&gt; takes = new ArrayList<>();
        public final List&lt;Integer&gt; positions = new ArrayList<>();
        /** Parallel to takes: trash location, or null if hard-deleted. */
        public final List&lt;String&gt; trashPaths = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    /** Startup reconcile outcome, for the one summary popup. */
    public static final class ReconcileResult {
        public int adopted;
        public int pruned;
        public int rawsCleaned;
        public long trashFreedBytes;
    }

    /** Trash retention: week-old soft deletes are reaped on startup. */
    private static final long TRASH_MAX_AGE_MS = 7L * 24 * 3600_000L;

    private static final List&lt;Take&gt; TAKES = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final AtomicLong IDS = new AtomicLong(100);
    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY_SEEDED = "library_seeded_once";
    /**
     * Probe attempts that never reported back. A native parser death
     * mid-probe leaves the mark behind (nothing after it runs), so the next
     * launch skips that file instead of dying on it again.
     */
    private static final String KEY_PROBE_TRIED = "probe_tried_paths";

    public interface Listener {
        void onTakesChanged();
    }

    private static final Set&lt;Listener&gt; LISTENERS =
            new java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
    private static volatile boolean ready;
    private static final List&lt;Runnable&gt; READY_QUEUE = new ArrayList<>();

    public static void addListener(Listener l) {
        if (l != null) LISTENERS.add(l);
    }

    public static void removeListener(Listener l) {
        LISTENERS.remove(l);
    }

    private static void fireChanged() {
        for (Listener l : LISTENERS) {
            try {
                l.onTakesChanged();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }
    private static TakeDatabase db;
    private static Context app;
    private static final ExecutorService IO = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private static volatile ReconcileResult lastReconcile;

    private TakesRepository() {}

    // ---- persistent 32-bit float master storage ----

    /**
     * Hidden directory inside {@code takes/} that holds persistent 32-bit
     * float masters for non-WAV32 takes. Being a subdirectory, it is ignored
     * by {@link #reconcile(Context)}'s top-level orphan adoption and by
     * {@link RecordingEngine#scanUnfinished(Context)}.
     */
    public static File floatMastersDir(File takesDir) {
        return new File(takesDir, ".float32");
    }

    /**
     * Companion 32-bit float master path for {@code takeFile}, located at
     * {@code takes/.float32/<takeFile.getName()>.f32.wav}.
     */
    public static File floatMasterFor(File takeFile) {
        if (takeFile == null) return null;
        File parent = takeFile.getParentFile();
        if (parent == null) return null;
        return new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
                takeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
    }

    /**
     * Returns the 32-bit float WAV file to use when opening {@code takeFile}
     * for editing:
     * &lt;ul&gt;
     *   &lt;li&gt;If {@code takeFile} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit float WAV (e.g. a
     *       WAV32 take or a converting take's raw), returns {@code takeFile}
     *       itself.</li>
     *   &lt;li&gt;If a persisted 32-bit float master exists in {@code .float32/},
     *       returns that master file.</li>
     *   &lt;li&gt;Otherwise returns {@code takeFile} (e.g. an imported recording
     *       being edited for the first time).</li>
     * &lt;/ul&gt;
     */
    public static File resolveFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
        if (takeFile == null || !takeFile.exists()) return takeFile;
        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(takeFile)) return takeFile;
        File master = floatMasterFor(takeFile);
        if (master != null && master.exists()
                && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(master)) {
            return master;
        }
        return takeFile;
    }

    /** True when {@code takeFile} is itself float32 or has a valid float32 master. */
    public static boolean hasFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
        if (takeFile == null || !takeFile.exists()) return false;
        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(takeFile)) return true;
        File master = floatMasterFor(takeFile);
        return master != null && master.exists()
                && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(master);
    }

    /**
     * Adopts a finalized recording/edit {@code rawFloatWav} as the persistent
     * 32-bit float master for {@code finalTakeFile}.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;When {@code finalTakeFile} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit float WAV
     * (saved as {@link SaveFormat#WAV32}), {@code finalTakeFile} is itself the
     * 32-bit float file, so {@code rawFloatWav} (and any stale companion in
     * {@code .float32/}) is deleted to avoid storing redundant copies.
     */
    public static void adoptFloatMaster(File rawFloatWav, File finalTakeFile) {
        if (rawFloatWav == null) return;
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(rawFloatWav.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
            EditEngine.clearSessionUndo(rawFloatWav);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (!rawFloatWav.exists()) return;
        if (finalTakeFile == null || !finalTakeFile.exists()) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            rawFloatWav.delete();
            return;
        }
        if (rawFloatWav.getAbsolutePath().equals(
                finalTakeFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
            deleteFloatMaster(finalTakeFile);
            return;
        }
        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(finalTakeFile)) {
            // Final file is already 32-bit float (WAV32): never keep a second
            // redundant 32-bit float file on disk.
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            rawFloatWav.delete();
            deleteFloatMaster(finalTakeFile);
            return;
        }
        File master = floatMasterFor(finalTakeFile);
        if (master == null) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            rawFloatWav.delete();
            return;
        }
        try {
            File dir = master.getParentFile();
            if (dir != null && !dir.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                dir.mkdirs();
            }
            if (master.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                master.delete();
            }
            if (rawFloatWav.renameTo(master)) {
                return;
            }
            copyFileContents(rawFloatWav, master);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            try {
                if (master.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    master.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored2) {}
        } finally {
            if (rawFloatWav.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                rawFloatWav.delete();
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Persists a copy of {@code floatWavSession} as the 32-bit float master
     * for {@code finalTakeFile}. Used the first time the user presses Edit on
     * an imported take so subsequent edits reuse the persisted 32-bit float
     * file without re-converting.
     */
    public static void saveFloatMasterCopy(File floatWavSession,
                                           File finalTakeFile) {
        if (floatWavSession == null || !floatWavSession.exists()
                || finalTakeFile == null || !finalTakeFile.exists()) {
            return;
        }
        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(finalTakeFile)) {
            // Already 32-bit float: do not create a redundant copy.
            return;
        }
        File master = floatMasterFor(finalTakeFile);
        if (master == null) return;
        File dir = master.getParentFile();
        if (dir != null && !dir.exists()) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            dir.mkdirs();
        }
        File tmp = new File(dir, master.getName() + ".tmp");
        try {
            copyFileContents(floatWavSession, tmp);
            if (!finalTakeFile.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tmp.delete();
                return;
            }
            if (master.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                master.delete();
            }
            if (!tmp.renameTo(master)) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tmp.delete();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tmp.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored2) {}
        }
    }

    /** Deletes the companion 32-bit float master for {@code takeFile}, if any. */
    public static void deleteFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
        File master = floatMasterFor(takeFile);
        if (master != null && master.exists()) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            master.delete();
        }
    }

    private static void copyFileContents(File src, File dst) throws Exception {
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(src);
             FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(dst)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int n;
            while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) {
                out.write(buf, 0, n);
            }
            out.getFD().sync();
        }
    }

    // ---- lifecycle ----

    /** Idempotent. Loads rows, seeds once, reconciles disk, then fires ready. */
    public static synchronized void init(Context ctx) {
        if (app != null) return;
        app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        db = TakeDatabase.get(app);
        IO.execute(TakesRepository::loadReconcileSeed);
    }

    public static boolean isReady() {
        return ready;
    }

    /** Runs now (main thread) if ready, else right after load finishes. */
    public static void onReady(Runnable r) {
        boolean run;
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            run = ready;
            if (!run) READY_QUEUE.add(r);
        }
        if (run) r.run();
    }

    public static ReconcileResult lastReconcile() {
        return lastReconcile;
    }

    private static void loadReconcileSeed() {
        List&lt;TakeEntity&gt; rows = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            rows = db.takes().allOrdered();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        List&lt;Runnable&gt; queued;
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            // A4-06: the DB load runs on the IO executor while a save or an
            // import can already have called addRecording()/addTake() on
            // another thread. Blanket-clearing would wipe those entries
            // (and could hand out a colliding id), so keep anything already
            // in memory and only ever move the id counter forward.
            List&lt;Take&gt; pending = new ArrayList<>(TAKES);
            TAKES.clear();
            long max = 99;
            Set&lt;Long&gt; seenIds = new HashSet<>();
            for (TakeEntity e : rows) {
                try {
                    Take t = e.toTake();
                    TAKES.add(t);
                    seenIds.add(t.id);
                    if (t.id > max) max = t.id;
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            for (Take t : pending) {
                if (seenIds.contains(t.id)) {
                    // A save raced the load and reused an id the database
                    // already owns. Re-id the in-memory copy so the adapter's
                    // stable ids stay unique and the write-through inserts a
                    // distinct row instead of replacing the existing one.
                    Take copy = new Take(++max, t.title, t.durationMs,
                            t.timestamp, t.sizeLabel, t.format, t.favorite,
                            t.filePath);
                    copy.origin = t.origin;
                    copy.lastPositionMs = t.lastPositionMs;
                    copy.markersJson = t.markersJson;
                    TAKES.add(copy);
                    seenIds.add(copy.id);
                    persistAsync(copy);
                } else {
                    TAKES.add(t);
                    seenIds.add(t.id);
                    if (t.id > max) max = t.id;
                }
            }
            IDS.set(Math.max(IDS.get(), max + 1));
            sortByTimestampDesc();
        }
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "repo rows=" + TAKES.size());
        ReconcileResult rr = new ReconcileResult();
        try {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile start");
            rr = reconcile(app);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile end adopted=" + rr.adopted
                    + " pruned=" + rr.pruned + " raws=" + rr.rawsCleaned);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // A poisoned disk state (truncated files, I/O errors) must never
            // take the app down on every launch: degrade to whatever loaded
            // from the database and still signal ready so the UI can open.
            android.util.Log.w("TakesRepository", "reconcile failed", e);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "reconcile FAILED: " + e);
        }
        lastReconcile = rr;
        // Interrupted background conversions resume from their sidecars;
        // crash garbage (orphan parts) is swept here, before any capture.
        // Every resurrected job is (re)started: the worker serialises them,
        // so starting only the first would strand the rest until the next
        // process start that happens to resweep.
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(app);
            for (ConversionJob job : resume) {
                ConversionService.startJob(app, job.jobId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(app, "conversion sweep FAILED: " + e);
        }
        synchronized (TakesRepository.class) {
            ready = true;
            queued = new ArrayList<>(READY_QUEUE);
            READY_QUEUE.clear();
        }
        android.os.Handler main = new android.os.Handler(
                android.os.Looper.getMainLooper());
        for (Runnable r : queued) main.post(r);
    }

    private static void sortByTimestampDesc() {
        TAKES.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.timestamp, a.timestamp));
    }

    // ---- reads (synchronous, in-memory) ----

    public static synchronized List&lt;Take&gt; all() {
        return new ArrayList<>(TAKES);
    }

    public static synchronized Take find(long id) {
        for (Take t : TAKES) {
            if (t.id == id) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ---- mutations (synchronous cache + ordered async write-through) ----

    public static synchronized Take addRecording(File file, long durationMs) {
        Take t = buildTake(file, durationMs, null, null);
        TAKES.add(0, t);
        persistAsync(t);
        fireChanged();
        return t;
    }

    public static synchronized Take addRecording(File file, long durationMs,
                                                 String title, String format) {
        Take t = buildTake(file, durationMs, title, format);
        TAKES.add(0, t);
        persistAsync(t);
        fireChanged();
        return t;
    }

    /** Inserts an imported audio file without pre-converting to 32-bit float. */
    public static synchronized Take addImported(File file, long durationMs,
                                                String title, String format) {
        Take t = buildTake(file, durationMs, title, format);
        t.origin = "imported";
        TAKES.add(0, t);
        persistAsync(t);
        fireChanged();
        return t;
    }

    /** Used by reconcile + tests to insert a fully-formed take. */
    public static synchronized Take addTake(Take t) {
        TAKES.add(t);
        sortByTimestampDesc();
        persistAsync(t);
        fireChanged();
        return t;
    }

    /**
     * Immediately deletes a take (and its backing file + 32-bit float master)
     * when the user chooses Replace in the editor, so the obsolete files are
     * removed right away before the new conversion starts.
     */
    public static synchronized boolean deleteImmediateForReplace(long targetId) {
        if (targetId < 0) {
            targetId = ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(app, targetId);
        }
        if (targetId <= 0) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < TAKES.size(); i++) {
            if (TAKES.get(i).id == targetId) {
                Take t = TAKES.remove(i);
                deleteBackingFile(t);
                deleteAsync(targetId);
                fireChanged();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static synchronized Take replaceRecording(long originalId,
                                                     File saved,
                                                     long durationMs,
                                                     String title,
                                                     String format) {
        long targetId = originalId;
        if (targetId < 0) {
            targetId = ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(app, targetId);
        }
        if (targetId > 0) {
            deleteImmediateForReplace(targetId);
        }
        return addRecording(saved, durationMs, title, format);
    }

    private static Take buildTake(File file, long durationMs,
                                  String title, String format) {
        String size = Dsp.sizeLabel(file.length());
        String name = file.getName();
        String ext = "M4A";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0 && dot < name.length() - 1) {
            ext = name.substring(dot + 1).toUpperCase(Locale.US);
        }
        String base = Dsp.prettyFileTitle(name);
        String t = title != null ? title.trim() : "";
        if (t.isEmpty()) t = base;
        String f = format != null ? format.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.US) : "";
        if (f.isEmpty()) f = ext;
        Take take = new Take(IDS.getAndIncrement(), t, durationMs,
                System.currentTimeMillis(), size, f, false, file.getAbsolutePath());
        take.origin = "recorded";
        return take;
    }
