package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Foreground host for an ongoing take: keeps capture alive when the app is
 * backgrounded, owns audio-focus interruption handling (pause, never
 * auto-resume) and exposes one clean persistent notification — name, preset,
 * live timer plus pause/resume, Save and Cancel actions that work without
 * opening the app.
 */
public class RecordingService extends Service {

    public static final String ACTION_START =
            "com.example.hello.REC_START";
    public static final String ACTION_TOGGLE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_TOGGLE";
    public static final String ACTION_SAVE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_SAVE";
    public static final String ACTION_CANCEL =
            "com.example.hello.REC_CANCEL";
    public static final String ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF =
            "com.example.hello.action.RESTORE_NOTIF";

    public static final String EXTRA_FORMAT = "format";

    /** Broadcast when a background save/cancel finishes. */
    public static final String BROADCAST_DONE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_DONE";
    public static final String EXTRA_OK = "ok";
    public static final String EXTRA_MESSAGE = "message";
    public static final String EXTRA_TITLE = "title";
    public static final String EXTRA_KIND = "kind"; // "save" or "cancel"

    private static final String CHANNEL = "takeone_recording";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 41;
    /** Focus losses inside this window after a (re)start are spurious. */
    private static final long FOCUS_GRACE_MS = 1200;

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private boolean ticking;
    private boolean busy; // a save/cancel is running
    private int convertingPct = -1;
    private long lastToggleAt;
    private long lastPctPush;
    private long captureStartedAt;

    private static volatile RecordingService activeInstance;

    private PendingIntent cachedContentIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedToggleIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedSaveIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedCancelIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedRestoreIntent;

    private String lastNotifTitle = "";
    private String lastNotifText = "";
    private Boolean lastNotifPaused = null;
    private int lastNotifPct = -2;
    private long lastChronoBaseMs = 0L;

    private AudioManager audioManager;
    private AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener focusListener;

    public static void start(Context ctx, String presetId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_START);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT, presetId);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            } else {
                ctx.startService(i);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                ctx.startService(i);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static void stopService(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.stopService(new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Called by RecordingEngine whenever capture starts, pauses, resumes,
     * finalizes, clears, aborts, or renames, so the notification updates
     * immediately without waiting for the next tick.
     */
    public static void onRecordingStateChanged() {
        RecordingService s = activeInstance;
        if (s != null) {
            s.handler.post(() -> s.refreshNotif(true));
        }
    }

    public static boolean isRunning(Context ctx) {
        // Best-effort: true while the engine holds an active capture session.
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        return e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        super.onCreate();
        activeInstance = this;
        ensureChannel();
        audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        initPendingIntents();
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent == null) {
            // System-restarted. START_NOT_STICKY means this should not happen,
            // but never re-enter startForeground() from here: a restart
            // racing the save could hit the Android 14+ rule that a
            // microphone FGS may not start from the background, and a
            // startForegroundService() that never promotes itself is fatal
            // to the process.
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        String a = intent.getAction();
        if (ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF.equals(a)) {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (e.hasSession() && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                    || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED)) {
                startFg();
                refreshNotif(true);
            } else {
                stopSelf();
            }
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        if (ACTION_START.equals(a)) {
            String preset = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT);
            if (preset != null) RecordPreset.of(preset).save(this);
            captureStartedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            registerFocus();
            startFg();
            startTick();
        } else if (ACTION_TOGGLE.equals(a)) {
            doToggle();
        } else if (ACTION_SAVE.equals(a)) {
            doSave();
        } else if (ACTION_CANCEL.equals(a)) {
            doCancel();
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (activeInstance == this) activeInstance = null;
        stopTick();
        abandonFocus();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ---- audio focus: interruptions pause, never auto-resume ----

    private android.media.AudioFocusRequest focusReq26;

    /**
     * True when a cellular or VoIP call (ringing, dialing, or in-call) is active.
     * Prevents resuming AudioRecord while Android's telephony policy mutes the mic.
     */
    public static boolean isCallActive(Context ctx) {
        if (ctx == null) return false;
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am != null) {
                int mode = am.getMode();
                if (mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_CALL
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_RINGTONE) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            android.telephony.TelephonyManager tm =
                    (android.telephony.TelephonyManager) ctx.getSystemService(
                            Context.TELEPHONY_SERVICE);
            if (tm != null) {
                int callState = tm.getCallState();
                if (callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_RINGING
                        || callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Requests audio focus and returns true only if granted.
     * If a call or exclusive speaker session rejects focus, returns false.
     */
    private boolean registerFocus() {
        try {
            if (isCallActive(this)) return false;
            if (audioManager == null) {
                audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            }
            if (audioManager == null) return true;
            if (focusListener == null) {
                focusListener = focus -> {
                    if (focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK) {
                        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - captureStartedAt
                                < FOCUS_GRACE_MS) {
                            return;
                        }
                        handler.post(() -> {
                            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
                            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                                e.pauseCapture();
                                abandonFocus();
                                boolean call = isCallActive(RecordingService.this);
                                toast(getString(call
                                        ? R.string.msg_paused_call
                                        : R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                                refreshNotif(true);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                };
            }
            int res;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                focusReq26 = new android.media.AudioFocusRequest.Builder(
                        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
                        .setAudioAttributes(new android.media.AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(focusListener, handler)
                        .build();
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusReq26);
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusListener,
                        AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN);
            }
            return res == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    private void abandonFocus() {
        try {
            if (audioManager != null) {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && focusReq26 != null) {
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(focusReq26);
                    focusReq26 = null;
                } else if (focusListener != null) {
                    //noinspection deprecation
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocus(focusListener);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        focusListener = null;
    }

    // ---- actions (debounced: one tap, one transition) ----

    private void doToggle() {
        if (busy) return;
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (now - lastToggleAt < 400) return;
        lastToggleAt = now;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        try {
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                e.pauseCapture();
                abandonFocus();
            } else if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED) {
                if (isCallActive(this)) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_call_active));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                captureStartedAt = now;
                if (!registerFocus()) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                e.resumeCapture(getApplicationContext(),
                        RecordPreset.load(this).audioSource);
            } else {
                return;
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            toast(getString(R.string.msg_need_mic));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            toast(getString(R.string.couldnt_save));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        }
        refreshNotif(true);
    }

    private void doSave() {
        if (busy) return;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        if (!e.hasSession()) {
            stopSelf();
            return;
        }
        if (e.isSaving()) return;
        e.setSaving(true);
        busy = true;
        convertingPct = 0;
        lastPctPush = 0;
        refreshNotif();
        new Thread(() -> {
            boolean ok;
            String msg;
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            try {
                Context appCtx = getApplicationContext();
                if (e.isInSubSession()) {
                    // The notification saved while a Select & Replace
                    // sub-session was open: splice first, then save the parent
                    // instead of exporting only the temporary snippet.
                    boolean commitSub = e.rawFile != null
                            && RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(e.rawFile) > 0;
                    e.exitSelectAndReplaceSubSession(commitSub, null);
                }
                RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
                SaveFormat save = SaveFormat.load(this);
                // NEW-06 fix: honour and clear stashed EditLink when saving
                // an edited take from the notification action.
                String rawPath = e.rawFile != null
                        ? e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() : null;
                long replaceId = -1;
                String replaceTitle = null;
                if (EditLink.matches(appCtx, rawPath)) {
                    replaceId = EditLink.id(appCtx);
                    replaceTitle = EditLink.title(appCtx);
                }
                ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                        appCtx, preset, save, this::setPct,
                        replaceId, replaceTitle);
                EditLink.clear(appCtx);
                if (r.adopted) {
                    if (replaceId > 0) {
                        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replaceId);
                    }
                    String rt = replaceTitle != null
                            && !replaceTitle.isEmpty()
                            ? replaceTitle : r.title;
                    TakesRepository.addRecording(r.file, r.durationMs,
                            rt, r.label);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.convert_done_msg, r.title,
                            r.label);
                } else {
                    // Handed to the conversion service; this service is done.
                    ConversionService.startJob(appCtx, r.job.jobId);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.conv_bg_toast);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                ok = false;
                msg = getString(R.string.convert_failed_msg, title);
            }
            final boolean done = ok;
            final String text = msg;
            final String t = title;
            handler.post(() -> {
                e.setSaving(false);
                try {
                    convertingPct = -1;
                    refreshNotif();
                    Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, done);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "save");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, t);
                try {
                    // Explicit package: stays inside the app, satisfies
                    // UnsafeImplicitIntentLaunch, same delivery as before.
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                convertingPct = -1;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    CrashLog.breadcrumb(getApplicationContext(),
                            "service completion FAILED: " + ex);
                    try {
                        stopSelf();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            });
        }).start();
    }

    private void doCancel() {
        if (busy) return;
        if (RecordingEngine.get().isSaving()) return;
        busy = true;
        new Thread(() -> {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            boolean ok = e.abortAndDelete();
            EditLink.clear(getApplicationContext());
            final String text = ok
                    ? getString(R.string.delete_success_one, title)
                    : getString(R.string.delete_failed_msg);
            handler.post(() -> {
                toast(text);
                Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, ok);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "cancel");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, title);
                try {
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
            });
        }).start();
    }

    // ---- notification: one clean standard layout ----

    private void ensureChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;
        try {
            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(
                    CHANNEL, getString(R.string.notif_channel),
                    NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ch.setDescription(getString(R.string.notif_channel_desc));
            nm.createNotificationChannel(ch);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void startFg() {
        lastNotifTitle = "";
        lastNotifText = "";
        lastNotifPaused = null;
        lastNotifPct = -2;
        Notification n = buildNotif();
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n,
                        ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
            }
            return;
        } catch (Exception typed) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "typed startForeground failed: " + typed);
        }
        // Untyped retry: a service launched with startForegroundService()
        // must reach the foreground within ~5s or the system kills the app,
        // so it is always worth attempting the permissive call.
        try {
            startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "startForeground failed: " + e);
            try {
                stopSelf();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void refreshNotif() {
        refreshNotif(false);
    }

    private void refreshNotif(boolean force) {
        try {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (!e.hasSession() && !busy) return;
            String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
            boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
            RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
            String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
            long durMs = e.durationMs();
            String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

            String title;
            String text;
            if (convertingPct >= 0) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
                text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
            } else if (paused) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
                // Chronometer is hidden when paused, so show frozen MM:SS here.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                        + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
            } else {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
                // Native Chronometer in header is the single live timer;
                // do not duplicate a second text timer in contentText.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
            }

            long expectedBase = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            boolean baseDrifted = !paused && convertingPct < 0
                    && Math.abs(expectedBase - lastChronoBaseMs) > 250L;

            if (!force && !baseDrifted
                    && title.equals(lastNotifTitle)
                    && text.equals(lastNotifText)
                    && lastNotifPaused != null && lastNotifPaused == paused
                    && lastNotifPct == convertingPct) {
                return;
            }
            lastNotifTitle = title;
            lastNotifText = text;
            lastNotifPaused = paused;
            lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
            if (!paused && convertingPct < 0) {
                lastChronoBaseMs = expectedBase;
            }

            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm != null) {
                nm.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * A single standard notification: small mic icon, "Recording — name"
     * title, "preset • live timer" text and exactly three actions. Built
     * with NotificationCompat so it renders identically (and lint-clean)
     * from API 24 up, with no custom RemoteViews for the system to duplicate.
     */
    private Notification buildNotif() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
        boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
        long durMs = e.durationMs();
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

        String title;
        String text;
        if (convertingPct >= 0) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
            text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
        } else if (paused) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                    + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
        } else {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
        }
        lastNotifTitle = title;
        lastNotifText = text;
        lastNotifPaused = paused;
        lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
        return buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs);
    }

    private Notification buildNotifWith(String title, String text,
                                        boolean paused, long durMs) {
        if (cachedContentIntent == null && cachedToggleIntent == null) {
            initPendingIntents();
        }
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));
        androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL);
        b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_mic);
        // Match TakeOne brand colors: record red (#FF3B30) when active,
        // amber (#FF9F0A) when paused.
        // Tint only the icon badge and action buttons (never flood-fill the
        // card background with setColorized(true)).
        b.setColor(paused ? 0xFFFF9F0A : 0xFFFF3B30);
        b.setColorized(false);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setCategory(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_SERVICE);
        b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setOngoing(true);
        b.setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        b.setSilent(true);
        if (cachedRestoreIntent != null) {
            b.setDeleteIntent(cachedRestoreIntent);
        }
        // Native SystemUI Chronometer ticks in real time on the system UI
        // thread without requiring sub-second Binder IPC updates.
        if (convertingPct < 0 && !paused) {
            long base = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            lastChronoBaseMs = base;
            b.setWhen(base);
            b.setShowWhen(true);
            b.setUsesChronometer(true);
        } else {
            b.setShowWhen(false);
            b.setUsesChronometer(false);
        }
        if (cachedContentIntent != null) {
            b.setContentIntent(cachedContentIntent);
        }
        if (convertingPct < 0) {
            b.addAction(0,
                    paused ? getString(R.string.notif_resume)
                            : getString(R.string.notif_pause),
                    cachedToggleIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_save),
                    cachedSaveIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_cancel),
                    cachedCancelIntent);
        } else {
            b.setProgress(100, Math.max(0, Math.min(100, convertingPct)), false);
        }
        try {
            Notification n = b.build();
            n.flags |= Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT
                    | Notification.FLAG_NO_CLEAR
                    | Notification.FLAG_FOREGROUND_SERVICE;
            return n;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return new Notification();
        }
    }

    private void initPendingIntents() {
        Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
        open.putExtra("open_studio", true);
        open.setAction("com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO");
        try {
            cachedContentIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 10, open,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            cachedContentIntent = null;
        }
        cachedToggleIntent = action(ACTION_TOGGLE, 21);
        cachedSaveIntent = action(ACTION_SAVE, 22);
        cachedCancelIntent = action(ACTION_CANCEL, 23);
        cachedRestoreIntent = action(ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF, 24);
    }

    private PendingIntent action(String what, int code) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(what);
        try {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
        }
    }

    private void startTick() {
        if (ticking) return;
        ticking = true;
        handler.post(tick);
    }

    private void stopTick() {
        ticking = false;
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
    }

    private final Runnable tick = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            if (!ticking) return;
            refreshNotif(false);
            // Align to the next whole-second boundary while recording so the
            // MM:SS readout steps in sync with the audio duration and never
            // exceeds 1 update/sec.
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            long delay = 1000L;
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                long rem = 1000L - (e.durationMs() % 1000L);
                delay = Math.max(200L, Math.min(1000L, rem));
            }
            handler.postDelayed(this, delay);
        }
    };

    private void setPct(int pct) {
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (pct == convertingPct) return;
        if (pct < 100 && now - lastPctPush < 500) {
            convertingPct = pct;
            return;
        }
        convertingPct = pct;
        lastPctPush = now;
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    private void toast(String text) {
        try {
            Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), text, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

================================================================================

/**
 * Name-first studio on top of the crash-safe 32-bit float engine.
 *
 * Flow: open -> name modal (no recording yet) -> tap mic to start (FAB morphs
 * into pause/play + split stop) -> stop asks save/discard -> convert to the
 * chosen preset with a live progress bar -> back to the library.
 *
 * Recovery and edit punch-ins arrive with an attached session: the timer
 * shows the loaded duration immediately and (for crash recovery) capture
 * resumes straight away.
 */

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback teleFrameCallback = new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
        @Override
        public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
            if (!isAdded() || getView() == null || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) {
                lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
                return;
            }
            advanceTeleprompterFrame(frameTimeNanos);
            if (!telePaused && tele != null && tele.autoScroll
                    && telePanel != null && telePanel.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
                scheduleTeleFrame();
            }
        }
    };

    private void scheduleTeleFrame() {
        if (teleChoreographerActive || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
            teleChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelTeleFrame() {
        teleChoreographerActive = false;
        lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- 60 FPS waveform / preview VSYNC driver ----
    private boolean waveChoreographerActive;

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback waveFrameCallback =
            new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
                @Override
                public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
                    waveChoreographerActive = false;
                    if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
                    try {
                        boolean live = engine.state
                                == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
                        boolean preview = studioPreviewPlayer != null;
                        if (live) {
                            long cur = engine.liveInterpolatedFrames();
                            if (cur > 0 && cur != lastPushedCursorFrame) {
                                lastPushedCursorFrame = cur;
                                waveform.updateLiveFromFrames(
                                        engine.lastSmoothedPeak(), cur,
                                        replaceTargetEndFrame);
                            }
                        } else if (preview) {
                            long total = previewPlaysRenderedFx
                                    && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0
                                    ? fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames
                                    : Math.max(1L, engine.totalFrames());
                            waveform.setPlayheadFraction(Math.min(1f,
                                    studioPreviewPlayer.positionFrames()
                                            / (float) total));
                        }
                        if ((live || preview) && getView() != null) {
                            scheduleWaveFrame();
                        }
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                }
            };

    private void scheduleWaveFrame() {
        if (waveChoreographerActive || !isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
            waveChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            waveChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelWaveFrame() {
        waveChoreographerActive = false;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

        fxPanel = v.findViewById(R.id.fxPanel);
        fxTitle = v.findViewById(R.id.fxTitle);
        fxPresetDropdown = v.findViewById(R.id.fxPresetDropdown);
        fxCloseBtn = v.findViewById(R.id.fxCloseBtn);
        fxListContainer = v.findViewById(R.id.fxListContainer);
        fxHint = v.findViewById(R.id.fxHint);

        dspConfig = DspChain.Config.load(requireContext());
        dspBakedToRaw = false;
        dspSubRangeBaked = false;
        lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
        undoJournal = new EditEngine.UndoJournal(RecordingEngine.takesDir(requireContext()));
        subEditorUndoJournal = new EditEngine.UndoJournal(
                new File(RecordingEngine.takesDir(requireContext()), "sub_undo"));

        if (btnCutDelete != null) {
            btnCutDelete.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        // 1) "Replace" Mode Toggle Button (btnPreviewPlay):
        //    Pure toggle: pressing once selects Replace (red pill, main FAB
        //    morphs to Mic icon) and locks all other editing options; pressing
        //    again deselects Replace and re-enables the other editing options.
        if (btnPreviewPlay != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnPreviewPlay, 0.95f);
            btnPreviewPlay.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), "Replace", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();
                replaceModeArmed = !replaceModeArmed;
                if (replaceModeArmed) {
                    if (waveform != null) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();
                        waveform.setSelectionLocked(true);
                    }
                    if (fxPanelOpen) {
                        setFxPanelVisible(false);
                    }
                    RawFloatPlayer.releaseWarmSpeaker();
                } else {
                    if (waveform != null) {
                        waveform.setSelectionLocked(false);
                    }
                    RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                }
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
                syncStudioFabIcon();
            });
        }

        // 2) "Select" Button: stays labeled "Select", simply turns red when active
        //    (does NOT activate Select & Replace, and is blocked while Replace is on)
        if (btnSelectRange != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnSelectRange, 0.95f);
            btnSelectRange.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), "Select", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();
                if (fxPanelOpen) {
                    // Select stays live in effects mode so a noise profile
                    // can be learned from a sub-range, but the handles are
                    // clamped to the frozen apply target. Tapping again puts
                    // the full target back once the sub-selection is gone.
                    if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();
                    } else {
                        waveform.selectRange(fxApplyTargetStart,
                                fxApplyTargetEnd);
                    }
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                } else {
                    waveform.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
                    paintEditorStrip();
                }
            });
        }

        // 3) "Select & Replace" Button: opens dedicated sub-editor configuration
        if (btnReplaceSeg != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnReplaceSeg, 0.95f);
            btnReplaceSeg.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), "Select & Replace", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                openSelectAndReplaceSubEditor();
            });
        }

        // 4) "Trim" Button: opens stylized Keep Selected / Delete Selected popup
        if (btnTrimCrop != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnTrimCrop, 0.95f);
            btnTrimCrop.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), "Trim", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                showTrimOptionsPopup();
            });
        }

        // 5) "FX" Button: opens inline Pro FX window in place of Teleprompter
        if (btnDspFx != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnDspFx, 0.95f);
            btnDspFx.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), "Effects", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                toggleFxPanel();
            });
        }

        // 6) "Undo" & "Redo" Buttons
        if (btnEditUndo != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnEditUndo, 0.95f);
            btnEditUndo.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), "Undo", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                performStudioUndo();
            });
        }
        if (btnEditRedo != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnEditRedo, 0.95f);
            btnEditRedo.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), "Redo", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                performStudioRedo();
            });
        }

        if (fxCloseBtn != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxCloseBtn, 0.95f);
            fxCloseBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> setFxPanelVisible(false));
        }
        if (fxPresetDropdown != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxPresetDropdown, 0.95f);
            fxPresetDropdown.setOnClickListener(view -> showFxPresetsMenu());
        }
        waveform.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrollStarted() {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                engine.warmUpMic(requireContext(), preset.audioSource, engine.channels);
            }

            @Override
            public void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction) {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                if (studioPreviewPlayer != null || fxPreviewPreparing) {
                    stopStudioPreview();
                }
                if (fxPanelOpen && fxRenderedPreviewWaveLoaded
                        && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0) {
                    fxPreviewPlayheadFrame = Math.max(
                            fxRenderedPreviewStartFrame,
                            Math.min(fxRenderedPreviewEndFrame,
                                    Math.round(fraction * fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames)));
                    float rStart = waveform.fxRegionStartFraction();
                    float rEnd = Math.max(rStart + 1e-5f,
                            waveform.fxRegionEndFraction());
                    float rel = Math.max(0f,
                            Math.min(1f, (fraction - rStart) / (rEnd - rStart)));
                    long rawTotal = engine.totalFrames();
                    long rawStart = Math.round(fxApplyTargetStart * rawTotal);
                    long rawEnd = Math.round(fxApplyTargetEnd * rawTotal);
                    long mappedRaw = rawStart + Math.round(rel * (rawEnd - rawStart));
                    engine.seekCursorFrame(
                            Math.max(0L, Math.min(rawTotal, mappedRaw)));
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                    timerText.setText(formatTimer(
                            fxPreviewPlayheadFrame * 1000L
                                    / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE));
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                    return;
                }
                long totalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long targetFrame = Math.round(fraction * totalFrames);
                // Never disarm replaceModeArmed while scrubbing! If the user
                // enabled Replace at the end of the take and starts dragging
                // back, the initial move events are near 1.0f and must keep
                // Replace armed.
                //
                // The playhead is NEVER snapped forward here: the timer must
                // show the real scrubbed position. At low zoom a short drag
                // covers many buckets, so forcing targetFrame = totalFrames as
                // soon as the drag came within 480 frames of the end made the
                // timer jump to the whole take duration mid-scroll. Parking at
                // the end is still recognised by the 480-frame tolerance in
                // resumeTake()/syncStudioFabIcon(), which is all this flag is for.
                if (!replaceModeArmed
                        && (fraction >= 0.995f || targetFrame >= totalFrames - 480)) {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = false;
                } else {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                }
                engine.seekCursorFrame(targetFrame);
                timerText.setText(formatTimer(engine.cursorMs()));
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
            }

            @Override
            public void onSelectionChanged(boolean active, float startFrac, float endFrac) {
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
            }
        });

        // Recovery (crash prompt / notification tap) or an edit punch-in:
        // a session is already attached — never show the name modal.
        Bundle args = getArguments();
        boolean attached = false;
        boolean autostart = false;
        if (args != null && args.containsKey("recover_raw")) {
            try {
                File raw = new File(args.getString("recover_raw"));
                if (raw.exists() && !engine.hasSession()) {
                    // Attach with the file's real geometry: a mono session
                    // must stay mono, or punch-in + re-save silently upmixes.
                    int attachCh = 2;
                    try {
                        FormatConverter.WavInfo ai =
                                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                        if (ai.channels == 1 || ai.channels == 2) {
                            attachCh = ai.channels;
                        }
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    engine.attachExisting(requireContext(), raw,
                            engine.takeName != null ? engine.takeName
                                    : prettyBase(raw),
                            attachCh, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));
                }
                pendingName = engine.takeName;
                autostart = args.getBoolean("autostart", false);
                editSourceId = args.getLong("edit_source_id", -1);
                editSourceTitle = args.getString("edit_source_title");
                if (editSourceId == -1 && engine.rawFile != null
                        && EditLink.matches(requireContext(),
                        engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                    // Killed mid-edit: re-adopt the stashed linkage so save
                    // still offers replace-vs-new for the right take.
                    editSourceId = EditLink.id(requireContext());
                    editSourceTitle = EditLink.title(requireContext());
                }
                nameAsked = true;
                attached = true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                pendingName = null;
            }
            args.remove("recover_raw");
        }
        if (!attached && engine.hasSession()) {
            pendingName = engine.takeName;
            if (engine.rawFile != null && EditLink.matches(requireContext(),
                    engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                editSourceId = EditLink.id(requireContext());
                editSourceTitle = EditLink.title(requireContext());
            }
            nameAsked = true;
            attached = true;
        }
        restoreWaveformForAttachedSession();
        restoreEditingMode(savedInstanceState);

        // Snapshot the attached session size so backing out of an untouched
        // edit can skip the save nag, and park the prompter unless capture
        // is actively running.
        initialSessionBytes = engine.hasSession() ? engine.dataBytes : 0L;
        setTelePaused(engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING);

        if (editorStrip != null) {
            editorStrip.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        paint();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        handler.post(tick);
        scheduleWaveFrame();
        activity().syncFabWithEngine();

        doneReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                if (!RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE.equals(intent.getAction())) return;
                boolean ok = intent.getBooleanExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_OK, false);
                String msg = intent.getStringExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_MESSAGE);
                String kind = intent.getStringExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_KIND);
                onBackgroundActionDone(ok, "cancel".equals(kind), msg);
            }
        };
        try {
            IntentFilter f = new IntentFilter(RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE);
            // Compat registration handles the API 33+ exported-flag
            // requirement on every version, killing the lint error and the
            // hand-rolled version branch.
            androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.registerReceiver(
                    requireContext(), doneReceiver, f,
                    androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            doneReceiver = null;
        }

        if (!attached && !nameAsked) {
            nameAsked = true;
            v.post(this::askForName);
        } else if (attached && autostart
                && engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            // Crash recovery: reopen directly in the recording state.
            v.post(() -> {
                if (!isAdded()) return;
                if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(),
                        Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                        == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    ensureNotifThenStart();
                } else {
                    micPermission.launch(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onSaveInstanceState(@NonNull Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putBoolean("fxPanelOpen", fxPanelOpen);
        outState.putBoolean("fxEverOpened", fxEverOpened);
        outState.putBoolean("replaceModeArmed", replaceModeArmed);
        outState.putBoolean("inSelectAndReplaceEditor", inSelectAndReplaceEditor);
        outState.putBoolean("userScrolledWhilePaused", userScrolledWhilePaused);
        outState.putBoolean("dspBakedToRaw", dspBakedToRaw);
        outState.putBoolean("dspSubRangeBaked", dspSubRangeBaked);
        outState.putBoolean("lastEditWasSubRangeBake", lastEditWasSubRangeBake);
        outState.putBoolean("fxTargetHasSelection", fxApplyTargetHasSelection);
        outState.putFloat("fxTargetStart", fxApplyTargetStart);
        outState.putFloat("fxTargetEnd", fxApplyTargetEnd);
        if (waveform != null) {
            if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                outState.putBoolean("selActive", true);
                outState.putFloat("selStart", waveform.selectionStartFraction());
                outState.putFloat("selEnd", waveform.selectionEndFraction());
            }
            waveform.saveSubEditorState(outState);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Puts the editor back into the mode the user was in before a rotation.
     * The engine session survives the configuration change, but the fragment
     * is recreated, so every mode flag has to travel in the saved state.
     */
    private void restoreEditingMode(@Nullable Bundle state) {
        if (state == null || waveform == null) return;
        boolean fxWasOpen = state.getBoolean("fxPanelOpen", false);
        fxEverOpened = state.getBoolean("fxEverOpened", false) || fxWasOpen;
        boolean selActive = state.getBoolean("selActive", false);
        float selStart = state.getFloat("selStart", 0f);
        float selEnd = state.getFloat("selEnd", 1f);

        dspBakedToRaw = state.getBoolean("dspBakedToRaw", false);
        dspSubRangeBaked = state.getBoolean("dspSubRangeBaked", false);
        lastEditWasSubRangeBake =
                state.getBoolean("lastEditWasSubRangeBake", false);

        if (state.getBoolean("inSelectAndReplaceEditor", false)
                && engine.isInSubSession()) {
            inSelectAndReplaceEditor = true;
            waveform.restoreSubEditorState(state);
        }

        replaceModeArmed = state.getBoolean("replaceModeArmed", false);
        if (replaceModeArmed) {
            waveform.clearSelection();
            waveform.setSelectionLocked(true);
        }
        userScrolledWhilePaused =
                state.getBoolean("userScrolledWhilePaused", false);

        // Ranges need buckets. The attached take loads in the background, so
        // finish the restore from that callback instead of losing the mode.
        if ((fxWasOpen || selActive) && waveform.historyCount() <= 1) {
            pendingModeRestore = state;
            paintEditorStrip();
            return;
        }

        if (fxWasOpen) {
            float ts = state.getFloat("fxTargetStart", 0f);
            float te = state.getFloat("fxTargetEnd", 1f);
            if (te <= ts) {
                ts = 0f;
                te = 1f;
            }
            fxApplyTargetStart = ts;
            fxApplyTargetEnd = te;
            fxApplyTargetHasSelection = true;
            // Bounds first: selectRange and the handle drags are clamped to
            // this region for the whole lifetime of the mode.
            waveform.setFxRegionBounds(ts, te);
            waveform.selectRange(ts, te);
            fxPanelOpen = false;
            setFxPanelVisible(true);
            if (selActive) {
                waveform.selectRange(selStart, selEnd);
            }
        } else if (selActive) {
            waveform.selectRange(selStart, selEnd);
        }

        pendingModeRestore = null;
        paintEditorStrip();
        paintFxPanelControls();
    }

    @Override
    public void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        handler.post(tick);
        scheduleWaveFrame();
        if (!telePaused) scheduleTeleFrame();
        paint();
        activity().syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    @Override
    public void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        cancelWaveFrame();
        cancelTeleFrame();
        persistTeleScript();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroyView() {
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
        cancelWaveFrame();
        cancelTeleFrame();
        stopDotPulse();
        stopStudioPreview();
        pendingModeRestore = null;
        persistTeleScript();
        // Never abort here: the take keeps recording in the background via
        // the foreground service when the user leaves the studio.
        try {
            if (doneReceiver != null) requireContext().unregisterReceiver(doneReceiver);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        doneReceiver = null;
        super.onDestroyView();
    }

    // ---- entry: name first, never auto-record ----

    private void askForName() {
        if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
        if (engine.hasSession()) return;
        namingModalOpen = true;
        OptionsSheet.showInputWithCancel(requireContext(),
                getString(R.string.name_take_title),
                nextTakeName(),
                getString(R.string.name_take_save),
                text -> {
                    namingModalOpen = false;
                    pendingName = RecordingEngine.sanitize(text);
                    paint();
                    activity().syncFabWithEngine();
                },
                () -> {
                    namingModalOpen = false;
                    if (!isAdded()) return;
                    if (!engine.hasSession() && pendingName == null) {
                        activity().exitStudio();
                    }
                },
                true);
    }

    private void showRenameModal() {
        if (!isAdded()) return;
        if (engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.studio_recording_hint,
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        String current = engine.hasSession() && engine.takeName != null
                ? engine.takeName : pendingName;
        if (current == null) current = nextTakeName();
        OptionsSheet.showInput(requireContext(), getString(R.string.rename_title),
                current, getString(R.string.rename_save), text -> {
                    String clean = RecordingEngine.sanitize(text);
                    try {
                        if (engine.hasSession()) {
                            engine.renameSession(requireContext(), clean);
                            pendingName = engine.takeName;
                            if (editSourceId != -1 && engine.rawFile != null) {
                                editSourceTitle = clean;
                                EditLink.save(requireContext(), editSourceId,
                                        clean, engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath());
                            }
                        } else {
                            pendingName = clean;
                        }
                        paint();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                R.string.rename_failed_msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    }
                });
    }

    private void attachRenameGestures(View target) {
        final GestureDetector gd = new GestureDetector(requireContext(),
                new GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener() {
                    @Override
                    public boolean onDoubleTap(MotionEvent e) {
                        if (pendingName != null || engine.hasSession()) showRenameModal();
                        else askForName();
                        return true;
                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onLongPress(MotionEvent e) {
                        try {
                            if (pendingName != null || engine.hasSession()) {
                                showRenameModal();
                            } else {
                                askForName();
                            }
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                });
        target.setOnTouchListener((view, event) -> gd.onTouchEvent(event));
    }

    // ---- unified recording settings: presets + format toggles ----

    private int presetIcon(RecordPreset p) {
        switch (p) {
            case PODCAST: return R.drawable.ic_sliders;
            case MUSIC: return R.drawable.ic_wave;
            default: return R.drawable.ic_mic;
        }
    }

    private void showRecordingSettings() {
        if (!isAdded()) return;
        if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                requireActivity(), "Recording Settings", null)) {
            return;
        }
        OptionsSheet.SettingsState state = new OptionsSheet.SettingsState() {
            @Override
            public List<OptionsSheet.Item> presets() {
                List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
                for (RecordPreset p : RecordPreset.all()) {
                    final RecordPreset pick = p;
                    items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(
                            presetIcon(p),
                            getString(p.titleRes), getString(p.subRes),
                            p == preset,
                            () -> {
                                // NEW-06 fix: lock preset changes whenever
                                // recording OR when an attached session
                                // already holds recorded audio on disk
                                // (whose channel geometry is fixed).
                                if (engine.state
                                        == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                                        || (engine.hasSession()
                                        && engine.dataBytes > 0)) {
                                    try {
                                        PressAnim.nudge(settingsRow, 1.02f);
                                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                                R.string.preset_locked,
                                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                                    return;
                                }
                                preset = pick;
                                preset.save(requireContext());
                                paint();
                            }));
                }
                return items;
            }

            @Override
            public List<OptionsSheet.Chip> formats() {
                List<OptionsSheet.Chip> chips = new ArrayList<>();
                for (SaveFormat f : SaveFormat.values()) {
                    if (!f.available(requireContext())) continue;
                    final SaveFormat pick = f;
                    String label = f == SaveFormat.AUTO
                            ? getString(R.string.save_auto)
                            : chipLabel(f);
                    // Size is resolved against AUTO so the Auto chip shows
                    // what it will actually produce, and re-read on every
                    // preset change so mono/stereo estimates stay honest.
                    SaveFormat shown = f == SaveFormat.AUTO ? f.effective(preset)
                            : f;
                    chips.add(OptionsSheet.Chip.of(label,
                            shown.sizePerMinuteLabel(preset),
                            f == saveFormat,
                            () -> {
                                if (saving) {
                                    try {
                                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                                R.string.save_locked,
                                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                                    return;
                                }
                                saveFormat = pick;
                                saveFormat.save(requireContext());
                                if (engine.hasSession() && !engine.isInPlaceEdited()) {
                                    engine.restartStreaming(requireContext(), preset, saveFormat);
                                }
                                paint();
                            }));
                }
                return chips;
            }

            @Override
            public String formatHint() {
                return getString(R.string.save_auto_sub) + " • "
                        + TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.AUTO);
            }
        };
        OptionsSheet.showRecordingSettings(requireContext(),
                getString(R.string.settings_title),
                getString(R.string.preset_title), micCapabilityLine(),
                getString(R.string.settings_format), state,
                getString(R.string.settings_done));
    }

    /** Short chip text: "M4A", "WAV 16", "WAV 24", "AMR", "FLAC", … */
    private String chipLabel(SaveFormat f) {
        switch (f) {
            case WAV16: return "WAV 16";
            case WAV24: return "WAV 24";
            case WAV32: return "WAV 32";
            default: return TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, f);
        }
    }

    private String micCapabilityLine() {
        int n = MicSupport.physicalMicCount(audioManager);
        if (n >= 2) return getString(R.string.mic_stereo_ok, n);
        if (n == 1) return getString(R.string.mic_mono_only);
        return getString(R.string.mic_unknown);
    }

    // ---- teleprompter ----

    private void initTeleprompter() {
        tele = TeleSettings.load(requireContext());
        String savedScript = loadTeleScript();
        teleView.setScript(savedScript);
        // A4-10: the header title only ever updated on an explicit edit, so
        // reopening the studio showed a stale/empty title.
        if (teleTitle != null) {
            teleTitle.setText(scriptNameOf(savedScript));
        }
        applyTeleSettings();
        // The control chrome overlays the top of the panel: keep the reading
        // centre in the middle of the visible area, not the middle of the
        // view, as the chrome height settles.
        final View chrome = requireView().findViewById(R.id.teleChrome);
        if (chrome != null && telePanel != null) {
            telePanel.addOnLayoutChangeListener(
                    (v, left, top, right, bottom,
                     oldLeft, oldTop, oldRight, oldBottom) -> {
                        if (teleView != null) {
                            teleView.setCenterShiftPx(chrome.getHeight() / 2f);
                        }
                    });
        }
        // On by default: a performer opening the studio wants the script,
        // not an empty recorder.
        setTeleprompterVisible(true);
        scriptPicker = registerForActivityResult(
                new ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument(), uri -> {
                    if (uri == null || !isAdded()) return;
                    ScriptImporter.Result r = ScriptImporter.read(
                            requireContext(), uri);
                    if (!r.ok()) {
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                getString(R.string.tele_import_failed),
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        return;
                    }
                    persistTeleScript(r.text);
                    teleView.setScript(r.text);
                    teleTitle.setText(scriptNameOf(r.text));
                    // Reflect it in the editor too, if it is still open.
                    TeleDialogs.applyImported(requireContext(), r.text,
                            scriptNameOf(r.text), tele.wordsPerMinute);
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                            getString(R.string.tele_imported,
                                    scriptNameOf(r.text),
                                    TeleMath.wordCount(r.text)),
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });
    }

    private static String scriptNameOf(String text) {
        String first = "";
        if (text != null) {
            for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
                String t = line.trim();
                if (!t.isEmpty()) {
                    first = t;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (first.isEmpty()) return "Script";
        return first.length() > 28 ? first.substring(0, 28) + "…" : first;
    }

    /** Pushes settings into the view, applying the words-per-line clamp. */
    private void applyTeleSettings() {
        if (tele == null || teleView == null || getView() == null) return;
        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        teleView.setTextSizePx(tele.textSizeSp * density);
        teleView.setWordsPerLine(tele.wordsPerLine);
        teleView.setMirror(tele.mirror);
    }

    private void setTeleprompterVisible(boolean visible) {
        if (telePanel == null) return;
        // Teleprompter is always present unless the inline FX screen is open.
        boolean showTele = visible || !fxPanelOpen;
        telePanel.setVisibility(showTele ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        setTeleActive(showTele);
    }

    private void toggleTeleprompter() {
        // Teleprompter is permanently visible when not in the FX screen; if FX is
        // open, switching back restores the teleprompter.
        if (fxPanelOpen) {
            setFxPanelVisible(false);
        } else {
            setTeleprompterVisible(true);
        }
    }

    private void setTeleActive(boolean active) {
        if (teleToggle != null) {
            teleToggle.setBackgroundResource(active
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected : R.drawable.bg_search);
        }
        if (teleToggleIcon != null) {
            teleToggleIcon.setAlpha(active ? 1f : 0.55f);
        }
        if (teleState != null) {
            teleState.setText(active ? R.string.tele_hide_short : R.string.tele_show);
        }
    }

    private void openTeleEditor() {
        if (!isAdded()) return;
        TeleDialogs.showEditor(requireContext(), loadTeleScript(),
                tele != null ? tele.wordsPerMinute : 120,
                script -> {
                    persistTeleScript(script);
                    if (teleView != null) teleView.setScript(script);
                    if (teleTitle != null) teleTitle.setText(scriptNameOf(script));
                },
                () -> {
                    try {
                        scriptPicker.launch(new String[]{
                                "text/plain",
                                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument"
                                        + ".wordprocessingml.document",
                                "*/*"
                        });
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                getString(R.string.tele_import_failed),
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    }
                });
    }

    private String loadTeleScript() {
        try {
            return requireContext().getSharedPreferences("takeone",
                            Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getString("tele_script", TeleSettings.DEFAULT_SCRIPT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private void persistTeleScript() {
        if (teleView != null) persistTeleScript(teleView.getScript());
    }

    private void persistTeleScript(String text) {
        try {
            requireContext().getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putString("tele_script", text == null ? "" : text)
                    .apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Drives the prompter: advances whenever not paused (both while recording
     * AND before recording starts so the user can check the speed), yields
     * while the user's finger is actively dragging the script, and resumes
     * immediately on finger lift.
     */
    /**
     * Native display refresh-rate (60Hz/90Hz/120Hz) VSYNC callback so the
     * teleprompter scrolls smoothly every single display frame.
     */
    private void advanceTeleprompterFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
        if (teleView == null || tele == null) return;
        long nowMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (!tele.autoScroll || telePaused || namingModalOpen) {
            lastTeleAdvanceMs = 0L;
            lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
            return;
        }
        if (telePanel == null || telePanel.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            lastTeleAdvanceMs = 0L;
            lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
            return;
        }
        if (teleView.isDragging()) {
            lastTeleAdvanceMs = nowMs;
            lastTeleFrameNanos = frameTimeNanos;
            return;
        }
        if (teleView.maxScroll() > 0f
                && teleView.scrollOffset() >= teleView.maxScroll() - 0.5f) {
            setTelePaused(true);
            return;
        }
        float dt = lastTeleFrameNanos > 0L
                ? Math.max(0f, (frameTimeNanos - lastTeleFrameNanos) / 1_000_000_000f)
                : (1f / 60f);
        dt = Math.min(dt, 0.08f);
        lastTeleFrameNanos = frameTimeNanos;
        lastTeleAdvanceMs = nowMs;
        float px = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(tele.wordsPerMinute,
                teleView.effectiveWordsPerLine(),
                teleView.renderedTextSizePx());
        if (px <= 0f) return;
        teleView.scrollBy(px * dt);
    }

    /**
     * Fallback called from the 50ms tick only when Choreographer has not
     * already advanced the current frame (e.g. in headless Robolectric tests).
     */
    private void advanceTeleprompter() {
        if (teleView == null || tele == null) return;
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (!tele.autoScroll || telePaused || namingModalOpen) {
            lastTeleAdvanceMs = 0L;
            return;
        }
        if (telePanel == null || telePanel.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            lastTeleAdvanceMs = 0L;
            return;
        }
        // If Choreographer is actively driving VSYNC frames, let it own the
        // scroll update so we never step at 20Hz on top of 60/120Hz.
        if (teleChoreographerActive && lastTeleFrameNanos > 0L
                && (now - lastTeleAdvanceMs) < 40L) {
            return;
        }
        if (!teleChoreographerActive) {
            scheduleTeleFrame();
        }
        if (teleView.isDragging()) {
            lastTeleAdvanceMs = now;
            return;
        }
        if (teleView.maxScroll() > 0f
                && teleView.scrollOffset() >= teleView.maxScroll() - 0.5f) {
            setTelePaused(true);
            return;
        }
        float dt = lastTeleAdvanceMs > 0
                ? Math.max(0f, (now - lastTeleAdvanceMs) / 1000f)
                : (1f / 60f);
        dt = Math.min(dt, 0.25f);
        lastTeleAdvanceMs = now;
        float px = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(tele.wordsPerMinute,
                teleView.effectiveWordsPerLine(),
                teleView.renderedTextSizePx());
        if (px <= 0f) return;
        teleView.scrollBy(px * dt);
    }

    private void setTelePaused(boolean paused) {
        telePaused = paused;
        lastTeleAdvanceMs = 0L;
        lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
        if (!telePaused) {
            teleManualUntil = 0L;
            scheduleTeleFrame();
        } else {
            cancelTeleFrame();
        }
        if (telePauseBtn != null) {
            telePauseBtn.setText(telePaused
                    ? R.string.tele_resume_short : R.string.tele_pause_short);
            telePauseBtn.setCompoundDrawablesRelativeWithIntrinsicBounds(
                    telePaused ? R.drawable.ic_tele_play : R.drawable.ic_tele_pause,
                    0, 0, 0);
            telePauseBtn.setSelected(telePaused);
        }
    }

    private void toggleTelePaused() {
        boolean nextPaused = !telePaused;
        if (!nextPaused && teleView != null && teleView.maxScroll() > 0f
                && teleView.scrollOffset() >= teleView.maxScroll() - 1f) {
            teleView.rewind();
        }
        setTelePaused(nextPaused);
        if (telePauseBtn != null) {
            PressAnim.nudge(telePauseBtn, 1.12f);
        }
    }

    private void paintTeleMirror() {
        if (teleMirrorBtn == null) return;
        boolean on = tele != null && tele.mirror;
        teleMirrorBtn.setSelected(on);
        teleMirrorBtn.setAlpha(on ? 1f : 0.55f);
        TextViewCompat.setCompoundDrawableTintList(teleMirrorBtn,
                ColorStateList.valueOf(on ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFFF2F4F7));
    }

    /** Inline size / speed / words-per-line controls, plus zoom. */
    private void initTeleValueControls() {
        teleSizeValue.setCaption(getString(R.string.tele_size_short));
        teleSpeedValue.setCaption(getString(R.string.tele_speed_short));
        teleWplValue.setCaption(getString(R.string.tele_wpl_short));
        zoomValue.setCaption(getString(R.string.zoom));
        zoomValue.setStacked(true);
        // A vertical pass over the zoom rail zooms, like the waveform itself.
        zoomValue.setVerticalScrub(true);
        zoomValue.setValueScale(100); // 1 unit = 0.01% (10000 = 100%, 92 = 0.92%)
        zoomValue.setStepRule((cur, dir) -> {
            int ref = dir < 0 ? cur - 1 : cur;
            if (ref < 200) return 10;     // < 2%: 0.10% steps
            if (ref < 1000) return 50;    // 2%..10%: 0.50% steps
            if (ref < 5000) return 200;   // 10%..50%: 2% steps
            if (ref < 10000) return 500;  // 50%..100%: 5% steps
            return 2000;                  // 100%..400%: 20% steps
        });
        teleSizeValue.configure(12, 56, 1, tele.textSizeSp, "");
        teleSpeedValue.configure(TeleSettings.MIN_WPM, TeleSettings.MAX_WPM,
                5, tele.wordsPerMinute, "");
        teleWplValue.configure(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, 1, tele.wordsPerLine, "");

        teleSizeValue.setOnScrubListener(new TeleValue.OnScrubListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrubValueChanged(int val) {
                commitTeleSize(val);
            }

            @Override
            public void onScrubFinished(int val) {
                commitTeleSize(val);
            }
        });
        teleSpeedValue.setOnScrubListener(new TeleValue.OnScrubListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrubValueChanged(int val) {
                commitTeleSpeed(val);
            }

            @Override
            public void onScrubFinished(int val) {
                commitTeleSpeed(val);
            }
        });
        teleWplValue.setOnScrubListener(new TeleValue.OnScrubListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrubValueChanged(int val) {
                // Re-wrap live like size/speed: the label alone moving while
                // the script keeps its old segmentation reads as broken.
                commitTeleWordsPerLine(val);
            }

            @Override
            public void onScrubFinished(int val) {
                commitTeleWordsPerLine(val);
            }
        });
        teleSizeValue.setOnValueChanged(this::commitTeleSize);
        teleSpeedValue.setOnValueChanged(this::commitTeleSpeed);
        teleWplValue.setOnValueChanged(this::commitTeleWordsPerLine);

        // Zoom shares the same control; its floor moves with the timeline.
        refreshZoomValue();
        zoomValue.setOnScrubListener(new TeleValue.OnScrubListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrubValueChanged(int percent) {
                applyZoomValue(percent);
            }

            @Override
            public void onScrubFinished(int percent) {
                applyZoomValue(percent);
            }
        });
        zoomValue.setOnValueChanged(this::applyZoomValue);
        paintTeleMirror();
    }

    private void commitTeleSize(int textSizeSp) {
        TeleSettings.setTextSize(requireContext(), textSizeSp);
        tele = TeleSettings.load(requireContext());
        applyTeleSettings();
    }

    private void commitTeleSpeed(int wordsPerMinute) {
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerMinute(requireContext(), wordsPerMinute);
        tele = TeleSettings.load(requireContext());
        applyTeleSettings();
    }

    private void commitTeleWordsPerLine(int wordsPerLine) {
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerLine(requireContext(), wordsPerLine);
        tele = TeleSettings.load(requireContext());
        applyTeleSettings();
    }

    private void applyZoomValue(int bp) {
        if (waveform == null) return;
        if (isAdded() && !TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                requireActivity(), "Waveform Zoom", null)) {
            refreshZoomValue();
            return;
        }
        if (bp <= zoomValue.getMin()) {
            waveform.setZoom(waveform.minimumZoom());
        } else {
