                        ? (val > 0) : (val != slot.type.defaultVal);
                if (!slot.enabled && engages) slot.enabled = true;
                onSlotMutated.run();
                rebuildFxRackList();
            });

            // ---- Inspector extras: ordering, blend, reset, extra params ----
            final int slotIdx = i;

            android.widget.LinearLayout ops =
                    new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
            ops.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams opsLp =
                    new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            opsLp.topMargin = Math.round(8 * density);

            TextView upBtn = makeFxChip(ctx, "↑ Move Up", density);
            TextView downBtn = makeFxChip(ctx, "↓ Move Down", density);
            TextView resetBtn = makeFxChip(ctx, "Reset", density);
            ops.addView(upBtn);
            ops.addView(downBtn);
            ops.addView(resetBtn);
            body.addView(ops, opsLp);

            boolean canUp = slotIdx > 0;
            boolean canDown = slotIdx < dspConfig.slots.size() - 1;
            upBtn.setEnabled(canUp);
            upBtn.setAlpha(canUp ? 1f : 0.35f);
            downBtn.setEnabled(canDown);
            downBtn.setAlpha(canDown ? 1f : 0.35f);
            upBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (slotIdx <= 0) return;
                DspChain.EffectSlot moved =
                        dspConfig.slots.remove(slotIdx);
                dspConfig.slots.add(slotIdx - 1, moved);
                onSlotMutated.run();
                rebuildFxRackList();
            });
            downBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (slotIdx >= dspConfig.slots.size() - 1) return;
                DspChain.EffectSlot moved =
                        dspConfig.slots.remove(slotIdx);
                dspConfig.slots.add(slotIdx + 1, moved);
                onSlotMutated.run();
                rebuildFxRackList();
            });
            resetBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                slot.value = slot.type.defaultVal;
                slot.wetDry = 1f;
                slot.extraParams.clear();
                slot.noiseProfile = null;
                onSlotMutated.run();
                rebuildFxRackList();
            });

            {
                TextView mixCaption = new TextView(ctx);
                mixCaption.setText("Wet-Dry Mix");
                mixCaption.setTextSize(10.5f);
                mixCaption.setTextColor(0xFF8A93A0);
                body.addView(mixCaption);

                TeleValue mixCtl = new TeleValue(ctx);
                mixCtl.setCompact(true);
                mixCtl.configure(0, 100, 5,
                        Math.round(slot.wetDry * 100f), "%");
                mixCtlHolder[0] = mixCtl;
                android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams mixLp =
                        new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                mixLp.topMargin = Math.round(4 * density);
                body.addView(mixCtl, mixLp);
                mixCtl.setOnScrubListener(new TeleValue.OnScrubListener() {
                    @Override
                    public void onScrubValueChanged(int value) {
                        slot.wetDry = value / 100f;
                        onSlotMutated.run();
                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onScrubFinished(int value) {
                        slot.wetDry = value / 100f;
                        onSlotMutated.run();
                    }
                });
                mixCtl.setOnValueChanged(val -> {
                    slot.wetDry = val / 100f;
                    onSlotMutated.run();
                });
            }

            // Secondary processor parameters, laid out two per row so the
            // dense Pro cards stay readable on narrow phones. The legacy
            // stages only surface their own extra knobs; their primary dial
            // stays above.
            java.util.List<View> secondaryViews = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            AudioProcessor meta = FxRackChain.getPrototypeProcessor(slot.type.id);
            if (meta != null) {
                for (FxParameter param : meta.getParameters()) {
                    if (isPrimaryFxParam(slot.type, param.id)) continue;
                    // The warmth and presence cards share one tone processor;
                    // each card only edits its own corner frequency.
                    if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY
                            && "presence_freq".equals(param.id)) continue;
                    if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE
                            && "warmth_freq".equals(param.id)) continue;
                    // Curve editors own these params: graphic bands and
                    // filter-curve nodes are dragged on the canvas instead.
                    if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.GRAPHIC_EQ
                            && param.id.matches("g\\d+")) continue;
                    if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.FILTER_CURVE_EQ
                            && (param.id.startsWith("pf")
                                    || param.id.startsWith("pg")
                                    || "npts".equals(param.id))) continue;
                    if (param.type == FxParameter.Type.BOOLEAN) {
                        TextView b = makeFxChip(ctx, param.name, density);
                        final int rawBool = slot.extraParams.containsKey(
                                param.id)
                                ? slot.extraParams.get(param.id)
                                : param.defaultRaw;
                        final boolean on = rawBool != 0;
                        b.setText(param.name + ": "
                                + (on ? "On" : "Off"));
                        b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                            boolean nextOn = !on;
                            slot.extraParams.put(param.id, nextOn ? 1 : 0);
                            if (nextOn && slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.BASS_TREBLE
                                    && "link".equals(param.id)) {
                                slot.extraParams.put("treble", slot.value);
                            }
                            if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
                            onSlotMutated.run();
                            rebuildFxRackList();
                        });
                        secondaryViews.add(b);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (param.type == FxParameter.Type.ENUM
                            && param.enumLabels != null
                            && param.enumLabels.length > 0) {
                        TextView eChip = makeFxChip(ctx, param.name, density);
                        final int curIdx = param.clampRaw(
                                slot.extraParams.containsKey(param.id)
                                        ? slot.extraParams.get(param.id)
                                        : param.defaultRaw);
                        eChip.setText(param.name + ": "
                                + param.getEnumLabel(curIdx));
                        eChip.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                            int nextIdx = (curIdx + 1) % param.enumLabels.length;
                            slot.extraParams.put(param.id, nextIdx);
                            if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOTCH_FILTER
                                    && "preset".equals(param.id)) {
                                if (nextIdx == 1) slot.value = 50;
                                else if (nextIdx == 2) slot.value = 60;
                            }
                            if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
                            onSlotMutated.run();
                            rebuildFxRackList();
                        });
                        secondaryViews.add(eChip);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (param.type == FxParameter.Type.ACTION) {
                        TextView actChip = makeFxChip(ctx, param.name, density);
                        actChip.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                            int triggers = slot.extraParams.containsKey(param.id)
                                    ? slot.extraParams.get(param.id) + 1 : 1;
                            slot.extraParams.put(param.id, triggers);
                            if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
                            onSlotMutated.run();
                            rebuildFxRackList();
                        });
                        secondaryViews.add(actChip);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (param.type != FxParameter.Type.INT
                            && param.type != FxParameter.Type.FLOAT) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    TeleValue pc = new TeleValue(ctx);
                    pc.setCaption(param.name);
                    pc.setValueScale(Math.max(1, param.scaleDivisor));
                    pc.setValueFormatter(param::formatRaw);
                    pc.configure(param.minRaw, param.maxRaw,
                            param.interactionStepRaw(),
                            slot.extraParams.containsKey(param.id)
                                    ? slot.extraParams.get(param.id)
                                    : param.defaultRaw,
                            param.unit);
                    pc.setCompact(true);
                    extraControls.put(param.id, pc);
                    java.util.function.IntConsumer syncSecondaryLinks = (int value) -> {
                        slot.extraParams.put(param.id, value);
                        if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.BASS_TREBLE
                                && "treble".equals(param.id)) {
                            Integer linkRaw = slot.extraParams.get("link");
                            if (linkRaw != null && linkRaw != 0) {
                                slot.value = value;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!slot.enabled && value != param.defaultRaw) {
                            slot.enabled = true;
                        }
                    };
                    pc.setOnScrubListener(new TeleValue.OnScrubListener() {
                        @Override
                        public void onScrubValueChanged(int value) {
                            syncSecondaryLinks.accept(value);
                            onSlotMutated.run();
                        }

                        @Override
                        public void onScrubFinished(int value) {
                            syncSecondaryLinks.accept(value);
                            onSlotMutated.run();
                        }
                    });
                    pc.setOnValueChanged(val -> {
                        syncSecondaryLinks.accept(val);
                        onSlotMutated.run();
                    });
                    secondaryViews.add(pc);
                }
            }
            if (hasEqView && !secondaryViews.isEmpty()) {
                // The curve canvas is the primary EQ editor; its numeric
                // frequency/gain/Q parameters stay one tap away instead of
                // forming a wall of steppers under the graph.
                final android.widget.LinearLayout advancedBox =
                        new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
                advancedBox.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                final boolean advancedOpen = fxAdvancedOpen.contains(slot);
                advancedBox.setVisibility(advancedOpen
                        ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                addFxExtraGrid(advancedBox, secondaryViews, density);

                final TextView advancedToggle = makeFxChip(ctx,
                        advancedOpen ? "Hide advanced controls"
                                : "Show advanced controls ("
                                        + secondaryViews.size() + ")",
                        density);
                android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams advLp =
                        new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                advLp.topMargin = Math.round(6 * density);
                body.addView(advancedToggle, advLp);
                body.addView(advancedBox);
                advancedToggle.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    boolean show = advancedBox.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE;
                    advancedBox.setVisibility(show ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                    if (show) {
                        fxAdvancedOpen.add(slot);
                    } else {
                        fxAdvancedOpen.remove(slot);
                    }
                    advancedToggle.setText(show
                            ? "Hide advanced controls"
                            : "Show advanced controls (" + secondaryViews.size() + ")");
                });
            } else {
                addFxExtraGrid(body, secondaryViews, density);
            }

            fxListContainer.addView(pill, pillLp);
        }

        // Bottom action row: split horizontally into "+ Add Effect" and "Delete All"
        android.widget.LinearLayout bottomActionRow =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        bottomActionRow.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        bottomActionRow.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams actionRowLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        actionRowLp.topMargin = Math.round(8 * density);

        int addPad = Math.round(10 * density);
        TextView addBtn = new TextView(ctx);
        addBtn.setText("+ Add Effect");
        addBtn.setTextSize(12.5f);
        addBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
        addBtn.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        addBtn.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        addBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);
        addBtn.setPadding(addPad, addPad, addPad, addPad);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams addLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
        addLp.rightMargin = Math.round(4 * density);
        PressAnim.applySoft(addBtn, 0.96f);
        addBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> showAddEffectSearchDialog());
        bottomActionRow.addView(addBtn, addLp);

        TextView deleteAllBtn = new TextView(ctx);
        deleteAllBtn.setText("Delete All");
        deleteAllBtn.setTextSize(12.5f);
        deleteAllBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
        deleteAllBtn.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        boolean hasAnySlots = !dspConfig.slots.isEmpty();
        deleteAllBtn.setTextColor(hasAnySlots ? 0xFFFF453A : 0xFF5D6672);
        deleteAllBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_danger);
        deleteAllBtn.setPadding(addPad, addPad, addPad, addPad);
        deleteAllBtn.setEnabled(hasAnySlots);
        deleteAllBtn.setClickable(hasAnySlots);
        deleteAllBtn.setAlpha(hasAnySlots ? 1f : 0.4f);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams delAllLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
        delAllLp.leftMargin = Math.round(4 * density);
        PressAnim.applySoft(deleteAllBtn, 0.96f);
        deleteAllBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (dspConfig == null || dspConfig.slots.isEmpty()) return;
            OptionsSheet.showConfirm(requireContext(),
                    "Delete all effects?",
                    "Remove all currently added effects from the rack?",
                    "Delete All",
                    R.drawable.ic_trash,
                    true,
                    () -> {
                        if (!isAdded() || dspConfig == null) return;
                        if (dspSubRangeBaked) lastEditWasSubRangeBake = true;
                        dspBakedToRaw = false;
                        dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                        fxAdvancedOpen.clear();
                        dspConfig.clearRack();
                        dspConfig.save(requireContext());
                        if (livePreviewDsp != null) {
                            livePreviewDsp.updateConfig(dspConfig);
                        }
                        refreshFxPreviewPeaks();
                        rebuildFxRackList();
                        paintEditorStrip();
                        paintFxPanelControls();
                    });
        });
        bottomActionRow.addView(deleteAllBtn, delAllLp);
        fxListContainer.addView(bottomActionRow, actionRowLp);
    }

    /**
     * Lays extra FX parameters out in two compact columns. Two-per-row cuts
     * the vertical run of a Pro card roughly in half on a phone, while a lone
     * control (or an odd tail) still gets the full width.
     */
    private void addFxExtraGrid(android.widget.LinearLayout body,
                                java.util.List&lt;View&gt; views, float density) {
        if (body == null || views == null || views.isEmpty()) return;
        Context ctx = requireContext();
        int gap = Math.round(5 * density);
        for (int i = 0; i < views.size(); i += 2) {
            android.widget.LinearLayout row = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
            row.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            boolean pair = i + 1 < views.size();
            android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp =
                    new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
            row.addView(views.get(i), lp);
            if (pair) {
                android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams rp =
                        new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                                0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
                rp.leftMargin = gap;
                row.addView(views.get(i + 1), rp);
            }
            android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams rowLp =
                    new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rowLp.topMargin = Math.round(4 * density);
            body.addView(row, rowLp);
        }
    }

    /** Dropdown menu of premade presets (templates of effects and their settings). */
    private int fxPresetIcon(DspChain.Preset p) {
        switch (p) {
            case VOICE_POLISH: return R.drawable.ic_mic;
            case PODCAST_BROADCAST: return R.drawable.ic_sliders;
            case WARM_VOCAL: return R.drawable.ic_heart;
            case CRISP_CLARITY: return R.drawable.ic_star;
            case CLEAR_ALL: return R.drawable.ic_close;
            default: return R.drawable.ic_edit_fx;
        }
    }

    private void showFxPresetsMenu() {
        if (!isAdded()) return;
        DspChain.Preset[] presets = {
                DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH,
                DspChain.Preset.PODCAST_BROADCAST,
                DspChain.Preset.NOISY_ROOM,
                DspChain.Preset.WARM_VOCAL,
                DspChain.Preset.CRISP_CLARITY,
                DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL
        };
        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (DspChain.Preset p : presets) {
            final DspChain.Preset pick = p;
            boolean checked = p.id.equals(dspConfig.activePresetId);
            items.add(new OptionsSheet.Item(fxPresetIcon(p),
                    p.title, false, checked, () -> {
                if (!isAdded() || dspConfig == null) return;
                if (dspSubRangeBaked) lastEditWasSubRangeBake = true;
                dspBakedToRaw = false;
                dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                dspConfig.applyPreset(pick);
                dspConfig.save(requireContext());
                if (livePreviewDsp != null) {
                    livePreviewDsp.updateConfig(dspConfig);
                }
                refreshFxPreviewPeaks();
                rebuildFxRackList();
                paintFxPanelControls();
                paintEditorStrip();
            }));
        }
        OptionsSheet.showOptions(requireContext(),
                "FX Presets",
                "Premade effect chains & settings",
                items);
    }

    /** Searchable menu of available effects opened by "+ Add Effect". */
    private void showAddEffectSearchDialog() {
        if (!isAdded()) return;
        Context ctx = requireContext();
        android.app.Dialog d = new android.app.Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        d.requestWindowFeature(android.view.Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        int pad = Math.round(18 * density);
        android.widget.LinearLayout root = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        root.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(ctx);
        title.setText("Add Effect");
        title.setTextSize(17f);
        title.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        title.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        title.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
        root.addView(title);

        android.widget.EditText searchBox = new android.widget.EditText(ctx);
        searchBox.setHint("Search effects (e.g. noise, de-ess, warm)...");
        searchBox.setHintTextColor(0xFF5D6672);
        searchBox.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        searchBox.setTextSize(13.5f);
        searchBox.setSingleLine(true);
        searchBox.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
        int sPad = Math.round(10 * density);
        searchBox.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams sLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        sLp.topMargin = Math.round(10 * density);
        root.addView(searchBox, sLp);

        android.widget.ScrollView listScroll = new android.widget.ScrollView(ctx);
        android.widget.LinearLayout listCol = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        listCol.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        listScroll.addView(listCol);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams scLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        Math.round(240 * density));
        scLp.topMargin = Math.round(10 * density);
        root.addView(listScroll, scLp);

        // Category filter chips: the catalog now spans eight families, so a
        // search box alone is not enough to find an effect quickly.
        final FxCategory[] categories = {
                null, FxCategory.EQUALIZER, FxCategory.DYNAMICS,
                FxCategory.RESTORATION, FxCategory.SPATIAL, FxCategory.TIME,
                FxCategory.CREATIVE, FxCategory.TOOLS, FxCategory.ANALYZER};
        final String[] categoryLabels = {
                "All", "EQ & Filters", "Dynamics", "Restoration",
                "Spatial", "Pitch & Time", "Creative", "Tools", "Analyzers"};
        final FxCategory[] selected = {null};
        final android.widget.HorizontalScrollView chipScroll =
                new android.widget.HorizontalScrollView(ctx);
        chipScroll.setHorizontalScrollBarEnabled(false);
        android.widget.LinearLayout chipRow =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        chipRow.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        chipScroll.addView(chipRow);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams chipLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        chipLp.topMargin = Math.round(8 * density);
        root.addView(chipScroll, chipLp);
        final android.widget.TextView[] chipViews =
                new android.widget.TextView[categories.length];

        Runnable populateList = () -> {
            String q = searchBox.getText().toString().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            FxCategory filter = selected[0];
            listCol.removeAllViews();
            // The catalog is listed alphabetically so a long effect list stays
            // navigable.
            java.util.List<DspChain.EffectType> catalog =
                    new java.util.ArrayList<>(java.util.Arrays.asList(
                            DspChain.EffectType.values()));
            java.util.Collections.sort(catalog,
                    new java.util.Comparator<DspChain.EffectType>() {
                        @Override
                        public int compare(DspChain.EffectType a,
                                           DspChain.EffectType b) {
                            return a.title.compareToIgnoreCase(b.title);
                        }
                    });
            for (DspChain.EffectType t : catalog) {
                if (filter != null
                        && DspChain.categoryOf(t) != filter) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (!q.isEmpty()
                        && !t.title.toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(q)
                        && !t.description.toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(q)) {
                    continue;
                }
                android.widget.LinearLayout row = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
                row.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
                row.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
                android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams rLp =
                        new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                rLp.topMargin = Math.round(6 * density);

                TextView rTitle = new TextView(ctx);
                rTitle.setText(t.title);
                rTitle.setTextSize(13.5f);
                rTitle.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
                rTitle.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                        "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));

                TextView rSub = new TextView(ctx);
                rSub.setText(t.description);
                rSub.setTextSize(11f);
                rSub.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);

                row.addView(rTitle);
                row.addView(rSub);
                PressAnim.applySoft(row, 0.97f);
                row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    if (!isAdded() || dspConfig == null) return;
                    if (dspSubRangeBaked) lastEditWasSubRangeBake = true;
                    dspBakedToRaw = false;
                    dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                    dspConfig.addOrFocusSlot(t);
                    dspConfig.save(ctx);
                    if (livePreviewDsp != null) {
                        livePreviewDsp.updateConfig(dspConfig);
                    }
                    refreshFxPreviewPeaks();
                    rebuildFxRackList();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    d.dismiss();
                });
                listCol.addView(row, rLp);
            }
        };

        for (int i = 0; i < categories.length; i++) {
            final int index = i;
            TextView chip = makeFxChip(ctx, categoryLabels[i], density);
            chipViews[i] = chip;
            android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams clp =
                    new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            clp.rightMargin = Math.round(5 * density);
            chipRow.addView(chip, clp);
            chip.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                selected[0] = categories[index];
                for (int k = 0; k < chipViews.length; k++) {
                    boolean on = k == index;
                    chipViews[k].setTextColor(on ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF);
                    chipViews[k].setBackgroundResource(on
                            ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                            : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
                }
                populateList.run();
            });
        }
        // "All" starts selected.
        chipViews[0].setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        chipViews[0].setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected);
        populateList.run();

        searchBox.addTextChangedListener(new android.text.TextWatcher() {
            @Override public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int c, int a) {}
            @Override public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int b, int c) {
                populateList.run();
            }
            @Override public void afterTextChanged(android.text.Editable s) {}
        });

        TextView cancelBtn = new TextView(ctx);
        cancelBtn.setText(R.string.cancel);
        cancelBtn.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        cancelBtn.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        cancelBtn.setTextSize(13.5f);
        cancelBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);
        cancelBtn.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
        cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> d.dismiss());
        root.addView(cancelBtn, sLp);

        d.setContentView(root);
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(d);
        d.show();
    }


    /**
     * Applies enabled effects from the FX rack to the selected audio region
     * when a selection is active, or to the entire take when no region is
     * selected. Works identically on both the normal recording and the
     * Select & Replace sub-editor recording.
     */
    private boolean commitDspFx() {
        if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return false;
        if (replaceModeArmed) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Disable Replace mode before applying effects",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        stopStudioPreview();
        if (dspConfig == null) return false;
        dspConfig.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        if (!dspConfig.isActive()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Enable at least one effect (checkmark) first",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        // Apply works on the selection when there is one and on the WHOLE TAKE
        // otherwise — the old forced "enable selection first" return aborted
        // silently and made the full-take branch below unreachable.
        if (waveform == null) return false;
        // In effects mode the target is the region that was selected before
        // the rack opened, so re-selecting a range (to learn a noise profile,
        // say) cannot silently change what Stop commits to.
        boolean hadSel = fxPanelOpen
                ? fxApplyTargetHasSelection
                : waveform.hasSelection();
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) return false;
        if (!hadSel && dspBakedToRaw && !dspSubRangeBaked) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Effects already applied to entire take (tap Undo or adjust a parameter first)",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        boolean peaksPushed = false;
        try {
            // Config.isActive() can disagree with the processor chain (e.g. a
            // Stage 3 slot whose parameters are neutral); probe the real chain
            // BEFORE any undo bookkeeping so an inaudible rack never pushes a
            // waveform peak snapshot without a matching audio snapshot.
            try {
                FormatConverter.WavInfo preInfo =
                        FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                DspChain probeChain = new DspChain(preInfo.channels, dspConfig);
                if (!probeChain.isActive()) {
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                            "Adjust an effect parameter away from 0 dB first",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return false;
            }
            EditEngine.UndoJournal uj = activeUndoJournal();
            // If a sub-selection was just baked with this exact rack — even if
            // a knob tweak has since cleared dspSubRangeBaked — restore the
            // pre-sub-bake snapshot first so the selected region is not baked
            // twice!
            if (!hadSel && (dspSubRangeBaked || lastEditWasSubRangeBake)
                    && uj != null && uj.canUndo()) {
                if (uj.undo(raw)) {
                    waveform.popUndoPeaks();
                    engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                    dspBakedToRaw = false;
                    dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                    lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
                }
            }
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
            long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, info.channels);
            if (totalFrames <= 0) return false;
            long start = 0L;
            long end = totalFrames;
            if (hadSel) {
                float startFrac = fxPanelOpen
                        ? fxApplyTargetStart
                        : waveform.selectionStartFraction();
                float endFrac = fxPanelOpen
                        ? fxApplyTargetEnd
                        : waveform.selectionEndFraction();
                start = Math.round(startFrac * totalFrames);
                end = Math.round(endFrac * totalFrames);
                if (end <= start) {
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                            "Select a valid audio region first",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    return false;
                }
            }
            // The file is about to change: stop the live region render and
            // drop its dry baseline so the reloaded bars become the new truth.
            fxPreviewGeneration++;
            handler.removeCallbacks(fxPreviewRefresh);
            waveform.clearFxRegionPeaks();
            waveform.recordUndoPeaks();
            peaksPushed = true;
            DspChain chain = new DspChain(info.channels, dspConfig);
            // Duration-changing tools (Change Tempo, Change Speed, Repeat,
            // Truncate Silence, ...) render the region offline and rewrite the
            // file, so they take a different path than the in-place chain.
            // They run first; the in-place chain then processes whatever
            // region came out of them.
            java.util.List&lt;AudioProcessor&gt; offline =
                    chain.offlineProcessors();
            if (!offline.isEmpty()) {
                long regionEnd = end;
                boolean firstOffline = true;
                for (AudioProcessor proc : offline) {
                    FormatConverter.WavInfo curInfo = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                    long curTotalBefore = curInfo.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, curInfo.channels);
                    long newTotal = EditEngine.applyLengthChangingEffectToRange(
                            raw, start, regionEnd, proc, firstOffline ? uj : null);
                    if (newTotal < 0) {
                        if (firstOffline) {
                            waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                        } else if (uj != null && uj.canUndo()) {
                            uj.undo(raw);
                            waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                        }
                        peaksPushed = false;
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                "This effect could not be applied here",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        return false;
                    }
                    firstOffline = false;
                    regionEnd = start + (newTotal - (curTotalBefore - regionEnd));
                }
                // The offline pass rewrote the region: run the remaining
                // in-place processors over the new boundaries.
                if (chain.hasInPlaceProcessors()) {
                    DspChain inPlace = new DspChain(info.channels, dspConfig);
                    inPlace.clearOfflineProcessors();
                    EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, start, regionEnd, inPlace, null);
                }
                engine.abortStreaming();
                engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                long newTotalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long nextCursor = Math.min(newTotalFrames, Math.max(0L, regionEnd));
                engine.seekCursorFrame(nextCursor);
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = hadSel;
                lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
                waveform.reloadFullFromWavSync(raw);
                waveform.syncFramesPerBar(newTotalFrames);
                if (newTotalFrames > 0) {
                    waveform.setPlayheadFraction(
                            nextCursor / (float) newTotalFrames);
                }
                refreshZoomValue();
                if (timerText != null) {
                    timerText.setText(formatTimer(engine.cursorMs()));
                }
                resetFxRackAfterApply();
                waveform.clearSelection();
                syncFxBakeRequired();
                OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Effects applied");
                paint();
                paintFxPanelControls();
                return true;
            }
            boolean snapshotRecorded =
                    EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, start, end, chain, uj);
            if (!snapshotRecorded) {
                waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                peaksPushed = false;
            }
            lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
            // The raw now carries the chain for the applied range: the
            // incremental pump must not keep encoding unprocessed audio, and
            // neither preview nor save may process these samples a second time.
            engine.abortStreaming();
            engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
            if (!hadSel) {
                // Whole take baked: mark it so preview (livePreviewDsp) and
                // save never process these samples a second time.
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                waveform.reloadSelectionPeaksFromWav(raw, 0f, 1f);
            } else {
                waveform.reloadSelectionPeaksFromWav(raw,
                        fxPanelOpen ? fxApplyTargetStart
                                : waveform.selectionStartFraction(),
                        fxPanelOpen ? fxApplyTargetEnd
                                : waveform.selectionEndFraction());
                // Only the selected region was baked. The raw file now carries
                // that bake, so preview/save must not process it again even
                // though the rest of the take remains dry.
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = true;
            }
            // Apply is the single commit point: the raw file and waveform now
            // carry the processed audio, so start a fresh, blank rack. Keeping
            // the old slots enabled would leave the UI implying the effects
            // are still pending and invite a second bake.
            resetFxRackAfterApply();
            syncFxBakeRequired();
            waveform.clearSelection();
            OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Effects applied");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            if (peaksPushed && waveform != null) waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "FX failed",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        paint();
        paintFxPanelControls();
        return true;
    }

    /** Preserves the user's FX rack after a bake while marking the audio committed. */
    private void resetFxRackAfterApply() {
        if (dspConfig == null) return;
        try {
            dspConfig.save(requireContext());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (livePreviewDsp != null) {
            livePreviewDsp.updateConfig(dspConfig);
        }
        refreshFxPreviewPeaks();
        rebuildFxRackList();
    }

    private void paint() {
        if (getView() == null || !isAdded()) return;
        syncFxBakeRequired();
        // A capture paused outside the studio (call, notification, mic
        // disconnect) must park the prompter too — and a resume must
        // release it — even though no studio button was involved.
        if (lastPaintedState == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                && engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            setTelePaused(true);
        } else if (lastPaintedState == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED
                && engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            setTelePaused(false);
        }
        lastPaintedState = engine.state;
        lastPaintedName = String.valueOf(displayName());
        boolean hasSession = engine.hasSession();
        boolean rec = engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        boolean paused = engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;

        String name = displayName();
        if (name != null) {
            statusText.setText(name);
            takeNameView.setText(name);
        } else {
            statusText.setText(R.string.studio_ready);
            takeNameView.setText(nextTakeName());
        }

        stateLabel.setText(!hasSession ? getString(R.string.studio_ready)
                : rec ? getString(R.string.studio_recording)
                : paused ? getString(R.string.studio_paused)
                : getString(R.string.studio_ready));
        statusText.setAlpha(name != null ? 1f : 0.7f);

        if (!hasSession) {
            hintText.setText(name != null
                    ? getString(R.string.studio_tap_to_start)
                    : getString(R.string.studio_hint));
        } else if (rec) {
            hintText.setText(R.string.studio_recording_hint);
        } else if (paused) {
            hintText.setText(R.string.studio_paused_hint);
        } else {
            hintText.setText(editSourceId != -1
                    ? getString(R.string.studio_tap_to_start)
                    : getString(R.string.studio_recovered));
        }

        // Unfinalised indicator: the pending marker means raw 32-bit float
        // bytes are streamed but the take is not finalised yet.
        boolean unfin = hasSession && isUnfinalised();
        draftBadge.setVisibility(unfin ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

        formatBadge.setText(preset.shortLabel + " → "
                + TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, saveFormat));
        settingsName.setText(preset.titleRes);
        settingsSub.setText(preset.shortLabel + " → "
                + TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, saveFormat));
        settingsRow.setAlpha(saving ? 0.45f : 1f);
        setTeleActive(telePanel.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE);

        statusDot.setBackgroundResource(rec ? R.drawable.dot_live : R.drawable.bg_round_btn);
        if (rec) startDotPulse(); else stopDotPulse();
        statusDot.setAlpha(rec ? 1f : 0.35f);
        paintEditorStrip();

        syncStudioFabIcon();
    }

    private boolean isUnfinalised() {
        try {
            File raw = engine.rawFile;
            if (raw == null) return false;
            return new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void startDotPulse() {
        stopDotPulse();
        statusDot.setAlpha(1f);
        dotPulse = ObjectAnimator.ofFloat(statusDot, View.ALPHA, 1f, 0.25f);
        dotPulse.setDuration(700);
        dotPulse.setRepeatCount(ObjectAnimator.INFINITE);
        dotPulse.setRepeatMode(ObjectAnimator.REVERSE);
        dotPulse.start();
    }

    private void stopDotPulse() {
        if (dotPulse != null) {
            dotPulse.cancel();
            dotPulse = null;
        }
    }

    // ---- files ----

    private String nextTakeName() {
        // A take still converting is not in the repository yet, so counting
        // rows alone handed the next recording the same "Take N" as the one
        // already encoding. Count those and never reuse a live title.
        List&lt;Take&gt; existing = TakesRepository.all();
        List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; converting = ConversionJobs.active();
        int n = existing.size() + converting.size() + 1;
        while (true) {
            String candidate = "Take " + n;
            boolean taken = false;
            for (Take t : existing) {
                if (candidate.equalsIgnoreCase(t.title)) { taken = true; break; }
            }
            if (!taken) {
                for (ConversionJob j : converting) {
                    if (candidate.equalsIgnoreCase(j.title)) { taken = true; break; }
                }
            }
            if (!taken) return candidate;
            n++;
        }
    }

    private static String prettyBase(File f) {
        return f.getName().replaceFirst("\\.[^.]+$", "").replace('_', ' ');
    }

    /** Centisecond timer (one more decimal place than before). */
    static String formatTimer(long ms) {
        return TimeFmt.formatTimer(ms);
    }

    private MainActivity activity() {
        return (MainActivity) requireActivity();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import com.android.billingclient.api.AcknowledgePurchaseParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingClient;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingClientStateListener;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingFlowParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingResult;
import com.android.billingclient.api.ProductDetails;
import com.android.billingclient.api.Purchase;
import com.android.billingclient.api.PurchasesUpdatedListener;
import com.android.billingclient.api.QueryProductDetailsParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.QueryPurchasesParams;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * Manages TakeOne's one-recording free allowance and Google Play Billing v7
 * entitlements (Monthly subscription {@link #SKU_MONTHLY} and One-Time Lifetime
 * purchase {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}, either of which unlocks all features).
 *
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;No time-based free trial:&lt;/b&gt; All features (Replace, Select,
 *       Select & Replace, Trim, 53-Effect DSP Rack, Undo/Redo, Recording
 *       Settings, Waveform Zoom, Teleprompter) are unlocked during the user's
 *       first recording.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Subsequent recordings:&lt;/b&gt; Everything except the Teleprompter is
 *       blocked on subsequent recordings and opens the Google Play Billing
 *       paywall when pressed.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Dynamic region-dependent pricing (no fallbacks):&lt;/b&gt; Formatted
 *       localized prices are fetched directly from Google Play's
 *       {@link ProductDetails}. Missing product details or pricing throw
 *       {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly without hardcoded fallback
 *       strings.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 */
public final class TrialAndBillingManager implements PurchasesUpdatedListener {

    // Google Play Console Product IDs
    /** Monthly recurring subscription (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS). */
    public static final String SKU_MONTHLY  = "takeone_pro_monthly";
    /** One-time lifetime unlock purchase (BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP). */
    public static final String SKU_LIFETIME = "takeone_pro_lifetime";

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED = "free_recording_used";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PRO        = "entitled_pro_active";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN       = "entitled_pro_plan";

    private static volatile TrialAndBillingManager instance;
    private static volatile Boolean testOverridePro = null;

    private final Context appCtx;
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private BillingClient billingClient;
    private final Map<String, ProductDetails> productCache = new HashMap<>();
    private Runnable onEntitlementChanged;

    private TrialAndBillingManager(Context ctx) {
        this.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public static TrialAndBillingManager get(Context ctx) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = instance;
        if (mgr == null) {
            synchronized (TrialAndBillingManager.class) {
                mgr = instance;
                if (mgr == null) {
                    mgr = new TrialAndBillingManager(ctx);
                    instance = mgr;
                }
            }
        }
        return mgr;
    }

    /** For unit/instrumentation tests to bypass or exercise the paywall. */
    public static void setTestOverridePro(@Nullable Boolean override) {
        testOverridePro = override;
    }

    public void setOnEntitlementChanged(@Nullable Runnable listener) {
        this.onEntitlementChanged = listener;
    }

    /**
     * True when the user has an active Monthly subscription or One-Time
     * Lifetime purchase.
     */
    public boolean isPaidPro() {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        return p.getBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, false);
    }

    /**
     * True once the user has completed/saved their first free recording (or if
     * a saved/converting recording already exists in the Library).
     */
    public boolean isFreeRecordingUsed() {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        if (p.getBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, false)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!TakesRepository.all().isEmpty() || !ConversionJobs.active().isEmpty()) {
            p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true).apply();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Marks the one free full-feature recording as consumed once the first
     * recording is saved.
     */
    public void markFreeRecordingUsed() {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        if (!p.getBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, false)) {
            p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true).apply();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Master entitlement check: returns true if the user has purchased Monthly
     * or One-Time Pro OR is still on their first recording (or running under
     * automated unit/instrumentation tests when {@code testOverridePro} is not
     * set).
     */
    public boolean hasProAccess() {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        if (isRunningUnderUnitTest()) return true;
        return isPaidPro() || !isFreeRecordingUsed();
    }

    /** Compact status label for the Studio/Library badge. */
    public String statusBadgeText() {
        if (isPaidPro()) return "PRO STUDIO";
        if (!isFreeRecordingUsed()) return "FIRST RECORDING • ALL FEATURES";
        return "FREE TIER • UPGRADE";
    }

    private static boolean isRunningUnderUnitTest() {
        try {
            Class.forName("org.robolectric.Robolectric");
            return true;
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException ignored) {}
        try {
            Class<?> reg = Class.forName(
                    "androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry");
            Object instr = reg.getMethod("getInstrumentation").invoke(null);
            if (instr != null) return true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Gate helper for Studio features (Replace, Select, Select & Replace,
     * Trim, Effects, Undo, Redo, Recording Settings, Waveform Zoom).
     * Runs {@code onAllowed} immediately if entitled (Paid Pro or first
     * recording), or opens the Google Play Billing paywall when locked on
     * subsequent recordings.
     */
    public static boolean requireProOrShowPaywall(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                                  @NonNull String featureName,
                                                  @Nullable Runnable onAllowed) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = get(activity);
        if (mgr.hasProAccess()) {
            if (onAllowed != null) onAllowed.run();
            return true;
        }
        mgr.showPaywallSheet(activity, featureName);
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the region-dependent formatted price directly from Google Play's
     * {@link ProductDetails}. Never uses fallback strings; throws
     * {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if product details or Google Play
     * pricing phases are unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public static String requireDynamicPrice(@Nullable ProductDetails pd,
                                             @NonNull String sku) {
        if (pd == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Google Play ProductDetails not loaded for " + sku);
        }
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                    pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
            if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "No subscription offers from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
                if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) continue;
                List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                        offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
                if (phases == null || phases.isEmpty()) continue;
                for (int i = phases.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    ProductDetails.PricingPhase phase = phases.get(i);
                    if (phase != null && phase.getPriceAmountMicros() > 0L) {
                        String formatted = phase.getFormattedPrice();
                        if (formatted != null && !formatted.trim().isEmpty()) {
                            return formatted.trim();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No paid subscription pricing phase from Google Play for " + sku);
        }
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            ProductDetails.OneTimePurchaseOfferDetails offer =
                    pd.getOneTimePurchaseOfferDetails();
            if (offer == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "No one-time purchase offer from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            String formatted = offer.getFormattedPrice();
            if (formatted == null || formatted.trim().isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Empty one-time formatted price from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            return formatted.trim();
        }
        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Unsupported Google Play product type for " + sku + ": " + pd.getProductType());
    }

    /**
     * Returns the dynamically fetched region-dependent price for {@code sku}
     * from the Google Play product cache, or throws {@link IllegalStateException}
     * cleanly if unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public String getDynamicPriceOrThrow(@NonNull String sku) {
        ProductDetails pd;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            pd = productCache.get(sku);
        }
        return requireDynamicPrice(pd, sku);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the base subscription offer token (no free trial) from Google
     * Play {@link ProductDetails}, or throws {@link IllegalStateException}
     * cleanly if unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public static String requireSubscriptionOfferToken(@NonNull ProductDetails pd) {
        List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
        if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No subscription offer token available from Google Play for "
                            + pd.getProductId());
        }
        for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
            if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) continue;
            List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                    offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
            if (phases != null && phases.size() == 1
                    && phases.get(0).getPriceAmountMicros() > 0L
                    && offer.getOfferToken() != null
                    && !offer.getOfferToken().isEmpty()) {
                return offer.getOfferToken();
            }
        }
        String token = offers.get(0).getOfferToken();
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Empty subscription offer token from Google Play for "
                            + pd.getProductId());
        }
        return token;
    }

    /**
     * Renders the paywall sheet using strictly dynamic region-dependent prices
     * fetched from Google Play ({@link #SKU_MONTHLY} and {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}).
     * Throws {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if either product or its
     * localized Google Play price is missing.
     */
    public void renderPaywallSheetOrThrow(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                          @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        String monthlyPrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
        String lifetimePrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);

        String subtitle = (lockedFeature != null && !lockedFeature.isEmpty())
                ? "Your 1 free full-feature recording has been used. Unlock "
                        + lockedFeature + " and all Studio tools on every recording:"
                : "Your 1 free full-feature recording has been used. Choose Monthly or One-Time Purchase to unlock everything:";

        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_check,
                "One-Time Purchase — " + lifetimePrice,
                "Pay once • Unlocks all Studio features forever",
                true,
                () -> launchPurchase(activity, SKU_LIFETIME)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_sliders,
                "Monthly — " + monthlyPrice + "/month",
                "Billed monthly via Google Play • Unlocks all features",
                false,
                () -> launchPurchase(activity, SKU_MONTHLY)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_undo,
                "Restore existing purchase",
                this::refreshPurchasesAsync));

        OptionsSheet.showOptions(activity, "Unlock TakeOne Pro", subtitle, items);
    }

    /**
     * Opens the paywall when the user presses any locked feature on subsequent
     * recordings. Fetches dynamic region-dependent pricing from Google Play if
     * not yet cached, and fails cleanly (without fallback prices) if Google Play
     * pricing is unavailable.
     */
    public void showPaywallSheet(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                 @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        boolean hasBothCached;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            hasBothCached = productCache.containsKey(SKU_MONTHLY)
                    && productCache.containsKey(SKU_LIFETIME);
        }
        if (hasBothCached) {
            try {
                renderPaywallSheetOrThrow(activity, lockedFeature);
            } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(appCtx, "paywall price error: " + ex.getMessage());
                OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false, "Billing unavailable",
                        ex.getMessage());
            }
            return;
        }
        fetchDynamicPricesFromPlay(
                () -> mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                    try {
                        renderPaywallSheetOrThrow(activity, lockedFeature);
                    } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
                        CrashLog.breadcrumb(appCtx,
                                "paywall dynamic price error: " + ex.getMessage());
                        OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false,
                                "Billing unavailable", ex.getMessage());
                    }
                }),
                err -> mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                    CrashLog.breadcrumb(appCtx,
                            "paywall fetch failed: " + err.getMessage());
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false,
                            "Billing unavailable", err.getMessage());
                }));
    }

    // ---- Google Play Billing Client lifecycle ----

    public synchronized void connectAndSync() {
        if (isRunningUnderUnitTest()) return;
        if (billingClient == null) {
            billingClient = BillingClient.newBuilder(appCtx)
                    .setListener(this)
                    .enablePendingPurchases()
                    .build();
        }
        if (billingClient.isReady()) {
            queryProducts(null, null);
            refreshPurchasesAsync();
            return;
        }
        billingClient.startConnection(new BillingClientStateListener() {
            @Override
            public void onBillingSetupFinished(@NonNull BillingResult result) {
                if (result.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                    queryProducts(null, null);
                    refreshPurchasesAsync();
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onBillingServiceDisconnected() {
                // Cached SharedPreferences entitlement keeps working offline.
            }
        });
    }

    private interface ErrorCallback {
        void onError(@NonNull IllegalStateException error);
    }

    private synchronized void fetchDynamicPricesFromPlay(
            @Nullable Runnable onComplete,
            @Nullable ErrorCallback onError) {
        if (billingClient == null) {
            billingClient = BillingClient.newBuilder(appCtx)
                    .setListener(this)
                    .enablePendingPurchases()
                    .build();
        }
        if (billingClient.isReady()) {
            queryProducts(onComplete, onError);
            return;
        }
        billingClient.startConnection(new BillingClientStateListener() {
            @Override
            public void onBillingSetupFinished(@NonNull BillingResult result) {
                if (result.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                    queryProducts(onComplete, onError);
                    refreshPurchasesAsync();
                } else if (onError != null) {
                    onError.onError(new IllegalStateException(
                            "Google Play Billing setup failed (code "
                                    + result.getResponseCode() + ")"));
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onBillingServiceDisconnected() {
                if (onError != null) {
                    onError.onError(new IllegalStateException(
                            "Google Play Billing service disconnected"));
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void queryProducts(@Nullable Runnable onComplete,
                               @Nullable ErrorCallback onError) {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
            if (onError != null) {
                onError.onError(new IllegalStateException(
                        "Google Play BillingClient is not ready"));
            }
            return;
        }
        AtomicInteger remaining = new AtomicInteger(2);
        final Runnable finishOne = () -> {
            if (remaining.decrementAndGet() == 0) {
                try {
                    getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
                    getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);
                    if (onComplete != null) onComplete.run();
                } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
                    if (onError != null) onError.onError(ex);
                }
            }
        };

        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> subs = Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                        .setProductId(SKU_MONTHLY)
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                        .build());
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder().setProductList(subs).build(),
                (res, list) -> {
                    if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                            && list != null) {
                        synchronized (productCache) {
                            for (ProductDetails pd : list) {
                                productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    finishOne.run();
                });

        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> inapp = Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                        .setProductId(SKU_LIFETIME)
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP)
                        .build());
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder().setProductList(inapp).build(),
                (res, list) -> {
                    if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                            && list != null) {
                        synchronized (productCache) {
                            for (ProductDetails pd : list) {
                                productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    finishOne.run();
                });
    }

    public void refreshPurchasesAsync() {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) return;
        billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                        .build(),
                (res, subsList) -> {
                    boolean activeSub = res.getResponseCode()
                            == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                            && hasActivePurchase(subsList);
                    billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                            QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                                    .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP)
                                    .build(),
                            (res2, inappList) -> {
                                boolean activeLifetime = res2.getResponseCode()
                                        == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                                        && hasActivePurchase(inappList);
                                if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                                        && res2.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                                    String plan = activeLifetime ? SKU_LIFETIME
                                            : (activeSub ? SKU_MONTHLY : "");
                                    persistEntitlement(activeSub || activeLifetime, plan);
                                } else if (activeSub || activeLifetime) {
                                    String plan = activeLifetime ? SKU_LIFETIME : SKU_MONTHLY;
                                    persistEntitlement(true, plan);
                                }
                            });
                });
    }

    private boolean hasActivePurchase(@Nullable List<Purchase> purchases) {
        if (purchases == null) return false;
        boolean found = false;
        for (Purchase p : purchases) {
            if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                found = true;
                if (!p.isAcknowledged() && billingClient != null) {
                    AcknowledgePurchaseParams ack = AcknowledgePurchaseParams
                            .newBuilder()
                            .setPurchaseToken(p.getPurchaseToken())
                            .build();
                    billingClient.acknowledgePurchase(ack, r -> {});
                }
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    /**
     * Launches the Google Play Billing flow for {@code sku} ({@link #SKU_MONTHLY}
     * or {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}), or throws {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly
     * if {@link BillingClient} or {@link ProductDetails} is unavailable.
     */
    public void launchPurchaseOrThrow(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                      @NonNull String sku) {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Google Play BillingClient is not connected");
        }
        ProductDetails pd;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            pd = productCache.get(sku);
        }
        requireDynamicPrice(pd, sku);
        BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.Builder builder =
                BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                        .setProductDetails(pd);
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            builder.setOfferToken(requireSubscriptionOfferToken(pd));
        }
        BillingFlowParams flowParams = BillingFlowParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductDetailsParamsList(
                        Collections.singletonList(builder.build()))
                .build();
        BillingResult launchRes = billingClient.launchBillingFlow(activity, flowParams);
        if (launchRes.getResponseCode() != BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Google Play launchBillingFlow failed (code "
                            + launchRes.getResponseCode() + ")");
        }
    }

    public void launchPurchase(@NonNull Activity activity, @NonNull String sku) {
        try {
            launchPurchaseOrThrow(activity, sku);
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(appCtx, "launchPurchase failed: " + ex.getMessage());
            connectAndSync();
            OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false, "Billing unavailable",
                    ex.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onPurchasesUpdated(@NonNull BillingResult result,
                                   @Nullable List<Purchase> purchases) {
        if (result.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                && purchases != null) {
            if (hasActivePurchase(purchases)) {
                String plan = SKU_MONTHLY;
                for (Purchase p : purchases) {
                    if (p.getProducts().contains(SKU_LIFETIME)) {
                        plan = SKU_LIFETIME;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                persistEntitlement(true, plan);
            }
        }
    }

    private void persistEntitlement(boolean entitled, String plan) {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        boolean prev = p.getBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, false);
        p.edit()
                .putBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, entitled)
                .putString(KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN, plan != null ? plan : "")
                .apply();
        if (prev != entitled && onEntitlementChanged != null) {
            mainHandler.post(onEntitlementChanged);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Dialog;

/**
 * Centered modal dialogs (overlaying the current screen) replacing the old
 * bottom sheets. Sort options appear as distinct pills, rename is a centered
 * input modal, deletes ask for confirmation, and every success/failure gets
 * its own styled popup. All dialogs pop/scale in and out and cap their width
 * cleanly in landscape mode.
 */
public final class OptionsSheet {

    /** Maximum width in dp for standard centered dialogs (save/discard/confirm/etc.). */
    public static final int MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP = 380;
    /** Maximum width in dp for the 2-pane landscape Recording Settings dialog. */
    public static final int MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP = 620;

    private OptionsSheet() {}

    private static Dialog activeTopPopup;
    private static final Handler TOP_POPUP_HANDLER =
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    /**
     * Enforces at most two words on stylized top popup titles so banners
     * stay scannable at a glance.
     */
    static String compactTwoWords(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        String clean = text.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        String[] parts = clean.split(" ");
        if (parts.length <= 2) return clean;
        return parts[0] + " " + parts[1];
    }

    public static final class Item {
        public final int icon;
        public final String label;
        public final String sub;
        public final boolean destructive;
        public final boolean checked;
        public final Runnable action;

        public Item(int icon, String label, boolean destructive, boolean checked,
                    Runnable action) {
            this(icon, label, null, destructive, checked, action);
        }

        public Item(int icon, String label, String sub, boolean destructive,
                    boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            this.icon = icon;
            this.label = label;
            this.sub = sub;
            this.destructive = destructive;
            this.checked = checked;
            this.action = action;
        }

        public static Item of(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, false, false, action);
        }

        public static Item danger(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, true, false, action);
        }

        /** Two-line row: title + smaller spec line (presets, save formats). */
        public static Item detail(String label, String sub, boolean checked,
                                  Runnable action) {
            return new Item(0, label, sub, false, checked, action);
        }

        /** Two-line row with a leading icon. */
        public static Item detail(int icon, String label, String sub,
                                  boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, sub, false, checked, action);
        }
    }

    /** One save-format toggle chip inside the unified recording dialog. */
    public static final class Chip {
        public final String label;
        /** Approximate storage per minute, e.g. "17 MB/min". */
        public final String size;
        public final boolean checked;
        public final Runnable action;

        public Chip(String label, String size, boolean checked,
                    Runnable action) {
            this.label = label;
            this.size = size;
            this.checked = checked;
            this.action = action;
        }

        public static Chip of(String label, String size, boolean checked,
                              Runnable action) {
            return new Chip(label, size, checked, action);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Live state behind the unified recording dialog. Lists are re-queried

    public interface SettingsState {
        java.util.List&lt;Item&gt; presets();
        java.util.List&lt;Chip&gt; formats();
        String formatHint();
    }

    public interface SaveCallback {
