     * byte copy with a fresh 44-byte header — no float-to-int conversion and
     * no resampling. Extra RIFF chunks on an imported source are dropped so
     * the result has the same predictable geometry as the recording engine.
     */
    public static void toWav32(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4;
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        RandomAccessFile w = null;
        try {
            w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(info.channels, info.sampleRate,
                    info.dataBytes));
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(2048L, Math.min((long) CONV_CHUNK, totalSamples / 25L))
                    : CONV_CHUNK;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, info.channels);
            byte[] buf = new byte[chunk * 4];
            long done = 0;
            int lastPct = -1;
            while (done < totalSamples) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunk, totalSamples - done);
                r.readFully(buf, 0, want * 4);
                w.write(buf, 0, want * 4);
                done += want;
                if (cb != null) {
                    int pct = (int) (done * 100 / Math.max(1, totalSamples));
                    if (pct != lastPct) {
                        lastPct = pct;
                        cb.onProgress(pct);
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    /** 32-bit float WAV -> 16-bit PCM WAV. */
    public static void toWav16(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4;
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        RandomAccessFile w = null;
        try {
            w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(wav16Header(info.channels, info.sampleRate, 0));
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(2048L, Math.min((long) CONV_CHUNK, totalSamples / 25L))
                    : CONV_CHUNK;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, info.channels);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * 4];
            byte[] out = new byte[chunk * 2];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asShortBuffer();
            long done = 0;
            int lastPct = -1;
            while (done < totalSamples) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunk, totalSamples - done);
                r.readFully(in, 0, want * 4);
                toInt16(fb, want, sb);
                w.write(out, 0, want * 2);
                done += want;
                if (cb != null) {
                    int pct = (int) (done * 100 / Math.max(1, totalSamples));
                    if (pct != lastPct) {
                        lastPct = pct;
                        cb.onProgress(pct);
                    }
                }
            }
            long pcmBytes = totalSamples * 2;
            w.seek(0);
            w.write(wav16Header(info.channels, info.sampleRate, pcmBytes));
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
    }

    /** 32-bit float WAV -> M4A (AAC) via MediaCodec + MediaMuxer. */
    public static void toM4a(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        toM4a(src, dst, 128000, cb);
    }

    /**
     * Same with an explicit AAC bitrate (the presets range 64–320 kbps).
     * Tuned for speed: big input chunks, microsecond codec waits and
     * throttled progress so a minute of audio converts in seconds.
     */
    public static void toM4a(File src, File dst, int bitrate, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        encodeMuxed(src, dst, MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC,
                Math.max(64000, Math.min(320000, bitrate)),
                MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_MPEG_4,
                android.media.MediaCodecInfo.CodecProfileLevel.AACObjectLC, cb);
    }

    /**
     * 32-bit float WAV -> 24-bit PCM WAV.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;24-bit samples are not 4-byte aligned, so each one is assembled
     * byte-wise rather than through a typed {@link ByteBuffer} read.
     */
    public static void toWav24(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4;
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        RandomAccessFile w = null;
        try {
            w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wav24Header(info.channels, info.sampleRate, 0));
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(2048L, Math.min((long) CONV_CHUNK, totalSamples / 25L))
                    : CONV_CHUNK;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, info.channels);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * 4];
            byte[] out = new byte[chunk * 3];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            int[] ints = new int[chunk];
            long done = 0;
            int lastPct = -1;
            while (done < totalSamples) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunk, totalSamples - done);
                r.readFully(in, 0, want * 4);
                toInt24(fb, want, ints);
                int p = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < want; i++) {
                    int v = ints[i];
                    out[p++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
                    out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
                    out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
                }
                w.write(out, 0, p);
                done += want;
                if (cb != null) {
                    int pct = (int) (done * 100 / Math.max(1, totalSamples));
                    if (pct != lastPct) {
                        lastPct = pct;
                        cb.onProgress(pct);
                    }
                }
            }
            long pcmBytes = totalSamples * 3;
            w.seek(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wav24Header(info.channels, info.sampleRate, pcmBytes));
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
    }

    /** Opus in Ogg on API 29+ (WebM fallback on API 24-28). */
    public static void toOpus(File src, File dst, int bitrate, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        int muxFmt = android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29
                ? MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_OGG
                : MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_WEBM;
        encodeMuxed(src, dst, "audio/opus",
                Math.max(32000, Math.min(256000, bitrate <= 0 ? 128000 : bitrate)),
                muxFmt, -1, cb);
    }

    /**
     * Shared float-WAV -> encoder -> muxer pipeline. Negative aacProfile skips
     * the AAC profile key (Opus/Vorbis don't take one).
     */
    private static void encodeMuxed(File src, File dst, String mime, int bitrate,
                                    int muxerFormat, int aacProfile,
                                    Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        final int ch = info.channels;
        final int sr = info.sampleRate;
        final long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4; // interleaved samples
        final long totalFrames = totalSamples / Math.max(1, ch);

        MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat(mime, sr, ch);
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BIT_RATE, bitrate);
        if (aacProfile >= 0) {
            fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_AAC_PROFILE, aacProfile);
        }
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 262144);

        MediaCodec enc = null;
        MediaMuxer muxer = null;
        boolean muxStarted = false;
        int samplesWritten = 0;
        int track = -1;
        MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        try {
            enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType(mime);
            enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
            enc.start();
            muxer = new MediaMuxer(dst.getAbsolutePath(), muxerFormat);
            r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(1024L, Math.min(16384L, totalFrames / 25L))
                    : 16384;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, ch);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * ch * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            long framesDone = 0;
            boolean inputEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            int lastPct = -1;
            long drainDeadline = 0;

            while (!outEos) {
                if (!inputEos) {
                    int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                    if (idx >= 0) {
                        ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                        dstBuf.clear();
                        long framesLeft = totalFrames - framesDone;
                        // Never read more file bytes than the codec buffer fits.
                        int maxByBuf = dstBuf.remaining() / 2 / Math.max(1, ch);
                        int wantFrames = (int) Math.min(chunk,
                                Math.min(framesLeft, maxByBuf));
                        if (wantFrames <= 0 && framesLeft > 0) {
                            // Codec buffer unexpectedly small: retry next round.
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                        } else if (wantFrames <= 0) {
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                    MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                            inputEos = true;
                            // All audio is queued, so the progress bar is
                            // already at 100% from here on. What remains is
                            // draining the encoder, which some OEM codecs
                            // never finish: bound it, or the worker thread
                            // spins forever and the app is ANR-killed right
                            // after the bar completes.
                            drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                    + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                        } else {
                            int wantBytes = wantFrames * ch * 4;
                            r.readFully(in, 0, wantBytes);
                            int shorts = wantFrames * ch;
                            java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                    .asShortBuffer();
                            toInt16(fb, shorts, sb);
                            dstBuf.position(0);
                            dstBuf.limit(shorts * 2);
                            long pts = framesDone * 1_000_000L / sr;
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(
                                    idx, 0, shorts * 2, pts, 0);
                            framesDone += wantFrames;
                            if (cb != null) {
                                int pct = (int) (framesDone * 100
                                        / Math.max(1, totalFrames));
                                if (pct != lastPct) {
                                    lastPct = pct;
                                    cb.onProgress(pct);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 2000);
                if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                    if (inputEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                            > drainDeadline) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "encoder never finished");
                    }
                } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                    MediaFormat of = enc.getOutputFormat();
                    track = muxer.addTrack(of);
                    muxer.start();
                    muxStarted = true;
                } else if (oidx >= 0) {
                    ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                    if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                            && bi.size > 0 && muxStarted) {
                        ob.position(bi.offset);
                        ob.limit(bi.offset + bi.size);
                        muxer.writeSampleData(track, ob, bi);
                        samplesWritten++;
                    }
                    enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                    if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                        outEos = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
        } finally {
            if (r != null) {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (enc != null) {
                try {
                    enc.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    enc.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (muxer != null) {
                try {
                    // stop() with an empty track is undefined in the native
                    // muxer; only finalize it when samples actually landed.
                    if (muxStarted && samplesWritten > 0) muxer.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    muxer.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (dst.length() < 1024) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            dst.delete();
            throw new IllegalStateException("encode failed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Pure-Java sanity check on a finished conversion, run before the library
     * ever sees the file. Catches containers torn by a dying encoder or a
     * process kill (header written, trailer missing) without touching the
     * platform parser. Throws on anything invalid.
     */
    public static void validateFinal(File dst, SaveFormat fmt) throws Exception {
        if (dst == null || !dst.exists() || dst.length() < 64) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("output too small");
        }
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "r");
        try {
            byte[] head = new byte[12];
            r.readFully(head);
            switch (fmt) {
                case M4A:
                case AUTO:
                default:
                    // ISO base media: 'ftyp' at offset 4, and a 'moov' box
                    // somewhere (written last — its absence means teardown
                    // never finished).
                    if (head[4] != 'f' || head[5] != 't'
                            || head[6] != 'y' || head[7] != 'p') {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("not an mp4 container");
                    }
                    if (!containsBox(r, new byte[]{'m', 'o', 'o', 'v'})) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("mp4 truncated (no moov)");
                    }
                    break;
                case AMR_NB:
                case AMR_WB:
                    // A .3gp that merely has ftyp/moov can still contain no
                    // AMR sample entry. Require the exact sample description
                    // atom the chosen codec must have written.
                    if (head[4] != 'f' || head[5] != 't'
                            || head[6] != 'y' || head[7] != 'p') {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("not a 3gp container");
                    }
                    if (!containsBox(r, new byte[]{'m', 'o', 'o', 'v'})) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("3gp truncated (no moov)");
                    }
                    byte[] sampleEntry = fmt == SaveFormat.AMR_WB
                            ? new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'}
                            : new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'm', 'r'};
                    if (!containsBox(r, sampleEntry)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "3gp missing " + new String(sampleEntry)
                                        + " sample entry");
                    }
                    break;
                case OPUS:
                    // Accept RFC 7845 Ogg Opus ("OggS") on API 29+ or WebM
                    // EBML (0x1A45DFA3) on older devices.
                    boolean isOgg = head[0] == 'O' && head[1] == 'g'
                            && head[2] == 'g' && head[3] == 'S';
                    boolean isWebm = (head[0] & 0xFF) == 0x1A
                            && (head[1] & 0xFF) == 0x45
                            && (head[2] & 0xFF) == 0xDF
                            && (head[3] & 0xFF) == 0xA3;
                    if (!isOgg && !isWebm) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "not an ogg or webm opus container");
                    }
                    if (isWebm && !containsBox(r, new byte[]{0x1F, 0x43,
                            (byte) 0xB6, 0x75})) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "webm has no clusters (truncated)");
                    }
                    break;
                case FLAC: {
                    // Magic alone is not enough: a wrong metadata block type
                    // (0x90) or a 0 Hz sample rate produces a file every
                    // player rejects.
                    byte[] fh = new byte[42];
                    r.seek(0);
                    r.readFully(fh);
                    if (!FlacHeader.validHead(fh)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "flac streaminfo invalid");
                    }
                    break;
                }
                case WAV16:
                case WAV24:
                case WAV32:
                    // RIFF/WAVE; wavDurationMs() re-reads the header and
                    // rejects a bit depth it does not understand.
                    if (head[0] != 'R' || head[1] != 'I'
                            || head[2] != 'F' || head[3] != 'F'
                            || head[8] != 'W' || head[9] != 'A'
                            || head[10] != 'V' || head[11] != 'E') {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("not a wav container");
                    }
                    // A header with a zero data size is a conversion that
                    // died before writing any payload.
                    if (Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst) <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("wav has no audio");
                    }
                    if (fmt == SaveFormat.WAV32) {
                        Dsp.WavHeader wh = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
                        if (wh.audioFormat != 3 || wh.bits != 32) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "not a 32-bit float wav");
                        }
                    }
                    break;
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /** True when the 4-byte token occurs anywhere in the file. */
    private static boolean containsBox(RandomAccessFile r, byte[] token)
            throws Exception {
        byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
        int carry = 0;
        long left = r.length();
        r.seek(0);
        while (left > 0) {
            int n = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
            r.readFully(buf, 0, n);
            left -= n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (buf[i] == token[carry]) {
                    if (++carry == token.length) return true;
                } else {
                    carry = buf[i] == token[0] ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the exact byte length of a single RFC 4867 / 3GPP AMR frame
     * from its Table of Contents (ToC) header byte, so any multi-frame
     * MediaCodec output buffer can be split into 1-frame (20 ms) samples
     * matching damr.frames_per_sample = 1.
     */
    static int amrFrameBytes(byte tocByte, boolean wideband) {
        int ft = (tocByte >> 3) & 0x0F;
        if (wideband) {
            // 3GPP TS 26.201 AMR-WB frame sizes (including 1 ToC byte)
            final int[] wbSizes = {18, 24, 33, 37, 41, 47, 51, 59, 61, 6, 1,
                    1, 1, 1, 1, 1};
            return wbSizes[ft];
        } else {
            // 3GPP TS 26.101 AMR-NB frame sizes (including 1 ToC byte)
            final int[] nbSizes = {13, 14, 16, 18, 20, 21, 27, 32, 6, 7, 6,
                    6, 1, 1, 1, 1};
            return nbSizes[ft];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Writes an AMR MediaCodec output buffer to MediaMuxer as individual
     * 1-frame (20 ms) MP4 samples. This prevents multi-frame MP4 samples
     * that violate damr.frames_per_sample = 1 and fixes both the 0.28s/0.32s
     * decode truncation and the stts duration inflation.
     */
    static long writeAmrFramesSingle(MediaMuxer muxer, int track,
                                     ByteBuffer ob, MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi,
                                     boolean wideband, long nextFramePtsUs) {
        int pos = bi.offset;
        int end = bi.offset + bi.size;
        MediaCodec.BufferInfo singleBi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
        while (pos < end) {
            int frameLen = amrFrameBytes(ob.get(pos), wideband);
            if (frameLen <= 0 || pos + frameLen > end) {
                frameLen = end - pos;
            }
            ob.position(pos);
            ob.limit(pos + frameLen);
            singleBi.set(pos, frameLen, nextFramePtsUs,
                    (pos + frameLen >= end) ? bi.flags : 0);
            muxer.writeSampleData(track, ob, singleBi);
            nextFramePtsUs += 20_000L; // 20 ms per AMR frame
            pos += frameLen;
        }
        return nextFramePtsUs;
    }

    /**
     * AMR-NB (8 kHz) or AMR-WB (16 kHz) in a .3gp container. The 48 kHz float
     * capture is mixed to mono and properly decimated through a windowed-sinc
     * lowpass (no naive downsampling, so no aliasing whistle).
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Fully streaming: a bounded chunk plus the decimator&#39;s ~17k-sample
     * window is all that is ever retained, so takes of any length convert
     * with constant memory and no duration cap.
     */
    public static void toAmr(File src, File dst, boolean wideband, Progress cb)
            throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        final int outRate = wideband ? 16000 : 8000;
        // AMR encoders require exact 20 ms frames: 160 samples at 8 kHz,
        // 320 at 16 kHz. Anything else produces a malformed .3gp.
        final int frameSamples = wideband ? 320 : 160;
        final int decim = Math.max(1, info.sampleRate / outRate);
        final double cutoff = (wideband ? 7000.0 : 3400.0) / info.sampleRate;
        final int taps = wideband ? 48 : 64;
        Dsp.FirDecimator decimator =
                new Dsp.FirDecimator(decim, Dsp.firLowpass(cutoff, taps));

        final int ch = info.channels;
        final long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, ch);
        final long expectOut = totalFrames / decim;
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        try {
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            String mime = wideband ? "audio/amr-wb" : "audio/3gpp";
            int bitrate = wideband ? 23850 : 12200;
            MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat(mime, outRate, 1);
            fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BIT_RATE, bitrate);
            fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 32768);
            MediaCodec enc = null;
            MediaMuxer muxer = null;
            boolean muxStarted = false;
            int samplesWritten = 0;
            long nextOutPtsUs = 0L;
            int track = -1;
            MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(CONV_CHUNK, ch);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * ch * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            float[] mono = new float[chunk];
            // NEW-08 fix: removed unused `short[] decOut` allocation.
            // Encoder backlog: decimated shorts awaiting codec room.
            short[] pend = new short[32768];
            int pendLen = 0;
            long readFrames = 0;
            long fed = 0;
            boolean tailFlushed = false;
            boolean inEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            int lastPct = -1;
            long drainDeadline = 0;
            try {
                enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType(mime);
                enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
                enc.start();
                muxer = new MediaMuxer(
                        dst.getAbsolutePath(),
                        MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_3GPP);
                while (!outEos) {
                    if (!inEos) {
                        // 1) Produce more decimated samples while the backlog
                        // has room and the file has frames.
                        if (pendLen < pend.length / 2
                                && readFrames < totalFrames) {
                            int want = (int) Math.min(chunk,
                                    totalFrames - readFrames);
                            r.readFully(in, 0, want * ch * 4);
                            fb.clear();
                            fb.limit(want * ch);
                            if (ch == 2) {
                                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                    mono[f] = (fb.get(f * 2)
                                            + fb.get(f * 2 + 1)) * 0.5f;
                                }
                            } else if (ch > 2) {
                                float inv = 1f / ch;
                                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                    float sum = 0f;
                                    int base = f * ch;
                                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                                        sum += fb.get(base + c);
                                    }
                                    mono[f] = sum * inv;
                                }
                            } else {
                                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                    mono[f] = fb.get(f);
                                }
                            }
                            int need = pendLen + want / decim + taps + 16;
                            if (need > pend.length) {
                                short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                        pend.length * 2, need)];
                                System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0, pendLen);
                                pend = bigger;
                            }
                            pendLen += decimator.push(mono, want, pend,
                                    pendLen);
                            readFrames += want;
                        } else if (readFrames >= totalFrames
                                && !tailFlushed) {
                            int need = pendLen + taps + 16;
                            if (need > pend.length) {
                                short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                        pend.length * 2, need)];
                                System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0, pendLen);
                                pend = bigger;
                            }
                            pendLen += decimator.flush(totalFrames, pend,
                                    pendLen);
                            // Zero-pad the final partial frame so every
                            // queued buffer is an exact AMR frame multiple.
                            int pad = (frameSamples - (pendLen % frameSamples))
                                    % frameSamples;
                            if (pad > 0) {
                                int padNeed = pendLen + pad;
                                if (padNeed > pend.length) {
                                    short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                            pend.length * 2, padNeed)];
                                    System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0,
                                            pendLen);
                                    pend = bigger;
                                }
                                java.util.Arrays.fill(pend, pendLen,
                                        pendLen + pad, (short) 0);
                                pendLen += pad;
                            }
                            tailFlushed = true;
                        }
                        // 2) Feed the encoder from the backlog.
                        int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(5000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            if (pendLen >= frameSamples) {
                                ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                                dstBuf.clear();
                                // Queue exactly 1 AMR frame (20 ms) per input
                                // buffer so each MediaCodec output packet is a
                                // single 20 ms frame matching damr.
                                int want = frameSamples;
                                java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                        .asShortBuffer();
                                sb.put(pend, 0, want);
                                dstBuf.position(0);
                                dstBuf.limit(want * 2);
                                long pts = fed * 1_000_000L / outRate;
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, want * 2, pts, 0);
                                fed += want;
                                System.arraycopy(pend, want, pend, 0,
                                        pendLen - want);
                                pendLen -= want;
                                if (cb != null) {
                                    int pct = (int) (fed * 100 / Math.max(
                                            1, expectOut));
                                    if (pct != lastPct) {
                                        lastPct = pct;
                                        cb.onProgress(
                                                Math.min(100, pct));
                                    }
                                }
                            } else if (tailFlushed && pendLen == 0) {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                        MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                inEos = true;
                                // Progress is already 100%; bound the drain.
                                drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                        + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                            } else {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    // Drain every output buffer the codec has ready, not just
                    // one per input buffer. The old single dequeue let the
                    // encoder fall behind and stall near EOS.
                    int drained = 0;
                    while (true) {
                        int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi,
                                drained == 0 ? 5000L : 0L);
                        if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                            if (inEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                    > drainDeadline) {
                                throw new IllegalStateException(
                                        "encoder never finished");
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                        if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                            if (!muxStarted) {
                                track = muxer.addTrack(enc.getOutputFormat());
                                muxer.start();
                                muxStarted = true;
                            }
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (oidx < 0) continue;
                        ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                                && bi.size > 0 && muxStarted) {
                            nextOutPtsUs = writeAmrFramesSingle(
                                    muxer, track, ob, bi, wideband,
                                    nextOutPtsUs);
                            samplesWritten++;
                        }
                        enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                        drained++;
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                            outEos = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
            } finally {
                if (enc != null) {
                    try { enc.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    try { enc.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                if (muxer != null) {
                    try {
                        if (muxStarted && samplesWritten > 0) muxer.stop();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    try { muxer.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            }
            if (dst.length() < 512) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                dst.delete();
                throw new IllegalStateException("amr encode failed");
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /**
     * FLAC stream-header writer, shared by the batch converter and the
     * incremental encoder so the two can never disagree on the layout.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Three defects lived here before: the metadata block header byte was
     * written as {@code 0x90} (type 16 = reserved, which makes Android's
     * FLACExtractor reject every saved file); the encoder's csd-0 buffer was
     * copied from offset 0 even though Android's FLAC encoder prefixes
     * STREAMINFO with {@code "fLaC"} and a block header, so the payload
     * contained a duplicated magic and a 0 Hz sample rate; and
     * {@code total_samples} stayed 0, breaking duration probing.
     */
    public static final class FlacHeader {

        public static final int STREAMINFO_LEN = 34;
        /** Byte offset of the 20-bit sample rate inside STREAMINFO. */
        private static final int SI_SAMPLE_RATE = 10;
        /** First byte of the 36-bit total-samples field (spans 13..17). */
        private static final int SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES = 13;

        private FlacHeader() {}

        /**
         * Pulls the 34-byte STREAMINFO out of an encoder csd-0 buffer,
         * tolerating the three shapes Android ships: bare STREAMINFO,
         * block-header-prefixed, or {@code "fLaC"}+block-header-prefixed.
         *
         * @return the 34 bytes, or null when the buffer holds none.
         */
        public static byte[] streamInfoFromCsd(ByteBuffer csd) {
            if (csd == null || csd.remaining() < STREAMINFO_LEN) return null;
            int start = csd.position();
            int skip = 0;
            if (csd.remaining() >= 42) {
                int p = csd.position();
                if (csd.get(p) == 'f' && csd.get(p + 1) == 'L'
                        && csd.get(p + 2) == 'a' && csd.get(p + 3) == 'C') {
                    // "fLaC" + [0x80 0x00 0x00 0x22] + STREAMINFO
                    skip = 8;
                }
            }
            if (skip == 0 && csd.remaining() >= 38
                    && (csd.get(csd.position()) & 0x7F) == 0
                    && csd.get(csd.position() + 1) == 0
                    && csd.get(csd.position() + 2) == 0
                    && (csd.get(csd.position() + 3) & 0xFF)
                    == STREAMINFO_LEN) {
                // block header + STREAMINFO
                skip = 4;
            }
            if (csd.remaining() - skip < STREAMINFO_LEN) return null;
            byte[] si = new byte[STREAMINFO_LEN];
            ByteBuffer view = csd.duplicate();
            view.position(view.position() + skip);
            view.get(si);
            csd.position(start);
            return si;
        }

        /** Writes {@code fLaC} + the last-STREAMINFO block header + payload. */
        public static void write(java.io.OutputStream out, byte[] si)
                throws Exception {
            out.write(new byte[]{'f', 'L', 'a', 'C'});
            // bit 7 = last-metadata-block, bits 6..0 = type 0 (STREAMINFO).
            out.write(0x80);
            out.write(0x00);
            out.write(0x00);
            out.write(STREAMINFO_LEN);
            out.write(si);
        }

        /**
         * Patches the 36-bit total-samples field so players can report a
         * duration. The encoder streams, so it leaves this at 0.
         *
         * &lt;p&gt;Layout: low 4 bits of STREAMINFO byte 13, then bytes 14..17.
         */
        public static void patchTotalSamples(RandomAccessFile r,
                                              long totalSamples)
                throws Exception {
            if (totalSamples <= 0 || totalSamples >= (1L << 36)) return;
            byte[] si = new byte[STREAMINFO_LEN];
            r.seek(8 + SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES - 1); // byte 12: keep its high bits
            r.readFully(si, SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES - 1, 5);
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES] = (byte) ((si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES] & 0xF0)
                    | ((totalSamples >>> 32) & 0x0F));
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES + 1] = (byte) (totalSamples >>> 24);
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES + 2] = (byte) (totalSamples >>> 16);
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES + 3] = (byte) (totalSamples >>> 8);
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES + 4] = (byte) totalSamples;
            r.seek(8 + SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES - 1);
            r.write(si, SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES - 1, 5);
        }

        /** Sample rate in Hz from a 34-byte STREAMINFO. */
        public static int sampleRate(byte[] si) {
            if (si == null || si.length < 21) return 0;
            return ((si[SI_SAMPLE_RATE] & 0xFF) << 12)
                    | ((si[SI_SAMPLE_RATE + 1] & 0xFF) << 4)
                    | ((si[SI_SAMPLE_RATE + 2] & 0xF0) >>> 4);
        }

        /**
         * Structural check on the first 42 bytes of a FLAC file: magic,
         * a STREAMINFO last-block header with the right length, no nested
         * magic, and a non-zero sample rate.
         */
        public static boolean validHead(byte[] head) {
            if (head == null || head.length < 42) return false;
            if (head[0] != 'f' || head[1] != 'L' || head[2] != 'a'
                    || head[3] != 'C') return false;
            if ((head[4] & 0x7F) != 0) return false;   // type must be 0
            if ((head[5] & 0xFF) != 0 || (head[6] & 0xFF) != 0
                    || (head[7] & 0xFF) != STREAMINFO_LEN) return false;
            if (head[8] == 'f' && head[9] == 'L' && head[10] == 'a'
                    && head[11] == 'C') return false;   // duplicated magic
            int rate = ((head[8 + SI_SAMPLE_RATE] & 0xFF) << 12)
                    | ((head[8 + SI_SAMPLE_RATE + 1] & 0xFF) << 4)
                    | ((head[8 + SI_SAMPLE_RATE + 2] & 0xF0) >>> 4);
            return rate > 0;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Lossless FLAC stream (probe-gated). Writes the encoder's STREAMINFO as
     * the file's metadata block followed by raw audio frames — playable
     * anywhere FLAC is supported.
     */
    public static void toFlac(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        final int ch = info.channels;
        final int sr = info.sampleRate;
        final long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, ch);

        MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat("audio/flac", sr, ch);
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 262144);
        MediaCodec enc = null;
        java.io.FileOutputStream out = null;
        boolean ok = false;
        try {
            enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType("audio/flac");
            enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
            enc.start();
            out = new java.io.FileOutputStream(dst);
            // No magic here: FlacHeader.write() emits "fLaC" with the
            // STREAMINFO block once the encoder publishes its config.
            boolean wroteInfo = false;
            // Frames can precede the format change; hold them until the
            // STREAMINFO header is written so no audio is lost.
            java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream pending = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
            RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(1024L, Math.min(16384L, totalFrames / 25L))
                    : 16384;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, ch);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * ch * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
            long framesDone = 0;
            boolean inEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            int lastPct = -1;
            long drainDeadline = 0;
            try {
                r.seek(info.dataStart);
                while (!outEos) {
                    if (!inEos) {
                        int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(5000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                            dstBuf.clear();
                            long framesLeft = totalFrames - framesDone;
                            int maxByBuf = dstBuf.remaining() / 2 / Math.max(1, ch);
                            int wantFrames = (int) Math.min(chunk,
                                    Math.min(framesLeft, maxByBuf));
                            if (wantFrames <= 0 && framesLeft > 0) {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                            } else if (wantFrames <= 0) {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                        MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                inEos = true;
                                // Progress is already 100%; bound the drain.
                                drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                        + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                            } else {
                                int wantBytes = wantFrames * ch * 4;
                                r.readFully(in, 0, wantBytes);
                                int shorts = wantFrames * ch;
                                java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                        .asShortBuffer();
                                toInt16(fb, shorts, sb);
                                dstBuf.position(0);
                                dstBuf.limit(shorts * 2);
                                long pts = framesDone * 1_000_000L / sr;
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, shorts * 2, pts, 0);
                                framesDone += wantFrames;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 5000);
                    if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                        if (inEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                > drainDeadline) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "encoder never finished");
                        }
                    } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                        try {
                            MediaFormat of = enc.getOutputFormat();
                            if (!wroteInfo) {
                                byte[] si = FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(
                                        of.getByteBuffer("csd-0"));
                                if (si != null) {
                                    FlacHeader.write(out, si);
                                    wroteInfo = true;
                                    if (pending.size() > 0) {
                                        pending.writeTo(out);
                                        pending.reset();
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    } else if (oidx >= 0) {
                        ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                                && bi.size > 0) {
                            byte[] frame = new byte[bi.size];
                            ob.position(bi.offset);
                            ob.get(frame);
                            if (wroteInfo) {
                                out.write(frame);
                            } else {
                                pending.write(frame, 0, frame.length);
                            }
                        }
                        enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                            outEos = true;
                        }
                    }
                    if (cb != null) {
                        int pct = (int) (framesDone * 100 / Math.max(1, totalFrames));
                        if (pct != lastPct) {
                            lastPct = pct;
                            cb.onProgress(pct);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            out.flush();
            // The encoder streams, so STREAMINFO's total_samples is 0; patch
            // it now that the frame count is known.
            try {
                RandomAccessFile rr = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
                try {
                    FlacHeader.patchTotalSamples(rr, totalFrames);
                } finally {
                    rr.close();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            ok = wroteInfo && dst.length() > 1024;
            if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
        } finally {
            if (out != null) {
                try {
                    out.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (enc != null) {
                try {
                    enc.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    enc.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (!ok) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                dst.delete();
                throw new IllegalStateException("flac encode failed");
            }
        }
    }

    private static byte[] wav16Header(int ch, int sr, long pcmBytes) {
        return Dsp.wav16Header(ch, sr, pcmBytes);
    }
}


--- FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/TakesAdapter.java ---
package com.example.hello;

import android.animation.ValueAnimator;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.SeekBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public class TakesAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<TakesAdapter.Vh> {

    public interface Listener {
        void onCardClick(Take take);
        void onCardLongPress(Take take);
        void onPlay(Take take);
        void onFavorite(Take take);
        void onRename(Take take);
        void onExport(Take take);
        void onEdit(Take take);
        void onDelete(Take take);
        void onCancelConversion(Take take);
        void onSeek(Take take, long posMs);
    }

    private final Listener listener;
    private List<Take> takes = new ArrayList<>();
    private long expandedId = -1;
    private long playingId = -1;
    private boolean paused = false;
    private boolean selectionMode = false;
    private Set<Long> selected = new HashSet<>();
    private final Map<Long, Long> progressMap = new HashMap<>();

    /** Selected cards shrink so multi-select reads at a glance. */
    private static final float SEL_SCALE = 0.92f;
    /** SeekBar resolution — high enough that progress looks continuous. */
    private static final int SCRUB_MAX = 10000;

    public TakesAdapter(Listener listener) {
        this.listener = listener;
        setHasStableIds(true);
    }

    @Override
    public long getItemId(int position) {
        // Stable ids make RecyclerView query this against its own (possibly
        // stale) position bookkeeping while a rebind is in flight. A
        // converting card that disappears on completion shortens the list, and
        // the out-of-range read used to crash the app right as the user was
        // looking at the finished take.
        if (position < 0 || position >= takes.size()) {
            return RecyclerView.NO_ID;
        }
        return takes.get(position).id;
    }

    public void setTakes(List<Take> takes) {
        setTakesAndState(takes, playingId, paused, selected, selectionMode);
    }

    /**
     * Applies list and playback/selection state in a single pass, so a refresh
     * never issues {@code notifyDataSetChanged()} followed by
     * {@code notifyItemChanged()} in the same UI turn. Under
     * {@code setHasStableIds(true)} with an id that just changed sign (a
     * converting card becoming its finished Room take) that pairing is what
     * drove RecyclerView into an inconsistent-adapter-state crash.
     */
    public void setTakesAndState(List<Take> takes, long playingId,
                                 boolean paused, Set<Long> selected,
                                 boolean selectionMode) {
        // An expanded converting card (negative id) is replaced by a real
        // take when its job finishes. Hand the open state over so the card the
        // user opened stays open instead of silently snapping shut.
        if (expandedId < 0) {
            String rawPath = ConversionJobs.rawForTakeId(expandedId);
            Long completed = rawPath != null
                    ? ConversionJobs.completedTakeIdForRaw(rawPath) : null;
            if (completed != null) expandedId = completed;
        }
        this.takes = takes;
        this.playingId = playingId;
        this.paused = paused;
        this.selected = selected;
        this.selectionMode = selectionMode;
        // Drop stale expanded refs that are no longer visible.
        boolean expAlive = false;
        for (Take t : takes) {
            if (t.id == expandedId) expAlive = true;
        }
        if (!expAlive) expandedId = -1;
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    /**
     * Keeps a recycled or failing holder from animating a view that is no
     * longer attached: a running height animator calling requestLayout() on a
     * detached holder corrupts RecyclerView's layout pass.
     */
    @Override
    public void onViewRecycled(@NonNull Vh h) {
        cancelHolderAnimations(h);
        super.onViewRecycled(h);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onFailedToRecycleView(@NonNull Vh h) {
        cancelHolderAnimations(h);
        return super.onFailedToRecycleView(h);
    }

    private void cancelHolderAnimations(Vh h) {
        if (h == null) return;
        Object pending = h.expanded.getTag();
        if (pending instanceof ValueAnimator) {
            ((ValueAnimator) pending).cancel();
        }
        h.expanded.setTag(null);
        h.expanded.getLayoutParams().height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        h.expanded.setAlpha(1f);
        h.cardRoot.animate().cancel();
        h.cardRoot.setScaleX(1f);
        h.cardRoot.setScaleY(1f);
        h.playBtn.animate().cancel();
        h.fav.animate().cancel();
        h.chevron.animate().cancel();
    }

    public void setExpandedId(long id) {
        long old = expandedId;
        expandedId = id;
        notifyForId(old);
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    public long getExpandedId() {
        return expandedId;
    }

    public void collapseAll() {
        long old = expandedId;
        expandedId = -1;
        notifyForId(old);
    }

    public void setPlayingId(long id) {
        long old = playingId;
        playingId = id;
        notifyForId(old);
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    public void setPaused(boolean p) {
        paused = p;
        notifyForId(playingId);
    }

    /** Single-notify reset of the playing state (avoids double-rebind flicker). */
    public void clearPlaying() {
        long old = playingId;
        playingId = -1;
        paused = false;
        notifyForId(old);
    }

    /**
     * Smoothly expands {@code id} (and smoothly collapses any previously
     * expanded card) using the same height/alpha transition as tapping the
     * card body, without triggering a full ViewHolder rebind.
     */
    public void expandDirectIfNeeded(RecyclerView rv, long id) {
        if (rv == null) {
            setExpandedId(id);
            return;
        }
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder curVh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (expandedId == id) {
            if (curVh instanceof Vh) {
                Vh h = (Vh) curVh;
                if (h.expanded.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) return;
                animateExpand(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            }
            return;
        }
        toggleExpandedDirect(rv, id);
    }

    /**
     * Updates the playing/paused state and repaints the play/pause button icon
     * directly on visible ViewHolder(s) without notifyItemChanged(), so an
     * in-flight smooth expand animation is never interrupted or snapped.
     */
    public void paintPlayState(RecyclerView rv, long newPlayingId,
                               boolean isPaused) {
        long oldPlayingId = this.playingId;
        this.playingId = newPlayingId;
        this.paused = isPaused;
        if (rv == null) {
            notifyForId(oldPlayingId);
            notifyForId(newPlayingId);
            return;
        }
        if (oldPlayingId != -1 && oldPlayingId != newPlayingId) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder oldVh =
                    rv.findViewHolderForItemId(oldPlayingId);
            if (oldVh instanceof Vh) {
                ((Vh) oldVh).play.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_play);
            } else {
                notifyForId(oldPlayingId);
            }
        }
        if (newPlayingId != -1) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder newVh =
                    rv.findViewHolderForItemId(newPlayingId);
            if (newVh instanceof Vh) {
                ((Vh) newVh).play.setImageResource(isPaused
                        ? R.drawable.ic_play : R.drawable.ic_pause);
            } else {
                notifyForId(newPlayingId);
            }
        }
    }

    public void refreshItem(long id) {
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    /** Update only the heart artwork, no rebind (no flicker on favorite taps). */
    public void paintFavorite(RecyclerView rv, long id, boolean fav) {
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            h.fav.setImageResource(fav ? R.drawable.ic_heart_filled : R.drawable.ic_heart);
            h.fav.setAlpha(fav ? 1f : 0.55f);
        }
    }

    /** Toggle the expanded section with a smooth height + fade animation. */
    public void toggleExpandedDirect(RecyclerView rv, long id) {
        boolean expand = expandedId != id;
        // Smoothly collapse any previously open card.
        if (expandedId != -1 && expandedId != id) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder oldVh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(expandedId);
            if (oldVh instanceof Vh) {
                Vh old = (Vh) oldVh;
                animateCollapse(old.expanded, old.chevron);
            }
        }
        expandedId = expand ? id : -1;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            // Drop any stuck pressed/focus glow on the scrubber when it (re)appears.
            h.scrubber.setPressed(false);
            h.scrubber.clearFocus();
            h.scrubber.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();
            if (expand) {
                Take t = findTake(id);
                if (t != null) {
                    h.totalTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs));
                    if (t.id != playingId) {
                        h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(0));
                        if (!h.tracking) h.scrubber.setProgress(0);
                    } else {
                        // A4-12: re-expanding the card that is playing (even
                        // paused) reset its readout to 00:00 while the audio
                        // kept its position.
                        long pos = progressMap != null && progressMap
                                .containsKey(t.id)
                                ? progressMap.get(t.id) : 0L;
                        h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(pos));
                        if (!h.tracking) {
                            h.scrubber.setProgress((int) Math.min(SCRUB_MAX,
                                    pos * SCRUB_MAX / Math.max(1L, t.durationMs)));
                        }
                    }
                    h.btnExport.setVisibility((t.hasFile() || t.converting)
                            ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                }
                animateExpand(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            } else {
                animateCollapse(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            }
        }
    }

    private void animateExpand(final View expanded, final View ignored) {
        // Cancel any in-flight height animation.
        Object tag = expanded.getTag();
        if (tag instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) tag).cancel();
        expanded.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        expanded.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(
                        ((View) expanded.getParent()).getWidth(),
                        View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED));
        final int targetH = expanded.getMeasuredHeight();
        expanded.getLayoutParams().height = 0;
        expanded.setAlpha(0f);
        expanded.requestLayout();
        ValueAnimator anim = ValueAnimator.ofInt(0, targetH);
        anim.setDuration(300);
        anim.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.3f));
        anim.addUpdateListener(a -> {
            int val = (int) a.getAnimatedValue();
            expanded.getLayoutParams().height = val;
            expanded.setAlpha(Math.min(1f, val / (float) Math.max(1, targetH)));
            expanded.requestLayout();
        });
        anim.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationEnd(android.animation.Animator animation) {
                expanded.getLayoutParams().height =
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
                expanded.setAlpha(1f);
                expanded.requestLayout();
                expanded.setTag(null);
            }
        });
        expanded.setTag(anim);
        anim.start();
    }

    private void animateCollapse(final View expanded, final View ignored) {
        if (expanded.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) return;
        Object tag = expanded.getTag();
        if (tag instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) tag).cancel();
        final int startH = expanded.getHeight() > 0
                ? expanded.getHeight() : expanded.getMeasuredHeight();
        if (startH <= 0) {
            expanded.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }
        ValueAnimator anim = ValueAnimator.ofInt(startH, 0);
        anim.setDuration(240);
        anim.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f));
        anim.addUpdateListener(a -> {
            int val = (int) a.getAnimatedValue();
            expanded.getLayoutParams().height = val;
            expanded.setAlpha(val / (float) Math.max(1, startH));
            expanded.requestLayout();
        });
        anim.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationEnd(android.animation.Animator animation) {
                expanded.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                expanded.getLayoutParams().height =
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
                expanded.setAlpha(1f);
                expanded.requestLayout();
                expanded.setTag(null);
            }
        });
        expanded.setTag(anim);
        anim.start();
    }

    /** True while the user is actively dragging this take's scrubber. */
    public boolean isTracking(long id, RecyclerView rv) {
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        return vh instanceof Vh && ((Vh) vh).tracking;
    }

    private Take findTake(long id) {
        for (Take t : takes) {
            if (t.id == id) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public void setSelection(Set<Long> selected, boolean mode) {
        Set<Long> copy = new HashSet<>(selected);
        boolean modeChanged = this.selectionMode != mode;
        boolean contentChanged = !this.selected.equals(copy);
        this.selected = copy;
        this.selectionMode = mode;
        // Any change — mode flip, single toggle, or select-all — rebinds every
        // visible row, so badges, backgrounds and the shrink always converge
        // on the tapped state in one pass. No walk-then-rebind double driver,
        // so effects can never land a tap late or on the wrong card.
        if (modeChanged || contentChanged) {
            notifyDataSetChanged();
        }
    }

    private void applySelectionScale(Vh h, boolean isSel) {
        float target = isSel ? SEL_SCALE : 1f;
        View card = h.cardRoot;
        // Stateless: always converge from the ACTUAL current scale to the
        // target. No remembered per-view state, so rapid taps, recycling and
        // mode exits can never desync — every bind ends exactly at target,
        // gliding when there is distance to cover, snapping when already home.
        card.animate().cancel();
        if (Math.abs(card.getScaleX() - target) < 0.002f
                && Math.abs(card.getScaleY() - target) < 0.002f) {
            card.setScaleX(target);
            card.setScaleY(target);
            return;
        }
        card.animate()
                .scaleX(target).scaleY(target)
                .setDuration(160)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }

    private void notifyForId(long id) {
        if (id == -1) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < takes.size(); i++) {
            if (takes.get(i).id == id) {
                notifyItemChanged(i);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private void pressBounce(View v) {
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.setScaleX(0.94f);
        v.setScaleY(0.94f);
        v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(180)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                .start();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public Vh onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
                .inflate(R.layout.item_take, parent, false);
        Vh holder = new Vh(v);
        // Press feedback on everything tappable (scrubber excluded — it drags).
        // Icons get the softer variant so they give without flashing; the card
        // uses a ripple foreground so it never fights the selection scale.
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.fav, 0.9f);
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.chevron, 0.88f);
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.playBtn, 0.92f);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnRename);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnExport);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnDelete);
        return holder;
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull Vh h, int position) {
        Take t = takes.get(position);
        boolean expanded = t.id == expandedId;
        boolean playing = t.id == playingId;
        boolean isSel = selectionMode && selected.contains(t.id);

        h.cardRoot.setBackgroundResource(isSel ? R.drawable.bg_card_selected : R.drawable.bg_card);
        h.selectBadge.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        h.selectBadge.setImageResource(isSel ? R.drawable.ic_checked : R.drawable.bg_select_ring);
        h.selectBadge.setColorFilter(isSel ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672);
        h.selectBadge.setAlpha(isSel ? 1f : 0.5f);

        // Deterministic selection shrink. Every bind converges the card to the
        // exact scale its selection state demands, so recycled holders can
        // never carry a stale size.
        applySelectionScale(h, isSel);

        h.title.setText(t.title);
        if (t.converting) {
            h.meta.setText(h.itemView.getContext().getString(
                    R.string.conv_card_status, t.convFormat, t.convProgress));
        } else {
            h.meta.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs) + "  •  " + t.dateLabel + "  •  " + t.sizeLabel);
        }
        h.formatBadge.setText(t.format);
        h.play.setImageResource((playing && !paused) ? R.drawable.ic_pause : R.drawable.ic_play);
        h.play.setContentDescription(h.itemView.getContext().getString(R.string.cd_play));

        // Professional heart: outline idle, filled red favorite, with a pop on tap.
        // Converting rows have no stored row to favorite: hide the control.
        h.fav.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
        h.fav.setImageResource(t.favorite ? R.drawable.ic_heart_filled : R.drawable.ic_heart);
        h.fav.setAlpha(t.favorite ? 1f : 0.55f);
        h.fav.setColorFilter(null);

        // Header edit shortcut (replaces the old expand chevron; tapping the
        // card itself still expands/collapses, so nothing is lost).
        h.chevron.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_pencil);
        h.chevron.setRotation(0f);
        h.chevron.setAlpha((t.hasFile() || t.converting) ? 0.85f : 0.35f);
        h.chevron.setContentDescription(
                h.itemView.getContext().getString(R.string.cd_edit));
        // Reset any mid-animation height leftovers from recycled holders.
        Object pending = h.expanded.getTag();
        if (pending instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) pending).cancel();
        h.expanded.setTag(null);
        h.expanded.getLayoutParams().height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        h.expanded.setAlpha(1f);
        h.expanded.setVisibility(expanded ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        // Detach first: setProgress() on a rebound holder fires the PREVIOUS
        // take's listener, which wrote the old take's position (and seeked it).
        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(null);
        if (expanded) {
            h.totalTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs));
            long shown = playing ? progressMap.getOrDefault(t.id, 0L) : 0L;
            if (!h.tracking) {
                h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(shown));
                h.scrubber.setProgress(t.durationMs <= 0 ? 0
                        : (int) (shown * SCRUB_MAX / t.durationMs));
            }
        }
        // Conversion chrome is bound on every pass — expanding only animates
        // visibility, it never rebinds, so expanded-only state set here
        // would otherwise show whatever a recycled holder carried. The
        // progress stays visible even collapsed so conversions read at a
        // glance; only rename is ever hidden (no stored row to rename).
        h.btnExport.setVisibility((t.hasFile() || t.converting)
                ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        // Renaming is a pure metadata change, so it is safe while the take
        // converts: the worker inserts the finished file under this title.
        h.btnRename.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        h.convStatus.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        h.convProgress.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (t.converting) {
            h.convStatus.setText(h.itemView.getContext().getString(
                    R.string.conv_card_status, t.convFormat, t.convProgress));
            h.convProgress.setProgress(t.convProgress);
        }

        h.cardRoot.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onCardClick(t));
        h.cardRoot.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
            listener.onCardLongPress(t);
            return true;
        });
        h.playBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            v.animate().cancel();
            v.setScaleX(0.9f);
            v.setScaleY(0.9f);
            v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(200)
                    .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                    .start();
            listener.onPlay(t);
        });
        h.fav.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Soft nudge on a falloff curve — no hard overshoot, no flash.
            PressAnim.nudge(v, 1.14f);
            listener.onFavorite(t);
        });
        h.chevron.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onEdit(t);
        });
        h.btnRename.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onRename(t);
        });
        h.btnExport.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onExport(t);
        });
        h.btnDelete.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            if (t.converting) listener.onCancelConversion(t);
            else listener.onDelete(t);
        });

        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(null);
        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener() {
            @Override
            public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar s, int progress, boolean fromUser) {
                if (fromUser && h.tracking) {
                    long pos = t.durationMs * progress / SCRUB_MAX;
                    h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(pos));
                }
            }

            @Override public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar s) {
                h.tracking = true;
            }

            @Override public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar s) {
                h.tracking = false;
                long pos = t.durationMs * s.getProgress() / SCRUB_MAX;
                listener.onSeek(t, pos);
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return takes.size();
    }

    /** Direct conversion-progress paint without rebind. */
    public void paintConvProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, int pct,
                                  String status) {
        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
        Take t = findTake(id);
        if (t != null) {
            t.convProgress = clamped;
            if (status != null) t.dateLabel = status;
        }
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            if (h.convProgress != null) {
                h.convProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                h.convProgress.setProgress(clamped);
            }
            if (status != null) {
                if (h.convStatus != null) h.convStatus.setText(status);
                if (h.meta != null) h.meta.setText(status);
            }
        } else {
            notifyForId(id);
        }
    }

    /** Direct progress paint without rebind (called ~10x/sec while playing). */
    public void paintProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, long posMs) {
        if (id != -1) progressMap.put(id, posMs);
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            ((Vh) vh).applyProgress(posMs);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Set the stored position for a take (e.g. 0 when (re)starting playback)
     * so a rebind never snaps to a stale near-end value. Also paints it live
     * when the holder is visible and the user isn't dragging.
     */
    public void setProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, long posMs) {
        progressMap.put(id, posMs);
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh && !((Vh) vh).tracking) {
            ((Vh) vh).applyProgress(posMs);
        }
    }

    public class Vh extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final View cardRoot;
        final ImageView selectBadge;
        final View playBtn;
        final ImageView play;
        final TextView title;
        final TextView meta;
        final TextView formatBadge;
        final ImageView fav;
        final ImageView chevron;
        final LinearLayout expanded;
        final TextView curTime;
        final TextView totalTime;
        final SeekBar scrubber;
        final View btnRename;
        final View btnExport;
        final View btnDelete;
        final TextView convStatus;
        final android.widget.ProgressBar convProgress;
        boolean tracking = false;

        Vh(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            cardRoot = itemView.findViewById(R.id.cardRoot);
            selectBadge = itemView.findViewById(R.id.selectBadge);
            playBtn = itemView.findViewById(R.id.playBtn);
            play = itemView.findViewById(R.id.playIcon);
            title = itemView.findViewById(R.id.takeTitle);
            meta = itemView.findViewById(R.id.takeMeta);
            formatBadge = itemView.findViewById(R.id.formatBadge);
            fav = itemView.findViewById(R.id.favIcon);
            chevron = itemView.findViewById(R.id.chevron);
            expanded = itemView.findViewById(R.id.expanded);
            curTime = itemView.findViewById(R.id.curTime);
            totalTime = itemView.findViewById(R.id.totalTime);
            scrubber = itemView.findViewById(R.id.scrubber);
            btnRename = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnRename);
            btnExport = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnExport);
            btnDelete = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnDelete);
            convStatus = itemView.findViewById(R.id.convStatus);
            convProgress = itemView.findViewById(R.id.convProgress);
        }

        void applyProgress(long posMs) {
            int pos = getBindingAdapterPosition();
            if (pos == RecyclerView.NO_POSITION || pos < 0
                    || pos >= takes.size()) {
                return;
            }
            Take t = takes.get(pos);
            progressMap.put(t.id, posMs);
            if (tracking) return;
            if (t.durationMs > 0 && scrubber != null) {
                // Clamp so completion always lands exactly on the end.
                int p = (int) (posMs * SCRUB_MAX / t.durationMs);
                scrubber.setProgress(Math.min(p, SCRUB_MAX));
            }
            if (curTime != null) curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(posMs));
        }
    }
}
