package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Foreground host for an ongoing take: keeps capture alive when the app is
 * backgrounded, owns audio-focus interruption handling (pause, never
 * auto-resume) and exposes one clean persistent notification — name, preset,
 * live timer plus pause/resume, Save and Cancel actions that work without
 * opening the app.
 */
public class RecordingService extends Service {

    public static final String ACTION_START =
            "com.example.hello.REC_START";
    public static final String ACTION_TOGGLE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_TOGGLE";
    public static final String ACTION_SAVE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_SAVE";
    public static final String ACTION_CANCEL =
            "com.example.hello.REC_CANCEL";
    public static final String ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF =
            "com.example.hello.action.RESTORE_NOTIF";

    public static final String EXTRA_FORMAT = "format";

    /** Broadcast when a background save/cancel finishes. */
    public static final String BROADCAST_DONE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_DONE";
    public static final String EXTRA_OK = "ok";
    public static final String EXTRA_MESSAGE = "message";
    public static final String EXTRA_TITLE = "title";
    public static final String EXTRA_KIND = "kind"; // "save" or "cancel"

    private static final String CHANNEL = "takeone_recording";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 41;
    /** Focus losses inside this window after a (re)start are spurious. */
    private static final long FOCUS_GRACE_MS = 1200;

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private boolean ticking;
    private boolean busy; // a save/cancel is running
    private int convertingPct = -1;
    private long lastToggleAt;
    private long lastPctPush;
    private long captureStartedAt;

    private static volatile RecordingService activeInstance;

    private PendingIntent cachedContentIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedToggleIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedSaveIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedCancelIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedRestoreIntent;

    private String lastNotifTitle = "";
    private String lastNotifText = "";
    private Boolean lastNotifPaused = null;
    private int lastNotifPct = -2;
    private long lastChronoBaseMs = 0L;

    private AudioManager audioManager;
    private AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener focusListener;

    public static void start(Context ctx, String presetId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_START);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT, presetId);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            } else {
                ctx.startService(i);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                ctx.startService(i);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static void stopService(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.stopService(new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Called by RecordingEngine whenever capture starts, pauses, resumes,
     * finalizes, clears, aborts, or renames, so the notification updates
     * immediately without waiting for the next tick.
     */
    public static void onRecordingStateChanged() {
        RecordingService s = activeInstance;
        if (s != null) {
            s.handler.post(() -> s.refreshNotif(true));
        }
    }

    public static boolean isRunning(Context ctx) {
        // Best-effort: true while the engine holds an active capture session.
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        return e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        super.onCreate();
        activeInstance = this;
        ensureChannel();
        audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        initPendingIntents();
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent == null) {
            // System-restarted. START_NOT_STICKY means this should not happen,
            // but never re-enter startForeground() from here: a restart
            // racing the save could hit the Android 14+ rule that a
            // microphone FGS may not start from the background, and a
            // startForegroundService() that never promotes itself is fatal
            // to the process.
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        String a = intent.getAction();
        if (ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF.equals(a)) {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (e.hasSession() && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                    || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED)) {
                startFg();
                refreshNotif(true);
            } else {
                stopSelf();
            }
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        if (ACTION_START.equals(a)) {
            String preset = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT);
            if (preset != null) RecordPreset.of(preset).save(this);
            captureStartedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            registerFocus();
            startFg();
            startTick();
        } else if (ACTION_TOGGLE.equals(a)) {
            doToggle();
        } else if (ACTION_SAVE.equals(a)) {
            doSave();
        } else if (ACTION_CANCEL.equals(a)) {
            doCancel();
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (activeInstance == this) activeInstance = null;
        stopTick();
        abandonFocus();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ---- audio focus: interruptions pause, never auto-resume ----

    private android.media.AudioFocusRequest focusReq26;

    /**
     * True when a cellular or VoIP call (ringing, dialing, or in-call) is active.
     * Prevents resuming AudioRecord while Android's telephony policy mutes the mic.
     */
    public static boolean isCallActive(Context ctx) {
        if (ctx == null) return false;
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am != null) {
                int mode = am.getMode();
                if (mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_CALL
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_RINGTONE) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            android.telephony.TelephonyManager tm =
                    (android.telephony.TelephonyManager) ctx.getSystemService(
                            Context.TELEPHONY_SERVICE);
            if (tm != null) {
                int callState = tm.getCallState();
                if (callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_RINGING
                        || callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Requests audio focus and returns true only if granted.
     * If a call or exclusive speaker session rejects focus, returns false.
     */
    private boolean registerFocus() {
        try {
            if (isCallActive(this)) return false;
            if (audioManager == null) {
                audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            }
            if (audioManager == null) return true;
            if (focusListener == null) {
                focusListener = focus -> {
                    if (focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK) {
                        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - captureStartedAt
                                < FOCUS_GRACE_MS) {
                            return;
                        }
                        handler.post(() -> {
                            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
                            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                                e.pauseCapture();
                                abandonFocus();
                                boolean call = isCallActive(RecordingService.this);
                                toast(getString(call
                                        ? R.string.msg_paused_call
                                        : R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                                refreshNotif(true);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                };
            }
            int res;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                focusReq26 = new android.media.AudioFocusRequest.Builder(
                        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
                        .setAudioAttributes(new android.media.AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(focusListener, handler)
                        .build();
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusReq26);
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusListener,
                        AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN);
            }
            return res == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    private void abandonFocus() {
        try {
            if (audioManager != null) {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && focusReq26 != null) {
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(focusReq26);
                    focusReq26 = null;
                } else if (focusListener != null) {
                    //noinspection deprecation
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocus(focusListener);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        focusListener = null;
    }

    // ---- actions (debounced: one tap, one transition) ----

    private void doToggle() {
        if (busy) return;
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (now - lastToggleAt < 400) return;
        lastToggleAt = now;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        try {
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                e.pauseCapture();
                abandonFocus();
            } else if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED) {
                if (isCallActive(this)) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_call_active));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                captureStartedAt = now;
                if (!registerFocus()) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                e.resumeCapture(getApplicationContext(),
                        RecordPreset.load(this).audioSource);
            } else {
                return;
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            toast(getString(R.string.msg_need_mic));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            toast(getString(R.string.couldnt_save));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        }
        refreshNotif(true);
    }

    private void doSave() {
        if (busy) return;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        if (!e.hasSession()) {
            stopSelf();
            return;
        }
        if (e.isSaving()) return;
        e.setSaving(true);
        busy = true;
        convertingPct = 0;
        lastPctPush = 0;
        refreshNotif();
        new Thread(() -> {
            boolean ok;
            String msg;
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            try {
                Context appCtx = getApplicationContext();
                if (e.isInSubSession()) {
                    // The notification saved while a Select & Replace
                    // sub-session was open: splice first, then save the parent
                    // instead of exporting only the temporary snippet.
                    boolean commitSub = e.rawFile != null
                            && RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(e.rawFile) > 0;
                    e.exitSelectAndReplaceSubSession(commitSub, null);
                }
                RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
                SaveFormat save = SaveFormat.load(this);
                // NEW-06 fix: honour and clear stashed EditLink when saving
                // an edited take from the notification action.
                String rawPath = e.rawFile != null
                        ? e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() : null;
                long replaceId = -1;
                String replaceTitle = null;
                if (EditLink.matches(appCtx, rawPath)) {
                    replaceId = EditLink.id(appCtx);
                    replaceTitle = EditLink.title(appCtx);
                }
                ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                        appCtx, preset, save, this::setPct,
                        replaceId, replaceTitle);
                EditLink.clear(appCtx);
                if (r.adopted) {
                    if (replaceId > 0) {
                        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replaceId);
                    }
                    String rt = replaceTitle != null
                            && !replaceTitle.isEmpty()
                            ? replaceTitle : r.title;
                    TakesRepository.addRecordingWithId(
                            r.recordingId, r.file, r.durationMs,
                            rt, r.label);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.convert_done_msg, r.title,
                            r.label);
                } else {
                    // Handed to the conversion service; this service is done.
                    ConversionService.startJob(appCtx, r.job.jobId);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.conv_bg_toast);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                ok = false;
                msg = getString(R.string.convert_failed_msg, title);
            }
            final boolean done = ok;
            final String text = msg;
            final String t = title;
            handler.post(() -> {
                e.setSaving(false);
                try {
                    convertingPct = -1;
                    refreshNotif();
                    Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, done);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "save");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, t);
                try {
                    // Explicit package: stays inside the app, satisfies
                    // UnsafeImplicitIntentLaunch, same delivery as before.
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                convertingPct = -1;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    CrashLog.breadcrumb(getApplicationContext(),
                            "service completion FAILED: " + ex);
                    try {
                        stopSelf();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            });
        }).start();
    }

    private void doCancel() {
        if (busy) return;
        if (RecordingEngine.get().isSaving()) return;
        busy = true;
        new Thread(() -> {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            boolean ok = e.abortAndDelete();
            EditLink.clear(getApplicationContext());
            final String text = ok
                    ? getString(R.string.delete_success_one, title)
                    : getString(R.string.delete_failed_msg);
            handler.post(() -> {
                toast(text);
                Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, ok);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "cancel");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, title);
                try {
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
            });
        }).start();
    }

    // ---- notification: one clean standard layout ----

    private void ensureChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;
        try {
            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(
                    CHANNEL, getString(R.string.notif_channel),
                    NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ch.setDescription(getString(R.string.notif_channel_desc));
            nm.createNotificationChannel(ch);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void startFg() {
        lastNotifTitle = "";
        lastNotifText = "";
        lastNotifPaused = null;
        lastNotifPct = -2;
        Notification n = buildNotif();
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n,
                        ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
            }
            return;
        } catch (Exception typed) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "typed startForeground failed: " + typed);
        }
        // Untyped retry: a service launched with startForegroundService()
        // must reach the foreground within ~5s or the system kills the app,
        // so it is always worth attempting the permissive call.
        try {
            startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "startForeground failed: " + e);
            try {
                stopSelf();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void refreshNotif() {
        refreshNotif(false);
    }

    private void refreshNotif(boolean force) {
        try {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (!e.hasSession() && !busy) return;
            String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
            boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
            RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
            String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
            long durMs = e.durationMs();
            String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

            String title;
            String text;
            if (convertingPct >= 0) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
                text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
            } else if (paused) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
                // Chronometer is hidden when paused, so show frozen MM:SS here.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                        + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
            } else {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
                // Native Chronometer in header is the single live timer;
                // do not duplicate a second text timer in contentText.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
            }

            long expectedBase = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            boolean baseDrifted = !paused && convertingPct < 0
                    && Math.abs(expectedBase - lastChronoBaseMs) > 250L;

            if (!force && !baseDrifted
                    && title.equals(lastNotifTitle)
                    && text.equals(lastNotifText)
                    && lastNotifPaused != null && lastNotifPaused == paused
                    && lastNotifPct == convertingPct) {
                return;
            }
            lastNotifTitle = title;
            lastNotifText = text;
            lastNotifPaused = paused;
            lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
            if (!paused && convertingPct < 0) {
                lastChronoBaseMs = expectedBase;
            }

            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm != null) {
                nm.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * A single standard notification: small mic icon, "Recording — name"
     * title, "preset • live timer" text and exactly three actions. Built
     * with NotificationCompat so it renders identically (and lint-clean)
     * from API 24 up, with no custom RemoteViews for the system to duplicate.
     */
    private Notification buildNotif() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
        boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
        long durMs = e.durationMs();
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

        String title;
        String text;
        if (convertingPct >= 0) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
            text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
        } else if (paused) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                    + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
        } else {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
        }
        lastNotifTitle = title;
        lastNotifText = text;
        lastNotifPaused = paused;
        lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
        return buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs);
    }

    private Notification buildNotifWith(String title, String text,
                                        boolean paused, long durMs) {
        if (cachedContentIntent == null && cachedToggleIntent == null) {
            initPendingIntents();
        }
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));
        androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL);
        b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_mic);
        // Match TakeOne brand colors: record red (#FF3B30) when active,
        // amber (#FF9F0A) when paused.
        // Tint only the icon badge and action buttons (never flood-fill the
        // card background with setColorized(true)).
        b.setColor(paused ? 0xFFFF9F0A : 0xFFFF3B30);
        b.setColorized(false);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setCategory(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_SERVICE);
        b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setOngoing(true);
        b.setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        b.setSilent(true);
        if (cachedRestoreIntent != null) {
            b.setDeleteIntent(cachedRestoreIntent);
        }
        // Native SystemUI Chronometer ticks in real time on the system UI
        // thread without requiring sub-second Binder IPC updates.
        if (convertingPct < 0 && !paused) {
            long base = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            lastChronoBaseMs = base;
            b.setWhen(base);
            b.setShowWhen(true);
            b.setUsesChronometer(true);
        } else {
            b.setShowWhen(false);
            b.setUsesChronometer(false);
        }
        if (cachedContentIntent != null) {
            b.setContentIntent(cachedContentIntent);
        }
        if (convertingPct < 0) {
            b.addAction(0,
                    paused ? getString(R.string.notif_resume)
                            : getString(R.string.notif_pause),
                    cachedToggleIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_save),
                    cachedSaveIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_cancel),
                    cachedCancelIntent);
        } else {
            b.setProgress(100, Math.max(0, Math.min(100, convertingPct)), false);
        }
        try {
            Notification n = b.build();
            n.flags |= Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT
                    | Notification.FLAG_NO_CLEAR
                    | Notification.FLAG_FOREGROUND_SERVICE;
            return n;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return new Notification();
        }
    }

    private void initPendingIntents() {
        Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
        open.putExtra("open_studio", true);
        open.setAction("com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO");
        try {
            cachedContentIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 10, open,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            cachedContentIntent = null;
        }
        cachedToggleIntent = action(ACTION_TOGGLE, 21);
        cachedSaveIntent = action(ACTION_SAVE, 22);
        cachedCancelIntent = action(ACTION_CANCEL, 23);
        cachedRestoreIntent = action(ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF, 24);
    }

    private PendingIntent action(String what, int code) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(what);
        try {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
        }
    }

    private void startTick() {
        if (ticking) return;
        ticking = true;
        handler.post(tick);
    }

    private void stopTick() {
        ticking = false;
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
    }

    private final Runnable tick = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            if (!ticking) return;
            refreshNotif(false);
            // Align to the next whole-second boundary while recording so the
            // MM:SS readout steps in sync with the audio duration and never
            // exceeds 1 update/sec.
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            long delay = 1000L;
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                long rem = 1000L - (e.durationMs() % 1000L);
                delay = Math.max(200L, Math.min(1000L, rem));
            }
            handler.postDelayed(this, delay);
        }
    };

    private void setPct(int pct) {
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (pct == convertingPct) return;
        if (pct < 100 && now - lastPctPush < 500) {
            convertingPct = pct;
            return;
        }
        convertingPct = pct;
        lastPctPush = now;
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    private void toast(String text) {
        try {
            Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), text, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.app.Dialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable;
import android.text.InputType;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.Window;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Three-way value control: minus, value, plus.
 *
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tap&lt;/b&gt; minus/plus to step the value.&lt;/li&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Double-tap the value&lt;/b&gt; to type an exact number.&lt;/li&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tap and scroll left/right&lt;/b&gt; anywhere on the control to scrub the
 *       value continuously, without lifting off.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 *
 * A single tap deliberately does nothing: no popup list and no keyboard.
 * Used for teleprompter text size / speed / words-per-line, the FX rack and
 * waveform zoom, so the same muscle memory applies everywhere.
 */
public class TeleValue extends LinearLayout {

    public interface OnValueChanged {
        void onValueChanged(int value);
    }

    /**
     * Continuous scrub notifications. Unlike {@link OnValueChanged}, these fire
     * while the finger is still down; the final committed value is reported
     * through {@link #onScrubFinished(int)} rather than the discrete listener.
     */
    public interface OnScrubListener {
        void onScrubValueChanged(int value);
        void onScrubFinished(int value);
    }

    private static final int DOUBLE_TAP_MS = 280;

    private int min;
    private int max = 100;
    private int step = 1;
    private int value;
    private String unit = "";

    public interface StepRule {
        int stepFor(int currentValue, int direction);
    }

    /**
     * Optional presentation override so a consumer can render dB, Hz or ratio
     * labels without subclassing. When unset, the numeric value is joined
     * with the configured unit.
     */
    public interface ValueFormatter {
        String formatValueText(int value);
    }

    private int valueScale = 1;
    private StepRule stepRule;
    private ValueFormatter valueFormatter;
    private Runnable paywallInterceptor;

    public void setValueFormatter(ValueFormatter formatter) {
        this.valueFormatter = formatter;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    /**
     * When non-null, marks this control as locked by the paywall on subsequent
     * recordings: visually dimmed ({@code alpha = 0.35f}) while keeping its
     * minus, plus, and value buttons clickable so any tap or scrub opens the
     * paywall immediately.
     */
    public void setPaywallInterceptor(Runnable interceptor) {
        this.paywallInterceptor = interceptor;
        setAlpha(interceptor != null ? 0.35f : 1f);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    /**
     * Fixed-point divisor for high-resolution controls (e.g. 100 for basis
     * points where 10000 = 100% and 92 = 0.92%). Default is 1 (integer).
     */
    public void setValueScale(int scale) {
        this.valueScale = Math.max(1, scale);
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    public int getValueScale() {
        return valueScale;
    }

    public void setStepRule(StepRule rule) {
        this.stepRule = rule;
    }

    private int effectiveStep(int fromValue, int dir) {
        if (stepRule != null) {
            return Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(fromValue, dir));
        }
        return Math.max(1, step);
    }

    private String formatNumberPart(int v) {
        if (valueScale <= 1) {
            return String.valueOf(v);
        }
        if (v % valueScale == 0) {
            return String.valueOf(v / valueScale);
        }
        double d = v / (double) valueScale;
        if (Math.abs((long) v) >= 10L * valueScale) {
            String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", d);
            if (s.endsWith(".0")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 2);
            return s;
        }
        String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", d);
        while (s.contains(".") && (s.endsWith("0") || s.endsWith("."))) {
            if (s.endsWith(".")) {
                s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
                break;
            }
            s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        }
        return s;
    }

    private String formatValueText(int v) {
        if (valueFormatter != null) {
            return valueFormatter.formatValueText(v);
        }
        String num = formatNumberPart(v);
        return unit.isEmpty() ? num : num + unit;
    }

    private OnValueChanged listener;
    private OnScrubListener scrubListener;

    private TextView caption;
    private LinearLayout controlRow;
    private boolean stacked;
    private TextView minus;
    private TextView plus;
    private TextView label;

    private float downX;
    private boolean scrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubEnabled;
    private float downY;
    private int activePointerId = -1;
    private boolean movedBeyondSlop;
    private int dragStartValue;
    private float dragStartPos;
    private long lastTapAt = -DOUBLE_TAP_MS - 1;
    private boolean compact;
    private Dialog keyboardDialog;

    public TeleValue(Context context) {
        this(context, null);
    }

    /** Required for XML inflation; without it the studio screen crashes. */
    public TeleValue(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        build(context);
    }

    private void build(Context ctx) {
        setOrientation(VERTICAL);
        setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);

        caption = new TextView(ctx);
        caption.setTextSize(8.5f);
        caption.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        caption.setTextColor(0xFF8A93A0);
        caption.setSingleLine(true);
        caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        addView(caption, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        row.setOrientation(HORIZONTAL);
        row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
        row.setPadding(dp(ctx, 2), 0, dp(ctx, 2), 0);
        controlRow = row;

        minus = button(ctx, "−");
        plus = button(ctx, "+");

        label = new TextView(ctx);
        label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        label.setTextSize(12);
        label.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        label.setSingleLine(true);
        label.setMaxLines(1);
        label.setContentDescription("value");
        // The system long-press listener is intentionally not used: Android
        // would schedule the keyboard as soon as the finger rests, even if the
        // user then begins a scrub. A value hold is detected below instead.
        label.setLongClickable(false);

        row.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                        LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
        row.addView(label, lp);
        row.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));

        addView(row, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dp(ctx, 26)));

        minus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, -1);
            int next = value - s;
            // If stepping down lands within one step of min, snap to min.
            if (value > min && next < min) next = min;
            setValue(next, true);
        });
        plus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, 1);
            setValue(value + s, true);
        });

        // A single tap is intentionally inert when unlocked. Only a double-tap
        // opens the exact-value keyboard; when paywall-locked, any tap opens
        // the paywall.
        label.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (scrubbing || movedBeyondSlop) return;
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
            if (now - lastTapAt < DOUBLE_TAP_MS) {
                lastTapAt = 0;
                showKeyboardInput();
            } else {
                lastTapAt = now;
            }
        });
    }

    private void updateStepperButtons() {
        if (minus == null || plus == null) return;
        if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
            minus.setEnabled(true);
            minus.setClickable(true);
            minus.setAlpha(1f);
            plus.setEnabled(true);
            plus.setClickable(true);
            plus.setAlpha(1f);
            return;
        }
        boolean canDec = value > min;
        boolean canInc = value < max;
        minus.setEnabled(canDec);
        minus.setClickable(canDec);
        minus.setAlpha(canDec ? 1f : 0.35f);
        plus.setEnabled(canInc);
        plus.setClickable(canInc);
        plus.setAlpha(canInc ? 1f : 0.35f);
    }

    private void clearChildPress() {
        if (minus != null) {
            minus.cancelLongPress();
            minus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (plus != null) {
            plus.cancelLongPress();
            plus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.cancelLongPress();
            label.setPressed(false);
        }
    }

    private TextView button(Context ctx, String glyph) {
        TextView t = new TextView(ctx);
        t.setText(glyph);
        t.setTextSize(15);
        t.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        t.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        t.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_round_btn);
        t.setContentDescription(glyph.equals("+") ? "increase" : "decrease");
        return t;
    }

    public boolean isStacked() {
        return stacked;
    }

    /** Small name shown above the stepper, so controls need no external label. */
    public void setCaption(String s) {
        if (caption == null) return;
        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) {
            caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        } else {
            caption.setText(s);
            caption.setVisibility(VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Stacks minus/value/plus vertically for a narrow rail, such as waveform
     * zoom. Gesture handling is unchanged: a horizontal scrub still adjusts
     * the value, while taps retain their four behaviours.
     */
    public void setStacked(boolean stacked) {
        if (controlRow == null || minus == null || label == null || plus == null) {
            return;
        }
        this.stacked = stacked;
        int button = dp(getContext(), 26);
        int height = dp(getContext(), 24);
        controlRow.setOrientation(stacked ? VERTICAL : HORIZONTAL);
        controlRow.setGravity(stacked ? Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
                : Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        controlRow.removeAllViews();
        if (stacked) {
            // The row must wrap its content: it was built for a single 24dp
            // horizontal strip, which would crush a vertical stack to 2px.
            // High-resolution labels ("0.92%") also need a slightly more
            // compact text size to fit cleanly inside the 40dp rail.
            // Plus sits on top, minus at the bottom, matching the drag
            // direction (up increases, down decreases).
            label.setTextSize(10.5f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(getContext(), 20)));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        } else {
            label.setTextSize(12f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, height));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(0,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    /**
     * Compacts the control for dense FX cards: smaller caption, label and
     * stepper buttons without changing its gestures. Ignored in stacked mode
     * because that rail already has its own sizing.
     */
    public void setCompact(boolean compact) {
        this.compact = compact;
        Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (caption != null) {
            caption.setTextSize(compact ? 8f : 8.5f);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.setTextSize(compact ? 11f : 12f);
        }
        if (!stacked && controlRow != null
                && minus != null && plus != null) {
            int size = dp(ctx, compact ? 22 : 26);
            minus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            plus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            if (controlRow.getLayoutParams() instanceof LayoutParams) {
                LayoutParams rp = (LayoutParams)
                        controlRow.getLayoutParams();
                rp.height = size;
                controlRow.setLayoutParams(rp);
            }
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean isCompact() {
        return compact;
    }

    /** Values the wheel may show when {@code step > 1}, padded to range. */
    private int[] steppedValues() {
        java.util.ArrayList&lt;Integer&gt; out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (stepRule != null) {
            int cur = min;
            out.add(cur);
            while (cur < max) {
                int s = Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(cur, 1));
                int next = (cur == min && s > 1)
                        ? ((cur / s) + 1) * s
                        : cur + s;
                if (next <= cur) next = cur + 1;
                if (next >= max) {
                    out.add(max);
                    break;
                }
                out.add(next);
                cur = next;
            }
        } else {
            int rem = ((min % step) + step) % step;
            int first = (rem == 0) ? min : Math.min(max, min + (step - rem));
            if (first > min && (valueScale > 1 || min < 0)) {
                out.add(min);
            }
            for (int v = first; v <= max; v += step) {
                out.add(v);
            }
            if (!out.isEmpty() && out.get(out.size() - 1) < max) {
                out.add(max);
            }
            if (out.isEmpty()) {
                for (int v = min; v <= max; v++) out.add(v);
            }
        }
        int[] arr = new int[out.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) arr[i] = out.get(i);
        return arr;
    }

    private String[] steppedLabels() {
        int[] vals = steppedValues();
        String[] out = new String[vals.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
            out[i] = formatValueText(vals[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Test hook: the wheel labels for the configured step. */
    String[] steppedLabelsForTest() {
        return steppedLabels();
    }

    public void configure(int min, int max, int step, int value, String unit) {
        this.min = min;
        this.max = max;
        this.step = Math.max(1, step);
        this.unit = unit == null ? "" : unit;
        setValue(value, false);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    public void setOnValueChanged(OnValueChanged l) {
        listener = l;
    }

    public void setOnScrubListener(OnScrubListener l) {
        scrubListener = l;
    }

    /**
     * Allows vertical drags to scrub the value (drag up increases), reported
     * through the same {@link OnScrubListener} as horizontal scrubs. Off by
     * default so a vertical pass over an unrelated control stays inert.
     */
    public void setVerticalScrub(boolean enabled) {
        verticalScrubEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public int getValue() {
        return value;
    }

    public int getMin() {
        return min;
    }

    private int clamp(int v) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
    }

    public void setValue(int v, boolean notify) {
        int nv = clamp(v);
        String formatted = formatValueText(nv);
        if (nv == value && label != null
                && formatted.contentEquals(label.getText())) {
            updateStepperButtons();
            return;
        }
        value = nv;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatted);
        }
        updateStepperButtons();
        if (notify && listener != null) listener.onValueChanged(value);
    }

    // ---- keyboard ----

    private String captionTitle() {
        CharSequence cap = caption != null ? caption.getText() : null;
        if (cap != null && cap.length() > 0) {
            return cap.toString();
        }
        return getContext().getString(R.string.tele_value_picker);
    }

    private static void styleModalWindow(Dialog dialog) {
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(dialog);
    }

    /** Overridable presentation hook so gesture routing is unit-testable. */
    protected void showKeyboardInput() {
        final Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (keyboardDialog != null && keyboardDialog.isShowing()) return;

            keyboardDialog = d;

                if (keyboardDialog == d) keyboardDialog = null;

            input.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            input.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            input.setHintTextColor(0xFF5D6672);
            input.setTextSize(16);
            input.setSingleLine(true);
            input.setMaxLines(1);

            // (e.g. a -24..+24 dB trim), so every existing positive-only
            // control keeps its familiar keypad.

            if (min < 0) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_SIGNED;
            }

                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_DECIMAL;
            }

            input.setSelectAllOnFocus(true);

                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(ctx, 50)));
            box.addView(inputBox, ibLp);

            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);

                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);

            cancelBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

            cancelBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);

            okBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.settings_done));
            okBtn.setTextSize(14);
            okBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            okBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            okBtn.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);

            half.rightMargin = dp(ctx, 6);

            half2.leftMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            row.addView(cancelBtn, half);
            row.addView(okBtn, half2);
            box.addView(row, rowLp);
            PressAnim.apply(cancelBtn);
            PressAnim.apply(okBtn);

            d.setContentView(box);
            input.setImeOptions(android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                    .IME_ACTION_DONE);
            input.setOnEditorActionListener((v2, actionId, ev) -> {
                if (actionId == android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                        .IME_ACTION_DONE) {
                    commitTyped(input);
                    d.dismiss();
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            });
            cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> d.dismiss());
            okBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                commitTyped(input);
                d.dismiss();

                w.setSoftInputMode(WindowManager.LayoutParams
                        .SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                        | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
            }

            d.show();
            input.post(() -> {
                android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager imm =
                        (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager) ctx
                                .getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
                if (imm != null) {
                    imm.showSoftInput(input,
                            android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager
                                    .SHOW_IMPLICIT);
                }
            });
            // Back / outside-tap dismisses WITHOUT committing: cancelling
            // must never mutate the value.
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            keyboardDialog = null;
        }
    }

    /** Parses and commits the typed value exactly once. */
    private void commitTyped(EditText input) {
        try {
            String raw = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (raw.isEmpty()) return;
            int v = valueScale > 1
                    ? (int) Math.round(Double.parseDouble(raw) * valueScale)
                    : Integer.parseInt(raw);
            setValue(v, true);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    /**
     * Horizontal scrubs are intercepted here rather than in an
     * {@code OnTouchListener}: the minus, value and plus children are all
     * clickable, so they consume ACTION_DOWN and the parent would never see
     * the gesture at all.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Only a clean tap reaches the children. Motion beyond touch slop is
     * consumed here, so a scrolling finger can never turn into a value change
     * or a stray double-tap.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                downX = ev.getX();
                downY = ev.getY();
                activePointerId = eventPointerId(ev, 0);
                movedBeyondSlop = false;
                scrubbing = false;
                verticalScrubbing = false;
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN:
                // A second finger invalidates tap and double-tap semantics.
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                clearChildPress();
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                int pointerIndex = ev.findPointerIndex(activePointerId);
                if (pointerIndex < 0) return true;
                float x = ev.getX(pointerIndex);
                float y = ev.getY(pointerIndex);
                float dx = x - downX;
                float dy = y - downY;
                float slop = ViewConfiguration.get(getContext())
                        .getScaledTouchSlop();
                if (!movedBeyondSlop
                        && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > slop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = true;
                    clearChildPress();
                }
                if (!scrubbing && !verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Claim the gesture once its direction is clear. A
                    // vertical move is consumed so it cannot become a tap
                    // when the finger lifts — unless vertical scrubbing is
                    // enabled, in which case it drives the value.
                    if (!movedBeyondSlop) {
                        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
                    }
                    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
                        scrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        dragStartPos = x;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else if (verticalScrubEnabled) {
                        verticalScrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        // Anchor at the current position like horizontal
                        // scrub does: anchoring at the touch-down point
                        // makes the value jump by the slop distance.
                        dragStartPos = y;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                    return true;
                }
                if (verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Drag upward increases the value, drag downward decreases it,
                    // matching the direction the finger moves away from the
                    // starting point.
                    int delta = (int) Math.round((dragStartPos - y)
                            / dp(getContext(), 7));
                    int s = effectiveStep(dragStartValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
                    setLiveValue(dragStartValue + delta * s);
                    return true;
                }
                int delta = (int) Math.round((x - dragStartPos)
                        / dp(getContext(), 7));
                scrubTo(dragStartValue, delta);
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP: {
                int lifted = eventPointerId(ev, ev.getActionIndex());
                if (lifted == activePointerId) {
                    return finishInterruptedGesture();
                }
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
                    scrubbing = false;
                    verticalScrubbing = false;
                    if (getParent() != null) {
                        getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
                    }
                    if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                        paywallInterceptor.run();
                        return true;
                    }
                    // A scrub reports through the scrub listener only. The
                    // discrete listener remains reserved for +/- and keyboard
                    // commits.
                    if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
                    performClick();
                    return true;
                }
                if (movedBeyondSlop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = false;
                    return true;
                }
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            default:
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
        }
    }

    private boolean finishInterruptedGesture() {
        activePointerId = -1;
        if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
            scrubbing = false;
            verticalScrubbing = false;
            if (getParent() != null) {
                getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
            }
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
            performClick();
        }
        movedBeyondSlop = true;
        return true;
    }

    private static int eventPointerId(MotionEvent ev, int pointerIndex) {
        try {
            return ev.getPointerId(pointerIndex);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    private void setLiveValue(int v) {
        int before = value;
        setValue(v, false);
        if (value != before && scrubListener != null) {
            scrubListener.onScrubValueChanged(value);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies a scrub delta measured in 7dp ticks. Without a step rule this
     * is one fixed step per tick; with a piecewise rule (e.g. zoom) each
     * tick steps from the running value so bracket boundaries are honored
     * instead of extrapolating a single step across the whole drag.
     */
    private void scrubTo(int startValue, int delta) {
        if (delta == 0) {
            setLiveValue(startValue);
            return;
        }
        if (stepRule == null) {
            int s = effectiveStep(startValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
            setLiveValue(startValue + delta * s);
            return;
        }
        int dir = delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
        int v = startValue;
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.abs(delta); i++) {
            v += effectiveStep(v, dir);
        }
        setLiveValue(v);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        scrubbing = false;
        verticalScrubbing = false;
        movedBeyondSlop = false;
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    private static int dp(Context c, int v) {
        return Math.round(v * c.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}


--- FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/PressAnim.java ---
package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.PathInterpolator;

/**
 * Restrained press feedback for every tappable view.
 *
 * The effect is deliberately shallow — a small scale dip plus a barely-there
 * alpha change — and every transition runs on a falloff curve so the motion
 * decays quickly instead of flashing. Nothing here changes layout, so it can
 * safely coexist with the selection scale driven by the adapter.
 */
public final class PressAnim {

    /** Fast lift-off, long settle: the "falloff" easing used on release. */
    private static final PathInterpolator FALLOFF =
            new PathInterpolator(0.2f, 0f, 0f, 1f);
    /** Opposite curve for pressing in: moves a little, then eases. */
    private static final PathInterpolator SETTLE_IN =
            new PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0f, 0.6f, 1f);

    private PressAnim() {}

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void apply(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    // A disabled or non-clickable chip must not give press
                    // feedback: that is what made disabled actions look tappable.
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(0.97f).scaleY(0.97f)
                            .alpha(0.9f)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .alpha(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false; // let click listeners still fire
        });
    }

    public static void applyAll(View... views) {
        if (views == null) return;
        for (View v : views) apply(v);
    }

    /**
     * Gentler variant for elements that already have their own emphasis
     * (icons, chips): scales a touch and never dips alpha, so there is no
     * visible flash — just a soft give.
     */
    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void applySoft(View v, final float pressedScale) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(pressedScale).scaleY(pressedScale)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Small confirmation pop for icons — a light nudge on the same falloff
     * curve. Used instead of a hard overshoot so nothing flashes.
     */
    public static void nudge(View v, float peak) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate().scaleX(peak).scaleY(peak)
                .setDuration(90).setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate()
                        .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(260).setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN).start())
                .start();
    }

    /** One-shot entrance pop used for dialog icons. */
    public static void pop(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setScaleX(0.6f);
        v.setScaleY(0.6f);
        v.setAlpha(0f);
        v.animate()
                .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(280)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Job registry rules: one job per raw, stable card ids, cancel cleanup, and
 * the startup sweep resurrecting interrupted jobs while dropping garbage.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConversionJobsTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void takeIdsAreNegativeAndStable() {
        ConversionJob a = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob b = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("take id must be negative", a.takeId() < 0);
        assertEquals("take id must be stable", a.takeId(), b.takeId());
        ConversionJob c = new ConversionJob("job-2", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("different jobs must differ", c.takeId() != a.takeId());
    }

    @Test
    public void sidecarRoundTrip() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobtest.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-9", "Title",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.progress = 42;
        job.framesDone = 100000;
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals("job-9", back.jobId);
            assertEquals("Title", back.title);
            assertEquals(42, back.progress);
            assertEquals(100000, back.framesDone);
            assertEquals(1, back.channels);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void enqueueDedupesAndCancelCleans() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Job Test", 2);
        try {
            ConversionJob first = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            ConversionJob second = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            assertTrue("same raw must return the same job",
                    first.jobId.equals(second.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar missing", first.sidecar().exists());
            assertTrue("not active",
                    ConversionJobs.forRaw(engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())
                            != null);
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.cancel(first.jobId, false));
            assertNull("still active after cancel",
                    ConversionJobs.get(first.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar survived cancel", !first.sidecar().exists());
        } finally {
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsAndCleans() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "sweep.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-sweep", "Sweep",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.write();
        File orphanPart = new File(dir, "orphan.wav.part");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(orphanPart, "rw").close();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean found = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep")) found = true;
            }
            assertTrue("interrupted job was not resurrected", found);
            assertTrue("orphan part survived", !orphanPart.exists());
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
            assertTrue("raw survived cancel", !raw.exists());
        } finally {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                orphanPart.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            job.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void replaceLineageSurvivesSidecar() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobreplace.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-rep", "Edit",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.replaceTakeId = 12345L;
        job.replaceTitle = "Original";
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals(12345L, back.replaceTakeId);
            assertEquals("Original", back.replaceTitle);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
        // Old sidecars without the keys default to "no lineage".
        ConversionJob plain = new ConversionJob("job-plain", "T",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertEquals(-1L, plain.replaceTakeId);
        assertNull(plain.replaceTitle);
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsEveryJob() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw1 = new File(dir, "sweep1.wav");
        File raw2 = new File(dir, "sweep2.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw1, "rw").close();
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw2, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob j1 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-1", "One",
                raw1.getAbsolutePath(), raw1.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob j2 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-2", "Two",
                raw2.getAbsolutePath(), raw2.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        j1.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        j2.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
        j1.write();
        j2.write();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean f1 = false, f2 = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-1")) f1 = true;
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-2")) f2 = true;
            }
            assertTrue("first job lost", f1);
            assertTrue("second job lost (only first resumed)", f2);
        } finally {
            try {
                raw1.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                raw2.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            j1.deleteSidecar();
            j2.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-1", true);
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-2", true);
        }
    }
