    }

    private void showMassExportOptions() {
        List<Take> files = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (selection.contains(t.id) && t.hasFile()) files.add(t);
        }
        if (files.isEmpty()) return;
        final int n = files.size();
        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_share,
                getString(R.string.export_share_multi, n), () -> shareFiles(files)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_folder,
                getString(R.string.export_save_multi, n),
                () -> launchFolderPicker(files)));
        OptionsSheet.showOptions(requireContext(), getString(R.string.action_export),
                getString(R.string.export_subtitle, n) + "\n"
                        + getString(R.string.export_current_location,
                        currentTakesDirLabel()),
                items);
    }

    private void shareFiles(List<Take> takes) {
        try {
            String authority = requireContext().getPackageName() + ".fileprovider";
            ArrayList<Uri> uris = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Take t : takes) {
                uris.add(FileProvider.getUriForFile(requireContext(), authority,
                        new File(t.filePath)));
            }
            Intent intent;
            if (uris.size() == 1) {
                intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND);
                intent.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uris.get(0));
            } else {
                intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE);
                intent.putParcelableArrayListExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uris);
            }
            intent.setType("audio/*");
            intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
            startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, getString(R.string.action_export)));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                    "Export failed", null);
        }
    }

    // ---- unified export: user picks a folder (SAF), we copy file(s) there ----

    /** Both single-card and multi-select export go through this one picker. */
    private void launchFolderPicker(List<Take> takes) {
        List<Take> withFiles = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Take t : takes) {
            if (t != null && t.hasFile()) withFiles.add(t);
        }
        if (withFiles.isEmpty()) {
            OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                    getString(R.string.couldnt_save_title),
                    getString(R.string.couldnt_save));
            return;
        }
        pendingExportTakes = withFiles;
        try {
            openTreeLauncher.launch(null);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            pendingExportTakes = null;
            OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                    getString(R.string.couldnt_save_title),
                    getString(R.string.couldnt_export));
        }
    }

    private void exportTakesToFolder(List<Take> takes, Uri treeUri) {
        final Context app = requireContext().getApplicationContext();
        final List<Take> copy = new ArrayList<>(takes);
        final String folderLabel = resolveFolderLabel(treeUri);
        new Thread(() -> {
            final List<String> savedNames = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Take t : copy) {
                String name = saveOneToTree(app, t, treeUri);
                if (name != null) savedNames.add(name);
            }
            final int n = savedNames.size();
            final int total = copy.size();
            handler.post(() -> {
                if (getView() == null || !isAdded()) return;
                if (n == total) {
                    OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Export complete");
                } else if (n > 0) {
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                            "Export partial", null);
                } else {
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                            "Export failed", null);
                }
            });
        }).start();
    }

    /**
     * Copies one take into the user-picked tree URI.
     *
     * @return the file name actually created, or null on failure.
     */
    private String saveOneToTree(Context ctx, Take t, Uri treeUri) {
        File src = new File(t.filePath);
        if (!src.exists()) return null;
        try {
            DocumentFile dir = DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(ctx, treeUri);
            if (dir == null || !dir.canWrite()) return null;
            String wanted = safeName(src.getName());
            String uniqueName = uniqueDocName(dir, wanted);
            String mime = mimeFor(uniqueName);
            DocumentFile out = dir.createFile(mime, uniqueName);
            if (out == null) return null;
            // Some providers append their canonical extension to a name that
            // already has one ("audio/3gpp" turns ".3gp" into ".3gp.3ga").
            // Rename back to the exact requested name when that happens.
            String createdName = out.getName();
            if (createdName != null && !createdName.equals(uniqueName)) {
                try {
                    out.renameTo(uniqueName);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(src);
                 OutputStream outStream = ctx.getContentResolver().openOutputStream(
                         out.getUri())) {
                if (outStream == null) {
                    try {
                        out.delete();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    return null;
                }
                copyStream(in, outStream);
            }
            String actual = out.getName();
            return actual != null ? actual : uniqueName;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String uniqueDocName(DocumentFile dir, String wanted) {
        // Some providers append ".mp4" to an .m4a name behind our back, so a
        // bare findFile(wanted) misses the file that is actually on disk.
        if (dir.findFile(wanted) == null
                && dir.findFile(wanted + ".mp4") == null) {
            return wanted;
        }
        String base = wanted;
        String ext = "";
        int dot = wanted.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0) {
            base = wanted.substring(0, dot);
            ext = wanted.substring(dot);
        }
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            String candidate = base + " (" + i + ")" + ext;
            if (dir.findFile(candidate) == null
                    && dir.findFile(candidate + ".mp4") == null) {
                return candidate;
            }
            i++;
        }
    }

    private String mimeFor(String name) {
        String lower = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (lower.endsWith(".wav")) return "audio/wav";
        // "audio/mp4" makes the provider append ".mp4" to .m4a names
        // ("Take.m4a.mp4"); mp4a-latm resolves to ".m4a" instead.
        if (lower.endsWith(".m4a")) return "audio/mp4a-latm";
        if (lower.endsWith(".mp4")) return "audio/mp4";
        if (lower.endsWith(".mp3")) return "audio/mpeg";
        if (lower.endsWith(".opus") || lower.endsWith(".ogg")) {
            return "audio/ogg";
        }
        if (lower.endsWith(".flac")) return "audio/flac";
        if (lower.endsWith(".webm")) return "audio/webm";
        if (lower.endsWith(".3gp") || lower.endsWith(".3gpp")
                || lower.endsWith(".3ga")) return "audio/3gpp";
        return "audio/*";
    }

    /** Best-effort human-readable label for the picked folder. */
    private String resolveFolderLabel(Uri treeUri) {
        if (treeUri == null) return "";
        String name = null;
        try {
            try (Cursor c = requireContext().getContentResolver().query(
                    treeUri, new String[]{OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME},
                    null, null, null)) {
                if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                    int col = c.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                    if (col >= 0) name = c.getString(col);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                name = Uri.decode(treeUri.getLastPathSegment());
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) return treeUri.toString();
        // Tree URIs look like "primary:Download/Backup" — keep the tail.
        int colon = name.lastIndexOf(':');
        if (colon >= 0 && colon < name.length() - 1) name = name.substring(colon + 1);
        int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash >= 0 && slash < name.length() - 1 && name.contains(":")) {
            name = name.substring(slash + 1);
        }
        return name;
    }

    /** Where takes currently live on this device (shown in the export dialog). */
    private String currentTakesDirLabel() {
        try {
            File base = requireContext().getExternalFilesDir(null);
            if (base == null) base = requireContext().getFilesDir();
            return new File(base, "takes").getAbsolutePath();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private void copyStream(InputStream in, OutputStream out) throws Exception {
        byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
        int n;
        while ((n = in.read(buf)) != -1) out.write(buf, 0, n);
        out.flush();
    }

    private String safeName(String name) {
        return name.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_");
    }

    // ---- back handling ----
    // Order: selection -> open search -> double-press exit. True = consumed.

    public boolean onBackPressed() {
        if (selectionMode) {
            exitSelection();
            return true;
        }
        if (isSearchOpen()) {
            closeSearch();
            return true;
        }
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (now - lastBackPress < 2000) {
            return false; // let the activity exit
        }
        lastBackPress = now;
        View root = getView();
        if (root != null) {
            Snackbar.make(root, R.string.press_back_exit, Snackbar.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private View fabWrap;
    private View fabHalo;
    private ImageView fabIcon;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {

        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES);
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main);

        fabWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
        fabHalo = findViewById(R.id.fabHalo);
        fabIcon = findViewById(R.id.fabIcon);
        fabStopWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabStopWrap);

        // Smooth press animation: shrink on touch-down, spring back on release.
        fabWrap.setOnTouchListener((v, event) -> {
            if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.9f).scaleY(0.9f).setDuration(120).start();
            } else if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                    || event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(160).start();
            }
            return false;
        });
        fabWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Debounced: one tap, one transition. Guards against double
            // delivery that used to start-then-instantly-pause takes.
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastFabPress < 400) return;
            lastFabPress = now;
            if (!inStudio) {
                pulseHalo();
                openStudio();
            } else {
                StudioFragment st = studio();
                if (st != null) st.onFabPressed();
            }
        });
        PressAnim.apply(fabStopWrap);
        fabStopWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastStopPress < 400) return;
            lastStopPress = now;
            StudioFragment st = studio();
            if (st != null) st.onStopPressed();
        });

        getOnBackPressedDispatcher().addCallback(this, backCallback =
                new OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            @Override
            public void handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (inStudio) {
                    StudioFragment st = studio();
                    if (st != null) {
                        st.onBackPressed();
                    } else {
                        exitStudio();
                    }
                } else {
                    Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
                    boolean consumed = f instanceof LibraryFragment
                            && ((LibraryFragment) f).onBackPressed();
                    if (!consumed) {
                        finish();
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        if (savedInstanceState != null) {
            inStudio = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("inStudio", false);
            recoveryChecked = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("recoveryChecked", false);
        } else {
            getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                    .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                    .commitAllowingStateLoss();
        }

        handleOpenStudioIntent(getIntent());
        // Library loads async (Room + disk reconcile). Recovery + first paint
        // wait for it so prompts see adopted orphans and pruned rows.
        TakesRepository.init(this);
        TrialAndBillingManager.get(this).connectAndSync();
        TakesRepository.onReady(() -> {
            if (!recoveryChecked) {
                recoveryChecked = true;
                fabWrap.post(this::checkUnfinishedTakes);
            } else {
                fabWrap.post(this::refreshLibraryIfShown);
            }
            maybeAnnounceRecovered();
            maybeHealCrashedEncoder();
            maybeShowCrashReport();
        });
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    /**
     * Self-healing after an encoder kills a save: the breadcrumbs name the
     * exact format that never finished. Step one rung down the reliability
     * ladder (exotic -> AAC -> pure-Java WAV) so the next recording can
     * actually save on this device.
     */
    private void maybeHealCrashedEncoder() {
        String stage;
        try {
            stage = CrashLog.unterminatedStage(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (stage == null || !stage.startsWith("convert ") || inStudio) return;
        String crashedId = stage.substring("convert ".length()).trim();
        SaveFormat crashed = SaveFormat.of(crashedId);
        SaveFormat current = SaveFormat.load(this);
        SaveFormat currentEff = current.effective(RecordPreset.load(this));
        // Only act while the user still has the killer selected: a manual
        // switch since the crash is respected, not overridden.
        if (currentEff != crashed) return;
        SaveFormat fallback = crashed.fallbackAfterCrash();
        if (fallback == null) return;
        try {
            fallback.save(this);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this,
                    "auto-switch " + crashed.id + "->" + fallback.id);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // A Java crash file already tells the story (breadcrumbs included):
        // don't stack a second dialog on top of its share prompt.
        boolean crashFile;
        try {
            crashFile = CrashLog.recentCrash(this) != null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            crashFile = false;
        }
        if (crashFile) return;
        final String from = crashed.badge;
        final String to = fallback.badge;
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_msg, from, to),
                        () -> { });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One surfacing of the previous run's crash log, with share + dismiss. */
    private void maybeShowCrashReport() {
        File crash = CrashLog.recentCrash(this);
        if (crash == null || inStudio) return;
        // Stale reports auto-expire: only a fresh crash nags, and sharing
        // clears it. Cancelling keeps it for the next launch (bounded by
        // the same freshness window).
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - crash.lastModified()
                > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L) {
            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
            return;
        }
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showConfirm(this,
                        getString(R.string.crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.crash_msg),
                        getString(R.string.crash_share),
                        R.drawable.ic_close, false,
                        () -> {
                            CrashLog.share(this, crash);
                            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
                        });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One summary popup when the startup sweep adopted orphaned files. */
    private void maybeAnnounceRecovered() {
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.lastReconcile();
        if (rr == null || rr.adopted <= 0 || inStudio) return;
        // Posted: dialogs need a resumed activity, and onReady can fire
        // synchronously inside onCreate after a rotation.
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(this, "Takes recovered");
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    void refreshLibraryIfShown() {
        try {
            Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
            if (f instanceof LibraryFragment && f.isAdded()) {
                ((LibraryFragment) f).refreshExternal();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @Override
    protected void onNewIntent(Intent intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent);
        setIntent(intent);
        handleOpenStudioIntent(intent);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (backCallback != null) backCallback.setEnabled(true);
        syncFabWithEngine();
        for (ConversionJob j : ConversionJobs.active()) {
            if (ConversionJob.QUEUED.equals(j.state)) {
                ConversionService.startJob(this, j.jobId);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSaveInstanceState(Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putBoolean("inStudio", inStudio);
        outState.putBoolean("recoveryChecked", recoveryChecked);
    }

    private void handleOpenStudioIntent(Intent intent) {
        if (intent == null) return;
        boolean open = intent.getBooleanExtra("open_studio", false)
                || "com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO".equals(intent.getAction());
        if (open && RecordingEngine.get().hasSession() && !inStudio) {
            openStudio();
        }
        try {
            intent.removeExtra("open_studio");
            intent.setAction(null);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public void openStudio() {
        inStudio = true;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out,
                        R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right)
                .replace(R.id.container, new StudioFragment(), "STU")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    public void openStudioWithRecovery(File rawFile) {
        // Crash recovery reopens directly in the recording state.
        openStudioWithSession(rawFile.getAbsolutePath(), true, -1, null);
    }

    /** Edit punch-in: session pre-loaded, timer correct, waits for mic tap. */
    public void openStudioWithEdit(File rawFile, long sourceId, String sourceTitle) {
        openStudioWithSession(rawFile.getAbsolutePath(), false, sourceId, sourceTitle);
    }

    private void openStudioWithSession(String rawPath, boolean autostart,
                                       long editSourceId, String editSourceTitle) {
        inStudio = true;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        StudioFragment f = new StudioFragment();
        Bundle b = new Bundle();
        b.putString("recover_raw", rawPath);
        b.putBoolean("autostart", autostart);
        if (editSourceId != -1) {
            b.putLong("edit_source_id", editSourceId);
            b.putString("edit_source_title", editSourceTitle);
        }
        f.setArguments(b);
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out,
                        R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right)
                .replace(R.id.container, f, "STU")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    public void exitStudio() {
        inStudio = false;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right,
                        R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out)
                .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    // ---- split record controls ----

    /**
     * Main FAB artwork morph (mic / pause / play) with a smooth shrink-swap-pop.
     * Scale-only: the old rotation accumulated 70° on every tap, visibly
     * twisting the icon over time. The split stop button is shown separately
     * while a take is active.
     */
    public void morphFabIcon(int resId) {
        if (fabIconRes == resId) return;
        fabIconRes = resId;
        fabIcon.animate().cancel();
        // Snap rotation back first so repeated morphs can never accumulate.
        fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
        fabIcon.animate()
                .scaleX(0.35f).scaleY(0.35f)
                .setDuration(110)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .withEndAction(() -> {
                    try {
                        fabIcon.setImageResource(resId);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
                    fabIcon.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(230)
                            .setInterpolator(new OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                            .start();
                })
                .start();
    }

    /** Show/hide the split stop button with a pop. */
    public void setStopVisible(boolean visible) {
        if (visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            PressAnim.pop(fabStopWrap);
        } else if (!visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.animate().cancel();
            fabStopWrap.animate()
                    .scaleX(0.4f).scaleY(0.4f)
                    .alpha(0f)
                    .setDuration(150)
                    .withEndAction(() -> {
                        fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleX(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleY(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setAlpha(1f);
                    })
                    .start();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Drive both FABs from the engine state. Called on studio transitions and
     * on resume so a background recording re-attaches its controls.
     */
    public void syncFabWithEngine() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        boolean active = inStudio && e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
        boolean paused = e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;
        if (active) {
            morphFabIcon(paused ? R.drawable.ic_play : R.drawable.ic_pause);
            setStopVisible(true);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(
                    getString(paused ? R.string.action_resume : R.string.action_pause));
        } else {
            morphFabIcon(inStudio ? R.drawable.ic_mic : R.drawable.ic_mic);
            setStopVisible(false);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(getString(R.string.cd_mic));
        }
    }

    /** Legacy hook: true once meant square-stop artwork; now drives split UI. */
    public void setFabStop(boolean stop) {
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    // ---- unfinished-take recovery (every app start) ----

    private void checkUnfinishedTakes() {
        // Never interrupt an attached studio session with its own UI.
        if (inStudio) return;
        // If the engine already holds a session (background recording), the
        // notification owns it — just offer to reopen the studio.
        if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()) {
            return;
        }
        List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> found;
        try {
            found = RecordingEngine.scanUnfinished(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (found == null || found.isEmpty()) return;
        promptRecovery(0, found);
    }

    private void promptRecovery(int index, List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> all) {
        if (index >= all.size()) return;
        RecordingEngine.Unfinished u = all.get(index);
        String dur = String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d",
                (u.durationMs / 60000), (u.durationMs / 1000) % 60);
        try {
            OptionsSheet.showTwoChoiceModal(this,
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_title),
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_msg, u.name, dur),
                    OptionsSheet.Item.danger(R.drawable.ic_trash,
                            "Discard", () -> {
                                boolean ok = RecordingEngine.deleteUnfinished(u.rawFile);
                                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, ok,
                                        ok ? "Take discarded" : "Delete failed",
                                        null,
                                        () -> promptRecovery(index + 1, all));
                            }),
                    OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_play,
                            "Continue", () -> {
                                try {
                                    RecordingEngine.get().attachExisting(
                                            getApplicationContext(),
                                            u.rawFile, u.name, u.channels,
                                            RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(u.rawFile));
                                } catch (Exception e) {
                                    OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                                            "Open failed", null);
                                    promptRecovery(index + 1, all);
                                    return;
                                }
                                openStudioWithRecovery(u.rawFile);
                            }));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private StudioFragment studio() {
        Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("STU");
        return (f instanceof StudioFragment && f.isVisible()) ? (StudioFragment) f : null;
    }

    private void pulseHalo() {
        fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1.22f).scaleY(1.22f).setDuration(150)
                .withEndAction(() -> fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(220).start())
                .start();
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/ConversionJobs.java

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet;

/**
 * Registry for background conversions: enqueue, cancel, observe, and recover.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Invariants the rest of the app relies on:
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;Raw files under conversion are &lt;b&gt;never written to&lt;/b&gt; — only read.
 *       Punch-in edits copy bytes out, so an edit can never invalidate an
 *       in-flight conversion. The only invalidations are delete and
 *       replace, which cancel the job first.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;One active job per raw file. Enqueueing for the same raw returns the
 *       existing job instead of doubling the work.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;Every state change is persisted to the job sidecar &lt;em&gt;and&lt;/em&gt;
 *       fanned out to {@link Listener}s, so the library, notifications and
 *       share warnings stay in sync whether the app is open or not.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 */
public final class ConversionJobs {

    public interface Listener {
        void onJobsChanged();
    }

    public static final class SaveResult {
        /** True when the file is ready now (incremental output adopted). */
        public final boolean adopted;
        public final File file;
        public final String label;
        public final long durationMs;
        public final String title;
        /** Non-null when the save went to the background worker. */
        public final ConversionJob job;

        private SaveResult(boolean adopted, File file, String label,
                           long durationMs, String title, ConversionJob job) {
            this.adopted = adopted;
            this.file = file;
            this.label = label;
            this.durationMs = durationMs;
            this.title = title;
            this.job = job;
        }

        static SaveResult adopted(File file, String label, long durationMs,
                                  String title) {
            return new SaveResult(true, file, label, durationMs, title, null);
        }

        static SaveResult background(ConversionJob job) {
            return new SaveResult(false, null, null, job.durationMs,
                    job.title, job);
        }
    }

    private ConversionJobs() {}

    /**
     * How long a save may spend finishing the incremental encoder inline
     * before giving up and converting in the background. Kept small on
     * purpose: a budget overrun is paid as visible latency on the UI thread,
     * and a backlog that cannot drain inside it is handed to the worker
     * anyway.
     */
    private static final long ADOPT_DRAIN_BUDGET_MS = 350L;

    /**
     * Largest unencoded backlog still worth draining inline (~1.5s of audio),
     * which encodes in well under the budget above.
     */
    private static final long MAX_INLINE_TAIL_FRAMES =
            RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE * 3L / 2L;

    private static final Map<String, ConversionJob> ACTIVE = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Set<Listener> LISTENERS = new CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
    /** rawPath -> finished library take id, for replace-after-completion. */
    private static final Map<String, Long> COMPLETED = new HashMap<>();
    /**
     * raws with an in-flight reader. The worker defers its raw.delete() while
     * one is open, so an Edit on a converting card cannot have the file
     * pulled out from under AudioImporter mid-decode.
     */
    private static final Map<String, Integer> RAW_READERS =
            new HashMap<>();
    /** Synthetic (negative) take id -> raw path, for edit-replace lookup. */
    private static final Map<Long, String> NEG_TO_RAW = new HashMap<>();
    /**
     * rawPath -> latest user-chosen title from a rename requested while its
     * take was converting. Kept separately from {@link ConversionJob#title}
     * so a rename that arrives after the worker read the title but before the
     * finished take is visible can still be applied exactly once.
     */
    private static final Map<String, String> RENAMED_TITLES = new HashMap<>();

    public static synchronized void addListener(Listener l) {
        if (l != null) LISTENERS.add(l);
    }

    public static synchronized void removeListener(Listener l) {
        LISTENERS.remove(l);
    }

    private static void fireChanged() {
        for (Listener l : LISTENERS) {
            try {
                l.onJobsChanged();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static synchronized List<ConversionJob> active() {
        return new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE.values());
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob get(String jobId) {
        return ACTIVE.get(jobId);
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob forRaw(String rawPath) {
        for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
            if (j.rawPath.equals(rawPath)) return j;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob forTakeId(long takeId) {
        for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
            if (j.takeId() == takeId) return j;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static synchronized void noteCompletion(String rawPath, long takeId) {
        COMPLETED.put(rawPath, takeId);
    }

    public static synchronized Long completedTakeIdForRaw(String rawPath) {
        return COMPLETED.get(rawPath);
    }

    /**
     * Atomically records a rename for a take that was (or still is)
     * converting. Updates the active job and sidecar when the job is still in
     * flight, remembers the override by raw path so the worker handoff cannot
     * miss it, and renames the finished take when the job already completed
     * while the rename dialog was open.
     *
     * <p>The repository rename happens after this class's lock is released:
     * the worker can hold the repository lock while calling back into this
     * registry, so nesting those two locks in the other order could deadlock.
     */
    public static String renameConvertingOrCompleted(String jobId,
                                                     long syntheticTakeId,
                                                     String rawPath,
                                                     String newTitle) {
        String clean = newTitle != null ? newTitle.trim() : "";
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        final String effectiveRaw;
        final Long doneId;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            ConversionJob job = null;
            if (jobId != null && !jobId.isEmpty()) {
                job = ACTIVE.get(jobId);
            }
            if (job == null && syntheticTakeId < 0) {
                for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
                    if (j.takeId() == syntheticTakeId) {
                        job = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (job == null && rawPath != null && !rawPath.isEmpty()) {
                for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
                    if (rawPath.equals(j.rawPath)) {
                        job = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            String eff = rawPath;
            if ((eff == null || eff.isEmpty()) && job != null) {
                eff = job.rawPath;
            }
            if ((eff == null || eff.isEmpty()) && syntheticTakeId < 0) {
                eff = NEG_TO_RAW.get(syntheticTakeId);
            }
            if (eff != null && !eff.isEmpty()) {
                RENAMED_TITLES.put(eff, clean);
            }
            if (job != null) {
                job.title = clean;
                if (job.replaceTitle != null) {
                    job.replaceTitle = clean;
                }
                job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
                job.write();
            }
            effectiveRaw = eff;
            doneId = (eff != null && !eff.isEmpty())
                    ? COMPLETED.get(eff) : null;
        }
        if (doneId != null) {
            TakesRepository.rename(doneId, clean);
        }
        fireChanged();
        return clean;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the most up-to-date title for {@code job}, honouring any rename
     * that arrived while the job was queued or running.
     */
    public static synchronized String latestTitle(ConversionJob job,
                                                  String fallback) {
        String cleanFallback = fallback != null ? fallback : "";
        if (job == null) return cleanFallback;
        String byRaw = RENAMED_TITLES.get(job.rawPath);
        if (byRaw != null && !byRaw.trim().isEmpty()) {
            job.title = byRaw.trim();
            return job.title;
        }
        if (job.title != null && !job.title.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return job.title.trim();
        }
        return cleanFallback;
    }

    /**
     * Takes and clears a pending rename override recorded by
     * {@link #renameConvertingOrCompleted}. The worker calls this after the
     * finished take is visible, then applies the result without holding this
     * class's lock.
     */
    public static synchronized String consumeRenamedTitle(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
        String renamed = RENAMED_TITLES.remove(rawPath);
        if (renamed == null || renamed.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        return renamed.trim();
    }

    /**
     * Reads a pending rename override without clearing it, so the worker can
     * decide which title a completion should carry while still honouring the
     * initial edit-replace title when no rename arrived.
     */
    public static synchronized String peekRenamedTitle(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
        String renamed = RENAMED_TITLES.get(rawPath);
        if (renamed == null || renamed.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        return renamed.trim();
    }

    public static synchronized void noteTakeRaw(long takeId, String rawPath) {
        NEG_TO_RAW.put(takeId, rawPath);
    }

    public static synchronized String rawForTakeId(long takeId) {
        return NEG_TO_RAW.get(takeId);
    }

    public static synchronized void forgetCompletion(String rawPath) {
        COMPLETED.remove(rawPath);
        RENAMED_TITLES.remove(rawPath);
    }

    /** Marks {@code rawPath} as being read. Pair every call with {@link #endRawRead}. */
    public static void beginRawRead(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            Integer n = RAW_READERS.get(rawPath);
            RAW_READERS.put(rawPath, n == null ? 1 : n + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void endRawRead(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        boolean lastReader;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            Integer n = RAW_READERS.get(rawPath);
            if (n == null) return;
            if (n <= 1) {
                RAW_READERS.remove(rawPath);
                lastReader = true;
            } else {
                RAW_READERS.put(rawPath, n - 1);
                lastReader = false;
            }
            if (lastReader && DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.remove(rawPath)
                    && forRaw(rawPath) == null) {
                // The worker finished while this reader held the file and
                // deferred its deletion: no job owns the raw anymore, so
                // remove it now instead of leaking it into reconcile().
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(rawPath).delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    /** Raws whose deletion was deferred until their last reader finishes. */
    private static final java.util.Set<String> DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES =
            new java.util.HashSet<>();

    /** True while some thread is decoding this raw. */
    public static synchronized boolean rawIsBeingRead(String rawPath) {
        return RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath);
    }

    /**
     * Deletes a finished conversion's raw immediately, unless a reader
     * (preview playback or edit import) still holds it open — then the
     * deletion is deferred to {@link #endRawRead} so the file can neither be
     * pulled out from under the reader nor leaked into reconcile().
     */
    public static void deleteOrDeferRaw(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            if (RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath)) {
                DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.add(rawPath);
                return;
            }
        }
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(rawPath).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Enqueues a background conversion for a finalized raw take. Returns the
     * existing job when one is already active for the same raw.
     */
    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs) {
        return enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, durationMs, -1, null);
    }

    /**
     * Same, carrying edit-replace lineage: when the job completes, the take
     * with {@code replaceTakeId} is replaced (under {@code replaceTitle})
     * instead of adding a duplicate.
     */
    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs,
                                                     long replaceTakeId,
                                                     String replaceTitle) {
        ConversionJob existing = forRaw(raw.getAbsolutePath());
        if (existing != null) return existing;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        // AUDIT-3-02 fix: read the geometry from the `raw` file itself.
        // The engine may be idle/cleared (dataBytes 0, channels back to its
        // 2 default) at enqueue time, which recorded framesTotal = 1 and the
        // wrong channel count for a mono take.
        int ch = Math.max(1, e.channels);
        long bytes = e.dataBytes;
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
            ch = Math.max(1, info.channels);
            bytes = info.dataBytes;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        long framesTotal = Math.max(1, bytes / 4 / ch);
        String jobTitle = (replaceTitle != null && !replaceTitle.trim().isEmpty())
                ? replaceTitle.trim()
                : (title != null ? title : "");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                jobTitle,
                raw.getAbsolutePath(),
                ConversionJob.partFor(raw).getAbsolutePath(),
                preset != null ? preset.id : RecordPreset.MEMO.id,
                format != null ? format.id : SaveFormat.AUTO.id,
                ch,
                preset != null ? preset.aacBitrate : 128000,
                Math.max(durationMs, 1000),
                framesTotal);
        job.replaceTakeId = replaceTakeId;
        job.replaceTitle = replaceTitle;
        NEG_TO_RAW.put(job.takeId(), raw.getAbsolutePath());
        ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
        job.write();
        fireChanged();
        return job;
    }

    /**
     * Cancels a job: stops the worker, deletes partial output and — when
     * {@code deleteRaw} — the raw take itself. The sidecar always goes.
     * When the raw is kept it gets its pending marker back, so the next
     * launch offers the usual continue/discard recovery instead of leaking
     * an invisible file.
     */
    public static synchronized boolean cancel(String jobId, boolean deleteRaw) {
        ConversionJob job = ACTIVE.get(jobId);
        if (job == null) return false;
        job.cancelled = true;
        job.state = ConversionJob.CANCELLED;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        job.write();
        ACTIVE.remove(jobId);
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(job.partPath).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        job.deleteSidecar();
        if (deleteRaw) {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(job.rawPath).delete();
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(job.rawPath + ".pending").delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            forgetCompletion(job.rawPath);
        } else {
            try {
                File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
                if (raw.exists()) {
                    RecordingEngine.writePendingMarker(raw, job.title,
                            job.channels);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        fireChanged();
        return true;
    }

    /** Cancels by library card id (negative synthetic ids map to jobs). */
    public static synchronized boolean cancelByTakeId(long takeId,
                                                      boolean deleteRaw) {
        ConversionJob job = forTakeId(takeId);
        return job != null && cancel(job.jobId, deleteRaw);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves or cancels the source of an Edit -> Replace save BEFORE the
     * edited take is converted or adopted.
     *
     * <ul>
     *   <li>If {@code replaceTakeId < 0} and the original conversion job is
     *       still queued or running, cancels it immediately (marking it
     *       {@code superseded} and deleting its raw + part + sidecar) so the
     *       worker never wastes time finishing the obsolete original file,
     *       and returns {@code -1} because no finished library row exists to
     *       replace.</li>
     *   <li>If {@code replaceTakeId < 0} and the original conversion job
     *       already finished while the user was editing, returns the positive
     *       {@code Take.id} of that finished take so the replacement deletes
     *       it.</li>
     * </ul>
     */
    public static long cancelForReplace(Context ctx, long replaceTakeId) {
        if (replaceTakeId >= 0) return replaceTakeId;
        String jobIdToCancel = null;
        Long finishedId;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            ConversionJob srcJob = forTakeId(replaceTakeId);
            String srcRaw = srcJob != null ? srcJob.rawPath
                    : NEG_TO_RAW.get(replaceTakeId);
            if (srcJob != null) {
                srcJob.superseded = true;
                srcJob.cancelled = true;
                jobIdToCancel = srcJob.jobId;
                cancel(srcJob.jobId, true);
            }
            finishedId = (srcRaw != null) ? COMPLETED.get(srcRaw) : null;
        }
        if (jobIdToCancel != null && ctx != null) {
            ConversionService.cancelJob(ctx, jobIdToCancel);
            ConversionService.onRecordingStateChanged();
        }
        return finishedId != null ? finishedId : -1L;
    }

    /**
     * Cancels any active background conversion job that was scheduled to
     * replace {@code deletedTakeId}. Prevents a replacement conversion from
     * resurrecting a take that the user deleted while the conversion was
     * still in flight.
     */
    public static void cancelForDeletedTargetTake(Context ctx, long deletedTakeId) {
        if (deletedTakeId < 0) return;
        List<String> jobsToCancel = new ArrayList<>();
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            for (ConversionJob j : new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE.values())) {
                if (j.replaceTakeId == deletedTakeId) {
                    j.superseded = true;
                    j.cancelled = true;
                    jobsToCancel.add(j.jobId);
                    cancel(j.jobId, true);
                }
            }
        }
        if (ctx != null) {
            for (String jid : jobsToCancel) {
                ConversionService.cancelJob(ctx, jid);
            }
            if (!jobsToCancel.isEmpty()) {
                ConversionService.onRecordingStateChanged();
            }
        }
    }

    static synchronized void updateProgress(ConversionJob job, int pct,
                                            long framesDone) {
        job.progress = pct;
        job.framesDone = framesDone;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if ((pct % 5) == 0 || pct >= 100) job.write();
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markRunning(ConversionJob job) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        job.write();
        if (!ACTIVE.containsKey(job.jobId)) ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markDone(ConversionJob job) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.DONE;
        job.progress = 100;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ACTIVE.remove(job.jobId);
        job.deleteSidecar();
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markFailed(ConversionJob job, String error) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.FAILED;
        job.error = error;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ACTIVE.remove(job.jobId);
        job.deleteSidecar();
        fireChanged();
    }

    /**
     * Startup sweep: resurrect interrupted jobs, drop garbage. Returns the
     * jobs the worker should run. Stale sidecars (orphaned > 7 days) and
     * partial outputs without a sidecar are deleted.
     */
    public static synchronized List<ConversionJob> sweep(Context ctx) {
        List<ConversionJob> resume = new ArrayList<>();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File[] files;
        try {
            files = dir.listFiles();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            files = null;
        }
        if (files == null) return resume;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Set<String> liveParts = new HashSet<>();
        // A live capture owns a .part with no sidecar yet. Sweep used to
        // assume it only ran at cold start, but the service sweeps on every
        // start command, so this file was deleted out from under the running
        // StreamingEncoder mid-recording.
        File activeRaw = RecordingEngine.get().rawFile;
        if (activeRaw != null) {
            liveParts.add(ConversionJob.partFor(activeRaw).getAbsolutePath());
        }
        // Same protection for a session that is being written but not yet
        // finalized (a .pending marker sits beside it).
        for (File f : files) {
            if (f.isFile() && f.getName().endsWith(".pending")) {
                String rawName = f.getName().substring(0,
                        f.getName().length() - ".pending".length());
                liveParts.add(new File(dir, rawName + ".part")
                        .getAbsolutePath());
            }
        }
        for (File f : files) {
            if (f.isFile() && f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json.tmp")) {
                String mainName = f.getName().substring(
                        0, f.getName().length() - ".tmp".length());
                File mainSidecar = new File(dir, mainName);
                if (!mainSidecar.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    f.renameTo(mainSidecar);
                } else {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    f.delete();
                }
            }
        }
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json")) continue;
            ConversionJob job = ConversionJob.read(f);
            if (job == null) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            liveParts.add(job.partPath);
            // Already tracked in memory (RUNNING or QUEUED): keep the live
            // instance. Replacing it reset progress to 0 and let the queue run
            // the same jobId twice, the second run reporting a false failure
            // because the raw was already gone.
            ConversionJob inMem = ACTIVE.get(job.jobId);
            if (inMem != null) {
                resume.add(inMem);
                continue;
            }
            boolean stale = now - job.updatedAt > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L;
            File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
            if (stale || !raw.exists()
                    || ConversionJob.DONE.equals(job.state)
                    || ConversionJob.FAILED.equals(job.state)
                    || ConversionJob.CANCELLED.equals(job.state)) {
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(job.partPath).delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            job.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
            job.cancelled = false;
            job.write();
            NEG_TO_RAW.put(job.takeId(), job.rawPath);
            ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
            resume.add(job);
        }
        // Partial outputs with no sidecar are crash garbage — except the one
        // a live capture may be writing right now (protected above).
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !f.getName().endsWith(".part")) continue;
            if (!liveParts.contains(f.getAbsolutePath())) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
            }
        }
        if (!resume.isEmpty()) fireChanged();
        return resume;
    }

    /**
     * The unified save dispatch: finalize the raw, then either adopt the
     * incremental output (fast path) or enqueue a background job. Never
     * blocks on conversion work beyond draining the incremental tail.
     */
    public static SaveResult dispatchSave(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                          SaveFormat format,
                                          StreamingEncoder.Progress cb) {
        return dispatchSave(ctx, preset, format, cb, -1, null);
    }

    /**
     * Same, carrying edit-replace lineage into the background job when the
     * fast path misses.
     */
    public static SaveResult dispatchSave(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                          SaveFormat format,
                                          StreamingEncoder.Progress cb,
                                          long replaceTakeId,
                                          String replaceTitle) {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        File raw = e.finalizeRawForSave();
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        }
        // If replacing a take that is still converting (replaceTakeId < 0),
        // cancel the original conversion job immediately so we never convert
        // the original file first and then convert the edited file second.
        if (replaceTakeId < 0) {
            replaceTakeId = cancelForReplace(ctx, replaceTakeId);
        }
        // If the original take already exists in the library (either because
        // the user edited a finished take, or because the converting take
        // finished while the user was editing in Studio), delete the previous
        // take and its file immediately before starting the new conversion!
        if (replaceTakeId > 0) {
            TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replaceTakeId);
            replaceTakeId = -1L;
        }
        String title = (replaceTitle != null && !replaceTitle.trim().isEmpty())
                ? replaceTitle.trim()
                : (e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "");
        long dur = Math.max(e.durationMs(), 1000);
        StreamingEncoder sess = e.endStreamingDetach();
        SaveFormat eff = format.effective(preset);
        if (eff == SaveFormat.AUTO) eff = SaveFormat.M4A;
        // An enabled-but-unbaked FX chain invalidates the incremental output:
        // the pump encoded raw microphone frames, so its .part would ship
        // without a single effect. Drop it and let the worker convert the
        // FX-baked raw instead of silently losing the whole chain.
        boolean needsFxBake = e.isFxBakeRequired();
        if (needsFxBake) {
            if (sess != null) {
                try {
                    sess.abort();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                sess = null;
            }
            // Enqueue the background job FIRST so the Library shows the
            // converting card at 0% immediately instead of staying blank
            // while the full-file DSP bake runs.
            ConversionJob prequeued = enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format,
                    dur, replaceTakeId, replaceTitle);
            try {
                if (ctx != null) {
                    DspChain.Config cfg = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
                    if (cfg != null && cfg.isActive()) {
                        FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4
                                / Math.max(1, info.channels);
                        if (totalFrames > 0) {
                            DspChain chain = new DspChain(info.channels, cfg);
                            EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, 0, totalFrames,
                                     chain, null);
                            e.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "dispatchSave fx bake failed: " + ex);
            }
            e.setFxBakeRequired(false);
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
            if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(0);
            return SaveResult.background(prequeued);
        }
        // framesEncoded() > 0 is NOT evidence that the pump kept up: a
        // format switch restarts the encoder from the top of the raw file, so
        // it reports progress after its first chunk while nearly the whole
        // take is still unencoded. Only drain inline when the real backlog is
        // tiny; otherwise skip straight to the worker with no stall at all.
        boolean canAdoptInline = sess != null && sess.healthy()
                && sess.matches(preset, format)
                && sess.framesEncoded() > 0
                && sess.unencodedFrames() <= MAX_INLINE_TAIL_FRAMES;
        if (canAdoptInline) {
            try {
                if (!sess.finish(ADOPT_DRAIN_BUDGET_MS)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("drain budget exceeded");
                }
                if (sess.finishedOk()) {
                    File part = sess.partFile();
                    // Same guard as the background path: a pass-through FLAC
                    // encoder hands back a near-full-size file under a
                    // lossless label. Fall through to the worker, which
                    // re-encodes as WAV24.
                    if (eff == SaveFormat.FLAC
                            && TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(part.length(),
                            raw.length())) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "flac ineffective; fallback to worker");
                    }
                    FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
                    File fin = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw,
                            eff.extension());
                    if (!part.renameTo(fin)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("adopt failed");
                    }
                    if (!fin.equals(raw)) {
                        // Keep the scratch only when it is the result.
                        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                        raw.delete();
                    }
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
                    return SaveResult.adopted(fin,
                            TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, format), dur, title);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "stream adopt failed: " + ex);
            }
            // abort(), never a bare unlink: a timed-out finish() leaves the
            // pump running, and only abort() stops it. Enqueuing a job onto
            // the same part path while that thread still writes it corrupts
            // the container.
            sess.abort();
        } else if (sess != null) {
            sess.abort();
        }
        ConversionJob job = enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, dur,
                replaceTakeId, replaceTitle);
        // The sidecar now exists, so recovery no longer needs the pending
        // marker. Keep it until this instant to close the finalize/enqueue
        // crash window.
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(0);
        return SaveResult.background(job);
    }
}
