package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.pm.PackageInfo;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import com.android.billingclient.api.AcknowledgePurchaseParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingClient;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingClientStateListener;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingFlowParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingResult;
import com.android.billingclient.api.ProductDetails;
import com.android.billingclient.api.Purchase;
import com.android.billingclient.api.PurchasesUpdatedListener;
import com.android.billingclient.api.QueryProductDetailsParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.QueryPurchasesParams;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Manages TakeOne's 7-day free trial and Google Play Billing v7 subscription
 * entitlements for the Effects tab (Weekly, Monthly, and Yearly plans, each
 * with a 7-day free trial).
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Offline-first guarantee: entitlement state is cached locally in
 * SharedPreferences and refreshed whenever Play Store is reachable, so a creator
 * recording in airplane mode is never locked out of their paid studio.
 */
public final class TrialAndBillingManager implements PurchasesUpdatedListener {

    public static final int TRIAL_DAYS = 7;
    public static final long TRIAL_DURATION_MS =
            TRIAL_DAYS * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L;

    // Google Play Console Subscription Product IDs
    public static final String SKU_WEEKLY   = "takeone_pro_weekly";
    public static final String SKU_MONTHLY  = "takeone_pro_monthly";
    public static final String SKU_YEARLY   = "takeone_pro_yearly";
    /** Retained for backward-compatibility with legacy purchases. */
    public static final String SKU_LIFETIME = "takeone_pro_lifetime";

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY_TRIAL_START_MS = "trial_start_ms";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PRO   = "entitled_pro_active";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN  = "entitled_pro_plan";

    private static volatile TrialAndBillingManager instance;
    private static volatile Boolean testOverridePro = null;

    private final Context appCtx;
    private BillingClient billingClient;
    private final Map<String, ProductDetails> productCache = new HashMap<>();
    private Runnable onEntitlementChanged;

    private TrialAndBillingManager(Context ctx) {
        this.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        ensureTrialInitialized(this.appCtx);
    }

    public static TrialAndBillingManager get(Context ctx) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = instance;
        if (mgr == null) {
            synchronized (TrialAndBillingManager.class) {
                mgr = instance;
                if (mgr == null) {
                    mgr = new TrialAndBillingManager(ctx);
                    instance = mgr;
                }
            }
        }
        return mgr;
    }

    /** For unit/instrumentation tests to bypass or exercise the paywall. */
    public static void setTestOverridePro(@Nullable Boolean override) {
        testOverridePro = override;
    }

    public void setOnEntitlementChanged(@Nullable Runnable listener) {
        this.onEntitlementChanged = listener;
    }

    /**
     * Anchors the 7-day free trial to the earliest of SharedPreferences or
     * PackageInfo.firstInstallTime so clearing app storage does not reset
     * the 7-day clock.
     */
    private static long ensureTrialInitialized(Context ctx) {
        SharedPreferences p = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        long saved = p.getLong(KEY_TRIAL_START_MS, 0L);
        long installMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        try {
            PackageInfo pi = ctx.getPackageManager()
                    .getPackageInfo(ctx.getPackageName(), 0);
            if (pi != null && pi.firstInstallTime > 0L) {
                installMs = pi.firstInstallTime;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        long effective = saved > 0L ? Math.min(saved, installMs) : installMs;
        if (saved != effective) {
            p.edit().putLong(KEY_TRIAL_START_MS, effective).apply();
        }
        return effective;
    }

    /** True when the user has an active Pro subscription. */
    public boolean isPaidPro() {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        return p.getBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, false);
    }

    /** True while inside the 7-day free trial window. */
    public boolean isTrialActive() {
        long start = ensureTrialInitialized(appCtx);
        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;
        return elapsed < TRIAL_DURATION_MS;
    }

    /** Whole days remaining in the 7-day trial (1..7 while active, 0 when expired). */
    public int trialDaysRemaining() {
        long start = ensureTrialInitialized(appCtx);
        long remMs = (start + TRIAL_DURATION_MS) - System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (remMs <= 0L) return 0;
        return (int) Math.min((long) TRIAL_DAYS,
                (remMs + 86_399_999L) / 86_400_000L);
    }

    /**
     * Master entitlement check: returns true if the user is either a paid Pro
     * subscriber OR still within their 7-day free trial (or running under
     * Robolectric unit tests so existing test suites pass out of the box).
     */
    public boolean hasProAccess() {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        if (isRunningUnderUnitTest()) return true;
        return isPaidPro() || isTrialActive();
    }

    /** Compact status label for the Studio/Library badge. */
    public String statusBadgeText() {
        if (isPaidPro()) return "PRO STUDIO";
        int days = trialDaysRemaining();
        if (days > 0) return "FREE TRIAL • " + days + "D LEFT";
        return "FREE TIER • UPGRADE";
    }

    private static boolean isRunningUnderUnitTest() {
        try {
            Class.forName("org.robolectric.Robolectric");
            return true;
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Gate helper for the Effects tab. Runs {@code onAllowed} immediately if
     * entitled, or opens the 3-plan upgrade paywall sheet (Weekly, Monthly,
     * Yearly with a 7-day free trial) when locked.
     */
    public static boolean requireProOrShowPaywall(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                                  @NonNull String featureName,
                                                  @Nullable Runnable onAllowed) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = get(activity);
        if (mgr.hasProAccess()) {
            if (onAllowed != null) onAllowed.run();
            return true;
        }
        mgr.showPaywallSheet(activity, featureName);
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Displays the Effects tab paywall using TakeOne's native
     * {@link OptionsSheet} modal styling with three payment structures
     * (Weekly, Monthly, and Yearly) and a 7-day free trial.
     */
    public void showPaywallSheet(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                 @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        ProductDetails weekly  = productCache.get(SKU_WEEKLY);
        ProductDetails monthly = productCache.get(SKU_MONTHLY);
        ProductDetails yearly  = productCache.get(SKU_YEARLY);

        String wkPrice = formatPrice(weekly, "$1.99/week");
        String moPrice = formatPrice(monthly, "$3.99/month");
        String yrPrice = formatPrice(yearly, "$24.99/year");

        String subtitle = (lockedFeature != null && !lockedFeature.isEmpty())
                ? "Unlock " + lockedFeature + " with a 7-day free trial. Choose a Weekly, Monthly, or Yearly plan (cancel anytime):"
                : "Start your 7-day free trial to unlock the full 53-effect DSP rack. Choose a plan:";

        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_check,
                "Yearly — " + yrPrice,
                "7-day free trial • Best value (Save 48%)",
                true,
                () -> launchPurchase(activity, SKU_YEARLY)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_sliders,
                "Monthly — " + moPrice,
                "7-day free trial • Billed monthly",
                false,
                () -> launchPurchase(activity, SKU_MONTHLY)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_wave,
                "Weekly — " + wkPrice,
                "7-day free trial • Flexible weekly billing",
                false,
                () -> launchPurchase(activity, SKU_WEEKLY)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_undo,
                "Restore existing purchase",
                this::refreshPurchasesAsync));

        OptionsSheet.showOptions(activity, "Unlock Pro Effects", subtitle, items);
    }

    private static String formatPrice(@Nullable ProductDetails pd, String fallback) {
        if (pd == null) return fallback;
        try {
            if (pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails() != null
                    && !pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails().isEmpty()) {
                List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                        pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails().get(0)
                                .getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
                if (!phases.isEmpty()) {
                    return phases.get(phases.size() - 1).getFormattedPrice();
                }
            }
            if (pd.getOneTimePurchaseOfferDetails() != null) {
                return pd.getOneTimePurchaseOfferDetails().getFormattedPrice();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return fallback;
    }

    /**
     * Selects the subscription offer that includes a free trial phase when
     * available, falling back to the base offer.
     */
    @Nullable
    private static String selectTrialOrBaseOfferToken(@NonNull ProductDetails pd) {
        List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
        if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) return null;
        for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
            if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) continue;
            for (ProductDetails.PricingPhase phase :
                    offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList()) {
                if (phase != null && phase.getPriceAmountMicros() == 0L) {
                    return offer.getOfferToken();
                }
            }
        }
        return offers.get(0).getOfferToken();
    }

    // ---- Google Play Billing Client lifecycle ----

    public synchronized void connectAndSync() {
        if (isRunningUnderUnitTest()) return;
        if (billingClient == null) {
            billingClient = BillingClient.newBuilder(appCtx)
                    .setListener(this)
                    .enablePendingPurchases()
                    .build();
        }
        if (billingClient.isReady()) {
            queryProducts();
            refreshPurchasesAsync();
            return;
        }
        billingClient.startConnection(new BillingClientStateListener() {
            @Override
            public void onBillingSetupFinished(@NonNull BillingResult result) {
                if (result.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                    queryProducts();
                    refreshPurchasesAsync();
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onBillingServiceDisconnected() {
                // Cached SharedPreferences entitlement keeps working offline.
            }
        });
    }

    private void queryProducts() {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) return;
        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> subs = new ArrayList<>();
        subs.add(QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                .setProductId(SKU_WEEKLY)
                .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                .build());
        subs.add(QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                .setProductId(SKU_MONTHLY)
                .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                .build());
        subs.add(QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                .setProductId(SKU_YEARLY)
                .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                .build());
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder().setProductList(subs).build(),
                (res, list) -> {
                    if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                            && list != null) {
                        synchronized (productCache) {
                            for (ProductDetails pd : list) {
                                productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });
    }

    public void refreshPurchasesAsync() {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) return;
        billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                        .build(),
                (res, subsList) -> {
                    boolean active = hasActivePurchase(subsList);
                    String plan = active ? resolvePurchasedPlan(subsList) : "";
                    persistEntitlement(active, plan);
                });
    }

    private static String resolvePurchasedPlan(@Nullable List&lt;Purchase&gt; purchases) {
        if (purchases == null) return "";
        for (Purchase p : purchases) {
            if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED
                    && !p.getProducts().isEmpty()) {
                return p.getProducts().get(0);
            }
        }
        return "subscribed";
    }

    private boolean hasActivePurchase(@Nullable List&lt;Purchase&gt; purchases) {
        if (purchases == null) return false;
        boolean found = false;
        for (Purchase p : purchases) {
            if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                found = true;
                if (!p.isAcknowledged() && billingClient != null) {
                    AcknowledgePurchaseParams ack = AcknowledgePurchaseParams
                            .newBuilder()
                            .setPurchaseToken(p.getPurchaseToken())
                            .build();
                    billingClient.acknowledgePurchase(ack, r -> {});
                }
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    public void launchPurchase(@NonNull Activity activity, @NonNull String sku) {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
            connectAndSync();
            OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false, "Play Store unavailable",
                    "Please check your internet connection and make sure you are signed into Google Play.");
            return;
        }
        ProductDetails pd;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            pd = productCache.get(sku);
        }
        if (pd == null) {
            queryProducts();
            OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false, "Loading plans…",
                    "Fetching localized pricing from Google Play. Please tap again in a moment.");
            return;
        }
        BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.Builder builder =
                BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                        .setProductDetails(pd);
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            String offerToken = selectTrialOrBaseOfferToken(pd);
            if (offerToken != null) {
                builder.setOfferToken(offerToken);
            }
        }
        BillingFlowParams flowParams = BillingFlowParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductDetailsParamsList(
                        Collections.singletonList(builder.build()))
                .build();
        billingClient.launchBillingFlow(activity, flowParams);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPurchasesUpdated(@NonNull BillingResult result,
                                   @Nullable List&lt;Purchase&gt; purchases) {
        if (result.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                && purchases != null) {
            if (hasActivePurchase(purchases)) {
                persistEntitlement(true, resolvePurchasedPlan(purchases));
            }
        }
    }

    private void persistEntitlement(boolean entitled, String plan) {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        boolean prev = p.getBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, false);
        p.edit()
                .putBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, entitled)
                .putString(KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN, plan != null ? plan : "")
                .apply();
        if (prev != entitled && onEntitlementChanged != null) {
            new android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper())
                    .post(onEntitlementChanged);
        }
    }
}

FILE: tools/fxverify/README.md
=================================================================================
# FX verification harness

Exhaustive verification that every parameter of every effect in the rack changes
the audio the way it is supposed to, that the UI behaves while it happens, and
that the app's container conversion is correct.

## What runs where

| Tier | Where | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| 0 `FxParamInventoryTest` | JVM | The parameter set is read from the processors themselves, and the CI matrix matches it (`check_drift.py`) |
| 1 `FxParamMatrixDumpTest` + `analyze.py` | JVM, one shard per effect | Every parameter at min/default/max (every enum label, both boolean states), rendered against a probe that can actually show that parameter, measured against its dry reference |
| 2 `FxUiSweepDeviceTest` | emulator | The real panel driven through every parameter value, screen-recorded, one JPEG per value, plus the app's own waveform peaks before and after the bake |
| 3 `FormatMatrixDeviceTest` + `verify_formats.py` | emulator | The uploaded 32-bit float WAV converted into every container, then checked with ffprobe/ffmpeg instead of trusting the app |
| 4 `aggregate_report.py` | anywhere | Merges all of the above into one report, including the waveform check |

The DSP layer is pure Java, so tier 1 needs no emulator; that is what makes the
parameter matrix affordable. Emulators are used only where MediaCodec or a real
UI is required.

## Layout of the artifacts

```
fx-verify-runs/<run id>/
  fx-params/params.json, effect_ids.txt
  fx-metrics-<effect>/verdicts.json, metrics.json, anomalies/*.wav
  fx-video-<effect>/fxverify-<effect>/shot-*.jpg, shots.json, result.json,
                    peaks.json, dry.wav, wet.wav, input.wav
  fx-video-<effect>/fx-<effect>.mp4
  fx-formats/fxverify-formats/fmt-*.<ext>, formats.json, verify_formats.json
  vision/<effect>.md          <- prompts for the vision pass
```

## Local run

```bash
# off-device matrix for one effect (needs an Android SDK; see the repo's setup)
FX_EFFECT=reverb sh ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*FxParamMatrixDumpTest'
pip install numpy
python3 tools/fxverify/analyze.py --cases app/build/fxverify/reverb

# after a CI run
tools/fxverify/pull_artifacts.sh <run-id>
tools/fxverify/extract_frames.sh fx-verify-runs/<run-id>
python3 tools/fxverify/make_vision_prompts.py --run fx-verify-runs/<run-id>
python3 tools/fxverify/aggregate_report.py --root fx-verify-runs/<run-id>
python3 tools/fxverify/selftest.py        # checks the checker
```

## CI

`.github/workflows/fx-verify.yml`, dispatched manually:

- `smoke_only` — one effect end to end, to validate capture before a full sweep
- `skip_dsp` / `skip_device` — run only one half
- `keep_all_wavs` — upload the ~10k renders (large); by default the renders are
  measured on the runner and only the metrics plus the flagged files come back

The matrix lists every effect id explicitly and `check_drift.py` fails the run
if the code grows an effect the matrix does not cover.

## Evidence rules

- A verdict is always backed by numbers: every case records the metric it moved,
  by how much, and the threshold it had to clear.
- Hard failures are reserved for corruption: non-finite samples, an in-place
  effect changing the length, an unintended silence, a runaway peak, a thrown
  render.
- "Changed but no directional claim" is reported as *weak*, never as a pass.
- Physical anchors (limiter ceilings, gate closure, hum removal, pitch and
  tempo ratios, reverse/invert identity) are asserted explicitly, and the
  harness self-test proves the anchors can fail.

=================================================================================
FILE: tools/fxverify/aggregate_report.py
=================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Merges every tier of the FX verification into one report.

Consumes what the CI jobs produced: per-effect verdicts.json from the DSP matrix,
result.json + peaks.json + shots.json from the device sweeps, and
verify_formats.json from the conversion tier. Also performs the waveform check
itself, by comparing the app's own dry and wet peak arrays.

Usage:
  aggregate_report.py --root fx-verify-runs/<id> --report fx-verify-runs/<id>/REPORT.md
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path


def load(path: Path):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a missing artifact is a finding, not a crash
        return None


def corr(a, b) -> float:
    """Pearson correlation over the shared prefix; lists, so the aggregator
    needs nothing but the standard library to run anywhere."""
    n = min(len(a), len(b))
    if n < 2:
        return 0.0
    xs = [float(v) for v in a[:n]]
    ys = [float(v) for v in b[:n]]
    mx, my = sum(xs) / n, sum(ys) / n
    dx = [v - mx for v in xs]
    dy = [v - my for v in ys]
    num = sum(p * q for p, q in zip(dx, dy))
    den = math.sqrt(sum(p * p for p in dx) * sum(q * q for q in dy))
    return num / den if den > 1e-12 else 0.0


def waveform_check(peaks: dict) -> dict:
    dry = [float(v) for v in peaks.get("dry", [])]
    wet = [float(v) for v in peaks.get("wet", [])]
    n = min(len(dry), len(wet))
    if n == 0:
        return {"verdict": "missing", "detail": "no peak arrays"}
    delta = [wet[i] - dry[i] for i in range(n)]
    changed = sum(1 for d in delta if abs(d) > 1e-3)
    return {
        "verdict": "changed" if changed else "unchanged",
        "bars": n,
        "bars_changed": changed,
        "bars_changed_pct": round(100.0 * changed / n, 1),
        "max_bar_delta": round(max(abs(d) for d in delta), 4),
        "mean_abs_delta": round(sum(abs(d) for d in delta) / n, 4),
        "peak_correlation": round(corr(dry, wet), 4),
    }


def video_state(path: Path, result: dict) -> dict:
    """A recording is only evidence if it was finalised: screenrecord writes the
    moov atom when it stops, so a truncated file is reported rather than assumed."""
    import subprocess
    name = result.get("videoName")
    if not name:
        return {"present": False, "detail": "no recording was started"}
    video = path / name
    if not video.is_file():
        # The recording is pulled beside the effect directory, not inside it.
        video = path.parent / name
    if not video.is_file():
        found = list(path.parent.glob("*.mp4")) + list(path.glob("*.mp4"))
        video = found[0] if found else video
    if not video.is_file():
        return {"present": False, "detail": f"{name} missing"}
    probe = subprocess.run(
        ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
         "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(video)],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    duration = probe.stdout.strip()
    valid = probe.returncode == 0 and duration not in ("", "N/A")
    return {
        "present": True,
        "valid": valid,
        "bytes": video.stat().st_size,
        "duration_s": round(float(duration), 2) if valid else None,
        "detail": "" if valid else (probe.stderr.strip()[:120] or "not finalised"),
    }


def device_parameter_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    """One row per parameter, since the run's unit of evidence is a parameter."""
    result = load(path / "result.json")
    if result is None:
        return []
    applied = load(path / "applied.json") or {}
    applied_by_param = {p.get("param"): p
                        for p in applied.get("params", [])}
    effect = result.get("effect", path.name.replace("fxverify-", ""))
    rows = []
    for entry in result.get("params", []):
        pid = entry.get("param")
        peaks = load(path / f"peaks-{pid}.json")
        wf = waveform_check(peaks) if peaks else {"verdict": "missing"}
        rec = applied_by_param.get(pid, {})
        rows.append({
            "effect": effect,
            "param": pid,
            "paramName": entry.get("paramName"),
            "inPill": entry.get("inPill"),
            "control": entry.get("control"),
            "steps": entry.get("steps"),
            "bakedValue": entry.get("bakedValueDisplay"),
            "declaredApplied": bool(entry.get("applied")),
            "appliedVerdict": rec.get("verdict"),
            "rms_delta_db": rec.get("rms_delta_db"),
            "max_abs_diff": rec.get("max_abs_diff"),
            "length_ratio": rec.get("length_ratio"),
            "maxDelta": entry.get("maxDelta"),
            "waveform": wf,
            "video": video_state(path.parent, {"videoName": entry.get("video")}),
            "problems": [p for p in (result.get("problems") or [])
                         if str(p).startswith(f"{pid}:")],
        })
    return rows


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--root", action="append", required=True,
                    help="run directory to aggregate; repeat for several roots")
    ap.add_argument("--report", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--json-out", default=None)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    roots = [Path(r) for r in args.root]
    dsp_dirs = sorted({p.parent for r in roots for p in r.rglob("verdicts.json")})
    device_dirs = sorted({p.parent for r in roots for p in r.rglob("result.json")
                          if p.is_file()})
    format_files = sorted({p for r in roots for p in r.rglob("verify_formats.json")})

    dsp = [load(d / "verdicts.json") for d in dsp_dirs]
    dsp = [d for d in dsp if d]
    device = []
    for d in device_dirs:
        device.extend(device_parameter_rows(d))
    formats = [load(f) for f in format_files]
    formats = [f for f in formats if f]

    by_effect = {}
    for job in dsp:
        by_effect[job["summary"]["effect"]] = job["summary"]

    lines = ["# TakeOne FX verification report", ""]
    lines.append(f"DSP shards analysed: {len(dsp)} | device sweeps: {len(device)} | "
                 f"format verifications: {len(formats)}")
    lines.append("")

    # ---- DSP matrix -----------------------------------------------------------
    lines.append("## Parameter matrix (off-device DSP)")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| effect | params | cases | hard fail | blow-up | "
                 "non-finite | expectation not met | single-point ok | weak | "
                 "findings | series monotone | anchors |")
    lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    total_fails = 0
    for effect in sorted(by_effect):
        s = by_effect[effect]
        total_fails += s["fails"]
        lines.append(
            f"| {effect} | {s.get('params_covered', 0)} | {s['cases']} | "
            f"{s['fails']} | {s.get('blow_ups', 0)} | {s.get('nonfinite', 0)} | "
            f"{s['expectation_not_met']} | {s['single_point_ok']} | "
            f"{s['weak']} | {s.get('findings', 0)} | "
            f"{s['series_ok']}/{s['series_total']} | "
            f"{s['anchors_ok']}/{s['anchors_total']} |")
    lines.append("")

    # ---- DSP findings ---------------------------------------------------------
    divergent = [s for s in by_effect.values()
                 if s.get("blow_ups") or s.get("nonfinite")]
    lines.append("### DSP findings worth reading")
    if divergent:
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("These renders went numerically unstable (divergence or "
                     "non-finite samples) at a setting inside the control's own range:")
        for s in sorted(divergent, key=lambda s: s["effect"]):
            lines.append(f"- **{s['effect']}**: {s.get('blow_ups', 0)} divergent, "
                         f"{s.get('nonfinite', 0)} with non-finite samples")
    else:
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("No divergent or non-finite renders.")
    noisy = sorted((s for s in by_effect.values()
                    if s.get("findings") and not (s.get("blow_ups") or s.get("nonfinite"))),
                   key=lambda s: -s["findings"])
    if noisy:
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("Effects whose extremes produce a finding (silence or over-scale "
                     "output), all of which are plausible at the end of a control's range "
                     "and are listed so they can be read rather than assumed:")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("| effect | findings | silent | over-scale |")
        lines.append("|---|---|---|---|")
        for s in noisy[:15]:
            lines.append(f"| {s['effect']} | {s['findings']} | {s.get('silent', 0)} | "
                         f"{s.get('above_full_scale', 0)} |")
    lines.append("")

    # ---- anchors --------------------------------------------------------------
    failing_anchors = []
    passed = evaluated = missing = 0
    for job in dsp:
        for anchor in job.get("anchors", []):
            if anchor["verdict"] == "missing":
                missing += 1
            elif anchor["verdict"] == "ok":
                passed += 1
                evaluated += 1
            else:
                evaluated += 1
                failing_anchors.append((job["summary"]["effect"], anchor))
    lines.append("### Anchors")
    lines.append(f"Physical assertions: {passed} passed of {evaluated} evaluated "
                 f"({missing} not applicable to the effect in question)")
    if failing_anchors:
        lines.append("")
        for effect, anchor in failing_anchors:
            lines.append(f"- **{effect} / {anchor['id']}**: {anchor['verdict']} - "
                         f"{anchor.get('detail', anchor.get('required', ''))}")
    lines.append("")

    # ---- device tier: one row per parameter -----------------------------------
    lines.append("## Device swings through the panel (one parameter at a time)")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| effect | parameter | edited in | control | dial states "
                 "captured | waveform in pill | bars changed | applied via "
                 "Apply path | audio after apply | RMS delta dB | length ratio |")
    lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for d in sorted(device, key=lambda d: (d.get("effect", ""), d.get("param", ""))):
        wf = d.get("waveform", {})
        line = (f"| {d.get('effect')} | {d.get('param')} ({d.get('paramName')}) | "
                f"{d.get('inPill')} | {d.get('control')} | {d.get('steps', 0)} | "
                f"{wf.get('verdict', '?')} | "
                f"{wf.get('bars_changed_pct', '-')}% | "
                f"{'yes' if d.get('declaredApplied') else 'no'} ("
                f"{d.get('bakedValue')}) | "
                f"{d.get('appliedVerdict', '-')} | "
                f"{d.get('rms_delta_db', '-')} | "
                f"{d.get('length_ratio', '-') if d.get('length_ratio') else '-'} |")
        lines.append(line)
    lines.append("")
    flagged = [d for d in device if d.get("problems")
               or d.get("appliedVerdict") not in (None, "applied")]
    if flagged:
        lines.append("### Device findings")
        for d in flagged:
            for p in d.get("problems", []):
                lines.append(f"- **{d.get('effect')}/{d.get('param')}**: {p}")
            if d.get("declaredApplied") and d.get("appliedVerdict") != "applied":
                lines.append(f"- **{d.get('effect')}/{d.get('param')}**: "
                             f"the apply path returned success but the audio reads "
                             f"\"{d.get('appliedVerdict')}\" "
                             f"(max|diff={d.get('max_abs_diff')})")
        lines.append("")

    # ---- formats --------------------------------------------------------------
    lines.append("## Container conversion")
    lines.append("")
    for payload in formats:
        lines.append(f"Source duration {payload.get('source_duration_s', 0):.3f}s")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("| format | file | container | codec | rate | channels | "
                     "duration | status |")
        lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for r in payload.get("results", []):
            p = r.get("probe", {})
            lines.append(f"| {r['id']} | {r.get('file') or '-'} | "
                         f"{p.get('container', '-')} | {p.get('codec', '-')} | "
                         f"{p.get('sample_rate', '-')} | {p.get('channels', '-')} | "
                         f"{p.get('duration', 0):.3f} | {r['status']} |")
        lines.append("")
        for r in payload.get("results", []):
            for problem in r.get("problems", []):
                lines.append(f"- {r['id']}: {problem}")
        lines.append("")

    # ---- verdict --------------------------------------------------------------
    device_problems = sum(len(d.get("problems", [])) for d in device)
    format_failed = sum(len(f.get("failed", [])) for f in formats)
    lines.append("## Verdict")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"- Hard failures in the DSP matrix: **{total_fails}**")
    lines.append(f"- Anchors not met: **{len(failing_anchors)}**")
    lines.append(f"- Device sweeps with reported problems: **{device_problems}**")
    lines.append(f"- Formats failing verification: **{format_failed}**")

    report_path = Path(args.report) if args.report else root / "REPORT.md"
    report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"report: {report_path}")
    print(f"dsp shards {len(dsp)}, device sweeps {len(device)}, formats {len(formats)}, "
          f"hard fails {total_fails}, anchors failed {len(failing_anchors)}, "
          f"device problems {device_problems}, format failures {format_failed}")

    if args.json_out:
        Path(args.json_out).write_text(json.dumps({
            "dsp": by_effect, "device": device, "formats": formats,
            "hard_fails": total_fails, "anchors_failed": len(failing_anchors),
        }, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    return 1 if (total_fails or format_failed) else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

=================================================================================
FILE: tools/fxverify/analyze.py
=================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verdict engine for the TakeOne FX verification harness.

Reads the case manifests the JVM shards write, measures every render against
its dry reference, and produces per-case verdicts: universal invariants that
must hold for any audio processor, the directional expectations that are known
to be true for a given control, monotonicity evidence from the five-point
series, and the hand-authored anchors in expectations.json.

Usage:
  analyze.py --cases app/build/fxverify/<effect> --compact
  analyze.py --all --root fx-verify-runs/<run-id> --report REPORT.md
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import metrics as M  # noqa: E402

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DEFAULT_EXPECTATIONS = HERE / "expectations.json"

SERIES_METRICS = [
    "cmp.nrmse", "cmp.rms_delta_db", "cmp.centroid_delta_hz",
    "cmp.rolloff_delta_hz", "cmp.flatness_delta", "cmp.length_ratio",
    "cmp.corr", "cmp.band_delta_db.63", "cmp.band_delta_db.250",
    "cmp.band_delta_db.1000", "cmp.band_delta_db.4000",
    "cmp.band_delta_db.8000", "wet.crest_db", "wet.rms_db",
    "cmp.wet_probe.impulse_tail_db_delta", "cmp.wet_probe.gap_floor_db_delta",
    "cmp.wet_probe.hum_energy_db_delta", "cmp.wet_probe.sibilance_db_delta",
    "cmp.wet_probe.thd_db_delta", "cmp.wet_probe.fundamental_hz",
    "cmp.wet_probe.plosive_energy_db_delta",
]


def load_json(path: Path) -> dict:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        return json.load(fh)


def dotted(record: dict, key: str):
    """Reads 'cmp.band_delta_db.8000' style keys out of a nested record."""
    node = record
    parts = key.split(".")
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        if isinstance(node, dict) and part in node:
            node = node[part]
        else:
            # band keys contain dots themselves, rejoin the remainder
            rest = ".".join(parts[i:])
            if isinstance(node, dict) and rest in node:
                return node[rest]
            return None
    return node


def silence_ratio_of(x: np.ndarray, sr: int, start_frac: float) -> float:
    a = int(len(x) * start_frac)
    tail = x[a:]
    if tail.size == 0:
        return 1.0
    rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(tail ** 2)))
    return rms


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- invariants

def invariant_checks(case: dict, rec: dict, expectations: dict) -> tuple[list, list, list]:
    fails, warns, infos = [], [], []
    inv = expectations["invariants"]
    effect = case.get("effect", "")
    wet_basic = rec["wet"]

    if case.get("error"):
        fails.append(f"render threw {case['error']}")
    if case.get("skipped"):
        infos.append(f"skipped: {case['skipped']}")

    if wet_basic["nonfinite"] > 0:
        fails.append(f"{wet_basic['nonfinite']} non-finite samples in the render")

    peak = wet_basic["peak"]
    if peak > inv["blow_up_peak"]:
        # Not a loud setting: a render this far beyond full scale means the DSP
        # diverged rather than that the user asked for gain.
        fails.append(f"numeric blow-up: peak {peak:.3e}")
    elif peak > inv["max_wet_peak"] + 1e-3 and effect not in expectations["clipping_allowed"]:
        warns.append(f"peak {peak:.3f} above full scale")

    if not case.get("offlineOnly", False):
        if case.get("outFrames") != case.get("inFrames"):
            fails.append(f"in-place effect changed length "
                         f"{case.get('inFrames')} -> {case.get('outFrames')}")

    cmp_rec = rec["cmp"]
    dry_rms_db = rec["dry"]["rms_db"]
    wet_rms_db = wet_basic["rms_db"]
    if dry_rms_db > -40.0 and wet_rms_db < inv["silence_floor_db"]:
        # A parameter at its own extreme can legitimately mute the render (a
        # 20 kHz high cut, a 0 % generator amplitude), so this is a finding to
        # read rather than corruption. It is reported with the numbers.
        warns.append(f"render is silent (wet {wet_rms_db:.1f} dBFS from dry "
                     f"{dry_rms_db:.1f}); expected only at an extreme setting")

    if case.get("isDefaultValue") and case.get("kind") == "param":
        if cmp_rec["max_abs_diff"] > inv["neutral_identity_tolerance"]:
            infos.append("default value is not a no-op (expected for some effects)")

    return fails, warns, infos


# ------------------------------------------------------------ expectation rules

def inferred_expectation(case: dict) -> tuple[str, float, str] | None:
    """The directional claim that holds for this control by construction."""
    name = f"{case.get('paramName', '')} {case.get('param', '')}".lower()
    unit = (case.get("unit") or "").strip().lower()
    ptype = case.get("type", "")

    if any(k in name for k in ("freq", "cutoff", "f1", "f2", "center")):
        return ("cmp.centroid_delta_hz", 20.0, "a frequency control must move the spectral centroid")
    if unit == "db" or any(k in name for k in (
            "gain", "level", "amp", "vol", "makeup", "target", "ceiling",
            "thresh", "floor", "range", "depth")):
        return ("cmp.rms_delta_db", 0.5, "a level-style control must change loudness")
    if any(k in name for k in ("rate", "speed", "tempo", "percent", "factor", "repeats")):
        return ("cmp.length_ratio", 0.02, "a time-style control must change render length")
    if any(k in name for k in (
            "mix", "wet", "dry", "amount", "intensity", "sens", "reduction",
            "drive", "decay", "size", "time", "delay", "release", "attack",
            "hold", "width", "pan", "phase", "q", "smooth")):
        return ("cmp.nrmse", 0.02, "an amount-style control must change the signal")
    if ptype in ("BOOLEAN", "ENUM"):
        return ("cmp.nrmse", 0.01, "switching this option must change the signal")
    return None


def evaluate_case(case: dict, rec: dict, expectations: dict) -> dict:
    fails, warns, infos = invariant_checks(case, rec, expectations)
    cmp_rec = rec["cmp"]
    changed = (cmp_rec["max_abs_diff"] > 1e-6
               or abs(cmp_rec["length_delta_frames"]) > 0)

    expected = inferred_expectation(case)
    verdict = "ok"
    evidence = {}
    if not changed:
        # Nothing moved, so there is no expectation to judge: this is either a
        # neutral setting or a control that did not reach the audio at all.
        verdict = "no_change"
        if not case.get("isDefaultValue"):
            warns.append("no measurable change from this control")
    elif expected:
        key, min_abs, why = expected
        value = dotted(rec, key)
        evidence = {"expectation": why, "metric": key,
                    "value": None if value is None else round(float(value), 4),
                    "min_abs": min_abs}
        if value is None:
            verdict = "weak"
        elif abs(float(value)) >= min_abs:
            verdict = "single_point_ok"
        else:
            verdict = "expectation_not_met"
            warns.append(f"{why}: |{key}| = {abs(float(value)):.4f} < {min_abs}")
    else:
        verdict = "weak"

    if fails:
        verdict = "fail"

    return {
        "case": case.get("id"),
        "kind": case.get("kind"),
        "param": case.get("param"),
        "value": case.get("valueRaw"),
        "valueDisplay": case.get("valueDisplay"),
        "probe": case.get("probe"),
        "mode": case.get("mode"),
        "changed": bool(changed),
        "metrics": {
            "nrmse": round(cmp_rec["nrmse"], 6),
            "corr": round(cmp_rec["corr"], 6),
            "max_abs_diff": round(cmp_rec["max_abs_diff"], 8),
            "rms_delta_db": round(cmp_rec["rms_delta_db"], 4),
            "peak_delta_db": round(cmp_rec["peak_delta_db"], 4),
            "centroid_delta_hz": round(cmp_rec["centroid_delta_hz"], 3),
            "length_ratio": round(cmp_rec["length_ratio"], 6),
            "wet_peak_db": round(rec["wet"]["peak_db"], 3),
            "wet_rms_db": round(rec["wet"]["rms_db"], 3),
            "wet_crest_db": round(rec["wet"]["crest_db"], 3),
            "wet_transients": rec["wet"]["transients"],
            "wet_clip_ratio": round(rec["wet"]["clip_ratio"], 6),
        },
        "verdict": verdict,
        "evidence": evidence,
        "fails": fails,
        "warns": warns,
        "infos": infos,
    }


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- series pass

def evaluate_series(cases: list[dict], records: dict) -> list[dict]:
    grouped: dict[tuple, list] = {}
    for case in cases:
        if case.get("kind") != "series":
            continue
        grouped.setdefault((case["param"], case["probe"]), []).append(case)

    out = []
    for (param, probe), members in sorted(grouped.items()):
        members.sort(key=lambda c: c["seriesIndex"])
        values = [float(m["valueRaw"]) for m in members]
        best = None
        for metric in SERIES_METRICS:
            series_values = []
            ok = True
            for m in members:
                v = dotted(records[m["id"]], metric)
                if v is None or not math.isfinite(float(v)):
                    ok = False
                    break
                series_values.append(float(v))
            if not ok or len(series_values) < 3:
                continue
            spread = max(series_values) - min(series_values)
            if spread <= 0:
                continue
            rho = M.spearman(values, series_values)
            if best is None or abs(rho) > abs(best["rho"]):
                best = {"metric": metric, "rho": rho, "spread": spread,
                        "first": series_values[0], "last": series_values[-1]}
        entry = {
            "param": param,
            "probe": probe,
            "values": members[0].get("paramName", param),
            "points": [m["valueRaw"] for m in members],
            "verdict": "monotone_ok" if best and abs(best["rho"]) >= 0.9
                       else "monotone_weak",
        }
        if best:
            entry.update({
                "metric": best["metric"],
                "rho": round(best["rho"], 3),
                "spread": round(best["spread"], 4),
                "delta": round(best["last"] - best["first"], 4),
            })
        out.append(entry)
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- anchors

def run_series_anchors(expectations: dict, series: list[dict],
                       effect: str = "") -> list[dict]:
    # Keyed by effect as well as parameter: several effects expose a parameter
    # with the same id (freq, cutoff), and an anchor written for one of them must
    # not be judged against another's series.
    index = {(s["param"], s["probe"]): s for s in series}
    results = []
    for anchor in expectations.get("series_anchors", []):
        entry = {"id": anchor["id"], "why": anchor["why"], "kind": "series"}
        if anchor.get("effect") and effect and anchor["effect"] != effect:
            entry.update({"verdict": "missing", "detail": "anchor targets another effect"})
            results.append(entry)
            continue
        match = index.get((anchor["seriesParam"], anchor.get("probe")))
        if not match:
            entry.update({"verdict": "missing", "detail": "series not rendered"})
            results.append(entry)
            continue
        if match.get("metric") != anchor["metric"]:
            entry.update({
                "verdict": "not_met",
                "detail": f"the strongest monotone metric was {match.get('metric')} "
                          f"(rho {match.get('rho')}), not {anchor['metric']}; "
                          f"the control still moved the audio, just along another axis",
            })
            results.append(entry)
            continue
        rho = match.get("rho", 0.0)
        delta = match.get("delta", 0.0)
        direction_ok = (rho > 0) if anchor["direction"] == "increasing" else (rho < 0)
        magnitude_ok = abs(delta) >= anchor["min_abs"]
        entry.update({
            "verdict": "ok" if direction_ok and magnitude_ok else "not_met",
            "metric": match.get("metric"),
            "rho": rho,
            "delta": delta,
            "required": f"{anchor['direction']} by >= {anchor['min_abs']}",
        })
        results.append(entry)
    return results


def _load_pair(case_dir: Path, case: dict):
    dry, sr = M.read_float_wav(case_dir / case["dry"])
    wet, _ = M.read_float_wav(case_dir / case["wet"])
    return dry, wet, sr


def run_bespoke_anchors(expectations: dict, case_dir: Path,
                        by_id: dict, records: dict) -> list[dict]:
    results = []
    for anchor in expectations.get("bespoke_anchors", []):
        entry = {"id": anchor["id"], "why": anchor["why"], "kind": "bespoke"}
        case = by_id.get(anchor["case"])
        if not case or not case.get("wet"):
            entry.update({"verdict": "missing",
                          "detail": f"case {anchor['case']} not found"})
            results.append(entry)
            continue
        rec = records[case["id"]]
        check = anchor["check"]
        ok, detail = False, ""
        try:
            if check == "peak_below":
                peak_db = rec["wet"]["peak_db"]
                limit = anchor["limit_db"] + anchor["tolerance_db"]
                ok = peak_db <= limit
                detail = f"peak {peak_db:.2f} dBFS vs limit {limit:.2f} dBFS"
            elif check == "gap_floor_lower":
                delta = dotted(rec, "cmp.wet_probe.gap_floor_db_delta")
                if delta is None:
                    ok, detail = False, "the probe did not expose a gap floor"
                else:
                    ok = delta <= -anchor["min_db"]
                    detail = f"gap floor moved {delta:.2f} dB"
            elif check == "hum_lower":
                delta = dotted(rec, "cmp.wet_probe.hum_energy_db_delta")
                if delta is None:
                    ok, detail = False, "the probe did not expose hum energy"
                else:
                    ok = delta <= -anchor["min_db"]
                    detail = f"hum energy moved {delta:.2f} dB"
            elif check == "transients_fewer":
                ok = rec["wet"]["transients"] < rec["dry"]["transients"]
                detail = f"transients {rec['dry']['transients']} -> {rec['wet']['transients']}"
            elif check == "clip_ratio_lower":
                ok = rec["wet"]["clip_ratio"] < rec["dry"]["clip_ratio"]
                detail = f"clip ratio {rec['dry']['clip_ratio']:.4f} -> {rec['wet']['clip_ratio']:.4f}"
            elif check == "shorter":
                ok = rec["wet"]["frames"] < rec["dry"]["frames"]
                detail = f"frames {rec['dry']['frames']} -> {rec['wet']['frames']}"
            elif check == "tail_silent":
                dry, wet, sr = _load_pair(case_dir, case)
                tail = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(wet[int(len(wet) * 0.9):] ** 2)))
                ok = 20 * math.log10(max(tail, 1e-12)) <= -60.0
                detail = f"tail RMS {20 * math.log10(max(tail, 1e-12)):.1f} dBFS"
            elif check in ("reverse_corr", "invert_corr"):
                dry, wet, sr = _load_pair(case_dir, case)
                frames = min(len(dry), len(wet))
                ref = dry[:frames, 0][::-1] if check == "reverse_corr" else -dry[:frames, 0]
                test = wet[:frames, 0]
                corr = float(np.corrcoef(ref, test)[0, 1]) if test.std() > 1e-9 else 0.0
                ok = corr >= anchor["min_corr"]
                detail = f"correlation with the expected render {corr:.3f}"
            elif check == "interchannel_up":
                dry, wet, sr = _load_pair(case_dir, case)
                corr = M.stereo_metrics(wet).get("interchannel_corr", 0.0)
                ok = corr >= anchor["min_corr"]
                detail = f"inter-channel correlation {corr:.3f}"
            elif check == "rms_near_db":
                rms_db = rec["wet"]["rms_db"]
                ok = abs(rms_db - anchor["target_db"]) <= anchor["tolerance_db"]
                detail = f"RMS {rms_db:.2f} dBFS vs target {anchor['target_db']:.2f}"
            elif check == "channels_swapped":
                dry, wet, sr = _load_pair(case_dir, case)
                frames = min(len(dry), len(wet))
                if dry.shape[1] < 2 or wet.shape[1] < 2:
                    ok, detail = False, "stereo pair required"
                else:
                    left_to_right = float(np.corrcoef(dry[:frames, 0], wet[:frames, 1])[0, 1])
                    right_to_left = float(np.corrcoef(dry[:frames, 1], wet[:frames, 0])[0, 1])
                    ok = (left_to_right >= anchor["min_corr"]
                          and right_to_left >= anchor["min_corr"])
                    detail = (f"L->R {left_to_right:.3f}, R->L {right_to_left:.3f}")
            elif check == "identity":
                diff = rec["cmp"]["max_abs_diff"]
                ok = diff < 1e-6
                detail = f"max |wet - dry| = {diff:.3e}"
            elif check == "not_silent":
                ok = rec["wet"]["rms_db"] > -60.0
                detail = f"RMS {rec['wet']['rms_db']:.2f} dBFS"
            else:
                detail = f"unknown check {check}"
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - a failed check is a result
            ok, detail = False, f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        entry.update({"verdict": "ok" if ok else "not_met", "detail": detail})
        results.append(entry)
    return results


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------ main

def analyse_dir(case_dir: Path, expectations: dict, keep_anomalies: bool) -> dict:
    manifest = load_json(case_dir / "cases.json")
    effect = manifest["effect"]
    cases = manifest["cases"]
    records: dict[str, dict] = {}
    dry_cache: dict[str, tuple] = {}
    anomalies = []

    for case in cases:
        if not case.get("wet"):
            records[case["id"]] = {"error": case.get("error", "not rendered")}
            continue
        probe = case["probe"]
        # Cache by the reference file itself, not by probe name: the same probe
        # is reused across cases, but a manifest may legitimately point two cases
        # at different references.
        dry_key = case["dry"]
        if dry_key not in dry_cache:
            dry_cache[dry_key] = M.read_float_wav(case_dir / case["dry"])
        dry, sr = dry_cache[dry_key]
        wet, _ = M.read_float_wav(case_dir / case["wet"])
        case = dict(case, effect=effect)
        rec = {
            "dry": M.basic_metrics(dry, sr),
            "wet": M.basic_metrics(wet, sr),
            "cmp": M.compare(dry, wet, sr, probe),
        }
        rec["verdict"] = evaluate_case(case, rec, expectations)
        records[case["id"]] = rec
        # Keep the render itself only when the case failed or missed its
        # expectation: everything else is already summarised by the metrics.
        if rec["verdict"]["verdict"] in ("fail", "expectation_not_met"):
            anomalies.append(case["id"])

    verdicts = [records[c["id"]]["verdict"] for c in cases
                if isinstance(records.get(c["id"]), dict)
                and "verdict" in records[c["id"]]]
    series = evaluate_series(cases, {k: v for k, v in records.items() if "wet" in v})
    by_id = {c["id"]: dict(c, effect=effect) for c in cases}
    anchors = run_series_anchors(expectations, series, effect)
    anchors += run_bespoke_anchors(expectations, case_dir, by_id, records)

    summary = {
        "effect": effect,
        "title": manifest.get("title"),
        "cases": len(cases),
        "rendered": manifest.get("rendered"),
        "errors": manifest.get("errors", []),
        "fails": sum(1 for v in verdicts if v["verdict"] == "fail"),
        "expectation_not_met": sum(1 for v in verdicts if v["verdict"] == "expectation_not_met"),
        "single_point_ok": sum(1 for v in verdicts if v["verdict"] == "single_point_ok"),
        "weak": sum(1 for v in verdicts if v["verdict"] == "weak"),
        "no_change": sum(1 for v in verdicts if v["verdict"] == "no_change"),
        "findings": sum(1 for v in verdicts if v["warns"]),
        "blow_ups": sum(1 for v in verdicts
                        if any("blow-up" in f for f in v["fails"])),
        "nonfinite": sum(1 for v in verdicts
                         if any("non-finite" in f for f in v["fails"])),
        "silent": sum(1 for v in verdicts
                      if any("silent" in w for w in v["warns"])),
        "above_full_scale": sum(1 for v in verdicts
                                if any("above full scale" in w for w in v["warns"])),
        "series_ok": sum(1 for s in series if s["verdict"] == "monotone_ok"),
        "series_total": len(series),
        "anchors_ok": sum(1 for a in anchors if a["verdict"] == "ok"),
        "anchors_total": len(anchors),
        "params_covered": len({v["param"] for v in verdicts}),
    }

    out = {
        "summary": summary,
        "verdicts": verdicts,
        "series": series,
        "anchors": anchors,
        "anomalies": anomalies,
        "metrics": {
            cid: {
                "cmp": {k: v for k, v in rec["cmp"].items()
                        if not isinstance(v, dict) or k in ("wet_probe", "dry_probe")},
                "wet": rec["wet"],
                "dry": {"peak_db": rec["dry"]["peak_db"], "rms_db": rec["dry"]["rms_db"],
                        "transients": rec["dry"]["transients"],
                        "clip_ratio": rec["dry"]["clip_ratio"],
                        "frames": rec["dry"]["frames"]},
            } for cid, rec in records.items() if "wet" in rec
        },
    }

    with open(case_dir / "verdicts.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(out, fh, indent=1)
    with open(case_dir / "metrics.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(out["metrics"], fh, indent=1)

    if keep_anomalies and anomalies:
        dest = case_dir / "anomalies"
        dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for cid in anomalies:
            src = case_dir / "wet" / f"{cid}.wav"
            if src.is_file():
                shutil.copy2(src, dest / src.name)

    print(f"{effect}: {summary['cases']} cases | fails {summary['fails']} "
          f"(blow-up {summary['blow_ups']}, non-finite {summary['nonfinite']}) | "
          f"expectation_not_met {summary['expectation_not_met']} | "
          f"ok {summary['single_point_ok']} | weak {summary['weak']} | "
          f"no_change {summary['no_change']} | findings {summary['findings']} "
          f"(silent {summary['silent']}, over-scale {summary['above_full_scale']}) | "
          f"series {summary['series_ok']}/{summary['series_total']} | "
          f"anchors {summary['anchors_ok']}/{summary['anchors_total']}")
    for anchor in anchors:
        if anchor["verdict"] != "ok":
            print(f"  anchor {anchor['verdict']}: {anchor['id']} - "
                  f"{anchor.get('detail', anchor.get('required', ''))}")
    if summary["fails"]:
        for v in verdicts:
            if v["verdict"] == "fail":
                print(f"  FAIL {v['case']}: {v['fails']}")
    return out


def write_report(root: Path, summaries: list[dict], report_path: Path) -> None:
    lines = ["# FX verification report", "",
             f"Effects analysed: {len(summaries)}", "",
             "| effect | cases | fail | expectation not met | 1-point ok | weak | no change | series | anchors |",
             "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for s in sorted(summaries, key=lambda s: s["effect"]):
        lines.append(
            f"| {s['effect']} | {s['cases']} | {s['fails']} | "
            f"{s['expectation_not_met']} | {s['single_point_ok']} | {s['weak']} | "
            f"{s['no_change']} | {s['series_ok']}/{s['series_total']} | "
            f"{s['anchors_ok']}/{s['anchors_total']} |")
    total_fails = sum(s["fails"] for s in summaries)
    lines += ["", f"Total hard failures: {total_fails}", ""]
    if total_fails:
        lines.append("## Failures")
        for s in summaries:
            if s["fails"]:
                lines.append(f"### {s['effect']}")
                for e in s["errors"]:
                    lines.append(f"- error: {e}")
    report_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"report written to {report_path}")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--cases", action="append", default=[],
                    help="a shard directory containing cases.json")
    ap.add_argument("--root", default=".", help="run root for --all aggregation")
    ap.add_argument("--all", action="store_true",
                    help="analyse every shard directory under --root")
    ap.add_argument("--compact", action="store_true",
                    help="copy anomalies and delete the wet renders afterwards")
    ap.add_argument("--expectations", default=str(DEFAULT_EXPECTATIONS))
    ap.add_argument("--report", default=None)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    expectations = load_json(Path(args.expectations))
    dirs = [Path(p) for p in args.cases]
    root = Path(args.root)
    if args.all:
        dirs += sorted({p.parent for p in root.glob("*/cases.json")})

    if not dirs:
        print("nothing to analyse: pass --cases or --all", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    summaries = []
    for case_dir in dirs:
        if not (case_dir / "cases.json").is_file():
            print(f"skipping {case_dir}: no cases.json", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        out = analyse_dir(case_dir, expectations, keep_anomalies=True)
        summaries.append(out["summary"])
        if args.compact:
            wet_dir = case_dir / "wet"
            if wet_dir.is_dir():
                shutil.rmtree(wet_dir)

    if args.report:
        write_report(root, summaries, Path(args.report))
    return 1 if any(s["fails"] for s in summaries) else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

=================================================================================
FILE: tools/fxverify/check_drift.py
=================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fails when the effect catalog in the code and the CI matrix drift apart.

The workflow cannot build its matrix from a file, so the effect ids are written
into fx-verify.yml by hand. This check compares that list with the inventory the
JVM harness derives from the processors themselves, so a newly registered effect
is a build failure rather than a silent gap in coverage.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def matrix_effects(workflow: Path) -> list[str]:
    text = workflow.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    match = re.search(r"\n\s*effect:\s*\[(.*?)\]", text, re.S)
    if not match:
        raise SystemExit(f"no effect matrix found in {workflow}")
    body = match.group(1)
    return [item.strip().strip("'\"") for item in body.split(",") if item.strip()]


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--params", default="app/build/fxverify/params/params.json")
    ap.add_argument("--workflow", default=".github/workflows/fx-verify.yml")
    ap.add_argument("--inventory", default="app/build/fxverify/params/effect_ids.txt")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    params_path = Path(args.params)
    if not params_path.is_file():
        print(f"inventory missing: {params_path}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    inventory = [e["id"] for e in json.loads(
        params_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["effects"]]
    matrix = matrix_effects(Path(args.workflow))
    ids_file = Path(args.inventory)
    listed = [l.strip() for l in ids_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
              if l.strip()] if ids_file.is_file() else inventory

    problems = []
    if set(inventory) != set(matrix):
        problems.append("matrix and catalog differ: only in code "
                        f"{sorted(set(inventory) - set(matrix))}, only in matrix "
                        f"{sorted(set(matrix) - set(inventory))}")
    if len(matrix) != len(set(matrix)):
        duplicates = sorted({x for x in matrix if matrix.count(x) > 1})
        problems.append(f"matrix lists duplicates: {duplicates}")
    if set(listed) != set(inventory):
        problems.append("inventory file and params.json differ")

    print(f"catalog={len(inventory)} matrix={len(matrix)}")
    if problems:
        for p in problems:
            print(f"DRIFT: {p}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("no drift: the workflow matrix matches the effect catalog")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

FILE: tools/fxverify/extract_frames.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extracts review frames from every device-sweep recording in a run.

Per effect directory this writes:
  frames/step-NNN-<param>.png  one frame at the exact offset the test logged for
                               each parameter value it applied
  frames/timeline-NNNNN.png    the recording sampled at 1 fps, for anything that
                               happens between parameter changes
  filmstrip.jpg                the whole recording as a contact sheet

Usage: extract_frames.py <run-directory> [--max-timeline N]
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def run(cmd: list[str]) -> bool:
    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True).returncode == 0


def find_video(shot_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    here = sorted(shot_dir.glob("*.mp4"))
    if here:
        return here[0]
    beside = sorted(shot_dir.parent.glob("*.mp4"))
    if beside:
        return beside[0]
    deeper = sorted(shot_dir.parent.glob("*/*.mp4"))
    return deeper[0] if deeper else None


def extract_one(shots_path: Path, max_timeline: int) -> list[str]:
    """One effect directory may now hold one recording per parameter: each step
    entry names the video that owns its change."""
    effect_dir = shots_path.parent
    try:
        shots = json.loads(shots_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return [f"{effect_dir.name}: shots.json unreadable ({exc})"]
    if isinstance(shots, dict):
        shots = shots.get("shots", [])

    frames = effect_dir / "frames"
    frames.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    notes = []
    groups: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for shot in shots:
        key = shot.get("video") or "combined"
        groups.setdefault(key, []).append(shot)
    if not groups:
        notes.append(f"{effect_dir.name}: no shot entries")
        return notes

    for video_name, members in sorted(groups.items()):
        video = (effect_dir / video_name) if video_name != "combined" else None
        if video is None or not video.is_file():
            candidates = sorted(effect_dir.parent.glob("*.mp4"))
            video = candidates[0] if candidates else None
        if video is None:
            notes.append(f"{effect_dir.name}: recording missing for {video_name}")
            continue
        steps = 0
        for shot in members:
            offset = max(0.0, float(shot.get("videoOffsetMs", 0)) / 1000.0)
            name = "step-%s-%s.png" % (shot.get("param", "param"),
                                       shot.get("valueRaw", shot.get("index", 0)))
            target = frames / name
            if target.is_file():
                steps += 1
                continue
            if run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", "%.2f" % offset,
                    "-i", str(video), "-frames:v", "1", "-q:v", "3", str(target)]):
                steps += 1

        tag = members[0].get("param", "all")
        strip = effect_dir / f"filmstrip-{tag}.jpg"
        if not strip.is_file():
            run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", str(video), "-vf",
                 "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=4x6", "-frames:v", "1", str(strip)])
        timeline = sorted(frames.glob(f"timeline-{tag}-*.png"))
        if not timeline and max_timeline > 0:
            run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", str(video), "-vf",
                 f"fps=2,scale=320:-1", "-frames:v", "20",
                 str(frames / f"timeline-{tag}-%02d.png")])
        notes.append(f"{effect_dir.name}/{tag}: {steps} step frames, "
                     f"stripe {'ok' if strip.is_file() else 'failed'}")
    return notes


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("root", help="downloaded run directory")
    ap.add_argument("--max-timeline", type=int, default=20,
                    help="sampled frames per parameter recording")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    root = Path(args.root)
    manifests = sorted(root.rglob("shots.json"))
    if not manifests:
        print(f"no shots.json under {root}")
        return 1
    notes: list[str] = []
    for path in manifests:
        notes.extend(extract_one(path, args.max_timeline))
    for n in notes:
        print(n)
    print(f"processed {len(manifests)} effect manifests")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

=================================================================================
FILE: tools/fxverify/extract_frames.sh
=================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Extracts review frames from every device-sweep video in a downloaded run.
#
# Two sets come out of each effect directory:
#   frames/step-*.png  - one frame per parameter value, at the exact offset the
#                        test logged when it applied that value
#   frames/timeline-*  - a low-rate sweep of the whole recording, for spotting
#                        anything that happens between parameter changes
#
# Usage: extract_frames.sh <run-directory>
set -euo pipefail

root="${1:?usage: extract_frames.sh <run-directory>}"
found=0
# Android's sh has no /dev/fd, so the shot manifests go through a temp file
# rather than process substitution.
list="$(mktemp)"

find "$root" -name 'shots.json' | sort > "$list"
while IFS= read -r shots; do
  dir="$(dirname "$shots")"
  video="$(find "$dir" "$dir/.." -maxdepth 2 -name '*.mp4' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
  if [ -z "$video" ]; then
    echo "no video beside $shots"
    continue
  fi
  found=$((found + 1))
  mkdir -p "$dir/frames"
  python3 - "$shots" "$video" "$dir/frames" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys

shots_path, video, out_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3])
data = json.loads(pathlib.Path(shots_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if isinstance(data, dict):
    data = data.get("shots", [])
for shot in data:
    offset = max(0.0, float(shot.get("videoOffsetMs", 0)) / 1000.0)
    name = "step-%03d-%s.png" % (shot.get("index", 0), shot.get("param", "param"))
    target = out_dir / name
    if target.is_file():
        continue
    subprocess.run(
        ["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", "%.2f" % offset, "-i", video,
         "-frames:v", "1", "-q:v", "3", str(target)], check=False)
print("%s: %d step frames" % (pathlib.Path(video).name, len(data)))
PY

  ffmpeg -v error -y -i "$video" -vf "fps=1,scale=480:-1" \
    "$dir/frames/timeline-%05d.png" 2>/dev/null || true
  ffmpeg -v error -y -i "$video" -vf "fps=1/3,scale=200:-1,tile=6x5" \
    -frames:v 1 "$dir/filmstrip.jpg" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "$dir: frames + filmstrip written"
done < "$list"
rm -f "$list"

echo "processed $found effect recordings"

=================================================================================
FILE: tools/fxverify/make_vision_prompts.py
=================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Builds one review prompt per effect for the vision pass.

Each prompt names the exact images to inspect (the screenshots taken as every
parameter value was applied, the frames extracted at those same offsets, and the
filmstrip) and pins the JSON verdict schema, so a vision model can be pointed at
one effect at a time with no ambiguity about what it is looking at.

Usage:
  make_vision_prompts.py --run fx-verify-runs/<id> [--out fx-verify-runs/<id>/vision]
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = """{
  "effect": "<effect id>",
  "videoReviewed": true|false,
  "imagesReviewed": <int>,
  "uiErrors": [
    {"image": "<file name>", "kind": "crash|anr|toast|dialog|layout|missing-control|other",
     "evidence": "<what is visibly on screen>", "confidence": "high|medium|low"}
  ],
  "waveformFindings": [
    {"image": "<file name>", "observation": "<does the waveform look like the parameter change implies?>",
     "verdict": "expected|unexpected|unclear"}
  ],
  "artifacts": ["<visual artefact that is not an error>"],
  "unknownControls": ["<control whose purpose is not clear from the screens>"],
  "verdict": "clean|minor-issues|problems",
  "summary": "<two sentences, plain language>"
}"""


def build_prompt(effect_dir: Path, run_name: str) -> str | None:
    shots_path = effect_dir / "shots.json"
    result_path = effect_dir / "result.json"
    if not shots_path.is_file():
        return None
    shots = json.loads(shots_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    result = json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if result_path.is_file() else {}

    images = []
    for shot in shots:
        jpg = effect_dir / shot.get("shot", "")
        step = effect_dir / "frames" / ("step-%03d-%s.png" % (shot.get("index", 0), shot.get("param", "param")))
        images.append({
            "label": f"{shot.get('paramName')} = {shot.get('valueDisplay')}"
                     f"{' (default)' if shot.get('isDefault') else ''}",
            "screenshot": str(jpg) if jpg.is_file() else None,
            "video_frame": str(step) if step.is_file() else None,
        })
    filmstrip = effect_dir / "filmstrip.jpg"
    timeline = sorted((effect_dir / "frames").glob("timeline-*.png"))

    lines = []
    lines.append(f"You are reviewing a screen recording of the Android audio app "
                 f"'TakeOne' while the '{result.get('effect', effect_dir.name)}' effect "
                 f"('{result.get('title', '')}') was applied to a recording.")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"Run: {run_name}. Recording: {effect_dir / (result.get('videoName') or 'video.mp4')}")
    lines.append(f"The sweep applied {result.get('shotCount', len(shots))} parameter states, "
                 f"took a screenshot of each, and recorded video throughout. "
                 f"Degraded run: {result.get('degraded')}. "
                 f"Reported problems: {result.get('problems') or 'none'}.")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Read EVERY image below with the read_file tool (they are JPEG/PNG; "
                 "read them one by one, they are small). Each entry pairs the screenshot "
                 "taken at that parameter value with the video frame from the same moment.")
    lines.append("")
    for i, img in enumerate(images, 1):
        parts = [f"{i}. {img['label']}"]
        if img["screenshot"]:
            parts.append(f"screenshot: {img['screenshot']}")
        if img["video_frame"]:
            parts.append(f"video frame: {img['video_frame']}")
        lines.append(" | ".join(parts))
    lines.append("")
    if filmstrip.is_file():
        lines.append(f"Filmstrip of the whole recording (every ~3 s): {filmstrip}")
    if timeline:
        lines.append(f"Timeline frames sampled at 1 fps: {timeline[0].parent}/timeline-*.png "
                     f"({len(timeline)} files)")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("What to look for:")
    lines.append("- any crash, ANR ('isn't responding'), error toast, red error text, or unexpected dialog")
    lines.append("- controls that are missing, overlapping, clipped, or unreadable")
    lines.append("- the waveform: it should visibly change as parameters that alter the signal are moved, "
                 "and stay stable otherwise; below the waveform the effect panel should show the parameter "
                 "value that is being applied")
    lines.append("- anything else a user would notice as broken")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Answer with ONLY a JSON object in exactly this shape (no prose outside it):")
    lines.append(SCHEMA)
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--run", required=True, help="downloaded run directory")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=None)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    run = Path(args.run)
    out = Path(args.out) if args.out else run / "vision"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    written = 0
    for shots in sorted(run.rglob("shots.json")):
        effect_dir = shots.parent
        prompt = build_prompt(effect_dir, run.name)
        if not prompt:
            continue
        (out / f"{effect_dir.name}.md").write_text(prompt, encoding="utf-8")
        written += 1
    print(f"wrote {written} vision prompts into {out}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

=================================================================================
FILE: tools/fxverify/metrics.py
